Technical UID S_LOW_Park_FanclubMember02 UUID c11362d2-c6dd-48e7-87a1-775562ede7f1 Stats HalfElf_Commoner Caerdwyn is a high half-elf who can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ Yeah, the book was a lot more... lewd than its prequels. „ — Caerdwyn , discussing the group's most recent book Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Caerdwyn can be encountered in Bloomridge Park in the Lower City discussing books with Kepli and Morgan during their book club. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Caerdwyn, Kepli, and Morgan discuss Dusk's Dark Desires at book club: Kepli So - Book Brigade. What did we think of Dusk's Dark Desires? Caerdwyn A thrilling read. Gave me goosepimples. Morgan Goosepimples are right - bits of the book were downright naughty. Kepli Morgan, please . We're in public, let's keep away from the book's racier parts. Morgan Racy? More like juicy. A very juicy read. Caerdwyn Yeah, the book was a lot more... lewd than its prequels. Kepli Please focus, we're the Book Brigade, not a smut symposium! Kepli Now, I personally loved the book's setting. Twisty corridors, flickering candlelight - oh, it's just such compelling reading. Morgan Nah, the blood and sex were the best bits. Of any book, really. Caerdwyn No, I'm with Kepli. The novel's sense of intrigue was its finest quality. Morgan Don't get me wrong - the book intrigued me. In all the right ways. Caerdwyn So, Kepli - who was your favourite character in the book? Kepli I really liked what the author did with Bedford. Caerdwyn I agree. Who'd have thought a were-cow could be written so beautifully? Morgan You're fools, obviously Dusk was the story's best character. Kepli The novel's protagonist is such a basic choice, Morgan. Listen, I know what I like - and the book delivered it in spades . Technical UID S_LOW_BaldursMouth_Gossiper_001 UUID 5a7185d6-1f54-4870-831c-991f9743ea24 Stats Human_Commoner Caitlin is a patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ You want the who's who and the what's what? Speak to Carys. She's always got the best goss - none of it's been wrong yet. „ — Caitlin Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Caitlin can be found at the Elfsong Tavern in the Lower City , asking Carys for the latest gossip from the Baldur's Mouth Gazette . Carys warns the party to be wary of Caitlin, who she describes as an "awful liar". If Enver Gortash is defeated, Caitlin leaves and cannot be interacted with again. However, Carys still tells the party not to "believe Cait over there" even though she is no longer around. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Caitlin Broadsheet's rather dull today. Don't suppose you've learnt anything... juicier, of late, Carys? Carys Afraid not - both the gossip and the Gazette have been drier than the Anauroch recently. Caitlin It's a shame, Ettvard used to do such a good job running the Gazette. Carys But these days it's hard to tell if I'm reading the Baldur's Mouth or Gortash's diary! Caitlin Oh, come now, Carys, the broadsheet isn't that bad. Carys I don't know, Caitlin, I've read the Mouth for years - this is the closest to a rag it's ever been! Caitlin Found anything interesting in today's broadsheet, Carys? Carys Hah! Not of late - unless you want more lordly boot-licking - straight from the Baldur's Mouth! Caitlin What about Estra's column? She always has something juicy in the Gazette. Carys Even Estra's column has been lacking sauce of late... It's a real shame. It's not what it used to be, the Baldur's Mouth. Not at all. Carys Some real excitement in the Gazette this morning, Cait!  (If the Gazette publishes a positive article on the party) Caitlin Oh, what fantastic news - just as I was worried I'd have to find a new broadsheet. Carys A group of heroical adventurers slew a necromancer! At least, according to the Mouth. Caitlin I don't know, Carys. Could just be a tall tale - wouldn't be the first to cross the Gazette's pages. Carys Oh, don't be a bore, Caitlin! Besides, it's better than another fluff piece about the Gate's nobility. Caitlin Say, Carys, did you read the gazette this morning?  (If the Gazette publishes a negative article on the party) Carys Indeed I did. But, dear Caitlin, not everything made it to print. Caitlin No. You're telling me the Baldur's Mouth kept information back? Carys Oh yes - you'll never guess what I heard about the vagabonds. Caitlin Oh, do spill, Carys! Carys They call themselves 'adventurers' - they've not slain a single dragon. Technical UID S_GLO_ProdigyBrother UUID d0187724-c0e2-4019-a01d-a03ee8153f1b Stats Tiefling_Melee Eqp. EQP_Javelin_Leather_Shield Trs. DEN_Refugee Cal is a tiefling in Act One in the Emerald Grove . He is arguing with his siblings Lia and Rolan . “ Please! I can hardly hear myself think over the pair of you. „ — Cal , arguing with his siblings Contents 1 Background 2 Involvement 2.1 Act One 2.1.1 Convince to stay 2.1.2 Convince to leave 2.2 Camp celebration 2.3 Act Two 2.4 Act Three 3 Companion approval 4 Combat 4.1 Attacks and actions 4.2 Notable loot 5 Related quests 6 Idle banter 7 Notes Background [ edit section | visual editor ] Cal, Lia, and Rolan grew up together. While Cal and Lia are biological siblings, all three of them maintain a sibling relationship with each other. Out of the trio, Cal has the calmest temper, often serving as a mediator between the two. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Cal is in the The Hollow of the Emerald Grove , arguing with Lia , and Rolan on whether they should remain to help the tiefling refugees or leave. While Cal attempts to mediate, Lia fervently believes they should stay and help the tiefling refugees, while Rolan thinks they should leave. The party can convince them to leave or stay: [ 1 ] Convince to stay [ edit section | visual editor ] The following options convince the trio to stay: [ 2 ] [PERSUASION]  You should all stay. A single blade could make a difference. (DC 10) [DRAGONBORN]  Clan is everything. You don't abandon those you swore to protect. [TIEFLING]  Have you forgotten Elturel? We should stand by our people - no one else will. [BARBARIAN]  Only cowards run from a fight. [RANGER]  I'd choose the wilderness over the dangers of a city any day. Stay. [MONK]  To leave is a heavy choice - it will weigh on whatever path you walk next. [PALADIN]  'Where the weak have need, the strong have a duty'. Stay. Convince to leave [ edit section | visual editor ] The following options convince the trio to leave. [ 2 ] Get out while you can - the goblins will be back. [GITHYANKI]  If they cannot fight, they will die. That is as it should be. [EVIL CLERIC]  Why die for those who can't defend themselves? All other options, or deciding not to interact with them causes them to leave on their own as well. Camp celebration [ edit section | visual editor ] If the goblin leaders are killed, Cal takes part in the festivities at the party's Camp alongside Lia and Rolan. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If the trio are convinced to stay behind to help, and all three survive Act One, they are split apart in Act Two . When the tiefling refugees are ambushed, Cal and Lia are abducted by cultists and held captive in Moonrise Towers Prison . The remaining tieflings at the Last Light Inn then ask the party to ⁠ Rescue the Tieflings . If not freed from Moonrise Towers before dealing with the Nightsong , his corpse is disposed of in the Oubliette with those of all the other prisoners. [ 3 ] Cal does not appear in Act Two if the trio are not convinced to stay. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If Cal survives Act Two and Rolan chooses to side with the party against Lorroakan , he appears in Sorcerous Sundries together with Lia, one long rest after Lorroakan's death. Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] Convincing Cal, Lia and Rolan to stay:   +1   +1 Convincing Cal, Lia and Rolan to leave:   +1 Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Javelin Damage: 4~9 1d6 + 3 ⁠ Piercing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Ansur's Finest Recruitment Poster Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Raid the Grove ⁠ Rescue the Tieflings ⁠ Save the Refugees Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Cal attempts to calm Lia and Rolan as they argue about whether to stay in the Grove during Act One: Rolan We don't even know these people! Lia That doesn't matter. Rolan Of course it does. You would choose strangers over us! Lia That's not what I said. Cal Can we stop shouting? No? Cal Calm down! Please . Lia I won't leave them behind! Rolan You're going to get us killed! If Cal, Lia, and Rolan stay in the Grove: Cal Don't be grumpy, Rolan. We'll get to the city soon. Rolan I am not grumpy. Cal The scowl on your face would frighten a troll. Rolan Heh. You're an idiot. Cal How long until Rolan shows off his Thunderwave? Lia Depends. How many people are dumb enough to ask? Cal Hah! True. If Cal, Lia, and Rolan do not stay in the Grove: Cal How long will it take to get to Baldur's Gate? Rolan Depends. How often are you going to ask that? Cal Hey, sis. How long will it take to get to Baldur's Gate? Lia *Sigh.* Rolan We should add the Elfsong Tavern to the list. Lia So long as you're paying. Cal Drinks on Rolan? Count me in. Rolan I swear, I've never met such a pair of cheapskates. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ If Cal, Lia, and Rolan are convinced to remain in the Grove, the party is granted 15 XP. No XP is granted if they leave. ↑ 2.0 2.1 Dialogue file: Act1/DEN/DEN_Prodigy_Group ↑ In Patch 8 he may also die even if the party do free the prisoners from Moonrise Towers before dealing with the Nightsong. After the ceremony ends, Lord Bormul moves to the southern nave of the Audience Hall and stands near the first table with refreshments. If spoken to, he says that, in his opinion, Balduran himself would approve current course of events. If the party choose to confront Gortash, they can later find Lord Bormul along with all other invited guests and their retinue – slaughtered in the Audience Hall. Gold_Pocket_Random Harper Callie is a cheerful but vicious [ 1 ] Harper at Last Light Inn during Act Two . She reports directly to Jaheira , relaying information from Quartermaster Talli to her. “ Pretty as you are, this is no time for a natter. Head on in to Last Light. „ — Callie Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Callie is at the Last Light Inn , where she guards the entrance to the inn proper and watches over the main plaza from behind a barricade, next to the main door. Occasionally, she steps away from her post to talk to Jaheira [ 2 ] about absolutist patrols, or talks with Quartermaster Talli about supplies. [ 3 ] If the party is vouched for by Marcus but then exposes him as a True Soul , Callie joins the fight against his summoned Crawling Claws if she is close enough. Depending on proximity, she may be Stunned or Surprised . Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Callie more often than not fails her saving throw and is Impaled for the remainder of the battle. If Isobel is not saved, Callie and everyone in Last Light Inn turn into a Shadow-Cursed Undead , save for Jaheira. Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn, and the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise, Callie follows Jaheira to Moonrise Towers . However, Callie is killed during the fight against Absolute forces before the party can arrive. Her corpse is on the bridge leading to Moonrise Towers, implying she was amongst the first to fall in battle. WYR_Circus_GenericPerformer Calliope Blingsdorf is a Gnome Bard performing at the Circus of the Last Days in Act Three . “ You will never be half the bard Ms. Silvertongue is - do you hear me? „ — Calliope Blingsdorf Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Calliope performs alongside Viola Silvertongue , who he holds in great esteem, and plays the Hand Drums . His infatuation with Viola extends to being quite harsh to those he perceives as a threat to her position - namely, bards who have been mistaken for new hires. They usually fulfill certain roles, such as resurrecting dead party members or providing lore. Technical UID S_LOW_Client_004 UUID e3fa81d4-53f3-49ad-8497-18673d399a37 Stats Elf_Commoner Cappa Delourese is an elven customer of the Sorcerous Sundries shop in the Lower City in Act Three . “ My advice? Cobble together what you can from what's left and wait for this all to blow over. „ — Cappa Delourese Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Cappa is talking about the state of the Sorcerous Sundries to Hector Roba in the main lobby. She advises Hector to wait until the whole situation with the Absolute blows over, but he insists on remaining until Lorroakan sees him. Idle dialogue [ edit section | visual editor ] Cappa Delourese Find what you're looking for? Hector Roba No, I did not find what I'm looking for. Did you? Cappa Delourese Not a dicky bird. It's really quite disappointing. Hector Roba I've good mind to march up there and speak to Lorroakan myself. Cappa Delourese You might want to be careful - I've heard he's not really one for customer service. Hector Roba What do you mean 'not one for customer service'? Cappa Delourese I saw somebody go up to Lorroakan's tower last tenday - looked a proper fright when they came out. Hector Roba Surely you can't just go roughing up your customers? Especially if you're the one at fault! Cappa Delourese Apparently Lorroakan can. Hector Roba This is ludicrous! My complaints will be heard! Cappa Delourese Well, it might just be there's not much left - the Absolute's making people panic. Hector Roba Absolute or not, I still need my full complement of herbs - how am I supposed to do any healing without them? DEN_Refugee Bex is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One . She is married to Danis . “ Thank you for saving us - again . I'm never leaving Bex's side again. Never ever. „ — Danis on Bex Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act One 1.2 Act Two 1.3 Act Three 2 Combat 2.1 Attacks and actions 3 Idle banter 4 Related quests 5 Gallery 6 Notes and references Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Bex is usually with Danis in the Grove at X: 165 Y: 550 . If spoken with, she shares some of her hopes and dreams for Baldur's Gate , such as getting a dog. If the party decide to ⁠ Raid the Grove , Bex hides in the Secluded Chamber with other tieflings. If she survives ⁠ Defeat the Goblins , she and Danis join the celebration at the party's Campsite . She attempts to dance but realises she has had several drinks too many. Githyanki characters get a unique "humorous" dialogue option, asking about cats. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If Bex and Danis survive Act One, she moves to the Last Light Inn at X: -37 Y: 180 . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party enter the Iron Throne, Enver Gortash remotely triggers explosions which soon collapse the building. Caralee is trapped in the cell immediately south-west of the central ladder. If freed, she dashes towards the Submersible to escape. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] The only action Caralee uses on any turn is Dash , with the help of the Glimpse of Freedom condition which is applied when the cage is opened. Dash ( ) Cover more distance this turn: double your Movement Speed . Range: Self Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Potion of Speed Scale Mail Explorer only [ edit section | visual editor ] Caralee has 50% more HP and cannot be pushed or shoved. WYR_FigaroSister_Trader Carmen Pennygood is a merchant who works in the store she owns, Carm's Garms , in Wyrm's Crossing . “ Welcome back to Carm's Garms, we've got clothes for your... arms? Um. What do you need? „ — Carmen Pennygood Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Carmen stocks a collection dyes and low-priced Camp Clothing . She is the sister of Figaro Pennygood the owner of Facemaker's Boutique in the Lower City . Carmen and Figaro's father recently passed, and the two have an uneasy relationship. The party can speak to Carmen about Figaro's name appearing on a hit-list. She is concerned, but insists that the party should warn Figaro as he would not believe her. Carmen will comment on it if the character talking to her is wearing an outfit bought from Figaro. Notable items sold [ edit section | visual editor ] Corresponds to WYR_FigaroSister_Trader . Technical UID S_LOW_BaldursMouth_Gossiper_002 UUID 524b5ff3-1b9b-43bf-bb48-d5844b5c09b3 Stats Gnome_Commoner Carys is a patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ Don't get me wrong, I like a wee gossip as much as the rest, but Caitlin does get a bit carried away with the tall tales. „ — Carys Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Carys can be found at the Elfsong Tavern in the Lower City . She warns the party not to believe anything from gossiper Caitlin , saying she is an "awful liar". Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Caitlin Broadsheet's rather dull today. Don't suppose you've learnt anything... juicier, of late, Carys? Carys Afraid not - both the gossip and the Gazette have been drier than the Anauroch recently. Caitlin It's a shame, Ettvard used to do such a good job running the Gazette. Carys But these days it's hard to tell if I'm reading the Baldur's Mouth or Gortash's diary! Caitlin Oh, come now, Carys, the broadsheet isn't that bad. Carys I don't know, Caitlin, I've read the Mouth for years - this is the closest to a rag it's ever been! Caitlin Found anything interesting in today's broadsheet, Carys? Carys Hah! Not of late - unless you want more lordly boot-licking - straight from the Baldur's Mouth! Caitlin What about Estra's column? She always has something juicy in the Gazette. Carys Even Estra's column has been lacking sauce of late... It's a real shame. It's not what it used to be, the Baldur's Mouth. Not at all. Carys Some real excitement in the Gazette this morning, Cait!  (If the Gazette publishes a positive article on the party) Caitlin Oh, what fantastic news - just as I was worried I'd have to find a new broadsheet. Carys A group of heroical adventurers slew a necromancer! At least, according to the Mouth. Caitlin I don't know, Carys. Could just be a tall tale - wouldn't be the first to cross the Gazette's pages. Carys Oh, don't be a bore, Caitlin! Besides, it's better than another fluff piece about the Gate's nobility. Caitlin Say, Carys, did you read the gazette this morning?  (If the Gazette publishes a negative article on the party) Carys Indeed I did. But, dear Caitlin, not everything made it to print. Caitlin No. You're telling me the Baldur's Mouth kept information back? Carys Oh yes - you'll never guess what I heard about the vagabonds. Caitlin Oh, do spill, Carys! Carys They call themselves 'adventurers' - they've not slain a single dragon. Caitlin Good gods , how scandalous! v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the Lower City Anti-Hag Support Group Adrielle Hydrangea Wubb Jatlo Kled Mayrina Baldur's Mouth Gazette Baalfe Baz Hopbank Technical UID S_WYR_GurCamp_Hunter_001 UUID a4ef7429-bca0-4e2f-9aab-a4eff9ac95e9 Stats WYR_GurHunter_Melee_Mirage Eqp. EQP_Scimitar_Leather_DW Trs. Wyr_GurHunter Cassivora Dophir is one of the Gur , the human nomadic tribe. She is in the Gur Camp in Rivington in Act 3 . “ We are begging help from you? An outsider? „ — Cassivora Dophir at the Gur Camp in Rivington Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Cassivora Dophir is in the Gur Camp attending a funeral along with her peers for the fallen from a recent offensive on Cazador's palace. Cassivora with her fellow Gur, all members of a group of monster hunters lead by Ulma , are looking for their children, who have been kidnapped by Cazador's spawn. The nomads have camped in Rivington, and are trying to mount a rescue or seek revenge. Ulma asks the party to help defeat Cazador and discover the fate of their abducted children. Once Cazador is defeated, Cassivora along with Ulma and the other Gur move near the waypoint in Cazador's Dungeon . She attacks the party if the ritual held in the dungeon is completed. If Astarion was turned in to Gandrel in Act One and kidnapped, then in Act Three Dominica and all of her fellow Gur (except Gandrel) are dead. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Scimitar Damage: 5~10 1d6 + 4 ⁠ Slashing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Leather Armour Scimitar - 2x Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] A group of Gur hunters discuss dealing with Cazador's spawns. Katelyn Lerskin I'll destroy every last bloodsucker, I swear it. Oliver Quarlic There'll always be more. They spread like locusts. Cassivora Dophir So we should do nothing? Just wait for the next wave? Cassivora Dophir We cannot rush into their claws again. Another defeat will wipe us out. Oliver Quarlic What if this is it for our people? What if this is the end? Cassivora Dophir Then we should end it on our terms, not hiding in fear. Katelyn Lerskin They need to be wiped out - exterminated. Nothing less will do. Oliver Quarlic And if we fail? Who will stand between them and the innocent? Cassivora Dophir If we do nothing, the innocent will suffer just the same. We have no good choices. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] The cat is an illusion cast via the spell Minor Illusion and lasts 10 turns. When cast outside of combat, it causes most NPCs to walk towards the illusion and surround it. During combat, it causes enemies to turn towards the illusion. The illusion activates traps if placed on top of them and if placed on top of a vent, the illusion prevents gas from coming out, just as if a physical item were placed there. ## Cazador Szarr
- **来源**: [Cazador Szarr](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Cazador_Szarr)
- **分类**: Characters、Bosses

Overview Combat Cazador Szarr Vampire Lord In-game Portrait Full Name Cazador Szarr Identity Male Voice / Actor Graham Hoadly Main Writer Stephen Rooney Family Amanita Szarr (niece) Fistula Dralia Blovart Donnela Szarr [ 1 ] Hometown Szarr Palace , Baldur's Gate Stats Size Medium Type Undead Race Undead , Vampire Technical UID S_GLO_Cazador UUID 2f1880e6-1297-4ca3-a79c-9fabc7f179d3 Stats GLO_Cazador Cazador Szarr [ 2 ] is a vampire in Baldur's Gate 3 and Astarion's former master. He is the primary antagonist of Astarion's personal quest, The Pale Elf . “ First, thou shalt not drink of the blood of thinking creatures. Second, thou shalt obey me in all things. Third, thou shalt not leave my side unless directed. Four, thou shalt know that thou art mine . „ — Cazador Szarr 's four rules he enforces upon his Vampire Spawn, including Astarion Contents 1 Overview 1.1 History 2 Involvement 2.1 Act One 2.2 Act Two 2.3 Act Three 3 The Black Mass Ritual 3.1 Letting Astarion finish the Ritual 3.2 Convincing Astarion to kill Cazador and stop the Ritual 3.3 Refusing to help Astarion 3.4 Killing Cazador without Astarion in the party 3.5 Interrupting the ritual 3.6 Breaking the ritual 4 Combat 5 Loot 6 Related literature 7 Related quests 8 Gallery 9 Notes and references Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] History [ edit section | visual editor ] Cazador became a Vampire Lord in the year 1276, claiming the position of Master Vampire of Baldur's Gate from Vellioth the Martinet. [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] While not making an appearance until Act Three, Cazador's influence is felt earlier. If Astarion is chosen as Origin , he experiences a dream sequence involving Cazador, where he recites four rules he enforces amongst his spawn. Astarion as a companion can also show the party the scars on his back, which are ultimately revealed to be part of an Infernal Pact. What this pact entails is unknown, but he assumes it is extremely important to Cazador. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] While still not appearing in Act Two, Astarion can decipher the meaning of the pact with the help of Raphael . Cazador intends Astarion's scars be used as part of a ritual imparted to him by Mephistopheles . When performed, the recipient of the ritual becomes Vampire Ascendant , a creature that retains all the power of a Vampire, but none of their weaknesses (e.g., sunlight) or thirst for blood. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Once in Baldur's Gate, the party can hunt down Cazador at Cazador's Palace and, if met, is in his Dungeon , where he reveals that the ritual requires not just seven of the known spawn he sired, but thousands of others. The 'meals' Astarion brought Cazador were not for him to feed on, but rather prepared and turned into spawn for use in his infernal ritual. Upon encountering Cazador, he typically reclaims Astarion, and tries to use him for the ritual. Should the party free Astarion and defeat Cazador, Astarion readies himself to take over the ritual, and absorb the power for himself – only for Cazador to reveal that if Astarion chooses to continue the ritual himself, he will simply be consumed by it; he has the marks of the pact on his back and as the ritual requires an exact amount of such marked souls, it will still take his as a result. Astarion and the rest of the party must then make an important choice. The Black Mass Ritual [ edit section | visual editor ] Ecce dominus! Letting Astarion finish the Ritual [ edit section | visual editor ] Should the party assist Astarion in finishing the ritual, he connects to the player character's parasite and copies the scars on his back onto Cazador's own flesh, therefore fulfilling the requirements for the ritual, while allowing himself to remain alive. Astarion then consumes the essence of Cazador and the thousands of Vampire Spawn he sired, and successfully becomes the Vampire Ascendant. Convincing Astarion to kill Cazador and stop the Ritual [ edit section | visual editor ] If the player character succeeds a Persuasion or Insight check, Astarion renounces the ritual for himself, and instead stabs Cazador to death, falling to his knees, and sobbing, finally free of Cazador's tyranny. If any Vampire Spawn who are present die during the fight, the Vampire Ascendent ritual cannot be conducted, and Astarion defaults to this option (see 'Breaking the ritual' below). Refusing to help Astarion [ edit section | visual editor ] If the player character refuses to help Astarion without convincing him – or fails the skill checks and still refuses to help him – Astarion kills Cazador in the same sequence as above, but then destroys Cazador's Woe , leaving the Vampire Spawn to rot. After this, he permanently leaves the party, stating with venom that he hopes they "die screaming". Killing Cazador without Astarion in the party [ edit section | visual editor ] If Astarion is not brought to the fight it is possible to stab Cazador while he is in his coffin [ 5 ] . Mentioning this to Astarion afterwards infuriates him but he does not leave the party for it unless the player character has negative approval of more than -40 with him. Interrupting the ritual [ edit section | visual editor ] The party can choose to interrupt Astarion partway through the ritual. If they do, the player character throws Cazador's Rhapsody at Cazador, killing him and making the ritual impossible to complete. Astarion then destroys Cazador's staff and attacks the party, forcing them to kill him. Breaking the ritual [ edit section | visual editor ] Killing one or more sacrificial Vampire Spawn during the fight with Cazador results in Astarion killing Cazador and staying with the party without complaint (even if he is in the fight and witnesses a Vampire Spawn dying). Astarion's remaining siblings then flee the scene, skipping their normal cutscene. Several characters, including the Gur party, then react as if Astarion voluntarily forfeited the ritual. No matter which choice the party decides on, Cazador ultimately dies. If Cazador is killed while ascended, party members with the Soldier background gain the ⁠ Rudolph Van Richtover My Dead Body inspiration. BG_Bandit Caïros is the envoy of the Stone Lord , and is in the middle of an argument with the Guild on the Western Beach in Rivington during Act Three . “ End of the line, Guildy - you shouldn't've trusted those mice you call men. „ — Caïros , taunting Farlin and her gang Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Caïros is at the Western Beach west of the South Span Checkpoint in Wyrm's Crossing during Act Three at X: -212 Y: Y:87 . He and a group of members of the Stone Lord's thugs are arguing with some members of the Guild near a docked ship from Moonrise Towers , accessible by taking the western path between the South Span Checkpoint and Open Hand Temple . Upon approaching the two groups, Farlin asks for help fighting the Stone Lord's men, promising that the Guild will pay. If the party agree to help, the Guild joins them in a fight against the Stone Lord's men. Doing so grants the inspiration ⁠ Stacking the Deck for party members with the Criminal background. If the party decline to assist, appeal to Cairos, or prevent either side from fighting, both groups turn hostile. The party can also wait nearby for the fight to begin, join in, or wait for it to end. If Minsc is present, he can try to explain that he is the Stone Lord, but Caïros does not believe him. If Caïros' side wins the fight and the party kill them afterwards, party members with the Criminal background gain the inspiration ⁠ Easy Pickings . Technical UID S_DEN_BackupLeader UUID b304e07d-019c-4ec6-b5ea-c4ccb29ed892 Stats DEN_Refugees_Tiefling_Ranger Eqp. EQP_Longbow_ScaleMail Trs. DEN_BackupLeader Cerys is an Asmodeus tiefling scout travelling with a group of tiefling refugees . She can be found during certain events in Act One if some specific characters are dead, or more usually at Last Light Inn during Act Two . “ We've lost people today. But we are alive, and the dead have bought us a chance. „ — Cerys , after the loss of their leaders. Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act One 1.2 Act Two 1.3 Act Three 2 Combat 2.1 Attacks and actions 2.2 Loot 3 Related quests 4 Notes Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Cerys does not typically appear until Act Two . However she serves as a failsafe in Act One in the event both Zevlor and Asharak have died, with the game requiring a tiefling leader to trigger certain events such as ⁠ Raid the Grove , or the camp party after once ⁠ Defeat the Goblins has been completed. Successfully defending the Emerald Grove from Minthara's raid results in Cerys running in from outside, calling for either Zevlor or Asharak, before forcing dialogue with the party. The party can tell Cerys of the previous leaders' fates, to which she reacts with dismay. [ 1 ] If the goblins' leaders are killed, Cerys instead waits with the rest of the tieflings at the grove's entrance, telling the party that she noticed them clearing the Goblin Camp , but found Zevlor dead back in the grove as well. In both cases, she immediately takes charge of the remaining tiefling survivors, and rewards the party for their deeds. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If the tiefling refugees are rescued and en route to Baldur's Gate, Cerys moves to the Last Light Inn with the remaining tiefling survivors. Talking with her reveals that Zevlor had betrayed them [ 2 ] by surrendering the refugees to the Absolute , and that she and a few others managed to flee to Last Light Inn while the rest were either killed or captured. She asks the party to help the tieflings who were captured and taken to Moonrise Towers . It is also revealed there that Cerys was the scout responsible for finding their road to Baldur's Gate , although the road had turned out to be one that led directly into the Shadow-Cursed Lands , and by extension, the Cult of the Absolute's main base of power in Moonrise Towers. Upon rescuing the tieflings from Moonrise, Cerys thanks the party. After Moonrise Towers is cleared and Ketheric Thorm defeated, Cerys moves behind Moonrise Towers' throne room, scavenging supplies and preparing for the remainder of the road ahead. She can be told about Zevlor's fate if he was encountered and saved from the Mind Flayer Colony , to which she reacts with anger. Alternatively, she can be told that Zevlor died (even if he was rescued), to which she reacts with remorseful upset. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Cerys moves to the refugee camp in Rivington with the remaining tiefling refugees. She can be told about Zevlor's fate if he was encountered in the Mind Flayer Colony if this was not already done in Act Two. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Ranged Attack ( )   –   Longbow Damage: 3~10 1d8 + 2 ⁠ Piercing Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon. Technical UID S_TWN_CentralSquare_GuardianOfCharisma UUID 86b97d31-f124-4579-b88e-ac34312d21cf Stats TWN_DarkJusticiar_Charisma The Charismatic Sentinel is a unique type of Undead guarding the secret shrine to Shar underneath statue of Ketheric Thorm in Reithwin Town's square. Its abilities mirror that of a paladin , and fitting of its role it has very high Charisma . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party members fail to pass any of the three Saving Throw tests for Wisdom , Intelligence and Charisma , damage the statues, or take the Ritual Dagger of Shar it summons the undead Dark Justiciar . It along with the Wise Sentinel and Intelligent Sentinel puts up a difficult fight considering their large amount of Hit Points and special abilities. Technical UID S_LOW_Guildhall_Member_004 UUID d40ae4a2-f29a-4d69-b9f7-9b078aeee0be Stats HalfElf_Commoner Cheeky Nora is a member of the Guild who can potentially be found in the Guildhall in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate . “ Eyes off the barkeep, new blood. He and I, we're a thing. Were a thing. Will be a thing again. „ — Cheeky Nora Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Nora only appears in the Guildhall if Oskar Fevras was not saved from Brem in Act One . She can be found watching Lyrux Goldthroat performing on the far end of the Guildhall . Speaking with her reveals that she is fixated on gaining Severn's attention as he just recently broke it off with her. This leads to the quest to speak with him on her behalf to find out why. Break-up with Severn [ edit section | visual editor ] Speaking with Nora leads to her requesting the party ask Severn why he broke it off with her. He states that he broke it off because he is not interested in her sexual proclivities. Returning to Nora results in multiple skill check options to convince her he is no longer interested: [PERSUASION]  He's intimidated by you. Do yourself a favour and set your sights somewhere else. (DC 18) [INTIMIDATION]  He's a bugbear . The only date you two will go on is if he decides to eat you for dinner. (DC 30) [DECEPTION]  It's me. Severn and I are in love. (DC 18) [INTELLIGENCE]  Bugbears live short lives. It's destined for tragedy either way. (DC 18) On a successful check, she accepts his disinterest and rewards the party with a Peridot Ring . Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] This quest is not listed in the quest journal. Severn states that Nora is a, "M. F. - the M stands for Monster. Let's just say I ain't that type." As of Patch #8, Hotifx #34, there some bugs if the Intelligence Check is chosen: She only claims to reward the party if convinced to give up on Severn, but eventually does not do so. Even after 'successfully' convincing her to move on, she resumes pining for him in subsequent dialogues. v t e Undercity Characters Companions Boo Minsc Cult of Bhaal 'Jaheira' Abby Abraxa Aicir Tapol Barnz Bloodmopper Blythe Cilarea Comina Corniche Cruor Dellinjah Dax Derysia Dhoria Dogaletto Echo of Abazigal Echo of Amelyssan Echo of Illasera Echo of Sendai Eglantine Elda Ellice Eni Flange Flo-Flo Fustian Garithon Ghislev Glyria Grimlark Gruntman Helena Anchev Hervyl Hiila Hivune Horriss Kevo Phogge Kryss Liya Lizabett Luke Maireadh Majjo Minsc Mitchia Notar Esojac Nov Shmoz Ogga Orin Phylle Rycke Sarevok Anchev Snicker Snirr Stropes That Which Guards That Which Lurks That Which Watches Varneela Velki Zeironymous Zerillis The Guild Babyjowls Bad Twin Bubbins Blades Bakstir Cutter Violet Doozy the Dunce Elliot Happy Hands Lady Ague Lady Croup Lady Flux Lady Lockjaw Lady Quinsy Li'l Fezmor Lyrux Goldthroat Mango Nine-Fingers Keene Snapbone The Professor Three-Piece Uktar Harpers Blaird Freddo Leafsong Glist Sulian Traders Bareki Echo of Abazigal Mol Severn Sticky Dondo Zhentarim Carlorina the Wolf Fishbait Arno Follgast Friol Gravedigger Karcen Lacy Dancer Lugarrio Phase Roah Moonglow Slick Inatra Smilin' Ginna Trinoda Other Aelis Siryasius Arabella Carnelia Vanthampur Dairow Vin Floridor Hans Feather Lorna Esthelian Magpie Davys Phostlethwaite Qudenos Sarin Tut Thistlebog Voss Valeria Locations Abandoned Cistern Ancient Lair Murder Tribunal Bhaal Temple Guildhall Lower City Sewers Morphic Pool Undercity Ruins Quests Aid the Underduke Confront the Elder Brain Find Mol Free Orpheus Get Orin's Netherstone Impress the Murder Tribunal Investigate the Murders Rescue Orin's Victim Return Rakath's Gold The High Harper

EQP_WYR_Axe_DG_1 Variant 1 UID WYR_Axe_DoppelgangerShape_01 UUID 8996207d-068d-4d41-a10f-648e4bdad85b Stats Halfling_Melee Hemm , disguised as Harper Chelvin , [ 1 ] is a Doppelganger posing as an elderly lightfoot halfling member of the Harpers . Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the Mad Rashemaar , Chelvin was killed and impersonated some time ago. “ Aw, our cover's blown. The messy way it is! „ — Chelvin , impersonated by Hemm. History [ edit section | visual editor ] Bhaalist Resurgence [ edit section | visual editor ] After rumors of Bhaalist activity surfaced in Baldur's Gate , Jaheira ordered her Harpers to look into the machinations of the Cult of Bhaal, letting them uncover as much information as possible while she led another force of Harpers into the Shadow-Cursed Lands to defeat Ketheric Thorm . However, as Jaheira ordered the Harpers to concentrate their efforts in finding the Rashemaar , Chelvin and her cell of Harpers were either killed or captured, only to be brought to Orin ; Chelvin herself was strangled to death by a doppelganger by name of Hemm, who was already disguised as her. [ 2 ] The sole survivor of the Harper cell, a raw recruit by the name of Geraldus , is being used as live bait for Jaheira and the party to contact, in an attempt to ambush and silence them. [ 3 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Bhaalist Ambush [ edit section | visual editor ] While in Wyrm's Crossing with Jaheira, she points out Danthelon's Dancing Axe , a store run by Entharl Danthelon , and front for a Harper safe house. In a secret room beneath the store, an impersonated Chelvin, Leistine , Leysin , and Thonos wait to ambush Jaheira and the party. Upon the party and Jaheira's arrival, Geraldus attempts - through the use of an old Harper code - to communicate that the Harpers present are traitors . Hemm, disguised as Chelvin, attempts to derail Geraldus' implications, while Jaheira, if present in the party, understands the code and casually mentions that Chelvin seems familiar, and reminds her of Marcus . Failing to recognize the sign starts combat with the party Surprised , while recognizing the code and acting on it surprises the impersonated Harpers. Gold_Pocket_Random Harper Chenti is one of the Harpers reinforcing the barricade leading into the Last Light Inn during Act Two . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] “ Can't chat - need to reinforce the barricade. „ — Chenti Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Chenti is at the Last Light Inn, where she makes trips back and forth within the main plaza, bringing planks to the sanctuary's entrance in order to reinforce the barricade. If the party is vouched for by Marcus but then exposes him as a True Soul , Chenti will be Stunned and join the fight against his summoned Crawling Claws . Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Chenti tends to fail the save and be Impaled for the remainder of battle. If the party fail to protect Isobel, she and everyone in Last Light Inn turns into a Shadow-Cursed Undead , save for Jaheira . Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party successfully prevent Marcus from capturing Isobel at the Last Light Inn, and the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise, Chenti follows Jaheira to Moonrise Towers . However, Chenti is killed during the fight against Absolute forces before the party can arrive. Her corpse is the very first body on the bridge leading to Moonrise Towers, implying she was the first Harper to fall in battle. LOW_CountingHouse_Clerk Clerk Chervis is one of the cashiers handling customers at the Counting House in the Lower City . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Chervis is too busy to talk to the party. If there is chaos and the civilians have fled, he tells the party the "good stuff" is downstairs. Before him Gilla Merrun and Brialavant are waiting in line to be serviced. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Chervis occassionally chats with Clerk Zollerix , who manages the queue next to him: Clerk Zollerix Are you thinking what I'm thinking? Clerk Chervis I am, if you're looking where I'm looking. Clerk Zollerix Do you have any blank vouching documents? Clerk Chervis No - but I've got a little brandy in hip flask. Want a nip? Clerk Zollerix During work hours? Are you crazy? Clerk Chervis That's what they tell me. But we'll save it for later. Clerk Zollerix So, I told him 'I'm not that kind of drow.' Clerk Chervis You didn't! And what did he say? Clerk Zollerix He said, and I'm not kidding, 'What's stopping you?' Clerk Chervis Waukeen's scales! I'd have slapped him. Technical UID S_LOW_CazadorsPalace_Cells_Child_001 UUID 1fe747aa-f154-4507-b678-d51b3fffd20c Stats Vampire_Spawn Chessa is an Undead Vampire Spawn who is imprisoned in Cazador's Dungeon . She is one of the children recently kidnapped from the Gur by Astarion and forcibly turned into a vampire spawn. Interactions [ edit section | visual editor ] As the party progress through Cazador's Dungeon , they can find a prison containing various Vampire spawn, including Sebastian . When spoken to, Chessa comments she smells fresh flesh, and tells herself to snap out of it as the urges from being a vampire spawn begin to take hold. She then asks the party to have mercy and put her and the other children down, as the hunger is becoming too much. If playing as Astarion, Chessa reacts strongly to his presence as he is the one who captured her and brought her and the other children to Cazador. Astarion can tell Chessa he will free her, but she is still suspicious and asks why. Astarion can then convince her by passing a check: Chessa You want to free us? Chessa Why...? [PERSUASION]  Simple. I save your lives, your parents stop hunting me. (DC 15) [PERSUASION]  I can't bear to see you suffering like this because of something I did. (DC 18) [PERSUASION]  I'm not going to let Cazador take advantage of you like he took advantage of me. (DC 18) [NATURE]  Because you're vampire spawn. You should be out in the world feasting, not locked in a dungeon! (DC 18) Passing the check causes her to reveal that Cazador's staff unlocks the doors if the party did not already know. Otherwise, non-Astarion player characters can simply ask Chessa how to free the children, which results in her providing the information readily. If Cazador is later defeated, the party can then choose to consume the souls of all vampire spawn or free them, the former resulting in Chessa's immediate death. If Chessa is freed, she can later be seen in the Lower City Sewers with her father Gandrel . Technical UID S_COL_Butcher UUID 82ebdca0-f478-4c2b-a529-179a7e82b3db Stats COL_Butcher Eqp. EQP_Cleaver Trs. COL_Morgue_Butcher Chop is a Bugbear in the Morgue of the Mind Flayer Colony beneath Moonrise Towers at X: 663 Y: -74 . “ Little. Kitty. Dances. To another song. Same. Song. As you? „ — Chop , speaking to the player about Us Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Chop butchers humanoids to create Intellect Devourers . If a party member speaks with him they can find out that something has been done to his mind to make him more subservient and obedient – at great cost to his intellect; he seems distinctly unhappy with the situation. If they ask him "Why don't I send you to join all these creatures you butchered?" he responds with: "Yes. Yes. Please." Despite his apparent desire for death, he fights against the party when attacked, possibly due to his apparent inability to ignore or contradict his instructions. When killed, he remarks with his dying breath that he is now "free at last" . The exact nature of his affliction is unknown; he is not directly controlled by a Mind Flayer Parasite , as he does not drop one upon his death. Chop keeps Us locked in a cage, but can be convinced to give the key to the party. Chop Bad kitty. Sings wrong song. Must-fix. [ILLITHID]  Let it come with me. We sing the same song. [PERSUASION]  I'll take the creature with me. It won't disrupt the hivemind anymore. (DC 14) [INTIMIDATION]  Free the creature or I'll kill you and every one of your creations. (DC 18) If a party member attempts to lockpick the cage in Chop's line of sight, he initiates a dialogue wherein the party can, again, attempt to convince Chop to give them the key. Alternatively, they can pickpocket the key from him or take the key from his corpse. Regardless of method, freeing Us result in receiving Summon Us . If the party venture down in the Oubliette , Chop can be heard talking to himself through the walls. Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Morgue Cage Key - opens cage containing Us Related items [ edit section | visual editor ] Summon Us Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] In the Dark Elf Trilogy , the main character also encounters a Mind Flayer colony. The Mind Flayers there keep a wide assortment of slaves under powerful psychic control and brainwashing; it is possible this is what has affected Chop. v t e Mind Flayer Colony Characters Apostle of Myrkul Balthazar Chop Gortash Hairy Henry Ironfinger Ketheric Thorm Kressa Bonedaughter Maghtew Budj Mizora Nimias Orin Slack-Skinned Head The Netherbrain Ulder Ravengard Us Yeva Zevlor Zombie Dror Ragzlin Zombie Minthara Zombie Wulbren Creatures Death Shepherd Greater Zombie Reconstituted Arcanist Winged Horror Zombie Locations Barracks Morgue Necrotic Laboratory Tadpoling Centre Quests Defeat Ketheric Thorm Find Mol Find Zevlor Lift the Shadow Curse The Blade of Frontiers The Grand Duke The Wizard of Waterdeep

If Minsc is in the party, he comments on the situation and the party immediately goes into combat. Cilarea This operation demands subtlety, brother. Not your peculiar form of devotion. Barnz The Stone Lord has proven an effective instrument. A surprise, that he was not drawn to worship Lord Bhaal . Cilarea He is a berserker. His life has been spent worshipping our Lord whether he wills it or not. Barnz The Faceless grows weary of her current form - did you see her this morning? Cilarea Slashing at her own face in the mirror. Doppelgangers are not meant to wear the same skin for too long - especially one so offensive to our Lord as that one. Barnz How many of her Faceless has Lady Orin sent out to walk among us? Cilarea That is not for us to know, brother. Technical UID S_WYR_PerformanceBooster_Human UUID d97b5c78-9f70-42b3-9553-af40fc4b73ae Stats Human_Commoner Cillian is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three . “ I'm just buying, ah, bread off my friend here - everything is fine. „ — Cillian Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Cillian stands near the northern corner of the Sharess' Caress building, and is talking to Surixana . It was recommended that he buy a certain medicine from her to provide a certain kind of " pleasurable assistance". However, he is quite uneasy about exposing his need to a stranger, feeling embarrassed at the prospect of naming it for what it is. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Cillian This is safe to take - you're absolutely sure? Surixana My good man, every substance has been tried and tested by yours truly. Cillian What - what does it feel like? Surixana In a word, sir? Exquisite. Almost painfully so. My body burned like the noonday sun. Cillian And the... other person with you - they enjoyed it? Surixana Enjoyed it? Sir, I had no less than two maidens and a bachelor clawing at my door the very next morn. Cillian How long do the effects last? Surixana It depends on the person, and their virility . For you, I'd recommend two doses. Cillian Two? That seems like a lot. Surixana Do you not wish to pleasure your fine maiden? To feel her fingers grip yours in pure ecstacy? Cillian Shhh - people will hear. Surixana Good - let them see you taking charge of your pleasurable destiny. Surixana I sense some hesitation in you - speak, good sir. Cillian It's just embarassing to need something like this. Surixana Whatever for? Does the hand not assist the lips? The lips the tongue? If your mighty mast needs - Cillian I got it! I got it - and thanks. Surixana Of course. Set your worries at ease - you're in safe hands. v t e Wyrm's Crossing Characters Cultists of Bhaal Gavv Hemm Lunn Zoll Flaming Fists Azari Edwynna Elin Falcäo Gai Meadows Mîran Shah Carm's Garms Naaber Slozy Arminifer Trinigan Gazotts Vinegaroon Danthelon's Dancing Axe Geraldus Limmy Safyre Somi Tairn Fraygo's Flophouse Bernyr Crak Dalyria Dashkent Moliver Drim Ffion Goldgrind Petras Rilia Rosanna Sharess' Caress Amira Arfur Gregorio Borgus Elamin Chapeau Chorizo Cillian Earspoon Embry Ghainemeir Hakeem Irenya Jara Kira Korrilla Laila Naoise Nallinto Nym Orlith Raphael Rhol Sorn Orlith Surixana Valeria Voss Other Kali Hammerhand Neno Quilltop Traders Carmen Pennygood Entharl Danthelon Glynda Oltower Griska Hoots Hooligan Queelia Arvis Roberon Silt Stylin' Horst Thodric Shedeveer Velson Oakes Locations Carm's Garms Danthelon's Dancing Axe Fraygo's Flophouse Sharess' Caress The Velveteen Elixir Quests Deal with the Devil Deal with the Gnomes Find a way into Wyrm's Rock fortress Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion Free Orpheus Help Kith'rak Voss Investigate Cazador's Palace Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders The Githyanki Warrior The High Harper

Technical UID S_LOW_SteelwatchGame_Player2 UUID bfaf2ac8-8a22-4cec-8db8-e3046db89e29 Stats Human_Child Cinnamon is a human child who can be found in the Steeps district of the Lower City in Act Three . “ I've got you figured out! You're a spy for the Absolute, like I am! „ — Cinnamon Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Cinnamon plays with her friends on a small stone-paved space at X: -166 Y: -75 . She and her two mates, Punkins and Slow-Butt , are standing near Golbraith's Home . Her friend Punkins is pretending to be a Steel Watcher scanning Cinnamon and Slow-Butt, to check their 'records'. If spoken to, Cinnamon asks the interacting party member whether she seems suspicious to them. A DC 7 Perception Check reveals she is hiding candy from her friends. If asked, Cinnamon calls it "spy candy" , calling herself a spy of the Absolute. Detecting the candy earns minor approval from Gale , Wyll , Karlach , Jaheira , Minsc and Halsin . Ratting the girl out to Punkins upsets her for a short time. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Punkins Halt, citizen! Prepare to be scanned! Cinnamon I am holding very still! Go ahead and scan, Watcher ! Punkins Humm humm humm zip! Punkins Hold still, citizen. Initiating scans and stuff. Cinnamon Go ahead! I am totally not an Absolute spy! Punkins Humm zip humm humm zip! Punkins Violation! Violation! Whoop whoop! Cinnamon No way, hee hee! I know my rights and I have nothing to hide! Slow-Butt Ha ha! Fun at last! Punish her, Watcher! Slow-Butt Aw, come on! When is it my turn? Punkins Be patient, citizen. GEN_Toy Cinta Golewits is a Human refugee child living in Arfur's Mansion in Act Three . She is with her father Ben and mother Marpha . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Cinta Golewits' parents have decided to squat in a mansion in Rivington . The family has nowhere else to stay due to the influx of refugees at Baldur's Gate . Outside the mansion, Arfur Gregorio has hired mercenaries from the Guild led by Zenovia Dawg . He has plans to evict the family from his home. The party can convince or force Arfur to allow them refuge or offer the refugees 100 Gold to stay elsewhere. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Like most children in the game, Cinta cannot be killed. On her combat turn she flees and disappears. After combat ends, she reappears at full health and – if the party had aided her parents – she cheerfully thanks whomever talks to her. v t e Rivington v t e Characters in Rivington Refugees Arne Technical UID S_END_ArmouryCivilian_003 UUID bace1e81-671d-4120-bc0c-c46d26bcbbb7 Stats Elf_Commoner Civilian [ 1 ] is a character behind a locked door in the courtyard of High Hall during the final sequence of Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Upon approaching the locked door in the northern end of the courtyard, a cutscene plays out which reveals Tilly , Robyn , and a female elf named Civilian holed up in fear. Robyn admonishes the party to leave, believing that they are safe as long as they remain holed up. A party member can persuade, intimidate, or deceive them to open up the door; each option can only be attempted once: [PERSUASION]  You need to leave! This whole place is falling down. (DC 15) [DECEPTION]  Let me in! The mind flayers are after me! (DC 20) [INTIMIDATION]  Open this door. Right now.  (DC 20) After attempting to lockpick the door, the options change: [PERSUASION]  You're going to die in there if you don't leave soon! (DC 15) [INTIMIDATION]  Open the door. Now.  (DC 20) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  ROAR! (DC 20  ) Convincing Tilly to open the door causes her to breathe a sigh of relief when she sees the party. Robyn tells her to get going and the party can then ask if they would like to die (thus beginning combat) or to get out of there, after which Tilly grants each party member the Death Ward condition. However, if the interacting party member has undergone ceremorphosis and has become a mind flayer , Tilly, Robyn and Civilian flee in terror and do not grant the Death Ward condition. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Unarmed Strike ( ) Damage: 1 1 ⁠ Bludgeoning Hit a target with your bare fists. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Dash ( ) Cover more distance this turn: double your Movement Speed . If I'm found buying anti-cultist charms, I'll be laughed out the city. „ — Civilian (Lower City) Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Civilian is considering whether to purchase a charm from Honest Vendor's street stall near Flymm's Cobblers . She claims that her fiancé has been charmed by the Absolute and seeks a way to return him and protect herself. However, she does not quite believe in the power of these charms and is reluctant to use them openly. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Honest Vendor MIND CONTROL CHARMS! GET YOUR MIND CONTROL CHARMS HERE! Civilian SHHH! If I'm found buying anti-cultist charms, I'll be laughed out the city. Honest Vendor Well, you'll be the one laughing when they're all enslaved to the Absolute! Honest Vendor Those Absolutists love mind control - you'd do well to buy a charm sharpish. Civilian A cultist took control of my fiance. Have you got anything I can use to bring him back? Honest Vendor Ah, that would be the mind- restoring charm. I don't have any of those, sorry. Honest Vendor So, an amulet of Absolutist rebuttal? Maybe an enchanted ring? Civilian Those charms all sound a bit out of my price range. Along with Arborio Rolfin , he is likely to be accused of breaking and entering, as well as arson. Their lawyer Fentamia Viney practices defending speech with both, but unlike his fellow, Civilian continues to let slip that both are guilty. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Fentamia Viney Let's rehearse this one more time. Pretend I'm a Fist, and tell me what you were doing in the house. Civilian Well, your Fistliness, we broke down the door because it sounded like somebody was in trouble inside. Arborio Rolfin The house was on fire. We were rescuing people. Fentamia Viney I spoke to a witness who says you entered the house before the fire started. Civilian Who said that? I'll break their bloody legs! Arborio Rolfin Err, what my friend means to say is that the witness must have been mistaken. Probably a drunk. Fentamia Viney Better. I almost believed you this time. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ This character is named like this inside the game files so it seems to be done on purpose. WYR_OpenHand_Priest Brother Clements is a member of the Open Hand Temple . “ Times may be hard, but the God on the Rack asks that we endure. For him. „ — Clements Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Clements is in the temple, where he is in a heated debate with Brother Bill . They disagree on Father Lorgan's harbouring of refugees and its impact on his death. Clements feels that Lorgan was correct in sheltering the suffering fugitives, whereas Bill believes the temple should focus inward, rejecting Lorgan's ways. For party members with the Acolyte background, siding with Clements grants the inspiration ⁠ A Scorned Closed Heart while siding with Bill grants the inspiration ⁠ A Wounded Open Heart instead. Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] Support Clements [ edit section | visual editor ] Sounds like your god would be proud of Father Lorgan.   -1   +1   +1   +1   +1   -1   +1 Support Bill [ edit section | visual editor ] If Father Lorgan had been pickier, he might still be alive.   +1   +1   +1   +1 Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Cure Wounds ( + ) Healing: 1~8 + modifiers 1d8 + Spellcasting modifier ⁠ Healing Heal a creature you can touch. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Sacred Flame ( ) Damage: 1~8 1d8 ⁠ Radiant Engulf a target in a flame-like radiance. DEX Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Brother Clements and Brother Bill argue about Father Lorgan's harbouring of refugees. Brother Bill I warned the Temple of exactly this. Exactly this. Brother Clements Ilmater's edict is to welcome all into his embrace. Salve all suffering. Brother Bill By allowing his faithful to suffer the most? Brother Clements It is not for us to decide who deserves Ilmater's grace. Brother Bill Why not? We are his adherents - who would know if not us? Brother Clements To claim to know the lord's will is blasphemy. We interpret scripture and teachings - but we know nothing. Brother Clements I'll hear nothing more against Father Lorgan. Brother Bill I've nothing against Father Lorgan, Ilmater rest his soul. But his methods need to rest with him. Technical UID S_LOW_BasiliskGate_Sentinel UUID 6080d533-820b-4802-bf0b-fd27066a4a9b Stats FlamingFist_Human_Ranger Fist Clover is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist . She can be found in Lower City in Act Three . “ Hey, good-looking. Behave yourself, yeah? I'd hate to see someone as pretty as you in cuffs. „ — Clover Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Clover patrols the territory of the Basilisk Gate Barracks from the entrance and inside to the far wall, climbing up the wooden ramparts gallery. If spoken to, she reacts a bit more casual than other Fists on duty, expressing a special attitude to characters of races uncommon to the city: To a rarely-met race [ 1 ] : Well, hello. I've never seen anyone as interesting as yourself. Behave, yeah? I'd hate to see someone as pretty as you in cuffs. To an Underdark-origin character: Well, hello. We don't get too many visitors from down below. Behave, yeah? I'd hate to see someone as pretty as you in cuffs. To a Half-Orc character: Your arms are like tree trunks - they're amazing! Kindly behave yourself while you're here, yeah? I don't fancy my chances if I have to tackle you. Clover also occasionally talks to Fist Murphy (who endures his punishment at the barracks' entrance), obviously being tasked to check on him. She mostly reproaches him, but also feels sympathetic, as she had previously experienced the same punishment herself, and offers to sneak him some lunch. Range: Normal weapon range Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Heavy Crossbow Key (Clover) Leather Armour Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Murphy Can I put my leg down yet? Clover Nope - you're still in Blaze Portyr's bad books. Murphy But I - I can't feel my leg! Clover You stole coin , you dingus. What did you expect would happen? Clover I'm impressed. I fell on my arse the first time Blaze Portyr made me do that. Murphy Does that mean I can put my leg down? Clover Nope. Murphy Damn it. Murphy Here to yell at me, I presume? Clover I came to check on you. How are you holding up? Murphy I'm fine . Clover Liar. I'll see about sneaking you some lunch. Murphy Thank you! Clover All right, Murphy, five more minutes and your punishment is over.  (If Gortash has been defeated.) Murphy I'm getting off easy? What happened, has the Blaze gone soft? Clover Not likely. Lord Gortash has been killed, so it's all hands on deck. Punishment duty can wait. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ This dialogue option has ruletags "RARE", "PLANAR" and "BESTIAL". Of all races listed in devnotes correspondent to these tags the playable are Dragonborns, Githyanki, Half-Drow, Half-Orcs, and Tieflings. Technical UID S_LOW_Elfsong_Patron_007 UUID 8ed56d53-43bd-407d-bf02-bd9c1035b357 Stats HalfElf_Commoner Clovia Throaks is a tailor in Baldur's Gate and the wife of Blarson Throaks . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Clovia and her husband Blarson Throaks can be found drinking in the Elfsong Tavern , celebrating their son Gasper Throaks getting a job working security at the Steel Watch Foundry . When approached she mentions how happy they are that their son Gasper has finally found a 'proper' job. She states she introduced him to the 'darling' Tamia Holzt , and was glad she did as she straightened Gasper out. If the party then ask her if she and Tamia are close, she reveals to Blarson that she's leaving him for Tamia and selling their business "Throaks for Cloaks". ## Companions
- **来源**: [Companions](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Companions)
- **分类**: Characters

See also: Camp followers . Companions are playable characters who can join and fight alongside the player character. Each has their own motivations, personality, and approval , which increases or decreases according to choices made throughout the game. At high approval levels, many companions can be romanced . Conversely, a companion may leave the party or even try to kill the player character if their approval becomes too low. The default class of companions can be changed. However, for story purposes, the game acts as if they still have their original class. “ A disparate collection of vagabonds and strays. „ — Minthara , on her fellow companions [ 1 ] Contents 1 Origin companions 2 Non-origin companions 3 Temporary companions 4 Attached followers 4.1 Attached followers in the main game 4.2 Attached followers in the finale 5 Hirelings 6 Recruitment locations 6.1 Origin companions 6.2 Non-origin companions 6.3 Temporary companions 6.4 Attached followers 7 Permanent removal 8 Notes and references Origin companions [ edit section | visual editor ] Origin companions are playable characters with rich backgrounds and ties to the world and the events of the game. Origin companions can be recruited shortly after completing the prologue . Each origin can also be selected as a player character as an alternative to creating a custom character. Astarion High Elf Rogue Gale Human Wizard Karlach Zariel Tiefling Barbarian Lae'zel Githyanki Fighter Shadowheart High Half-Elf Cleric of Shar Wyll Human Warlock Non-origin companions [ edit section | visual editor ] Non-origin companions may be recruited at various points later in the game, and each non-origin companion has specific recruitment scenarios which must be followed. Halsin Wood Elf Druid Circle of the Moon Jaheira High Half-Elf Druid Circle of the Land Minsc Human Ranger Hunter Minthara Lolth-Sworn Drow Paladin Oath of Vengeance Temporary companions [ edit section | visual editor ] Temporary companions are characters who can be recruited as party members and take up a genuine but temporary party slot during quests or through world interactions. Alfira [ 2 ] Asmodeus Tiefling Bard Losiir [ 3 ] Githyanki Fighter Attached followers [ edit section | visual editor ] Attached followers are characters that can be attached to the player character or other party members, like summons or allied NPCs during particular quests . Attached followers in the main game [ edit section | visual editor ] Us [ 4 ] Intellect Devourer Scratch [ 5 ] Dog Halsin [ 6 ] Wood Elf Druid Circle of the Moon Glut [ 7 ] Myconid Sovereign (Myconid Monarch) Sazza [ 8 ] Goblin Brawler Jaheira [ 9 ] High Half-Elf Druid Circle of the Land Minthara [ 10 ] Lolth-Sworn Drow Paladin Oath of Vengeance Boo [ 11 ] Beast Miniature Giant Space Hamster Counsellor Florrick [ 12 ] High Elf Wizard Hope [ 13 ] Gold Dwarf Cleric ( Life Domain ) Omeluum [ 14 ] Mind Flayer Trader Ulder Ravengard [ 14 ] Human Fighter Zanner Toobin [ 15 ] Rock Gnome Gondian Attached followers in the finale [ edit section | visual editor ] Armoured Owlbear Beast Aylin Aasimar of Selûne Paladin Oath of Vengeance Mizora Cambion Sorcerer Servant of Zariel Orpheus Githyanki Monk Steel Watcher Construct Strange Ox Shapeshifter The Emperor Mind Flayer Yurgir Orthon Hirelings [ edit section | visual editor ] There are 12 hirelings available to recruit after level 3 – one for each class . Each has their own name, visuals, and race. Their abilities and classes can be re-specced at any time. Brinna Brightsong Lightfoot Halfling Bard Danton Mephistopheles Tiefling Druid Eldra Luthrinn Gold Dwarf Barbarian Sir Fuzzalump Rock Gnome Wizard Jacelyn High Half-Elf Sorcerer ( Draconic Bloodline ) Kerz Half-Orc Paladin ( Oath of Devotion ) Kree Derryck Duergar Warlock ( The Great Old One ) Maddala Deadeye Human Rogue Sina'zith Githyanki Monk Varanna Sunblossom Wood Half-Elf Fighter Ver'yll Wenkiir Seldarine Drow Ranger Zenith Feur'sel High Elf Cleric of Selûne ( Light Domain ) Recruitment locations [ edit section | visual editor ] Origin companions [ edit section | visual editor ] Astarion is standing on the trail west of the crashed Nautiloid on the Ravaged Beach . Gale is trapped within the Ancient Sigil Circle east of the Nautiloid. Karlach is on the Risen Road , south of the Toll House at the end of a trail of blood leading towards the river. Lae'zel is a temporary companion in the prologue . She can be recruited at the following locations where she is: Trapped in a cage by two tieflings , south of the Emerald Grove Confronting the Githyanki patrol as part of the Find the Githyanki Crèche quest Dead, in the Shadow-Cursed Lands . Her corpse is too damaged to be spoken to, but she can be resurrected using Revivify or its scroll version. Shadowheart is an optional temporary companion during the prologue. She can be recruited at the following locations where she is: Unconscious on the Ravaged Beach , close to where the player character landed – if freed from her pod on the Nautiloid Unsuccessfully trying to enter the Dank Crypt – if left in her pod on the Nautiloid Inside the Hollow of the Emerald Grove If not previously recruited, Shadowheart approaches the party at: The Goblin Camp The Mountain Pass Wyll is inside the Emerald Grove, training young tieflings. He appears in camp if Karlach joins the party before him. While initially hostile, he can be talked down and recruited. Non-origin companions [ edit section | visual editor ] Halsin is held prisoner in the Goblin Camp. He joins the party if he is freed and the party did not attack the Grove. He can become a full companion during ⁠ Lift the Shadow Curse . Jaheira is the Last Light Inn . She becomes available as a possible companion during the assault on Moonrise Towers , so long as she is alive and not hostile. Minsc can first be encountered in the Counting House . He becomes available as a companion if Jaheira is alive and he survives the battle in the Lower City Sewers . Minthara is one of the three leaders of the Goblin Camp in Act One . Minthara can be recruited by siding with her and raiding the Emerald Grove or by fighting against her and knocking her out . After the other goblin leaders are killed, she journeys to Moonrise Towers and faces judgment, where she is then able to be rescued and recruited. Temporary companions [ edit section | visual editor ] Losiir appears only if Lae'zel is chosen as an origin character, filling her role as tutorial guide on the Nautiloid . His death in the Nautiloid's crash is scripted and cannot be prevented. Attached followers [ edit section | visual editor ] Glut is in the Myconid Colony and can be temporarily recruited during the quest ⁠ Defeat the Duergar Intruders . He remains in the party as an attached follower as long as they remain in the Underdark and as his quest is not completed. Sazza is being held prisoner in the Hollow . If the party help her, she follows them while she escapes. Us is aboard the Nautiloid , in the second room. It can join the party for the prologue , and – if it survives – as a summons near the end of Act Two . Permanent removal [ edit section | visual editor ] Once they join the party, companions remain by the player character's side in most circumstances and, if killed during battle, can be brought back with Revivify , its scroll, or through Withers . However, there are several instances where a companion may leave, become hostile, or be killed during a cutscene – depending on the player character's choices. In these instances, they remain permanently dead and cannot be brought back under any circumstances. The following is a list of instances where a companion is permanently removed from the party: Universal: A companion drops to -50 Approval or below A companion is sacrificed to BOOOAL As the Dark Urge , after Isobel is spared, the player character is instructed to kill their closest companion; if they are not woken up (or are allowed to go back to sleep), the targeted companion is killed in their sleep If a companion is killed here, all other companions turn hostile unless the one spoken with is talked down with a DC 30 Deception Check If a companion trapped in a Profane Womb in the Mind Flayer Colony is turned into a Zombie by Balthazar's ritual, they cannot be resurrected after leaving the Colony Orin is not stopped from killing the companion she abducted A companion gives up their body and soul to Haarlep As origin Astarion , a cutscene plays during a long rest if the party does not know that Astarion is a vampire. He then has the option to drink a companion's blood. If he does so and chooses to keep drinking or fails the saving throw to stop, that companion dies permanently. Alternatively, if he fails a Stealth check and then fails a Persuasion or Deception check upon being caught, the companion leaves the party. Gale cannot be fully drained of blood, and so the only way to make him leave in this scene is to drink his blood and then fail a Persuasion check. Astarion : Telling him to leave or attempting to stake him when he reveals his status as a Vampire Spawn, regardless of the result Handing him over to Gandrel or telling Gandrel he is at the party's camp Breaking Yurgir's contract, unless a Persuasion or Deception check is passed Siding with the Gur against Astarion Failing to stop Cazador from becoming a Vampire Ascendant Refusing to help him ascend without trying to persuade him out of it Interrupting his Rite of Profane Ascension Killing Cazador without Astarion in the party while the player character's approval is not at least -40 (see thresholds ) Kicking a romanced and Ascended Astarion when he tries to make the player character kneel Gale : Telling Gale to leave after being caught attempting to probe his mind or coming clean about it when he demands the first magic item Repeatedly refusing his demand to give him the first magic item Telling him to leave after he reveals his condition Choosing to raid the Emerald Grove unless an Insight or Deception check is passed Ignoring or defeating Elminster , causing Gale to leave after Ketheric is defeated As the Dark Urge , becoming Bhaal's chosen if Jaheira is still alive and approval with Gale is not at least 20 (Medium) Halsin : Leaving the Shadow-Cursed Lands without fully resolving ⁠ Lift the Shadow Curse Jaheira and Minsc : Attacking Isobel in the Shadow-Cursed Lands after Ketheric Thorm has retreated Telling Jaheira to leave after Ketheric Thorm is defeated Attacking any of Jaheira's children Killing Minsc upon encountering him in the sewers rather than knocking him out or refusing to recruit him after he is freed If the Dark Urge has obtained the Slayer form, Jaheira and Minsc can appear in a cutscene during the first long rest in Act Three . Succeeding on an Intimidation check causes them to leave Sacrificing either or both of them to Sarevok's Murder Tribunal As the Dark Urge , becoming Bhaal's chosen Causing either one of them to leave the party at low approval Karlach : Allowing Wyll to kill her when he confronts her at camp, or attacking her under the impression that she is a devil Siding with Anders against her Heading to Alternatively, if she is still loyal to Vlaakith , freeing Orpheus and allying with him, unless the player character convinces her to kill him once the Netherbrain is destroyed Minthara : Insisting she leave after Ketheric Thorm is defeated Shadowheart : Siding against her when she attempts to kill a sleeping Lae'zel Attempting to enter the Shadowfell without the Spear of Night [ 18 ] Entering the Shadowfell without her Letting Balthazar capture the Nightsong Attempting to plead against her crusade to kill Aylin Handing her over to Viconia if she has rejected Shar Killing her parents after they are freed Wyll : Choosing to defend Karlach from him when he confronts her Choosing to raid the Emerald Grove [ 16 ] Killing a member of the Emerald Grove [ verify ] Choosing not to save Mizora from the Mind Flayer Colony , [ 19 ] or choosing to kill her in her pod Killing Ulder Ravengard in the Iron Throne or making him hostile in any way once he is in camp As the Dark Urge , becoming Bhaal's chosen if Jaheira is still alive Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Quote source: Minthara_InParty_Nested_PartyMemberThoughts ↑ Since the release of patch 7, Alfira can be recruited as a temporary companion. However, per Larian's notes for this patch, she is only recruitable if the Dark Urge is chosen as origin and there is room for her in the active party. During the Early Access Version of the game, Us was a temporary companion. ↑ Scratch is available as an attached follower in all three acts. ↑ After rescuing Halsin by defeating the Goblins inside the Worg Pens within the Shattered Sanctum , he can be recruited as an attached follower until all the Goblin leaders are defeated. ↑ Glut is available as an attached follower in the Underdark , but not in Grymforge . ↑ Sazza can be recruited as an attached follower in the Makeshift Prison and stays with the party until led to the Goblin Camp . ↑ Jaheira can be recruited as an attached follower during the assault on Moonrise Towers and remains as such until after the party's first fight with Ketheric Thorm atop Moonrise Towers. Afterwards, she can be recruited as a permanent companion. ↑ If Minthara is saved from the deep gnome questioners in Moonrise Towers Prison , she can be recruited as an attached follower and must then be led out of the prison to the campsite. After that, Minthara can be recruited as a permanent companion. ↑ Boo is only available as a summon to Minsc , who, in turn, is recruitable in Act Three. ↑ Counsellor Florrick becomes an attached follower while she is being led to freedom from Wyrm's Rock Prison . ↑ Hope is available as an attached follower during the fight against Raphael . ↑ 14.0 14.1 Omeluum and Ulder Ravengard are available as attached followers in the Iron Throne . ↑ Zanner Toobin is available as an attached follower in the Steel Watch Foundry . ↑ 16.0 16.1 An exploit is available to prevent Karlach, Wyll or both from leaving if the party side with the goblins. Before the battle commences, Wyll and Karlach must be dead . Afterwards, their corpses must be kept in the inventory of another active party member while making choices which improve their approval. The party member who carries the corpses must be in close vicinity when such events occur (see approval notes for more details on how approval works). Once their approval reaches or rises above -50, revive Karlach, Wyll, or both of them. In this way, Karlach and Wyll can live with this decision and stay, unless, of course, their approval drops below -50 again. ↑ If Karlach leaves the party this way, a unique steel watcher spawns in the High Hall courtyard, presumably a ⁠ converted Karlach . ↑ She initially warns the player character and only becomes hostile if ignored. ↑ Specific narration lines are added as a warning after the party descends the elevator that leads to the chamber where Gortash, Orin, and Ketheric meet, but before the party crosses the threshold.
