Technical UID S_LOW_Park_ChildLostBallScene02 UUID 0c6d7c78-bb49-45d6-ada9-4a46783396fb Stats Human_Child Conall is a Human child who can be found in the Steeps district of the Lower City in Act Three . “ I don't care what Emen said, I'm not getting the ball. And you can't make me. „ — Conall Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Conall is playing in the Bloomridge Park with his friend Emen . Emen and Conall were happily playing ball in the park, until Conall threw it far aside, right into the fountain bowl. Now both kids are arguing about which one of them should go and bring it back. If spoken to, Conall is obstinate about not going to fetch the ball. Meanwhile, he mocks his friend about the toy. However, he does not ask the party to do it instead of him. The party may take the ball themselves and return it to the boys, but if they do this, they step into an ambush set up by Bhaal cultists. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Emen Conall! You lost my ball! Conall I thought it was our ball. Emen No, it was a present for me, so it's my ball! And you lost it. Conall Prove it. Emen Prove what? The ball's right there. Emen Pleaaaaasssse go and get our ball, Conall. I want to play. Conall I thought it was your ball. Get it yourself. Emen No! YOU THREW IT! Conall I'm not fetching it. Don't want to get wet. Emen Well then we're not friends anymore. I'm not talking to you until you get it back. Conall Not if I stop talking to you first! Conall Where did you say the ball was? Emen In the fountain! There! Conall Ahh, but if you can see it, that means I can't have lost it, right? Emen Don't be mean, Conall, you know I don't like brain-riddles. Technical UID S_HAG_Hagspawn_HusbandJake UUID 133bf997-7c0d-4c64-88c9-9b9cd439dbb5 Stats Zombie Variant 1 UID QUEST_HAG_HusbandZombie UUID f1876ebc-8a68-410a-885f-21f991a5df09 Stats Zombie Connor Vinderblad is the deceased husband of Mayrina and is in a coffin behind the Riverside Teahouse . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Connor's untimely death drove Mayrina to seek help from the hag Auntie Ethel , who created a special magic wand to "bring back" Connor in exchange for Mayrina's unborn child. Upon defeating Ethel, the party can take the wand Bitter Divorce and use it on Connor's corpse behind the teahouse. If she survives, Mayrina is horrified to see that, contrary to her expectations, Connor is not resurrected as his former self, but only reanimated as an undead zombie. The party can either give the wand to Mayrina or keep it for themselves. If kept, it transformes to Second Marriage and can summon Connor at any time. If Mayrina is surrendered to Ethel, then using the wand on Connor's corpse resurrects him as a hostile entity. If Bitter Divorce is used on Connor's corpse without going through the dialogue with Mayrina, Connor comes back to life with 1 HP, and after a short cut-scene becomes hostile. Killing Connor yields no experience and causes Bitter Divorce to disappear from the party's inventory. Bitter Divorce can be dropped before killing Connor and picked up again after the fight to avoid this. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If Bitter Divorce is given to Mayrina in the Act One , Connor jouneys with Mayrina to Old Garlow's Place . Otherwise if Bitter Divorce is kept, Mayrina reacts to Connor being summoned nearby. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Connor's Undead form can be summoned using the wand Second Marriage . Having only a basic unarmed attack, his offensive capability is limited, but his low AC leads enemies to target him. Combined with Undead Fortitude preventing one killing blow, he can reliably waste at least two enemy actions. Connor is permanently afflicted with the Stench condition (labeled as 'smelly' in-game), which is unique to Connor and makes him smell bad. Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Slam ( ) Damage: 4~9 1d6 + 3 ⁠ Bludgeoning Hit a target with your bare fists. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Render by Luna Wullaert Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] It is not possible to use Speak with Dead on Connor. Connor's body can be picked up and stored at the camp. After killing Connor once, he can no longer be summoned with Bitter Divorce. Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] There seems to be a bug where it is possible to forcibly resurrect Connor with the wand by double clicking on his body with the wand. If the party leave the area and allow him to heal then they can kill and resurrect him. The party must then offer items or gold to him to improve their relationship. Technical UID S_LOW_CoraHighberry UUID 8a520cf7-c5da-419f-bdd4-792b27c5c679 Stats Halfling_Commoner Cora Highberry is a citizen hosting a wine festival in the Lower City during Act 3 . “ We're lucky to be blessed with a rather spacious one - seems cruel to let it go unused if there are children in need. „ — Cora Highberry , to the party [ 1 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Cora Highberry hosts a wine festival at her home southwest of the Elfsong Tavern . She is accompanied by her husband Roger Highberry , the wine connoisseur Master Meztli , and several other guests. If the party meet Cora before finding the Bloodstained Parchment , she is instead inside her home with her husband, discussing how in the next few days she will be hosting a wine tasting to help raise money to care for the children she took in. Cora is one of the murder targets during the quest ⁠ Investigate the Murders . "Master Meztli" is actually the Bhaalist aspirant Dolor , who seeks to kill her and chop off her hand to gain the approval of the Murder Tribunal and become an Assassin of Bhaal. If the party entered the Murder Tribunal before, or read the Bloodstained Parchment and approached the proximity of Cora's home, Dolor kills Cora after one long rest ( see time-sensitive activities ). Once the party approach Cora, she tells them she is about to taste some of "Master Meztli's" wine. A successful passive DC 18 Medicine Check ( DC 10 Perception Check if Barbarian) reveals that the wine smells sickly sweet, with an acrid note on the periphery, indicating poison. There are several dialogue options to either drink the wine causing Cora (and optionally the player character) to be poisoned, or the party can outright expose Metzli as a serial killer. If he is exposed, "Master Meztli" reveals himself to be the serial killer Dolor and is infuriated that his perfect crime was interrupted. He summons four Doppelgangers to keep the party occupied and uses a (scripted variation of) Spaceshunt Boots at level 5 which teleports 100 meters (66~ feet) away. One of the corpses contains a Tombstone Shop Key necessary for later on in the quest. Successfully warning Cora Highberry grants the Inspiration ⁠ Wine Connoisseur ( Noble background). The party can also attempt to kill Cora themselves in order to complete ⁠ Impress the Murder Tribunal . After the doppelgangers have been defeated, Cora is inside her home along with her husband and two orphans whom the pair are looking after. She thanks the party profusely for saving her life and rewards them with gold. The party can discover the grave of Cora's deceased stillborn child at the Lower City Graveyard . Technical UID S_LOW_SorcerousSundries_Necromancer UUID ba40224c-9113-4a18-b30b-a1a77e88f9d2 Stats LOW_NecromancerStaff Cordrane the Recent is a duergar wizard who peddles necromantic charms in the Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . “ Just think of the possibilities once you have a fresh, high-quality, completely safe zombie at your disposal. „ — Cordrane , in the flesh for cash business Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Cordrane is in the necromancy area with Alice Althea , attempting to sell her some necromantic charms to summon a fresh, "completely safe" zombie to perform various menial chores. Upon approaching him the first time, he casts Animate Dead: Zombie on a nearby corpse as a demonstration. He claims the summoned Zombie also makes a low-cost bodyguard and is great at food disposal and cleaning. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Blindness ( + ) Limit a foe's sight range. It is easier to hit, and the creature will miss more often. Attack rolls against it have Advantage and the foe attacks with Disadvantage . CON Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Bone Chill ( ) Damage: 1~8 1d8 ⁠ Necrotic Prevent the target from healing until your next turn. The target cannot help Downed characters. An undead target receives Disadvantage on Attack Rolls . Range: 18 m (60 ft) Ray of Sickness ( + ) Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Poison Possibly   Poisons the target. CON Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] REQUIREMENTS Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Cordrane the Recent I can tell you're a discerning customer - you're after nothing but the best. Cordrane the Recent And luckily for you, that's exactly what I have - the best necromantic charms in the city or your money back! Cordrane the Recent Just think of the possibilities once you have a fresh, high-quality, completely safe zombie at your disposal. Alice Althea Gods, but it stinks! And it looks like somebody melted most of its flesh off. Alice Althea I'd be a laughing stock with that lumbering 'round after me. Cordrane the Recent Now, now - you and I both know that being undead takes a toll on a corpse. Cordrane the Recent We also do a range of fetching liveries and complimentary perfume spritzers - all seasonal, of course. Alice Althea Complimentary, you say? Alice Althea So what can it do? I've a lot of domestic tasks that are quite frankly beneath me. Cordrane the Recent Oh. they excel at all those humdrum menial chores. Cordrane the Recent They're particularly good at cleaning - especially food disposal. Cordrane the Recent They'll happily eat anything you put in front of them. Alice Althea It is rather a pain to clean up after dinner parties... Cordrane the Recent Word of warning, mind: make sure you empty them frequently. Cordrane the Recent Otherwise you might have a gut explosion on your hands. Cordrane the Recent ...And everywhere else, really. Alice Althea Empty them? How? Oh. You know what - I'm not sure I want to know. Cordrane the Recent They also make excellent low-cost bodyguards - and you can't be too careful with the way things are going. Alice Althea It looks a little fragile to me... Cordrane the Recent Nonsense! They're tougher than they look. Plus, even if they lose a limb, they keep on going. Cordrane the Recent I sold one to a wonderful old gent for property protection. Cordrane the Recent A trespasser chopped its arms off but it still chewed right through their ankles. Cordrane the Recent They won't be trespassing anywhere else in a hurry! Or walking at all, for that matter. Alice Althea I see... Cordrane the Recent One more thing: I recommend getting at least a couple of scrolls of Turn Undead just in case. Alice Althea Just in case what? Cordrane the Recent Just in case you happen to lose control of your shiny new servant. Alice Althea Oh. Does that happen very often? Cordrane the Recent Not very. But it might. Cordrane the Recent It's very much a case of summoner error when it does - not our spellwork. Cordrane the Recent Tell you what, I'll throw one in for free with your purchase - limited time offer. Alice Althea I... Technical UID S_LOW_FlorrickConfrontation_Fallback UUID 6f74d6fd-6b13-4ccb-bd72-9b466856576e Stats LOW_Florrick_Fallback Eqp. EQP_LOW_Florrick_Fallback Cordula Eltan is a human wizard and patriar [ 1 ] , who confronts the party on the demise of Ulder Ravengard and on the subject of The Legend of Ansur in the Lower City - should Florrick be unavailable to do so, Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Heir to the founder of the Flaming Fist , former Grand Duke Eltan , Cordula Eltan is a Baldurian patriar who can only be encountered if Wyll is a companion, and Counsellor Florrick is either still jailed or deceased. As with the encounter with Florrick, if Wyll breaks his pact with Mizora during ⁠ The Blade of Frontiers and forsakes his father, Mizora tells Cordula Eltan that Wyll killed his father Ulder Ravengard . Cordula Eltan and her guards approach the party while they are in Baldur's Gate , with the intent to avenge Ravengard. However, Cordula can be convinced to stand down. [PERSUASION]  Ravengard could still be alive. And we intend to save him. (DC 18) [DECEPTION]  Ravengard's death was Gortash's doing. There was nothing we could do. (DC 18)  (if the party killed Ravengard at the coronation) [PERSUASION]  Mizora lied to you. We tried to save Ravengard, and she sabotaged us. (DC 15)  (if Ravengard was killed in the Iron Throne ) [HISTORY]  A relevant thread of knowledge pokes at your mind. Explore it.  (DC 15) Zariel's stunt destroyed countless lives. Mizora is her minion - you can't trust her. [WISDOM]  Probe her mind. The Blade has saved countless lives. He is still the man you thought he was. She then hands over the The Legend of Ansur , and directs the party to awaken the city's dragon protector to protect Baldur's Gate from the Cult of the Absolute . Failing any of the checks results in combat against her and her guards, Pollo the Muscle and Wanda Tullermoor . Epilogue [ edit section | visual editor ] If ⁠ The Blade of Frontiers is completed, Counsellor Florrick is dead, and Wyll chooses to ascend politically as the next Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate, he mentions during the epilogue party that Cordula Eltan is now the Duke of the Seatower, a Legacy Reborn. [ 2 ] If both Ulder Ravengard and Florrick are dead, Wyll entrusts the command of the Flaming Fist to Eltan, and mentions that she has pardoned most Fists, having said "Gortash led the parched Fist to Bane's bloody well. I refuse to punish the thirsty for drinking from it." . [ 3 ] Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Cone of Cold ( + ) Damage: 8~64 8d8 ⁠ Cold Make a flurry of frost, crisp air, and condensed snow crystals erupt from your hands. CON Save Range: Self Confusion ( + ) Befuddle a group of creatures, causing them to attack at random, wander around aimlessly, and occasionally skip turns in the stupor. WIS Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Fire Bolt ( ) Damage: 1~10 1d10 ⁠ Fire Hurl a mote of fire. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Lightning Bolt ( + ) Damage: 8~48 8d6 ⁠ Lightning Call forth a blast of lightning that hits all creatures in the line of the eruption. DEX Save Range: Self Magic Missile ( + ) Damage: 6~15 1d4 + 1 ⁠ Force + 1d4 + 1 ⁠ Force + 1d4 + 1 ⁠ Force Create three darts of magical force, each dealing 1d4 + 1 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage to its target. The darts always hit their target, and can each be targeted individually. The dancer has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving throws . Technical UID S_DEN_BardSquirrel2 UUID 73f18550-4755-4e3c-9326-c328d34478af Stats Rat Corinna is a Squirrel who can be found in the Emerald Grove in Act One , next to Alfira , painfully listening to her sing alongside Spar . “ It hurts! It hurts! „ — Corinna Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party talk to Corinna and Spar without Speak with Animals , they both screech and run away. If the party ask the pair what is wrong, they describe how awful Alfira's singing is; the party can respond with a few options, all of which cause them to leave: It is quite a racket. You could spare your ears by leaving. Sing along with the bard - as loudly and off-key as you can. Don't mock her - she's trying her best... I assume. If the party tell the Squirrels they are ruining the song, Spar and Corinna begin a duet. The party can respond with a few options: Bravo. You could go on tour, with talent like that. [BARD] [TIEFLING]  Sing along with them, improvising lyrics: 'How can we stop this dreadful song, this half-formed verse from leaden tongue?'   +1   +1   -1 [BARD]  Sing along with them, improvising lyrics: 'How can we stop this dreadful song, half-formed verse from devil's tongue?'   +1   +1   -1 Shut up - I want to hear the bard. Technical UID S_CRE_Cultist03 UUID 1953f136-1e57-4cfe-801a-9bde5c5344b6 Stats Halfling_Ranger Eqp. EQP_Leather Trs. MOO_Cultist Corliss is a is an Absolute cultist who attempts to leave the Rosymorn Monastery during Act One . “ No. No no no. I'm not going in there. I won't! „ — Corliss , to the githyanki Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] When the party first approaches the monastery gate at X: 73 Y: 40 , a cutscene plays. Raider Add'ath and Warrior Ith'dul are moving a group of halfling cultists ( Burrock , Corliss, and Mahrin ) to the Crêche for interrogation by the Captain. Corliss attempts to flee and is shot in the back. If the raiders are allowed to proceed, the monastery gates are magically locked behind them. Choosing to attack them leaves the gates open. [ 1 ] There are, however, several other routes inside – including via the Firewine storage and Gremiska den. If the area is approached from the parapet above the gate via the path leading from the ledge into the Monastery through the barricade at X: 33 Y: 29 , the cutscene does not play and the cultists scatter and escape. Moving on to the parapet triggers the raiders to attack the cultists, but the party can enter combat as close as X: 67 Y: 44 , just inside the room above the gate, to jump down and prevent the raiders from attacking the cultists. Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Leather Armour Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Corliss' corpse can be communed with using Speak with Dead . Who are you? Corliss Corliss... Undertump... Novice of... The Absolute... What do githyanki want with cultists? Corliss Searching... Hunting... For 'weapon'... Why were you so desperate to run? Corliss Scared... Heard... Bad things... Githyanki... Torture... What do you know about this 'weapon'? Corliss Nothing... Was telling... The truth... Didn't know... Anything... Where are you from? Corliss Little house... Under a hill... Somewhere... Don't... Remember... What were you doing here? Corliss Path to Moonrise Towers ... Absolute... Answering the call... What is happening at Moonrise Towers? Corliss Gathering... Coalescing... Preparing... Preparing for what? Corliss Orders... from... the General ... What 'General'? Corliss Chosen... Of the... Absolute... She can be found in the Lower City in Act Three . “ Hello hello, and all that. „ — Corlos Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Corlos together with Fist Arrinye , Fist Smithwynn and a Steel Watcher guards the Heapside Prison underneath the Basilisk Gate Barracks . If spoken to, she just greets the player character, not actually interested in chatting with them. Technical UID S_WYR_BruisedLocal_MaleCivilian UUID 085a2908-3136-45d7-a372-56e6f36570e2 Stats Human_Commoner Cormac is a human found near the entrance of the Open Hand Temple in Rivington in Act Three . “ Hey, don't be fussing over me - I get that plenty of that from my wife. „ — Cormac Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Cormac is near the Open Hand Temple in Rivington . He recently got robbed and beaten up by the Guild . His partner Brigid is angry and wants to avenge the assault. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Brigid What do you remember? Eye colour, hairstyle, accent, anything! Cormac They were big, and they were angry. Brigid I don't care how big they were, I'll give them a piece of my mind. Cormac They work for the Guild . Give them a piece of your mind, and pieces of your body will be washing up in Grey Harbour tomorrow. Brigid Bastards. Brigid This whole situation stinks. Brigid Guild robbers are usually decent enough folk. They take your gold, but they leave your ribs intact. Cormac Yeah, well, this time they weren't feeling polite. They really put the boot in me. Brigid And for what? You didn't even fight back! Cormac I tried. Cormac Are you all right? Brigid I'm fine - you're the one who took a beating. Cormac I survived the beating. Let that be the end of it, and don't make things worse. Brigid You want to let those thugs get away with this? He begins casting a ritual spell to kill the party after a certain number of turns, while his minions, including Corniche, appear and attack the party as they attempt to cross the bridge to stop Ghislev. Technical UID S_LOW_SerialKiller_FakeYagaShura UUID deecbcbc-aab6-41f5-a534-ace00fe38b33 Courageous Little Kimmabeth is a dead Human whose corpse is in the Lower City in Act Three. “ Yaga-Shura, who carried the blood of Bhaal and fire giants both. It ran just as red as his brethren's. „ — Jaheira , upon exploring the scene Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Courageous Little Kimmabeth's corpse is in the basement of Peartree House , his heart extracted and burning in a brazier nearby. Kimmabeth was killed by Orin the Red . His corpse was used as a component of Orin's "art" as an effigy to Yaga-Shura , a Bhaalspawn belonging to a Fire Giants race defeated more than a century ago, along with the body of Cassie Wheynstown. Kimmabeth's corpse can be looted for one of ⁠ Dribbles' body parts and the second of Orin's Ritual Notes . Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Find Dribbles the Clown ⁠ Investigate the Murders Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Clown's Severed Arm Yaga-Shura, the Second Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Fire Giants are not included in the game as a playable race, nor can any of them be met along the playthrough. Therefore, Kimmabeth's in-game model, as well as model of Hubersa Declensios (a dead human depicting Yaga-Shura in yet another corpse effigy in the Undercity Ruins ), is actually a heavyset, robust human with light-ginger hair and beard, resembling Yaga-Shura's image from the previous Baldur's Gate games. He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three . “ You're a stranger. I don't like strangers. „ — Cragbender Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Cragbender is a Warden of the Wyrm's Rock Fortress and the commander of a squad stationed in the Flaming Fist Office. His subordinates are Fist Broko , Fist Callaway and Fist Loudstone . Cragbender walks back and forth in the off-limits area near quartermaster Arkleia Oloril at X: -9 Y: 191 . He has little to say to the party if spoken to. Technical UID S_WYR_RoughSleepers_HalfOrc UUID 03dc8542-1d40-471b-89cc-f28950b5ba2b Stats HalfOrc_Commoner Crak is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three . “ The missus and I have been dreaming about the city - no more sleeping rough. Didn't expect to find it locked down tighter than a Watcher's fist. „ — Crak Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Crak is standing near the entrance to Fraygo's Flophouse , speaking with his mate Rilia . The couple has travelled to Wyrm's Crossing and got stuck here, because all available corners to stay have been occupied by refugees, adventurers or people who gathered to witness or hear a word about Gortash's ordination. Crak has been standing on guard all nights on their way to the city and is exhausted. He offers Rilia several possibilities for lodging, wishing only to obtain a warm meal and a bed. Alas, while worrying about him in words, in deeds she finds a reason to reject any option he proposes. v t e Wyrm's Crossing Characters Cultists of Bhaal Gavv Hemm Lunn Zoll Flaming Fists Azari Edwynna Elin Falcäo Gai Meadows Mîran Shah Carm's Garms Naaber Slozy Arminifer Trinigan Gazotts Vinegaroon Danthelon's Dancing Axe Geraldus Limmy Safyre Somi Tairn Fraygo's Flophouse Bernyr Crak Dalyria Dashkent Moliver Drim Ffion Goldgrind Petras Rilia Rosanna Sharess' Caress Amira Arfur Gregorio Borgus Elamin Chapeau Chorizo Cillian Earspoon Embry Ghainemeir Hakeem Irenya Jara Kira Korrilla Laila Naoise Nallinto Nym Orlith Raphael Rhol Sorn Orlith Surixana Valeria Voss Other Kali Hammerhand Neno Quilltop Traders Carmen Pennygood Entharl Danthelon Glynda Oltower Griska Hoots Hooligan Queelia Arvis Roberon Silt Stylin' Horst Thodric Shedeveer Velson Oakes Locations Carm's Garms Danthelon's Dancing Axe Fraygo's Flophouse Sharess' Caress The Velveteen Elixir Quests Deal with the Devil Deal with the Gnomes Find a way into Wyrm's Rock fortress Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion Free Orpheus Help Kith'rak Voss Investigate Cazador's Palace Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders The Githyanki Warrior The High Harper

Technical UID S_WYR_WyrmRockPrison_Guard_002 UUID 3a853d86-2086-4923-b09d-3192244effe6 Stats FlamingFist_Dwarf_Cleric Fist Creekrider is a dwarven cleric and a member of the Flaming Fist . He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three . “ So, what? You're saying there could really be a dragon down there? „ — Creekrider , discussing prisoner's slumber-mutters Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Creekrider guards the Wyrm's Rock Prison together with Fist Saunder , Fist Jagic and Fist Ivarus . While the latter is constantly patrolling the prison corridor, Creekrider sits in a guardroom with the other two Fists, wagging their tongues around recent events in the fortress: the death sentence passed on Counsellor Florrick , Gortash's ordaining, occasional thefts in the Flaming Fist barracks and some others. Creekrider does not want to discuss any of these with the player character, reacting to attempts to speak with him with grunts only. If Gortash is defeated, Creekrider takes the news philosophically, suggesting that he will carry on his duties regardless. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Aid ( + ) Bolster your allies with toughness and resolve to heal and increase their Hit Points maximum. Range: Self Calm Emotions ( + ) Humanoids can't be Charmed , Frightened , or become enraged. Technical UID S_LOW_BaldursMouth_Wanderer_02 UUID df51f991-98d1-413c-b3c4-b5caeed569f4 Stats Human_Commoner Cressida Flint is a voracious consumer of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette . She is found in the Lower City during Act Three , where she readily shares her opinions about current events. “ Careful, CAREFUL! People don't bloody look where they're walking. The gazette's right - folk these days have no manners. „ — Cressida Flint Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Cressida's interactions with the party vary according to major events and the outcome of ⁠ Stop the Presses . If no major events occurred yet, she is exasperated toward the party, requesting to pace and think in peace. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Cressida Flint You seen any Gazetteers around? Need to see if the new edition's out yet. Cressida Flint Careful, CAREFUL! People don't bloody look where they're walking. Cressida Flint The gazette's right - folk these days have no manners. Cressida Flint Here's a tip - latest Baldur's Mouth edition? Dynamite. That Lord Gortash ... Cressida Flint Should have his own column, never mind just an interview. If Baldur's Mouth publishes a negative article on the party: Cressida Flint You're exactly the sort Lord Gortash was talking about in his interview. In fact, I bet Gortash mentions you scum next time he's interviewed. Cressida Flint Watch yourself - hang on, I know you. Cressida Flint I read about you! In the Gazette! Ooh, you're a PROPER wrong'un. Cressida Flint Didn't the guards read the Baldur's Mouth? You should be booted from the city. Cressida Flint Hang on, can the guards even read? If Baldur's Mouth publishes a positive article on the party: Cressida Flint I look forward to reading about your next exploits! Cressida Flint I know that face - you're the one from the gazette! Cressida Flint A real hero ... thought you'd be taller, though. Cressida Flint You should see if the Baldur's Mouth will interview you. Technical UID S_WYR_Circus_Beast_02 UUID cfaec473-d13a-42e8-a771-aa0e8f6a04da Stats Dilophosaurus Crimson is a beast NPC found in Act Three . Crimson is kept in a cage at the Circus of the Last Days , in Rivington . “ The HUNGER. My stomach SCREAMS. Press your FLESH through BARS. A hand. A HEAD. BLOOD. Meat. „ — Crimson , mad with starvation Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] When spoken to, Crimson is ravenous, and being driven mad by his hunger. If using Speak with Animals , the party can immediately discern his bloodlust is due to being starved for food. If Crimson is interacted with without Speak with Animals, the interacting party member must be a Ranger or Druid and pass an Animal Handling check: [RANGER] [DRUID] [ANIMAL HANDLING]  Mimic the beast's body language to get a closer look.  (DC 15  ) [RANGER] [DRUID] [ANIMAL HANDLING]  Examine the animal.  (DC 15) Following this, the character can then calm Crimson with a gift of meat, earning the ⁠ Primary Needs for Outlander backgrounds. Any kind of meat will suffice; some can be found in the Temple Kitchen in the Open Hand Temple . Crimson is released from his cage and attacks the party during the fight with Dribbles the Clown . If fed beforehand, he is too busy eating and does not participate in the fight. Afterwards, Crimson thanks the party, explaining that the Doppelgangers starved him and then provoked him with bloody rags, whereas the true circus employees always treated him like family. He considers himself friends with Shadow-Whiskers , in the cage next to him, and sympathizes with her pain. If the animal handlers are attacked before approaching Dribbles, they unlock the cages but Crimson and Shadow-Whiskers continue to be neutral entities. Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Technical UID S_LOW_BhaalTemple_ButlerOrin UUID c4197c67-9fbf-4ac3-8a24-7902ea573c68 Stats Imp Cruor is an dead imp. Its corpse is in the Chosen's Room in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity . It was sent to Orin to become her butler but instead, she experimented on it leading to its death. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Cruor was sent to Orin by Bhaal , against her wishes. According to a nearby book, Orin grew increasingly frustrated at the imp praising the way she slaughtered her enemies that she decided to end its life to silence it. Butlers of Bhaal which are no longer needed, for whatever reason, die permanently. Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Experiment on Cruor Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Cruor may be a reference to Cespenar , Bhaal's imp butler from Baldur's Gate 2 which served Gorion's Ward in their Pocket Plane as they explored the limits of their divinity inherited from Bhaal . GOB_Goblin_Raider Crusher is a goblin stationed at the Goblin Camp near the Ancient Rune Circle in Act One . “ And who're you? 'Nother pest? Everyone just barges in here, thinkin' they rule the world. Hah! „ — Crusher when approached by the player Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act One 1.1.1 Dark Urge 2 Companion approval 2.1 Act One 3 Combat 3.1 Attacks and actions 3.2 Loot 4 Speak with Dead 5 Notes and references Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Crusher is in the eastern courtyard of the Goblin Camp, boasting to a small crowd about goblin superiority and the power of the Absolute . If a non-drow player character interacts with him, he attempts to humiliate them and demands their submission by kissing his foot. If the interacting party member is a drow or half drow , Crusher does not attempt to bully them. There are several ways to respond to Crusher: Persuade Crusher: [ 1 ] [BRANDED]  We're on the same side. I've got the Absolute's brand. Give in and kiss his foot: [ 1 ] [DARK URGE]  Ignore your lust to eat the foot. Get down to lick it. [DARK URGE]  Follow the goblin's orders and kneel down - for now. Kiss his foot and get it over with. It wasn't too bad. Do you use perfume? (Starts a fight) Was that enough reverence for you? Grab his foot and lick it. (Starts a fight) Attack the goblin. (Starts a fight) Give the foot a long lick. (Starts a fight) [ROGUE] [SLEIGHT OF HAND]  Kiss his foot - and try to slide the ring off his toe.  (DC 10  ) [SLEIGHT OF HAND]  Kiss his foot - and try to slide the ring off his toe.  (DC 10) Steal Crusher's Ring (dialogue only). This grants the following inspiration: ⁠ Anything for a Profit ( Charlatan background) ⁠ What Price Dignity? ( Urchin background) Demand Crusher kiss the player character's foot instead: [ 1 ] [INTIMIDATION]  How about you kiss my feet instead? (DC 15)  (if not a Barbarian) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  NO. KISS MY FOOT. (DC 15  ) [ 1 ] Not so high and mighty, after all. (leads to a fight) [INTIMIDATION]  You better kiss my foot. Now. (DC 15)  (if not a Barbarian) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  FOOT. KISS. NOW!  (DC 15  ) [ILLITHID] [WISDOM]  You will obey me. Kneel. (DC 2) [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM]  Scan his mind. I know you're planning to take over. I wonder what your boss will think of that. If Crusher initiates the fight, he surrenders when reduced to one-fourth of his Hit Points , granting the party 15 XP and the ⁠ Give Them a Show inspiration to characters with the Entertainer background. [ 2 ] I think my point's been made. Come on, I'll help you up. Now. You should kiss my feet. Leave him groveling on the ground. Laugh at his eagerness and finish him off. (makes the whole camp hostile) Ignore his pleading and prepare for the finishing blow. (makes the whole camp hostile) If the interacting party member completes the exchange without the entire camp becoming hostile, Crusher walks away from the stage toward the bridge to relieve himself. It is possible to Shove him into the river or to discreetly kill him. Dark Urge [ edit section | visual editor ] The Dark Urge has a special dialogue option: [ 1 ] [DARK URGE]  Ponder how it would taste to bite his toe clean off. This causes the player character to bite off his toe, initiating combat but sparing the party humiliation. Combat in this case only involves Crusher and the three other goblins in his "audience"; other goblins are attracted by the commotion, but only to cheer Crusher on. Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Insult Crusher until he starts a fight - I said I'd spit in your face. Was that unclear, or do you need a demonstration?   +1   +1 Kiss Crusher's foot   -1   -1   -1   +1   -1 Lick Crusher's foot after kissing it   +5   -1   +1   -5   +1   -1 Kiss Crusher's foot, but only to steal his ring   +1   +1   +1 Intimidate Crusher into kissing your feet   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 for the initial threat, and another   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 to make him follow through. Show Crusher mercy after defeating him   +1   -1   -1   -1 Spare Crusher after defeating him, but make him kiss your feet   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 Kill Crusher after defeating him   +1   -1   +1   +1 Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Goblin Scimitar Damage: 4~9 1d6 + 3 ⁠ Slashing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Range: Self Recharge: Short rest Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Crusher's Ring Goblin Scimitar Spiked Shield Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Crusher's corpse can be communed with using Speak with Dead . Who are you? Crusher Crusher. Strongest... of our tribe. Are you really the strongest? Does that mean you are the boss? Crusher Should be... boss. But Dror Ragzlin ... hobgoblin. Do you have anything of value? Crusher Toe ring... magic... Who killed you? Crusher They'll pay... Absolute ... will make them pay... The Absolute? Who is that? Crusher Absolute... blesses. Gives power. Makes... The True Souls... Did you see a druid named Halsin? Crusher If I had... would've killed 'im... So do you have a thing for feet, or...? Crusher Of...course not. That's... disgusting ... Will you kiss my feet again?  (If you made Crusher kiss your feet) Crusher No... not kissing you... anywhere... Have you learned you lesson, now that you're dead? Crusher Absolute... is forever. She'll punish... The Absolute? Who is that? Crusher Absolute... blesses. Gives power. Makes... The True Souls... GOB_Goblin_Generic Booyahg Culk is a goblin stationed in the Goblin Camp in Act One . “ Can't you go be a True Soul somewhere else? „ — Culk , awakened from a drunken sleep Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Booyahg Culk is on the secluded northern edge of the Goblin Camp with several other goblins and bugbears who have fallen into a drunk slumber. If the party attack the cracked wall to gain entry into the Shattered Sanctum , it causes all nearby enemies to wake up and initiate combat. The party can also startle Culk awake by landing nearby with a Jump . It is possible to avoid combat by passing a skill check. [PERSUASION]  Hush now. Go back to sleep. (DC 10) [DROW-ELF]  None of your concern. Back to your stupor. [ILLITHID] [WISDOM]  Nothing. Lie back down and be silent. (DC 2) Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Acid Splash ( ) Damage: 1~6 1d6 ⁠ Acid Throw a bubble of acid that damages each creature it hits. DEX Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Grease ( + )   –   Scroll of Grease Cover the ground in flammable grease. It becomes Difficult Terrain and creatures within can fall   Prone . DEX Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Ritual Staff Damage: 1~5 1d6 - 1 ⁠ Bludgeoning Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Ray of Sickness ( + ) Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Poison Possibly   Poisons the target. CON Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Sleep ( + ) Put creatures into a magical slumber. Select targets up to a combined 24 Hit Points . Technical UID S_LOW_PlagueShip_CursedImp UUID 008b019e-5e7d-456a-8697-656f8ca8f241 Stats LOW_PlagueShip_Imp Cursed Imp is a unique, high-level variant of imp found in the Lower City . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] The Imp can be located on Lustrous Lass, the quarantined ship on the docks of the The Counting House , and is suggested to be related to the Sea Plague that resulted in the ship's quarantining. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Caustic Claws ( ) Damage: 4~32 4d8 ⁠ Acid Lash out with acid fingernails. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Fly ( ) Fly to a target position Range: 18 m (60 ft) Ray of Sickness ( + ) Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Poison Possibly   Poisons the target. CON Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Sting ( ) Damage: 8~31 1d4 + 3 ⁠ Piercing + 4d6 ⁠ Poison Bite a target. Deals 1d4 + Dexterity Modifier Piercing damage and possibly deals an additional 1d4 Poison damage. CON Save Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] The imp is an unassuming but extremely dangerous foe, as its passive ability Caustic Retort deals massive retaliatory damage upon any attackers. Even though it is named Cursed Imp, Remove Curse does not affect it. However, given its small stature, the imp can be easily shoved or thrown out of the ship into the water, where it will die immediately — presumably through drowning, as imps can usually recover from being shoved into chasms. Killing the imp cleanses the ship of its plague clouds, as well as curing any characters infected with Sea Plague . It has no special drops. It always upcasts Ray of Sickness at level 6, so it does 7d8 damage. v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the Lower City Anti-Hag Support Group Adrielle Hydrangea Wubb Jatlo Kled Mayrina Baldur's PLA_Tollhouse_SuppliesTrader Cyrel is a human wizard, formerly dedicated to Tyr during Act One . She is hunting for Karlach with her companions along The Risen Road . “ The Lord of Justice sent us after a devil haunting this area. We squared off against her. We lost. „ — Cyrel Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Cyrel is in the Risen Road Toll House . If spoken with, she informs the party that she, Trynn , and Anders are stalwarts of Tyr sworn to uphold justice in their pursuit of a devil. [ 1 ] Cyrel states she is willing to trade with the party, as they have fewer mouths to feed since the gnolls attacked. If asked, she reveals that they lost two in a recent battle. If a party member speaks to Cyrel after discovering Anders is a fallen Paladin pledged to Zariel, she drops the Tyr act and talks of Zariel instead. [ 2 ] If Karlach is present in the party, then Cyrel, Anders, and Trynn become hostile. Most gold, items sold, and inventory cannot be looted if she is killed. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Hold Person ( + ) Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't Move , Act , or React . Attacks from within 3 m / 10 ft are always Critical Hits . At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Wisdom Saving Throw to end this condition. The darts always hit their target, and can each be targeted individually. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Dagger Damage: 2~5 1d4 + 1 ⁠ Piercing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Ray of Frost ( ) Damage: 1~8 1d8 ⁠ Cold Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 3 m / 10 ft. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Ray of Sickness ( + ) Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Poison Possibly   Poisons the target. CON Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Shield ( + ) When you are about to be hit by an enemy, use your Reaction to increase your Armour Class by 5. You also take no damage from Magic Missile . These effects last until the start of your next turn. Range: Self Thunderwave ( + ) Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Thunder Release a wave of thunderous force that pushes away all creatures and objects in an area, while also dealing Thunder damage. HAV_Survivor Cyril is an emotive Flaming Fist [ 1 ] under the command of Counsellor Florrick to rescue Duke Ravengard during Act Two . “ If you're poking around this gods-forsaken place, you must have someone in Moonrise, too. Hope you find them. „ — Cyril Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Initially on a mission led by Florrick to rescue Ulder Ravengard , Cyril and the rest of the Fists were waylaid by the dangers of the Shadow-Cursed Lands and found refuge with the Harpers at Last Light Inn . Cyril is within the inn, in the same room as several other Fists and Art Cullagh . If Florrick is not rescued from Waukeen's Rest in Act One , Cyril does not appear in the game. Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Cyril is not affected by the Impaled condition and is instead Surprised . He may join the battle on his own without being affected by any conditions if the door to the room he is in is opened after the encounter starts. If Isobel is not saved, he and everyone in Last Light Inn, save Jaheira , turn into Shadow-Cursed Undead . After the battle ends, Cyril takes up position in front of the door to the Flaming Fists' room alongside Gretta . Speaking with him results in his disclosing he knew Marcus well and did not expect his betrayal. [ 2 ] He sorrowfully wonders if they could have helped Marcus and prevented him from joining the Cult of the Absolute . [ 3 ] Leaving for Baldur's Gate [ edit section | visual editor ] After a Long Rest , Cyril, Manip Vidor and Fist Thadwick journey towards Baldur's Gate with Florrick to seek reinforcements unaffected by the Shadow Curse : the Steel Watch . Cyril is never seen again after his departure. Technical UID S_SCL_OliversDiary_DadShadow UUID 509470bc-6c99-40c6-8d50-9dbf78b71dcf Stats SCL_Oliver_Dad Daddy is a unique Wraith in the Shadow-Cursed Lands . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] 'Daddy' appears during the second game of hide-and-seek with Oliver, requiring the party to Hide if they wish to avoid a fight. It also enters them into Turn-Based Mode. The party must then either sneak their way into the ruined house where Oliver reappears in two turns or attempt to fight the powerful shadow which is backed up by 'Mummy' and 'Doggy' . The wraith appears again during the final confrontation with Oliver at the heart of Reithwin Town , even if defeated earlier. Cashguard Basher Nickelow Never mind Glitterbeard. It's Meadhoney's good books you want to be in. Technical UID S_PLA_FlamingFist7 UUID c28e5d52-8674-49a2-a60a-6e5ed47f4441 Stats FlamingFist_Human_Cleric Eqp. EQP_Warhammer_Scalemail_Shield_Fist Trs. PLA_Tavern_Paladin Gauntlet Dain is a human cleric serving as a corporal to the Flaming Fist during Act One . “ You're no help just standing there. Help us! „ — Dain Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Dain works alongside other members of the Flaming Fist attempting to put out the fires engulfing Waukeen's Rest on The Risen Road , following a raid by goblins. If the party leave the area and return later, then the inn has burned down. Dain then wanders around, trying to make sense of the tracks in the dirt. The party can talk to her, and offer to try and track the footsteps: [INVESTIGATION]  I'll see if I can spot anything. (DC 10) [RANGER] [INVESTIGATION]  Tracking is what I do. Let me see if I can spot anything. (DC 10  ) Successfully passing the check reveals the presence of a Drow , and the footsteps leading to the south. Otherwise, the party can ask if she has figured anything out and offer to help with one of the following options: [DECEPTION]  I'm a guard from a nearby village. I'm here to offer my assistance (DC 10) [PERSUASION]  Clearly you're in a rough spot. I can help. (DC 10) [SELDARINE] [PERSUASION]  My true kin have no care for surface raids. You can trust me. (DC 15) [PERSUASION]  If they allied with goblins, they were not Lolth's Chosen. Tell me more - now. (DC 15) [GOOD PALADIN] [PERSUASION]  By my oath, you have my help. But I must to know the truth to assist you. (DC 5) [DETECT THOUGHTS] [INTELLIGENCE]  Search her mind for information. (DC 15) You're smart to keep quiet. Nobles attract the wrong sort of attention. Passing any of these checks cause Dain to reveal that Ulder Ravengard was kidnapped. If the party already knew he was kidnapped, they may inform her, though nothing happens afterwards. The party may also wipe away the tracks, causing Dain to be angry at the party. MOO_Cultist Daine is in Moonrise Towers on the first floor balcony during Act Two . “ Hey, True Soul - what's the word? „ — Daine Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Daine is on a balcony of Moonrise Towers , on the eastern side of the first floor playing cards with Zealot Bennel . Daine attempts to cheat at cards, but Bennel notices and then deducts that Daine was a former Flaming Fist mercenary. [ 1 ] Talking with Daine lets her ask the party if they have any news or marching orders. Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Daine is part of the remaining forces defending Moonrise Towers, and moves to the center of the throne room. Should the party enter the throne room prematurely, or kill a few Absolutists in the hall, she joins combat. Technical UID S_LOW_Overdose_Unconscious UUID 5da78446-ff91-4432-b838-ac721160f6d4 Stats Tiefling_Commoner Dairow Vin is a tiefling who can be found Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Dairow Vin can be found unconscious in the Lower City Sewers at X: -155 Y: 846 , surrounded by empty Potion of Sleep bottles. He has the condition Impenetrable slumber , thus it is impossible to wake him up. [ 1 ] History [ edit section | visual editor ] Dairow and his husband fled Elturel for a better life. At some point they separated, Dairow taking work with the Guild , and his husband travelling with a group of refugees. [ 2 ] After losing contact with his husband, Dairow contacted guildmaster Nine-Fingers Keene to try and find information on his whereabouts. The Guild were able to track the latest refugees he was travelling with, but after crossing paths with the Absolute's forces, the entire group went missing without a trace. [ 2 ] Grieving the loss and probable death of his husband, Dairow consumed a large quantity of Potions of Sleep , falling into an impenetrable slumber in the city sewers. Dairow's husband is speculated to be the brother of the dead refugee Garrett , whose corpse can be found by the cliffside in Rivington . Information supporting this assertion can be learned by using Speak with Dead Dairow through which it is revealed that he fled from the Absolute's army with his brother. Additional evidence includes the Our Offer Remains Open note on Dairow Vin's body, which shows his husband was also a refugee. Also on the refugee's body is the Gemless Ring which, when combined with the Ringless Gem held by Ferg Drogher , creates a Tarnished Ring . If Garrett is asked about the ring using Speak with Dead, he answers that the ring belonged to his brother - who died on the road. Finally, if pickpocketing or killing Dairow Vin, a similar tarnished ring can be found. All of these details lend credence to the theory that Garrett’s brother was Dairow’s husband, and the Tarnished Rings were their wedding bands. SCL_HarpersDuty_Body1 Harper Lightspark [ 1 ] is a dead gold dwarven Harper whose corpse is in the Shadow-Cursed Lands at X: 92 Y: 107 , close to He Who Was . He, and two other Harpers, [ 2 ] went on an expedition to scout the boundaries of the Shadow Curse , before eventually getting lost and succumbing to it before they could make it back to the Last Light Inn . History [ edit section | visual editor ] Scouting Expedition [ edit section | visual editor ] Lightspark, along with two other Harpers , went on to scout the hills east of the Last Light Inn in an attempt to find the borders of the Shadow Curse , discovering an abandoned house just east of the inn at ( X: 33 Y: 145 ) and an eery ruined home on a nearby hillock. One of the Harpers he was with mentioned hearing a child's laughter from the ruined home, and observing Githyanki warriors approaching the house, to which Lightspark noted incredulously in his journal that he hoped his fellow scout was imagining things. [ 3 ] However, Lightspark and his scouting party eventually fall prey to the Shadow Curse before bringing the Harper Journal back to the Inn. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Who were you in life? Harper Lightspark Dal Lightspark... scout... What happened to you? Harper Lightspark The forest... no escape... the darkness turns all... twists all... Where did you come from? Harper Lightspark Last Light Inn... sanctuary from shadows... stronghold... What were you doing here? Harper Lightspark Scouting... seeking... gaps in cultist defences... Did you find a gap in the cultist defences? Harper Lightspark Caravan... to Moonrise Towers... know how to keep the shadows at bay... How can I fend off these cursed shadows? Harper Lightspark Last Light... Isobel... BG_Commoner_Wealthy Dalyria is a Vampire Spawn enslaved to Cazador , and one of Astarion's siblings. History [ edit section | visual editor ] Prior to being spawn, she was a doctor, Physician General to the Parliament of Baldur's Gate. She believes that vampirism can be cured as any other disease can, and so sought youthful blood to try to overwhelm the vampirism infection. [ 1 ] She sought Leon's daughter, Victoria , brought her to the Szarr Palace and bit into her. However, Leon had placed a curse on Victoria as a means of protection, which was triggered when she was bitten. Cazador then found Dalyria, who was retching in reaction to tasting cursed blood, and dragged her away for disobeying the rules and drinking a thinking creature. [ 2 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Dalyria can first be encountered on the first floor of Fraygo's Flophouse in Wyrm's Crossing , where she is hunting with Pale Petras . [ 3 ] If Astarion is present, the three will have a confrontation about Cazador and his intentions for the Black Mass ritual being held at the Szarr Palace . If Astarion is not present, the party can eavesdrop on their conversation: [STEALTH]  Listen in.  (DC 15) [ROGUE] [STEALTH]  Listen in.  (DC 15  ) Whether or not the check succeeds or fails, the party can interject by stating they know Astarion or they are interested in the 'party'. The spawn invite the party and then leave. She later can be encountered with the other spawn in Cazador's Dungeon , suspended and awaiting Cazador's ritual to finish. Like the other spawn, she can be spared or killed after the ritual, or allowed to be consumed as one of the ritual's sacrifices. Subsequent attacks that sap blood will further reduce the target's maximum hit points. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Claws ( ) Damage: 5~11 2d4 + 3 ⁠ Slashing Lash out with deadly claws. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Multiattack ( ) Damage: 10~22 2d4 + 3 ⁠ Slashing + 2d4 + 3 ⁠ Slashing Aim multiple attacks at a target. Each attack deals 2d4 Slashing damage. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Recharge: Per turn Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Pale Petras Not long before we leave scouring places like this behind. Part of me will miss it. Dalyria I will not. It is our chance to start over, and I will gladly do so. Pale Petras Do you think the master plans to expand his territory? Take Candlekeep - maybe even Amn ? Dalyria Oh, I'm sure he has plans. But I wouldn't dare guess at them. Dalyria Haven't we lingered long enough? We should return for the ceremony. Pale Petras We have time - the runaway is still missing, after all. Nothing happens until he's found. Yellow as a toad, and twice as ugly. „ — Damays , about Lae'zel Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Damays and Nymessa disagree on their next steps for Lae'zel , who is trapped in an elevated cage. Damays argues that Lae'zel is dangerous and should be brought to Zevlor in the Emerald Grove , but Nymessa argues that it is safer to leave "it" in the cage. If the party approach, Lae'zel telepathically demands that the party free her, initiating ⁠ Free Lae'zel . The party can convince the tieflings to leave the area or offer to help kill Lae'zel. If Damays and Nymessa are not dispatched through intimidation, the party can ask about nearby healers. They suggest seeking out Nettie , which advances ⁠ Find a Cure and ⁠ Get Help from Healer Nettie . Attacking Damays and Nymessa by any means, including options that occur through the dialogue, is considered an oathbreaking action for Paladins of any Oath subclass . LOW_Weaponsmith_Trade Dammon is a tiefling blacksmith and trader who fled Elturel with a group of tiefling refugees. “ Used to be a bread-and-butter tinsmith before Elturel fell into Avernus. These days my talents are more eclectic .<...> between you and me, there's nothing in all the realms like the utter power of infernal machinery. „ — Dammon Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Fixing Karlach's heart 1.2 Crafting special equipment 2 Related literature 3 Related quests 4 Items sold 4.1 Act One 4.2 Act Two 4.3 Act Three 4.4 Other 4.4.1 Stock 4.4.2 Trader tables 5 Loot 6 Gallery 7 Notes and References Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Dammon can be first met at his forge in the Hollow in the Emerald Grove . He describes himself as a "bread-and-butter tinsmith " before the events of Descent into Avernus and Elturel being pulled into the Hells. A few of his lines of dialogue reveal that, after Elturel's fall, Dammon spent a fair amount of time in the Hells working with Infernal machinery. He mentions that his captors were vicious, but thought him useful; they drafted him to an Infernal forge as a blacksmith. This is where much of his knowledge of Infernal metals comes from. The descriptions of several items contain quotes from Dammon about his time in the forge of Carixim . If surviving throughout the story, Dammon can be found at several locations in all acts of the game. As the only merchant reliably accessible through all three acts, he is an excellent candidate for an early investment in good attitude . He is found at: ⁠ The Hollow [ 1 ] at X: 180 Y: 561 in Act One . ⁠ Last Light Inn [ 2 ] at X: -35 Y: 169 in Act Two . ⁠ Forge of the Nine [ 3 ] at X: -2 Y: -8 in Act Three . ⁠ High Hall as part of ⁠ Gather Your Allies , although he cannot be traded with Fixing Karlach's heart [ edit section | visual editor ] As Dammon is the only infernal mechanic in the game, he is part of Karlach's personal quest, ⁠ The Hellion's Heart . It cannot be progressed any further if Dammon is killed by any means before its completion. Crafting special equipment [ edit section | visual editor ] Dammon can craft unique equipment for the party if given the right materials. With Devilfoil Masks he can craft: Orthon Explosive With Infernal Iron (or Infernal Alloy ) he can craft items from the Flawed Helldusk equipment set: [ 4 ] Flawed Helldusk Armour Flawed Helldusk Gloves Flawed Helldusk Helmet Crafting any of these equipment for the first time grants the ⁠ Hellish Armaments to party members with the Guild Artisan background. After Dammon has crafted all of the pieces of the Helldusk set at least once, there will no longer be the option of trading in any additional Infernal Iron or Infernal Alloy to him. Within Act Two, any special equipment can only be crafted before the party enter Shadowfell in Gauntlet of Shar . After this, if Dammon survives, he remains at Last Light Inn, but only his trading menu is available. Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Dammon's Journal Letter from Dammon Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Raid the Grove ⁠ Save the Refugees ⁠ The Hellion's Heart Items sold [ edit section | visual editor ] The items Dammon sells in Act One are available in all three acts. Charge-Bound Warhammer Darkfire Shortbow Harmonium Halberd Sword of Clutching Umbra Sword of Life Stealing Swordmaster Gloves Thermodynamo Axe Thorn Blade Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Corresponds to LOW_Weaponsmith_Trade . Armour of Persistence Boots of Persistence Legacy of the Masters Unwanted Masterwork Scalemail Other [ edit section | visual editor ] Stock [ edit section | visual editor ] Dye Remover Trader tables [ edit section | visual editor ] Items of following trader tables are possibly sold by Dammon: Adjusted Ranged Equipment Trader Table Armour Trader Table Dye Subtable Magic Armour Trader Table Melee Weapon Trader Table Secondary Armour Trader Table Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Next to a part of the wares he sells, Dammon can also be looted for The Forge Key in Act Three . Technical UID S_LOW_FakeDiaytha_Corpse_000 UUID b42e68ed-d168-4d20-a201-5ef340364301 Danfora of the Kingfish is a dead Drow whose is in the Lower City in Act Three. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Danfora of the Kingfish's corpse is in the basement of Lavernica's Home , a victim of a massacre unleashed by Orin the Red . It is one of the few in the massacre which has loot, namely a cryptic note about Sendai the Third. Danfora's UID runs as "FakeDiaytha" . Diaytha was a character in Baldur's Gate II game, a Drow cleric under the command of Bhaalspawn Sendai . Danfora's portrait is designed to resemble that of Diaytha as well. DEN_Refugee Danis (Act Two differences) Balanced Explorer Tactician Balanced Difficulty Stats Level 3 HP 28 Proficiency +2 Explorer Difficulty Stats Level 3 HP 19 Proficiency +4 Tactician Difficulty Stats Level 3 HP 36 Proficiency +2 Danis is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One . He is married to Bex . “ We made it through Hell - twice! I know now that as long as Danis and I stick together, we can do anything. „ — Bex on Danis Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Danis is usually with Bex at X: 165 Y: 550 . If a party member interacts with him, he shares some of his hopes and dreams for Baldur's Gate . Before arriving at the Grove, he was employed by his father-in-law as a caravan but quit on his third day. If the party decides to ⁠ Raid the Grove , Danis hides in the Secluded Chamber with other tieflings. If he survives ⁠ Defeat the Goblins , he and Bex join the celebration at the party's Campsite . If the party travels to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before resolving Kagha's ritual the Rite of Thorns , the tieflings are expelled from the Grove and Danis' corpse is among the pile of refugees near the bridge to the Blighted Village . Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If Danis survives Act One, Bex reveals to the party at the Last Light Inn that Danis was captured. He can be rescued as part of ⁠ Rescue the Tieflings . If Danis is not freed from Moonrise Towers before dealing with the Nightsong , his corpse is disposed of in the Oubliette with those of all the other prisoners. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If he is rescued in Act Two , Danis moves with the other refugees to Rivington near the Requisitioned Barn . Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Unarmed Strike ( ) Damage: 1 + modifiers 1 + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Hit a target with your bare fists. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] During the assault on the Emerald Grove, Danis chats with Bex, Ikaron, and Okta: Okta So you have experience treating the wounded? Bex Well... not exactly. Okta Just good with a needle and thread? Bex Sure. Were you a cook in Elturel? Okta You've had my food, right? Answer's in the gruel. Ikaron Look on the bright side, mother - should be fewer mouths to feed after today. Okta Ikaron, please. Bex Danis can hunt! Sharp as an elf with that bow, aren't you love? Danis Well. In a pinch. Ikaron Then why aren't you on the wall? Danis Rabbits don't shoot back, do they? Danis Would you... like to pray, or something? Ikaron No. Danis Right. Silence it is. BG_Commoner Danzo Arkwright is the owner of Sword Coast Couriers postal service in Rivington during Act Three . “ Welcome to Sword Coast Couriers - to Send and to Serve. Delivery not guaranteed. „ — Danzo Arkwright Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Find the Missing Letters Danzo is behind the counter in the main room of Sword Coast Couriers at X: 13 Y: 10 . If spoken to, he expresses concern because the "rampaging fanatics on the road" make his work more difficult. He reveals that several messenger pigeons were killed, forcing him to hunt down the letters they were carrying. The player character can offer to search for the missing letters. This starts ⁠ Find the Missing Letters . A letter on the roof of Open Hand Temple reveals Danzo's dealings with the Zhentarim , specifically Roah Moonglow . The player character can attempt to blackmail Danzo in exchange for more gold upon completing ⁠ Find the Missing Letters . Technical UID S_LOW_BaldursGate_FlamingFist_Cleric_001 UUID f61ed726-793d-4611-a234-ad5a6b487514 Stats FlamingFist_Human_Cleric Fist Healer Darbonna is a human cleric and a member of the Flaming Fist . She can be found in Lower City in Act Three . “ Wait your turn! Complaining won't get you in any faster. „ — Darbonna Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Darbonna is standing watch on the far end of the bridge at the Upper City Gate Checkpoint . She watches over the queue of residents trying to make their way into the Upper City together with 'Deadeye' Mibbs and Fist Granitdatter . However, she actually has received the orders to not let anyone "unauthorized" into the Upper City. Unbeknownst to everyone around her but Mibbs, she is infected with a Mind Flayer Tadpole . Should the party make it to the end of the bridge and enact dialogue with Darbonna [ 1 ] , she tells the party that she does not know why they are permitted to go through, but nonetheless tells them to go on. However, if the player character approaches her fellow Mibbs nearby, both Fists engage the party in dialogue, welcoming them into the Upper City [ 2 ] , while The Emperor chimes in (at it repeatedly does while crossing the bridge), warning that the party are being fooled, and urging them to turn back at once. If the party return to the city after acquiring all Netherstones , three infected refugees near the queue transform into Mind Flayers and attack the bypassers. Darbonna is Surprised , but fights alongside the party. Once the Mind Flayers are dead, she and all the Fists around run away to warn their superiors, before completely vanishing from the game once far enough. GOB_Goblin_Generic Darra is a goblin who can be met at Moonrise Towers in Act Two . “ We should never have come here. „ — Darra Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Darra can be found at Moonrise Towers undergoing a trial Ketheric Thorm for her failures, if Minthara or Fezzerk do not survive Act One . In this case Darra is accompanied by Drenn and Racha . It is not possible for the party to speak with any of the goblins outside of the cutscene. The player character has several options for deciding their fate. If the party set them free, the surviving goblins flee from Moonrise Towers and disappear. EQP_Club_RingMail_Shield Trs. Gold_Pocket_Random Harper Darragh is a gold dwarven fighter and Harper who guards the entrance to Last Light Inn in Act Two . “ If Jaheira trusts you, I trust you. But I'll be damned if a bug-brain doesn't creep me out. „ — Darragh Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Darragh is at the Last Light Inn , where he guards the entrance to the sanctuary and main plaza from behind the main barricade, below Terradissia and a few steps away from Elifer . If the party is vouched for by Marcus but exposes him as a True Soul , Darragh is Stunned and joins the fight against his summoned Crawling Claws . Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Darragh usually fails the saving throw and is Impaled for the remainder of the battle. If Isobel is not saved, he and everyone in Last Light Inn turn into a Shadow-Cursed Undead , save for Jaheira . Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn, and the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise, Darragh follows Jaheira to Moonrise Towers . However, Darragh is killed during the fight against Absolute forces before the party members can arrive. His corpse is in Moonrise Towers, down the staircase leading down from the entrance, in front of Disciple Z'rell . BG_Commoner_Poor Dashkent Moliver is the custodian of Fraygo's Flophouse in Rivington during Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Dashkent is the halfling wearing a red shirt who patrols the bottom floor of Fraygo's Flophouse. The party can question Dashkent about the disappearance of Ffion Goldgrind and, if her corpse was discovered, notify him of her murder. If the player character gathered the clue about a " dwarf wearing red" in ⁠ Investigate the Murders or ⁠ Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders , the player character can accuse Dashkent of resembling the murder suspect. He becomes indignant and stresses that he is a halfling, not a dwarf. Halfling characters receive a unique response if failing to recognize him as their kin. Technical UID S_LOW_SerialKiller_WineFestivalCivilian004 UUID ce407b77-4218-4a8e-b5c8-399ee2aeffa4 Stats Human_Commoner Dave Hosmo is a human wine taster. He is at the Wine Festival at Highberry's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . “ Have you heard what those refugees have been up to? Murder and worse! „ — Dave Hosmo Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Dave mingles among the patrons of the wine festival if the party began ⁠ Investigate the Murders and the wine festival takes place. After Dolor reveals himself and attempts to kill Cora Highberry , Dave runs off and is not seen again. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Dave occasionally chats with 'Zinfandel' Gorse and Jaycen Borgu . Dave Hosmo Quite the turnout, don't you think? 'Zinfandel' Gorse You should've seen the cheese festival last year. Jaycen Borgu The streets were packed. The stench was... potent. Jaycen Borgu This is a welcome distraction from all the war talk. Dave Hosmo No, we're being too lax right now. 'Zinfandel' Gorse What do you mean? Dave Hosmo Refugees, wine festivals, we're wasting our resources. 'Zinfandel' Gorse I can't help but notice you're drinking anyway, Dave. Dave Hosmo Well, if the wine's here already, I might as well drink it. 'Zinfandel' Gorse So you think they shouldn't bring any more wine? That right? Dave Hosmo I mean, I didn't say that... Jaycen Borgu I wish you hadn't said anything. Dave Hosmo I just think we shouldn't be letting our guard down. Jaycen Borgu Why not? It's good to relax. Dave Hosmo These refugees are killers, apparently. And they're everywhere. 'Zinfandel' Gorse The only killer around here is going to be your hangover tomorrow, Dave. Technical UID S_GOB_Scrying_BackupMindflayer UUID a043a111-4a15-4d4a-ac83-5dc93bc8ee76 Stats MindFlayer_Weak Dead Mind Flayer can be found in the Goblin Camp during Act One . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] The dead mind flayer can be encountered in the Shattered Sanctum during Dror Ragzlin's questioning. If Ragzlin is killed before he casts Speak with Dead on the corpse, the party can instead question the mind flayer. Upon casting the spell, the player character immediately recognises the mind flayer as responsible for abducting them and implanting their parasite. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] The dead mind flayer can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . Tell me who the Absolute is. Dead Mind Flayer Fractured images fill your mind: curved drow blades, crude goblin torches, gnoll teeth dripping blood. You see other mind flayers arranged in a serene circle. Absolute unity. Absolute power. What does the Absolute want from the goblins? Dead Mind Flayer You see Dror Ragzlin writhe. A tadpole clings to the mind flayer's fingers. The goblin king bows, obedient. The flesh of his tribe becomes the flesh of the Absolute. Why did you abduct me? Dead Mind Flayer Dark, empty pods flicker across your vision. They demand new flesh. How do I get rid of this parasite? Dead Mind Flayer You see the tadpole in the mind flayer's hand. Not a parasite: perfection. Rebirth is sloughing flesh. A new skull housing cold, sharp intellect. Why did the dragon-riders attack the ship? Dead Mind Flayer You watch through the creature's eyes as it curses the star-born slaves. They want the ones from the ship. Darkness and sun, barely contained. Are there more of your kind nearby? Dead Mind Flayer You see dark tunnels lit by noxious pools of brine. The darkness spreads through the earth. The sky splits open, and nautiloids pour out of a void that consumes the stars. v t e Goblin Camp Characters Bugbears Bao'ek'nuk Stimk Teghun Camp Followers Owlbear Cub Volo Companions Halsin Minthara Goblins Aggy Azak Bal Bez Birka Bolt Brakkal Breg Clack Crub Crusher Cry Culk Druk Dullwill Eef Fezk Glomp Gnat Greez Gribbo Grikka Grush Gruz Gurd Gurk Huk Kirz Klagga Krolla Mirg Mrak Muzul Nass Neem Nik-Nuk Nozk Nrog Olak Piddle Plagg Plig Puce Puli Raagg Rancer Rindle Roo Rot Rozzak Sazza Shekt Sluck Snurd Spike Skrut Sul Tak Tiny Tizg Tozad Trinzas Tud Vrak Wasp Zami Zurga Zurk Children Eight Five Four One Three Goblin Leaders Dror Ragzlin Gut Minthara Ogres Gurgon Polma Traders Grat Roah Moonglow Other Abdirak Andrick Brynna Dishevelled Chicken Erna Ferr Larger Giant Spider Kagran Klaw Liam Narvass Smaller Giant Spider Small Klaw Smythin Taeglyn Tale Yerle Locations Bloodied Shrine Defiled Temple Goblin Camp Shattered Sanctum Worg Pens Quests Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Defeat the Goblins Find a Cure Find the Nightsong Raid the Emerald Grove Rescue the Druid Halsin Rescue Volo Save the First Druid Save the Goblin Sazza Save the Refugees Travel to Moonrise Towers

Debin lacks any equipment save for the key from her personal chest. Her crossbow lays on the chest near her bunk. The Rothé speak of Ketheric Thorm and his Dark Justiciar army, who have left their mark on the area: "The rock shivers from the sound. The Ketheric Thorm." The Elder Rothé has lived long enough that it worked during the time of Ketheric's war. It recounts the bloody battle and Thorm's army, and Yurgir , the hellbeast that broke them. Technical UID S_LOW_PaperboyBreakTime_Paperboy UUID 63fc8feb-f875-4d85-966b-e3097a8484cf Stats Human_Child Dellys is a human child in the Heapside district of the Lower City in Act Three . “ I've got rights, you know. „ — Dellys Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Dellys can be found in the alley not far from the Crimson Draughts shop. He is arguing with his friend Pharnilla about having proper time for breaks in their work. Both kids are working as newspaper sellers for Baldur's Mouth Gazette . However, the party cannot buy a sheet from either of them. Dellys insists on having a due break himself and actually makes Pharnilla stop, too, mentioning Ettvard Needle , the editor-in-chief of the gazette. He is a bit controversial in his arguments, both shying away from work and worrying that he might not make the seller quota to receive payment. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Pharnilla What if I gave you my break? Can I go back to selling gazettes then? Dellys No. Boss says we can't take the breaks of other Gazetteers. Trust me, when you're older, you'll appreciate the breaks. Pharnilla You're only a year older than me - and I sell more broadsheets. Pharnilla But whyyyyy can't I keep selling broadsheets? I'm bored. Dellys If you keep skipping your breaks, Mr Needle's going to take mine away too. Pharnilla Pfft. You're just mad I sell more copies than you. Pharnilla Come on, if I can't sell broadsheets, I'll be oh-so hungry... Dellys That patter works on punters, but I know you spend your wages on sweets. Pharnilla Harumph. Mr Needle doesn't even pay enough for the good sweets. Pharnilla Oh, come on. Give me half your remaining broadsheets. With Gortash dead, they're selling like crazy!  (If Enver Gortash is killed) Dellys If you sell my broadsheets, how'm I going to make my quota? Huh? Pharnilla If you weren't such a duff seller, Del, you wouldn't need the help! Dellys And if you weren't such a pest, Pharni, I might do it. Technical UID S_LOW_TheLodge_SocietyMember_02 UUID 2e6e254e-967c-49ee-a52d-b100eadecbee Stats LOW_TheLodge_Warlock Delverdenn is a shield dwarven Warlock and member of the Society of Brilliance . “ So much Underdark strife comes from vying for scarce minerals. Lord Delwaer Jeth In-game Portrait Identity Male Voice / Actor Ben Deery Stats Size Medium Type Humanoid Race Elf Subrace High elf Balanced Balanced Difficulty Stats HP 8 AC 10 Initiative 0 Movement 9 m (30 ft) Weight 75 kg (150 lb) Darkvision 12 m (40 ft) XP reward 1 Ability scores STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) Saving throws STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 0 0 0 0 0 0 Features Darkvision Can see in the dark up to a certain distance. Fey Ancestry Advantage on saving throws against being charmed ; can't be put to sleep by magic. Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Technical UID S_LOW_AngryNoble_001 UUID 4707eca2-13b3-4912-9f5f-7a8ae5307aeb Stats Elf_Commoner Lord Delwaer Jeth is an elven noble that can potentially be found in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City . “ I'm hardly to blame if some people have more money than sense. Or in Gorran's case, a deficit of both. „ — Delwaer Jeth Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Delwaer can only be found in the dining room if Oskar Fevras was never rescued from Brem in Act One . He can be seen arguing with Sir Gorran Penghyst about a painting he sold, which Gorran claims is a counterfeit. Delwaer believes Gorran should have known it was a fake, while Gorran believes he should not have sold a fake in the first place. If not intervening, the pair agrees to duel and heads out to a balcony. Combat starts between the two and only ends once one of them is dead. The party can intervene to stop the duel: [INTIMIDATION]  Stop this, or I'm sticking both of your heads through that bloody painting. (DC 18)   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 [PERSUASION]  Why not just sell the fake to another gullible fool? (DC 18)   +1   +1 [OATH OF DEVOTION]  Do not sacrifice your lives on such petty grounds. They are too precious.   +1   +1 Or, the party can let the events play out: Sounds like a duel is the only answer. [HALF-ORC]  This can't be solved with words - only blades. Fight! WIN!   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 [FIGHTER]  You are clearly novices, but I will serve as second for you both, if you wish.   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 [OATH OF VENGEANCE]  Such actions demand retribution. It is only right you deliver it. [OATH OF VENGEANCE]  Sounds like a duel is the only answer. Or, if failing a check, the party can also attack them both. If Oskar Fevras is rescued, the manor is haunted and the art exhibition does not happen. At least by day, thank the gods. „ — Delyarna Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Delyarna and Pompton Norvath are two Lower City neighbours discussing a nearby abandoned house. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Delyarna D'you hear those noises coming out of the old Albright place? Pompton Norvath Louder than foxes, and all through the night! Delyarna You know what it is, don't you? Criminals. Pompton Norvath Opportunists, the lot of them. And not a thought for their neighbours. Pompton Norvath What do you think happened to the Albrights anyway? Delyarna Buggered off because of the Absolute , didn't they? Stupid of 'em, if you ask me - it's much safer this side of the city walls. Pompton Norvath Should've at least locked the place up proper before they left. Delyarna Imagine what it's done to the house prices! Pompton Norvath I'd never let the kids play out in the streets now. Delyarna Lord Gortash needs to send the Steel Watch through here, mop up all this riffraff. Gods, I think even they'd have their work cut out for 'em.
