Hag_Brother Demir is searching for his sister in the Sunlit Wetlands during Act One . “ Just let her go. Please. „ — Demir , to Ethel Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Demir and his brother Johl can be encountered at the east entrance to the Sunlit Wetlands, asking Auntie Ethel where she took their sister Mayrina . Upon interacting, the party learn that Mayrina disappeared and the last person to see her was Ethel. Throughout the encounter, Demir pleads with her to release their sister while she insists that she has never met their sister but is willing to help look for her. The player has the choice of siding with Ethel to defend her, siding with the brothers, or refusing to get involved. If the party defend Ethel, Johl and Demir accuse the party of working with her and attack. The brothers must be defeated, but their lives can be spared by toggling on Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks before landing a final blow. In this case, their corpses won't appear in the swamp, and the party can later tell Mayrina that her brothers were merely knocked unconscious. However, due to what appears to be an oversight in the game's dialogue files, she still cries out as if they are dead, and the quest journal receives the same entry as when she's told of their death. If the party sides with the brothers, Ethel chastises them and disappears in a burst of magic. The party can attempt to convince the two brothers not to pursue her into the swamp. While Demir is willing to take the party's advice if they offer to look for Mayrina instead, Johl refuses and drags his brother into the wetlands with him. In this case they always die, and their bodies can be discovered later in the wetlands. If their bodies are not found, Ethel may later claim that she sent them off to "Sutton Farm" north of Baldur's Gate, but voice actor notes in the dialogue files reveal that this is a lie and confirm that she has killed them. If the party refuses to get involved during the initial confrontation between Ethel and the brothers, they are killed on the spot by Ethel with a poison spell. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Cleaver Damage: 1~6 1d6 ⁠ Slashing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Save Mayrina Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Demir can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . Who are you? Demir Demir... Do you have any family? Demir Mam... Johl... Mayrina... and soon... a niece. We're in the middle of nowhere. Why come here? Demir ... gotta get Mayrina back... for Mam...  (if Demir and Johl pursued Ethel) Demir My sister...went to Ethel. Husband died... wants him... wants him back. Why did you accuse Ethel of taking Mayrina? Demir Because what... Mayrina wants... only hag... can give. Where are you from? Demir Farm... out by... Baldur's Gate. Why are you so worried about your sister? Demir Hags... play with... their food. This place seems strange. Anything I should be wary of? Demir Don't drink... the water... What killed you?  (if Demir and Johl pursued Ethel) Demir Wasn't... a sheep... Did you find your sister?  (if Demir and Johl pursued Ethel) Demir Heard her... screaming. Technical UID S_GLO_Derryth UUID 2b537d2a-14c8-43b3-ab71-d537c925a2a7 Stats GLO_Derryth Eqp. EQP_Crossbow_Leather Trs. UND_MycoVillage_AlchemistDwarf_Trade Derryth Bonecloak is a gold dwarf and trader in Ebonlake Grotto . “ Look at that. Got my useless old man back. „ — Derryth Bonecloak when her husband is returned safely Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act One 1.2 Act Three 2 Store 2.1 Notable items sold 3 Related literature 3.1 Written by Derryth 4 Related quests 5 Speak with Dead 6 Notes Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Derryth waits impatiently near the western entrance of the Myconid Colony for her husband, Baelen , to return from picking mushrooms. When the party speak to her for the first time, she asks if they have seen her husband. If not, the party can ask about Baelen, which reveals — alongside her low opinion of him — that she sent Baelen on an errand he is yet to return from. She welcomes the party to find him, but refuses to pay a ransom if he is found and returned. If Baelen is rescued, Derryth rewards the party with the Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo . She begrudgingly thanks the party and explains that she and her husband arrived in the Underdark to collect Noblestalk , a mushroom with incredible restorative abilities. She needs it to save their shop in Baldur's Gate because Baelen had nearly bankrupted the store to purchase alcohol. If the party mention they found a Noblestalk, Derryth asks for the mushroom but offers nothing in return. If the party give Derryth the Noblestalk, she thanks them and encourages them to visit her at Bonecloak's Apothecary when they reach The Gate. Alternatively, the party can withhold the mushroom from Derryth, asking her to beg. Selecting and passing one of the following options results in Derryth offering her wedding ring, a Tarnished Ring : [INTIMIDATION]  Not good enough. Give me something, or I'll toss you into a chasm. (DC 10) [ROGUE] [PERSUASION]  Not good enough. Give me something, or this noblestalk disappears right before your eyes. (DC 10  ) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  Correct. PAY UP. NOW.  (DC 10  ) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  I know exactly what you owe. Pay up.  (DC 10  ) Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If Baelen was rescued in the Underdark, he and Derryth can be found at Bonecloak's Apothecary in the Lower City . If Baelen was not rescued, then Derryth manages the store alone, melancholic of her late husband and lamenting that they both deserved better. She believes Baelen's soul found its way to The City of Judgement , wasting away unclaimed as a faithless. The party can encourage one of three cats near the store — Barsik , Malta , or Myshka — to join Derryth in her shop so that she is less lonely. If Derryth obtained a Noblestalk in the Underdark, then she sells 2-3 Noblestalks in her shop, which is refreshed after every long rest . Unlike the Noblestalk found in the Underdark, the ones in her store cannot restore lost memories for Shadowheart or the Dark Urge . Otherwise, if Baelen was rescued and the party used the Noblestalk to heal him, he manages the store alone and has no Noblestalk to sell. Derryth can be found in the Elfsong Tavern , where she thanks the party for healing Baelen because it caused her to finally leave him forever. She comments that she does not have much to her name now but the freedom and peace of mind are worth it. Store [ edit section | visual editor ] Corresponds to UND_MycoVillage_AlchemistDwarf_Trade . Notable items sold [ edit section | visual editor ] Accessories Amulet of Restoration Caustic Band Ring of Jumping Armour Gloves of Hail of Thorns Herbalist's Gloves Consumables Noblestalk - only in Act 3 and only if the party gave her the Noblestalk in Act 1 Various alchemical ingredients Weapons Corrosive Flail Hand Crossbow +1 Heavy Crossbow +1 Shortbow +1 Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] A letter from the Healer Baelen's Alchemical Notes Got the Shivering Fantods Written by Derryth [ edit section | visual editor ] Derryth's Journal To Glumbor from Derryth Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Find the Mushroom Picker Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Derryth Bonecloak can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . Who are you? Derryth Bonecloak Derryth... Bonecloak... Where are you from? Derryth Bonecloak Baldur's Gate... shop there... Bonecloak's... What is your profession? Derryth Bonecloak Alchemist... What happened to you? Derryth Bonecloak Don't know. Pain... then darkness... Where are your valuables? Derryth Bonecloak No valuables... only my ring... What were you doing here? Derryth Bonecloak Noblestalk... Did you come here alone? Derryth Bonecloak No... husband. Baelen... Where is Baelen?  (If the party did not meet Baelen) Derryth Bonecloak Gone... noblestalk... Why is Baelen so confused?  (If the party met Baelen) Derryth Bonecloak Mind's slipping... made him less of a bastard... Baelen's in danger. How do I help?  (If the party know of Baelen but he is not yet rescued) Derryth Bonecloak Don't know... don't care... Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] After obtaining the Noblestalk , Derryth mentions she will be on her way and informs her husband that they are leaving. Despite this, they do not actually leave Ebonlake Grotto during Act 1. Derryth has always had a secret desire for an unseen character named Glumbor. In previous updates, it was possible to give the Noblestalk to Derryth, pickpocket it back, and then use it for another NPC (Baelen, Thulla, Shadowheart, etc), while still retaining the later gains of the Noblestalk that Derryth could supply in Act 3. This is no longer possible without the use of mods or cheats. Derryth will still hand off the quest reward for giving her the Noblestalk, but upon arrival at her store, she will be in dire straits, and there will be a dialogue option to give Derryth the Noblestalk, if the party still possess it. Upon doing so, Derryth will then sell the additional three (3) Noblestalk as if the party had never pickpocketed it from her. v t e Underdark Characters Attached Followers Glut Creatures Bulette Hook Technical UID S_LOW_Elfsong_Devella_Fountainhead UUID 048defbd-d386-4272-a5b7-40c1a9e75b81 Stats LOW_DevellaFountainHead Devella Fountainhead is a constable of the Flaming Fist who can be found investigating a crime scene in the Elfsong Tavern . “ YOU. Name, rank, and reason for interrupting an active crime scene. For your sake, the last one better be bloody good. „ — Devella Fountainhead when approached in the Elfsong Tavern Contents 1 Overview 2 Involvement 2.1 Elfsong Tavern 2.2 Facemaker's Boutique 2.3 Basilisk Gate Barracks 3 Combat 3.1 Attacks and actions 3.2 Notable loot 4 Related literature 5 Speak with Dead 6 External links Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Devella currently acts as assistant to Valeria as they ⁠ investigate a string of murders that have occurred in Baldur's Gate . Devella and Valeria have been investigating a series of murders in the city. While Valeria has a very laid back attitude to the conduction of her investigations, Devella is meticulous and dogged, suspecting that the murders are part of a Bhaalist plot. Speak with Dead can be used on Devella's corpse. She can reveal her killer (if it was Dolor), and how to access the Murder Tribunal. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Investigate the Murders Elfsong Tavern [ edit section | visual editor ] After finding the Bloodstained Parchment as part of the quest ⁠ Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders , Valeria directs the party to speak with Devella in the Elfsong Tavern. Devella is on the upper floor of the Elfsong, behind a set of doors that are signposted as a murder scene, open only to the Flaming Fists. Devella is here regardless of whether Valeria was spoken to, however she leaves if progressing too far with ⁠ Investigate the Murders , after which she can next be found at Figaro's Facemaker's Boutique . If showing the Bloodstained Parchment to Devella, she confirms her suspicions about the Bhaalist involvement in the murders. Devella tells the party about Sarevok Anchev and the Cult of Bhaal , and her conclusion that they are still active despite outward appearances. She eventually asks the party to help with her investigations, saying that she cannot risk her job by raising a fuss about Bhaalists and Bhaalspawn. If declining, she asks them to at least investigate the Lower City murder targets who have been listed. Devella then leaves for the Upper City to secure the targeted patriars who she is oathbound to protect. Otherwise, the party can also use the crime scene to describe how Stelmane was killed by persuading Devella that they can help, or by lying and saying that they were "trained under Camber Fosrick, the world's greatest investigative mind" ( DC 15 Investigation , Persuasion , or Deception Check ). A successful check results in Devella sharing her findings: The duke was paralysed by poison and her hand was removed pre-mortem. With a subsequent Persuasion or Perception check, Devella divulges her theory - that the severed hands and "dioramas of death and murder" point to that the murders were perpetrated by Bhaalists. However, her conclusions also point to someone else being in charge of the slew of murder "dioramas". The party can then offer to help looking into the Bhaalist resurgence. If the murder list is not shown, Devella can still be told that these murders have the marks of a Bhaalist plot which causes her to ask the player character to elaborate. The player character can tell her to tell first and Devella shares her suspicions and findings. When she asks what the party knows in turn, they can either show her the murder list or pass a DC 18 Deception Check by telling her that they were joking. If the check is failed, the murder list is shown to Devella. The Dark Urge can reveal to Devella their true nature. Devella is fascinated by this while still being fearful for her life. She asks if they are there to sacrifice her and the Dark Urge can confirm that which initiates combat or state that they are opposing their Father. If combat breaks out, Devella shouts for the two Flaming Fists standing guard at the staircase who rush upstairs and aid her in battle. Facemaker's Boutique [ edit section | visual editor ] While checking in on the targets, the party can discover the murderer, Dolor . If Dolor escapes the first encounter, he can next be found at Facemaker's Boutique , attempting to kill Figaro Pennygood . Devella stands paralysed in the back room. If combat breaks out, Dolor targets Devella first. However if Figaro was killed by the party prior to Dolor's arrival, then Dolor can not be found at the boutique as he has departed already for the Bhaalist Crypt and Devella is lying dead. Basilisk Gate Barracks [ edit section | visual editor ] If she survived, Devella can later be found at Basilisk Gate Barracks , where the party can update her on their progress. It is possible to tell Devella the outcome of the ⁠ Murder Tribunal , and what happened after visiting the Bhaalist temple. If informing Devella that the player character became an Unholy Assassin, she becomes hostile. Technical UID S_GOB_AttackOnDen_Sapper_003 UUID 4264ba13-c816-405c-bc55-9f91dcfd9793 Stats GOB_GoblinSapper Sapper Dextor is a goblin sapper in Act One . “ Sparky boom-boom time. „ — Dextor Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Dextor only appears if Minthara launches a raid on the Emerald Grove . If Minthara learns of the Grove's location such as through the party, Liam's interrogation, or Sazza , she gathers a group of goblins to attack the sanctuary. Dextor does not appear in the Goblin Camp and is only encountered during this raid. As a sapper, Dextor's only purpose is to act as a suicide bomber and blow himself up on an enemy target. Technical UID S_LOW_Elfsong_Patron_008 UUID a29c8ff1-ce29-42c0-a426-c955cdb485bd Stats Gnome_Commoner Dez Kanshaw is a rock gnome in Baldur's Gate . “ I wonder if this was brewed with my barley? „ — Dez Kanshaw Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Dez is a patron of the Elfsong Tavern in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . When spoken with, he tells the party that he is a farmer and all his crops are gone thanks to the Absolute. He mentions needing to find a place for his son Korson as he eats as much as the rest of the family put together, but does not know where he should send him. The party can tell him to send him to the Counting House , the Flaming Fist , the wilds (barbarian, ranger, and oath of the crown paladins only), the Open Hand Temple , or if the player character is a rogue, the Thieves' Guild : Three-Piece sounds like a crook. Better if you join the Fists. That cleaner job sounds steady. Leaves you available to head back to the farm. I hear the Ilmater temple at Wyrm's needs volunteers. They don't pay, but at least the boy will eat. [ROGUE]  The Thieves Guild are always on the lookout for talent. He'd never run out of work. [BARBARIAN] [RANGER]  Forget the city - the wilds have everything you need. Enrol with the Fists. It's honourable work. Suggesting the Thieves' Guild grants the inspiration ⁠ Next Generation of Pockets for party members with the Criminal background. Technical UID S_LOW_SteepsEvacuation_Father UUID 9cb808d0-305e-4983-acff-58313fc5ce3e Stats Human_Commoner Dharin Brislen is a human civilian trying to smuggle his family out of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ I hate sending Leepak and the girls off without me, but if that smuggler can get them to Waterdeep and away from the Absolute... „ — Dharin Brislen Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Dharin can be encountered while arguing with Captain Sleam over smuggling his family of four out of the city. Unfortunately, the family is short of money, being able to pay only for three places aboard. The party can help the family by convincing Captain Sleam to take them all or by paying her the sum the Brislens are lacking. Helping the family by any means gains approval from Gale , Halsin , Karlach , Shadowheart , and Wyll . Captain Sleam Slipping through the Absolute blockade is risking business. Everybody pays. Leepak Brislen Captain, we have two children, you can't make us split up the family. Captain Sleam The crew and I are risking our lives. We're not doing this for charity. Dharin Brislen Honey, you go with the girls. I'll find another way to Waterdeep. Leepak Brislen What? No! We can't go without you! Dharin Brislen It's the only solution. Trust me. I'll catch up to you. Leepak Brislen You'd better! You'd better catch up to us! Dharin Brislen All right, captain. I am. But I thought we'd arrive as a family. Not like this..." „ — Dholber Greene Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Dholber Greene, his wife, and their son Dwindling travelled to Baldur's Gate together. However, Dholber's wife died during the trek and Dwindling caught lice while riding on the ox cart. The pair can be found in Nortale's Hostel speaking with Pammella Nortale , who explains to them how to be rid of the lice. Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Dheeber's Chest Key Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Hostel Registry Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Hostel Mother Pammella Nortale Rules are the same for everyone: clothes go in the fire, comb goes through the hair. We'll have no lice in here. Dholber Greene Burn my son's clothes? But I've nothing else for him to wear. Hostel Mother Pammella Nortale We've plenty of donations. I'm sure you'll find something that fits. Hostel Mother Pammella Nortale No need to look so glum. You'll be clean and comfortable in no time. Dholber Greene I'm so embarrassed. I - I'm sorry. We must have caught them riding on the ox cart. Hostel Mother Pammella Nortale No sense apologising for what can't be helped. You made it here safely - that's what matters. Dwindling Dad - my head's itchy. Hostel Mother Pammella Nortale Hot soapy water and a fine-tooth comb - that's all you need. Those lice will be gone in no time. Dholber Greene His mother was better with this kind of thing... Technical UID S_LOW_BhaalTemple_Reaper_06 UUID 646eaea2-2329-4d75-acc7-feddad951066 Stats Human_Cultist_Bhaal_Reaper Reaper of Bhaal Dhoria is a member of the Cult of Bhaal , found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate . “ We would've built you a pile, Chosen - a most horrible mound of corpses. A wet, weeping throne - but alas. No. „ — Dhoria , to the Dark Urge who rejected Bhaal Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] The party can go to the Bhaal Temple in hopes of saving their companion from Orin . There they encounter Orin, who engages the party in combat by transforming into a Slayer . Dhoria, along with the rest of the reapers, begins channeling a ritual spell Bloody Favour , granting Orin a Boon of Bhaal at the start of every turn. If the player character is not the Dark Urge , and Orin is killed or disabled, Dhoria ends concentration and attacks the party as normal. If the player character is the Dark Urge and defeats Orin, Dhoria remains neutral to the party and moves to the foot of one of the stairs leading to the central altar ground. His one-liners depend on whether the Dark Urge embraces or rejects their Bhaalspawn legacy. Technical UID S_UND_PetrifiedDrow_Wizard UUID 1f86d2de-db96-4662-a360-6ba5ad902fd7 Stats Elf_Drow_Caster Eqp. EQP_Dagger_Robe Trs. UND_PetrifiedDrow_Drow_Commander Dhourn is a petrified drow wizard in the Underdark , west of the Selûnite Outpost . “ Dust. On. My. Tongue! „ — Dhourn if he is unpetrified by the player Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] The battlefield west of the Selûnite Outpost is littered with Petrified drow. Entering the area triggers the appearance of a Spectator , who is immediately hostile to the party. The spectator can unpetrify Dhourn and the other drow, who then fight alongside the creature, unless their trance is broken by taking damage. Dhourn carries one of the three pieces required to rebuild the Mourning Frost . He also has a Memory Shard containing information on ⁠ The Adamantine Forge . If Dhourn survives the spectator battle, he informs the party that he is searching for the Grymforge , and the spectator was set upon him by Xargrim . If the party kill Filro before speaking to Dhourn, they can avoid discussing the Adamantine Forge by informing Dhourn of Filro's death and claiming that Filro had nothing of interest. Dhourn believes the party is uninterested in the Adamantine Forge and the interaction ends peacefully. The same can be done if Xargrim 's corpse was found in Ebonlake Grotto . There is no unique interaction for finding both. Otherwise, Dhourn can be convinced to reveal his secrets, kept in the Memory Shard under his possession: [LOLTH-SWORN] [PERSUASION]  Every house is beholden to Lolth - as every male is beholden to their betters. (DC 5) [LOLTH-SWORN] [INTIMIDATION]  I must have misheard you. Perhaps you'll speak louder from a rack in Menzoberranzan. (DC 5) [INTIMIDATION]  I'm above house politics myself - but I'll still kill for what I want. (DC 5) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  HAND IT OVER, BOY. OR ELSE.  (DC 5  ) [DECEPTION]  House Ba'Tol, you said? You'll be welcomed back - all the male heirs died, I believe. (DC 5) Convincing Dhourn to hand over the Memory Shard as a drow (or disguised as one) grants the inspiration ⁠ Know Your Place to party members with the Noble background. Combat remains an option afterwards. Combat can also be avoided if Dhourn does not survive the spectator fight. He disappears with any other surviving unpetrified drow after a long rest, but the petrified drow still remain. History [ edit section | visual editor ] Xargrim , Filro and Dhourn were trying to find the Adamantine Forge somewhere within the Underdark. Dhourn was responsible for finding the physical location. However, after discovering information about the forge each explorer wanted the glory for himself, and the three turned on each other. Dhourn hired a mercenary group and planned an ambush for Xargrim, who in turn planned to ambush Dhourn. The two argued until Xargrim unleashed a Spectator who petrified Dhourn and his mercenaries. Dhourn's party remained in stasis long enough for his Memory Shard to fade. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Darkness ( ) Create a cloud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscures and inflicts Blind to creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Long rest Mage Armour ( + ) Surround an unarmoured creature in a protective magical force. Its Armour Class increases to 13 + its Dexterity modifier . This effect does not stack with Unarmoured Defence . Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Dagger Damage: 1~4 1d4 ⁠ Piercing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Misty Step ( + ) Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Scorching Ray ( + ) Damage: 6~36 2d6 ⁠ Fire + 2d6 ⁠ Fire + 2d6 ⁠ Fire Hurl 3 rays of fire. Each ray deals 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Sleep ( + ) Put creatures into a magical slumber. Select targets up to a combined 24 Hit Points . Range: 18 m (60 ft) Thunderwave ( + ) Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Thunder Release a wave of thunderous force that pushes away all creatures and objects in an area, while also dealing Thunder damage. CON Save Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Dagger Icy Helve Memory Shard Polished Ring Potion of Healing Silver Necklace Simple Robe Supply Pack The Blast Pendant 47x Gold Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] Arcagh Artimezt Izwae Moy Tecothy Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] The fight with the Spectator and then Dhourn can be skipped by using a Familiar . A Familiar exploring the area and attacking the petrified drow does not trigger the Spectator. It can, for example, walk down from the Selûnite Outpost waypoint and kill Dhourn while he is petrified; his body is the closest to the top right of the cragged rock. A character can then sneak to the body, loot it, and sneak back to Selûnite Outpost, obtaining Dhourn's loot without combat. Classes without familiars can also accomplish this by using the Cheeky Quasit familiar from the Apothecary's Cellar . Looting Dhourn causes any Paladin grouped with the party to break their oath. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Dhourn can be communed with using Speak with Dead . Who are you? Dhourn Dhourn... House Ba'Tol... Gravenhollow scholar... How where you petrified? Dhourn Xargim... argument... summoned spectator. Why did you argue with Xargrim? Dhourn He wanted... memory shard... Do you carry anything valuable? Dhourn Memory... shard... How do I use this memory shard? Dhourn True title... activates... 'Dhourn, Lord Archmage' ... What does this memory shard do? Dhourn Show way... to Adamantine Forge... Where are you from? Dhourn Menzoberranzan... What where you doing here? Dhourn Searching.. forge... What can you tell me about this forge? Dhoun Adamantine... precious beyond measure... Technical UID S_LOW_SteepsDrunkards_Drunkard3 UUID d1e68cd6-ab04-4cca-8058-a464af2fdae2 Stats Human_Commoner Dickon can be found behind the Blushing Mermaid in the Lower City during Act Three . “ That plum prosecco ! Oh, gods, never again, never again... Solemn oath, solemn vow, solemn... wuurrgh! „ — Dickon Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Dickon, Bleeri , and Oaknuzzle are celebrating a last drink before joining the Flaming Fist . Although Bleeri and Oaknuzzle are comfortably drunk, Dickon feels ill from being drunk in the first time in his life. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Bleeri What's the matter with you, freshie? I know you're green, but you don't have to turn green, heh! Oaknuzzle He attacked that bottle like someone was going to give him a medal for it. Dickon Urgh... I feel like I'm going to die. Bleeri Nah, nah. Hold on until after training, then at least you'll get paid for dying. Or your next o' kin will, at least. Dickon I don't have a... ugh... I don't have a sweetheart. Oaknuzzle Wonder why, with you being such a catch right now. Bleeri Don't you worry about that, freshie. Soon you'll have a handsome new uniform, coin in your pocket, and the pick of the finest strange the city's got to offer! And the first round can be on you. Dickon Don't even mention drink... Oaknuzzle You've gone and done it now. Bleeri He's a big boy, supposedly. Not like I forced it down his neck. Bleeri You done yet? Don't even have any chunks to blow - it's all water! Oaknuzzle Water? Bleeri Well, liquid anyway. Dickon Where's it all coming from? There was just the toast, then a chaser, and one for the road... Bleeri It was quite a road, as I remember. Had to refuel a few times. Dickon Never again... Oaknuzzle Never again, until next time. Bleeri Deep breaths, laddie. You'll be right in no time. Oaknuzzle Good, because we have no time - this leaky wineskin's due back at barracks. Bleeri Half the new recruits will be in the same way - there's no rush. Bleeri Keep sucking in that sea air. Good for what ails you. Dickon Ale? Don't even say it... Dickon I think... I think I'm better now. Can't miss my first roll call for the Fists. Oaknuzzle You might want to wash up, first. Got a few souvenirs from the night stuck to your chin. Bleeri Aye, and you smell like that place down the docks where they dump out the fish guts. Technical UID S_WYR_KillDirectorGortash_Patriar_012 UUID 4ae37244-c9eb-41b3-82fb-c302abd01f1e Stats WYR_DillardPortyr Duke Dillard Portyr is a Duke of Baldur's Gate and a member of the Council of Four . He is the uncle of Liara Portyr . “ What glory, our city. And what glory, its future. „ — Dillard Portyr History [ edit section | visual editor ] Dillard Portyr is a Baldur's Gate patriar from the well-off and influential Portyr patriar family. The Portyrs made their coin in maritime shipping, investing, and trading. [ 1 ] During the events of Descent into Avernus , Dillard recalls his niece Liara Portyr to Baldur's Gate, where she served as the acting marshal of the Flaming Fist until Duke Ravengard's return. Duke Dillard Portyr has been part of the Council of Four for quite some time and has lived through a failed coup by Grand Duke Valarken. [ 2 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Dillard Portyr attends Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city in Wyrm's Rock Fortress . After the ceremony ends, Duke Dillard stays near the throne, speaking with Rugger Shattershield , Ulder Ravengard and Enver Gortash, discussing Gortash's future actions as the Archduke. If spoken with, he calls the city's future glorious. If the party confront Gortash, they can later find Dillard Portyr along with all other invited guests and their retinue – slaughtered in the Audience hall. According to research by the Black Hand of Loyalty , Duke Dillard Portyr is one of the nobles who may easily fall in line with the cult via bribery, blackmail, or direct threats. [ 3 ] Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Ulder Ravengard Let us be resolved. Today, we name Lord Enver Gortash as Archduke of Baldur's Gate . Rugger Shattershield Aye! Alia Durinbold Aye! Dillard Portyr ...Aye. Ulder Ravengard The Council is unanimous. Let our walls be girded with steel! Ulder Ravengard Dukes, patriars - an army approaches. Ulder Ravengard An army of evil, an all-conquering force. We must not stand idle as it burns the city to ash! Dillard Portyr Yes, but - Ulder Ravengard Portyr. I will not mire us in endless red tape. Baldur's Gate deserves a true leader, not a council of simpering bureaucrats . Ulder Ravengard That leader is Enver Gortash. Enver Gortash ... we identify all enemies within our walls and within our ranks ...  (Part of Gortash's monologue) Dillard Portyr Enemies within? Who do you mean? Enver Gortash Traitors, Portyr. Any who dares speak ill of Baldur's Gate or its people. Rugger Shattershield Pardon me saying, Archduke, but do the people require such a heavy hand? Enver Gortash The people demand it. Is a Baldurian truly free when he fears for his future? I do know shit. „ — Dim Phimberg Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Phimberg is on the beach with Big Liar Bronzon and Matthurny with fishing poles and buckets of fish. The group chat with each other about possibly catching a Sahuagin and what that might entail. Bronzon tends to lie and exaggerate, however Phimberg is not too bright and tends to believe her. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Big Liar Bronzon I'm telling you, a sahuagin stole my bait. Dim Phimberg What's a swa-gog-gin? Matthurny A shark-person, Dim. They don't play nice. Dim Phimberg I think I'm afraid of swa-gog-gins. Matthurny Aw, don't worry. Big Liar's just pulling your leg. Big Liar Bronzon Am not. It was a sahuagin, big as life, all fangs and fins. Big Liar Bronzon If we caught a sahuagin, would they buy it at the fish market? Matthurny A sahuagin is more likely to catch you. BG_Bandit Dimples Backster is a gnome member of Zenovia's gang and member of The Guild . He is outside Arfur Gregorio's mansion in Rivington . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Bakster and the rest of Zenovia's gang were paid by Arfur Gregorio only to bring him safely home, but he now demands that they also evict the refugees who are currently squatting in his mansion. Zenovia reminds him that she and her group were only paid to act as caravan guards and anything more will cost extra. If Arfur is antagonized, or the intimidation of him fails, he calls on Zenovia to remove the refugees by force. If the party intervene, a fight can break out and Bakster then becomes hostile. They can add a +1d6 bonus to their next Attack roll , Ability check , or Saving throw . Range: 18 m (60 ft) Blindness ( + ) Limit a foe's sight range. It is easier to hit, and the creature will miss more often. Attack rolls against it have Advantage and the foe attacks with Disadvantage . BG_Guard Gauntlet Dion is a Flaming Fist killed by a githyanki patrol along the Risen Road during Act One . “ This is y-your last chance! „ — Dion , clearly failing to intimidate Baretha Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Dion confronts a githyanki patrol on a bridge near the Mountain Pass entrance at X: -146 Y: 569 . Dion demands the githyanki drop their weapons, but is swiftly rebuked by their leader Sarth Baretha just before Qudenos flies overhead and incinerates him and the other Flaming Fists using dragon flames; this also destroys the nearby bridge. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Shortsword Damage: 2~7 1d6 + 1 ⁠ Piercing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] Bryanne Rowan Wexford Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Dion cannot be looted, as he dies during the cutscene and his corpse cannot be found. Killing him during dialogue before the githyanki kills him causes him to disappear, and skips the cutscene altogether, forcing the party into interacting with Kith'rak Voss . None of the Flaming Fist Mercenary corpses by the destroyed bridge resemble him or any of his squad. v t e Risen Road Characters Companions Karlach Flaming Fists Aelis Bryanne Dain Dion Ephren Florrick Jacek Ito Marilla Pavel Rowan Tristan Wexford Yeva Githyanki Baretha Chost For'reth Voss Zastri Paladins of Tyr Anders Buckle Refugee Trynn Traders Brem Cyrel Zhentarim Amnos Bellar Garias Jarg Karad Olly Rugan Salazon Vol Zarys Other Benryn Ellyka Krug Marten Mirileth Oskar Fevras Sszaryn Vance Yul Animals and Creatures Bloated Hyena Flind Frightened Ox Gnoll Fang of Yeenoghu Gnoll Flesh Gnawer Gnoll Hunter Newborn Gnoll Indra Isbeth Istor Qudenos Locations Mountain Pass Toll House Waukeen's Rest Zhentarim Basement Quests Find a Cure Find the Githyanki Crèche Find the Missing Shipment Find the Nightsong Free the Artist Hunt the Devil Our Fiery Friend Rescue the Trapped Man The Blade of Frontiers The Githyanki Warrior Travel to Moonrise Towers Travel through the Mountain Pass

Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Fist Discoria patrols the streets of the Lower City with Fist Syllving , Fist Starrlet and a Steel Watcher . Their route runs back and forth from the bridge and gates to the Upper City to the Society of Brilliance Lodge (approximately from X: -195 Y: -10 to X: -196 Y: -68 ). Starrlet and her mates do not respond to any attempts to speak with them, regardless of whether the Steel Watch Foundry is intact or destroyed. A plaything for the goblins , the frightened poultry is constantly chased by Devout Mezzka or forced to take part in Krolla's chicken chasing games. “ Escape?! Escape! „ — Dishevelled Chicken Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] The Dishevelled Chicken can only be encountered in the Goblin Camp if the party have not thoroughly explored other parts of the Wilderness yet. Long resting after having met the Owlbear , regardless if it survives, as long as the cub is not harmed, sets a series of events in motion which result in the chicken being eaten by the Owlbear Cub . Consequently, the cub replaces the Chicken. Even if the party use Speak with Animals , the chicken is too distressed to form coherent answers. However, while playing the chicken chasing game, the party can communicate with it: [PERSUASION]  Urge her to attack them.  (DC 20) [ANIMAL HANDLING]  Urge her to attack them.  (DC 20)  (during the chicken chase game) [DRUID] [INTIMIDATION]  Wild things do not beg for help. They protect themselves.  (DC 5) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  You are a noble fowl. Fast. Sharp. VENGEFUL!  (DC 5  ) Choosing either of the above options results in the chicken entering a mad rage, the whole camp turning hostile to it, and quickly killing it. What's wrong? (The chicken talks about its dire situation.) I'll help. Just run through the posts and you'll be free. (This will make the chicken run to the end of the course and quickly finish the game.) Shoo her towards the posts. (During the chase, will also make the chicken run to the end of the course) Oh shut up and play . (Just makes the chicken more distressed.) Unfortunately there is no way to free the Dishevelled Chicken. In any case, it either dies or is chased again. The chicken can be killed without turning the goblins hostile, though the party cannot play chicken chasing anymore unless they leave the Goblin Camp, encounter the Owlbear, and take a long rest – after which the Owlbear Cub arrives at the Goblin Camp. Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] Any option that makes the chicken attack or shooing it towards the posts:   +1 Tell the chicken to run through the posts or to shut up and play:   +1   +1   -1   -1 Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Dishevelled Chicken with Krolla v t e Goblin Camp Characters Bugbears Bao'ek'nuk Stimk Teghun Camp Followers Owlbear Cub Volo Companions Halsin Minthara Goblins Aggy Azak Bal Bez Birka Bolt Brakkal Breg Clack Crub Crusher Cry Culk Druk Dullwill Eef Fezk Glomp Gnat Greez Gribbo Grikka Grush Gruz Gurd Gurk Huk Kirz Klagga Krolla Mirg Mrak Muzul Nass Neem Nik-Nuk Nozk Nrog Olak Piddle Plagg Plig Puce Puli Raagg Rancer Rindle Roo Rot Rozzak Sazza Shekt Sluck Snurd Spike Skrut Sul Tak Tiny Tizg Tozad Trinzas Tud Vrak Wasp Zami Zurga Zurk Children Eight Five Four One Three Goblin Leaders Dror Ragzlin Gut Minthara Ogres Gurgon Polma Traders Grat Roah Moonglow Other Abdirak Andrick Brynna Dishevelled Chicken Erna Ferr Larger Giant Spider Kagran Klaw Liam Narvass Smaller Giant Spider Small Klaw Smythin Taeglyn Tale Yerle Locations Bloodied Shrine Defiled Temple Goblin Camp Shattered Sanctum Worg Pens Quests Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Defeat the Goblins Find a Cure Find the Nightsong Raid the Emerald Grove Rescue the Druid Halsin Rescue Volo Save the First Druid Save the Goblin Sazza Save the Refugees Travel to Moonrise Towers

Technical UID S_TWN_Hospital_Patient UUID 70280618-041e-4029-b0b8-9b9cb4b7c494 Stats Human_Commoner Distressed Patient is a human subject used in Malus Thorm's twisted medical lectures in Act Two . “ Grggg - gng - nng... „ — Distressed Patient Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Distressed Patient is initially encountered In Surgery at the House of Healing , where he is strapped to a gurney in Malus Thorm's operating theater. His eyes and tongue are removed for demonstration purposes. He can be spared by convincing Malus to have his nurses kill each other, then kill himself. Lockpicking the surgical bed is "impossible" but talking to the Distressed Patient after investigating the bed results in the option to free him. Knock can also be used. When freed from his restraints, he flees in a terrified stupor, possibly disappearing before leaving the surgical suite. Though his tongue was cut out, interacting with him while he is running results in the floating text "Later!" above him. Trader Djingo We both know you'll sell it for twice that to the armoury once the city's under siege. Smiley Gheef Too right. I'll go 600. Pheebs Splayfoot Hey, I was here first. 700. Kaet Ling A thousand gold, all in cash, no notes. Trader Djingo Sold! Technical UID S_LOW_Noble_001 UUID 6efe6e4a-cac8-4060-b4e2-fd89d9278742 Stats HalfElf_Commoner Saer Dokksill is a half-elven noble that can potentially be found in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City . “ An Amnian wedding? Now that would be a party. „ — Dokksill Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Dokksill can only be found if Oskar Fevras was never rescued from Brem in Act One . She is gossiping with fellow noble Impurto Nexim on the first floor. If Oskar Fevras was rescued, the manor is haunted and the art exhibition does not happen. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Dokksill will occasionally chat with Impurto Nexim: Impurto Nexim I believe it's your turn to throw the next get-together. Saer Dokksill I think not. How is one to throw a half-decent party without a florist? Saer Dokksill Mine travelled all the way from Neverwinter, to be turned away at the gate. It's outrageous. Impurto Nexim You must take this to Lord Gortash. He's a man who will see sense. Impurto Nexim I came all the way from the Upper City for this little viewing of hers, and she's holding back on us. Impurto Nexim I know for a fact she has an original Yapswurt hidden away. I've seen it. Saer Dokksill Typical. The least she could do is have it on display. How else is one to buy it from her? Saer Dokksill I find it hard to believe she's still pining over that commoner. Impurto Nexim She should have married my cousin, as I suggested. He has plenty of land out in Amn. Saer Dokksill An Amnian wedding? Now that would be a party. Saer Dokksill Tell me, has anything caught your eye? Impurto Nexim Certainly not the lobster. I haven't seen one in hours! Saer Dokksill Oh, very good. Very good. Yes, Fireliia keeps a rather lax house, doesn't she? Impurto Nexim I wouldn't stand for it under my roof. Lazy little serfs. Technical UID S_LOW_LeftAshore_Sailor_02 UUID af93a409-d98c-4057-b081-96f608ad94fe Stats Dwarf_Commoner Dollivar Noot is a gold dwarf sailor at the Grey Harbour Docks in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three . “ If it ain't bad genes, it's too many years of salt in the eyes. Can't see further than a gull can shit. „ — Dollivar Noot Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Dollivar Noot and fellow sailor Matey Tallhamper can be encountered talking to each other at the docks. They are on the lookout for a ship they were supposed to leave on, unaware it has already left. If Gortash is defeated, Matey Tallhamper and Dollivar Noot leave and can no longer be found. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Matey Tallhamper I'm starting to think they've forgotten about us. Dollivar Noot They'd better not. They haven't even paid us for the shipment yet. Matey Tallhamper I ain't seen no new ships in a while though. Dollivar Noot They can't have sailed off without us, right? Matey Tallhamper Better hope not, I'll run out of coin if I stay here a day longer than I have to. Dollivar Noot I'd kill for a pint of mermaid's breath. These city brews ain't got much bite to 'em. Dollivar Noot Is that The Endless Miracle? Matey Tallhamper No, you conk. It ain't got stripes on the sails. Dollivar Noot Aren't those stripes? I see stripes! Dolly Dolly Dolly Model Portrait Identity Female Voice / Actor Charlotte Sparey Stats Size Tiny Type Fey Race Pixie Balanced Balanced Difficulty Stats Level 1 HP 4 AC 10 Initiative 0 Proficiency +2 Movement 9 m (30 ft) Weight 25 kg (50 lb) Darkvision 0 m (0 ft) Ability scores STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 5 (-3) 10 (0) 5 (-3) 8 (-1) 8 (-1) 10 (0) Saving throws STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA -3 0 -3 -1 -1 0 Technical UID S_GLO_Pixie UUID 250b9342-fd7d-4a1d-a320-aa5e0dfbf2d5 Stats Commoner_Child Dolly Dolly Dolly or Dolly Thrice is a pixie trapped in the Moonlantern carried by Kar'niss , a drider travelling the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two . “ Oh please, oh golly, me-oh-my, you must release me or I'll die! „ — Dolly Dolly Dolly Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] After travelling to the Shadow-Cursed Lands, the party can meet Kar'niss , who traverses the Shadow Curse with the assistance of a Moonlantern. If Kar'niss is defeated, the party can collect and investigate the Moonlantern. Inspecting the Moonlantern reveals the presence of Dolly and grants the inspiration ⁠ Trust and a Little Pixie Dust inspiration to party members with the Guild Artisan background. Dolly pleads with the inspecting party member to free her, and they can either release her gently, release her by smashing the lantern, torture her, or ignore her: I need protection from this curse. If I release you, will you help me travel through the shadows? What's this mechanism at the base of the lantern? Turn the mechanism. [ROGUE]  Quickly unlock the lantern and release the pixie. Release the pixie. Smash the lantern on the ground. Ignore the pixie; keep the lantern. Freeing Dolly Thrice in turn earns the party freedom to safely travel the Shadow-Cursed Lands . Refusing to release Dolly from the lantern results in her dropping the rhyming speech affectation and instead viciously cursing the party out. While the lantern is equipped from then on, she occasionally pipes up with further insults and demands to be released. Turning the mechanism causes Dolly to scream out in pain, and she begs the player character to stop. Turning the mechanism a second time kills her, although the lantern still functions normally. If a party member inspects the lantern a second time, they see a "tangle of blood, bones, and two broken wings". Releasing her by either means destroys the lantern, and Dolly asks the party what she owes them: [DARK URGE]  A beautiful thing it would be, to end a life in this first moment of freedom. [DARK URGE]  Refuse to crush her. Ask her for help against the shadow curse. I need to get through this shadow curse. Can you help?  (if not Dark Urge) What's on offer? Nothing - my help doesn't come with strings attached. [OATH OF DEVOTION]  Freeing you was the right thing to do - you owe me no debt. [OATH OF THE ANCIENTS]  I know the Feyfolk are used to debts - but you owe me nothing. Be free. [OATH OF VENGEANCE]  Nothing - I know I'd want a shot at revenge if I was trapped. Only fair to free you. [OATHBREAKER]  Everyone deserves their freedom - you owe me nothing. [OATH OF THE CROWN]  Prisons are for criminals; you were innocent. You owe me nothing. If The Dark Urge is chosen as Origin , then they want to kill the pixie by crushing her between their fingers. Doing this yields no benefits, other than the inspiration ⁠ Fly-Swatter and an Oathbreaking Action for Paladins , forcing the party to find another Moonlantern if they want to traverse the stronger areas of the Shadow Curse. Otherwise, regardless of the option chosen, Dolly rewards the party with the Filigreed Feywild Bell . This bell grants the entire party the condition Pixie Blessing , which gives full immunity from the Shadow Curse without the need to use a Moonlantern. Releasing her by smashing the lantern causes her to curse the interacting party member with A Clown in Town , which gives them a clown's facepaint. If Kar'niss survives his journey to Moonrise Towers with the Moonlantern, Dolly dies and cannot be freed from it. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party free her during Act Two, then Jelliwig , the "Printing Press" of the quest ⁠ Stop the Presses recognises the party and may allow them to change the printing to something more favourable. If rescued, Dolly Thrice can be spoken with at any time by using the Filigreed Feywild Bell during Acts Two and Three. Filigreed Feywild Bell [ edit section | visual editor ] When used, Dolly appears and asks the party a riddle in prose. Depending on the answer, Dolly either grants Pixie Blessing or plays a prank on the speaking party member by polymorphing them into an animal: Dolly Dolly Dolly You look like you want to say the magic words. Like they're right on the tip of your lips... Dolly Dolly Dolly, Dolly; won't you save me from my folly? (Grants Pixie Blessing ) I'm afraid I don't know the magic words. Mind sharing them? (Inflicts Toad Mode ) Oh, my lovely Dolly thrice who is so very sweet and nice - won't you assist your humble friend so I won't meet my cursèd end? (Grants Pixie Blessing ) We're living in a magical theatre show puppeteered by a madman. (Inflicts Big Pig ) Snurl. (Inflicts Cattle Prattle ) Quotes [ edit section | visual editor ] “ OPEN THIS CAGE YOU MUNTING ARSEHOLE! „ — Dolly Dolly Dolly , if not freed Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Follow the Convoy ⁠ Infiltrate Moonrise Towers ⁠ Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Render by Reza Abedi See also [ edit section | visual editor ] Jelliwig Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Moonlantern is not automatically inspected after picking it up, equipping it allows the party member to use the action Inspect Moonlantern to talk to Dolly. If the action is not in the quick action bar, it can be found in the Spellbook menu under "Common". Dolly's Pixie Blessing disappears if the party move between Act areas (for example if they travel back to the Wilderness ( Act One ) from the Shadow-Cursed Lands ( Act Two )). Because of this, if the blessing is applied during Act Three, there is no way to remove it, because the party cannot leave Act Three. [ verify ] Dolly is one of the few characters who are able to break the "fourth wall" and acknowledge that she is part of a video game. When using the Filigreed Feywild Bell , the talking party member has the option to tell her that the "magic words" are "We're living in a magical theatre show puppeteered by a madman" . Dolly replies that they are not supposed to know that, and polymorphs them into a pig for two turns as punishment. v t e Shadow-Cursed Lands Characters Companions Halsin Cultists of the Absolute Bedi Gronag Kansif Kar'niss Korliss Lora Rizzle Vez Flaming Fists Art Cullagh Aubree Cyril Florrick Gretta Helena J'ehlar Marcus Falgor Nipawa Rahir Rhed Thadwick Ulthred Vidor Harpers Antony Arthus Bor Branthos Callie Chenti Darragh Donner Elifer Elindale Essius Grenywald Hangfar Jaheira Karrow Lanni Lassandra Lightspark Lilineth Lymn Manus Meygan Mijah Naysa Olam Olys Skywin Teebs Terradissia Tumeril Yonas Shadow Creatures Crawling Claw Daddy Doggy Giant Shadow Creeper Mummy Shadow Shadow Creeper Shadow Friend Shadow Mastiff Shadow Mastiff Alpha Shadow Plush Shadow-Cursed Harper Shadow-Cursed Flaming Fist Shadow-Cursed Githyanki Warrior Shadow-Cursed Needle Blight Shadow-Cursed Pilgrim Shadow-Cursed Raven Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound Shadow-Cursed Vine Blight Shadow-Cursed Zealot Winged Horror Wraith Tiefling Refugees Alfira Bex Cal Cerys Danis Ide Lakrissa Lia Meli Mirkon Mol Rolan Umi Traders Barcus Wroot Dammon Mattis Talli Other Dolly Dolly Dolly He Who Was His Majesty Hyena Isobel Madeline Meazel Meenlock Oliver Raven Strange Ox Teth'ka Thaniel Locations Grand Mausoleum Last Light Inn Cellar Moonrise Towers Reithwin Town Ruined Battlefield Quests Capture Isobel the Selûnite Cleric Daughter of Darkness Find Arabella's Parents Find Rolan in the Shadows Follow the Convoy Infiltrate Moonrise Towers Investigate the Selûnite Resistance Find the Githyanki Creche Find the Nightsong Kill Raphael's Old Enemy Lift the Shadow Curse Punish the Wicked Rescue the Tieflings Resolve the Abduction Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse The Chosen of Shar The Hellion's Heart The Pale Elf Wake Art Cullagh

Technical UID S_LOW_Dolor UUID 55837c0f-0171-4020-a4a3-dd6de7ffc134 Stats LOW_SerialKiller_Dolor Variant 1 UID LOW_SerialKiller_DolorForDoppelgangers UUID f402fb53-743e-42b6-9e42-30599eb1b4ae Stats Dwarf_Commoner Dolor [ 1 ] is a serial killer seeking to gain the Bhaalist title of Unholy Assassin by impressing the Murder Tribunal . He is the son of Ffion Goldgrind , who was a sex worker at Sharess' Caress before being murdered by Dolor. He is first encountered under the false name Master Meztli . “ It was perfect... perfectperfectperfect... You have sullied it with knowledge. Made it an unclean sacrifice. I will remember your face. „ — Dolor , if revealed during the Wine Festival Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] While most of Dolor's confirmed murders were committed in order to ⁠ Impress the Murder Tribunal , the murder of his mother - according to Ffion herself (via Speak with Dead ) - was committed because she discovered his 'secret'. According to Ffion, Dolor enjoys murder, specifically killing people slowly. Despite the fact that he was only required to murder two targets in order to become an Unholy Assassin , Dolor continued and so far has successfully murdered four victims; Father Lorgan , Franc Peartree , Alexander Rainforest and Duke Stelmane . This string of successes has earned the attention [ 2 ] as well as admiration [ 3 ] of Bhaalist Doppelgangers who are witnesses to his murders and assist him if need be. [ 4 ] His murders are currently being investigated by two Flaming Fist officers, Valeria and Devella Fountainhead . Investigator Valeria is in Sharess' Caress having drinks as she has concluded that a refugee named Brilgor is responsible for Father Lorgar's murder. However her assistant is much closer in finding the truth; Constable Fountainhead can be found in Elfsong Tavern investigating for clues in the room of Duke Stelmane, Dolor's latest murder victim. Dolor can be encountered in the Lower City , on different occasions, first at the Wine Festival where he can be found posing as a wine connoisseur (under the alias Master Meztli) in order to poison Cora Highberry . This only happens if the party have read any of the Bloodstained Parchments before, which can be found in several locations. The party can expose him here, triggering a battle with several doppelgangers, during which he attempts to flee using Dimension Door . [ 5 ] If it is Counterspelled, he attempts to escape via invisibility . If Dolor is able to flee from the Wine Festival, his next mark is Figaro Pennygood , owner of Facemaker's Boutique . The party can disturb him mid-assassination and kill him in the ensuing battle. A paralyzed Devella Fountainhead is also there and is the first target of Dolor during combat. If Dolor is killed his looted corpse contains the Dirge of the Unholy Assassin , which reveals the location of the Bhaalist Murder Tribunal and the password Sicarius , as well as the Hand Bag with the severed hands required for entry. If the player character independently seeks the Murder Tribunal by becoming an Unholy Assassin and certain conditions are met , Dolor must be fought at the Tribunal as a professional rival. Alternatively, Dolor can be convinced with a DC 25 Persuasion Check to turn on the Tribunal, arguing it does not properly serve Bhaal since it is pitting two perfect killers against each other. If Dolor is convinced, he states that Bhaal is not a god of decrees and doctrines and attacks the Guardians. If he survives the encounter he proceeds to attack Sarevok Anchev as well as Echo of Amelyssan , Echo of Sendai , and Echo of Illasera . However he is instantly killed as Sarevok uses Power Word Kill on the dwarf. If the Murder Tribunal is defeated and Dolor survives, he turns on the party and immediately attacks them. If the player character encounters Dolor at the wine festival, steals both the Dirge of the Unholy Assassin and the Hand Bag, and leaves without combat, then Dolor can be found wandering outside the Murder Tribunal complaining that he is not allowed entry. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Dolor is explicitly coded to have two Bonus Actions , one of which he spends using a grenade (typically Karabasan's Gift ) as a special variant of Throw that uses bonus actions. Because of Dolor's high Dexterity and access to the Alert feat, it can be difficult to start before him in combat. Furthermore, failing the appropriate checks can leave the party surprised, allowing Dolor to escape to this next target on unprepared parties. Elixir of Vigilance and party members with the Alert feat are useful when encountering him. Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Sneak Attack (Melee) ( ) Damage: 1~6 Normal weapon damage + 1d6 ⁠ Weapon Deal an extra 1d6 damage to a foe you have Advantage against. Also works if you have an ally within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the target and you don't have Disadvantage . Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Per turn Throw ( )   –   Karabasan's Gift Damage Normal weapon damage Throw a character or item from the world or your inventory. Your Strength affects how much weight you can throw. Heavier items deal more damage. The damage of weapons with the thrown property is the same as the weapon's melee damage. Range: 3-18 m (10-60 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Dagger +2 Dirge of the Unholy Assassin Dolor Amarus Hand Bag containing: Alexander Rainforest's Hand Duke Stelmane's Hand Father Lorgan's Hand Franc Peartree's Hand Karabasan's Gift 3x Scarlet Leather Armour Spaceshunt Boots Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] A Promising Candidate A Murderous Masterpiece Bloodstained Note Diary, 1492DR, Ffion Goldgrind Field Report - Deathstalker Zumm Torn Orders Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Dolor can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . Who are you? Meztli Dolor... A humble servant... A most glorious aspirant... Why did you kill all those people? Meztli My becoming ... Unholy... Assassin... What's an Unholy Assassin? Meztli Avatar... of... Murder ... How does one become an Unholy Assassin? Meztli Prove thyself... Before the Tribunal How do I get access to the Murder Tribunal? Meztli Speak the word at the door... Bring proof of two sacrifices... What word must be spoken? Meztli Sicarius ... What proof will the Tribunal require? Meztli An innocent's hand... To touch divinity... Why were these targets chosen? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.* What is the Murder Tribunal? Meztli The Tribunal... It... Narrator *The corpse tries to speak but something prevents it.* Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion ⁠ Impress the Murder Tribunal ⁠ Investigate the Murders Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Dolor means "pain" or "grief" in Latin, it is identical to the incantation of Eldritch Blast . ↑ A Promising Candidate ↑ A Murderous Masterpiece ↑ For example, during Cora's attempted murder they do not intervene if Cora simply drinks the wine and Dolor murders her before teleporting away, however if the player character intervenes they assist the dwarf during his escape attempt. ↑ While Dolor carries the Spaceshunt Boots , the Act3b_LOW_SerialKiller_HighberrysHouse   script contains a trigger for him to cast Boots of Dimension Door , a 5th level version of Dimension Door with a range of 100 m (333 ft) as opposed to the usual 50 m (167 ft), exclusively at the wine festival. Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] If Dolor is killed at the wine festival, picking up his corpse and holding onto it (in a character's inventory, or by placing it in any container) may cause the game save to corrupt after the next long rest. Reverting to a save prior to a long rest and dropping the corpse (near the wine festival, if possible) can resolve the issue. EQP_Longbow_B_StuddedLeather_B Dominica Arsetz is one of the Gur , the human nomadic tribe. She is in the Gur Camp in Rivington in Act 3 . “ No screaming children, no laughter, no scolding words. There's only silence and pain now. „ — Dominica Arsetz , at the Gur Camp in Rivington Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Dominica Arsetz is in the Gur Camp attending a funeral for the fallen from a recent offence on Cazador's palace. Dominica and her fellow Gur are all members of a group of monster hunters lead by Ulma . They are looking for their children, who have been kidnapped by Cazador's spawns. The nomads have camped in Rivington, trying to mount a rescue or seek revenge. Ulma asks the party for help in defeating Cazador and discovering the fate of their abducted children. Once Cazador is defeated, Dominica - along with Ulma and the other Gur - move near the waypoint in Cazador's Dungeon . She attacks the party if the ritual held in the dungeons is completed. If Astarion was turned in to Gandrel in Act One and kidnapped, then in Act Three Dominica and all of her fellow Gur (except Gandrel) are dead. If the target dies before the spell ends, you can use Reapply Hunter's Mark to mark a new creature. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Longbow +1 Studded Leather Armour +1 Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Dominica Arsetz talks to Ulma in the Gur Camp: Dominica Arsetz Forgive me. I know tears will not bring our children back. Ulma There is nothing to forgive. It is only right to mourn. Pumler Grejit We shed tears today so we may shed blood tomorrow. Dominica Arsetz What will we do? There are so few of us left. Ulma Our strength was never numbers, but the bonds we share. And they are stronger than ever. Pumler Grejit As long as we stand together, we can never be truly broken. Ulma We let emotion cloud our judgement and it almost doomed us. We need strategy and cool heads. Dominica Arsetz Should we fortify the camp? Wait for the vampires to strike here? Pumler Grejit And let them marshal all their strength against us? I do not like our chances. Pumler Grejit Cazador's nest of serpents must be exterminated. Nothing less will do. Dominica Arsetz And if our children still live? What will happen to them if we attack? Ulma I share your fear, but we cannot build plans on fear. We will have to act, for all our sakes. EQP_Unarmed Doni is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One . Rikka is his guardian. “ *Grunt.* „ — Doni Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Doni does not speak and tries to avoid eye contact when spoken to. Like many children in-game, he reacts with written dialogue when certain animals approach him, such as a Dire Raven Companion . Before arriving at the Emerald Grove, Doni lost his father and home, which led Rikka to take guardianship. Doni is also part of the children's gang led by Mol . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Doni is in the Grove at X: 225 Y: 550 . Upon the first attempt by a party member to speak with him, he stares past them. If they turn around to see what Doni is looking at, a passive DC 10 Perception Check is rolled. On success, Doni is seen slipping between the rocks. The party member can then make an additional check to spot the entrance to the Tiefling Hideout and receive 15 XP : [ 1 ] [INVESTIGATION]  Search the rocks for an opening.  (DC 10)  (if not a Ranger or Rogue) [RANGER] [INVESTIGATION]  Examine the rocks for anything out of the ordinary.  (DC 10  ) [ROGUE] [INVESTIGATION]  Study the rocks for a secret passage.  (DC 10  ) Alternatively, if Mirkon survives ⁠ Investigate the Beach , he gives the party a password and instructs them to speak with Doni to gain entry. Gold_Pocket_Random Harper Donner is a Harper who guards and reinforces the barriers leading into the main plaza of Last Light Inn during Act Two . “ Jaheira seems sure of you. I hope she's right. This barricade might keep the shadows out, but it won't help against what's already inside. „ — Donner Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Donner is at the Last Light Inn , reinforcing the barricade with planks, which Antony and Chenti bring to him. He is in the background as Elifer and Jaheira interact with the party, stepping aside to make way for Mol , if she is alive and comes to the party's rescue. Alternatively, he can be lightly pushed aside by Marcus , if the tiefling refugees do not make it to Last Light. If Marcus is exposed as a True Soul , Donner gets Stunned and joins the fight against the summoned Crawling Claws . Talking with Donner after exposing Marcus' true identity reveals he is the only Harper around who is still unwilling to trust the party, berating them that Marcus got away without being injured and that the party is only doing this to gain their trust. [ 1 ] Donner then reinforces and sharpens the barricades with a dagger until later events, occasionally chatting with Antony who brings him wood. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Flaming Fist Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Donner usually fails his saving throw and is Impaled for the remainder of battle. If Isobel is not saved, Donner and everyone in Last Light Inn, save for Jaheira, turn into Shadow-Cursed Undead . Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved and the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers , Donner follows Jaheira to the assault on Moonrise. However, Donner is killed during the fight against Absolute forces before the party arrive. His corpse is on the bridge leading to Moonrise Towers, implying he was amongst the first to fall in battle. WYR_OpenHand_Priest Brother Donnick is a member of the Open Hand Temple in Rivington during Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Donnick is working in the kitchen. He despairs over Father Lorgan's murder and how the rising tide of anti-refugee sentiment forced his soup kitchen to close. Questioning him reveals that Lorgan was murdered in the nearby basement and Donnick often brought unusually large amounts of food down to him. Technical UID S_LOW_Elfsong_Exterior_Patron_001 UUID b0acaed9-296a-409c-8064-a8aff1131013 Stats Halfling_Commoner Doora Thumbfoot is a lightfoot halfling in Baldur's Gate 3 . She can be found on the ground floor of the Elfsong Tavern near one of the doorways to the kitchen. “ Pardon me, saer. You look... prosperous. „ — Doora Thumbfoot Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] When spoken to, she offers to sell the party her mother's Polished Necklace with no additional properties for 200 gold. When asked, she says she wishes to sell it because she needs more gold than what the jewelers would give her for it, due to the market being flooded by loot brought in by adventurers - something which the party can apologize for contributing to. If pressed, she eventually admits that she needs the money to help her husband escape Baldur's Gate after incurring the wrath of Enver Gortash . The party can choose to reject her offer, buy the necklace, or give her 200 gold and let her keep the necklace. If Gortash is defeated, Doora leaves and cannot be found or interacted with again. Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] It is actually possible to trade with Doora and buy the necklace from her during the dialogue, for less than 200 gold (depending on discount). If doing this and then agreeing to buy the necklace off her, Doora is quite upset about the necklace that she just sold to the party herself, disappearing. v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the ## Doozy the Dunce
- **来源**: [Doozy the Dunce](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Doozy_the_Dunce)
- **分类**: Characters

Doozy the Dunce Guild Member In-game Portrait Voice / Actor Adam Diggle Faction The Guild Stats Size Medium Type Humanoid Race Human Technical UID S_LOW_Guildhall_Member_005 UUID b34e82a2-f774-4f73-b808-c2e79cabdb2a Stats Human_Commoner Doozy the Dunce is a member of the Guild that can sometimes be found in the Guildhall in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate . “ Please, not a step closer! I, uh, lost a ring in the mud here and I don't want you to step on it and bury it. „ — Doozy the Dunce Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Doozy the Dunce will only appear in the Guildhall if Oskar Fevras was not saved from Brem in Act One . He can be found in the pit, looking for a lost ring. If the party wishes to help, a Tarnished Ring can be found and returned to him by looking at the other side of the pit. Technical UID S_MOO_BazaarGuard_000 UUID 1d5cdba7-f2e4-4568-9bb8-94abcf9081d6 Stats MOO_FanaticOfTheAbsolute_Drow Eqp. EQP_Staff_Magic_Scalemail Trs. MOO_Cultist Adept Dorikel is a drow Adept of the Absolute in Moonrise Towers during Act Two . He is stationed outside the main throne room, alongside Adept Furek . “ I saw it, True Soul. The army. They're nearly ready. It's nearly time. „ — Dorikel Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Dorikel is on the ground floor hall of Moonrise Towers , up on the staircase leading into the throne room and watching over the hall. If spoken with, he states he is anxious yet strangely calm about the pending invasion. If asked what role he will take in the ensuing invasion of Baldur's Gate , he reveals he has been trained as an assassin of House Hekar [ 1 ] and proposes his skills can be used for scouting or special operations purposes. Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Dorikel is part of the remaining forces defending Moonrise Towers; he remains on the ground floor hall and stands in the same area as before the assault. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Command: Flee ( + ) Command a creature to flee from you on its turn and do nothing else. WIS Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Per comat Death Ward ( + ) Protect a creature from death. The next time damage would reduce it to 0 Hit Points , it remains conscious with 1 Hit Point left. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Guardian of Faith ( + ) Call forth a divine guardian that attacks nearby enemies. Every time it deals damage, the guardian loses an equal amount of Hit Points . Creatures starting their turn in the area take 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Cold damage. Creatures ending their turn in the area possibly take 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Acid damage. The area is Difficult Terrain . BG_Commoner_Poor Dorrich Manne is a Halfling in the Rivington refugee camp in Act Three . “ Washin' my pits, washin' my pits, this is the song when I'm... OI! Can a bloke got get any bleedin' privacy around here? Buncha perverts, you lot! I hate this place. Can't even soap my forearms in peace... „ — Dorrich Manne Interactions [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Dorrich is beneath a makeshift tent in the refugee camp at X: 88 Y: -102 . If spoken with, the half-naked Halfling sings a song and grooms himself, before lamenting that his privacy is always being interrupted. Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] Although characterized as a Halfling , Dorrich's appearance is more similar to that of Gnomes (pointy ears). Technical UID S_LOW_LostInBramption_Citizen_02 UUID cd550033-d233-401c-ba0a-84830bf8c8d5 Stats Halfling_Commoner Saer Drana Hoyte is a halfling civilian. She appears to be lost and is near the Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City during Act Three . “ We're not lost. Just taking in the view before continuing on our way. „ — Drana Hoyte Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Drana and her companion Filson Vago have both stopped at a fork in the road and are discussing whether they should ask for directions. They are looking for the Facemaker's Boutique but are currently on the opposite side of town. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Filson Vago You're certain Figaro's is in this part of town? Saer Drana Hoyte I wouldn't say I'm certain . Just optimistic. Filson Vago We're lost, aren't we? Saer Drana Hoyte Why don't we just retrace our steps? Filson Vago Great idea. Do you remember which way we came? Saer Drana Hoyte Left, left, right, down the stairs and - or was it up the stairs? Filson Vago I'm going to ask for directions. Saer Drana Hoyte No, no - you mustn't! The city is full of criminals. We can't let them know we're vulnerable. Saer Drana Hoyte Fine. We'll just stand here until you remember the way, shall we? v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the Lower City Anti-Hag Support Group Adrielle Hydrangea Wubb Jatlo Kled Mayrina Baldur's Mouth Gazette He is also the father of Enver Gortash . Dravo and Sally are available to trade with, selling a small selection of camp shoes . “ Be very welcome to Flymm's Cobblers! Humble family home of our Archduke Enver Gortash! „ — Dravo Flymm Contents 1 History 2 Involvement 3 Speak with Dead 4 Loot 5 References History [ edit section | visual editor ] Sally and Dravo Flymm inherited Flymm's Cobblers from family, [ 1 ] giving birth to and raising Enver Gortash in their small Lower City store. However, they struggled with Enver as a child, finding him demanding and troublesome. Parenthood also put a strain on their relationship, nearly driving them apart. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] While Enver was still a child, Sally and Dravo Flymm went into debt trying to keep their store afloat. They borrowed from the Guild, who later threatened them with death when they were unable to repay their loans. [ 4 ] [ 5 ] A warlock visited the Flymms, and offered them coin in exchange for Enver's service, which they accepted. [ 6 ] [ 7 ] This warlock, either in the service of Raphael or Raphael himself, took Enver to the House of Hope , where he became a pageboy under Raphael and Nubaldin . [ 8 ] He eventually escaped the House. [ 9 ] After he was successful in establishing the cult of the Absolute, Enver returned to his family to take revenge. Enver forced two illithid tadpoles into Sally and Dravo, using them to control their bodies and make them "powerless". [ 10 ] [ 11 ] Under the tadpole's compulsion, Sally and Dravo outwardly appeared as their son's greatest fans, and were used by Enver to assist in his efforts to control the city. While Sally retained her mind beneath the compulsion, Dravo lost his completely, now no more than a puppet. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Dravo can be found with Sally at their store, proudly proclaiming it to be the family home of Enver Gortash, replete with a large painting of a young Gortash hung behind the counter. The player character can use their tadpole to try to connect to his, however they will find that "it's as though the inner workings of his mind have been wiped clean". If Dravo is killed, Speak with Dead can be used on him to discover that he was tadpoled by Gortash in revenge for selling him off to pay a debt to the Guild. He can also provide a hint for killing Gortash; to use his Steel Watchers against him. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Dravo can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . Who are you? Dravo Flymm Dravo Flymm... father of... Enver Flymm... Gortash... What was Gortash like as a child? Dravo Flymm Foolish... needy... wicked... Too much... trouble... needed money... sold him off... Why did you sell your son? Dravo Flymm Heavy debts... no way to repay... Trouble... with Guild... warlock offered... good coin... How did you get tadpoled?  (If player member knows Flymm was tadpoled) Dravo Flymm Enver... came to us... forced worm... into our heads... Revenge... for... selling him... had no... choice... Does Gortash have any weaknesses I can use against him?  (If Gortash is alive) Dravo Flymm Clever boy... always... tinkering. Traps... mechanisms... Use his work... against him... Steel Watchers... are his... greatest weapon... Gortash is dead.  (If Gortash is dead) Dravo Flymm May... he... rot...
