I hope we get a chance to see to the dead. „ — Grenywald Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved, and the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers , Grenywald takes the place of one of the original Harper allies (either Antony , Essius , Lymn , or Naysa ) as a failsafe in the event that one the latter has been killed before the ⁠ Assault on Moonrise Towers . Speaking with Grenywald lets him awkwardly compliment the player character. [ 1 ] If he survives the fight, he guards the first floor of Moonrise Towers with the remaining Harpers. [ 2 ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If Grenywald survives Moonrise Towers, he can be summoned as an ally through the Gather Your Allies variant Silver Harp Squadron , if ⁠ The High Harper is completed with Minsc alive, and either Antony, Naysa, or Lymn being dead. GOB_Goblin_Generic Warrior Gresh is a Goblin Warrior in the Underground Passage in Act One . He leads a small group of scouts who are holding Findal hostage. “ Did some bleeding hearts show up to save the druid? I'll cut ya to pieces. „ — Gresh Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Upon entering the Underground Passage, Gresh, Gurza , Torrack , and Worm are discussing the fate of their fellow goblins . One of the druids of the Emerald Grove , Findal , lies unconscious nearby. While the other goblins discuss new torture methods, Gresh asserts that they still need answers from their hostage. Presumably, Findal fell unconscious during an interrogation. Regardless of the party's interactions with Gresh, he is always hostile to the party and cannot be persuaded to release Findal or allow them safe passage. If Sazza is with the party, he ridicules her as a failure. HAV_Survivor Gretta is a Flaming Fist under the command of Counsellor Florrick to rescue Duke Ravengard during Act Two . “ That parasite of yours could prove useful. Until it kills you. „ — Gretta Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Initially on a mission led by Florrick to rescue Ulder Ravengard , Gretta and the rest of the Fists were waylaid by the dangers of the Shadow-Cursed Lands and found refuge with the Harpers at Last Light Inn . Gretta is within Last Light Inn , in the same room as several other Fists, and Art Cullagh . If Florrick is not rescued from Waukeen's Rest in Act One , Gretta never appears in the game. Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Gretta is incapacitated by a Winged Horror before the party can react, and becomes Impaled for the remainder of the battle. If Isobel is not saved, Gretta and everyone in Last Light Inn turn into a Shadow-Cursed Undead , save for Jaheira . Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn and the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers , Gretta is among the Fists left by Florrick to follow Jaheira to the ⁠ Assault on the fortress . However, Gretta is killed during the initial fight against Absolute forces before the party arrive. Her corpse is on the bridge leading to Moonrise, implying she was amongst the first to fall in battle. EQP_Duergar_GreatAxe_Leather Trs. UND_KC_Trader_Weapons Corsair Greymon is a duergar trader who can be found at Grymforge . “ Spit it up, Morghal . Or you busy choking on that True Soul Nere's prick with Thrinn ? „ — Greymon Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] After boarding the boat from the Underdark beach, another boat captained by Corsair Greymon sails up alongside the party's boat. Greymon comes aboard, and the player character must pass a check or attack Greymon and his crew. Passing a DC 15 Athletics Check to push him into the water during the cutscene kills Greymon, sinking his corpse and inventory to the bottom of the sea, making both permanently inaccessible. This also initiates combat with the surviving duergar, and garners approval from Lae'zel and Astarion . In a chest aboard Greymon's skiff is the Intransigent Warhammer . If Greymon or a member of his crew is pushed into the water during battle , they wash up at the beach near the southern pier of the Decrepit Village . Otherwise, Greymon can be convinced to let the party proceed, either by bringing Sergeant Thrinn's boots back or by passing one of the following checks: [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  MOVE YOUR BOAT, OR SINK. MAKE THE CHOICE.  (DC 10  ) [INTIMIDATION]  In the name of the Absolute - you will let me pass. (DC 10) [DECEPTION]  I saw a body left by the myconids - your 'Gekh' must be dead. (DC 15) [DECEPTION]  I'm afraid Gekh is dead - he fell fighting the myconids. (DC 15) [BRANDED] [PERSUASION]  Just let me cross - I have the brand, see? (DC 10) Successfully convincing Greymon to let the party pass grants party members with the Charlatan background the inspiration ⁠ A Friend to All . Defeating the duergar instead grants the inspiration ⁠ Drowned in the Dark to party members with the Soldier background. If Greymon sails to Grymforge with the party, he moves to the area where deep gnome slaves are digging out Nere and can be traded with. As a follower of the Absolute , he sides with Nere, if the party choose to fight him. Store [ edit section | visual editor ] Corresponds to UND_KC_Trader_Weapons . GOB_Goblin_Generic Gribbo is a goblin in the Goblin Camp during Act One . She is the proud owner of her new 'pigeon': the writer Volo . “ Don't go botherin' my pigeon! He's mine. „ — Gribbo , when approaching the captured Volo Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] When the party first arrive in the Goblin Camp, Volo is onstage. To complete ⁠ Rescue Volo , the player character must convince her to release him or circumvent her through other means. [ILLITHID]  Set him free. [DECEPTION]  He looks weak. Sick, even. Open the cage or you'll be sorry. (DC 10) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  Watch your tongue, or I'll take it.  (DC 10) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  THE HELLS DID YOU SAY TO ME?!  (DC 10) [INTELLIGENCE]  Read her thoughts. Someone raised the- „ — Griff , just before being dominated Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Griff can be encountered in the Bloomridge Park , after the party defeat the Bhaal cultists waiting for them in ambush. She only appears in the gameplay if Manip Edenosa did not survive the battle. Griff approaches the party immediately after resolving the battle, and the Netherbrain speaks to the player character through her, entreating the party to kill any remaining of the Dead Three , as it would have done through Edenosa. Griff then dies from the mind strain. Connecting with the Netherbrain in this manner grants the ⁠ Urgent Communications inspiration event to any party member with the Soldier background. After death, Griff unlike Edenosa cannot be looted for a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen . Technical UID S_LOW_BhaalTemple_DeathsHead_01 UUID dc5d659c-8703-4e41-bf3e-0eeae60d919b Stats Human_Cultist_Bhaal_Invoker Invoker of Bhaal Grimlark is a human follower of Bhaal found in the Bhaal Temple in the Undercity of Baldur's Gate . He is the assumed author of Murder, Be My Muse and the Grimlark Verses . “ Bhaal rejoices in your ascension, Chosen. As do I. „ — Grimlark Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Grimlark is in the Chosen's Room within the Bhaal Temple . If the party enter the room before defeating Orin , he tells them to quickly make their way to her. If the Dark Urge defeats Orin in combat, he congratulate them afterwards. If Orin is defeated by a non-Dark Urge character, he immediately dies. If the Dark Urge embraces Bhaal, and Jaheira and Minsc were recruited and did not leave the party up to this moment, they both confront the player character on their way back from the temple. In this case, Grimlark joins the fight as the party's ally. Grimlark is the author of Murder, Be My Muse , the Grimlark Verses , and the stanza engraved on the skulls in the basement of the Candulhallow's Tombstones shop. Did we finally reach your 'dead gondian' quota? Is that why it took so long for anyone to help us? „ — Grindo Biggs Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Grindo Biggs can be found on the lab floor of the foundry battling Black Gauntlet of Banes and Steel Watchers . He wears a Kill Collar , which must be disabled by deactivating a Motivator held by one of the Black Gauntlets. If saving him as part of the quest ⁠ Save the Gondians , he runs out of the lab and gathers with the rest of the Gondians outside of the foundry. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Thunderwave ( + ) Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Thunder Release a wave of thunderous force that pushes away all creatures and objects in an area, while also dealing Thunder damage. CON Save Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Destroyed Kill Collar Light Hammer Idle conversation [ edit section | visual editor ] Grindo Biggs can be seen having a conversation with Borri Paver : Black Gauntlet Borri Paver Explain - preparing the cadaver's brain. Gondian Grindo Biggs Really? You don't know how your own Steel Watchers operate? Black Gauntlet Borri Paver One finger. Another word, and it'll be your left eye. Gondian Grindo Biggs Forgive me. The brains have a parasite inserted into their frontal lobes. Gondian Grindo Biggs We preserve them in an embalming solution for longevity. Gondian Grindo Biggs This is not helping me work quicker. Black Gauntlet Borri Paver I'm going to be merciful and pretend I didn't hear that tone. Black Gauntlet Borri Paver Tell me - what are you doing? Gondian Grindo Biggs Preparing the cadaver's brain. Gondian Grindo Biggs Is this some kind of test? Black Gauntlet Borri Paver It's whatever I damn well want it to be. Keep going. Gondian Grindo Biggs The parasite's psionic connection to the hivemind is what enables remote control of its Watcher. Black Gauntlet Borri Paver Correct. Now, tell me - how excited are you to dig your stubby little fingers into a corpse's brain? Gondian Grindo Biggs I am... excited. And fortunate to work on such a momentous project. GOB_Goblin_Generic Warrior Gronag is a goblin in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two . “ What part of 'piss off' weren't clear? „ — Gronag Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Gronag is in a camp next to Kansif and Brawler Vez , and can escort the party alongside Kar'niss . If a party member speaks with him in their camp, he will throw a bone into the Shadow Curse and watch with glee as a Hyena is killed fetching it unless they intervene. The party member can elect to use their Illithid powers, while a Dark Urge character can command Gronag to fetch the bone instead. This rewards the Forcing Responsibility for the Haunted One background. If Gronag survives the trip to Moonrise Towers or is never encountered, he travels to Moonrise Towers and is west of the throne room alongside Vez and Lora . BG_Commoner_Poor Gronch is a Half-orc in the Rivington refugee camp at X: 86 Y: -79 . He was traveling with Gregory and Nealos Bright . “ Aghkk! Whatever you need, I can't help you. Even talking is painful right now. „ — Gronch , on his "injuries" Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] When encountered, Gronch appears to be wounded with his torso covered in bandages. The party can try and examine him: [MEDICINE]  Let me take a look at that wound. (DC 10)  (Non-Cleric) [CLERIC] [MEDICINE]  I'm well versed in healing rites - allow me to take a look. (DC 10  ) Examining his wounds successfully reveals that Gronch is not hurt, but merely pretending. He then confesses that he is faking it, so that his traveling companions will stick around for a little longer. v t e Rivington v t e Characters in Rivington Refugees Arne Jacobson Belron Strongstep EQP_Dagger Trs. BG_Commoner Saer Grotpoll is a high elven character, a Baldurian in Act Three . “ Baldurians! Stand with me against this tide that threatens to overwhelm us. „ — Grotpoll Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Saer Grotpoll is in Rivington, near the Requisitioned Barn at ( Rivington X: 44 Y: -103 ). He is trying to draw everyone's attention (mostly to himself) by shouting out his indignation with hundreds of refugees who temporarily reside around Baldur's Gate, trying to find safety from the armies of the Absolute. Fist Lochan nearby tries to bring him to reason, however, without any success. When spoken to, Saer Grotpoll calls the player character 'another visitor'. If the player character is a Baldurian himself (for example, a Human or a High Elf custom origin, or Karlach , Astarion or Shadowheart ), they have several additional dialogue options to counter Grotpoll's rumblings, including the line about his own accent that betrays himself being a Rivingtonian rather then a 'pure' Baldurian (using this line brings approval from Astarion , Karlach and Jaheira ). If the player character is a custom origin that clearly is not a native-born of Baldur's Gate (like a Drow ), they have an option to make a DC 15 Deception Check to convince him. However, even any of these do not change Grotpoll's opinion or tamp down his temper. v t e Rivington v t e Characters in Rivington Refugees Arne Jacobson Belron Strongstep Ben Golewits Bex Billigan Technical UID S_LOW_BeachSahuagin_Civilian_002 UUID da3dafe4-f014-41e1-8dfe-56670ac9fd0a Stats Gnome_Commoner Grout is a forest gnome on a stroll along the docks east of Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City . “ Gods - all we wanted was a nice dockside walk, not an unscheduled menagerie visit. „ — Grout Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Grout can be initially found on the edge of the docks near Philgrave's Mansion and the Heapside Strand waypoint X: 22 Y: -135 . He is with his date Rossina . If Grout and Rossina survive the Sahuagin attack on the docks, Grout is horrified at the events and the danger he and Rossina faced. In contrast, Rossina is elated at their survival. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Grout is one of only two forest gnomes in the entirety of the game. The other forest gnome is none other than his date, Rossina . Grout has a rare and unusual developer comment in the code that's shared with all nearby NPCs in the docks/beach area, simply describing him as "POTENTIAL SIMPLE CHARACTER". v t e Lower City v t e Technical UID S_GLO_YennasCat UUID 6583b752-ac47-4ae9-ab9d-d75cebaf9b71 Stats Cat Grub is a medium haired red Cat with blue eyes in Rivington . “ Don't look at me. „ — Grub Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Grub can be found with his best friend, Yenna , in Rivington during Act 3 . If allowed, Grub and Yenna become Camp Followers and remain at the party's Camp . Grub is shy and a bit anxious; his trust is only gained by ignoring him. He appears to have some manner of sixth sense regarding the danger Yenna is potentially in, telling the player character that they should be helping her if using Speak with Animals . If talking to Grub without Speak with Animals, the talking party member must pass an Animal Handling check to discern a little information about Yenna: [ANIMAL HANDLING]  You sense this is a reticent cat - gain its trust by ignoring it.  (DC 15) [ANIMAL HANDLING]  Peer into the cat's eyes. Does it know anything about Yenna's mother's fate?  (DC 15) Grub is killed if Orin the Red kidnaps Yenna. This can be prevented by leaving an alternative companion at camp ( Lae'zel , Gale , Halsin , or Minthara ). If Yenna is killed, Grub dutifully sits by her side and mournfully meows. v t e Rivington v t e Characters in Rivington Refugees Arne Jacobson Belron Strongstep Ben Golewits Bex Billigan Indigo Billy Technical UID S_FOR_BugBearMate UUID b6c6764f-ba9d-4109-8b4e-c0d1da72be7d Stats Bugbear Eqp. EQP_Bugbear_MorningStar Trs. GOB_Goblin_Generic Grukkoh is a bugbear in Act One . He can be found in the Forest , north of the Blighted Village with his companion Buthir . “ Puny?! I am strong! I am virile! I am - „ — Grukkoh Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Grukkoh is in a barn next to the Blighted Village, where he and Buthir enjoy a private moment. Should the party interrupt, a cut scene triggers, where Grukkoh angrily demands to know what they are doing: Grukkoh Ngh. W-what the hells are you doin'? Apologies. I didn't mean to interrupt. You were making a lot of noise - I wanted to join the fun. Back away slowly. [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  I'M LAUGHING AT YOUR PUNY RUTTING.  (DC 15) [BARD] [PERSUASION]  Do carry on. There's bookshops in Baldur's Gate that'd pay well for this kind of smut. (DC 15) Attack the couple. All options start combat unless the party passes an Intimidation check as a Barbarian or a Persuasion check as a Bard . Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] The player character opens the door after a party member warns them not to.   +1   -1   -1   -1 The player character fulfills Astarion's request to open the door instead.   +5   -1   -1 Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Morningstar Damage: 3~10 1d8 + 2 ⁠ Piercing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Tenacity ( )   –   Morningstar Damage: 2 2 ⁠ Bludgeoning When you miss an attack, deal ⁠ Bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier anyway (minimum of 1). Throw ( )   –   Javelin Damage: 3~8 1d6 + 2 ⁠ Piercing Throw a character or item from the world or your inventory. Your Strength affects how much weight you can throw. Heavier items deal more damage. The damage of weapons with the thrown property is the same as the weapon's melee damage. Range: 3-18 m (10-60 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Javelin - 2x (if unused) Morningstar Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Grukkoh can be communed with using Speak with Dead . Who are you? Grukkoh Name... Grukkoh... What happened to you? Grukkoh Intruders... me and... Butters... ruined. Were you alone when you died? Grukkoh Butters... Buthir... love... Who killed you? Grukkoh Dog... split us up... ran us through... Where did you come from? Grukkoh Hills... then... Moonrise ... What were you doing in the village? Grukkoh Weapon... search... take break... Butters... Who do you report to? Grukkoh Absolute... only goddess... Moonrise... Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Prior to Hotfix #16 it was possible to trade with Grukkoh, mid-copulation, while talking through the shabby wooden doors. v t e Forest Characters Adventurers Aradin Barth Remira Camp Followers Owlbear Cub Scratch Cultists of the Absolute Andrick Brynna Edowin Beasts Owlbear Mate Owlbear Mother Bugbears and Goblins Brek Fezzerk Grukkoh Scrawny Bugbear Slice Ettercaps and Spiders Ettercap Phase Spider Phase Spiderling Phase Spider Matriarch Ogres Buthir Chock Fank Lump Other Barcus Wroot Dead Tiefling Gomwick Ornate Mirror Shovel Locations Apothecary's Cellar Blighted Village Owlbear Nest Whispering Depths Quests Destroy the Ancient Tome Finish the Masterwork Weapon Forging a Heart Rescue the Gnome Search the Cellar The Hellion's Heart Travel through the Underdark Unlock the Ancient Tome

Technical UID S_LOW_HeapsideDarkGods_Civilian3 UUID 6dd7afdf-46f7-4f06-8719-16ffaf964b45 Stats Dwarf_Commoner Grundlgornn is a dwarven civilian who is listening to Umbrenne , a prophet of Talona in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ We've got no choice - we have to do what he says! „ — Grundlgornn Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Grundlgornn is behind the Stormshore Tabernacle , listening closely to Umbrenne, who is trying to convince him and Leary Dowse that everyone will die soon thanks to Talona , otherwise known as the Mistress of Disease . Grundlgornn fully believes him, and proclaims that he does not want to die. Grundlgornn's attitude towards the party changes depending on the outcome of ⁠ Stop the Presses . Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Leary Dowse Talona? You want to let Talona loose in our city? Umbrenne Poor, sweet fool - you speak as if the Plague-Crone is not already here, striding among us! Umbrenne Her power waxes, and soon the cycle will reach its zenith - should you want it to or otherwise. Leary Dowse And then what happens? Nothing good, I bet! Umbrenne And then all will perish so the cycle can begin anew! Grundlgornn Dear gods, he's right - it's too late to stop it now! Grundlgornn What do we do? What can we do? Umbrenne Embrace it! Umbrenne The Mistress of Disease loves us all - her fondest wish is to free us from the agonies we have created! Grundlgornn My lungs feel tight! It's happening already! Leary Dowse Oh calm down, would you? It's all in your head. Leary Dowse I've a good mind to get the Flaming Fist before people start chucking themselves into the Chionthar . Umbrenne All the Talontar await her blessings with open arms - and we pity those who would reject her. Umbrenne I will smile as her fevers sear me to my core. I will bask in her febrile radiance. Grundlgornn Oh gods, I don't want to die! Not yet! Leary Dowse You are not going to die. Umbrenne We are all going to die, my friend - some of us merely intend to do so in service of something greater. Umbrenne And to thank blessed Talona for the honour. v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the Lower City Anti-Hag Support Group Adrielle Hydrangea Wubb Jatlo Kled Mayrina Baldur's Mouth Gazette Baalfe EQP_Shortbow_Leather Trs. UND_Duergar_Generic Grundril is a duergar ranger at Grymforge during Act One . “ Here to help? Talk to Skarjall. Here to gawk? Find a ledge to fall off. „ — Grundril Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Grundril and Morgya are helping Herdmaster Skarjall clear the rubble wreckage at the far end of the Grymforge stronghold at X: -668 Y: 442 in the Underdark. If the party speak with the Rothé via Speak with Animals and convince the animals to attack the duergar, he turns hostile and attacks. If they instead hit the Rothé, Grundril joins the fight as a neutral participant against the animals. Despite being labeled a "Novice of the Absolute", Grundril is a member of Clan Flameshade . Should the party conspire with Brithvar against Nere , he allies with the party, though he is usually too far from the battle to participate. GOB_Goblin_Generic Lookout Grush is a goblin stationed at the Shattered Sanctum in Act One . He and Torturer Spike are interrogating Liam next to the Bloodied Shrine . “ Keep yer mitts off the prisoner. 'E's mine. MINE „ — Grush Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] When a party member approaches, a cutscene plays out where Spike tortures Liam and asks them to join him. The party member can take over the interrogation, force Grush and Spike to leave using their Illithid tadpole, or deceive them to into believing they have been relieved of their duties. If the party member tortures Liam into revealing the Emerald Grove's location, Grush informs Minthara , who prepares an assault on the Grove. After informing Minthara, Grush moves to where Abdirak is and loiters there. If Spike witnesses a party member undergo the pain ritual with Abdirak , he exclaims that he needs to "see it again" and commands Grush to undergo the ritual as well. The party can then watch as Grush takes hit after hit, eventually succumbing and getting Knocked Out . UND_KC_AdamantineGolem Grym is a powerful Adamantine Golem that eternally protects the Adamantine Forge . It cannot be damaged without becoming Superheated first. Contents 1 Overview 2 Combat 2.1 Attacks and actions 2.1.1 Honour mode 2.2 Immunities 3 Encounter details 4 Tactics 4.1 Hammer tactic 4.2 Ranged bombardment tactic 4.3 Minor Illusion tactic 4.4 Throwing water tactic 4.5 Owlbear from the top ropes tactic 4.6 Loot 5 Related literature 6 Related quests 7 Quotes 8 Gallery 9 Notes 10 Bugs 11 Achievements Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Grym is the eternal golem guardian of the Adamantine Forge hidden away in Grymforge . It is made of adamantine and defends the forge against any who might try to use it. If the Adamantine Forge is used, Grym activates and attempts to destroy its users. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Awaken ( ) Nearby activity rouses Grym, readying it to crush any who set their eyes on its forge. Range: Self Quake ( ) Damage: 3~12 3d4 ⁠ Bludgeoning Stomp the ground to cause a massive shockwave and knock nearby creatures Prone . STR Save Range: Self Seismic Wrath ( ) Grym makes the earth quake and the ground roar - anything to eliminate intruders. Range: Self Recharge: Per combat Slam ( ) Damage: 11~39 4d8 + 7 ⁠ Bludgeoning Hit a target and possibly knock it Prone . STR Save Range: 3 m (10 ft) Honour mode [ edit section | visual editor ] Adamantine Reverberation Immunities [ edit section | visual editor ] Bleeding Burning Charmed conditions, such as Charmed and Dominated Chest Trauma Dazed Difficult Terrain: Lava Frightened conditions, such as Frightened and Phantasmal Killer Gaping Wounds Knocked Out Melting Paralysed Petrified Poisoned conditions, such as Poisoned and Nauseous Stunned Encounter details [ edit section | visual editor ] Grym can send melee attackers Reeling . Its Adamantine Skin passive renders it immune to all damage until it is Superheated by standing in lava; this also removes its Intense Adamantine Backlash passive. Once Superheated, ⁠ Bludgeoning damage is most effective against Grym. Grym cannot be Stunned or Dazed . New resistances when Superheated: Grym's Vengeful Guardian passive causes it to gain the condition Threat Assessment when attacked, which marks the attacker with Prime Target . Grym chases and attacks the Prime Target, which can be utilised to lure the golem into lava – or beneath the hammer of the Adamantine Forge itself. Pulling the forge lever while Grym is Superheated and standing on the central anvil hammers it for 12d8 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage (which is doubled due to Bludgeoning vulnerability when Superheated) and knocks it Prone . However, damaging Grym with the forge immediately removes Grym's Superheated condition and can summon a group of Magma Mephits , though the mephits may eventually appear regardless once Grym is sufficiently damaged. Hammering Grym when not Superheated knocks it Prone but does no damage and might still summon Magma Mephits. Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] Regardless of the party's approach, some method of triggering the lava valve is required, and the lava recedes after two turns, making the golem invincible again. Some ways of triggering it are: one party member can stand near the lava valve, it can be activated with ranged attacks, a familiar can trigger the valve by attacking it, or a Mage Hand can interact with the valve in place of a party member. However, using a familiar or Mage Hand for the initial activation of the lava valve may bug the encounter and prevent Grym from spawning. [ See: Bugs ] Before the fight, it may be wise to spread out the party, placing casters in the back and melee up front near the gate where Grym appears. Using elixirs, such as the Elixir of Hill Giant Strength or Elixir of the Colossus , noticeably boosts melee combatants. Before turning the valve, ensure all party members are standing on raised areas, and enter Turn-Based Mode to prepare additional short-duration buffs. It is advisable to hasten melee characters for the extra attack and added AC . Applying weapon oils, such as the Oil of Accuracy , boosts attack rolls to more easily beat Grym's high AC. Lastly, have party members use weapons that deal ⁠ Bludgeoning damage to exploit Grym's vulnerability. In Honour mode, Command: Halt can be useful because of its potential to prevent Grym from using Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation and dishing out large amounts of melee damage, or providing a pause in the fight to heal the party. This can occasionally prevent the Magma Mephits from spawning. [ verify ] Also in Honour mode, Silence prevents Legendary Action: Adamantine Reverberation from inflicting ⁠ Thunder damage, although it might not prevent the shockwave's 4 m (13 ft) knockback. Hammer tactic [ edit section | visual editor ] One of the easiest ways to defeat Grym is by using the Adamantine Forge's hammer. The hammer used to forge the adamantine equipment is active during each turn of the fight and deals 12d8 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. Positioning the party on each lava-free island allows them to take advantage of Prime Target to lure Grym under the hammer. Only one leg needs to be on the pedestal for a hit to connect. As with other tactics, the party must be able to activate the lava valve and hammer lever, either with nearby party members, summons, or party members shooting at the valve and lever. Magma Mephits eventually spawn on the western island, so having a party member with some form of Fire resistance is advised when using this tactic. Ranged bombardment tactic [ edit section | visual editor ] One possible tactic against Grym is using an all-ranged setup that takes advantage of the terrain. Grym has no ranged attacks, so if the party shoot it from positions it cannot reach, they can slowly destroy Grym without taking damage. Surrounding the forge, there is the central stairway and a second pathway to the right of it. When the forge is lowered, ranged characters (both spellcasters and archers) can hit nearly the entire forge floor where Grym can move from the area on the right, and characters on the entry stairway can also hit the Lava Valve. Grym sniping positions Characters are needed at both positions. Characters on the right are unable to reach the lava valve to Superheat Grym to make it vulnerable to damage. However, there is a section of raised floor just under the left position where Grym can stand and does not get Superheated, so party members need to keep it by the right position to keep it vulnerable to damage. From this position, there is no safe floor area for Grym. Due to Prime Target , Grym always follows the last character that hit it, if able. In the turn order, always make sure that the last one to hit Grym was on the right platform. It then walks to that character's position and stays there every round until it dies or is lured to a different position. Make sure the character(s) on the right side can fire multiple ranged attacks per turn to reduce the chance of them all missing and Grym moving to the left side, potentially onto a floor section safe from Superheating. At this point, continue hitting Grym, having a character on the left side put a shot into the lava valve whenever the lava clears, and always having the characters on the right side move last. It may take a while, but you will be able to defeat Grym without getting wounded and without needing to use the forge hammer, which is needed for obtaining an Achievement . Minor Illusion tactic [ edit section | visual editor ] This strategy improves on the ranged bombardment tactic by using the Minor Illusion cantrip to lure Grym onto the central anvil. Rather than using ranged attacks and spells to damage Grym, which can take some time, the party use the forge hammer to deal large amounts of damage at once, reducing combat to about five rounds. As with the ranged bombardment tactic, height advantage is used by placing characters on elevated positions to maintain a safe distance and use ranged attacks and spells to manipulate the lava valve and hammer. Grym must be Superheated by activating the lava valve. If it is not Superheated, a character can hit it or use Minor Illusion on a lower surface to lure it to an area where it can be affected by the lava before using the lava valve. Once Grym is Superheated, Minor Illusion should be used on the opposite edge of the central anvil. This causes Grym to move onto the anvil to investigate. Grym's extremely low Intelligence score means it almost always fails the Investigation check. The hammer lever must be activated by hitting it with a ranged attack or spell. The first time this happens, Magma Mephits spawn below. Grym loses the Superheated condition and is knocked Prone . It remains invulnerable until its next turn, at which point the Superheated condition must be reapplied. These steps must be repeated until Grym is defeated. Throwing water tactic [ edit section | visual editor ] Similar to ranged bombardment, but exploiting Grym's weakness to Bludgeoning damage, the extra damage dealt by 'gravity' when throwing from a great height, and the easy availability of water jugs. In this version, leave three party members up on the entrance steps, supplied with lots of Water jugs. Because thrown water does Bludgeoning damage and has a gravity bonus when thrown from up high, Grym takes 20+ damage on most hits, and even most 'misses' because of the gravity applied to the water spread. The fourth party member remains on the platform to operate the valve and keep Grym standing in the lava, and should have access to rapid movement spells like Misty Step . When only one party member is on the platform, Grym ignores any threat assessment and pursues the single accessible character. It is arguably most efficient to keep Grym always lured into the lava, rather than attempting to use the forge hammer, as regaining the Superheated condition can sometimes prove a challenging manoeuvre. This throwing technique can also be used while keeping all four party members "up top" as in the above method, gaining more safety but perhaps making manoeuvring Grym into the lava more challenging. Owlbear from the top ropes tactic [ edit section | visual editor ] A potential spot to launch Crushing Flight from and where to target Grym – right where it spawns. It is possible to defeat Grym in a single hit. To do so, the party need: A level 6 druid in Wild Shape: Owlbear (If your druid is lower than level 6, you can do this with Wild Shape: Bear or Wild Shape: Deep Rothé ) A spellcaster who can Enlarge the druid An Elixir of the Colossus consumed by the druid This tactic works because when the druid drinks an Elixir of the Colossus , wild shapes, and then receives the Enlarge spell, their size increases to Gargantuan and their weight increases to 50,005 kg. The weight change does not always properly trigger when changing sizes (See Creature size#Bugs ). The character's weight can be checked from the Examine panel or on the Character Sheet . Additionally, there is a display bug that causes a wildshaped Owlbear to appear as Gargantuan when it becomes Huge. By having the druid remain on the stairs, rather than jumping down onto the platform, they maintain a large vertical distance from the lowered platform when Grym spawns. They can then use Crushing Flight on Grym, negating any fall damage while dealing massive damage due to their large weight and falling distance. If the druid uses any of the other Large Wild Shape forms, they can use Feather Fall or similar effects and perform a regular jump. Make sure to land them as close to Grym as possible without hitting him directly, and avoid landing near an ally, or they will be killed as well. Paired with Grym's vulnerability to Bludgeoning damage while Superheated, the crushing damage should defeat it instantly, even on Tactician or Honour difficulty. In Honour Mode, the Elixir of the Colossus does not stack with Enlarge, and so only one or the other can be used. Even so, the damage of this technique is usually enough to instantly kill Grym. This tactic can be finicky. Key tips to making this happen are: Crouch before jumping. Stand high up on the stairs while still being able to reach Grym. Reloading after buffing is not recommended because it may reset the weight and ruin the damage. If there is difficulty executing this strategy, verify these steps: Grym is Superheated in lava. Buff order: apply Elixir of the Colossus, then Wild Shape, then Enlarge, and verify weight; if weight does not increase properly, then use random actions one at a time and keep checking until the weight is correct. Avoid reloading a save to after this point. Target the ground just adjacent to Grym, not Grym's model, so that the jump path passes through it. When targeting Crushing Flight, Grym should be red-highlighted, but no percentage to hit should appear. Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Grymskull Helm Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Scribbled Notes The Great Furnace of Grymforge Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ The Adamantine Forge Quotes [ edit section | visual editor ] “ Unstoppable juggernauts that exist only to follow their creator's orders, even if that creator has long since passed. „ Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Concept art. Official Concept Render by Gino Luka Kölling, concept art by Jane Katsubo for Larian Studios. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Although Shocking Grasp cannot damage Grym, it prevents it from taking opportunity attacks (thus allowing the party to move around near it more freely), and the attack roll always has advantage as Grym's body counts as metal armour. As of Hotfix 6 , there is no cooldown for the application of Superheated . Thus, it is possible to reapply the effect by activating the lava valve (has a slight delay, check Grym for status effects) and consequently hitting Grym with the hammer multiple times per turn. This can be easily achieved by placing a character within shooting distance of both the lava valve and hammer lever and then shooting them both with arrows. For example, a Hastened character with 3 levels of Thief rogue and 2 levels of fighter has essentially 5 attacks when dual wielding hand crossbows , and can kill Grym in a single turn of combat at tactician difficulty; Grym must first be lured under the hammer, and then stand with one leg in the lava and the other under the hammer. Grym cannot be moved by force, not even when Reduced or Polymorphed . Grym's Quake attack has no height restriction. As such, it is capable of damaging and knocking Prone a character who is high up on the ledge above the forge, if they happen to be caught in the radius. Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] Using a familiar or Mage Hand for the initial activation of the lava valve prevents Grym from spawning. Leaving the fight with a character on the ledge and re-entering the forge stops the ability to turn the lava back on, making the forge unusable. [ verify ] However, it is still possible to kill Grym by manoeuvring a Polymorphed Lava Elemental next to him. The elemental creates Lava under Grym, making him Superheated. Technical UID S_GLO_IrritatedTiefling UUID 65ad9da0-0efb-4cc3-bf82-c006f43dda6c Stats GLO_IrritatedTiefling Eqp. EQP_Shortsword_Scalemail Trs. Humanoid_Melee Guex is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One . He is usually on the training grounds, where he is practising his combat skills. “ Step, parry, strike - damn it! It's just not landing. „ — Guex practicing his swordplay Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Guex is in the training area of The Hollow within the Emerald Grove . If the player character interacts with him, he reveals his frustration with not being able to properly hit a dummy. The player character can offer him ineffectual advice or train him by passing any of the following skill checks: [ 1 ] [ATHLETICS]  Demonstrate a swing - show him the fluidity of movement he lacks.  (DC 12) [INSIGHT]  No wonder you're struggling - you've no balance. Space your feet farther apart. (DC 10) [HALF-ORC] [PERFORMANCE]  Show him how to coil his shoulder muscles into a more intimidating stance before striking. (DC 7) [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM]  Read his thoughts. Clear your mind. Past mistakes don't matter. Focus on the present, the target. The following options automatically succeed the check and improve his training: [ 1 ] [WYLL]  Try this swing. A little number I call 'The Legend's Strike'. [GITHYANKI]  Inspire fear with a war cry - loosen bowels before you spill them - hrath ajak! [GITHYANKI]  Try confusing your foe, like when you first saw me. Shout a question at them. [BARBARIAN]  Don't waste good anger on your thoughts - use it on that target! [MONK]  You need discipline, focus. Fix your gaze to a point, then guide your strikes to it. [FIGHTER]  Put one foot in front of the other. Let momentum aid your strikes. [ROGUE]  This isn't a joust. Feint with your sword, then kick between the 'legs' instead. The following options automatically frustrate him and fail to improve his training: Try hitting the target. If the Detect Thoughts roll fails, Guex and everyone nearby become hostile and initiate combat with the party. If the Athletics or Insight rolls fail, Guex grows angry with the player character and can then be observed and heard to be more frustrated and worse at hitting the dummy. If successful, the player character is rewarded with a Battleaxe and 10 Experience . Guex can also be observed and heard to be much happier and effective at hitting the dummy. Successfully helping him train earns the ⁠ To Arms! inspiration for party members with the Soldier background. If the party travels to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before resolving Kagha's ritual the Rite of Thorns , then the tieflings are expelled from the Emerald Grove and Guex's corpse is among the pile of refugees near the bridge to the Blighted Village . In the event that Minthara and her raiding party are primed to assault the Emerald Grove, Guex moves to the grove's ramparts alongside Pandirna , busy filling up empty barrels with oil . If the raid is stopped or if the goblins ' leaders are defeated, Guex takes part in the festivities at the party's Camp , occasionally chatting with Ikaron in an attempt to get him to drink and lighten up. Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] If the player character succeeds in training him:   +1   +5   +1   +1   +1 If the player character tells him to not call out his moves:   +1   +1 If the player character kills him:   -10 Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Shortsword Damage: 4~9 1d6 + 3 ⁠ Piercing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Scale Mail Shortsword Storage Key Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Raid the Grove ⁠ Save the Refugees Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Before the assault on the Emerald Grove, Guex will be rallied by Asharak : Asharak Looking well, folks - keep it up. Guex Yes sir! Asharak I'm not 'sir'. I was a doorjack in Elturel. Pandirna ' Yes sir'. Guex Shut it, you - and help me with these barrels. Asharak Remember - get down to the cave as soon as you hear the horn. Guex What happens if they attack before we get the signal? Asharak I reckon you'll hear something. Asharak Almost done? Pandirna Nearly. We've ransacked the packs for anything that'll burn. Asharak Good. Reckon we can brave a few nights without lamp-light if it means burning these buggers. He can also be seen filling barrels and talking with Pandirna : Pandirna Gods, this oil bloody stinks. Guex Not so bad as burning goblin will, I'd wager. Pandirna It seems... cruel, when you say it like that. Guex Cruel? Imagine what they'd do to us, given half the chance. Pandirna Can we just get this done, please? I want to get below before - Guex Before what? Afraid you might actually have to fight? Pandirna Look. Asharak already picked who he wanted on the walls, right? And it wasn't us. Guex You might be afraid of your own shadow, but some of us - Pandirna Puff out your chest all you like - I'm going where it's safe. Guex Would you be careful? We're going to spill if you don't stop shaking. Pandirna I'm not shaking. Guex Please, you're trembling like - Pandirna I'm not. Shaking. Guex All right... Guex occasionally chats with Kivak during the camp celebration if he survives the assault on the Emerald Grove: Guex We're alive, Kivak. Alive! Kivak But the others... Guex Tonight we drink to them! Kivak I can't lie - I'm going to miss this place a bit. Guex One sight of the city, and you'll forget all about it. Kivak I thought you'd never been. Guex Ah, but I know. Kivak I feel like I can breathe for the first time in months. Guex Less air, more ale! Guex will also talk to Ikaron during the same event: Guex Grab a drink! Ikaron I'm fine. Guex Ah, loosen up, Ikaron! Guex Your mug's as sour as this ale. We're supposed to be celebratin'! Ikaron Well go bother someone else then. Guex Agh! Spilled my pint. Ikaron Not like you needed it. If a party member talks to Ikaron and convinces him to drink, their banter will change: Guex You'll have a drink, but not with me? Betrayal. Ikaron It's not like that. Guex You're looking flushed! Ikaron I am a bit light-headed. Guex Bah! Nothing another ale won't fix! Guex Are you weaving, or is it me? Ikaron Maybe you should drink some water. Guex I'm fine. One more, that's all. Ikaron I - all right. Guex There's an animal hiding in that shell, I bet. Ikaron I don't know what that means. Guex Have another drink and you'll know exactly what I mean. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Gulster Boyes can be found unconscious near the entrance of Stormshore Tabernacle in the Lower City at X: 113 Y: -47 . She was attacked by a Steel Watcher because her name "was on the list" for thievery. Baz Hopbank and Scribe Goosequill vouch for Gulster, claiming that she is no thief; [ 1 ] they ask the nearby Flaming Fists to bring her to a hospital, but their request is denied. Technical UID S_LOW_SWS_BasiliskGate_FF_002 UUID 436652ca-46ca-4e7c-bdf4-df75a40720ea Stats FlamingFist_Human_Ranger Fist Gummidge is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist . He can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three . “ Listen up! In Baldur's Gate, you do not mouth off to the Flaming Fist! „ — Gummidge Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Gummidge is patrolling the streets of Lower City with Fist Olloa , Fist Nateen and a Steel Watcher . They can be found near the Baldur's Mouth building at X: 113 Y: -47 , guarding the unconscious Gulster Boyes , prostrated on the ground after being knocked out by the automaton. Several citizens - Baz Hopbank , Scribe Goosequill and Eefa Barlow are vouching for their associate, but to no luck. Gummidge claims that Gulster is a thief [ 1 ] and her name is on a list, but both Baz and Goosequill insist that she is innocent. After the Steel Watch Foundry is destroyed, Gummidge ponders on whether he could loot some arrows for his weapon from the wreck, and whether they would fit his crossbow. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Ensnaring Strike (Ranged) ( + + )   –   Heavy Crossbow Damage: 7~21 1d10 + 5 ⁠ Piercing + 1d6 ⁠ Piercing Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target. STR Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Ranged Attack ( )   –   Heavy Crossbow Damage: 6~15 1d10 + 5 ⁠ Piercing Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Volley ( )   –   Heavy Crossbow Damage: 6~15 1d10 + 5 ⁠ Piercing Fire a cascade of magical broadheads and bodkin arrows upon nearby foes. Range: Normal weapon range Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Heavy Crossbow Leather Armour Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Baz Hopbank Whoa, that metal monster don't look so big now.  (If the Steel Watch Foundry is destroyed) Scribe Goosequill The Watchers are history! Think for yourself and show some mercy. Fist Gummidge I still have my duty. Now step back, I know how to use this bow. Baz Hopbank Let her go! Lord Gortash is dead, you have no right to hold her now!  (If Gortash is dead) Fist Gummidge How does the death of Gortash change anything? Duty is duty. Baz Hopbank Yeah, but orders are orders, and whoever is in charge now must have new orders for you. Right? Baz Hopbank That thing damn near busted her skull! I didn't see her make no trouble. Scribe Goosequill I know her, that's Gulster, she's no thief! Fist Gummidge Stay back and stay calm, I'm warning you. She was on the list. Baz Hopbank Come on! At least let us take her to a doctor! Scribe Goosequill That's my friend's niece! Let her go! Fist Gummidge Back off. She goes into the clink unless Lord Gortash tells us otherwise. We're workin' here. „ — Gurd Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Brawler Gurd is in the room west of Dror Ragzlin , where Brakkal is imprisoned. Range: 9 m (30 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Goblin Scimitar Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Gurd chats with Zurga in the goblin camp: Zurga Don't get too comfortable, you 'orrible sacks of muck. Drow might need us any time. Brawler Gurd Ain't been comfortable since we been here. I miss the swamp. Brawler Gurd Proper nice that swamp was. If the goblin attack on the Emerald Grove is successful, Clack and Gurd chat while raiding the grove's storehouse: Warrior Clack You smell that? Brawler Gurd Yeah. It's all... green. Why do druids store tree muck inside? Warrior Clack Dunno. But some of it's gotta be valuable, right? Warrior Clack Maybe. Can't tell if it's for eating or smoking though. Brawler Gurd *Ah-choo!* Ugh... smells funny whatever it's for. Grab as much as you can. ...and are admonished by Rozzak for taking too long: Rozzak What's taking you two so long? Get the goods and get moving! Warrior Clack Gurd keeps sneezing and dropping stuff. Brawler Gurd Shut your mouth! I... *Ah-choo!* Feckin' leaves. Rozzak You serious? Cashguard Taslim Just - just a bitta beer. And wine. And mead. Cashguard Gurira We have to go back to the Counting House! What were you thinking?! Cashguard Taslim Ah, don't be a dry-shite. No one will... will... yeah. Cashguard Gurira Could you at least try to stand up straight. Cashguard Taslim I am! Oh - oh, that was a bad idea. Cashguard Gurira Don't you dare puke on your uniform. Cashguard Taslim You - you want a drink? Let's get one for the road. Cashguard Gurira No, you moron . We could be fired for this! Cashguard Taslim Ah, sure, a bitta drink never killed anyone. Cashguard Gurira Tell that to Glitterbeard ! Technical UID S_GOB_GoblinPriest UUID b983c336-9a14-4e9b-adb9-4689e7e0afa9 Stats GOB_Priestess Eqp. GOB_GoblinPriest_Mace_Shield Trs. GOB_GoblinPriest Priestess Gut , also known as True Soul Gut , is a goblin True Soul and follower of The Absolute stationed at the Goblin Camp in Act One . “ Hells. We need to fish that thing out before it eats any important parts of your brain. „ — Gut on removing the tadpole from the player character Contents 1 Overview 1.1 Background 2 Involvement 2.1 Act One 3 Combat 3.1 Attacks and actions 3.2 Allies 3.3 Encounter details 3.4 Tactics 3.5 Loot 4 Speak with Dead 5 Related literature 6 Related quests 7 Notes 8 Gallery Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Background [ edit section | visual editor ] Priestess Gut is one of the spiritual leaders of the cult. She is one of three leaders at the Shattered Sanctum , alongside Minthara and Dror Ragzlin . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Gut is in the main hall of the Shattered Sanctum. Interacting with her starts or progresses ⁠ Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help . She offers all party members the Brand of the Absolute , which can grant permanent bonuses . The player character can follow her to the chapel and attack her or comply with her wishes. If they comply, she gives them a potion to make them fall asleep, and they wake up imprisoned. If the player character drinks the potion as an elf , drow or half-elf , their Fey Ancestry prevents the potion's effects, which causes Gut to attack immediately. Additionally, a paladin's resolve enables a Constitution Ability check to resist the effects of the potion. If the player character is imprisoned, they find themselves chained up in the prison inside the chapel. If they fail the checks or choose to preserve their strength, they are rescued by a dwarven warlock named Korrilla in the service of Raphael , who kills Gut and Polma instantly. Gut can be killed to complete the quest ⁠ Defeat the Goblins . The quest can also be completed while ignoring her. To do so, Halsin must be first freed in the Worg Pens but left there. Then, after the party agree with Minthara to seize the grove, they must speak with Halsin in the Worg Pens and immediately travel to the Emerald Grove . All this must be done without a long rest. At the Emerald Grove the party must then side with the Tiefling defenders. If the goblin forces are defeated and Minthara is killed or knocked out, then ⁠ Rescue the Druid Halsin , ⁠ Save the First Druid and ⁠ Defeat the Goblins are completed without killing Dror Ragzlin and Gut. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Aid ( )   –   Absolute's Talisman Bolster your allies with toughness and resolve to heal and increase their Hit Points maximum. Range: Self Recharge: Long rest Call for Help Gut calls for help! Recharge: Per combat Healing Word ( ) Healing: 1~4 + modifiers 1d4 + Spellcasting modifier ⁠ Healing Heal a creature you can see. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Heroism ( )   –   Absolute's Warboard Make yourself or a target immune to Frightened and gain 5 Temporary Hit Points each turn. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Recharge: Long rest Shield ( + ) When you are about to be hit by an enemy, use your Reaction to increase your Armour Class by 5. You also take no damage from Magic Missile . These effects last until the start of your next turn. Range: Self Shocking Grasp ( ) Damage: 1~8 1d8 ⁠ Lightning The target cannot use Reactions . This spell has   Advantage on creatures with metal Armour . Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Shield of Faith ( ) Surround a creature with a shimmering field of magic that increases its Armour Class by 2. Range: 18 m (60 ft) The Absolute's Will ( ) Use telekinesis to pull targets closer. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Per turn Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] (If fought in the main room) Booyahg Shekt Devout Mrak Devout Muzul Gribbo Tracker Azak Warlock Greez (If Gut uses Call for Help in her chapel) Booyahg Shekt Devout Mrak Devout Muzul Tracker Azak Tracker Tozad Warlock Greez (If the fight gets too close to them) Erna Lookout Grush Roah Moonglow Torturer Spike Yerle Encounter details [ edit section | visual editor ] Priestess Gut can be fought in one of two locations: in the main hall where the party first meets her or in her private chapel after the party has chosen certain dialogue options. In her chapel, Gut will be completely alone; however, at the start of her turn she Calls for Help to get backup from the other goblins. Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] Gut can be defeated easily in several ways. If the party has high damage and initiative, they can kill Gut before she uses Call for Help . She may attempt to use Shield to survive, but the party can force her to use her reaction on an opportunity attack before they attack her themselves. Alternatively, the party can cast Silence around Gut to prevent her from calling reinforcements. Although She may still flee from the spell's area, the party can group up around her, forcing multiple opportunity attacks if she attempts to leave. Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Technical UID S_GLO_OrinsImpersonation_Smith UUID 2ac966aa-3372-419a-902a-8330925830ef Stats Human_Melee_Strong Eqp. EQP_Hammer_Leather Trs. Gold_Pocket_Wealthy Gyldro Angleiron is a human blacksmith who owns the Rivington General in Rivington . “ If you're a customer, go down to the shop. Otherwise - clear off. „ — Gyldro Angleiron , 'greeting' the player Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Gyldro is busy forging weapons and, if spoken with, directs the party downstairs to Exxvikyap , if they wish to trade. Gyldro Angleiron is one of the potential disguises of Orin the Red . If the party meets Orin as Gyldro, she asks the interacting party member a number of questions about weapons and methods of killing they enjoy. Describing their perfect weapon grants the inspiration ⁠ Dream Big to party members with the Guild Artisan background. After she has left, the real Gyldro runs out of a nearby room and accuses the party of attacking him: Gyldro Angleiron You! Try attacking me when my back isn't turned, you bloody coward! I didn't attack you - I've been out here the whole time. You were attacked by a doppelganger. She was impersonating me. What in the nine Hells are you talking about? Go on. Say that again. Like you really, really mean it... Gyldro complains the party is lying and the player character can respond: Gyldro Angleiron I'm going to knock that smirk right off your face. I'm telling you, it was a doppelganger!  (If told he was attacked by a doppelganger) (begins combat) [PERSUASION]  I know it's hard to believe, but you really were attacked by a doppelganger. (DC 20)  (If told he was attacked by a doppelganger) Brave words for a man harbouring wanted terrorists in his cellar.  (If party saw the Ironhand Gnomes in the cellar) [DECEPTION]  You must have been attacked by my twin. They're a real handful. (DC 20) [INTIMIDATION]  Try it, and you'll be smiling without teeth for the rest of your life. (DC 20) [PERSUASION]  You had a blow to the head. Are you sure you're remembering correctly? (DC 20) [MEDICINE]  Hallucinations. Irrational anger. These are symptoms of a serious head injury. (DC 20) Failing to pass an ability check or otherwise explain that it was not the party turns him hostile. On returning to him later, he is dead, with a letter from Orin saying how disappointed she is that the party did not kill the blacksmith. His corpse is later moved to the Temple of Bhaal . Although presenting as a gruff and melancholy blacksmith, the party can read the diary and notes in his home, across from his smithy, to learn he is an introspective soul, an aspiring artist and is aware something is amiss in the city. If spoken to after meeting with Wulbren Bongle in Angleiron's Cellar , a conversation option presents to learn more about why he agreed to shelter Wulbren and the rest of the Ironhand Gnomes there. Technical UID S_END_LastStandGuard_001 UUID 27ac67d4-2c33-4b87-8cc2-92c2719e52ac Stats END_CityWatchMelee_Human Watchman Gyordi is a member of The Watch in the Upper City in Act Three . He attempts to flee the High Hall's courtyard after it has been overrun by forces belonging to the Absolute . “ City Watch - with me! We'll follow you. To our last breaths. „ — Gyordi Contents 1 Involvement 2 Combat 2.1 Attacks and actions 2.2 Notable loot 3 Notes 4 References Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] During the initial battle for High Hall, a large force of Absolutist cultists coming from the Upper City Sewers destroys the keep and routs the City Watch away from it, forcing what remains of the Watch to flee. [ 1 ] Faced with severe casualties, the last remnants of the Watch are composed of Gyordi, Ebber , Fry , Goodge , Matthew , and Preyn . A Mind Flayer kills Matthew and Preyn as the Watchmen try to flee from High Hall, before being confronted with the party. Gyordi is leading the remaining Watchmen out of the courtyard as he meets the party. If a Mind Flayer (be it the player character, Karlach , The Emperor , or Orpheus ) is present, he is frightened by it. Succeeding a passive DC 20 Insight Check allows for the option of having the remaining Watchmen fight at the party's side. A Mind Flayer player character can convince Gyordi to partake in the ensuing battle as City Watch allies with a DC 18 ability check: [PERSUASION]  I'm not like other mind flayers. I'm here to save you. Fight with me.  (DC 18) [INTIMIDATION]  While the High Hall stands, you've no right to leave. Get back to your duty - fight.  (DC 18) [INTIMIDATION]  Join me in the fight against the brain or I'll turn you into a thrall right now.  (DC 18) [STRENGTH]  If you leave now, the brain will kill you anyway, and turn you into its slaves. You may as well fight with me. For your own salvation.  (DC 18) A non-Mind Flayer must pass a DC 20 ability check to convince them: [PERSUASION]  This mind flayer is not like the others. This one will save you. Fight with us. (DC 20) [DECEPTION]  This mind flayer is my thrall. Fight with us, and we'll defeat the brain together. (DC 20) [INTIMIDATION]  Join us, or I'll set the mind flayer on you. (DC 20) [STRENGTH]  If you leave now, the brain will kill you anyway, and turn you into its slaves. You may as well fight with me. For your own salvation. (DC 20) If the party's Mind Flayer is too far away and dialogue starts with the Watchmen oblivious to it, the insight check instead reveals Gyordi is completely dejected and has given up, but still retains hope that something may happen to tip the odds: [PERSUASION]  It's not too late. Fight with us. For Baldur's Gate. (DC 20) [INTIMIDATION]  While the High Hall stands, you've no right to leave. Get back to your duty - fight. (DC 20) [WISDOM]  If you leave now, the brain will kill you anyway, and turn you into its slaves. Fight with us, for your own salvation. (DC 20) [PALADIN] [PERSUASION]  The fires of adversity forge the most noble heroes. Stand by your city. Stand by your people . (DC 20  ) (non-Vengeance/Oathbreaker) [OATHBREAKER] [PERSUASION]  Oh, you think this is scary? Wait until you see what I do if you leave. That will be scary. (DC 20  ) [VENGEANCE] [PERSUASION]  If you leave now, I will hunt you down as the cowards you are. Your choice. (DC 20  ) [BARD] [PERSUASION]  When legends recall this day - will you be a valiant sentinel or a cowering runaway? (DC 20) [NEUTRAL CLERIC] [GOOD CLERIC] [PERSUASION]  Stay and fight - even if you die here, you will die a martyr. Your soul lauded forever. (DC 20) [NEUTRAL CLERIC] [GOOD CLERIC] [PERSUASION]  Run if you must, it will not help. You will be judged, and your soul will be forfeit. (DC 20) [FIGHTER] [PERSUASION]  You knew the risk when you signed your sword arm to protect this city. Stay.  (DC 20) [MONK] [PERSUASION]  Fear is natural right now. But still your heart, focus your mind. Stay - fight - win.  (DC 20) [RANGER] [PERSUASION]  Never turn your back on a predator you don't understand. Running now won't save you. (DC 20  ) [ROGUE] [INTIMIDATION]  To the victor go the spoils - the Duke said anything you find while fighting, you get to keep. (DC 20) [SORCERER] [INTIMIDATION]  Once I burn these aberrations to dust, I will turn my ire on any who ran on this day. (DC 20) [WARLOCK] [PERSUASION]  Let your patron run their magic through these guards - convince them to stay.  (DC 20  ) [WARLOCK] [ARCANA]  Running would be futile, this is exactly what will happen if illithids take Baldur's Gate... (DC 20  ) If the interacting party member passes any of these checks, Gyordi rallies the rest of the Watchmen, and encourages them to fight with the party during the courtyard battle. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Greatsword Helmet Plate Armour Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Gyordi and the rest of the named Watchmen have identical stats to the Watcher Guardians that can be summoned through the Gather Your Allies action The Watch . Gyordi and the rest of the named Watchmen's armour is similar in appearance to the Breastplate +1 dyed in blue, brown, and black colours, rather than the plate armour specifically designed and seen on the rest of The Watch . Gyordi's breastplate is exclusively coloured black and blue, rather than having brown accents. Gyordi also wears the Scalpspike Helm . Technical UID S_WYR_ScaredLocals_Mother02 UUID 2501fe05-28c3-40b5-9913-ea35dfa274a9 Stats Human_Commoner Ha-yoon Kim is a human mother and resident of Rivington in Act Three . “ The cult could raze this place to the ground and those upper city folks wouldn't even blink. „ — Ha-yoon Kim Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Ha-yoon Kim is talking to fellow mother Monifa Diallo and her daughter Kimmy just outside the well across from the Open Hand Temple . Monifa fears the Steel Watchers will protect the upper classes and leave Rivington’s residents to their own devices. Ha-yoon Kim tries to reassure her that the Steel Watchers or the Flaming Fist will protect them, but Monifa says she is ready to leave. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Monifa Diallo The Absolute's army will be here any day now. Ha-yoon Kim Stop fretting - the Steel Watch will put a stop to them. Monifa Diallo Those machines will form a circle 'round the upper city as soon as the fighting starts, mark my words. We'll be on our own. If Steel Watch Foundry is destroyed: Monifa Diallo The Absolute's army will be here any day now. Ha-yoon Kim Stop fretting - the Fist will stop them. Monifa Diallo They're too busy with their precious patriars. We're on our own. Monifa Diallo I've bags packed for myself and the kids, ready by the door. You should do the same. Kimmy But Mummy, I don't want to leave! Monifa Diallo I know, sweetie, but we'll be safe in the wilds, all right? Ha-yoon Kim The wilds? You throw a fit when there's no hot water - you wouldn't last a day out there! Monifa Diallo It's run or sit on my arse praying! And the gods don't give a damn about us. Ha-yoon Kim Why don't we talk about something else? Did you try that rye bread recipe I gave you? Monifa Diallo Really? The cult is on our doorstep and you want to talk about bread? LOW_Legendary_Incubus_Treasure Variant 1 UID S_LOW_HouseOfHope_Succubus UUID 6060f41a-0d78-471e-89a6-4ef41d46ce6d Stats Incubus Variant 2 UID S_LOW_HouseOfHope_NakedIncubus UUID 490e740d-26f4-4949-bf90-310e1d45b3c3 Stats Incubus Variant 3 UID S_LOW_HouseOfHope_NakedSuccubus UUID 8e3e56d0-3747-488d-baab-6b8a15b18e90 Stats Incubus Variant 4 UID S_LOW_HouseOfHope_IncubusTransformedIntoPlayer UUID c416cf25-0538-48eb-a504-427b98aeaec8 Stats Incubus Archduchess Haarlep In-game Model Haarlep [ 1 ] is an Incubus in the House of Hope . Employed by Raphael to satisfy his desires, they [ 2 ] are in Raphael's personal chambers. Haarlep can be engaged with, in which case they will provide valuable information in exchange for a fiendish sexual encounter. Alternatively, they can be fought, skipping the sexual encounter but losing access to the information. “ I'm a perfect copy. He only ever wants to sleep with himself. What's better than the devil you know, eh? „ — Haarlep Contents 1 Overview 1.1 Background 2 Involvement 2.1 Act Three 3 Combat 3.1 Attacks and actions 3.2 Encounter details 3.3 Allies 3.4 Loot 4 Related literature 5 Companion approval 6 Speak with Dead 7 Quotes 8 Gallery 9 See also 10 Notes and references Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Background [ edit section | visual editor ] Haarlep was sent by Mephistopheles to distract his naughty son Raphael. They serve as the devil's main sexual partner, indulging him in his fantasies. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Haarlep is on Raphael's bed in the House of Hope's boudoir. When approached, they inquire as to what the party is doing. They quickly see through any form of deception, so the interacting party member must be honest or Haarlep becomes irritated and starts a fight. Intrigued, Haarlep offers valuable information on one condition: one of the party members must "play" with them. If the invitation is accepted, Haarlep commands them to undress and lay on the bed. Before continuing, Haarlep asks whether the talking party member prefers their male or female form (responding that it does not matter causes them to move to the feminine form). With the party member on the bed, Haarlep then initiates sex with them. The party member can either surrender to Haarlep or resist via a DC 18 Wisdom Check or DC 18 Performance Check . Even if successful, Haarlep's charm is too much and the party member must choose: surrender or fight. If they choose to fight, Haarlep is disappointed and combat begins. If the party member surrenders, Haarlep continues to have their way with them and attempts to consume their soul. The party member is now presented with a final choice. They can surrender their body, but not their mind, in which case Haarlep continues. Haarlep then invites them to surrender their body one last time: if rejected, a fight ensues. If accepted, Haarlep finishes and assumes the party member's form, adding their likeness to Haarlep's shapeshifting repertoire. As thanks, Haarlep provides Key From Raphael's Safe , letting them know that Raphael's secret safe is behind the painting of himself. Haarlep then departs, informing the party member that from then on, they will periodically be able to feel it when Haarlep sleeps with others using their likeness. Alternatively, the party member may surrender their body and soul, in which case Haarlep consumes their soul, resulting in a game over if the participant is the main character or a permanent death if they are a companion . Finally, the party member may resist via a successful DC 25 Constitution Check , in which case they throw Haarlep off them and begin a fight. If Haarlep is killed, they can be communed with using Speak with Dead , where they reveal that the safe containing the information the party seek is in a safe behind Raphael's "vanity", which is the painting on the leftside of Raphael's bed. The Key From Raphael's Safe can be looted from Haarlep's body to open the safe. Sleeping with Haarlep does not have any negative repercussions on any current romance. However, it locks the party out of gaining the Helldusk Gloves , and potentially gains the party a humorous line at the end of the House of Hope; if the party member asks Haarlep if Raphael is any good in bed, a verbal riposte is available when Raphael asks if the party have any last words. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Claws ( ) Damage: 2~8 + modifiers 2d4 + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Slashing Lash out with deadly claws. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Draining Kiss (Haarlep) ( ) Lay a deadly kiss upon a foe   Charmed by your   Incubus Charm . On a failed save, the target receives   Sumptuously Drained . On a successful save, it receives   Drained . CON Save Range: 9 m (30 ft) Incubus Charm ( ) Magically   Charm a humanoid. An afflicted target can repeat the Saving throw each time they take damage. WIS Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Encounter details [ edit section | visual editor ] Haarlep can be fought by rejecting their invitation to play outright or resisting their advances. If not surprised, silenced or otherwise disabled before being killed, Haarlep summons six Vengeful Imps to assist in the fight. If not summoned by Haarlep, the imps appear when the button to the secret safe is pushed. If battle was initiated by resisting Haarlep after having begun the sexual encounter, the party member who took off their clothes begins the fight without any of their weapons or equipment, having only their underwear equipped. The fight itself is not too daunting, though it can become annoying due to Haarlep's passive ability. When attacked, Haarlep can cast Ethereal Escape as a reaction, allowing them to prevent further damage until the start of their next turn. It can be helpful to inflict a condition on them that prevents reactions (such as dazed, paralysis, or knocking them prone), although Shocking Grasp is ineffective. Alternatively, baiting out an Attack of Opportunity consumes their reaction. Offensively, they use Claws . The imps themselves are not too troublesome as they have low health, however, they continuously cast Eldritch Blast which can push characters off the boudoir's balcony via Repelling Blast . It is best to deal with them quickly via area-of-effect spells and focus on Haarlep later. Characters outside of combat are not revealed if approaching Haarlep under the Ethereal Escape effect, as their line of sight cone is disabled. Narration uses both masculine and neutral pronouns. In-game dialogue refers to them as male and as an incubus, while Wiktoria Kubien, who designed most of Haarlep's appearance and clothing, refers to them as "Incubus/Succubus" and uses neutral pronouns. Game files alternate between masculine and neutral, and there are separate data entries for the male and female form. In Forgotten Realms lore it is not clear if incubi and succubi are separate beings, who can change their sex at will, or if they are two forms of the same being. ↑ Quote source: LOW_HouseOfHope_ROM_Incubus v t e House of Hope Characters Archivist Haarlep Hope Infernal Mason Korrilla Nubaldin Raphael Yurgir Creatures Errant Soul Hell Sphere Spectator Vengeful Boar Vengeful Cambion Vengeful Imp Vengeful Merregon Eternal Debtors Devoured Eternal Rat Immortal Librarian Loyal Mocking Perfect Shameful Smouldering Theologist Unclean Visionary Voyeur Waltzing Locations Hope's Prison Archive Boudoir Chamber of Egress Feast Hall Foyer Quests Acquire the Gauntlets for Helsik Deal with the Devil Free Orpheus Help Kith'rak Voss Save Hope The Githyanki Warrior The Githyanki Warrior (Origin)

Technical UID S_MOO_AssaultFlamingFist_004 UUID eba54058-6cac-467e-9912-a3942eb49a8d Stats MOO_FlamingFist_Human_Melee Fist Hadenwell is a human Flaming Fist in Act Two . He can help the party during the ⁠ Assault on Moonrise Towers . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn , and once the Nightsong has been freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers , Hadenwell, along with the Flaming Fists Helena , Nipawa , Rhed and Ulthred survives the first assault and assists the party in the remaining battle against the Absolute forces. After the battle, provided she survives, she and the remaining Flaming Fists scout the Moonrise Towers Prison and enter a second battle against the Myrkulites Duckie Verish , Sarabayle , and Willinx Jindlebee , as well as a Death Shepherd and a horde of Necromites . The party can assist the Fists in this optional battle. If the Fists survive, they guard the prison until Ketheric Thorm is defeated. After Ketheric Thorm is killed and the party leave for Act Three , Hadenwell disappears from the game entirely. Technical UID S_LOW_BaneiteOfficer10_Leader UUID a2db5bf9-03a9-408e-971f-fc63741308bb Stats Human_Cultist_Bane_BlackGauntlet Hahns Rives is a Black Gauntlet of Bane who oversees the Steel Watch Foundry's underground lab area. He is at X: -1957 Y: 454 . “ "We seek a realm without conflict, without ego, without free will. We seek unity. We seek the Ultimate State." „ — Hahns Rives Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Hahns Rives is the Black Gauntlet of the Foundry Lab Level in the Steel Watch Foundry. He is in charge of overseeing the Foundry's operations, and ordering and controlling the Gondian workers. [ 1 ] Hans was also in charge of sourcing a vessel and pilot, Redhammer , for transporting Gondian hostages to the Iron Throne. [ 2 ] Previously a research facility for the Steel Watchers , the Iron Throne was converted into a prison, mainly to contain the hostages. [ 3 ] With the production of Gortash's Steel Watchers reaching completion, Rives was ordered to begin winding down operations in the Foundry and executing any Gondians who proved difficult. [ 4 ] Hahns also recieved orders from Enver Gortash , which he dispersed to the other Banites , to sweep the Iron Throne and dispose of any leftover technical prototypes and experiment logs. With the Gondian workers no longer needed, they were ordered to dispose of the remaining hostages as well. COL_Barracks_SkullLasher Hairy Henry is a member of the Cult of Myrkul in the sanctum north of the Barracks in the Mind Flayer Colony . “ Heed the Mistress. She is blessed. „ — Hairy Henry Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Henry is being rallied by Kressa Bonedaughter along with his fellow cultists Ironfinger and Maghtew Budj . On approaching, Kressa casts Myrkul's Gift , which gives her and the other cultists 10 temporary hitpoints. Henry attacks along with the other followers in the barracks if combat is initiated through dialogue with Kressa or if he is attacked. If left alone, he moves to his room in the south-western part of the barracks, greeting the party with "Heed the Mistress. She is blessed" and "Walk in shadow" if spoken to. What if my mother finds out? Gods above. „ — Hakeem Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Hakeem and his friends Laila and Embry argue near the entrance of Sharess' Caress . Hakeem is having his birthday, and Embry and Laila, wishing to make him a surprise, arranged for him a visit to the pleasure house. However, the birthday dwarf is not pleased with their idea, worries that his family learn of this disgrace, and tries all means to avoid visiting Sharess' Caress. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Hakeem Do you two have rocks for brains? What were you thinking ? Embry Ah, here - you haven't even gone inside yet! Hakeem I am not going inside a - a - Laila Brothel? Pleasure house? Den of decadent delights? Hakeem Shhh! Not so loud! Laila Look, Sharess' Caress isn't just about wetting your whistle. There's dancing, dinner, drinks... Embry Exactly! 'Pleasure' isn't just physical - it's a state of mind. Hakeem That doesn't make any sense. Embry It will when you've met the drow - they're twins . Hakeem All-Father give me strength... Embry Mate, it's your birthday - you deserve to cut loose! Laila The Librarian does this thing with her whip where you're on all fours, and - Hakeem Lalalalalala! I can't hear you! Laila Don't be such a prude. Technical UID S_END_FlamingFist001 UUID f4ea6aa2-849e-41ac-848b-19fe3cbbc8dd Stats FlamingFist_Human_Melee_Attacker Halfar , named in-game as Dead Flaming Fist , is a Flaming Fist mercenary and cleric of Ilmater that can be found slain on the footsteps leading into High Hall . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Killed by Absolutist forces, Halfar is one of two corpses in the area found at X: 253 Y: 72 which can be spoken to with Speak with Dead , the other one being Lewis Morell . At some time before the party's arrival, Halfar made his way from the Flaming Fist reserve to High Hall in an attempt to rescue potential survivors fleeing from the Absolutist forces . From there, he witnessed the Netherbrain rise into the sky, and found High Hall's courtyard to be swarmed with Absolutist cultists coming from the mountainside. Halfar was then killed by a Mind Flayer before he could get through the gate, dying in front of the courtyard. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Who are you?
