Don't worry - it's not as scary as it seems. „ — Larca Mena , assuming the party are refugees Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Larca Mena and Druggag are discussing the refugee crisis in Baldur's Gate . Since Druggag recently took in refugees from Elturel , Larca Mena is asking how they are faring. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Druggag Never thought I'd end up taking in refugees. Larca Mena It's a good thing you're doing. More than most would do. Druggag I just pictured my own young'uns out on that road, no home, no shelter... It don't bear thinking about. Larca Mena How are your new guests settling in? Druggag Well enough, well enough. Though the city's been a shock to them, after all that time on the road. Larca Mena Must have been a hard walk from Elturel. They'll get used to it. Larca Mena Six children, four adults... it must be a bit of a squeeze. Druggag We manage. They didn't bring much with them, of course - not so much as a rattle for the babe. Larca Mena I can spare some things. Technical UID S_LOW_SWS_AtWall_FF_001 UUID c1e39d70-09f6-4760-8c46-9082ca341909 Stats FlamingFist_Dwarf_Ranger Fist Larche is a dwarven ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist . She can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ As you can see, there's no trouble here, right? And I'm sure you don't want to cause any. „ — Larche Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Larche is patrolling the streets of Lower City with Fist Nephel , Fist Shargil and a Steel Watcher . They can be found near the Stormshore Armoury at X: -44 Y: -101 , guarding Courier Hara , Moorino and Burzenberg , who are being "evaluated" by the Steel Watcher. If spoken to, Nephel asks the player character not to do sudden moves while the automaton is checking the detained civilians. After the Steel Watch Foundry is destroyed, Larche remains at the same place and tries to examine the broken automaton. Unlike Nephel, she is skeptical about it being operational in the near future. After a long rest, she disappears from the game along with her mates and all "evaluated" citizens. WYR_Ironhand_Worker Apprentice Laridda is an enslaved deep gnome who is forced to dig out Nere from the collapsed rubble in the Grymforge . “ I'd tell you to stay safe out there, but I don't think that's an option. „ — Laridda Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Laridda converses with Lunkbug as they toil away, clearing the debris. If the party pass a check, from several options, they can eavesdrop and learn about Philomeen and Runepowder . If Laridda survives Grymforge, she travels alongside Lunkbug , Beldron , and Thulla to Ebonlake Grotto at X: 87 Y: -95 . Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Ironhand Gnomes are freed from Moonrise Towers , Laridda joins them in Angleiron's Cellar . She and Nimble sabotage the Steel Watcher and Flaming Fist checkpoint with a Flashblinder , should the party pick a fight with the soldiers. She can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three . “ You're not being paid to like it. If I were you, I'd focus on my own job, and leave the Steel Watchers to theirs. „ — Larys , reasoning with Serrik Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Larys is standing together with Fist Serrik in the main hallway of the Wyrm's Rock Fortress on the way to the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . She is dismissive about Serrik’s wary feelings on the Steel Watchers , and tells him to pay more attention to his duties than to the automatons' operating around. If spoken to, Larys shoos the player character away, telling them that she is on the watch. Larys is the only tiefling Flaming Fist who can be encountered in the game as a whole. Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Technical UID S_SCL_HarperScout_000 UUID c6dfb2aa-809f-4b3e-8b32-968c10184ec3 Stats SCL_Caravan_Ambusher_Lassandra Eqp. SCL_HarperScout Trs. HAV_Survivor Harper Lassandra leads a small group of Harpers on patrol to the hill east of Last Light Inn during Act Two . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] “ 'Last Light', indeed. Savour it while you can. „ — Lassandra , after arriving at Last Light Inn. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Lassandra can be encountered near the entrance to the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Grymforge lift as part of a Harper expedition, which consists of herself, Karrow , Meygan , and Yonas . Lassandra orders Yonas to move in, but is quickly ambushed and corrupted by a Shadow . If intervening and saving her, Lassandra thanks the party and marks a safe location on their map, known as Last Light Inn . Saving all the harpers (except Yonas) grants the ⁠ Not Another Soul inspiration to party members with the Folk Hero background. Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] At Last Light Inn, Elifer remains distrustful of the party despite Lassandra's attempts to vouch for them. She then remains idle near the entrance to the inn, watching over the bridge from the barricades. After speaking with Jaheira inside the inn, Lassandra moves to the bridge in front of the Last Light Inn with Branthos , Elindale , Manus , and Skywin . They wait for the party so they can intercept and ambush a nearby absolutist convoy and acquire their source of protection against the Shadow Curse . Accepting the mission causes Lassandra and her squad of Harpers casting Light on their weapons and head toward the Ruined Battlefield , where they lay in wait for the Absolutist convoy. The party can go with the group immediately or catch up with them later, as the ambush site is marked on their map. If the party speak with Isobel and triggering the fight with Marcus , Lassandra will have already moved to the bridge, out of reach of the battle. If Isobel is not saved, Lassandra turns into a Shadow-Cursed Undead and is found at a rocky ledge near the docks. Ambush [ edit section | visual editor ] Lassandra, along with Harpers Skywin, Elindale, Branthos, and Manus wait in a run-down shack at the Ruined Battlefield. [ 3 ] Approaching the ambush site starts the cut-scene, with Lassandra telling the party to hide and to be ready to send the signal, before spawning the encounter. Once Kar'niss' convoy arrives, the party can attack immediately or hang back. If they choose to stay hidden and keep watching, Kar'niss kills Vez . From there, the party can either signal the Harpers or wait as they start the encounter themselves. After the fight, a Moonlantern can be found on the drider's corpse. Alternatively, the party can convince Kar'niss to relinquish the Moonlantern and consign the convoy members to their fate as Shadow-Cursed Undead . Either way, Elindale and his squad then depart amiably and return to Last Light Inn. Reaching the Shadow-Cursed Lands through the Rosymorn Monastery Trail starts ⁠ Follow the Convoy instead. The party can turn on the convoy and help the Harpers, or protect the convoy to continue their cover as a True Soul. Lassandra is absent from this ambush, as she has yet to be rescued from her expedition. No matter the resolution, if the party continue to Last Light Inn, they can observe Lassandra returning to the sanctuary with Karrow and Meygan. After Ambush [ edit section | visual editor ] Once the ambush is over, Lassandra and her first group move to a rocky ledge near the Last Light Inn docks, where Lassandra mourns Yonas. Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Lassandra, along with Meygan, Mijah , and Karrow do not join the assault against Absolute forces. She remains at the Last Light Inn to patrol its outskirts, before completely disappearing once Ketheric Thorm is defeated. Technical UID S_LOW_BhaalTemple_HarperCaptain UUID 8600e330-fa15-471e-ab67-958f0543ee9f Stats LOW_HarperConfrontation_Captain Captain Leafsong is a high elven druid and a high-ranking [ 1 ] member of the Harpers in Act Three . He joins Jaheira in the battle against the Dark Urge , should the latter choose to accept and embrace their heritage. “ Greetings, Bhaalspawn. I hoped to see the High Harper walk out those doors with you. „ — Captain Leafsong greeting the Dark Urge . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Temple of Bhaal [ edit section | visual editor ] Should the Dark Urge defeat Orin the Red and embrace Bhaal's gift, becoming the latter's Chosen, the Harpers set up an ambush at the entrance of the Temple of Bhaal , provided Jaheira is alive. Led by Jaheira and accompanied by Minsc (if rescued), the Harpers stand guard on the bridge leading out of the temple, preventing the party from leaving. The party members then have a brief exchange with Jaheira concerning the Dark Urge's role as the Chosen of Bhaal . Should Minsc be present, the party can use his Mind Flayer Tadpole to force him to stab Jaheira in the back. Doing so immediately kills Jaheira, and triggers combat with Minsc, Leafsong, and the rest of the Harpers. [WISDOM]  Ease his confusion. Try to control him.  (DC 25) Alternatively, if the Dark Urge withdraws from Minsc's mind, Jaheira can potentially convince Gale (if under 20 approval), Karlach (if under 40 approval), or Wyll (always) to turn their side, forcing the party to kill them in the ensuing fight with the Harpers. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Hold Person ( + ) Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't Move , Act , or React . Attacks from within 3 m / 10 ft are always Critical Hits . At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Wisdom Saving Throw to end this condition. WIS Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Lesser Restoration ( + ) Cure a creature from Diseased , Poisoned , Paralysis , or Blinded . Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Scimitar Damage: 3~8 1d6 + 2 ⁠ Slashing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Polymorph ( + ) Transform a creature into a harmless sheep. If the sheep's Hit Points drop to 0, the target reverts to its original form with its original Hit Points. WIS Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Sunbeam ( + ) Damage: 6~48 6d8 ⁠ Radiant A beam of brilliant light sears and Blinds all creatures in its path. Until the spell ends, you can recast Sunbeam without expending a spell slot . CON Save Thorn Whip ( ) Damage: 1~6 1d6 ⁠ Piercing Pulls the creature 3 m (10 ft) closer to you. Range: 9 m (30 ft) Wild Shape: Earth Myrmidon ( + 2 ) Take the shape of an Earth Myrmidon. Your earth myrmidon shape has a starting health of 103 hit points that increases every two druid levels. It can cast   Muck to Metal ,   Sludgy Sling , and   Burrow . Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] Jaheira Blaird Freddo Glist Sulian Minsc (if present) Wyll (if present) Gale (if turned) Karlach (if turned) Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Elixir of Universal Resistance Leather Armour Scimitar Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Unlike other Harpers , Leafsong and his nearby Harpers do not conform to their organization's brown and blue colour patterns. Instead, Leafsong, as well as Freddo and Sulian , wear Druid Leather Armour identical to the ones worn by the Circle of the Emerald Grove and their insignias. Leafsong serves as a contingency failsafe for the Harper ambush outside the Temple of Bhaal. He can take the lead in talking with the Dark Urge during the confrontation in the event that either Jaheira or Minsc died in the temple. However, as the confrontation can only be triggered if Jaheira is still alive, there are no natural ways to trigger his dialogue with the party, or the encounter without Jaheira's involvement. Technical UID S_LOW_HeapsideDarkGods_Civilian2 UUID 65668e3e-85ff-42e4-bc29-f51768dde0b8 Stats Human_Commoner Leary Dowse is a human civilian listening to Umbrenne , a prophet of Talona in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ You're good at sorting things out - want to bonk this one on the head and do us all a favour? „ — Leary Dowse Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Leary is behind the Stormshore Tabernacle , and is skeptical of Umbrenne, who is trying to convince her and Grundlgornn that everyone will die soon thanks to Talona, otherwise known as the Mistress of Disease ; she refuses to believe him. Leary's attitude towards the party changes depending on the outcome of ⁠ Stop the Presses . Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Leary Dowse Talona? You want to let Talona loose in our city? Umbrenne Poor, sweet fool - you speak as if the Plague-Crone is not already here, striding among us! Umbrenne Her power waxes, and soon the cycle will reach its zenith - should you want it to or otherwise. Leary Dowse And then what happens? Nothing good, I bet! Umbrenne And then all will perish so the cycle can begin anew! Grundlgornn Dear gods, he's right - it's too late to stop it now! Grundlgornn What do we do? What can we do? Umbrenne Embrace it! Umbrenne The Mistress of Disease loves us all - her fondest wish is to free us from the agonies we have created! Grundlgornn My lungs feel tight! It's happening already! Leary Dowse Oh calm down, would you? It's all in your head. Leary Dowse I've a good mind to get the Flaming Fist before people start chucking themselves into the Chionthar . Umbrenne All the Talontar await her blessings with open arms - and we pity those who would reject her. Umbrenne I will smile as her fevers sear me to my core. I will bask in her febrile radiance. Grundlgornn Oh gods, I don't want to die! Not yet! Leary Dowse You are not going to die. Umbrenne We are all going to die, my friend - some of us merely intend to do so in service of something greater. Technical UID S_LOW_SteepsEvacuation_Mother UUID a50e70b0-972e-4fa0-bf0d-2fe54b11e713 Stats Human_Commoner Leepak Brislen is a human civilian trying to smuggle her family out of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ I hate this! That lousy smuggler won't take all of us because we can't afford four berths. Greedy bastard! „ — Leepak Brislen , on Captain Sleam's business practices Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Leepak is on the Grey Harbour Docks alongside her family, with her husband Dharin Brislen arguing with Captain Sleam over smuggling his family of four out of the city. Unfortunately, the family is short of money, being able to pay only for three places aboard. The party can help the family by convincing Captain Sleam to take them all or by paying her the sum the Brislens are lacking. Helping the family by any means gains approval from Gale , Halsin , Karlach , Shadowheart , and Wyll . Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Captain Sleam You want four berths on the sloop, you pay for all four berths. Dharin Brislen We only have enough for three! We sold everything! Captain Sleam Slipping through the Absolute blockade is risking business. Everybody pays. Leepak Brislen Captain, we have two children, you can't make us split up the family. Captain Sleam The crew and I are risking our lives. We're not doing this for charity. Dharin Brislen Honey, you go with the girls. I'll find another way to Waterdeep. Leepak Brislen What? No! We can't go without you! Dharin Brislen It's the only solution. Trust me. I'll catch up to you. Leepak Brislen You'd better! You'd better catch up to us! Dharin Brislen All right, captain. EQP_WYR_Axe_DG_2 Variant 1 UID WYR_Axe_DoppelgangerShape_04 UUID a635223d-096e-4e3c-8efe-08265ab2eb44 Stats Halfling_Melee Zoll , disguised as Harper Leistine , [ 1 ] [ 2 ] is a Doppelganger posing as a lightfoot halfling member of the Harpers . Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the Mad Rashemaar , Leistine was killed and impersonated some time ago. History [ edit section | visual editor ] Bhaalist Resurgence [ edit section | visual editor ] After rumors of Bhaalist activity surfaced in Baldur's Gate , Jaheira ordered her Harpers to look into the machinations of the Cult of Bhaal, letting them uncover as much information as possible while she led another force of Harpers into the Shadow-Cursed Lands to defeat Ketheric Thorm . However, as Jaheira ordered the Harpers to concentrate their efforts in finding the Rashemaar , Leistine and her cell of Harpers were either killed or captured, only to be brought to Orin . The sole survivor of the Harper cell, a raw recruit by the name of Geraldus , is being used as live bait for Jaheira and the party to contact, in an attempt to ambush and silence them [ 3 ] . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Bhaalist Ambush [ edit section | visual editor ] While in Wyrm's Crossing following ⁠ The High Harper with Jaheira, she points out Danthelon's Dancing Axe , a store run by Entharl Danthelon , and front for a Harper safe house. In a secret room beneath the store, an impersonated Leistine, Chelvin , Leysin , and Thonos wait to ambush Jaheira and the party. Upon the party and Jaheira's arrival, Geraldus attempts to communicate through use of an old Harper code that the Harpers present are traitors . If present in the party, Jaheira understands the code. She mentions the impersonated Chelvin seems familiar and reminds her of Marcus . Failing to recognize the code starts combat with the party Surprised , while recognizing and acting on it surprises the impersonated Harpers. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Morphic Ambush ( ) Undergo a shocking transformation to startle your foes. Successfully   Ambushed entities are more susceptible to your attacks. ## Lenore De Hurst
- **来源**: [Lenore De Hurst](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Lenore_De_Hurst)
- **分类**: Characters

Lenore De Hurst Identity Female Faction Mystra Family Yrre (partner) Hometown Arcane Tower Stats Class Cleric Lenore De Hurst [ 1 ] is a cleric of Mystra who lived in the Arcane Tower , where she researched the magical properties of the Underdark . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite Although Lenore is not encountered in any playthrough, her former home can be visited, and she is referenced by several different characters, books, and item descriptions. The party can also find correspondence she kept with other magic practitioners, including Lorroakan and Yrre . In order to help Omeluum investigate the player character's mind flayer parasite, Blurg directs them to Lenore's tower. Lenore grew several rare and dangerous species of fungi that are needed to learn more about the parasite. On the first and basement floors of the Arcane Tower, the Tongue of Madness and Timmask Spores can be found. History [ edit section | visual editor ] Lenore is a cleric of Mystra who was studying the magical properties of the Underdark. [ 2 ] Lenore and her partner, the gnomish inventor Yrre, lived and worked together for a short time in the Arcane Tower. [ 3 ] After a falling out, Yrre left the Underdark to pursue their obsession with storm magic, [ 4 ] leaving Lenore alone with her research. Lenore remained in the tower, which moved around the Underdark, [ 5 ] with only her pet dog Myrna and her construct Bernard for company. At some point during her stay in the Underdark, Myrna died and was buried in the Dread Hollow. Her grave overlooks the lake and contains her favourite autumncrocus flowers. Lenore later became enamoured with a bulette she found near Myrna's grave, taming it to become a guardian. [ 6 ] Lenore was fond of gardening [ 7 ] and was particularly interested in the antimagic properties of sussur tree bark and flowers. [ 8 ] She used them to control the lighting and turrets in the tower. Lenore also created the tower guardian Bernard, a construct that only responds to poetry and play scripts. She programmed Bernard to remind her that she was loved; however, she grew lonely with no one else for company. In 1481 DR, Lenore had just begun writing her treatise on sussur flowers when she was called to Baldur's Gate to confer with her fellow Mystran clerics. [ 9 ] Before departing the tower, Lenore left a message for Yrre, asking that they await her return with the hope that the two could reunite. [ 10 ] Lenore planned to depart the tower only for a short time. However, she never returned, and her research and tower were untouched for a decade. Yrre eventually visited with The Spellsparkler , a staff they made specially for Lenore, [ 11 ] and Lenore's letter. They waited in vain, but eventually left when she failed to return. Lenore's last known location was her conference in Baldur's Gate, where she was temporarily ensnared by an anomaly caused by Tarquin Related equipment [ edit section | visual editor ] Guiding Light [ 12 ] Staff of Arcane Blessing The Blast Pendant [ 13 ] The Sparkswall [ 14 ] The Spellsparkler [ 15 ] Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] A Query from DeHurst De Hurst's Diary Letter from Amarith Letter to Yrre Treatise on the Antimagic Properties of Sussur Tree Flowers Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Lenore's last name is variously spelled as 'DeHurst' and 'De Hurst' in the game. ↑ De Hurst's Diary by Lenore De Hurst ↑ The Blast Pendant ↑ The Watersparkers ↑ " The southwest, when I last saw her. Although her tower does have a tendency... to move. " - Blurg ↑ Letter from Amarith by Amarith ↑ " She is quite fond of her garden. Lenore has always been a lonely sort - nature was her only companion. - Blurg ↑ Antimagic Properties of Sussur Tree Flowers by Lenore De Hurst ↑ De Hurst's Diary by Lenore De Hurst ↑ Letter to Yrre by Lenore De Hurst ↑ The Spellsparkler ↑ This is one of Lenore's inventions. ↑ Thi is invented by Yrre and inspired by Lenore. ↑ This is co-invented by Yrre and Lenore. ↑ This is a staff Yrre invented for Lenore.

LOW_Journalist Lens is a journalist working for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette during Act Three . “ I'm Lens, roving reporter for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette. My editor's sent me to cover the drama out here at the gate. „ — Lens Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Lens is north of Sword Coast Couriers next to the bridge to Wyrm's Crossing in Rivington . Lens hails the party as they pass and informs them that she is gathering information on the city closing its doors to refugees. She can direct the party to the Baldur's Mouth Gazette to initiate ⁠ Stop the Presses . If the party have not yet encountered Orin twice, she may appear as Lens and ask several questions about their victory over Ketheric Thorm and plans for the Netherbrain. The real Lens' corpse can later be found in the Bhaal Temple . Completing Orin's "interview" grants the following inspiration: ⁠ Press Release ( Noble backgrounds) ⁠ Blabbermouth ( Entertainer backgrounds) ⁠ Free Advertisement ( Guild Artisan backgrounds). These inspirations are not available if the real Lens is present, as an interview is actually conducted. Meeting one of Orin's impersonations for the first time also earns the ⁠ Personal Relations inspiration for party members with the Haunted One background. Technical UID S_LOW_CazadorsPalace_RitualRoom_Spawn_001 UUID 062ff971-d709-4f54-bb03-51c02844eacb Stats Vampire_Spawn Leon Onufrio is a Vampire Spawn enslaved to Cazador . He may appear at Camp or Cazador's Dungeon during Act Three . “ The master said bring you home - so you're coming home. „ — Leon History [ edit section | visual editor ] Leon is one of Cazador's spawn and Astarion's 'siblings'. Before he was a slave, he was a Sorcerer , and is also the father of Victoria . [ 1 ] Cazador forced Leon to bring Victoria to the palace, and ever since he has tried to keep the position of Favoured Spawn so they could stay together in the 'favoured spawn' bedchamber. He organised an escape for Victoria, but she was later brought back to the palace where she was killed by Dalyria . Leon and Victoria's belongings can be found in the favoured spawn bedchamber, including Leon's diary and Victoria's Stuffed Owlbear Toy . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] During act three, Leon may be encountered at camp with three other vampire spawn. They arrive in the dead of night, seeking to bring Astarion home. He and his fellow spawn can be persuaded that Astarion will help them. However, they still are compelled to attack. Failing to defeat them before Astarion reaches one hit point results in them abducting him back to Szarr Palace . Leon then moves to the kennels with Godey . Later on Leon moves to Cazador's Dungeon with the other spawn, suspended and compelled to wait while Cazador completes his ritual. Like the other spawn, he can be spared or killed after the ritual, or be consumed as one of the ritual's sacrifices. Technical UID S_LOW_Client_003 UUID 8d2f44b7-7fa1-4586-a2c8-c49f730a3f2b Stats Dwarf_Commoner Lester Farrower is a dwarven customer of the Sorcerous Sundries shop in the Lower City in Act Three . “ Perhaps you can swap garlic for bloodstaunch? Worst case scenario you just wouldn't stop bleeding. And stink. „ — Lester Farrower Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Lester Farrower and his partner Shuna Huanje are looking at shelves and a table full of alchemical ingredients. He and Shuna are both 'stress buying', as supplies of certain ingredients appear to be running low. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Lester Farrower Gods, the shelves are practically picked bare. Shuna Huanje Some people are so selfish. Lester Farrower Bloodstaunch, jewelweed, mothersleaf - all gone. Typical. Lester Farrower Not everyone can just wave their hands and be healed. Why aren't they rationing anything? Shuna Huanje Gold. It's all about profits, my love. Lester Farrower It certainly is at that - but what'll we do in the meantime? Lester Farrower We really should've planted that herb garden, you know. Shuna Huanje Ah, well, it's too late for that now, isn't it, dear? Shuna Huanje We might have a bit of that catnip decoction left - as long as Lord Pawtash hasn't gotten into it. Lester Farrower I really wish you hadn't called the cat that. It feels a little... improper? Shuna Huanje Impropriety's the least of our worries with that mad cult on our doorstep. Lester Farrower I just think we should be careful what we say in public, is all. Lester Farrower So what do we have? Shuna Huanje Weavemoss... mugwort... incense... Shuna Huanje Six handfuls of assorted mushrooms. You can never have too many mushrooms. Lester Farrower Perhaps we ought to ask what they have in the back? If anything... Shuna Huanje I don't think it'd hurt - they'll probably have even less tomorrow. Lester Farrower Madness. Utter madness. Technical UID S_END_DeadAbsolutist001 UUID 293286c0-b0e6-4657-ab9b-1ddc6a3b93fa Stats MOO_ZealotOfTheAbsolute_Human Lewis Morell , named in-game as Dead Cultist , is an Absolutist cultist and paladin who can be found slain on the steps leading into High Hall. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Killed by remnants of the City Watch , Lewis is one of two corpses in the area found at X: 254 Y: 76 which can be spoken to with Speak with Dead , the other one being Halfar . Lewis Morell was once a worker in Baldur's Gate, but under the impression that the Steel Watch was to potentially replace his job, he was soon brought into the fold of the Cult of the Absolute , either forcibly or of his own volition. [ 1 ] As a cultist within the Absolute army, Lewis Morell was part of a large force assaulting the High Hall from the depths of the Upper City Sewers . During the ensuing battle against the City Watch , the cultists defeated and forced the remnants of the City Watch into fleeing the area, at the cost of high casualties — Lewis Morell included. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Who are you? Dead Cultist Lewis... Morell... loyal servant... of the... Absolute... So you're a cultist? Dead Cultist Lewis... Morell... loyal servant... of the... Absolute... What were you doing here? Dead Cultist Instructed... to raid... the city... Dead Cultist Round up... civilians... thralls... How did you get here? Dead Cultist Sewers [ 2 ] ... underground... unnoticed... How did you die? Dead Cultist Fighting... last of... City Watch... Dead Cultist Felled... on the threshold... of victory... Where were these sewers you came through? Dead Cultist Cliffside... under... tower... nearby... How many more cultists are there? Dead Cultist Many came... few left... men slaughtered... Dead Cultist Illithids... remain... strong... Who were you before you became a slave to the Absolute? Dead Cultist Nobody... Another worker... Another automaton... Dead Cultist Soon to lose... job... to... Steel Watch... Why did you join the Absolute's forces? Dead Cultist Joining... not my... choice... Dead Cultist But I... wanted... to... matter... And in the end, did you find your purpose with the Absolute? Dead Cultist You are... my... purpose... Dead Cultist Your... failure... gives... my death... meaning... Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Halberd Plate Armour Shortbow Notes and References [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ It's not clear as to how Lewis Morell joined the Cult of the Absolute as his dialogue mention both personal motivations to abandon Baldur's Gate, his loyalty to the Absolute, and his hopes that the party fails in their endeavors, but also that his adherence to the cult was nevertheless not by choice. ↑ According to developer's notes, it's likely that Lewis Morell's dialogue was meant to let curious players know that leading a frontal assault into High Hall would be dangerous, and to give them a subtle hint as to the whereabouts of a secret underground passage used by the Absolutists . v t e Upper City Characters Beorn Wunterbrood Cal Civilian Ebber Fry Goodge Gyordi Koll Lia Lorroakan Matthew Miklaur Preyn Robyn Rolan Stalker Svignee Tilly Voss Wrenfrew the Barker Locations Ramazith's Tower High Hall High Hall Courtyard Upper City Sewers Watch Citadel Szarr Palace Quests Confront the Elder Brain

EQP_WYR_Axe_DG_2 Variant 1 UID WYR_Axe_DoppelgangerShape_02 UUID f768841e-ce20-422b-85b1-64a48dbd5046 Stats Elf_Caster Leysin was a wood elven member of the Harpers . Originally on a mission to look into Bhaalist activity in the city and to find the whereabouts of the Mad Rashemaar , she was killed and impersonated by a Doppelganger named Lunn . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] History [ edit section | visual editor ] Bhaalist Resurgence [ edit section | visual editor ] After rumors of Bhaalist activity surfaced in Baldur's Gate , Jaheira ordered her Harpers to look into the machinations of the Cult of Bhaal, letting them uncover as much information as possible while she led another force of Harpers into the Shadow-Cursed Lands to defeat Ketheric Thorm . However, as Jaheira ordered the Harpers to concentrate their efforts in finding the Rashemaar, Leysin and her cell of Harpers were either killed or captured, only to be brought to Orin . The sole survivor of the Harper cell, a raw recruit by the name of Geraldus , is being used as live bait for Jaheira and the party to contact, in an attempt to ambush and silence them [ 3 ] . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Bhaalist Ambush [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: The High Harper While in Wyrm's Crossing with Jaheira, she points out Danthelon's Dancing Axe , a store run by Entharl Danthelon , and front for a Harper safe house. In a secret room beneath the store, an impersonated Leysin, Chelvin , Leistine , and Thonos wait to ambush Jaheira and the party. Upon the party and Jaheira's arrival, Geraldus attempts - through the use of an old Harper code - to communicate that the Harpers present were traitors . Jaheira, if present in the party, understands the code and casually mentions that the impersonated Chelvin seemed familiar, and reminded her of Marcus . Failing to recognize the sign starts combat with the party Surprised , while recognizing the code and acting on it surprises the impersonated Harpers. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Morphic Ambush ( ) Undergo a shocking transformation to startle your foes. Successfully   Ambushed entities are more susceptible to your attacks. Technical UID S_LOW_Elfsong_Exterior_Patron_006 UUID dbb296c5-29e5-454c-bfd1-f555a8eea857 Stats FlamingFist_Human_Melee_Attacker Manip Leythim is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist . He can be found in Lower City during Act Three . “ Have you got bugs in your head? The Fists don't mess with wealthy patriars, they've got the Watch to back them up. „ — Leythim Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Leythim can be found sitting at a table outside The Singing Lute , under its wooden balcony. Upon interacting, he notices the party's equipment and asks to spare him a Potion of Healing . If the speaking party member chooses to inquire deeper, Leythim explains that he was secretly engaged to Henrietta Hhune, daughter of Hurlbut Hhune, a member of a rich patriar family in the city. However, her father bethrothed her to Derque Rillyn, whom Leythim considers "a major arsehole". Leythim tried to see Henrietta again but was turned away by Hurlbut, who threatened him with violence. Leythim expects to be beaten by thugs sent to attack him, hence the pre-emptive need for a healing potion. The player character can suggest Leythim refer to the order quartermaster to provide him a potion, or to ask his fellow Fists to protect him. Manip rejects both propositions, as he does not want to foul his own nest and at the same time means no harm to his beloved. Giving Leythim a healing potion results in approval changes from companions:   -1   +1   +1   +2   +1   -1   +1   -1   -1   +1 Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Sweeping Attack ( + )   –   Dagger Damage Superiority Die Swing your weapon in a rapid, sweeping arc to attack multiple enemies at once. Technical UID S_LOW_Guildhall_FetchersBrat_001 UUID 721084d3-de1a-4213-93db-c7f93cf9d632 Stats Human_Child Li'l Fezmor is a member of Fetcher's Brats within The Guild . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Fezmore can be found inside the Guildhall . She replaces Mol , if Mol did not survive Act One , however she does not act as a trader. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Li'l Fezmor will occassionally chat with Floridor : Floridor Does it always take this long? Nothing went wrong, did it? Li'l Fezmor Please , lady! Strong emotions can mess up the settling of the humours! Floridor I... I guess I don't want the humours messed up, do I? Floridor Hi, it's me again! Just wondering about that recipe. Li'l Fezmor We're working on it, all right? It's got, like, three different viscosities in it. Floridor Very well, very well. I don't want to upset the process. Floridor Is that special recipe ready yet? Just checking. Li'l Fezmor 'Fraid not, saer. We're still gathering the, you know, special fluid. Floridor All right. I'll try to be patient. But he's eager. Floridor Really, I must insist on delivery of my order! Li'l Fezmor Now you've done it! The middle slime layers have inverted. I'm going to have to start over. Floridor Son of a lich! All right, start over, then. Li'l Fezmor will also occassionally chat with Happy Hands : Li'l Fezmor Happy. Another job - just a little light finger-work this time. Happy Hands I did the last one! Li'l Fezmor And lost half the coin on the cobbles. I'm giving you a chance to prove you're not a total dunce. Li'l Fezmor Happy. Thought I slipped you a job? Happy Hands Yes, boss. Just, uh... waiting for the right moment. Li'l Fezmor The right moment is when I told you to do it the first time. Li'l Fezmor Take much longer, Happy, and they'll have to call you Smashed Hands instead. Li'l Fezmor Where'd Happy get to? DEN_Refugee Lia is a tiefling in Act One , who can be encountered in the Emerald Grove arguing with her siblings Cal and Rolan . “ What's the point in blades and spells if we don't bloody use them? We should stay. „ — Lia arguing with Rolan Background [ edit section | visual editor ] Lia, Cal, and Rolan grew up together. While Lia and Cal are biological siblings, all three of them maintain a sibling relationship with each other. Out of the trio, Lia's views on honor and duty differ sharply from those of Rolan, often leading to forceful disagreements with him. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Lia is in the The Hollow of the Emerald Grove , arguing with with Cal and Rolan on whether they should remain in the Grove to help the tiefling refugees or leave. While Cal attempts to mediate, Lia empathizes with her kin, and attempts to convince her brother Rolan to stay and help the tiefling refugees, but he thinks they should leave. The party can convince them to leave or stay. [ 1 ] Convince to stay [ edit section | visual editor ] The following options convince the trio to stay: [ 2 ] [PERSUASION]  You should all stay. A single blade could make a difference. (DC 10) [DRAGONBORN]  Clan is everything. You don't abandon those you swore to protect. [TIEFLING]  Have you forgotten Elturel? We should stand by our people - no one else will. [BARBARIAN]  Only cowards run from a fight. [RANGER]  I'd choose the wilderness over the dangers of a city any day. Stay. [MONK]  To leave is a heavy choice - it will weigh on whatever path you walk next. [PALADIN]  'Where the weak have need, the strong have a duty'. Stay. Convince to leave [ edit section | visual editor ] The following options convince the trio to leave. [ 2 ] Get out while you can - the goblins will be back. [GITHYANKI]  If they cannot fight, they will die. That is as it should be. [EVIL CLERIC]  Why die for those who can't defend themselves? All other options, or deciding not to interact with them causes them to leave on their own as well. If the goblin leaders are killed, Lia takes part in the festivities at the party's Camp alongside Cal and Rolan. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If the trio remain in the Grove and survive through Act One, they are inevitably separated in Act Two . When the tiefling refugees are ambushed, Lia and Cal are captured by cultists and held captive in Moonrise Towers Prison . The remaining tieflings at the Last Light Inn ask the party to ⁠ Rescue the Tieflings . If Lia is not freed from Moonrise Towers before the party deals with the Nightsong , Lia's corpse is in the Oubliette alongside the other prisoners. If the trio decide to leave the Grove in Act One, Lia does not appear in Act Two. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If Lia survives Act Two and Rolan sides with the party against Lorroakan , she moves to the Sorcerous Sundries with Cal after Lorroakan's death. Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] Convincing Cal, Lia and Rolan to stay:   +1   +1 Convincing Cal, Lia and Rolan to leave:   +1 Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Ranged Attack ( )   –   Shortbow Damage: 3~8 1d6 + 2 ⁠ Piercing Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Lia's To-Do List Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Raid the Grove ⁠ Rescue the Tieflings ⁠ Save the Refugees Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Lia, Cal, and Rolan argue about whether to stay in the Grove during Act One: Rolan We don't even know these people! Lia That doesn't matter. Rolan Of course it does. You would choose strangers over us! Lia That's not what I said. Cal Can we stop shouting? No? Cal Calm down! Please . Lia I won't leave them behind! Rolan You're going to get us killed! If Cal, Lia, and Rolan stay in the Grove: Cal Don't be grumpy, Rolan. We'll get to the city soon. Rolan I am not grumpy. Cal The scowl on your face would frighten a troll. Rolan Heh. You're an idiot. Cal How long until Rolan shows off his Thunderwave? Lia Depends. How many people are dumb enough to ask? Cal Hah! True. If Cal, Lia, and Rolan do not stay in the Grove: Cal How long will it take to get to Baldur's Gate? Rolan Depends. How often are you going to ask that? Cal Hey, sis. How long will it take to get to Baldur's Gate? Lia *Sigh.* Rolan We should add the Elfsong Tavern to the list. Lia So long as you're paying. Cal Drinks on Rolan? Count me in. Rolan I swear, I've never met such a pair of cheapskates. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ If Cal, Lia, and Rolan are convinced to remain in the Grove, the party is granted 15 XP. Technical UID S_LOW_FireworksHouse_BaniteGuard02 UUID 2dc8b619-4962-4da9-9ab9-011c2f08133e Stats Human_Cultist_Bane_IronConsul Feloguard Liadan is a Human who can be encountered in the Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate , in Act Three of the game, while following through the quest ⁠ Investigate the Suspicious Toys . “ Any torches, matches, wizards, or other sources of open flame, keep them unlit, please. „ — Liadan Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Feloguard Liadan can be found on the ground floor of Felogyr's Fireworks . She guards the side entrance to the pyrotechnics shop. The term "feloguard" is unique, it cannot be found elsewhere in the game. It corresponds with the name of the establishment. However, Liadan herself has stats and most abilities of another type of Bane followers - an Iron Consul of Bane . As the ⁠ Investigate the Suspicious Toys quest cannot be ultimately resolved in a peaceful way, Liadan joins the fight as soon as she notices any ill commotion, siding with the followers of Bane, who reside on the second floor of the building. She remains at the ground floor and attacks the party along with other Felogyr's employees. Exploration_Minor Liam is a human trapped in the torture rack of the Shattered Sanctum in Act One . “ G-get away! Please, no more! „ — Liam Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Liam is one of the adventurers who accompanied Aradin Beno to the Shattered Sanctum in hopes of finding the Nightsong . According to Remira , Liam was the first to charge the goblins, but the other adventurers thought he was reckless and left him to his fate. Liam is in the Shattered Sanctum being interrogated by Torturer Spike and Grush . The party can show the goblins how to properly torture their prisoner. If successful, Liam reveals the location of the Emerald Grove and Torturer Spike reports the information to Minthara . Doing so grants the ⁠ Grabbing the Poker with Both Hands to party members with the Haunted One background. After the goblins leave, Liam does not believe the party is on his side and claims they could have killed him. The party can attempt to calm him and then ask him about Halsin and his search for the Nightsong. Alternatively, the party can free Liam by killing the goblins or convincing Torturer Spike to leave. If successfully released, Liam flees through a hidden exit in the same room, and party members with the Folk Hero background gain the ⁠ Fate Worse Than Death inspiration. He then moves to the Emerald Grove next to his fellow adventures to rest (if Aradin's adventurers remained in the Emerald Grove and are still alive). BG_Guard Liara Portyr is a high-ranking Blaze [ 1 ] of the Flaming Fist - often answering directly to Duke Ulder Ravengard himself - and the niece of Duke Dillard Portyr . “ Commander Portyr, acting Marshal of the Fist. If you have a crime to report, please wait outside - we are currently at capacity. „ — Liara Portyr History [ edit section | visual editor ] Liara Portyr is a Baldur's Gate patriar from the well-off and influential Portyr patriar family. She was in command of Fort Beluarian in Chult, where she arranged a deal with local pirates that allowed for the safe passage of Baldurian trade vessels, as well as planning the search and acquisition of relics and treasure from the jungle. [ 2 ] During the events of Descent into Avernus , Liara Portyr was recalled to Baldur's Gate, where she served as the acting marshal of the Flaming Fist until Duke Ravengard's return. Gortash eventually planned to make Liara Portyr subservient to the Absolute by infecting her with a Mind Flayer Tadpole , before threatening her uncle, Dillard Portyr, into resigning his seat on the Ducal Council in her favour. [ 3 ] At the same time, Raphael planned to elevate Liara Portyr into the spotlight and reinforce her power through a series of schemes that involved a religious leader, [ 4 ] the Flaming Fist commander of the Seatower of Balduran , [ 5 ] and an unknown individual with a position in the Flaming Fist barracks. [ 6 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Upon entering the main office of the Basilisk Gate Barracks , [ 7 ] Lora Bergauz can be met, futilely attempting to explain to Flame Portyr that her daughter, Vanra , has gone missing. Portyr seems to be having severe short-term memory issues and keeps forgetting what Lora has said only seconds earlier in the conversation. A successful Arcana check reveals her memory has been magically tampered with. Speaking to Lora and Portyr allows the party to start the ⁠ Save Vanra quest. Through progressing the quest to save Vanra, it is revealed that Auntie Ethel has bewitched Portyr to prevent her from investigating Vanra's disappearance. If the party kills Ethel and returns to Portyr, she will appear to have fully recovered save for some headaches and the vague memory of a " Fey -like creature". Epilogue [ edit section | visual editor ] If ⁠ The Blade of Frontiers is completed and Duke Ravengard is dead, and Wyll chooses to ascend politically as the next Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate, Wyll will mention during the epilogue party that Liara Portyr is now Grand Duke of the Wilds, Sickle of Chult. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn , and the Nightsong is freed from her cage to wage war against Ketheric Thorm at Moonrise Towers , Lilineth takes the place of one of the original Harper allies (either Antony , Essius , Lymn , or Naysa ) as a failsafe if one of them is killed before the ⁠ Assault on Moonrise Towers . Speaking with Lilineth has her mention many Harpers lost their lives in the first war against Ketheric Thorm, and that this time she intends on putting an end to him for good. [ 1 ] If Lilineth survives the main battle, she proceeds to guard the first floor of Moonrise Towers with the remaining Harpers. Technical UID S_LOW_FireworksHouse_BaniteWorker01 UUID f6575645-22d7-48e7-bbcc-24dab827e02d Stats LOW_Human_FelogyrFireworks_AlchemichalWorker Limeburn Sphagwood is a human in Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate , in Act Three of the game. He can be encounterd while following through the quest ⁠ Investigate the Suspicious Toys . “ What the - you're not supposed to be here! „ — Limeburn Sphagwood Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Limeburn Sphagwood is on the second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks . He is an assistant of Tomboldt the Pallid , the head of the secret explosives' production that hides behind the veneer of the pyrotechnics shop. Limeburn works in the main laboratory, guarded by Fist of Bane Hyrriet and Fist of Bane Volgu Drak . As the second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks is considered a restricted area, Limeburn Sphagwood, along with other laboratory workers and guards, becomes hostile immediately upon seeing any party member there, or if he is spoken to. Also, he joins the fight as soon as he notices any commotion, siding with other followers of Bane . Technical UID S_WYR_ShoppingDate_Human UUID 41ae6cd6-5934-4a09-93ac-83d45a1365c0 Stats Human_Commoner Limmy is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three . “ You have got to check out Danthelon's Dancing Axe - their leatherwork is 'amazing'. „ — Limmy Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Limmy is outside Danthelon's Dancing Axe . He came to Wyrm's Crossing together with his girlfriend Safyre to purchase him a decent outfit to introduce him to her family at a dinner in a few days. However, Limmy seems to consider himself an adventurer in first place and only after that Safyre's beloved. Instead of clothes, he has already purchased leather armour with fine embroidery, and persuades Safyre to visit The Velveteen Elixir next - to buy a present for her parents (but actually to stock up a few potions for himself). Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Limmy The stitching on this leather armour is sublime . Safyre Yes, darling, it's very... leather-like. Limmy Do you not like it? Safyre Well, we're shopping for a suit . Dinner with my parents, remember? Limmy But this armour was such a bargain - I can't return it! Safyre Let's go to Carm's Garms ! She has the most fabulous cendal - it's perfect for a shirt. Limmy I would - but this armour was... pricey. Safyre You told me the armour was a 'bargain'. Limmy It was! But good armour is hard to find. Maybe I could wear it to dinner with your folks? CRE_Supplies_Gith_NPC Ardent Lin'a'an is a githyanki ardent and member of Inquisitor W'wargaz's retinue in Act One . “ I find an operation runs much more efficiently under... proper observation. „ — Lin'a'an Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Lin'a'an arrived at the Crèche with Inquisitor W’wargaz , who was sent to locate and retrieve the mystical ultimate weapon against ghaik . While the search continues, Lin'a'an accompanies the Crèche guards at the Rosymorn Monastery Basement entrance . When the party enter the Crèche, Warrior Khunaruth and Lin'a'an are arguing about the Inquisition's presence in the area. Lin'a'an scolds the Crèche githyanki for their negligence and lack of results in producing the weapon. Lin'a'an and the other guards become hostile if the party fail to explain their infiltration into the Crèche or if they progress far enough in ⁠ The Githyanki Warrior . Technical UID S_MOO_Kitchen_GnollMaster UUID 627dfc1c-56e1-4e56-9920-56e381e72c53 Stats MOO_GnollMaster Eqp. EQP_HandCrossbow_Leather_Cleaver Trs. MOO_Cultist Linsella is a True Soul who works in the kitchen in Moonrise Towers during Act Two . “ You use a spoon to stir the soup, Barnabus. Forget the axe, my darling. „ — Linsella , instructing Barnabus Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Linsella was gifted by the Absolute the ability to "rewrite the lives of her faithful". Her ability enforces the condition Dominated Will on creatures, and allows her to control them. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Linsella is in the Moonrise Towers kitchen at X: -116 Y: -178 , training 'Barnabus' , with the other gnolls 'Timothy' and 'Tomelia' nearby. She offers to demonstrate her domination over the gnolls by forcing 'Barnabus' to dance or pray, during which his primal rage attempts to rebel against her hold. Sever her control [ edit section | visual editor ] The player character can sever her control, allowing the 'Barnabus' to murder his master: [DARK URGE] [WISDOM]  Compel the gnolls to pulp their master.  (DC 16) [OATH OF THE CROWN] [WISDOM]  This is an abuse of power. Sever her control.  (DC 16) [WISDOM]  Sever her control once and for all.  (DC 16) Successfully doing so rewards the following inspiration: ⁠ Gone Feral ( Urchin background) ⁠ No Strings to Hold Them Back ( Folk Hero background) ⁠ Pied Piper ( Charlatan background) ⁠ Who Let the Gnolls Out ( Haunted One background) If freed from domination, the gnolls attack the party unless another ability check is passed: [PERSUASION]  Easy! I freed you - I'm a friend. (DC 16) [INTIMIDATION]  Try it - I dare you. (DC 16) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  Match it growl for growl. (DC 16) [ILLITHID] [TRUE SOUL] [WISDOM]  Now, now, Barnabus - behave . (DC 2) [RANGER] [ANIMAL HANDLING]  The creature thinks you prey - adjust your body language to display as a threat.' (DC 16  ) The Dark Urge does not need to pass a check to pacify the gnolls because they are recognized by 'Barnabus': "...he grovels with a howl of pining awe..." and offers a few more lines of dialogue. Reinforce her control [ edit section | visual editor ] Alternatively, the player character can reinforce her domination: [DARK URGE]  Put aside dreams of mincing her. Help her take back control. [OATH OF THE CROWN]  Discipline is crucial. Help her assert her authority. Reinforce her efforts with your own. Linsella compliments the player character and rewards them with a Severed Arm , and the following inspiration is gained: ⁠ Danse Macabre ( Entertainer background) ⁠ Pied Piper ( Charlatan background) Do nothing [ edit section | visual editor ] It seems you're not as commanding as you think. If the last option is chosen, 'Barnabus' collapses and dies from the mental strain. Features Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Lionel Brenton is a deceased human commoner in the Graveyard of Baldur's Gate in Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lionel is buried in a rosewood casket at the Lower City graveyard . The casket needs to be dug up from a Dirt Mound at X: -13 Y: 25 . Inside the casket is his corpse, 60 gold pieces and a Grave-dusty Diary . According to the diary he knew he was dying and searched for an appropriate resting place. He always admired the vigil Mortarch Gracie Scyre kept at the graveyard. His tombstone reads L Brenton. Prelate Lir'i'c Chief of Orpheus' Honour Guard In-game Model Portrait Identity Female Voice / Actor Amy McAllister Faction Warriors of the Comet Stats Size Medium Type Humanoid Race Githyanki Archetype Gish'ra (melee) Class Monk Subclass Way of the Open Hand Balanced Explorer Tactician Balanced Difficulty Stats Level 9 HP 136 AC 19 Initiative +5 Proficiency +4 Movement 13.5 m (45 ft) Weight 75 kg (150 lb) Darkvision 0 m (0 ft) XP reward 500 Ability scores STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 14 (+2) 20 (+5) 16 (+3) 15 (+2) 18 (+4) 13 (+1) Saving throws STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA +6 +9 +3 +2 +4 +1 Skills Athletics Acrobatics Perception 2 5 4 Resistances (info) Additional Resources 9 Conditions Astral Gravity Immune to Falling damage and Jump distance is tripled. Features Advanced Unarmoured Movement Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you down and you can Jump an additional 6 m (20 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield . Deflect Missiles Use your reaction to reduce the damage from a ranged weapon attack by 1d10 + your Dexterity Modifier + your monk level. Evasion Successful DEX saves nullify damage; failed DEX saves reduce it by half. Extra Attack Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack. Ki-Empowered Strikes Your unarmed attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming enemies' Resistance and Immunity to non-magical damage. Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike After making an attack with a melee Monk weapon or while unarmed, you can make another unarmed attack as a bonus action. Martial Arts: Deft Strikes Attacks with Monk Weapons and unarmed attacks deal 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage, unless their normal damage is higher. Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks Attacks with Monk weapons and unarmed attacks scale with your Dexterity instead of your Strength if your Dexterity is higher. Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Psionic Empowerment Your attacks deal an extra 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage - the scars of illithid enslavement run deep. Slow Fall When you fall, you can use your reaction to gain Resistance to Falling damage. Stillness of Mind If Charmed or Frightened , automatically cast Stillness of Mind to remove them. Unarmoured Defence Your reflexes are as effective as any armour . While not wearing armour, you add your Wisdom Modifier to your Armour Class . Unarmoured Movement Your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft) while you are not wearing armour or using a shield. Experienced And Deadly The wearer deals additional damage equal to their Wisdom Modifier with unarmed strikes. Technical UID S_INT_GithRoyalGuard02 UUID fd75dc6e-6a8d-4d9d-8cfc-ca4ff5da53d7 Stats INT_Githyanki_Gishra_Lieutenant Prelate Lir'i'c is a githyanki character encountered on the Astral Prism at the start of Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] She is the leader of Orpheus's honour guard. The honour guard clashes with the party when the former attempt to free Orpheus and escape the Astral Prism on the road to Baldur's Gate . Upon approaching, she has gained the upper hand against the Emperor in the fight over Orpheus. Lir'i'c is always hostile and she and the rest of the honor guard must be beaten in order to progress through the game. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Ki Resonation: Blast ( ) Damage: 3~18 3d6 ⁠ Force Detonate the ki of a creature   Resonating with you, hitting the creature and all creatures other than party members and summoned creatures within 5 m / 17 ft of it. The resulting explosion causes any nearby creatures Resonating with you to also detonate. DEX Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Per turn Ki Resonation: Punch ( ) Damage Unarmed ⁠ Bludgeoning Hit a creature with your bare fists, making the ki in its body Resonate with yours. You can then make this ki explode with Ki Resonation: Blast . Technical UID S_WYR_OpenHand_FakeBlackReaver_001 UUID a8de052f-8de1-4309-a26c-16fca9b6fdb9 Stats Human_Commoner Liron Dustclotter is a dead Human whose corpse is in Rivington in Act Three. “ Hells, they're displaying murder victims openly now... „ — Shadowheart , upon exploring the scene Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Liron's corpse is in the cave underneath the Open Hand Temple . Liron was killed by Orin the Red and his body (along with bodies of Benferlaen Plum , Blue Connor Balkosc , Enris Kellem and Penela Lumpensicks ) used as a component of Orin's "art" as an effigy to Illasera , a Bhaalspawn defeated more than a century ago. Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Find Dribbles the Clown ⁠ Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders ⁠ Investigate the Murders Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Within the game files, Liron and his fellows-in-misery are called "Fake Black Reavers". Black Reaver was a common name for the members of Illasera's retinue, accompanying her during the fights. Technical UID S_END_DeadSmuggler UUID a50663a2-2bdf-4465-81ef-84958d498e91 Stats Dragonborn_Melee Listelia Dryselis is a Dragonborn smuggler whose body can be found in the Morphic Pool . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Some of the lore pieces found throughout the area were penned by her before her death, revealing her as a competent smuggler for the Knights of the Shield before perishing to the Absolute . Her sister Droralias' corpse can be found in the same area, behind a locked door at X: -885 Y: 3815 . Returning Droralias' Teddy Bear found on Listelia's corpse to Droralias' corpse, after using Speak with Dead on Listelia's corpse, prompts special banter between party members. Technical UID S_LOW_UnloadingTheBrigg_Dockworker_02 UUID d01f0d0a-3f2f-4c86-8bcb-92a79897bd17 Stats Human_Commoner Listless is a dockworker unloading a boat in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ Blast it, this cargo's heavy as lead, and I've got lumbago issues! „ — Listless Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Listless is on a boat in the Grey Harbour Docks , attempting to unload its cargo together with Kadugan . However, the cargo is extremely heavy and he makes his displeasure known to Bosun Sharley . Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Bosun Sharley Let's get the cargo sorted for unloading. Sprightly, now! Listless Some of these crates are heavier than I feel good. Listless I think by the rules we're entitled to a break. Kadugan He's right. Trust me, I've read the Articles forwards and back. Bosun Sharley When do I get a break from your whining? Bosun Sharley I'd like to get this tub out of here before they tighten the blockade. Kadugan Why not leave the cargo aboard, then? Try for a better price in Waterdeep? Listless That's brilliant, Kadugan! Technical UID S_LOW_BhaalTemple_Reaper_01 UUID 72d472ba-5e32-4922-ab0b-b5a554c6dcab Stats Human_Cultist_Bhaal_Reaper Reaper of Bhaal Liya is a member of the Cult of Bhaal , found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate . “ Well met, Chosen. I smell Orin's blood on you - such a heady perfume. „ — Liya , to the Dark Urge who embraced Bhaal Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] The party can go to the Bhaal Temple in hopes of saving their party member from Orin . There they encounter Orin, who engages the party in combat by transforming into a Slayer . Liya, along with the rest of the reapers, begin channeling a ritual spell Bloody Favour , granting Orin a Boon of Bhaal at the start of every turn. If the player character is not the Dark Urge , and Orin is killed or disabled, Liya ends concentration and attacks the party as normal. If the player character is the Dark Urge and defeats Orin, Liya remains neutral to the party and takes place at the foot of one of the stairs leading to the central altar ground. Her one-liners depend on whether the Dark Urge has embraced or rejected their Bhaalspawn legacy. Liya has a particular interest in the scents and stenches of death and her potential victims. BG_Guard Fist Lochan is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist . She is in Rivington in Act Three . “ Please just go home - you're ruining a perfectly uneventful posting with this nonsense. „ — Lochan , to the group of protesters Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lochan together with Fist Poole , Fist Rowan , Fist Madigan , Fist Varone and Fist Broadhorn , under command of Manip Nestor , guards the goods donated to the benefit of refugees, put into storage inside the Requisitioned Barn . Lochan stands across the front entrance to the barn, and is trying to placate a group of protesters: Saer Grotpoll , Ricks Garven , and Mandii Harvestmoon , who call the Fist to not guard the refugees, but to forfend [ 1 ] the citizens of Baldur's Gate from the refugees. DEN_Refugee Locke is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter in the Emerald Grove in Act One . “ The road to Baldur's Gate looks a little less daunting now that we're all back together. „ — Locke , after reuniting with Arabella Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Locke and his wife Komira are near the entrance of the Sacred Pool , attempting to reach their daughter Arabella , whom Kagha has taken prisoner after her failed attempt to steal the Idol of Silvanus . If the party interact with Locke and Komira, they can offer to speak with Kagha on their behalf. This initiates ⁠ Save Arabella . If the party return Arabella to her parents, Locke and Komira offer Komira's Locket as gratitude. If Arabella dies but Komira, Locke, and Kagha survive, the two of them move to poison Kagha at a celebration . The party can either allow them to poison her or try to convince them otherwise. If the party travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before resolving the Rite of Thorns , the tieflings are expelled from the Grove and Locke's corpse is among the pile of refugees near the bridge to the Blighted Village . Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If Arabella survives into Act Two , she moves to Reithwin Town , where she asks the party to ⁠ Find Arabella's Parents . The corpses of Locke and Komira are in the eastern wing of the children's ward at X: -185 Y: 12 within the House of Healing . Sister Lidwin is tending to their bodies but does not understand they are dead. Passing a Deception or Sleight of Hand check can convince her that her "patients" are cured. Locke's corpse can be communed with using Speak with Dead . He explains that he and Komira ran to the House of Healing after the ambush because they believed it was abandoned. Upon arrival, they were killed by the surgeon sisters. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Unarmed Strike ( ) Damage: 1 1 ⁠ Bludgeoning Hit a target with your bare fists. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Find Arabella's Parents ⁠ Raid the Grove ⁠ Save Arabella ⁠ Save the Refugees Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Locke can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . Who are you? Locke Locke... husband to Komira... father to Arabella... Where is your daughter, Arabella? Locke Ran... into... shadows... How did you die? Locke Surgeon... sisters... Where are you from? Locke Elturel... Why were you in this place? Locke Zevlor... betrayed... ran... shelter... Where is Zevlor now? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. The more the more people like you, the more you can get away with. „ — Lockhorn Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Sister Lockhorn and Lolo Fuzzletoes are near the balcony of Baldur's Mouth considering their prospects for being in the newspaper. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Lolo Fuzzletoes Do you think they might write about me in Baldur's Mouth someday? Sister Lockhorn Only if it's to review that awful fashion disaster you're wearing. Lolo Fuzzletoes Oi! I dress well. For my budget. Sister Lockhorn Perhaps you should start your own opinion column. Lolo Fuzzletoes I could do that! I have loads of opinions! Sister Lockhorn I was joking. You really aren't that interesting. Lolo Fuzzletoes For a moment there, I thought you actually valued me as a person. Lolo Fuzzletoes I need to do something heroic. That'll get their attention. Sister Lockhorn You could start by standing on a ladder. So they can actually see you. Lolo Fuzzletoes Sometimes I wonder why we're even friends. Sister Lockhorn That crier says Lord Gortash is dead! Should we get copies of the latest Mouth? You know, as souvenirs?  (If Enver Gortash is killed) Lolo Fuzzletoes Sod that, I've got a better idea - I bet they'll be doing citizen-on-the-street reaction interviews. Sister Lockhorn You're right! This could be our chance to see our names in the daily broadsheet. Lolo Fuzzletoes Keep your eyes open! DEN_DruidServant Loic is one of the druids at the Emerald Grove during Act One . He is civil to visitors, but wary of guests who overstay their welcome. “ Please leave. Our hospitality has limits - and they were crossed long ago. „ — Loic Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Loic passes his time in the Inner Sanctum , often arguing with Marcoryl about violence as a justification for peace. Their idle banter varies according to the outcomes of ⁠ Investigate Kagha , ⁠ Raid the Grove , and ⁠ Save Arabella . If the party persuade Kagha to turn against the shadow druids, Loic becomes an ally in the subsequent fight (and afterwards, moves to the servants quarter). However, if they fail to persuade Kagha to redeem herself, Loic becomes hostile and fights against the party alongside the Shadow Druids and Kagha. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Club Damage: 3~6 1d4 + 2 ⁠ Bludgeoning Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Club Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Marcoryl Ridiculous. We just let her run off!  (If Kagha spares Arabella ) Loic She's a child. Marcoryl A devil child. One who tried to steal from us. Loic Yet she failed - that's what matters. Loic This will all be over, the ritual is almost finished. Marcoryl What if they try to steal from us? Again? Loic We've shown them once - we take grove law seriously. Marcoryl By letting that child escape without consequence? We might as well have lain down on the ground and let them trample over us. Loic I don't want blood on my hands. Marcoryl We have the right to defend our home. Loic So that's what you want? To kill innocents? Marcoryl I don't want to kill anyone. But I won't let the grove be harmed - not again. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Despite being nominally a druid , Loic is in all gameplay measures a fighter . As the only druid of the Emerald Grove with the fighter class, it is likely this is an oversight dating all the way back to Early Access ; before the addition of druid as a class, the druids of the grove were either fighters or wizards . v t e Emerald Grove Characters Adventurers Aradin Barth Liam Remira Animals Bored Ox Bosk Corinna Hungry Ox Ormn Silver Spar Timber Tingmiaq Topaz Tuffet Tusk Wounded Bird Druids Aelar Apikusis Elwyn Findal Inwe Jeorna Kagha Karrik Loic Maggran Marcoryl Mino Nettie Rath Tahan Goblins Gresh Gurza Sazza Torrack Worm Za'krug Tiefling Refugees Alfira Amek Arka Asharak Bex Cal Cerys Chell Danis Elegis Eramas Gerson Guex Ikaron Kaldani Kanon Kivak Komira Lakrissa Lia Locke Memnos Nadira Okta Pandirna Rechel Rhy Rikka Rolan Tilses Toron Vatas Xeph Zae Zevlor Zorru Children Arabella Doni Gan Ide Meli Mirkon Silfy Umi Zaki Traders Arron Auntie Ethel Dammon Mattis Mol Volo Other Bugbear Assassin Strange Ox Locations Inner Sanctum Sacred Pool Secluded Cove The Hollow Tiefling Hideout Underground Passage Quests Daughter of Darkness Defeat the Goblins Find Doni Find Your Belongings Forging a Heart Get Help from Healer Nettie Investigate Kagha Investigate the Beach Kill Kagha Raid the Grove Rescue the Druid Halsin Return the Locket Save Arabella Save the First Druid Save the Goblin Sazza Save the Refugees Steal the Sacred Idol The Hellion's Heart

Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Lolo Fuzzletoes Do you think they might write about me in Baldur's Mouth someday? Sister Lockhorn Only if it's to review that awful fashion disaster you're wearing. Lolo Fuzzletoes Oi! I dress well. For my budget. Sister Lockhorn Perhaps you should start your own opinion column. Lolo Fuzzletoes I could do that! I have loads of opinions! Sister Lockhorn I was joking. You really aren't that interesting. Lolo Fuzzletoes For a moment there, I thought you actually valued me as a person. Lolo Fuzzletoes I need to do something heroic. That'll get their attention. Sister Lockhorn You could start by standing on a ladder. So they can actually see you. Lolo Fuzzletoes Sometimes I wonder why we're even friends. Sister Lockhorn That crier says Lord Gortash is dead! Should we get copies of the latest Mouth? You know, as souvenirs?  (If Enver Gortash is killed) Lolo Fuzzletoes Sod that, I've got a better idea - I bet they'll be doing citizen-on-the-street reaction interviews. Sister Lockhorn You're right! This could be our chance to see our names in the daily broadsheet. Lolo Fuzzletoes Keep your eyes open! GOB_Goblin_Generic Sharp-Eye Lora is a goblin in the Shadow-Cursed Lands in Act Two . “ I miss the camp. It's too quiet out here. „ — Lora (goblin) Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Lora greets the party immediately upon entering the Shadow-Cursed Lands from Rosymorn Monastery Trail , treating them as True Souls . If they play along, the party can talk to Kar'niss and arrange safe travel to Moonrise Towers , where she and her fellow goblins accompany them. If she survives the Harper ambush or the party do not encounter her, she journeys to Moonrise Towers and is with Brawler Vez and Warrior Gronag west of the throne room. Technical UID S_LOW_BlushingMermaid_MissingKidsMother UUID 58ece4ba-e097-4b3b-ac71-7abe8706d3a8 Stats LOW_Lora Lora , also known as Lora Bergauz , [ 2 ] is a human in Baldur's Gate , initially found during Act Three inside the Basilisk Gate Barracks . She is the mother of Vanra . Speaking to her can initiate the quest ⁠ Save Vanra . “ How many times do I need to say it? You sent word about a lead - said that I should come see you about it. „ — Lora Bergauz Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Save Vanra If spoken to at the Basilisk Gate Barracks , she provides the player character with the quest Save Vanra . If choosing options that assert the party's wish to help Lora, she provides details that they can use to start their investigation, then departs from the barracks. If agreeing to save Vanra, and having spoken with Captain Grisly about her side of the story, an option is unlocked to ask Lora about the details given by Captain Grisly in her home southwest of the Lower City Central Waypoint at X: -57 Y: -93 . Captain Grisly asks the party to kill Lora for 3000 gp. Rogues can ask for double the amount and Grisly agres. Killing Lora grants the agreed upon money as well as Veil of the Weird during ⁠ Gather Your Allies . If Vanra is successfully saved and Lora is spoken with in her home again, she grants Duellist's Prerogative and Amulet of Windrider . All of this only occurs if Ethel was denied access to Mayrina in Act One . Otherwise, Lora and Vanra can be found at their house in the Lower City and have little to say other than berating the party for barging into their home. Technical UID S_WYR_WyrmRock_MessHallBodyguard_002 UUID 214fd102-81e0-4492-8bef-389c66dcd7dc Stats WYR_MessHallBodyguard_02 Lord Amber's Bodyguard is a half-elven monk who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three . “ Hells' hallows - the ceremony's gone on for days, seems like. „ — Lord Amber's Bodyguard Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lord Amber's Bodyguard can be found at the mess hall, at the first floor of the Wyrm's Rock Fortress. He came with his master, Lord Petric Amber , and while waiting for his lord to descend from Audience Hall, spends time chatting with retinue members of other patriars. If spoken to for the first time, he discusses the Steel Watch with Lord Shattershield's Attendant and Lady Durinbold's Attendant , and the three ask the party's opinion on these automatons. He doubts other two's surety in usefulness of the constructs, explaining the unease he feels while close to them. If spoken to afterwards, he complains that the ceremony is still going on, as it has been for several days now. If confronting Gortash, Lord Amber's Bodyguard can be found along with all other invited guests and their retinue slaughtered in the Audience hall. BGO_Supplies_Poor Lord Jannath's Bodyguard is a human barbarian who accompanies her master to the ceremony of ordaining Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lord Jannath's Bodyguard is in the mess hall, on the first floor of Wyrm's Rock Fortress. She came with her master, Lord Raylen Jannath , and while waiting for her lord to descend from Audience Hall, spends time walking back and forth in the mess hall. If spoken to, she shoos the party away, telling them she is on duty and might be called by her master any moment. If the party confront Gortash, Lord Jannath's Bodyguard's corpse is with all the other invited guests and their retinue, slaughtered in the Audience hall. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Enraged Throw ( )   –   Javelin +1 Damage: 7~12 1d6 + 6 ⁠ Piercing Pick up an item or creature and throw it at a target, dealing additional damage and knocking it Prone . Your Strength affects the additional damage and how much weight you can throw. Heavier items deal more damage. The damage of weapons with the Thrown property is the same as the weapon's melee damage. You also deal additional damage based on your Strength . Available only when Frenzied . Range: 18 m (60 ft) Frenzied Strike ( )   –   Trident +1 Damage: 7~12 1d6 + 6 ⁠ Piercing As a bonus action, make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Will cause a stack of Frenzied Strain on the barbarian. Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Per turn Frenzy ( + ) Your Rage turns into a frenzy! You gain Frenzied Strike and Enraged Throw . You can also make an Improvised Melee Weapon attack as a bonus action. Deal 2 extra damage with melee and improvised weapons, and throwing. Gain Resistance to physical damage, and Advantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws . Range: Self Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Trident +1 Damage: 7~12 1d6 + 6 ⁠ Piercing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Reckless Attack ( )   –   Trident +1 Damage: 7~12 1d6 + 6 ⁠ Piercing Throw all caution in the wind to gain Advantage on your melee Attack Roll . Until your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls, but enemies also have advantage on attack rolls against you. If confronting Gortash, Lord Portyr's Attendant can be found along with all other invited guests and their retinue slaughtered in the Audience hall. Technical UID S_WYR_WyrmRock_MessHallBodyguard_004 UUID 80511a28-308f-486c-ac56-2c84e1c36f91 Stats WYR_MessHallBodyguard_04 Lord Portyr's Bodyguard is a half-elven ranger who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three . He came with his master, Duke Dillard Portyr , and while waiting for his lord to descend from Audience Hall, spends time with retinue members of other patriars. Technical UID S_WYR_WyrmRock_MessHallBodyguard_008 UUID c183baeb-2677-4340-8896-eccfb3ff2952 Stats WYR_MessHallBodyguard_08 Lord Shattershield's Attendant is a rock gnome ranger who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lord Shattershield's Attendant can be found at the mess hall, at the first floor of the Wyrm's Rock Fortress . He came with his master, Lord Rugger Shattershield , and while waiting for his lord to descend from Audience Hall, spends time chatting with retinue members of other patriars. First time spoken to, he is discussing the Steel Watch with Lady Durinbold's Attendant and Lord Amber's Bodyguard , and the three ask the party's opinion on these automatons. He considers constructs a true miracle of engineering, and agrees with his lord's (and, by extension, Gortash's) opinion that the outsiders shouldn't be let in the city. If spoken to afterwards, he calls himself a true Baldurian - born, bred and raised. If confronting Gortash, Lord Shattershield's Attendant can be found along with all other invited guests and their retinue slaughtered in the Audience hall.
