Technical UID S_WYR_WyrmRock_MessHallBodyguard_001 UUID 2c553951-81ba-472e-98e3-7e688116c8c0 Stats WYR_MessHallBodyguard_01 Lord Shattershield's Bodyguard is a halfling wizard who accompanies his master to the ceremony of ordaining Enver Gortash as an Archduke of Baldur's Gate in Act Three . “ Lord, archduke, god - I'll call Gortash what he wants, long as Lord Shattershield pays me for all this waiting around. „ — Lord Shattershield's Bodyguard Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lord Shattershield's Bodyguard is at the mess hall, on the first floor of the Wyrm's Rock Fortress . He came with his master, Lord Rugger Shattershield , and while waiting for his lord to descend from Audience Hall, spends time with the retinue of other patriars. If spoken to, he says that a bodyguard's job is a good work if one can find it. He tells the interacting party member that he would call Gortash whatever his master wants, as long as he is paid. He also tells the party not to tangle with him, because he might be small, but is able to fight back. If the party confront Gortash, Lord Shattershield's Bodyguard moves to the Audience Hall and is slaughtered along with all other invited guests and their retinue. Technical UID S_LOW_KeepingAppearances_Lord UUID 70527469-61d6-483c-87ff-5b26b72542d2 Stats Human_Commoner Lord Whitburn is an unnamed member of the Whitburn patriar family chatting with Lady Whitburn outside The Glitter Gala in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ Good day! What could be more pleasant than spending one's inheritance? Though I don't imagine you would know. „ — Lord Whitburn Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] When spoken with, Lord Whitburn comments on how it is a pleasant day to spend their inheritance. He also regularly talks to Lady Whitburn about new clothes and diamonds as if the events of the city do not matter to them like they do for the rest of the citizens of Baldur's Gate. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Lord Whitburn has idle banter with Lady Whitburn: Lord Whitburn This neighbourhood isn't what it used to be. Lady Whitburn What is, dear? What is? Lord Whitburn You , darling! You're just as rich as the day I married you. Lady Whitburn No Lower City house can compare to our mansion next to the High Hall. Lord Whitburn Right! Safest place in the city, too. Lady Whitburn It was so clever of your grandparents to build there. Lady Whitburn Refugees. What a dreadful existence. Lord Whitburn We could take a few in. Our mansion's big enough. Lady Whitburn Oh, you are the funny one! Lady Whitburn Darling, did you hear that crier from Baldur's Mouth? Lord Gortash is dead! Lord Whitburn Lord Gortash, dead! Do you know what that means, sweetness? Lady Whitburn A state funeral! And we're sure to be invited. I'll need new clothes! Lord Whitburn You always look smashing in black, dear. Wear your diamonds. LOW_CountingHouse_Guard Cashguard Artillerist Loretta is a human member of the Cashguard in the high security vaults area, on the lowest floor of the Counting House , in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . “ Hells, if I'd have known there was that much coin back here, I'd have robbed the place myself. „ — Loretta Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] When the party enters the high security vaults, Minsc reveals himself and a fight breaks out between members of the Cult of Bhaal and the Counting House staff. Loretta allies with the party alongside the rest of the Cashguard and Rakath Glitterbeard . Features Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Technical UID S_WYR_OpenHand_Lorgan UUID 75fd6462-4d79-4d36-8fdc-fbdd124f5722 Stats WYR_OpenHandTemple_Human_Cleric Trs. WYR_OpenHand_Priest Father Lorgan was a cleric of Ilmater and a priest of the Open Hand Temple . His corpse is in Rivington during Act Three . “ I pen this from the temple cellar - the only place I feel close to the Ilmater's will anymore. I pass my gaze between the crests that hide my sin apparent, and I wonder: Who are they to pass any judgement? They bark that those who arrive on our doorstep - bloodied, beaten, fleeing from heretical hordes - are dirty, unwelcome, to be shunned. That it is a crime to house them, to bring them into the city proper - but if my back must be broken so others may step to the light, so be it. „ — Confessions, Vol. 1, Father Lorgan Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] If one or more party members approach the Open Hand Temple, they learn that its priest was cruelly murdered. The temple's second-in-charge, Sister Yannis , is arguing with Investigator Valeria about the murder suspect. Valeria is convinced that Lorgan was killed by the refugee Brilgor , but Yannis disagrees. After Valeria leaves, Yannis asks the party to conduct a more thorough investigation, and informs them that the accused Brilgor was found dead alongside Lorgan. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Father Lorgan's corpse is in the temple's infirmary at X: -59 Y: -23 . The only thing which can be looted from it is Lorgan's Chest Key . If communed with using Speak with Dead , Father Lorgan reveals that he attempted to help the refugees in accordance with Ilmater's teachings, but he hid many of his actions because he knew many others in the temple would disapprove (such as Brother Bill ). Lorgan reveals that he was killed while hiding Brilgor from Flaming Fist guards in the caves beneath the temple. His murderer was a dwarf dressed in red, who used a paralytic poison on him. Brilgor's corpse can corroborate the murderer's physical description. If the party interrogates a dead doppelganger in the caves, the corpse confirms this description and names the killer as Dolor . Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Lorgan's chest key is on his corpse, and unlocks one of the chests in the temple's dormitories at X: -91 Y: -1 . Upon opening the chest and passing a DC 10 Investigation Check , a false bottom in the chest is revealed to contain Lorgan's personal diary, Confessions, Vol. 1, Father Lorgan . Diary entries show that Lorgan's faith remained steadfast. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Father Lorgan's corpse can be communed with using Speak with Dead . Who are you? Father Lorgan Lorgan... Reverend... Open Hand... Who killed you? Father Lorgan Dwarf... dressed in red... Why did he kill you? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.* What were you doing when you died? Father Lorgan Hiding Brilgor... from Fists... Why were you hiding Brilgor? Father Lorgan Must protect... innocents... Ilmater's will Where did you hide him? Father Lorgan Took him to tunnels... with the rest... fool... fool... How did you die? Father Lorgan A poisoned blade... paralysis... Where were you attacked? Father Lorgan Tunnels from the cellar... refuge... Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Address Book Confessions, Vol. 1, Father Lorgan Meditations, Vol. 1, Father Lorgan On the Weary, Vol. 1, Father Lorgan Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Corpses of other refugees who probably received Father Lorgan's aid are deeper in the caves (above the cragged rock near ritual murder scene). If he is spoken with again after killing Auntie Ethel, Lorin remembers seeing the party member as a Mind Flayer and runs away. If a party member does not speak to him before killing Auntie Ethel, he is more reasonable, yet still scared. Technical UID S_LOW_VampireBoyfriend_Lady UUID 18c2525c-e9dd-4e48-881f-29a9657c5075 Stats HalfElf_Commoner Lorna Esthelian is a character in the Lower City Sewers that can be found in Act Three . “ You haven't seen him, have you? Pale, skinny - extremely piercing eyes. „ — Lorna Esthelian , describing her missing date Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lorna has been lured by a vampire to this area expecting to attend an 'underground party'. They met the night before in The Blushing Mermaid . A party member can engage her in conversation, wherein she describes her date. Passing a DC 10 Insight Check check reveals the date to be a vampire. If Astarion is the one talking to her, she says that her date looks a bit like him. Either way, the interacting party member can inform her of her date's likely nature. No matter which dialogue choices are made, in the end she decides to "give this party a miss" and departs. ## Lorroakan
- **来源**: [Lorroakan](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Lorroakan)
- **分类**: Characters、Bosses

Overview Combat Lorroakan Identity Male Voice / Actor Joshua B. Sklar Hometown Ramazith's Tower , Baldur's Gate , Athkatla Stats Size Medium Type Humanoid Race Human Class Wizard Subclass Evocation School Technical UID S_LOW_Lorroakan UUID a9d4b71d-b0ef-429e-8210-6dc8be986ee9 Stats LOW_RamazithsTower_Lorroakan Lorroakan is the human proprietor of Sorcerous Sundries , in Act 3 of Baldur's Gate 3 . He is in Ramazith's Tower , after traveling there from Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . He is searching for something called the Nightsong, and offers a large reward for finding it. “ Witness me - immortal, until the end of all days. „ — Lorroakan , after imprisoning Dame Aylin Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act One 1.2 Act Three 1.2.1 Helping the Nightsong 1.2.2 Helping Lorroakan 2 Combat 2.1 Notable loot 3 Speak with Dead 4 Related literature 5 Related quests 6 Quotes 7 Gallery 8 Notes 9 References 10 External links Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Lorroakan is first mentioned by Aradin Beno in Act One , whom the party meets outside of the Druid Grove . Aradin tells the party about a huge sum of money offered by a wizard in exchange for retrieving a treasure called the Nightsong . This starts ⁠ Find the Nightsong . He is also mentioned by Rolan , who is especially proud that Lorroakan has accepted him as his student; this being his primary reason for travelling to Baldur's Gate. Gale , however, notes he has heard that Lorroakan is a bit of a cad. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Arriving in the city of Baldur's Gate in Act Three, Lorroakan can be met to find out what he wants with the Nightsong. Manning the till at Sorcerous Sundries , the party can meet Rolan with a bloodied face. A successful Insight check reveals that, despite his cheerful tone, there is something wrong. If he is asked about the Nightsong, Rolan divulges that many people have come to claim Lorroakan's bounty to no avail. He also warns them about Lorroakan's temper if they plan on bringing him information about the Nightsong. Upon heading upstairs, the party is greeted by Lorroakan's Projection . There are four portals, one of which is the correct one to transport the party to him. Using the far left pale blue portal, with the plaque that reads "The Nightsong is an immortal being, the child of a deity" , teleports the party to Ramazith's Tower in the Upper City where Lorroakan is using his assistant Miklaur as target practice for his Animated Armour , Krank . Noticing the party, he questions them on whereabouts of the Nightsong. Unbeknownst to the party, Lorroakan has been in contact with Ketheric Thorm and Balthazar and has been searching for the Nightsong, who already has been revealed to the party to be Dame Aylin, to grant himself the very same immortality Ketheric had. [ 1 ] The party can answer truthfully as to the whereabouts of Aylin and succeed various Ability Checks to deceive him into believing that she has been killed. If Aylin is at camp and is later informed of Lorrokan's intentions, she angrily departs for Ramazith's Tower to confront him, despite Isobel's efforts to stop her. Alternatively, if Lorroakan is successfully deceived, and Aylin is as well, there is no confrontation. Helping the Nightsong [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party side with Aylin, Lorroakan is joined in battle by one of each elemental type of Myrmidon , all able to Fly at will. The Earth Myrmidon can cast Stoneskin on him, and each myrmidon unlocks one spell slot for him until defeated. Miklaur and Krank also join the fray against the party. Lorroakan's death brings an end to the hunt for Aylin. The party gain the following inspiration: ⁠ Never To Be Chained Again ( Folk Hero backgrounds) ⁠ How High They Fall ( Haunted One backgrounds) ⁠ Stopping the Repetition of History ( Sage backgrounds) If his family was saved during Act Two, Rolan takes over as proprietor of Sorcerous Sundries and promises aid for ⁠ Gather Your Allies , granting Rolan's Firestorm during the final battle. If they were not saved, he fights alongside Lorroakan. Helping Lorroakan [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party side with Lorroakan, Aylin becomes hostile, summoning four Moonlight Silvers to her aid. If defeated, Lorroakan jails Aylin in another soul cage , finally obtaining his long sought-for immortality. Lorroakan rewards the party with 5000 gold and lends his aid for ⁠ Gather Your Allies , granting Lorroakan's Firestorm during the final battle (an identical Class Action to Rolan's). The inspiration ⁠ The Karsus of Our Times is also granted to party members with the Sage background. In the High Hall , Lorroakan appears with the Invulnerability condition, granting him Immunity to all damage types. If the party return to Isobel and inform her of Aylin's recapture, but deceive her as to their betrayal, Isobel rushes to Ramazith's Tower to confront Lorroakan herself. If the party travel there after this, only her corpse is found, having been killed by Lorroakan off-screen. Having witnessed the death of her lover, Aylin reels where she stands, imprisoned and horrified, and vows to murder the player character (and their descendants) upon her escape. Lorroakan himself makes no mention of the fight. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Lorroakan/Combat Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Despair of Athkatla Shelter of Athkatla Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Lorroakan can be spoken to through the use of Speak with Dead . How did you become the owner of this place? Lorroakan Ramazith... gone... Open for the taking... Who is Ramazith? Lorroakan Powerful mage... spell-maker... Where did Ramazith go? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.* How did you learn to imprison the Nightsong? Lorroakan Ramazith's notes... Balthazar's magic... Who is more powerful, you or your apprentice? Narrator *The corpse pauses, perhaps resisting the truth.* Lorroakan That... bloody... tiefling... Where do you store your valuables? Lorroakan Lower floor... magic repository... vault key... Any security measures I should be aware of in your repository? Lorroakan Traps... spells... deathly to the touch... How do I avoid the traps? Lorroakan All magic... can be... dispelled... But you say he's an accomplished wizard? „ — Gale on the great wizard Lorroakan Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Lorroakan promotional screenshot. Renders by Alena Dubrovina Full body renders by Levinna Angelita Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Lorroakan's myrmidons have weaker weapons compared to other myrmidons encountered throughout the game. They do not have innate elemental damage components and are not enchanted . The unique weapon abilities are not changed. Lorroakan first appeared in the Murder in Baldur's Gate adventure for the 5th Edition Dungeons & Dragons as well as Baldur's Gate: Descent into Avernus . In D&D 5e, he is the current owner of Ramazith's Tower in the Upper City while Sorcerous Sundries belonges to another wizard, Rivalen Blackhand . Lorroakan is broke and has an ever-pressing need for money, and he desperately wants to learn the late wizard Ramazith's secrets of wealth that lie beneath his tower. Lorroakan is eager to hire some adventurers to do it for him. It is possible that, when the Upper City was scrapped early in development, Larian had to move Lorroakan and his storyline to Sorcerous Sundries, making him a wealthy proprietor of both buildings. It is also possible that Sorcerous Vault was initally designed to be Ramazith's Vault as it has tower-like features. The door in the Sorcerous Vault which leads to the Archmage hub is titled "Ramazith". If Gale is brought along to meet Lorroakan while proceeding with his quest The Wizard of Waterdeep , the two will bicker over the artifacts they each desire: the Nightsong and the Crown of Karsus . As of Patch #7 , Lorroakan no longer has Opportunity Attack . Technical UID S_LOW_LorroakanProjection UUID 7929fdf5-73f4-43e4-9375-13c965685af2 Stats LOW_RamazithsTower_Projection Variant 1 UID S_LOW_LorroakanProjection_PuzzleGuardian_Punisher UUID ae4c07db-c5c3-4b83-9fb4-23854dda14c5 Stats LOW_RamazithsTower_PuzzleGuardian_Punisher Variant 2 UID S_LOW_LorroakanProjection_PuzzleGuardian UUID c65a2e91-34f1-4dd9-a784-2aca5a4d9cd2 Stats LOW_RamazithsTower_PuzzleGuardian Lorroakan's Projection is a programmed facsimile of Lorroakan that manages the front desk at the Sorcerous Sundries . “ It has come to my attention that there is a BITTER ADVENTURER located OUTSIDE the shop! Not to worry. We will quickly handle this disturbance for your comfort and safety. „ — Lorroakan's Projection if Aradin is outside Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Lorroakan's Projection serves guests by providing them information about the Nightsong , Lorroakan , trading, and even tax collection. Since it is a projected image, it cannot be targeted or attacked. The projection is only present if either Rolan or Lorroakan is dead, or if they are both upstairs being confronted by Aylin. If Rolan is alive, he takes the place of the projection while Lorroakan remains alive. After Lorroakan has been killed, the projection appears, selling scrolls only. Rolan then takes up residence in Ramazith's Tower , but does not act as a merchant - his magical items must be pickpocketed or looted from his body. Notable Items Sold [ edit section | visual editor ] Some items listed may not be available on every merchant restock. Corresponds to LOW_SorcerousSundries_Trade_Magic . Equipment [ edit section | visual editor ] Armour of Landfall Birthright Harper Sacredstriker Quickspell Gloves Ring of Regeneration Vest of Soul Rejuvenation Scrolls [ edit section | visual editor ] Scroll of Chain Lightning Scroll of Circle of Death Scroll of Cloudkill Scroll of Cone of Cold Scroll of Disintegrate Scroll of Dominate Person Scroll of Eyebite Scroll of Flesh to Stone Scroll of Globe of Invulnerability Scroll of Hold Monster Scroll of Otiluke's Freezing Sphere Scroll of Otto's Irresistible Dance Scroll of Planar Binding Scroll of Seeming Scroll of Sunbeam Scroll of Telekinesis Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] It is possible to collect taxes from the projection by passing one of several skill checks. Being a projection, it will not react to failed pickpocketing, allowing unlimited attempts and providing a good source to stockpile gold and powerful spells. There are two ways to make pickpocketing the hologram easier: Killing all other characters on the Sorcerous Sundries main floor to remove characters' sightlines makes hiding trivial, though this obviously locks the party out off trading with Tolna Tome-Monger permanently. Lorroakan's Projection does not react to this whatsoever, and there are no story repercussions if ⁠ Find the Nightsong has already been completed. The wandering Minor Illusion unfortunately appears to be impossible to remove and may still occasionally break stealth, as it automatically respawns. Hitting Lorroakan's Projection repeatedly using a Wisdom -based spell and Ability Drain to reduce its Wisdom to 1 will dramatically reduce the rolls required for successful pickpockets permanently. v Technical UID S_LOW_MyCabbages_Vendor UUID 319ab552-7aa2-4b99-91c0-0aebe3996ae3 Stats Human_Commoner Geezer Loryss is a cabbage vendor in Act Three . “ You're one of those monastic types! Your sort have done enough damage as is. „ — Loryss , when speaking to a Monk for the first time Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Loryss can be found beside the eastern wall of Sorcerous Sundries in the Lower City next to an overturned crate of Spoiled Cabbage . Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Loryss is a direct reference to the Cabbage Merchant from Avatar: The Last Airbender , whose cabbage cart was constantly overturned or destroyed by the show's main protagonist and other characters. His internal name is S_LOW_MyCabbages_Vendor . If a Monk character talks to Loryss, he has a special line where he recognizes "that stoic stance, calming presence". Loryss has a trader table ( LOW_Streets_MyCabbage_Trader ) attached to his character which consists entirely of Cabbage but he cannot be traded with in-game. CRE_Gith_Generic Losiir is a githyanki fighter who replaces Lae'zel's role in the Prologue while playing as her origin . Losiir has almost identical statistics and features to Lae'zel, but instead wields a scimitar and a longbow , and starts with the Defence fighting style . “ Lae'zel - you still live! May the Queen's favour be yours. „ — Losiir Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Prologue [ edit section | visual editor ] When Lae'zel is chosen as origin, the player character encounters Losiir upon leaving the "brain room" on the Nautiloid , in the same manner that any other player character would first encounter Lae'zel. As a fellow githyanki soldier, he is more agreeable and trusting toward Lae'zel than she is toward other player characters she meets in this moment. He accompanies Lae'zel as a temporary companion through the rest of the prologue. Losiir dies in the Nautiloid crash and his corpse lies bloodied on the beach. Upon seeing him, Lae'zel notes: "Losiir is gone. His spirit now swims the Astral Sea ." As Losiir is not a playable character, he cannot be revived with a Scroll of Revivify . If he dies during the prologue, the Nautiloid's restoration must instead be used to resurrect him. Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] After the Nautiloid crashes, Losiir's corpse is on the beach, where it can be looted for: Githyanki Boots Githyanki Half Plate Longbow Potion of Healing - x2 Scimitar Scroll of Revivify Tourmaline Ring Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Although Losiir is also infected with a Mind Flayer Tadpole , he is unable to commune with the illithid device trapping Shadowheart to release her. Technical UID S_WYR_WyrmRock_FFOfficeGuard_004 UUID 7f023df7-03e0-4d65-96ef-984be7392ba2 Stats FlamingFist_Dwarf_Ranger Fist Loudstone is a dwarven ranger and a mamber of the Flaming Fist . He can be found in Wyrm's Rock Fortress in Act Three . “ 'Archduke', 'king', it's all the same. It's always some rich prick in charge. „ — Loudstone , after the ceremony of Gortash's ordaining ends Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Loudstone is stationed in the Flaming Fist Office together with Fist Broko and Fist Callaway , under the command of Manip Cragbender . He is patrolling the office back and forth, occasionally climbing up the stairs in the far corner of the room. If spoken with, he talks dismissively about Gortash's coronation and the patriars who gathered to witness the ceremony. If Gortash is defeated, Loudstone keeps the same attitude, worried only about his own wages paid. Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Technical UID S_WYR_Circus_Ringmaster UUID c95af77b-6fc3-4c73-ac7c-087124f4b1e4 Stats WYR_Lucretious Eqp. EQP_WYR_Lucretious Trs. WYR_Circus_Ringmaster Madam Lucretious , [ 1 ] [ 2 ] also known as Bringer of the Night or Mama Lucretious, is a high elven [ 3 ] necromancer and the ringmaster of the Circus of the Last Days . “ Oh dear. Screaming children, an oozing corpse - and it's not even my birthday. „ — Lucretious Contents 1 Overview 1.1 Description 2 Involvement 3 Combat 3.1 Attacks and actions 3.2 Loot 4 Quotes 5 Related literature 6 Related quests 7 Gallery 8 Notes and references Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Description [ edit section | visual editor ] Lucretious is flamboyant, commanding, and flirty, with a larger-than-life personality and a dramatic flair. She is composed and well spoken. She has high standards and is dedicated to the success of her circus; currently she is attempting to train a troupe of dancing skeletons as a possible opening act for Dribbles. As a powerful wizard, Lucretious provides protection for her circus. [ 4 ] [ 5 ] Some members are so confident in her protection, they aren't afraid of the threat of the Absolute and its approaching army. If threatened, Popper may reveal he is unafraid to lose his fingers because he is certain she could replace them. [ 6 ] As a necromancer, Lucretious has a very casual attitude towards death; she sees corpses as a useful resource and shows insincere sympathy at the death of Dribbles. [ 7 ] When first encountered in the back of the circus, she is accompanied by three skeletons named Lucille , Boris , and Jacob , and two crawling claws named Itchy and Scratchy . [ 8 ] [ 9 ] She genuinely enjoys her work, and when she finds out she will have to put Dribbles' body back together, she is excited by the prospect of a challenge. [ 10 ] [ 11 ] "Wine-lover extraordinaire" is a part of her self-introduction, and she may refer to the character as a “delectable vintage.” [ 12 ] Lucretious claims to be quite old, even ancient. [ 13 ] [ 14 ] Her flirting is not reserved for the party members; a woman can be found in the Counting House intending to run away to the circus, citing the way she looked at her. [ 15 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] After Dribbles' show and discovering that he was replaced by a Doppelganger , Lucretious intends to move the circus elsewhere, but will not do so until the remains of her audience-beloved Dribbles are found. She asks the party to find the scattered body parts of Dribbles so she can reanimate him and continue to use him as part of the circus. If the party return with all seven of Dribbles' missing body parts, Lucretious thanks them for returning the star of her show and rewards them with Spellmight Gloves (or a small amount of gold if the gloves were previously pickpocketed). She lets the party know that the circus will finally leave soon (after the next long rest), so they should buy from its merchants while they still can. At the same time, Ludd and the rest of the doppelgangers all re-disguise as Dolor, aiding his escape. Lyrics [ edit section | visual editor ] Lug Hush little elfling, thou need'st not look far... Lug To feel the light of Corellon's bright star. Lug Darkness shan't find thee - the shadows despair. Lug They will not touch 'pon a lock of your hair. Lug Trust the Elf-Father and grip my hand tight... Lug We shall walk with you into that pitch night. Lug Once we see sunlight, the dawn of a day... Lug That's when we know we've been kept by the Fey. Technical UID S_LOW_UndercityPatrol1_Cultist_Strangler UUID 29ba6894-5a2b-4f81-b756-c5ebdafbbb74 Stats LOW_Chasm_Strangler Strangler Luke is a member of the Cult of Bhaal . He joins the ambush on the party during the battle with Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Luke joins the fight once the party approaches him. If the party is on top of or close to the bridge leading over the chasm he attempts to Shove them off of it. If defeated he drops Bonespike Gloves . To obtain them, he must be defeated and looted before completing the trial led by Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev , as his corpse will despawn upon Ghislev's defeat. Escaping the trial by running away does not complete it. He is located on the roof of a ruined building near the stone bridge across the chasm at X: -138 Y: 995 . Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Throat Punch ( + ) Damage: 6~11 1d6 + 5 ⁠ Bludgeoning Throw a ki-empowered punch to a foe's throat, wounding and possibly Dazing them, knocking them Prone , and Silencing them. CON Save Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Bonespike Gloves — must be looted before completing the trial, as Luke's corpse despawns upon Ghislev's death. Technical UID S_LOW_Lumbar UUID cc4b66fb-a789-472d-8d23-ad3380215ca4 Stats LOW_ZombieBeggars_Lumbar Strange Beggar Lumbar is an undead character in the Lower City in Act Three . “ Charge too much, people hit you harder. Then they take the gold back. „ — Lumbar Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lumbar is near the Basilisk Gate Barracks in Baldur's Gate , being punched by 'Logs' Odoolan . After Odoolan leaves, Lumbar can be spoken with. He offers to let the talking party member punch him for a small gold fee. If the party already started ⁠ Find Mystic Carrion's Servant and knows Lumbar is one of the zombies, one of them can ask him where Thrumbo is: [ROGUE] [DECEPTION]  Relax, the boss just wanted to give you and Thrumbo a proper send off. Does you need anything? (DC 18) [DECEPTION]  Carrion means Thrumbo no harm. He sent me with provisions for his journey. (DC 18) [PALADIN] [CLERIC] [INTIMIDATION]  Unless you want me to purge this realm of you and your undead brothers, you'll talk . (DC 18  ) [INTIMIDATION]  Either you tell me where Thrumbo is, or I drive my fist through your skull. (DC 18) [PERSUASION]  Tell me where Thrumbo is, and it'll be like we never met. (DC 18) Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] 'Logs' Odoolan You really won't feel it?  (Before punching Lumbar) Strange Beggar Lumbar Not a thing. Don't hold back. 'Logs' Odoolan Brace yourself... 'Logs' Odoolan That felt great.   (After punching Lumbar) Strange Beggar Lumbar You're very welcome, sir. Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Find Mystic Carrion's Servant Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Lumbar's name is a likely a reference to the ⁠ lumbar region of the body. Technical UID S_FOR_SchoolOgre1 UUID 848b6f10-3ae5-41f6-b1a1-98c34a19ba3f Stats FOR_OgreCaptain Eqp. EQP_Ogre_Club Trs. FOR_SchoolOgre_Smart Lump the Enlightened lurks in the ruined remains of Blighted Village with two ogre companions during Act One . Despite being an ogre, Lump has unusually high intelligence. “ I've no use for the Absolute - or any god. I follow two masters only: gluttony and greed. „ — Lump , speaking the party Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Lump is in the Blighted Village with Chock and Fank . If the party approach Lump, he asks to see their Brand of the Absolute . If the brand has not been received, Lump attacks unless he is convinced otherwise: [BRANDED]  Show him your brand. [DECEPTION]  I'll do you one better - I'm one of the Absolute's chosen disciples. (DC 10) (Upon failure) Lump : I expect more than your word. Show me your flesh . [DECEPTION]  Flash your arm at him. There you are. You could see the brand, could you not? (DC 10) [INTIMIDATION]  Do not test the Absolute's finest, ogre. You would not survive Her wrath. (DC 10) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  What about you? I'm feeling hungry... (DC 10) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  ROAR.  (DC 10  ) [PALADIN] [INTIMIDATION]  Try to eat me and I'll brand your corpse with the mark of my oath. (DC 10) Lump can be convinced to work for the party instead of the Absolute: I'll give you 500 gold if I can call you into battle. [DECEPTION]  I'll give you 1000 gold - after you fight for me. (DC 10) [ 2 ] I'll give you 1000 gold - after you fight for me. [ 3 ] [ROGUE] [DECEPTION]  1000 gold - to be paid once the killing's done. (DC 5) [ 2 ] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  How about I spare your life. That tempting enough? (DC 20) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  JOIN ME OR I'LL CRUSH YOU TO PULP!  (DC 20  ) [PERSUASION]  I'll pay you in the flesh of the fallen - you'll have your fill. (DC 15) [ 3 ] [PERSUASION]  I'll pay you in the flesh of the fallen - you'll have your fill. (DC 20) [ 2 ] [PALADIN] [INTIMIDATION]  Fight for me and my oath or I'll cut the last meal from your belly. (DC 20) If Lump agrees to work for the party, he offers Lump's War Horn , which can be used three times to summon Lump and his two ogre companions. He and his ogre companions leave Blighted Village and can be called upon if the party do not stray too far. For example, the horn cannot be used in the Shadow-Cursed Lands. If the party pickpock the horn from him, blowing it leads to combat with the ogres, as Lump correctly deduces the horn was stolen from him. If promised gold, Lump collects it after the first fight, at which point he can be paid, attacked, or convinced to wait for a 2500 gold payment after the next fight with a DC 15 Deception Check . If Lump was promised gold but never called, he eventually appears in camp to collect, and the party can pay him or intimidate him into leaving: Pay him what you promised. [INTIMIDATION]  We have a new bargain: I pay nothing, and you leave the camp alive. (DC 20) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  FOLLOW ME AGAIN AND I'LL EAT YOU.  (DC 20  ) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  You can leave alive, or you can roast over my campfire. (DC 20  ) Any other option causes the ogres to attack. Lump accidentally ate a Warped Headband of Intellect , which, even though not worn, is the source of his unusually high Intelligence for an Ogre . [ 4 ] The following inspiration can be gained: ⁠ Bodyguards for Hire ( Noble backgrounds) - for recruiting the ogres ⁠ Creatures of Bloodlust ( Haunted One backgrounds) - promising to pay with the corpses of slain enemies ⁠ Pyramid Scheme ( Urchin backgrounds) - convincing to work without offering gold Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] Hire Lump and his ogres.   +1   +1 Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Blur ( + ) Attackers have Disadvantage on Attack rolls against you. Doesn't affect creatures that don't rely on sight or that can see through illusions. Range: Self Recharge: End of combat Fire Bolt ( ) Damage: 1~10 1d10 ⁠ Fire Hurl a mote of fire. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Heavy Spiked Club Damage: 7~21 2d8 + 5 ⁠ Bludgeoning Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Melf's Acid Arrow ( + ) Damage: 6~24 4d4 ⁠ Acid + 2d4 ⁠ Acid Shoot a green arrow that bursts in a spray of acid. Deals ⁠ 4d4 Acid damage immediately and ⁠ 2d4 Acid damage at the end of the target's next turn. If the spell misses, the target still takes half the initial damage, but no damage at the end of its next turn. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Lump's War Horn Scroll of Blur (if unused) The Diary of Lump the Enlightened Warped Headband of Intellect Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] Lump is vulnerable to many spells due to his low Wisdom . His AC is also quite low, despite being higher than most ogres. Bursting him with powerful spells and strong melee attacks like Divine Smite prevents him from unleashing too much damage. Smokepowder is also effective against him. If the party is a sufficient distance away, Lump casts Blur which will make him more difficult to hit. Breaking his Concentration can be difficult due to his high Constitution . He also throws Acid Arrow to create Acid surfaces. Similar to other ogres, Lump excels at melee combat and is capable of dealing significant damage. He also exploits the party's use of Grease with Fire Bolt , lighting the area on fire. Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ In addition to his increased Intelligence , Lump the Enlightened has slightly more HP than is typical for an Ogre . His slightly better armour also causes him to have an Armour Class 1 higher than normal for an Ogre . ↑ 2.0 2.1 2.2 If Lump was not teased ↑ 3.0 3.1 If a githyanki speaker teases him about their sweet flesh. ↑ Lump's dialogue file describes him as: "Lump is very smart after accidentally eating a headband of intellect." v t e Forest Characters Adventurers Aradin Barth Remira Camp Followers Owlbear Cub Scratch Cultists of the Absolute Andrick Brynna Edowin Beasts Owlbear Mate Owlbear Mother Bugbears and Goblins Brek Fezzerk Grukkoh Scrawny Bugbear Slice Ettercaps and Spiders Ettercap Phase Spider Phase Spiderling Phase Spider Matriarch Ogres Buthir Chock Fank Lump Other Barcus Wroot Dead Tiefling Gomwick Ornate Mirror Shovel Locations Apothecary's Cellar Blighted Village Owlbear Nest Whispering Depths Quests Destroy the Ancient Tome Finish the Masterwork Weapon Forging a Heart Rescue the Gnome Search the Cellar The Hellion's Heart Travel through the Underdark Unlock the Ancient Tome

Technical UID S_UND_DuergarLoyalPatroller_01_Spider_01 UUID 82f367a2-14c0-46cf-82d1-f070c87cf95a Stats Spider_Tiny_Underdark Lur Xanta is a spider in Grymforge during Act One . It can be found near the cages west of the waypoint with several other spiders and Murmath . “ We do not turn on Father Murmath. But we do outgrow him. The fate of clan Lur lies with the Spider Queen! „ — Lur Xanta Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act One 2 Combat 2.1 Attacks and actions 2.2 Allies Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] If approaching, the party can use Speak with Animals to listen to the conversation between Xanta and the other spiders. Xanta is trying to convince the other spiders to leave Murmath and join the cult of Lolth . Depending on dialogue choices, the other spiders can attack Xanta, or be convinced to join the cult. Turning on your head-of-clan are you? I'm sure that'll end well. You should know that spiders are revered among Lolth's faithful. Harming one of your kind is a capital crime. (if Religion check passed) [DECEPTION]  Murmath? Is that the guy who keeps telling everyone about his useless, hideous spiders? (DC 10) [BARBARIAN]  I don't care where you go, but it's time for all of you to leave. (DC 10) [BERSERKER]  FILTHY BUGS! LEAVE!  (DC 10  ) [PERSUASION]  I think your sister is right - among the Spider Queen's worshippers, you'll reach your true potential (DC 10) See how this mutiny plays out. (spiders attack each other) Lolth-related party members get additional dialogue choices: [PALADIN OF LOLTH] [LOLTH-SWORN] [CLERIC OF LOLTH] [RELIGION]  Recall your learnings about the Spider Queen, Lolth.  (DC 10) [PALADIN OF LOLTH] [LOLTH-SWORN] [CLERIC OF LOLTH]  Your sister speaks true. The Spider Queen would welcome you with great enthusiasm. I'd rather not get involved in your little coup. [RELIGION]  I suppose the Order of the Soul Spiders would have room for you among their ranks. (DC 5) [INTIMIDATION]  The Spider Queen doesn't suffer hesitation. I fear for anyone who resists her call. (DC 5) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  THE PRIEST IS WEAK . BECOME STRONG . (DC 5  ) [PERSUASION]  Among the Spider Queen's followers, you'd be revered as her physical manifestation. Honoured. Exalted.  (DC 5) [OATH OF THE ANCIENTS] [PERSUASION]  Being bound to serve Murmath spits in the face of natural order. It limits you. (DC 7) [OATH OF VENGEANCE] [PERSUASION]  Why be bound to Murmath when you could be Lolth's avenging Justiciars? (DC 7) [OATH OF DEVOTION] [PERSUASION]  Your duty is to each other, not Murmath. Embrace that, and power unlimited will be yours. (DC 7) [OATHBREAKER] [PERSUASION]  You owe nothing to Murmath. Break your bonds, free yourselves. Become unstoppable . (DC 7) [OATH OF THE CROWN] [PERSUASION]  Lolth is your queen - not Murmath. Following great leaders will make you greater in turn. (DC 7) Lastly, without Speak with Animals the party can attempt to communicate to varying degrees of success: Kssrt! [ANIMAL HANDLING]  Try to discern the nature of their chatter.  (DC 10) Hey! Knock it off, the lot of you! (spiders leave) Stand back and see how things play out. (spiders attack each other) Attack the nearest spider. (begins combat) Failing a check or choosing to not get involved results in Xanta being attacked by the other three spiders. Otherwise, the spiders are convinced and leave Grymforge peacefully. Party members with the Acolyte background subsequently gain the ⁠ Acolytes of the Demonweb Pits inspiration. Killing each spider gives 40 XP; killing Murmath gives 75 XP. Convincing them to leave earns the same experience as defeating them all. Technical UID S_LOW_CazadorsPalace_DeadWerewolf UUID 5d1dd933-3180-47d6-99e9-ded336ebf08e Stats Werewolf Lurianna Sauvage is a deceased werewolf in Szarr's Palace in Baldur's Gate 3. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lurianna Sauvage is in a hidden room in the chamberlain suites in Szarr Palace . According to a note on her body, she discovered Antwun Dufay's body along with an acid bottle. He had intended to fake his own death, but apparently, he drank the wrong bottle. Because they had planned to go together, she immediately decided to drink one of the other acid bottles to join him in the afterlife. Gold_Pocket_Random Harper Lymn is a Harper who patrols Last Light Inn during Act Two . She can help the party during ⁠ Assault on Moonrise Towers and be a potential ally during ⁠ Confront the Elder Brain . “ Shadows lurking. Light inside. Look. „ — Lymn , about the inn Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Lymn is at the Last Light Inn, where she patrols the southern side route of the docks area, with Teebs patrolling in the opposite direction. She can sometimes be seen gazing off into the distance, making comments to herself as to what she sees beyond the moonshield, and reminescing about smoking her pipe. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] [ 3 ] [ 4 ] [ 5 ] [ 6 ] Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Lymn is frequently amongst the Harpers who avoid being Impaled , and runs up to fight the Winged Horrors . If Isobel is not saved, Lymn and everyone in Last Light Inn turn into a Shadow-Cursed Undead , save for Jaheira . Speaking with her after the battle has her remark that she felt "something wrong" about Marcus, but that his betrayal nonetheless came as a surprise. [ 7 ] Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn, and the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers , Lymn follows Jaheira to the assault on Moonrise Towers, where she, along with Harper Antony , Essius , and Naysa survive the first assault and assist the party in the remaining fight against Absolute forces. After the main battle, if she survives the fight, she guards the first floor of Moonrise Towers with the remaining Harpers . [ 8 ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If she survives, Lymn can be summoned as an ally through the Gather Your Allies variant Silver Harp Squadron , if ⁠ The High Harper is completed with Minsc alive. Technical UID S_SHA_LastJusticiar UUID 594ba359-ce55-4b54-9efc-94eca306c540 Stats SHA_LastJusticiar_Lyrthindor Eqp. SHA_Justiciar_Scimitar_Shar_Shield_Shar Trs. SHA_LastJusticiar_Treasure Lyrthindor is a secret Dark Justiciar in the Gauntlet of Shar . “ These hands...too big. Where are the others? Where's the rest of me?! „ — Lyrthindor upon reappearing in front of the party History [ edit section | visual editor ] Lyrthindor was a member of Ketheric Thorm's Dark Justiciar army, during the Sharran occupation of Reithwin Town and its surroundings over a hundred years ago. Originally a husband and father, the plague took his family and Lyrthindor turned to Shar in his grief. He was one of many Sharrans who became a Justiciar through completion of the Gauntlet of Shar's trials, reaching the final test wherein he sacrificed the Nightsong. [ 1 ] As Ketheric's war progressed, Morfred , a member of the Selûnite resistance, made a deal with Raphael to destroy Ketheric's Justiciar army. [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Yurgir was sent to the Gauntlet to fulfil Raphael's side of the bargain, his own Infernal Contract stating that he would only be released from service if he killed every single Justiciar. [ 4 ] With no intention of actually freeing Yurgir, Raphael offered Lyrthindor help to escape from the slaughter. [ 5 ] He gave Lyrthindor the book One Becomes Many , which detailed how to transform into a swarm of rats in order to hide from Yurgir. [ 6 ] With Yurgir unable to leave the Gauntlet, and Lyrthindor still in hiding, the two remained there for the next hundred years. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Lyrthindor has hidden himself from Yurgir by transforming himself into the many rats scattered around the gauntlet. By Raphael's design, this prevented Yurgir from completing his contract with Raphael. The first few times the rats are encountered, the party can examine the rats to find out that there is more than meets the eye: [ANIMAL HANDLING]  Study the rat's behaviour.  (DC 14) [INSIGHT]  Consider the rat's tone, and choice of words.  (DC 14) [MONK] [INSIGHT]  Study the rat's ki to see the source of its aggression. (DC 16) Attacking one of the rats panics them, and they start to recover a bit of their memories. One of the rats initiates a conversation with the party and attempts to bargain. If this deal is accepted, the rat scurries off, no other rats can then be found in the temple anymore and the ⁠ Break Yurgir's Contract quest completes without freeing Yurgir; the map is also marked with the Sharran Provisions, which are located in a loose brick at X: -684 Y: -708 . However, if the first rat being attacked is one of those near the gargantuan-sized statue of Shar at X: -717 Y: -723 , it is only necessary to defeat the rats which manifest and fight against the party at that location for Lyrthindor to appear; he must then be killed to complete ⁠ Break Yurgir's Contract . Any remaining rats in the Gauntlet of Shar turn hostile on sight if Lyrthindor is defeated first. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Who are you? Lyrthindor Lyrthindor... What happened to you? Lyrthindor Devil. Fled. Hid. Rats ... How did you become a swarm of rats? Lyrthindor Man appeared. Offered help. Raphael... Raphael hired the orthon to kill you - why would he then help you? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.* What brought you to this place? Lyrthindor Sought Shar. Sought oblivion. Oblivion? Why would you want that? Lyrthindor Wife, daughter... plague. Nothing left. How did you become a Dark Justiciar? Lyrthindor Trials. Sacrifice. But she rose ... Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] As of Patch 8, Lyrthindor may start flashing in combat. He can still be targeted for attacks by clicking on him (or his portrait in the initiative order) while he is present on the screen. The bug prevents him from making any attacks. Area of effect attacks can be quite useful in this situation, particularly lingering ones such as Cloud of Daggers as he then stands in place while flashing only to end his turn. [ verify ] Flashing breaks the UI and prevents the usage of spells which need a variety selection. This bug can be fixed by applying the Wet condition on him, hitting him with Fireball or using Spike Growth . However, this does not fix his inability to take any kind of action. [ verify ] After killing Lyrthindor, some rats may still be alive near the Gauntlet of Shar waypoint; they then flee if approached. v t e Gauntlet of Shar Characters Aylin Balthazar Flesh Hoarding Merregon Lyrthindor Nessa Yurgir Creatures Apostate Defender Apostate Destroyer Apostate Librarian Apostate Sentinel Ghoul Medic Justiciar Avenger Justiciar Crusader Justiciar Nightweaver Justiciar Soulhunter Merregon Legionnaire Necrotic Rat Rat Reconstituted Duellist Reconstituted Marksman Soporific Rat Locations Faith-Leap Trial Self-Same Trial Shadowfell Silent Library Soft-Step Trial Quests Break Yurgir's Contract Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic Find the Nightsong Kill Raphael's Old Enemy Lift the Shadow Curse The Chosen of Shar

He is part of Orpheus' honour guard, and is fighting to free him. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] During a long rest at the end of Act Two , the party is suddenly woken to an attack by various githyanki monks. The party is then called into a portal by the Dream Guardian , where it is revealed it is The Emperor . It asks for the party's help, as M'i'hayk and the other monks are invading the Astral Prism to free the son of Gith himself Orpheus, who as it turns out is being held prisoner within the prism. The githyanki attack the party, regardless of the answer given to the Emperor. This marriage is for the best, you'll see. „ — Madalitso , to Nafula Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Madalitso can be found convincing his daughter, Nafula , to meet with the Nielsens' son for marriage because creditors are clawing at their door. Nafula insists that she is already happy with Sasha, the peddler's daughter. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Madalitso can be heard trying to convince his daughter to marry the Nielsens' son. Madalitso Honey, we're desperate . We need the Nielsens' money. Nafula I don't even know him, dad. Madalitso But you know me. Do you think I would choose a poor match for my daughter? Nafula Dad, you're picking a husband for me, not a new dress! Nafula What about what I want? Does that not matter? Madalitso Choice is a luxury, honey. One your family cannot afford. Madalitso Your mother and I had an arranged marriage, honey - it's not so bad. Nafula Wow - you're really selling it, dad. Backstory [ edit section | visual editor ] Madalla's blindness was cured by another True Soul passing through her village - so they [ 1 ] could watch it being burnt to the ground around them. Such was the price of refusing the Absolute. Achievements [ edit section | visual editor ] Outsourcing Recruit a hireling. You can befriend them or use them as cannon-fodder - we won't judge. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Although refered to as "They", the backstory given in-game says "her village" not "their village". "They", used in-game, is likely plural, referring to both Madalla and the other True Soul .

SCL_ServantOfTheRaven_Body Madeline is a deceased dwarf whose corpse is on the Ruined Battlefield in the Shadow-Cursed Lands at X: 125 Y: 106 . “ You didn't see it. Didn't see what the Dark Justiciar did. „ — Madeline Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Madeline tended bar at the distillery The Waning Moon many years ago, during the time when the army of Ketheric Thorm's Dark Justiciars occupied the town. Upon the party's first approaching He Who Was , he casts Speak with Dead on her corpse to try to interrogate her. This begins the quest ⁠ Punish the Wicked . He Who Was is a shadar-kai who seeks the guilty, tormented and anguished. He fittingly found Madeline, whose spirit remains in grief and regret over her actions while she was alive. Claiming that he is seeking justice for Madeline's crimes, He Who Was asks the party to retrieve Madeline's Ledger , which is under a loose plank behind the bar at The Waning Moon. After the ledger is brought back, He Who Was channels Madeline's spirit once again, allowing a party member to question her this time. Madeline explains how she was to report to Dark Justiciar Netasha any observed dissent against Ketheric and his army. Fearing for her life, Madeline betrayed many of her friends and patrons to Netasha, who captured and killed them in horrific ways. Madeline expresses grief and regret for what she did, believing herself beyond redemption or forgiveness. The interacting party member can forgive her, and let her spirit move on in peace, or choose to admonish or punish her. Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Madeline's Ledger - found under some hidden planks in The Waning Moon Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Punish the Wicked Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] Many of the developer notes for He Who Was' dialogue lines mention not only the cruelty underlying his intentions, but that much of what he says to the party is trying to manipulate them into torturing Madeline. v t e Shadow-Cursed Lands Characters Companions Halsin Cultists of the Absolute Bedi Gronag Kansif Kar'niss Korliss Lora Rizzle Vez Flaming Technical UID S_WYR_KillDirectorGortash_Patriar_010 UUID da3508f0-91ce-48c1-ab58-f3b359cd3315 Stats Human_Commoner Lady Madeline Whitburn is a Lady of Baldur's Gate who is present for Gortash's ordination as the Archduke of the city. “ Stone and steel. That is our way. „ — Madeline Whitburn , on Baldur's Gate's defenses Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Before the ceremony she sits among other patriars on the pews in central nave of the Audience Hall. After the ceremony ends, Lady Whitburn moves to the northern nave of the Audience Hall and stands near the second table with refreshments, accompanied by her maiden, Servant Naiske . She bosses Naiske around, constantly changing her mind about refreshments and meals she would like to taste. If spoken to, she says the city is as only strong as its walls are. If the party confronts Gortash, Lady Madeline can later be found along with all other invited guests and their retinue – slaughtered in the Audience hall. According to the research of the Black Hand of Loyalty , Lady Madeline Whitburn is one of the nobles who may easily fall in line with the cult via bribery, blackmail, or direct threats. [ 2 ] Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Madeline Whitburn Naiske, bring me a plate of the cold-water pike. Naiske The cook has prepared no pike today, my lady. Madeline Whitburn A most grievous error. In that case, fetch me a bowl of sunfish-head stew. Naiske The kitchen is fresh out of sunfish, my lady. Madeline Whitburn Well, I never . Naiske If that is all, my lady - Madeline Whitburn Cheese. Something cut fresh from the wheel. Naiske I'll have to inquire with Cook Darlie about... Madeline Whitburn Ah, Naiske. Why must you make everything such a bother? Madeline Whitburn I so fancy a glass of Dragondew. Fetch me a bottle, and be quick about it. Naiske At once, my lady. Would you... Madeline Whitburn Ah, never you mind - a young Pink Clarry [ 3 ] would more suit the occasion. Bring it at once. Naiske Pink Clarry it is, my good lady. Madeline Whitburn Ah, but perhaps a mint wine. My palate needs cleansing. Though I've grown quite fond of Evermead... Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] I Have a Serious Complaint! EQP_HeavyCrossbow_Leather Trs. BG_Guard Fist Madigan is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist . He is in Rivington in Act Three . “ An honest thief? City still finds ways to surprise after all these years... „ — Madigan Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Madigan together with Fist Poole , Fist Rowan , Fist Broadhorn , Fist Lochan and Fist Varone , under command of Manip Nestor , guards the goods donated to the benefit of refugees, put into storage inside the Requisitioned Barn . Madigan is one of the two guards who patrol the barn inside. If any party member is spotted by Madigan while exploring the barn without permission, the observing Fist orders them to go and speak with the Manip (this immediately moves the active party to the entrance). Being caught the second time leads them to be arrested. Rogue characters (only) have unique dialogue line while talking to Madigan, that can be used only the first time they are caught inside: [ROGUE]  This looked like the only place around here worth stealing from. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Fist Madstene is patrolling the streets of Lower City with Fist Hextra , Fist Malayah and a Steel Watcher . Madstene and her fellow Fists do not respond to any attempts to speak with them, regardless of whether the Steel Watch Foundry is intact or destroyed. Technical UID S_LOW_FireworksHouse_BaniteGuard03 UUID af2dde9a-b304-4656-b871-6804ff8247a9 Stats HalfElf_Cultist_Bane_IronConsul Feloguard Maeve is a wood half-elf who can be encountered in the Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate , in Act Three of the game, while following through the quest ⁠ Investigate the Suspicious Toys . “ You're not going to find Uncle Felogyr up there - he's literally not alive. „ — Maeve Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Feloguard Maeve can be found on the first floor of Felogyr's Fireworks . She guards the stairs to the second floor of the pyrotechnics shop. The term "feloguard" is unique, it cannot be found elsewhere in the game. It corresponds with the name of the establishment. However, Maeve herself features stats and most abilities of another type of Bane followers - an Iron Consul of Bane . As the ⁠ Investigate the Suspicious Toys quest cannot be ultimately resolved in a peaceful way, Maeve joins the fight as soon as she notices any ill commotion, siding with the followers of Bane, who reside on the second floor of the building. She remains at the ground floor and attacks the party along with other Felogyr's employees. DEN_DruidServant Maggran is a high half-elf in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One . “ You're lucky I'm not in my bear form. Back off. „ — Maggran Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Maggran guards the Rite of Thorns from a Tiefling mob. If Kagha is persuaded to turn against the shadow druids, Maggran remains in bear form just outside the druid circle (in the direction of the Secluded Cove ). Additionally, if Halsin is saved, a druid in Wild Shape can talk to Maggran in his bear form, who then thanks the party. "His leaves to shade you. His branches to point your path. His shelter to protect you. Thank you ". "His blessings - our blessings - to thank you." Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Maggran is not proficient with his armor or shield, and therefore cannot cast spells. He also has no Wild Shape charges and cannot use this ability in combat. Blur ( + ) Attackers have Disadvantage on Attack rolls against you. Doesn't affect creatures that don't rely on sight or that can see through illusions. Range: Self Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Club Damage: 1~4 1d4 ⁠ Bludgeoning Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Produce Flame ( ) Damage: 1~8 1d8 ⁠ Fire A flame in your hand sheds a light in a 9 m (30 ft) radius and deals 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage when thrown. Throwing the flame immediately after you conjure it does not cost an Action . Extinguishing or throwing it on subsequent turns costs an action. The throw has a range of 9 m (30 ft). Range: Self Silence ( + ) Create a sound-proof sphere. All within are Silenced and Immune to ⁠ Thunder damage. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Wild Shape: Bear ( + ) Assume the shape of a polar bear that can   Goad enemies into attacking it. The polar bear has a starting health of 30 hit points that increases every two druid levels. While in animal shape, you can't talk or cast spells. You take on the attribution of your beast form - excluding your Intelligence , Wisdom , and Charisma scores. When your beast form drops to 0 hit points , you revert to your normal form. Maggran unfortunately does not have a Wild Shape Charge to actually wild shape into a bear. v t e Emerald Grove Characters Adventurers Aradin Barth Liam Remira Animals Bored Ox Bosk Corinna Hungry Ox Ormn Silver Spar Timber Tingmiaq Topaz Tuffet Tusk Wounded Bird Druids Aelar Apikusis Elwyn Findal Inwe Jeorna Kagha Karrik Loic Maggran Marcoryl Mino Nettie Rath Tahan Goblins Gresh Gurza Sazza Torrack Worm Za'krug Tiefling Refugees Alfira Amek Arka Asharak Bex Cal Cerys Chell Danis Elegis Eramas Gerson Guex Ikaron Kaldani Kanon Kivak Komira Lakrissa Lia Locke Memnos Nadira Okta Pandirna Rechel Rhy Rikka Rolan Tilses Toron Vatas Xeph Zae Zevlor Zorru Children Arabella Doni Gan Ide Meli Mirkon Silfy Umi Zaki Traders Arron Auntie Ethel Dammon Mattis Mol Volo Other Bugbear Assassin Strange Ox Locations Inner Sanctum Sacred Pool Secluded Cove The Hollow Tiefling Hideout Underground Passage Quests Daughter of Darkness Defeat the Goblins Find Doni Find Your Belongings Forging a Heart Get Help from Healer Nettie Investigate Kagha Investigate the Beach Kill Kagha Raid the Grove Rescue the Druid Halsin Return the Locket Save Arabella Save the First Druid Save the Goblin Sazza Save the Refugees Steal the Sacred Idol The Hellion's Heart

COL_Barracks_SkullLasher Maghtew Budj is a member of the Followers of the Absolute . He is in the sanctum north of the Barracks in the Mind Flayer Colony . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Maghtew is being rallied by his wife Kressa Bonedaughter along with his fellow cultists Hairy Henry and Ironfinger . If a party member approaches, Kressa casts Myrkul's Gift , which gives her and the other cultists 10 temporary hit points. If left alone, he moves to his room in the north-eastern part of the barracks, greeting the party with "May death claim you soon" and "Your bones be blessed" if spoken to. A journal he penned is in his room. It reveals he is Kressa Bonedaughter's husband and that they were formerly country surgeons from Nashkel . It details how, after joining the Cult of Myrkul , Kressa became obsessed with her tadpole research as well as a 'pet' she used for her experiments - and how all of this estranged him from his wife. He attempted to bring her back to her senses by telling Balthazar of this 'pet'. While this resulted in Balthazar shipping it to the Nautiloid , it only entrenched her desire for a thrall of her own. UND_Duergar_Generic Ward Magmar is a Flameshade duergar in Grymforge during Act One . “ You want Nere, you claw him out. My drinking hand's busy. „ — Magmar Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Ward Magmar is at X: -606 Y: 384 , where he and Pistle guard the elevator leading to the Shadow-Cursed Lands . If the party move to access the elevator, Magmar asks whether they have a Moonlantern . This is the first mentioning of this as a means defence against the deadly effects within that cursed territory in the game. However, if the party insist on using the elevator without a lantern, Magmar is careless with his duties and allows the party passage. Magmar and Pistle maltreat an enslaved deep gnome named Skickpit , demanding he repeatedly fetch more beer from the barrel at the foot of the stairs. If the party free Skickpit, they must deal with Magmar and Pistle by attacking them or annoying them in dialogue. The other option is to tamper the beer in the barrel with poison or toxin. The party can try and speak to the gnome. It takes three or four lines and possibly passing a Persuasion Check to convince Skickpit that the party are really going to help. The party can also spike the beer straigtaway. Either way, after drinking a pitcher of poisoned beer each, both Magmar and Pistle fall dead. After both Wards die, Skickpit speaks to the party and asks what he is supposed to do next. If they answer politely, he gifts the party a vial of Wyvern Toxin . Magmar is a loyal member of the Clan Flameshade . Should the party conspire with Brithvar against Nere , Magmar joins them against the drow and duergar cult novices. However, he and Pistle are positioned too far from the possible location of the battle with Nere and his allies. Technical UID S_LOW_BaldursGate_FlamingFist_Ranger_002 UUID 961b6b4e-8dfe-40c1-ba9b-2859cecbe3a3 Stats FlamingFist_Dwarf_Ranger Fist Magnolia is a dwarven ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist . She can be found in Lower City in Act Three . “ Keep walking. Can't help you. „ — Magnolia Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Magnolia is standing watch on the bridge at the Upper City Gate Checkpoint . She watches over the queue of residents trying to make their way into the Upper City . Having received orders to not let anyone into the Upper City, Magnolia and her fellows: Fist Grassley , Fist Wizard Hartlebury , Fist Nudelmann and Fist Qirahe , accompanied by a Steel Watcher , are trying to keep the queue orderly and prevent anyone from entering. If spoken to, Magnolia, just as most other guards in the cordon, takes the player character for a citizen who tries to make their way through the gate ahead of the queue. If the party return to the city after acquiring all Netherstones , three infected refugees near the queue transform into Mind Flayers and attack the bypassers. Magnolia is Surprised , but fights alongside the party. Once the Mind Flayers are dead, she and all the Fists around run away to warn their superiors, before completely vanishing from the game once far enough. Technical UID S_LOW_BaldursMouth_Malek_Stones UUID 633663b4-a38a-4982-9f44-8ca368740f12 Stats Dwarf_Commoner Malek Stones is an investigative journalist for the Baldur's Mouth Gazette . He is inside the main building, Baldur's Mouth , in the Lower City . “ 'The pen is mightier than the -' no, that's horseshit, RUN! „ — Malek Stones if a fight breaks out in the Baldur's Mouth Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Malek is usually busy working on his next scoop in the writer's room of the Baldur's Mouth. He is somewhat paranoid as a result of his strong desire to find the truth in a city where many truths are being hidden, often at considerable expense. The editor in chief Ettvard Needle believes him 'unhinged' enough to consider firing him while Churg Elvek praises him for telling the truth. If Ettvard is killed, Malek is promoted to editor in chief. If Malek Stones is also killed, then a new character called Syril Valdemar takes their place after a long rest. Technical UID S_MOO_EntranceGuard_001 UUID b302d246-59ff-48ee-8247-0e3bcfd4b38e Stats MOO_ZealotOfTheAbsolute_Human Eqp. EQP_Halberd_Plate_Shortbow Trs. MOO_Cultist Zealot Malik is a True Soul zealot of the Cult of the Absolute in Act Two . He is stationed at the stairs leading into Moonrise Towers , guarding the entrance from intruders and vetting any new arrival before they can enter the seat of the Absolute. “ Before the Absolute? I was nobody. „ — Malik (zealot) Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If party members are observed approaching the main entrance to Moonrise Towers for the first time, Malik stops them and psionically probes their tadpoles through the use of his own . Upon recognizing them as True Souls , Malik asks for news from the field; the interacting party member can respond with a variety of dialogue options. If asked why he is on guard duty at the entrance, he reveals being tasked to recognize fellow True Souls. [ 1 ] Minthara's escape [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Decide Minthara's Fate If Minthara is freed from the Moonrise Towers Prison , the party can lead her out of Moonrise Towers through the main entrance. Passing by Malik and Merim results in their blocking the party's path, demanding an explanation as to why Minthara is not in her cell. If convinced the party has the authority to escort her out (or that she has been fully subjugated), they are satisfied and the party may leave peacefully; [ 2 ] otherwise Malik and Merin become hostile. Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If he is alive when the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Malik is killed during the subsequent battle. His corpse is at the bottom of the stairs of the main door entering Moonrise, at X: -157 Y: -135 . Technical UID S_LOW_BonecloakApothecary_CatForDerryth03 UUID dc7f3ee1-14c7-4912-8c1e-1c2807c6b62d Stats Cat Malta is a medium haired red and white Cat with green eyes in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . “ It was just another day in the city of lies. Baldur's Gate - where the people begged for justice until they starved. Two heroes were fated to cross paths that day. Their eyes met. Destiny was calling... „ — Malta Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Malta can be found near the Lower City Central Wall waypoint, in the alley behind the Central Watch Tower. Despite his bravado, he does not join the party. The party can speak with Malta using Speak with Animals . Along with Myshka and Barsik , he is one of three different cats located near Bonecloak's Apothecary that can be asked to keep Derryth Bonecloak company if Baelen Bonecloak died in Act One , and the party has spoken to her about how she feels lonely without him. Dialogue [ edit section | visual editor ] Without Speak with Animals [ edit section | visual editor ] Malta: *Meow...?* Player character : Hello, sour puss. Do you want scritches?" Malta: *...Meow.* Chase the cat away Malta: *HISS!* (Malta will then run away and disappear permanently from the game.) DC 15 Animal Handling Check - Attempt to pet the cat. (Successful.) Malta: *...Purr.* Narrator: *The cat seems to be trying very hard to remain aloof—and not wholly succeeding.* Do you want to come with me? Malta: *...Mrrrr. Meow.* If you're brave enough, I'm sure Derryth Bonecloak at the apothecary will pet you all you want. Malta: *Rrrriow!* (Failure.) Malta: *Hiss!* (When spoken to again at Bonecloak's Apothecary:) Malta: *Meow!* With Speak with Animals [ edit section | visual editor ] Malta: It was just another day in the city of lies. Baldur's Gate - where the people begged for justice until they starved. Two heroes were fated to cross paths that day. Their eyes met. Destiny was calling... Player character : And they both answered Malta: Strangers? Only in a fool's definition of the word. It was the start of something incredible—two heroes on the hunt for justice, no matter the cost. All the tall one had to do was say yes. (Continues below) Player character : Excuse me? Malta: Destiny is a fickle mistress. She showers you in riches one day and kicks you into the gutter the next. But today, she smiles. This could be the beginning of something. Two heroes against the world, enacting justice for those unable to seek their own. All the tall one had to do was say yes. (Continues below) Player character : Are you all right...? Malta: It was in the tall one's voice: they knew they cared about this creature but they didn't know why. But the cat did. This could be the beginning of something. Two heroes against the world, enacting justice for those unable to seek their own. All the tall one had to do was say yes. (Continues below) Player character : I don't think I'm the partner for you—but Derryth Bonecloak be [sic] just who you're looking for. Malta: The tall one volunteered another—the apothecary. A principled dwarf—a scritcher of heads, and a giver of scraps. Perhaps this was where the journey was meant to start after all... Player character : Yes! Join me! Malta: The tall one had failed the first test: they lacked caution. The cat could have just as easily been a foe as a potential friend. Perhaps it was simply not meant to be... Player character : Sorry - our destines aren't meant to intertwine. Malta: The tall one had passed the first test. The second would come when they were ready - and not before. When would they be ready? Only the tall one - and fate - truly knew. (End of dialogue) (When spoken to again) Malta: Upon their return, the cat couldn't help but wonder whether the tall one had finally decided how their die would be cast. (When spoken to again at Bonecloak's Apothecary) Malta: The cat beheld the one who'd delivered him from the streets while taking on the heavy burden of justice alone. He purred. Trivia [ edit section | visual editor ] His name is likely a reference to old detective-noir movies (e.g. The Maltese Falcon) due to his manner of speech. v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the ## Malus Thorm
- **来源**: [Malus Thorm](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Malus_Thorm)
- **分类**: Characters、Bosses

Overview Combat Malus Thorm Shar's Scalpel Model Portrait Identity Male Voice / Actor Sean Baker Family Ketheric Thorm (nephew) [ 1 ] Thisobald Thorm Gerringothe Thorm Isobel Thorm (grandniece) Hometown Reithwin Town Stats Size Medium Type Undead Race Undead Technical UID S_TWN_Hospital_Surgeon UUID e58b8b34-038b-4858-b817-c2a8096a9381 Stats Surgeon Malus is the undead master surgeon of the House of Healing , twisted follower of Shar , and member of the Thorm family. [ 2 ] “ The objective of the scalpel, sisters, is to soothe, for a scalpel, indeed, is an extension of Shar. „ — Malus Thorm instructing the Undead Nurses in their "medical practice." Contents 1 Overview 2 Involvement 3 Combat 3.1 Loot 4 Related literature 4.1 Written by Malus Thorm 5 Gallery 6 Notes and references 7 External links Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] In life, Malus directed a shift in the House's purpose from tending to the sick and injured among the populace of Reithwin to exclusively serving the Dark Justiciars of Ketheric Thorm's army, as he believed keeping the latter healthy would help them serve Shar while the rest were better off left to her oblivion. [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Having somehow kept his personality despite being in the Shadow-Cursed Lands , he believes graceful pain and calculated mutilation are the key to truly embracing the ideals of his dark faith. At his depraved hospital, he tirelessly works to train his Undead Nurses to hone such skill, yet their hollowed state leaves them lacking in ability beyond being dutiful assistants. Interacting with Malus Thorm as well as Ketheric Thorm's other family members, grants the inspiration ⁠ Thorm Family Secrets to party members with the Sage background. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Arriving at the House of Healing and gaining entry to the surgery theatre, Malus can be found educating his undead nurses on a poor 'patient'. He possesses the Battered Lute which is needed to solve ⁠ Wake up Art Cullagh . While cordial at first seeing the talking party members as a new students, preaching his view of Absence being the way to understanding Shar. After mutilating the 'patient', he urges to do the same to the party. Beyond attacking, there are a mix of Skill Checks that can be done instead: [INVESTIGATION]  Examine the sisters and their implements.  (DC 14) Their blades are uneven. Efficient surgery will require further training. [ROGUE] [INVESTIGATION]  Cast your gaze over the blades of the sisters.  (DC 14  ) Your blades are in an atrocious condition - no way you'd make a clean cut with those. [RELIGION]  Recall what you know of Shar's teachings.  (DC 14) (non-Cleric) [CLERIC] [RELIGION]  Recall what you know of Shar's blasphemous teachings.  (DC 14  )  (non-Shar Cleric only) (grants ⁠ Did My Homework to party members with the Acolyte background) [PERSUASION]  The sisters aren't ready. They'll make me sick instead of curing me. (DC 16) If any of these checks are successful, Malus asks how to train the nurses properly, leading to two differing Persuasion checks: [PERSUASION]  Why not have them hone their skills on each other? (DC 21) [FIGHTER] [PERSUASION]  Sparring is vital to progress. Have them practice on each other. (DC 21  ) [ROGUE] [PERSUASION]  Practice - that's how I got good with a blade. They should spar each other. (DC 21  ) [WIZARD] [PERSUASION]  In my years of study, I have found no better teacher than example. Perhaps you could volunteer? (DC 21  ) [MONK] [PERSUASION]  When the fist trembles, sometimes another is needed to steady it. A good master would volunteer themselves. (DC 21  ) [BARD] [PERSUASION]  I take joy in performing with a master of my craft - I'm sure the sisters are the same. Why don't you volunteer? (DC 21  ) [PERSUASION]  They need a better subject to practise on first. Not a student, but a master. (DC 21) If the party read the Surgery and Physiology: A Sharran's Primer book in the room behind Malus , two additional options are available, both of which result in the nurses killing Malus : [INTIMIDATION]  I have read your treatise. Initiate the final lesson, or die by my hand. (DC 18) [PERSUASION]  'Only with sacrifice is mastery gained.' For the sisters to learn, you must submit. (DC 18) If the nurses are convinced to fight each other, the inspiration ⁠ Inhumane Trials is granted to party members with the Guild Artisan background, and the mad surgeon presses to tend to the party next. He can be attacked, proving much easier to defeat without the support of his nurses. Alternatively, he can be convinced to kill himself: [BARD] [PERSUASION]  I am not worthy! Please, show me how a master works - I would be honoured. (DC 21  ) [CLERIC] [DECEPTION]  You do me an honour, but I am not worthy. Show me the way of Shar - I beg of you. (DC 21  ) [FIGHTER] [DECEPTION]  I am but a fumbling squire before a master swordsman. Please, demonstrate so that I might learn.. (DC 21  ) [WIZARD] [SORCERER] [DECEPTION]  My magic has blinded me - I see now that Shar is the only path. Show me how - I beg of you. (DC 21  ) [DRUID] [DECEPTION]  I sought purpose in the natural world - I see now that Shar is the only path. Show me how - I beg of you. (DC 21  ) [PERSUASION]  I would rather acquaint myself - if you show me how. (DC 21) Awed by the party's diligence, Malus happily makes an example of himself, stabbing and killing himself through the eye. Successfully making him kill himself grants the following inspiration: [ 5 ] ⁠ An Apple a Day Keeps the Scalpel Away ( Soldier background) ⁠ Inhumane Trials ( Guild Artisan background) ⁠ The Best Offence is Virtually Nonsense ( Soldier background) ⁠ Under the Knife ( Haunted One background) Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Malus Thorm/Combat Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Battered Lute Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] URGENT: Request for Supplies , Sister Lidwin advises a Baldur's Gate surgeon of Malus's descent into madness under Shar Written by Malus Thorm [ edit section | visual editor ] Blood Bank Log Notice (Malus Thorm) Reithwin Necrology Surgeon's Memorandum Surgeon's Research Notes Surgery and Physiology: A Sharran's Primer Tissue and Organ Register Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Malus prepares to engage the party Concept model by Nikolai Chugunov Concept art by Tan Bur-Ci Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ A Tissue and Organ Register written by Malus Thorm found in the House of Healing refers to Ketheric as nephew, thus it can be safely inferred that Malus is indeed his uncle. ↑ Malus, compared to the other Thorms, does not have Immune to Control Undead , meaning an Oathbreaker Paladin can control him with Control Undead (30% for a level 8 paladin). [ verify ] ↑ Patients' Registry ↑ URGENT: Request for Supplies by Sister Anna Lidwin ↑ If carrying the Sentient Amulet after dealing with Malus, regardless of directly fighting him or killing him with checks, the Monk's manifestation comments on it: Hehehehe - a horrific display. There is no red deeper than a Sharran's blood.
