Technical UID S_LOW_KurwinCoffin_WyvernTeaDrinker UUID 6411b408-32c4-43bc-a3d3-b85f632fcf45 Stats Dwarf_Commoner Malvo Rockfellow is a dead gold dwarf in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Malvo Rockfellow is buried in the Graveyard (Lower City) in the Lower City under the vandalized tombstone with an inscripture chiselled above the name, running "Cry a rain of tears so flowers may bloom over Iris." . The Notes on Tea which is in his grave tells the story about Malvo's business idea of introducing to the city a new sort of tea made of Wyvern Stingers . However, he either did not know about the venomousness of the main ingredient, or drank too much of the concocted brew. A single stinger can be taken from his coffin. v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the Lower City Anti-Hag Support Group Adrielle Hydrangea Wubb Jatlo Kled Mayrina Baldur's Mouth Gazette Baalfe Baz Never dreamed I'd bring my family to a place like this. „ — Mama Falice Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Mama Falice is trying to convince Hazelnut not to run away and to go back to the hostel. Hazelnut hates doing chores and would rather go back to their real home. Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Falice's Chest Key Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Mama Falice What were you playing at, running away? Hazelnut I don't want to do chores anymore. Mama Falice So you just disappeared? Do you know how worried I was? Hazelnut Why do we have to stay here? All we do is work. Mama Falice Everyone has to contribute, my darling. We all have to take care of each other. Mama Falice Once the washing is finished, you can play all you like. Mama Falice You must never, never run away like that again. Do you understand? Hazelnut I just wanted to go home. Mama Falice One day we will. Technical UID S_LOW_GondianWorker04 UUID 6cc09c40-6b09-4e92-ad36-4e5ad72f7c43 Stats Gnome_Gondian_Caster Gondian Manser Biggs is a rock gnome member of the Church of Gond , enslaved in the Steel Watch Foundry . “ Gond's bollocks, I thought I was dead. Hoped I was, to be honest. „ — Manser Biggs Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Manser Biggs is on the lab floor of the foundry battling Black Gauntlet of Banes and Steel Watchers . He wears a Kill Collar , which must be disabled by deactivating a Motivator held by one of the Black Gauntlets. If the party successfully fights to save him as part of the quest ⁠ Save the Gondians , he runs out of the lab and gathers with the rest of the Gondians outside of the foundry. If killed, Speak with Dead may be cast on him in which he reveals he was forced to kill his husband Lanpos Biggs when the latter discovered where their sons Grindo and Hastar were being held captive. Gondian Manser Biggs My husband was eavesdropping, ma'am. He - he needed to be beaten. Fist of Bane Anouk Very good, little Gondian. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Who are you? Gondian Manser Biggs Kill my... husband... Why did they make you kill your husband? Gondian Manser Biggs Because he found out where... they're holding our sons... captive... HAV_Survivor Harper Manus is a polite Harper who patrols the docks and stairway of the southern coastline of Last Light Inn during Act Two . “ No god can protect you. „ — Manus , ambushing the Absolutists Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party reach the Shadow-Cursed Lands through Grymforge , Manus is patrolling the southern docks of Last Light Inn. After speaking with Jaheira , Manus moves to the bridge in front of the Last Light Inn with Branthos , Elindale , Lassandra , and Skywin . They wait for the party so they can move in to intercept and ⁠ ambush a nearby absolutist convoy in order to acquire their ⁠ source of protection against the Shadow Curse . Accepting the mission results in Manus and his squad of Harpers casting Light on their weapons and moving to the Ruined Battlefield , where they lay in wait for the Absolutist convoy. The party can go with the group immediately or catch up with them later, as the ambush site is marked on their map. If the party speak with Isobel and trigger the fight with Marcus , Manus moves to the bridge, out of reach of the battle. If Isobel is not saved, Manus turns into a Shadow-Cursed Undead . Ambush [ edit section | visual editor ] Talking to Branthos [ 1 ] at the ambush site starts the cut-scene and spawns the encounter. Once Kar'niss and the convoy arrive, the party can attack immediately or hang back. If they choose to stay hidden and keep watching, Kar'niss kills Vez , one of the goblins in the convoy. From there, the party can either signal the Harpers or wait as they start the encounter themselves. After the fight, a Moonlantern can be found on the drider's corpse. Alternatively, the party can convince Kar'niss to relinquish the Moonlantern and consign the convoy members to their fate as Shadow-Cursed Undead . Either way, Elindale and his squad then depart amiably and return to Last Light Inn. If the party enter the Shadow-Cursed Lands through the Rosymorn Monastery Trail , a goblin greets them and sends them to a rendezvous point to wait for Kar'niss and the ⁠ convoy to guide them to Moonrise Towers , where the party can ⁠ pass off as True Souls . This starts ⁠ Follow the Convoy . Kar'niss ferries the party, as well as the rest of the convoy, to Moonrise. During the trek, Manus, along with Branthos, Elindale, and Skywin ambush the convoy. The party can choose to turn on the convoy and help the Harpers, or protect the convoy in order to infiltrate Moonrise Towers. If the party are meeting the Harpers for the first time, and Branthos dies while siding with them, Manus tells the party to head to Last Light Inn, where they can obtain similar protection after speaking with Isobel. If the party choose to remain with the convoy, Manus and his squad turn hostile. After the Ambush [ edit section | visual editor ] If Manus is sided with and survives, he moves to the southern coastline of Last Light Inn and gazes into the distance, just a few short steps away from where Meygan , Lassandra, and Karrow are mourning Yonas . Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn, and the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise, Manus follows Jaheira there. However, Manus is killed during the fight against Absolute forces before the party arrive. His corpse is in the Moonrise Towers Prison , surrounded by a Death Shepherd and a horde of Necromites . If the target dies before the spell ends, you can use Reapply Hunter's Mark to mark a new creature. Saer Manzarde is in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ Fear not, friend. The days of us proper Baldurians walking these streets in fear are over. „ — Saer Manzarde Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Saer Manzarde and Frothilda can be found next to Baldur's Mouth , discussing the latest articles published in the Baldur's Mouth Gazette . Although Manzarde is in support of Enver Gortash's policies, he is nonetheless concerned with rising taxes and the economy. Depending on the interacting party member's race, Manzarde might inform them that "your sort won't be welcome around here much longer." If Gortash is defeated, Frothilda and Saer Mazarde leave, and cannot be interacted with again. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Frothilda It's a shame Gortash's interview didn't touch on how the Watchers talk. Saer Manzarde That's just a gimmick. The Steel Watch don't need to talk. They're guards. Frothilda Sure, Gortash didn't need to make them speak - but that's precisely why he's a genius! Not only that, they're polite. Have you any idea how hard it is to make an automation have manners? Saer Manzarde As long as they do their jobs, they can sing sea shanties for all I care. Frothilda Did you see Lord Gortash's latest interview in the Baldur's Mouth ? Saer Manzarde Speaks well, that Enver Gortash. An excellent rhetorician. Frothilda He's a man of the people, too. Promised at least a hundred more Watchers before the year is out. Saer Manzarde Good. But once Gortash clears off the cultists, he'll still have to clean the rabble off the streets. Frothilda He'll manage. There's nothing that man can't do. Frothilda To think, for decades, all we needed to build the Steel Watch has been sitting right there. Saer Manzarde Gortash is a visionary, sure enough. But his vision has cost a pretty penny. Frothilda We have Steel Watchers promenading the streets and you're worried about the price of bread? Saer Manzarde He's delivered, yes, but these tax hikes are enough to make my eyes water. Frothilda Once the Watchers see off the cultists, we'll recoup what we've lost, and then some. Frothilda Dear gods above! It's hot off the press - Lord Gortash is dead!   (If Gortash is killed) Saer Manzarde Don't say that, Frothi. It isn't funny. Frothilda It's no joke, it's the truth! He's been taken from us, Manzarde - so young, so handsome, and gone, just like that! Saer Manzarde Shade of a lich! This is going to play merry hell with commodity prices. I'd better get over to the grain exchange. v t e Baldur's Mouth Characters Flaming Fists Ernestus Glenvora Jerbold Guards Baalfe Hertvor Dremble Inocente Bramm Unilda Tiro Vlomina Wulf Outside Augur Harxkellan Bliggerillo Flant Borlley Flo Hurlburl Frothilda Frunilla Grent Grintly 'Gunny' Sacko Korrinna Koreena Juxon Lockhorn Lolo Fuzzletoes Manzarde Muttonchops Dorryss Phyria Gollus 'Plumes' Fronkin Sadar Illanov Trina Wuloona Dor Staff Bronte Delcan Ettvard Needle Falael Glimmer Whistleborn Jarlath Jelliwig Malek Stones Salene Freig Syril Valdemar Ty Willowbrook Zita Locations Newsroom Basement Quests Stop the Presses

Technical UID S_WYR_Posthouse_Equerry UUID 800e7e52-64f1-4a52-a2a2-5a409e8aab53 Stats WYR_Posthouse_Human_Ranger Eqp. EQP_Club Trs. BG_Commoner Angry Mar'hyah is a human kennel master in Rivington . She is very abusive to people and animals. “ Shut up, Dringo. And get back to work! „ — Mar'hyah Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Mar'hyah can be found verbally abusing her apprentice Dringo in the kennel of Sword Coast Couriers where she trains courier dogs to follow orders, read maps, and protect their owners. Upon striking up conversation with her, she turns to the party and says "Woof", derisively demanding to know why a living thing other than a dog is wandering into her kennel. It is possible to ask to buy the dogs but she refuses. The party can also chide her for being too harsh to Dringo, but she dismissively says it is the only way to teach him because he "behaves worse than the dogs" . Mar'hyah only shows interest in the party when they mention they may have a dog that once came from this kennel - Scratch. She deceptively asks the party to bring him here so she can check him for 'worms and so on'. If the party summon Scratch to the kennel, Mar'hyah demands they return him to her. She explains that Gomwick was merely his handler but she is his rightful owner since he is property of Sword Coast Couriers. The talking party member can choose to give up Scratch, attack Angry Mar'hyah, or attempt to get her to stand down: I'm sorry Scratch, there's nothing I can do. [INTIMIDATION]  I'll break every bone in your body before I let you hurt that dog. (DC 18) [DRUID] [INTIMIDATION]  This noble beast has tasted true freedom - he will never be brought to heel again. (DC 18  ) [PERSUASION]  He's forgotten his training. He'll be a terrible influence on the rest of your hounds. (DC 18) [FIGHTER] [STRENGTH]  You might be able to bully a dog and a boy, but threaten me and I'll snap you in two. (DC 18  ) [PALADIN]  I suspect she mistreats the dog and you, boy. Is this true? (succeeds automatically) After successfully convincing her into giving up Scratch, Oyster Boy Dringo sees his opportunity and pipes up to mention she has a history of abusing all the dogs including Gustav and Zola , not just Scratch. The talking party member can either tell her that they only care about Scratch, or they can threaten her: I'm sorry, Dringo - I only care about Scratch. [DECEPTION]  I hear Lord Gortash abhors animal abuse. Perhaps I should report you to him. (DC 20) [INTIMIDATION]  I'll give you to the count of ten to leave these kennels. One, two...  (DC 20) [DRUID] [INTIMIDATION]  You have lost your way, hound-keeper. Leave, before I teach you to respect these creatures properly. (DC 20) Failing the checks causes her to refuse and then fire Dringo, making him leave. Succeeding the check results in her leaving the kennel for good while Dringo releases all the dogs from their cages. Another option is to use non-lethal attacks to knock her out. Dringo then takes control of the kennel and releases the dogs from their cages and the unconcious Mar'hyah disappears after a long rest. Dringo and the dogs all say they are glad Mar'hyah is gone. If the party attack Mar'hyah, the crowd flees, but as long as the local Fist patrol is not alerted, there are no actual negative consequences to this. DEN_DruidServant Marcoryl is a druid of the Emerald Grove in Act One . He dislikes visitors and is very concerned for the Grove's safety. “ By Silvanus - another outsider. Should you have an ounce of sense, you will leave. Immediately. „ — Marcoryl Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Marcoryl regularly patrols the Servants' Quarters in the Inner Sanctum . Of all the druids in the Grove, Marcoryl is the most isolationist, believing the tiefling refugees should be removed and the Rite of Thorns be performed. If Kagha tries to make amends in ⁠ Investigate Kagha , Marcoryl continues to endorse sealing off the Grove. Despite this, if Kagha stops the Rite, he joins the party in fighting the Shadow Druids . Marcoryl and Loic often discuss the ethics of violence. Their idle banter varies according to the outcomes of ⁠ Investigate Kagha , ⁠ Raid the Grove , and ⁠ Save Arabella . BG_Guard Fist Marcus is a former member of the Flaming Fist , now turned into an elite agent of the Cult of the Absolute during Act Two . “ General Ketheric wants her alive - at any cost! „ — Marcus Falgor Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act Two 1.1.1 Last Light Inn 1.1.2 Moonrise Towers 2 Combat 2.1 Attacks and actions 2.2 Allies 2.3 Loot 2.4 Encounter details 2.5 Tactics 3 Speak with Dead 4 Notes and references Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Upon reaching Last Light Inn , Jaheira is instantly wary of the party and summons vines to stop the player character. She believes the party members are True Souls . If Mol does not survive Act One , Marcus comes to vouch for the party, telepathically revealing that he is an Absolutist spy. Revealing to Jaheira that Marcus is tadpoled triggers a fight against him. He has a surprise round where he summons 13 Crawling Claws and then disappears, returning to Moonrise Towers. However, he can be defeated here if party members have the passive Alert or drank an Elixir of Vigilance . Killing him here prevents the abduction attempt that otherwise occurs when the party first speaks with Isobel . If Marcus was not killed earlier, he appears when the party first speaks with Isobel. He quickly reveals his loyalty to the Absolute and Ketheric Thorm , urging Isobel to come with him to see the warlord. The party must make a critical choice here: Fight against Marcus and his Winged Horrors , who focus on taking down Isobel. Turn against Isobel, making Marcus and the Winged Horrors allies. The rest of the inn is not initially hostile. However, siding with Marcus causes Jaheira and the Harpers to become hostile to the party. Siding with Marcus also grants the ⁠ Tadpole Solidarity inspiration to party members with the Charlatan background. If Isobel is not saved, her barrier protecting the Last Light Inn fades, and the Shadow Curse enters the location. Everyone except Jaheira and the party either dies or become Shadow-Cursed Undead . This causes multiple questlines to end prematurely, and causes the party to permanently lose access to the traders Dammon , Mattis and Talli . Marcus' corpse can be communed with using Speak with Dead . When asked if he left anything valuable behind, he answers with "Outside the inn... buried near graveyard... she found out..." . Moving to the graveyard adjacent to Last Light Inn, a Flaming Fist's corpse is directly east of the open graves at X: -3 Y: 215 , where the Shield of Scorching Reprisal can be looted. The dead gnome's corpse implies that the Flaming Fist discovered Marcus's treachery, but was killed by him before she could warn the rest of the Fists and Harpers. A successful DC 18 Perception Check is needed to detect the rubble, [ 1 ] and a character with at least 15 Strength [ verify ] is required to smash the rubble to find the body. If Marcus is killed while attempting to kidnap Isobel, his body is later moved to the grass, north of the Last Light Inn, seemingly dumped there unceremoniously during the cleanup after the attack. Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is not saved and Marcus survives the fight in the Last Light Inn , he moves to the top floor of Moonrise Towers, near the door to Balthazar's room. If Isobel is knocked out and abducted alive, Marcus remains alive. However, if Isobel does not survive the abduction, Marcus also dies, presumably killed by an angry Ketheric Thorm . Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Fly ( ) Fly to a target position Range: 18 m (60 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Greatclub +1 Damage: 8~15 1d8 + 7 ⁠ Bludgeoning Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Tenacity ( )   –   Greatclub +1 Damage: 6 6 ⁠ Bludgeoning When you miss an attack, deal ⁠ Bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier anyway (minimum of 1). Vampiric Shout ( ) Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Necrotic Healing Damage ⁠ Healing Vent a malevolent shout, wound nearby foes and healing yourself provided they're neither Constructs or Undead . Recharge: Per turn Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] Crawling Claw - 13x (if fought in Last Light Inn's courtyard) Winged Horror - 6x (if fought in Isobel's room) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Greatclub +1 Half Plate Armour (Flaming Fist variant) Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen Shifting Corpus Ring Encounter details [ edit section | visual editor ] Marcus is an aggressive great weapon fighter, who in the case of the encounter at the Last Light Inn focuses on trying to knock out Isobel. The fight can end very quickly if he and the Winged Horrors act first on Initiative . He can attack up to 3 times a turn due to his Extra Attack and the bonus attack gained through his Great Weapon Master passive. Three of the Winged Horrors engage Jaheira and the Harpers in combat on the first floor, while the other three land on the upper floor and race to Isobel's room to help Marcus. Their Claws (Ghoul) can paralyse Isobel or party members, making all attacks against them critically hit. Isobel can be defeated and carried off by either Marcus or the Winged Horrors, so she must be kept alive until all enemies are vanquished. Jaheira may occasionally kill other Harpers or tiefling refugees by casting Ice Storm , ruining the party's chances of getting the Leave No One Behind achievement. Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] The key to defeating Marcus is preparation. During the conversation with him, the party can position themselves around the room to avoid being caught up in his Vampiric Shout , and a cleric who is not part of the conversation can also cast Sanctuary and / or Warding Bond on Isobel to protect her during Marcus's first turn. [ 2 ] Marcus's high initiative means that he likely acts first but the party members can use Alert , Dread Ambusher , Soulbreaker Greatsword , Sentinel Shield , or Elixir of Vigilance to increase their initiative rolls. An easy approach to defeating him is to use Banishment to put him out of the fight, saving Isobel from his wrath and allowing the group to clear out the Winged Horrors . By the time the spell ends, he will be no match against the full party and the inn's defenders. Alternatively, adding barrels and other objects to block the entrances confuses the enemies and limits how many of them must be fought at the same time. While some enemies attack the blockades to gain access, using explosive barrels with torches or other effects can trick enemies into damaging themselves. The party can also use Arcane Lock to lock all doors before beginning the conversation with Isobel. It is also wise to prepare healing spells (e.g., Healing Word ) and healing potions (e.g., Potion of Greater Healing ) to help Isobel if she is hurt. Lesser Restoration is also useful in case anyone is Paralysed by a winged horror. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Marcus' corpse can be communed with using Speak with Dead . Questions and responses vary depending on whether Marcus dies at Last Light Inn or Moonrise. Who are you? Marcus Marcus Falgor... raised in... Baldur's Gate... Who were you before you became a True Soul? Marcus Marcus Falgor... raised in... Baldur's Gate... How did you get into the Last Light unnoticed? Marcus Trusted...me... How did you come to follow the Absolute? Marcus Squad... captured... enlightened... How did you come to work for the Absolute? Marcus Squad... captured... enlightened... What is the Absolute's end game? Marcus Enlightenment... love... power... Why were you sent here? Marcus Capture... Selûne's... cleric... Why were you after the cleric? Marcus Orders... of the General... Absolute's... Chosen... Whose orders are you following? Marcus The... General... Absolute's... Chosen... Who is the Chosen? Marcus Ketheric... Thorm... What do you know of Ketheric Thorm? Marcus Chosen of... the Absolute. Wants... the cleric... more than anything. Do you know the source of Ketheric's invulnerability? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.* What's making Ketheric invulnerable? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.* Did you leave anything valuable behind? Marcus Outside the inn... buried near graveyard... she found out... Do you have any valuables in this place? Marcus Only... my... devotion... Technical UID S_LOW_BaldursMouth_StreetGossiper_001 UUID a9a9f761-1829-4477-8204-7e83e0f41c04 Stats Gnome_Commoner Margolenn is a Baldurian citizen in the Lower City during Act Three . “ If you like pictures, the gazette's got some brilliant illustrators. Really pops off the page. „ — Margolenn Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Margolenn is chatting with his friend 'Bigmouth' Thimsen near the entrance of Forge of the Nine . Although he rarely reads the Baldur's Mouth Gazette , he purchases them regularly to browse the illustrations. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] 'Bigmouth' Thimsen Read the gazette today yet, mate? Margolenn Yeah, this edition looked better than ever! 'Bigmouth' Thimsen ... Better than ever? With all the articles about cults and war? Margolenn Oh, right. Nah. I don't read any of the gazette. I like the pictures, me. 'Bigmouth' Thimsen Wait, if you don't read the gazette, how do you stay informed? Margolenn I don't. Don't see the point - staying informed seems super stressful. 'Bigmouth' Thimsen Hearing you say that stresses me out more than the gazette, mate. Margolenn So, I was looking at the pictures in the gazette today... 'Bigmouth' Thimsen Rather than reading the articles, yeah. You said. Margolenn Well, they were in the gazette. Saw their pictures and everything. 'Bigmouth' Thimsen You're right - apparently they're these hero types.  (If Baldur's Mouth publishes a positive article on the party) 'Bigmouth' Thimsen Oh, shit - you're right. The article about Absolutists ... Bad news.  (If Baldur's Mouth publishes a negative article on the party) Margolenn Yeah, they looked real mean in the broadsheet illustration. 'Bigmouth' Thimsen Read the gazette today yet, mate?  (If Enver Gortash is killed) Margolenn Yeah, this edition looked better than ever! 'Bigmouth' Thimsen ... What do you mean better than ever? It was all about Lord Gortash dying! Margolenn Oh, right. Nah, I don't read any of the gazette. I like the pictures, me. 'Bigmouth' Thimsen But how do you stay informed about stuff? Dying lords, new wars, anything? Margolenn I don't. Don't see the point - staying informed seems super stressful. WLD_CHA_BanditLockpick Mari is one of the bandits raiding the Overgrown Ruins in Act One . “ I know when I've got a lock beaten and I didn't beat this one. „ — Mari , after the door she's lockpicking opens on its own. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Mari is in the Refectory patrolling the antechmaber to the library, while Cefrey , Barton , Haseid , and Torgga inspect the library for loot and Andorn guards the Chapel Entrance. Mari is instantly hostile to the party. If spotted, Mari quickly flees the area to alert the other bandits. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Marilla can be communed with using Speak with Dead . Who are you? Flaming Fist Mercenary ... Gauntlet... Marilla... Flaming Fist... Why were you at the inn? Flaming Fist Mercenary ... guarding... the Grand Duke ... What happened to the Duke? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. She doesn't know.* Do you know of any survivors? Flaming Fist Mercenary ... dead... or dying... Chef Marjoram In-game Portrait Identity Male Voice / Actor Kit Esuruoso Occupation Head chef Stats Size Medium Type Humanoid Race Human Balanced Explorer Tactician Balanced Difficulty Stats Level 1 HP 6 AC 10 Initiative 0 Proficiency +2 Movement 9 m (30 ft) Weight 75 kg (150 lb) Darkvision 0 m (0 ft) XP reward 1 Ability scores STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) Saving throws STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 0 0 0 0 0 0 Explorer Difficulty Stats Level 1 HP 4 AC 10 Initiative 0 Proficiency +4 Movement 9 m (30 ft) Weight 75 kg (150 lb) Darkvision 0 m (0 ft) XP reward 1 Ability scores STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) Saving throws STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 0 0 0 0 0 0 Tactician Difficulty Stats Level 1 HP 7 AC 10 Initiative 0 Proficiency +2 Movement 9 m (30 ft) Weight 75 kg (150 lb) Darkvision 0 m (0 ft) XP reward 1 Ability scores STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) Saving throws STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 0 0 0 0 0 0 Technical UID S_LOW_Chef UUID c324c082-2fb7-4e6a-a74b-6988b67dc6e5 Stats Human_Commoner Chef Marjoram is a human employee to Lady Jannath who can potentially be found in the kitchen of Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City . “ You served this to Lady Jannath? It's RAW! „ — Marjoram Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Marjoram can only be found cooking alongside his sous-chef Falura if Oskar Fevras was never rescued from Brem in Act One . If spoken to, he tells the party not to interrupt a chef, just as they would not interrupt a painter. If Oskar Fevras was rescued, the manor is haunted and Marjoram is sent away on a temporary leave of absence at the request of Chamberlain Mercer . Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Dismissal of Staff Orders for Staff Idle dialogue [ edit section | visual editor ] Marjoram has some interesting dialogue with Falura, including a reference to the show Kitchen Nightmares : Chef Marjoram You served this to Lady Jannath? It's RAW! Falura the Sous-Chef Sorry, Chef. Chef Marjoram I can't serve apologies, can I? Make it again, and cook it this time. Falura the Sous-Chef Yes, Chef. Chef Marjoram Is your tongue half-baked too? Louder! Falura the Sous-Chef YES, CHEF! Falura the Sous-Chef How many more mouths will we have to feed? Chef Marjoram As many as Lady Jannath desires. So keep cooking! Falura the Sous-Chef How did you become a chef, Chef? Chef Marjoram I trained in Duke Ravengard's kitchens, under Chef Dinethaar Marsh. Falura the Sous-Chef Was Chef Marsh a good teacher? Chef Marjoram He was an efficient teacher. I have the burns to prove it. Falura the Sous-Chef Should I slice the radishes like this? Chef Marjoram No, no, no - thinner! Make them elegant, and make them count . Those are the last we have. Falura the Sous-Chef Can't we just use something else? Chef Marjoram Spoken like the cook you are. I'll never make a chef of you. My darling Jheff. „ — Marlono Rhandle Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party enter the Iron Throne, Enver Gortash remotely triggers explosions which soon collapse the building. Dash ( ) Cover more distance this turn: double your Movement Speed . Range: Self Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Abandoned Journal (Lower City) Explorer only [ edit section | visual editor ] Marlono has 50% more HP and cannot be pushed or shoved. HAV_Survivor Acolyte Marls is an Acolyte of the Absolute at Moonrise Towers , located on the Docks at X: -78 Y: -186 . “ W-worms. Worms in their heads. Worms all over! „ — Marls Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] When speaking with Marls, the interacting party member can ask him about the crates being shipped. If they discover that there are crates filled with a thousand tadpoles, they can use Illithid Persuasion to break down a mental wall Marls put up to block his own knowledge of the contents of the crates. Then, the interacting party member can either convince him to jump off the docks to his death, or rebuild the mental wall: You had best wash them off. [WISDOM]  Guard duty's boring. You're letting your imagination run away with you. (DC 14) Leave. Telling him to wash off the tadpoles causes him to jump off the dock to his death, which grants ⁠ Swimming with the Shadows inspiration for the Dark Urge . All options except the second option cause non-Vengeance paladins to break their oath. Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers , Marls (if alive) is part of the remaining forces defending it. Marls then moves to the rafters above the ground floor's main hall, where he can harass the party and their allies. His combat dialogue varies, depending on if the party previously tore down his mental defences. ST_Vegetables_Small Marpha Golewits is a Human refugee living in Arfur's Mansion in Act Three . She is inside the house along with her husband Ben Golewits and daughter Cinta Golewits . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Marpha Golewits is squatting in a mansion in Rivington . She and her family have nowhere else to stay due to the influx of refugees at Baldur's Gate . Outside the mansion, the landlord Arfur Gregorio has hired mercenaries from the Guild led by Zenovia Dawg . He has plans to evict the family from his home. The party can convince or force Arfur to allow them refuge or offer the refugees 100 Gold to stay elsewhere. Technical UID S_LOW_Park_ElderlyCouple01 UUID a7270d7b-7fc1-4205-a7be-5bef768705fd Stats Human_Commoner Martina Kostaka is an elderly woman separated from her partner in the Lower City during Act Three . “ If you happen to see my husband, do trip him up for me. Every day we do this bloody walk, and every day he wanders off. „ — Martina Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Martina and her partner Bertram were taking a walk in Bloomridge Park but became separated due to Bertram's quick jaunt. Bertram is determined to finish each walk and oblivious to leaving his wife behind. The party can interact with both Martina and Bertram to reunite them. After the battle with the cultists, Martina appears after a long rest, and if her husband died in battle, then Martina's dialogue changes - she says that she cannot find her husband. v t e Lower City Part of the Flock Auntie Ethel welcomes you, dearie. Technical UID S_HAG_Hag_MaskedVictim1 UUID d2832662-4a12-4565-bfe2-094b93ae8af8 Stats HAG_Masked_Druid Eqp. EQP_Club_Leather_Shield The Mask of Regret is a lightfoot halfling member of Auntie Ethel's flock. She is in the Overgrown Tunnel inside the Riverside Teahouse / Gnarled Teahouse in Act One . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Like the other Masks , the Mask of Regret is initially hostile by virtue of wearing a Whispering Mask , placing her under the charming effect of Part of the Flock . Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] If her Whispering Mask is removed as long as the hag is alive, her mind collapses and she dies. Her mask cannot be pickpocketed off of her in the Overgrown Tunnel ; she must be knocked unconscious for it to be looted. If the halfling is encountered after Ethel was killed (taking Ethel's deal and letting her go does not work; taking Ethel's deal and then killing her does), she is no longer hostile and regains her sanity. She explains that she initially sought out Ethel's aid to cure her mother's dementia. Party members with the Folk Hero background then gain the ⁠ Unmasking the Truth inspiration. She alludes to the existence of a hag coven and vows to travel to Baldur's Gate to shore up support for other hag victims. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] The "Mask of Regret", now named Hydrangea Wubb , can be encountered at Old Garlow's Place in the Lower City as part of the quest ⁠ Help the Hag Survivors . Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Mask of Regret must succeed a DC  17 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of each of her turns or become affected by Hag's Pawn . If she succeeds the throw, she passes her turn without harming the party. Curse of Regret ( ) Damage: 2~5 1d4 + 1 ⁠ Psychic Curse a creature with regret. It takes 4~10 Psychic damage every turn, and becomes vulnerable to Psychic damage. EQP_Unarmed Not to be confused with Mask of Servitude (The Blushing Mermaid) The Mask of Servitude is an Asmodeus tiefling member of Auntie Ethel's flock. She is in the Overgrown Tunnel inside the Riverside Teahouse / Gnarled Teahouse in Act One . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Like the other Masks , the Mask of Servitude is initially hostile by virtue of wearing a Whispering Mask , placing her under the Charming effect of Part of the Flock . If she is encountered after Ethel is dead, she is no longer hostile, but her sanity is broken. She remains hostile if Ethel is defeated but the party accept the offer of Hag's Hair and let Ethel escape. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Mask of Servitude must succeed a DC  17 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of each of her turns or become affected by Hag's Pawn . If she succeeds the save, she passes her turn without harming the party. Mask of Servitude acts as a healer and buffer for Auntie Ethel and the other Masks. Boon of Servitude ( ) Bask in Ethel's boons. You regain 2d4+Spellcasting Modifier ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points each turn, and your Armour Class increased by 2. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Throw ( )   –   Heavy Stone Damage Normal weapon damage Throw a character or item from the world or your inventory. Your Strength affects how much weight you can throw. Heavier items deal more damage. The damage of weapons with the thrown property is the same as the weapon's melee damage. Technical UID S_LOW_BlushingMermaid_MaskedVictim_01 UUID 453e3292-b7ff-4a13-873a-82da3bfc2511 Stats LOW_Masked_Bard Mask of Servitude is a dwarven member of Auntie Ethel's flock. She can be found in the The Blushing Mermaid alongside Mask of Vengeance , Mask of Terror , and the real Captain Grisly . “ Come back, Auntie. „ — Mask of Servitude Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Like the other Masks, the Mask of Servitude wanders around the basement area. If the party did not discover Ethel was impersonating Grisly, or antagonised Ethel upstairs, then they all are hostile. However, if the party agreed to Ethel's deal as part of ⁠ Gather Your Allies then they are not hostile and can even be spoken to. Mask of Servitude claims that she used to be ugly until "Auntie made her beautiful". If the party confront Auntie Ethel in the basement's next-door room, then she and other the other members of the flock are teleported into the battle as long as they have not previously been killed or knocked out. They are hostile by virtue of the Whispering Mask , placing them under the Charming effect of Part of the Flock . If the party encounters Mask of Servitude after Ethel is dead, she is no longer hostile, but her sanity is broken. Every other ship's got stripes on its sails. Like asking us to look for a fish with a tail. „ — Matey Tallhamper Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Matey Tallhamper and fellow sailor Dollivar Noot are talking to each other at the docks. They are on the lookout for a ship they were supposed to leave on, unaware it has already left. If Gortash is defeated, Matey Tallhamper and Dollivar Noot leave and can no longer be found. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Matey Tallhamper I'm starting to think they've forgotten about us. Dollivar Noot They'd better not. They haven't even paid us for the shipment yet. Matey Tallhamper I ain't seen no new ships in a while though. Dollivar Noot They can't have sailed off without us, right? Matey Tallhamper Better hope not, I'll run out of coin if I stay here a day longer than I have to. Dollivar Noot I'd kill for a pint of mermaid's breath. These city brews ain't got much bite to 'em. Dollivar Noot Is that The Endless Miracle? Matey Tallhamper No, you conk. It ain't got stripes on the sails. Dollivar Noot Aren't those stripes? I see stripes! Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] During the initial battle for High Hall, a large force of Absolutist cultists coming from the Upper City Sewers destroys the keep and routs the City Watch away from it, forcing what remains of the Watch to flee. Technical UID S_LOW_BrokenDocksFishers_Fisher_03 UUID 6a5819eb-7833-4a93-9140-bd2ab606974b Stats Dwarf_Commoner Matthurny is a dwarven fisherman trying to fish with his buddies in the waters near the Water Queen's House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ Aw, don't worry. Big Liar's just pulling your leg. „ — Matthurny Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Matthurny is on the beach with Big Liar Bronzon and Dim Phimberg with fishing poles and buckets of fish. The group chat with each other about possibly catching a Sahuagin and what that might entail. Bronzon tends to lie and exaggerate, however Phimberg is not too bright and tends to believe her. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Big Liar Bronzon I'm telling you, a sahuagin stole my bait. Dim Phimberg What's a swa-gog-gin? Matthurny A shark-person, Dim. They don't play nice. Dim Phimberg I think I'm afraid of swa-gog-gins. Matthurny Aw, don't worry. Big Liar's just pulling your leg. Big Liar Bronzon Am not. It was a sahuagin, big as life, all fangs and fins. Big Liar Bronzon If we caught a sahuagin, would they buy it at the fish market? Matthurny A sahuagin is more likely to catch you. DEN_Thieflings_Pickpocket_Trade Variant 1 Trs. HAV_Thiefling_Trade Variant 2 Trs. WYR_Thiefling_Trade Mattis is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One . “ Look, I swear to you. These rings are the real deal. I promise I'm not running a scam. „ — Mattis , insisting he is an honest merchant Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Mischievous but good-natured, Mattis works as a scam artist for Mol's child-gang. His younger sister is Silfy . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Mattis and Silfy have a storefront in the Emerald Grove near X: 245 Y: 550 . When a party member first interacts with Mattis, he offers to sell them a 'Magic' Ring . The interacting party character can counter with their own magic trick by passing a check: [ 1 ] [ROGUE] [SLEIGHT OF HAND]  Vanish the ring with a reverse Hammar's Flourish.  (DC 10  ) [SLEIGHT OF HAND]  Mimic his trick and make the ring disappear.  (DC 15) [BARD] [PERFORMANCE]  Spin the ring in an elaborate parlour trick. (DC 10) Otherwise, Mattis attempts to demonstrate a magic trick with the ring but no matter what he successfully call heads or tails. Astute player characters who are rogues , sorcerers , wizards , or warlocks can identify the magic ring as a fake, to which Mattis says he is just trying to make a buck, and offers to sell them his wares. If the interacting party member decides to peruse Mattis' wares, Silfy tries to rob them. On a successful Perception check, they catch Silfy in the act and retrieve the stolen goods. On failure, ⁠ Find Your Belongings is initiated. Stealing Mattis' lucky magic ring before talking to him grants the following inspiration: ⁠ Artful Dodger ( Urchin background) ⁠ Made You Look ( Entertainer background) If ⁠ Save the Refugees is completed, as the tieflings are preparing to leave the Grove, Mattis and Mol argue about the items he wants to bring. At this point he can no longer be traded with until Act Two. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Investigate the Selûnite Resistance If Mattis survives through Act One and Cal , Lia , and Rolan were convinced to stay in the Grove, Mattis travels to the Last Light Inn and is inside with another storefront. Although most of his goods are arguably cheeky and worthless junk with occasional items of note, Mattis can be persuaded to offer or sell a Tower-Shaped Key , which can be used to unlock a location during ⁠ Investigate the Selûnite Resistance . Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If the tiefling children are saved by Rolan in Act Two, Mattis moves his shop to the Requisitioned Barn in Rivington . He states that he looted Moonrise Towers after the party's fight with Ketheric Thorm . Store [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] In Act One, Mattis' shop is in the Emerald Grove near X: 245 Y: 550 . Corresponds to Den_Thieflings_Pickpocket_Trade . Bucket Clamshell Dye Remover Dye Subtable Drops 2 - 6 of each kind rolled Fork Ink Pot Plate Potato Ring of Being Really Invisible Ring of Infinite Wishes Ring of Resistance to Ants Ring of the Lekinesus Shovel Starfish Thieves' Tools If a party member confronts Mattis about Silfy being a thief, the party cannot trade with Mattis through dialogue anymore. In this case only two dialogue options remain (Confront and Leave), though it is still possible to trade with Mattis through using the trade button in the lower left of the screen. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] In Act Two, Mattis' shop is near the entrance to the Last Light Inn. Corresponds to HAV_Thiefling_Trade . Arrow of Sparrow Slaying Cloak of Cunning Brume Decanter of Nearly Endless Water Evasive Shoes Fishing Rod of Alertness Sending Shell Spoon of Saltiness Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] In Act Three, Mattis' shop is outside the Requisitioned Barn in Rivington. Corresponds to WYR_Thiefling_Trade . Corvid Token Elixir of Battlemage's Power Elixir of See Invisibility Potion of Invisibility Scabby Pugilist Circlet Smokepowder Arrow Supreme Elixir of Arcane Cultivation In addition to his old "Magical" items, he now also stocks: Baldur's Gate Stone Holy Hand Soap Supplies [ edit section | visual editor ] The Poor Trader Table consists of 4-6 rolls on the following table. Including the Supply Pack , worth 61.4 Camp Supplies on average. HAG_SurrogateMother Variant 1 UID LOW_HagSurvivors_SheepFormMayrina UUID f50bfec3-5014-48e4-b1a3-2f3a64e421a8 Stats Sheep Mayrina is a human in Act One . She is the widow of Connor Vinderblad and sister to Demir and Johl . “ Auntie Ethel, please. One more bite and this pie is gonna come back up to say hello. „ — Mayrina , after eating Ethel's pie Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Mayrina, who is inside the Riverside Teahouse within the Sunlit Wetlands , seeks the help of Auntie Ethel to resurrect her deceased husband Connor. She is the objective in ⁠ Save Mayrina . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] When the party enter the Riverside Teahouse, Auntie Ethel is force-feeding Mayrina a pie. Inquiring about her or mentioning the fate of her brothers upsets the hag. She then teleports Mayrina to the end of the Overgrown Tunnel . If the party wish to save Mayrina, they must defeat Ethel. After defeating her or making a deal, Mayrina is upset and reveals that she made a deal with the hag, who she believes would have traded her unborn child to resurrect her husband. If a party member uses Speak with Dead on the hag prior to talking with Mayrina, Ethel reveals she planned to eat Mayrina's baby. This unlocks a Persuasion option when speaking with Mayrina. Exploring the Hag's lair Bitter Divorce can be found. After leaving through the mushroom circle, Mayrina can be encountered again next to the casket containing Connor's body at X: -68 Y: 224 . With Bitter Divorce in their inventory, it is possible to offer to try resurrecting Connor. The 'resurrection' results in Connor being returned as a Zombie controlled by the wielder of Bitter Divorce. If the wand is given to Mayrina, she sets off with zombie Connor for Baldur's Gate . Mayrina turns hostile if the party try to kill Connor or if a cleric party member calls on their god to "smite the undead". Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If Auntie Ethel was left with Mayrina in the Sunlit Wetlands or Ethel's deal was accepted and the hag took Mayrina with her, then Mayrina is nowhere to be found in Act Three. Otherwise Mayrina moves to Old Garlow's Place in the Lower City where she works with a group of hag survivors and is polymorphed into a sheep. She can be returned to her original form by casting Remove Curse on either her or the cursed doll that hovers about the room. Alternatively, the doll can be destroyed without killing Mayrina in the process. However, Mayrina takes 1 damage every time the doll is hit. She has 8 health while the doll has 30; it is recommended to destroy the doll in less than 8 hits or to heal Mayrina in time. Mayrina rewards the party upon completing ⁠ Help the Hag Survivors . If Connor traveled with her to Baldur's Gate, she can be convinced to finally bring him peace and snap Bitter Divorce in two. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Mayrina's corpse can be communed with using Speak with Dead , with the exact options depending on various conditions: Where are you from? Mayrina Farm... near... Baldur's Gate... Why did you come to the teahouse? Mayrina Ethel... bring husband... bring back... my Connor. Mayrina In return for... my baby. What is your name? Mayrina Mayrina... Elizabeth... Fenton... How long were you and Connor together? Mayrina Since we were... kids... Mayrina Loved him... more than anything... What can you tell me about your husband? Mayrina CONNOR... his name is... Connor ... Mayrina ... been together... since we were kids... loved him... more than anything. Was going to the hag worth it? Mayrina For Connor... yes. Mayrina But gone... all gone... Was going to the hag worth it? Mayrina Yes... but... urgh ... ruined it. Ruined... everything... Why did you give up your baby? Mayrina Shut UP... ngh ... shut... What drove you to give up your child? Mayrina I can't... without Connor... I... Mayrina Ethel promised... raise the baby... be a good... mother. Did you know that Ethel was a hag? Mayrina Yes. But... she promised... promised to take care of... everything. Do you regret anything? Mayrina My fault... everyone dead... because of me. I'm... cursed. Who are Demir and Johl? Mayrina My big brothers... dead... my fault... my... Who are Demir and Johl? Mayrina My... big brothers... Mayrina ... drove me mad but... loved them... dead now... everyone is... dead. They can add a +1d6 bonus to their next Attack roll , Ability check , or Saving throw . Range: 18 m (60 ft) Faerie Fire ( + ) All targets within the light turn visible, and Attack Rolls against them have Advantage . Technical UID S_LOW_StelmanesDeath_Citizen_01 UUID ffcb13de-e542-4ae3-9f3e-67e29d864eb3 Stats Dwarf_Commoner Megthanet is in Baldur's Gate during Act Three , enjoying thrilling rumors of a recent murder case. “ You eaten at the Elfsong before? Awful, just awful! Had a stew there once that looked like it had a finger in it. „ — Megthanet Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Megthanet and Hilario Varota are at the western entrance of Elfsong Tavern in the Lower City . They are discussing the murder of Duke Stelmane in gory detail. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Hilario Varota I heard it happened right here in the Elfsong. Sliced clean through Stelmane's neck. Megthanet I heard her guts were placed on the ground in the shape of the Absolute's mark! Hilario Varota I always said the Elfsong was haunted. Now it's doubly so. Hilario Varota They never found the head. Makes me wonder how they knew it was Stelmane. Megthanet You can tell all sorts with technology these days. I'm sure she left some hair. Or teeth. Megthanet What would you do with a decapitated head anyway? Not like you could sell it. Hilario Varota I can think of a thing or two. Nothing good, though. Megthanet I'm never eating at the Elfsong again. What if there were bits. If Enver Gortash is killed: Hilario Varota First Stelmane, and now Gortash! If the higher-ups aren't safe, what hope do we have? Megthanet I heard Gortash was strangled with a piece of his own intestine! Hilario Varota As if Stelmane's death wasn't horrid enough. Hilario Varota I wonder who will take charge now that Gortash is gone. Megthanet Whoever it is, good luck to them. Those Absolutists won't stop just because there's a power vacuum. Hilario Varota Probably responsible for his death, if you ask me. Megthanet I always said he was doing too good a job. Better than Stelmane, in any case. Megthanet Do you really think it was Absolutists that killed him? Hilario Varota Them or a disgruntled citizen. Megthanet These dukes need to start improving their security. If they can't keep themselves alive, how can we expect them to protect us? v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the Lower City Anti-Hag Support Group Adrielle Hydrangea Wubb Jatlo Kled Mayrina DEN_Kid Meli is a tiefling pickpocket who works for Mol's children's gang in the Emerald Grove . “ You're the first grown-up who's ever gotten in here. Not bad. „ — Meli , if Mol welcomes the party into the hideout Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] If Aradin Beno and his crew leave the Emerald Grove, Meli is in the Tiefling Hideout X: 87 Y: 71 , practicing pickpocketing on a dummy. Pickpocketing Barth [ edit section | visual editor ] If Aradin's crew stays for a drink, Meli spawns in the Hollow at X: 174 Y: 544 pretending to search an open crate while the crew heads to a nearby table. The party can watch Meli steal a Brass Locket from Barth's pocket and run up the ladder where Barth catches him. Initiating conversation with either one allows the choice to intervene and protect Meli, convince him to return the locket, or let Barth do what he wants. This starts ⁠ Return the Locket . There are four options: Protect Meli: "Don't lay a finger on that child." ( DC 10 Persuasion Check or DC 10 Intimidation Check ) and he runs off with the locket. Convince Meli to return the locket: ( DC 5 Persuasion Check or DC 15 Intimidation Check ) and he might be persuaded to reveal that he stole the locket because it reminded him of his mother's. Let Barth strike Meli: the locket falls out of his pocket, and the nearby guard Ikaron comes over to investigate the disturbance. If a party member has already pickpocketed the locket from Meli, it is possible to return it to Barth: "He's good, but I'm better." This both impresses Meli and placates Barth. After the encounter, Meli runs to the Tiefling Hideout near the practice dummy and Barth returns to his crew at the table in The Hollow. If the party speak with Barth afterward, he may reveal that the locket was given to him by his mother while she was on her deathbed. If the party allow Meli to take the locket, it can be recovered from the Tiefling Hideout and returned to Barth. He can then be persuaded to tell a backstory about the locket and its importance to him. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Meli will complain to Mattis as they are packing for Baldur's Gate: Meli Hands off, Mattis! I earned this! Mattis I helped you earn it. Meli Well, I'm stealin' on my own when we get to Baldur's Gate. Mattis Fine by me. I bet there's plenty of adults with loose pockets there. Meli will also be scolded by Mol: Mol Can you two help? Anything you don't pack is getting left behind. Meli We can always get more stuff later. Mattis Yeah! In the city. Mol You won't get there if we starve on the way. Gonna rob your friends when you're hungry? Meli No way. Mol Then pack. EQP_Unarmed Trs. DEN_Refugee Memnos is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter in the Emerald Grove in Act One . He and Arka are close friends. “ Lathander to light, Selûne to guide, Kelemvor to show mercy - „ — Memnos , performing last rites for the dead Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Memnos is initially at the gates of Emerald Grove in the aftermath of the conflict that was caused by Aradin and his party being chased by goblins . He is consoling his friend Arka on the Emerald Grove Ramparts, who is grieving the murder of her brother Kanon . After Arka picks up a crossbow to execute the goblin prisoner Sazza , he follows her with the intent to calm her down. If the party travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before resolving Kagha's ritual the Rite of Thorns , the tieflings are expelled from the Emerald Grove and Memnos' corpse is among the pile of refugees near the bridge to the Blighted Village . Emerald Grove raid [ edit section | visual editor ] If Minthara discovers the Grove's location and begins a raid on the grove, Memnos moves to pray. Passing a passive DC 10 Religion Check reveals he is cowering, praying in fear to Kelemvor , the god of death. If Lae'zel is present, she chides that she smells cowardice. The party can convince him to rejoin the defence of the grove by passing one of the following checks: [RELIGION]  Kelemvor judges cowards more harshly than others. Better if you die in combat. (DC 10)  (if passive Religion check passed) [INTIMIDATION]  Better if you die in combat then live on as a coward. (DC 15)  (if passive Religion check failed) [LAE'ZEL] [INTIMIDATION]  I'll kill you myself if you don't grab a weapon and join the line. (DC 10) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  FIGHT, COWARD.  (DC 15  ) [PERSUASION]  You have to try. We need every able body, or we're doomed. (DC 15) [BARD] [PERSUASION]  Songs will be sung for today's heroes. Do your part, and your name will live on. (DC 10) [FIGHTER]  Every fighter was once a novice. Better that than a victim. [CLERIC OF KELEMVOR]  My god abhors cowards. If you do nothing, your fate is sealed in his eyes. If he is successfully persuaded, Memnos leaves towards the gate and joins the fight. Otherwise, he continues cowering. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If Memnos survives through Act One, his murdered corpse is in the Shadow-Cursed Lands at X: -9 Y: 54 among the other tiefling refugees who failed to reach the Last Light Inn . Technical UID S_LOW_GondianWoker_15 UUID 1eb9d68b-2d0d-4b62-ba8f-0d8b01f08b53 Stats Gnome_Gondian_Caster Menalda is a gnomish member of the Church of Gond , and can be found at the Steel Watch Foundry during Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Menalda can only be seen during and right after the conclusion of the quest ⁠ Disable the Steel Watch if Zanner Toobin accompanied the party but died in the process. To get her to appear, the party must go to the Iron Throne and return. Zanner will initiate a revolution and after the fight on the ground floor, after which the player must tell Zanner that his daughter is safe (or successfully deceive him into thinking so). Zanner will offer to help destroy the Steel Watch Foundry, to which the party can accept: Zanner Toobin Our destination is the Neurocitor - the nerve centre of the Steel Watch. Guide me there, and I'll do the rest. Agreed - let's finish this. Doing so causes him to send the surviving Gondians outside of the factory while he also joins the party as a temporary companion . The party can then kill him or let him die on the way to the control centre. Once he is dead, the party needs an alternate way of destroying the Neurocitor, either by using the Runepowder Bomb from Wulbren Bongle or by obtaining the code, since Zanner is not alive to do it himself. If done correctly, when the Steel Watch Foundry is blown up Menalda runs out of the building instead of Zanner and gathers with the rest of the Gondians outside of the foundry before being approached by Wulbren. Chamberlain Mercer In-game Portrait Identity Male Voice / Actor Charles Armstrong Hometown Baldur's Gate Stats Size Small Type Humanoid Race Gnome Subrace Rock gnome Balanced Balanced Difficulty Stats Level 1 HP 8 AC 10 Initiative 0 Proficiency +2 Movement 7.5 m (25 ft) Weight 35 kg (70 lb) Darkvision 12 m (40 ft) XP reward 1 Ability scores STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) Saving throws STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 0 0 0 0 0 0 Technical UID S_LOW_YellingHighServant UUID ae833e8a-5787-4bd3-950d-b44fbf47df41 Stats Gnome_Commoner Chamberlain Mercer is a gnome employee to Lady Jannath , who can potentially be found in Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City . “ Why does Tarhun hire such people? They're clearly incorrigible. „ — Mercer Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Mercer can only be found berating Servant Bailey on the second floor of the manor if Oskar Fevras was never rescued from Brem in Act One. If not intervening, Bailey is fired and leaves on his own. The party can prevent this by talking with Mercer and passing one of the following ability checks: [PERSUASION]  That's rude. Do you want me to report to your employer that a guest was shocked by your rudeness? (DC 18) [INTIMIDATION]  I don't like bullies. Apologise to this man or you'll regret it. (DC 18) Afterwards, Mercer patrols the upper floors of the manor and ejects the party members if they are caught upstairs. Technical UID S_MOO_EntranceGuard_002 UUID 2ab30cea-d3f1-4aa4-8c83-b8b700ef0048 Stats MOO_FanaticOfTheAbsolute_Human Eqp. EQP_Staff_Magic_Scalemail Trs. MOO_Cultist Adept Merim is a True Soul adept of the Cult of the Absolute in Act Two . She is stationed at the stairs leading into Moonrise Towers , guarding the entrance from intruders and assisting True Soul Malik in vetting new arrivals. “ Plenty of supplies if you're running low, True Soul. „ — Merim Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If party members are observed approaching the main entrance to Moonrise Towers for the first time, Merim stops them and lets Malik probe at their tadpoles through the use of his own . Upon recognizing them as True Souls , Malik asks for news from the field; no matter the response, Merim notes that Disciple Z'rell is in the audience chamber, and would want to hear from them. Minthara's escape [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Decide Minthara's Fate If Minthara is freed from the Moonrise Towers Prison , the party can lead her out of Moonrise Towers through the main entrance. Passing by Merim and Malik results in their blocking the party's path, demanding an explanation as to why Minthara is not in her cell. If Merim is convinced the party has the authority to escort her out (or that she has been fully subjugated), they are satisfied and the party can leave peacefully; [ 1 ] otherwise Merim and Malik become hostile. Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Merim is killed during the subsequent battle. Her corpse is at the bottom of the stairs of the main door entering Moonrise, at X: -153 Y: -130 . Technical UID S_LOW_CazadorsPalace_GuardTower_Guard_001 UUID e0f6ebdc-e19a-4ae4-a487-f192b9edcfac Stats LOW_CazadorsPalace_GuardTower_Dwarf_Ranger “ Of course, whatever the master desires. Enter freely and of your own will. [ 1 ] „ — Merony , if successfully deceived [ 2 ] Merony is a gold dwarf guard stationed at the top of the ladder in the Central Watch Tower in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Merony confronts the party the first time they climb the ladder, stating that entry to the Szarr Palace is forbidden. The party can make a passive DC 15 Insight Check to determine that she is just a drone and is not quite 'all there'. The interacting character can then attempt to move forward by passing an ability check: [INTIMIDATION]  Another word from you and you'll fly out of this tower. (DC 15) [DECEPTION]  I am inspecting the security, on your master's orders. (DC 15) [ROGUE] [DECEPTION]  Cazador hired me for a job - it's very hush, hush. If you don't let me in, he's going to be most upset. (DC 15  ) Or the party can attack the guards: I'm here to kill Cazador Szarr. Attack. If Astarion is the one intiating the conversation, she tells him that he should be at the ritual and must not be late; no check is then required to pass. Casting Greater Restoration or similar on Merony or her companions causes them to play voice lines such as "All I remember is wanting to serve him." They vanish after their voice line is played. Technical UID Merregon UUID 9bbee0e3-4141-4561-9543-15d3a21000f4 Stats Merregon Eqp. EQP_Merregon_Halberd Merregon Legionnaire is a Merregon creature in Baldur's Gate 3 . Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] One Merregon Legionnaire is in a locked room in Grymforge , accompanied by three Hellsboar . It attacks on sight. The door can be opened by passing a DC 18 Sleight of Hand Check or using the Tarnished Silver Key . Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Several other Merregon Legionnaires and a Hoarding Merregon are participants in Yurgir's ambush in the Gauntlet of Shar . If Yurgir is pacified, they move to lounge beside a campfire at X: -664 Y: -760 . Technical UID S_LOW_BloomridgeParanoia_ElfLocal UUID 01bf1f19-906d-49f6-92ae-2140132e4bde Stats Elf_Commoner Merriolle is an elven civilian confronting Bastian d'Zinn after the latter harshly criticized Rhaneld for a prank with a pebble outside Elerrathin's Home in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ Almost coming to blows over a pebble. What's this city coming to? „ — Merriolle Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Merriolle is among a group of civilians who disagree with Bastian calling them "rabble" and "gutter-trash". She is astonished that a simple prank is at the top of Bastian's mind right now. If Gortash is defeated, Merriolle and Bastian as well as the rest of the crowd disperse, and cannot be found or interacted with again. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Merriolle chimes in on the banter between Bastian d'Zinn and other characters. Bastian d'Zinn Is this what the city is coming to? A man cannot stroll the thoroughfare without being assaulted by juvenile thugs? Rhaneld It was just a pebble. Bastian d'Zinn Just a pebble? A pebble could take out an eye, break a tooth, enter an open mouth and block a gullet. Bastian d'Zinn Is that what you wish? Do you wish to choke me to death? Perhaps loot my purse after? Thyssa Shineboot Ease up, won't you? It was just a tiny stone bounced off your rump, not a ballista bolt. Bastian d'Zinn Precisely the attitude that is ruining this city! No pride! No discipline! No consequences! Bastian d'Zinn Gutter-filth. And I suppose your mother squeezed out a whole litter just like you. Filling the damn city to the brim like a slop-bucket. Bastian d'Zinn You're just the sort that Lord Gortash warns us of. Just the sort he'll deal with. Rhaneld I'm sorry... Bastian d'Zinn You will be. Once order is restored. Tylman Sands Hear, hear. Merriolle 'Hear, hear'? Surely you can't agree with how he's talking to a child? It's out of order! Tylman Sands My shop's pilfered from every day by runts like him. City should be for proper folk, who earn their crust. Bastian d'Zinn There was a time when we'd have a pillory in the Wide, small enough even for street pups like you. Bastian d'Zinn Perhaps Lord Gortash will revive that grand tradition. Rhaneld I won't do it again, I swear. Merriolle Don't you have nothing else to do but browbeat this boy? Bastian d'Zinn And what do you propose? Just let him run amuck, no lesson heeded? Bastian d'Zinn I doubt he has a father to discipline him - probably dead in an alley or drunk in a tavern. Rhaneld No, he works. At the docks. Bastian d'Zinn Oh, I'm sure. Gutting fish, is he? Or perhaps he works the street corner? Nothing would surprise me with your kind. Thyssa Shineboot I don't care if the lad threw a bloody boulder at you - that's out of line! Rhaneld I said I'm sorry. Can I go now? Bastian d'Zinn You can go when I'm through with you, little brat. Thyssa Shineboot You've had your say, now clear off. Go back to the Upper City. Merriolle Why are you here, anyway? Bastian d'Zinn I am a gentleman who may venture where he pleases - it is you who must mind where they go, and do not forget it! v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the Lower City Anti-Hag Support No matter how much I wanted to." " Down by the Blushing Mermaid, there's a stink of something fey . Smells of arse, too, but boss doesn't care about that." "Boss says this work makes us honorary... Harlots? Harpies? Sounds nice." "I bring word of gnomes. Gnomes in the sea ". " Mer-gnomes! EQP_Shortsword_Leather_Torch Trs. HAV_Survivor Harper Meygan is part of a small group of Harpers on a patrol expedition to the hills east of Last Light Inn during Act Two . [ 1 ] [ 2 ] “ I'd rather die myself than see another Harper taken. „ — Meygan Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Meygan can be encountered near the entrance to the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Grymforge lift as part of a Harper expedition led by Lassandra , which consists of herself, Karrow , and Yonas . Shortly after meeting the party, Yonas is ambushed and corrupted by a Shadow , causing him to become a Shadow-Cursed Undead . Immediately after Yonas' demise, a battle with the ambushing Shadows begins. Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] If Lassandra survives the fight, she speaks with the party again and marks a safe location on their map, known as Last Light Inn . If Lassandra dies in the fight, Meygan speaks with the party. However, she does not offer to mark the party's map. Instead, she instructs them to follow her to the Inn's safety. If the party enter the Shadow-Cursed Lands through the Rosymorn Monastery Trail and start ⁠ Follow the Convoy instead, the party can reach Last Light Inn and observe Meygan returning to the sanctuary with Lassandra and Karrow. If the party visit the Last Light Inn, Karrow is mourning Yonas on a rocky ledge south of the docks. If Meygan survives the ambush, she is also kneeling before Yonas' shrine. Speaking with her reveals she had developed feelings towards Yonas, but he lost his life before she could confess to him. Talking to her grants the following inspiration: ⁠ Tragic Love ( Acolyte background) ⁠ Memento Mori ( Entertainer background) A party member can offer her Yonas' Harper Blade . If they do, she provides gold in return for this memento. However, after Marcus assaults the Last Light Inn, the option to return the blade to Meygan is no longer available. Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Meygan is too far away from the action to provide any help in the ensuing fight. If Isobel is not saved, Meygan and everyone else at the Last Light Inn, save for Jaheira , turn into Shadow-Cursed Undead . Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Meygan, along with Lassandra, Mijah , and Karrow do not join the assault against Absolute forces. She remains at the Last Light Inn to patrol its outskirts, before completely disappearing once Ketheric Thorm is defeated. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Shortsword Damage: 4~9 1d6 + 3 ⁠ Piercing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) [ 3 ] [ 4 ] Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] Harper Karrow Harper Lassandra Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Leather Armour [ 5 ] Shortsword Torch Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Follow the Convoy ⁠ Infiltrate Moonrise Towers ⁠ Resolve the Abduction ⁠ Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Meygan has three different, albeit very faint tattoos on her face despite player characters only being able to have one: Cursed Rose, Migration, and Sharp Candelabra. ↑ Meygan, much like Karrow , Lassandra , and Yonas , are the only level 5 Harpers in Act Two . All other Harpers in Last Light Inn are level 6, except for Jaheira , who is level 8. However, it is possible to have Lassandra, Karrow and Meygan "level up" to level 6 by using fast travel to a waypoint in the Rosymorn Monastery Trail , for example Rosymorn Monastery. ↑ Meygan has four level 1 spell slots and two level 2 spell slots, despite having no spell to cast. ↑ As of Patch 6 and after, despite having Extra Attack , Meygan is not able to attack twice during her turns. ↑ Meygan wears a set of armor similar to the Studded Leather Armour set, but with a scarf covering the collar of the outfit. Technical UID S_LOW_BaldursGate_FlamingFist_Ranger_001 UUID 08d0dcec-a5c3-4099-922c-2a0b8b97fcd6 Stats FlamingFist_Human_Ranger Fist 'Deadeye' Mibbs is a human ranger and a member of the Flaming Fist . He can be found in Lower City in Act Three . “ Leave! Before you have nothing left to go back to. „ — Mibbs Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Mibbs is standing watch on the far end of the bridge at the Upper City Gate Checkpoint . He watches over the queue of residents trying to make their way into the Upper City together with Fist Healer Darbonna and Fist Granitdatter . However, Darbonna actually has received the orders to not let anyone "unauthorized" into the Upper City. Unbeknownst to everyone around him but Darbonna, Mibbs is infected with a Mind Flayer Tadpole . Should the party make it to the end of the bridge and enact dialogue with Darbonna [ 1 ] , Mibbs joins the conversation, stopping Darbonna and welcoming the party into the Upper City [ 2 ] , while The Emperor chimes in (as it repeatedly does while crossing the bridge), warning that the party are being fooled, and urging them to turn back at once. Passing a DC 15 Insight Check reveals that Mibbs' behaviour is not his own, and he is being controlled (presumably by the Netherbrain ). If the party return to the city after acquiring all Netherstones , three infected refugees near the queue transform into Mind Flayers and attack the bypassers. Mibbs is Surprised , but fights alongside the party. Once the Mind Flayers are dead, he and all the Fists around run away to warn their superiors, before completely vanishing from the game once far enough. Technical UID S_MOO_WallTentacle_Ogress UUID c3b872b8-1937-4255-9d0c-29e490afd033 Stats Ogre Trs. MOO_WallTentacleOgress_Trade Mig is an ogre working for the Cult of the Absolute in Moonrise Towers . She loves meat and claims to hear "meat-things" moving in the walls. “ Hush. Meat sounds above. Hear? „ — Mig Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] In Moonrise Towers , Mig can be observed listening to the ceiling. If the party speak with her she explains that she hears "meat-sounds" moving inside the walls. She heard the noises most clearly above the kitchen, but is not allowed back in there because she tried to pet the gnolls. If the party follow her tip to explore the kitchen, they can discover 'Mucus' dripping down from the rafters above. Climbing a nearby ladder reveals the source of this mucus as the Cracked wall , which an interacting party member can make an Arcana check against and reach inside to figure out more about what is going on. Failing an ability check against the wall results in the interacting party member getting a Dislocated Shoulder until long rest, although doing so also provides a unique cut-scene which gives the party crucial giveaways about the true nature of the Absolute . Passing the check can result in witty comments from companions . After investigating the wall, the party can return and inform Mig her suspicions were correct. HAV_Survivor Harper Mijah is a calm and collected Harper veteran who patrols the upper floor of Last Light Inn during Act Two . [ 2 ] “ You're lucky Jaheira gave you the all-clear, or I'd be looking at you next. „ — Mijah , warning the party Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Mijah is at the Last Light Inn, where she patrols the entirety of the inn's upper floor, as well as stands guard at each end's balcony. Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Mijah is not affected by the Impaled condition and is instead Surprised . If the party fail to protect Isobel, she and everyone in Last Light Inn turns into a Shadow-Cursed Undead , save for Jaheira . Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Mijah does not join the assault against Absolute forces. She remains at the Last Light Inn and continues patrolling the same path she usually takes atop the inn, before completely disappearing once Ketheric Thorm is defeated. Technical UID S_EPI_DivineBard UUID 4a0c8230-f2f0-4bf0-89bc-b16989ea824c Stats EPI_DivineBard Milil is a divine entity encountered in the Epilogue . He is a dour bard who plays a Lute and supplements his music with a band of spiritual instruments. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Milil is a minor deity of song, who was cast out of Faerûn's pantheon and banished to the Fugue Plane by Cyric . Withers pulled him back to "honour the worthy" with his songs. The player character can pass a passive Religion Check during conversation to recognize him, greatly improving his spirits. Alternatively, the player character can pretend to recognize him by passing a DC 18 Deception Check . He functions as a jukebox for the Epilogue celebration; talking to him allows the player character to change the song that is playing. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Milil is immune to all damage. If attacked, he casts Vicious Mockery until the player character is nearly downed, then vanishes from the celebration entirely. Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Vicious Mockery ( ) Damage: 4~32 2d8 ⁠ Psychic + 2d8 ⁠ Radiant Insult a creature: it has Disadvantage on its next Attack roll . WIS Save Range: 26 m (87 ft) Divine Performance [ edit section | visual editor ] Milil plays six new variations of songs: "Ale of Balduran" - a version of the "Song of Balduran" "Bard Dance" "New Light" - a version of "Last Light" "Streets and Faces" "We Live Another Day" - a version of "I Want to Live" "Endless Spring" - a new song specific to the epilogue Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Milil bears a close physical resemblance to Baldur's Gate 3 composer Borislav Slavov . [1] Will de Renzy-Martin was the final actor to be cast in Baldur's Gate 3 . In-Game Performance [ edit section | visual editor ] Load video YouTube YouTube might collect personal data. Better to move with the times, I say. „ — Milon Tillerturn Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Before the ceremony he sits among other patriars on the pews in central nave of the Audience Hall. After the ceremony ends, Lord Tillerturn moves to the southern nave of the Audience hall and stands near the first table with refreshments. If spoken to, he says that he never thought he would see the day when a commoner was made an Archduke. If the party choose to confront Gortash, they can later find Lord Milon along with all other invited guests and their retinue – slaughtered in the Audience hall. GOB_DeadMindFlayer The Mind flayer can be found in a weakened, dying state on the Ravaged Beach during Act One . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] The mind flayer is trapped beneath debris in the Nautiloid Wreck . If a party member interacts with it, it attempts to telepathically control and have them lean in so it can consume their brain. The party member can attempt to resist through the following options: [WISDOM]  Resist the intrusion with everything you have.  (DC 5) [DRACONIC BLOODLINE] [CHARISMA]  You host the blood of a mighty dragon. Channel its will to resist the abomination.  (DC 5  ) [WILD MAGIC] [CHARISMA]  Steel your will and allow your untamed magic to unbalance the creature's mind.  (DC 5  ) [SORCERER] [CHARISMA]  Draw on your willpower. Improvise a mental shield against the creature's hungry mind.  (DC 5  ) Failing to resist, or willingly submitting to the mind flayer, causes their immediate death. The mind flayer then recovers hit points, becoming a weakened mind flayer, and is hostile to any remaining party members. Otherwise, the interacting party member ends the mind flayer's life. A Dark Urge character then gains the the inspiration ⁠ To Sleep, Perchance To Dream Tentacled Dreams . v t e Ravaged Beach Characters Bandits Andorn Barton Cefrey Gimblebock Haseid Mari Quelenna Taman Torgga Warryn Corpses Ellie Francis Marcus Tiefling Refugees Damays Nymessa Camp Followers Withers Companions Astarion Gale Lae'zel Shadowheart Other Mind Flayer Scared Boar Locations Chapel Entrance Overgrown Ruins Nautiloid Wreck Roadside Cliffs Quests Daughter of Darkness Explore the Ruins Find a Cure Find the Githyanki Creche Free Lae'zel The Githyanki Warrior The Pale Elf The Wizard of Waterdeep
