It does not know.* Leave.   (if no questions asked) Naaber Wait... we have... only... just... started... talking... Leave.   (if one question asked) Naaber Don't... leave... yet... Leave.   (if two questions asked) Naaber Don't... you... want... to... know... more... Naaber About... my... life? Leave.   (if three questions asked) Naaber Why... are... you... leaving... me... Naaber I... have so much... more... to tell... you... Narrator "His body longs to rest, but his spirit doesn't stop talking, even as he returns to what one can only hope are the deepest depths of the Hells." Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Naaber does not always approach the party first, nor does he always follow them around. For example, if first approached by a fighter and choosing the conversation option, "Here's a tip from a real fighter - less talking, more fighting." Naaber comments on finding something to punch, ends the conversation and remains by the tall mirror. If he does not follow the party, further interactions can still be held with him there, progressing through all the class options and (eventually) earning the unmarked quest. MOO_Cultist Zealot Nadi is a half-orc Zealot of the Absolute . He is in Moonrise Towers in Act Two , stationed next to the cells in Moonrise Towers Prison . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Nadi is in the Moonrise Towers Prison , standing guard at the very end of the prison's walkable space. Should the party attempt to ⁠ help the gnomes and ⁠ tieflings escape from the prison, Nadi can join The Warden in pursuit of the escapees should the cells be opened (either by the party, or by the Warden). Nadi can then engage the prisoners in combat and kill them if the party does not intervene. Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Nadi is killed during the subsequent battle. His corpse is situated on the bridge leading into Moonrise Towers proper, surrounded by Holy Fire , at X: -154 Y: -113 . DEN_Stargazer Nadira is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One . “ I talked an erinyes out of her favourite soul coin without blinking. And you're not half as scary as she was. „ — Nadira on acquiring her Soul Coin Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Nadira escaped Elturel in possession of a Soul Coin . She first appears during a cutscene at the end of the Prologue , peering through a telescope as the Nautiloid crashes onto the Ravaged Beach . Nadira credits her mother for her ability to see through Fiends and their servants. [ 1 ] . When Nadira was sixteen, she ran away from home, presumably because of her difficult relationship with her mother. [ 2 ] . It is unknown whether their strained relationship was due to her mother being a warlock . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Nadira is on top of a hill east of the entrance to the Emerald Grove, where a Bugbear Assassin is stalking her. Nadira's survival is time sensitive . If the party approach close enough to her location but do not intervene, the Bugbear Assassin kills her, and her corpse can be looted for the Soul Coin. If the party intervene and kill the Bugbear Assassin quickly enough, they can speak with Nadira. Although the party saved her life, she accuses them of being hires from Avernus , sent to retrieve her Soul Coin . The interacting party member can then try to convince her to hand it over. I've been to Avernus, but I'm no devil's servant. [PERSUASION]  A mind flayer abducted me, and its ship went straight to Avernus. (DC 5  ) [INTIMIDATION]  No, I don't. But that coin of yours is mine. (DC 10  ) [INTIMIDATION]  How about this? You give me the coin. Now.  (DC 5) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  No. Coin. Now.  (DC 10  ) [DECEPTION]  You got me. Hand the coin over and I'll be on my way. (DC 5  ) [PALADIN]  The path I follow is far more noble - if you possess a devil's artefact, you should leave it in my charge. If the interacting party member fails the Deception check, she realises that they are lying. This results in one last ability check to obtain the coin peacefully: [INTIMIDATION]  You hand the coin over, or I kill you. How about that? (DC 5  ) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  COIN. OR. DEATH.  (DC 5  ) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  Bad liar, but good killer. The coin - now.  (DC 5  ) If Karlach speaks with Nadira, these two dialogue options cause Nadira to immediately part with the Soul Coin out of pity: I'm Karlach. If you've spent any time in Avernus, you might've heard of me. I ran away from Zariel's service the first chance I got. I'm making a new life now. Peering through Nadira's telescope shows a glimpse of a red dragon , possibly Qudenos , circling near the Mountain Pass . The telescope can be rotated left or right, bringing into focus the Nautiloid Wreck or Waukeen's Rest , respectively. Her father, Madalitso , is trying to convince her to meet with the Nielsens' son for marriage because creditors are clawing at their door. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Nafula can be heard trying to refuse her father's insistence that she marry the Nielsens' son. Madalitso Honey, we're desperate . We need the Nielsens' money. Nafula I don't even know him, dad. Madalitso But you know me. Do you think I would choose a poor match for my daughter? Nafula Dad, you're picking a husband for me, not a new dress! Nafula What about what I want? Does that not matter? Madalitso Choice is a luxury, honey. One your family cannot afford. Madalitso Your mother and I had an arranged marriage, honey - it's not so bad. Nafula Wow - you're really selling it, dad. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] She accompanies Lady Madeline Whitburn and after the ceremony moves to the northern nave of the Audience hall. Naiske patiently forbears her mistress' constantly changing whims on refreshments she would like to try. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Madeline Whitburn Naiske, bring me a plate of the cold-water pike. Naiske The cook has prepared no pike today, my lady. Madeline Whitburn A most grievous error. In that case, fetch me a bowl of sunfish-head stew. Naiske The kitchen is fresh out of sunfish, my lady. Madeline Whitburn Well, I never . Naiske If that is all, my lady - Madeline Whitburn Cheese. Something cut fresh from the wheel. Naiske I'll have to inquire with Cook Darlie about... Madeline Whitburn Ah, Naiske. Why must you make everything such a bother? Madeline Whitburn I so fancy a glass of Dragondew. Fetch me a bottle, and be quick about it. Naiske At once, my lady. Would you... Madeline Whitburn Ah, never you mind - a young Pink Clarry [ 1 ] would more suit the occasion. Bring it at once. Naiske Pink Clarry it is, my good lady. Madeline Whitburn Ah, but perhaps a mint wine. My palate needs cleansing. Though I've grown quite fond of Evermead... MOO_Cultist Pilgrim Nalira is a dwarf in Moonrise Towers in Act Two . “ The Absolute Herself called us here. They cannot stop us from seeing Z'rell now! „ — Nalira Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Nalira is in the main hall of Moonrise Towers at X: -163 Y: -176 . She is part a group of new Absolutist pilgrims, consisting of her, Farimorn , Iong , Sul , and Taima . They are observed by Belub , who shows contempt for the pilgrims, and remarks on their lack of skills and usefulness. The party can either convince Belub to keep the pilgrims, or tell him to get rid of them. [PERSUASION]  They have potential. Great warriors have grown from less. (DC 14) It's not our place to question the Absolute's will. Then get rid of them. The undeserving should be purged. The first two options result in Belub sending them to the war camp west of Reithwin , where the pilgrims then disappear. Telling Belub to get rid of the pilgrims results in their deaths. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Pilgrim Nalira Where do you hail from, brother? Pilgrim Fairmorn I was a farrier in Dessarin Valley. Then the dreams came. Pilgrim Iong My brothers had the dreams too, same as me. But they wouldn't admit it. Pilgrim Nalira The Absolute calls us all to Her design. Your family will answer - eventually. Pilgrim Taima To stand this close to Her power... I never thought I'd make it. Pilgrim Iong I wouldn't have, if not for the lantern-bearer. To think the Absolute graces such a creature as that... Pilgrim Fairmorn We are each of us threads in Her design. Even those we once called monsters. Pilgrim Nalira Brothers. Sister. Pray with me while we wait. Pilgrim Fairmorn I'm not worthy. I... I never learned the words. Pilgrim Nalira Yes, you did. She gives them to you fully formed. Can you hear Her? Pilgrim Fairmorn Of many hearts, one soul. Of many thoughts, one mind... Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party go to camp between defeating the Cult of the Absolute members at Moonrise Towers and going the rooftop, they may find Talli fighting against Farimorn and the other pilgrims of the Absolute Iong , Nalira, Sul , and Taima . LOW_SteepsTrader_BooksAndScrolls Nansi Gretta is a character in Act Three who owns The Bibliophile , a bookstore in the Lower City X: -109 Y: -123 . “ My stall's no Candlekeep Library, I'll admit. But I've got a few nice finds tucked away. „ — Nansi Gretta Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Nansi Gretta sells books and scrolls , including Scrolls of Revivify . Nansi donated several copies of Lord Gortash's memoirs to the refugees at Baldur's Gate, as recorded in the Donation Record . Her Attitude towards the party often changes depending on the outcome of ⁠ Stop the Presses . Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Bookshop Chest Key Store [ edit section | visual editor ] Corresponds to LOW_SteepsTrader_BooksAndScrolls . Scroll of Revivify Various Books including: A History of the Flaming Fist One Night in Nashkel Scaled Scions of Abeir Yoshimo is Willing Various Scrolls Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Dinner at Candlekeep? Donation Record Letter from Morgan Manuscript The Bibliophile Recommends To Baldur's Gate Book Club, with apologies Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Nansi Gretta is an exceptionally easy trader to steal from because she is alone in an isolated room. Technical UID S_WYR_SharessCaress_NymphRoom_Nymph UUID bc3a5dac-3179-4a7c-bd3f-1391eb6d5497 Stats Elf_Commoner Naoise Nallinto is a Wood Elf courtesan working at Sharess' Caress in Wyrm's Crossing . “ But no tale did justice to its ethereal beauty. It floats like a butterfly, its blood shimmers like silver. „ — Naoise Nallinto commenting on the mind flayer she just saw Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Naoise (standard Irish pronunciation “NEE-sha” – /ˈniːʃə/) is on the third floor of the building in her room Nymph's Grotto at X: 23 Y: 85 . The party can first learn about her when entering Sharess' Caress and talking with Mamzell Amira ; she mentions that they have a "nymph", but she is currently busy with a client. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Upon entering the room Nymph's Grotto a cutscene begins. The player character and the client Fist Jara have a moment of tadpole connection. Jara announces that she recognizes the player character, as the Absolute has shown her. This triggers her transformation into a Mind Flayer and a fight begins. Afterwards, when talking with Naoise, she expresses admiration of the mind flayer's beauty. Passing a DC 10 Insight Check grants additional dialogue choices [ verify ] , allowing the interacting party member to comment on her arousal towards the mind flayer. This opens up an option to the experience of her rapture. Accepting Naoise's proposition earns the following inspiration: ⁠ Alternative Vocations ( Guild Artisan background) ⁠ Exsanguinated Ecstacy ( Haunted One background) ⁠ Giving a Private Performance ( Entertainer background) Reward [ edit section | visual editor ] Default reward: Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation If rapture is experienced: Rapture , a temporary passive buff v t e Wyrm's Crossing Characters Cultists of Bhaal Gavv Hemm Lunn Zoll Flaming Fists Azari Edwynna Elin Falcäo Gai Meadows Mîran Shah Carm's Garms Naaber Slozy Arminifer Trinigan Gazotts Vinegaroon Danthelon's Dancing Axe Geraldus Limmy Safyre Somi Tairn Fraygo's Flophouse Bernyr Crak Dalyria Dashkent Moliver Drim Ffion Goldgrind Petras Rilia Rosanna Sharess' Caress Amira Arfur Gregorio Borgus Elamin Chapeau Chorizo Cillian Earspoon Embry Ghainemeir Hakeem Irenya Jara Kira Korrilla Laila Naoise Nallinto Nym Orlith Raphael Rhol Sorn Orlith Surixana Valeria Voss Other Kali Hammerhand Neno Quilltop Traders Carmen Pennygood Entharl Danthelon Glynda Oltower Griska Hoots Hooligan Queelia Arvis Roberon Silt Stylin' Horst Thodric Shedeveer Velson Oakes Locations Carm's Garms Danthelon's Dancing Axe Fraygo's Flophouse Sharess' Caress The Velveteen Elixir Quests Deal with the Devil Deal with the Gnomes Find a way into Wyrm's Rock fortress Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion Free Orpheus Help Kith'rak Voss Investigate Cazador's Palace Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders The Githyanki Warrior The High Harper

I don't tolerate disrespect. „ — Nateen Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Nateen is patrolling the streets of Lower City with Fist Gummidge , Fist Olloa and a Steel Watcher . They can be found near the Baldur's Mouth building at X: 113 Y: -47 , guarding the unconscious Gulster Boyes , prostrated on the ground after being knocked out by the automaton. Several citizens - Baz Hopbank , Scribe Goosequill and Eefa Barlow are vouching for their associate, but to no luck. After the Steel Watch Foundry is destroyed, Nateen is angry with the Watchers disabled, and looks forward to "knocking some heads together", once the Fist find out who the culprit is. Gold_Pocket_Random Harper Naysa is a Harper who patrols Last Light Inn during Act Two . She can help the party during the ⁠ Assault on Moonrise Towers and be a potential ally during ⁠ Confront the Elder Brain . “ I'd like to pull this whole heap down when we're done. A cairn for all the Harpers who died here. „ — Naysa , on Moonrise Towers Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Naysa is at the Last Light Inn, where she patrols the same northern side route of the docks area as Hangfar . Resolve the Abduction [ edit section | visual editor ] When Marcus attacks the inn and attempts to kidnap Isobel during ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Naysa is amongst the Harpers who avoid being Impaled , and runs up to fight the Winged Horrors . If Isobel is not saved, Naysa and everyone in Last Light Inn turn into Shadow-Cursed Undead , save for Jaheira . Assault Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn and the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers , Naysa follows Jaheira to the assault on Moonrise Towers, where she, along with Harper Antony , Essius , and Lymn survive the first assault and assist the party in the remaining fight against Absolute forces. [ 1 ] After the main battle, if she survives the fight, she guards the first floor of Moonrise with the remaining Harpers . Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If alive, Naysa can be summoned as an ally through the Gather Your Allies variant Silver Harp Squadron , if ⁠ The High Harper is completed with Minsc alive. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Ranged Attack ( )   –   Longbow Damage: 3~10 1d8 + 2 ⁠ Piercing Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon. Range: 18 m (60 ft) [ 2 ] [ 3 ] Items (Act 3) [ edit section | visual editor ] Arrow of Lightning [ 4 ] Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Longbow Studded Leather Armour [ 5 ] Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Infiltrate Moonrise Towers ⁠ Resolve the Abduction ⁠ Confront the Elder Brain Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ If killed at any point before the ⁠ Assault on Moonrise Towers , a replacement Harper (either Olys , Grenywald , Lanni , or Lilineth ) will take Naysa's place. If killed during the Assault on Moonrise Towers, one of those aforementioned replacement Harpers will take her place as a Silver Harp Squadron summon instead. ↑ Naysa has four level 1 spell slots , and two level 2 spell slots, despite having no spell to cast. ↑ As of Patch 6 and after, despite having Extra Attack , Naysa is not able to attack twice during her turns. ↑ When summoned during ⁠ Confront the Elder Brain , Naysa has an unlimited Arrow of Lightning supply to use. ↑ Naysa wears a set of armor identical to the Studded Leather Armour set, but with shorter sleeves and a scarf BG_Commoner_Poor Tinker Nayzeem is a Human businessman in the Rivington refugee camp in Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Nayzeem is in the refugee camp at X: 71 Y: -85 . Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Refugee Arrival Record Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] Although listed as a human in-game, his appearance is that of an Elf or Half-Elf due to his pointed ears. Technical UID S_DEN_DissectedDrow UUID 0cb0cdde-16f8-440d-b73a-ceb385183ea9 Stats Elf_Drow_Ranger Ned'Cirannis , named in-game as Dissected Drow , was an Absolute cultist who died during a scouting mission in Act One . His corpse was brought to the Emerald Grove for dissection. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Ned's corpse is lying on a table in the Enclave Library at X: -445 Y: 20 . Although he received strict orders from Minthara to observe and not engage, Ned attacked Halsin and Nettie with a group of goblins . The druids killed him and a tadpole crawled out of his head. Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Drow's Letter Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Drow's Letter Halsin's Journal, Vol I Notes on Drow Parasite Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Ned can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . Who are you? Dissected Drow Ned'Cirannis... of the Absolute... What happened to you? Dissected Drow Scouting... found druids... Who killed you? Dissected Drow Druid... Bear... How many drow are out there? Dissected Drow Minthara... back at camp ... Where did you get your tadpole? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. It doesn't understand the question.* Where did you start following the Absolute? Dissected Drow Moonrise Towers ... initiation... Were you abducted by mind flayers ? Dissected Drow No... [DROW]  Your name and House. Now. Dissected Drow Ned'Cirannis... of the Absolute... [DROW]  There is no House of the Absolute. Dissected Drow No houses... all equal in Her love... [DROW]  Why would you serve? Drow are born to rule. Dissected Drow We will... Absolute will rule all... I'd give him a few more of those, if you catch my drift. Fast Neddio Hard not to. I'm standing downwind. Theda Grosz What about the tall one? He's a bit of all right. Fast Neddio Ugh. Not my type. He's not been near a razor in months. Theda Grosz Neither have I. I'm exactly as Yondalla made me. Can't you see I'm trying to concentrate? „ — Nelburn Frust Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Nelburn Frust is standing near the entrance of Devil's Fee , attempting to activate an enchantment that he bought from Helsik . If interacting, Nelburn is frustrated that he cannot say the tongue twister "scarab sap" three times in a row. [ 1 ] Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Nelburn can be heard talking to himself, repeatedly attempting the tongue twister. Nelburn Frust Scarabsapscarabsapscarabsapscarabsap - HAH! DID IT! Nelburn Frust But nothing's happening... Oh shit - that was four times, wasn't it? Bollocks. Nelburn Frust Just three times... Only have to say it three times... Nelburn Frust Scarab sap, scab - terrible. Idiot. Fool. Nelburn Frust Carab - no, scarab. Gods' sakes. Scarab sap, sarab - ugh. I'm forgetting something. What am I forgetting?! „ — Neno Quilltop Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Neno Quilltop and Kali Hammerhand are shopping for supplies in Wyrm's Crossing after the Absolute's failed assault on Rivington . Neno is panicking about the possible new attack and tries to fill her stock with every thing imaginable. Kali attempts to calm her down and persuades to purchase only necessities. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Neno Quilltop Apples, loaves, butter - honey! We should stock up. Kali Hammerhand Honey is a luxury. We don't need honey. Neno Quilltop But I love honey. I love honey so much. Kali Hammerhand Woah, slow down, sweetie. Take a deep breath for me, yeah? Kali Hammerhand Ten loaves of bread? Are you sure? Neno Quilltop The neighbours said they had fifteen! Kali Hammerhand The neighbours are talking out of their arses. Besides our pantry is full . Neno Quilltop What if there's food shortages? Rationing? We can't leave anything to chance! Kali Hammerhand If it'll make you feel better, then fine - fifteen loaves it is. Neno Quilltop We should hit Rivington next - they might have something we've forgotten. Kali Hammerhand Like what? Neno Quilltop I don't know - but I'll know it when I see it! Kali Hammerhand Let's just stick to the list. Neno Quilltop If the Absolute's armies lay siege, they won't care about a stupid list. We have to be prepared! Kali Hammerhand Whatever we need, we can get in Wyrm's Crossing. v t e Wyrm's Crossing Characters Cultists of Bhaal Gavv Hemm Lunn Zoll Flaming Fists Azari Edwynna Elin Falcäo Gai Meadows Mîran Shah Carm's Garms Naaber Slozy Arminifer Trinigan Gazotts Vinegaroon Danthelon's Dancing Axe Geraldus Limmy Safyre Somi Tairn Fraygo's Flophouse Bernyr Crak Dalyria Dashkent Moliver Drim Ffion Goldgrind Petras Rilia Rosanna Sharess' Caress Amira Arfur Gregorio Borgus Elamin Chapeau Chorizo Cillian Earspoon Embry Ghainemeir Hakeem Irenya Jara Kira Korrilla Laila Naoise Nallinto Nym Orlith Raphael Rhol Sorn Orlith Surixana Valeria Voss Other Kali Hammerhand Neno Quilltop Traders Carmen Pennygood Entharl Danthelon Glynda Oltower Griska Hoots Hooligan Queelia Arvis Roberon Silt Stylin' Horst Thodric Shedeveer Velson Oakes Locations Carm's Garms Danthelon's Dancing Axe Fraygo's Flophouse Sharess' Caress The Velveteen Elixir Quests Deal with the Devil Deal with the Gnomes Find a way into Wyrm's Rock fortress Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion Free Orpheus Help Kith'rak Voss Investigate Cazador's Palace Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders The Githyanki Warrior The High Harper

Technical UID S_LOW_SWS_AtWall_FF_000 UUID 01d5b697-8329-4735-88f9-15c869b12363 Stats FlamingFist_Human_Melee_Attacker Fist Nephel is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist . She can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three . “ Evaluation is harmless. Make no sudden moves and no one gets hurt. „ — Nephel Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Nephel is patrolling the streets of Lower City with Fist Larche , Fist Shargil and a Steel Watcher . She and her fellow Fists can be found near the Stormshore Armoury at X: -44 Y: -101 , guarding Courier Hara , Moorino and Burzenberg , who are being "evaluated" by the Steel Watcher. If spoken to, Nephel asks the player character not to do sudden moves while the automaton is checking the detained civilians. After the Steel Watch Foundry is destroyed, Nephel remains at the same place and expresses hope that the Watcher will soon start working again, so they can carry on their duties. After a long rest, she disappears from the game along with her fellow Fists and all "evaluated" citizens. He is a pivotal character for the quests ⁠ Free True Soul Nere , ⁠ Save the Grymforge Gnomes and ⁠ Deliver Nere's Head . “ Heretics. Let Nere be your end. „ — Nere Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act One 1.2 Act Two 2 Combat 2.1 Attacks and actions 2.1.1 Honour mode 2.2 Allies 2.3 Encounter details 2.4 Tactics 3 Loot 4 Related literature 5 Related quests 6 Speak with Dead 7 Notes 8 Bugs 9 Gallery Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Nere is trapped behind a cave-in near the main room in Grymforge . Several enslaved deep gnomes are forced to work on freeing him by a group of duergar slavers who are members of the Cult of the Absolute . To save him, the gnomes tell the party to find Philomeen , a runaway gnome in possession of an explosive capable of destroying the rubble. Caution : Nere dies if the party fast travel or long rest more than once after first communing with him at the cave-in. After freeing him, the party can fight Nere and his mercenaries to save the gnome slaves. The party can also complete the quest ⁠ Blind the Absolute - convincing Elder Brithvar to side against Nere. Alternatively, it is possible to betray Brithvar and convince Nere and the Absolute Cultists to turn on the mercenaries. It is also possible to lock the party out of either of these options through dialogue choices prior to rescuing Nere, leading him to kill both the gnome slaves and Sergeant Thrinn immediately after he is freed from the rubble. He then demands that the party help him to kill the rest of the cultists and duergar mercenaries; this turns all characters except Nere hostile and starts combat. If the party defy Nere when he kills the gnome slaves (or when he demands to kill the other cultists, and not having a deal with Elder Brithvar), a fight starts against him and all the duergar at the same time. However, if the party have a deal with Elder Brithvar, it is possible to interrupt Nere from killing the gnome slaves and still side with him once Elder Brithvar attacks Nere, leading to an option of saving the gnomes while Nere is still alive. Deciding to fight Nere's mercenaries before freeing him unlocks a dialogue option to convince him that the Absolute is little more than a group of cultists. This results in Nere abandoning the Cult of the Absolute and leaving Grymforge for good. If Nere is defeated (or dies off-screen from a revolt or poisoning), it is then possible to remove his head (earning the ⁠ Head of the Snake inspiration for party members with the Haunted One background) and deliver it to Spaw or Glut , completing the quest ⁠ Deliver Nere's Head . Regardless of his status, the party receives a Broken Moonlantern , a precursor to a crucial item needed to travel through the Shadow-Cursed Lands to reach Moonrise Towers . There is no way to fix this lantern, but there are several options to find a working one later. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If Nere survives in Grymforge and remains loyal to the Absolute, he appears briefly in Act Two in the Gauntlet of Shar as a zombie servant to Balthazar . See Nere (Zombie) . Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] Dalthar Drar Dunnol Fonmara Greymon Lur Fu * (conditional) Lur Jox * (conditional) Lur Otan * (conditional) Lur Xanta * (conditional) Murmath * Thrinn If the party do not complete ⁠ Blind the Absolute , then additional creatures (most of whom are potential allies of the party) side with Nere: Brithvar Danna * Gergerann * Grundril * Kith * Kur * Magmar * Mirthis * Morghal * Morgya * Pistle * Orgarth * Thudd Scrying Eye Skarjall * * = These creatures do not join the fight until it gets close to them. If this does not happen before the fight ends (either by winning or escaping), then these characters disappear. Philomeen also disappears, but Skickpit and the Deep Rothé stay. Encounter details [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party complete ⁠ Blind the Absolute then many duergar will choose to ally with them against Nere, significantly reducing the difficulty of the fight. Several enemies have spells which can control the minds of party members. Nere uses Wicked Coercion , and both Mind Master Dunnol and Mind Master Fonmara use Mind Mastery , forcing the party to waste actions fighting each other. This battle also occurs next to Lava which will quickly melt anyone who falls into it. Many enemies have ways of pushing party backwards into the lava, such as Shove , Thrinn's Thunderwave , or Nere's Shatter Visage on Honour mode. Nere has an abnormally high Athletics bonus of +9 and the Muscular passive, making it very difficult to shove him (DC 24), though he does not actually possess the Shove ability himself. Caution: the gnomes may move into area of effect spells like Hunger of Hadar and, as they are not in combat, take damage in real time, potentially preventing the caster from ending Concentration before they die. Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] It is most important to take out enemies that can mind control party members first. It is advisable to keep away from the lava as well, as it will almost certainly kill anyone who falls inside. However, this can be used to the party's advantage by knocking enemies in, using actions such as Shove , Pushing Attack (Melee) , Flurry of Blows: Push , Thunderwave , or Arrow of Roaring Thunder . Proximity to a Sussur Bloom greatly reduces the amount of magic used, thanks to its Sussur Flower Antimagic Field . This is particularly effective against Nere since his spells are far more dangerous than his physical attacks. Failing that, he can be attacked with a Sussur Greatsword , Sickle , or Dagger to Silence him. In Honour mode, Nere's legendary action, whilst stating it triggers when attacked, instead triggers on many offensive actions which do not require an attack roll. Even spells which do no damage and require no save, such as Create Water , will trigger it. Silencing him does not impact his ability to trigger this action; Incapacitating him prevents him from using it. Also, while Psionic Visages are active, the Detonations triggered by attacking Nere are centered on the character who triggered the Detonation , rather than Nere. However, Nere's Psionic Visages need not unduly hamper the party, as they can be quickly (albeit somewhat painfully) dispensed with using Magic Missiles from a wizard classed character or a scroll . It may be advisable to keep potent healing potions handy. Absolute unites... Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Although the Disintegrating Night Walkers can be looted from Nere's corpse, he cannot make use of the benefits of these boots, Misty Step and Nightwalker , because he has not equipped them while being alive. Instead the boots are attached to Nere's inventory by the ItemList tag. The same applies to the Dagger +1 which also can be looted from his corpse. Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] Due to an incorrect method of applying additional spell slots to Nere's character stats, he only enters combat with one Level 1 Spell Slot and one Level 2 Spell Slot . Technical UID S_GLO_TieflingScammer UUID 9b6e1dc8-6871-4e88-b65a-bda3284302fc Stats Tiefling_Commoner Eqp. EQP_Unarmed Nerela was a Tiefling refugee in the Hollow . She was never finished, and was cut from the game before the release of the Early Access version, though her model, animations, dialogue and interactions still remain in the game files. [ 1 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nerela could have been encountered in the Emerald Grove, on a rocky ledge behind Mattis . She was to be in the possession of a Music Box , playing The Power as the party approached her; Nerela would tell the party that her husband used to make music boxes for their daughter to keep her distracted. During her family's flight to Baldur's Gate, they stumbled upon a pack of gnolls that soon killed Nerela's husband and daughter, with the music box being one of the few possessions she still has left. She would mention that she heard entry into Baldur's Gate would require coin and bribes, while she has nothing to her name. The party could then offer to buy the music box from her, be charitable and give her gold, or tell her to accept Auntie Ethel's offer of purchase instead. However, if a party member instead inspected the music box and passed an Insight check, this would have revealed that Nerela had been lying the whole time, shedding fake tears and making up an elaborate sob story to get party members part with their coin. The tiefling conwoman would then reveal her scheme and state that she needs the coin to enter Baldur's Gate, as the guards there fish for bribes. Nerela could then be forced to leave with the music box through Intimidation or Detect Thoughts , be applauded for her acting skills, or the party members could still give her some gold, which she would accept and then tell them to watch out for the tiefling children, calling them the real swindlers . She is waiting for a friend to join her at the Blushing Mermaid tavern. “ This place certainly has an interesting… aroma to it. „ — Nesha Leesha , waiting for her acquaintance Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nesha Leesha is standing on the open terrace near the Blushing Mermaid at X: -145 Y: -96 ; she may sometimes walk a couple of meters to the west. Nesha is a bit nervous and her banter lines reveal that she is visiting the establishment for the first time. When the party approach her, Nesha tells them that a friend invited her for a drink but has not arrived yet. Nesha Leesha is one of the marked targets listed on the Bloodstained Parchment , those who seek to become an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal must kill two targets from the list. When the party reaches Act Three locations, she is still alive. Her name is included in the list alongside those of Cora Highberry , Chef Roveer , and Figaro Pennygood , the other living victims. If the player character tells Nesha that her name is on the serial killer's list, she does not believe them at first. To convince her, they must pass an ability check: [PERSUASION]  Please listen to me. Others have died already, you are in danger . (DC 15) On a successful check, Nesha becomes frightened and runs away. [ 1 ]   +1   +1   +1   -1 If the player character decides to become an Unholy Assassin by completing Impress the Murder Tribunal , they can tell Nesha that they intend to kill her. This turns Nesha and all nearby tavern personnel and clients temporarily hostile, except several Tipplesome Patrons inside the tavern and its owner Captain Grisly . Those characters remain neutral unless attacked. Master found me, fed me, then I... I... I love him. And he loves me. „ — Nessa , talking about Yurgir Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nessa tries to lead the party into an ambush with Yurgir . If choosing or pretending to help Yurgir, Nessa can later be spoken with using Speak with Animals . Investigating the spider carcass ( DC 14 Investigation Check , then DC 16 Arcana Check ) in the room adjacent to Yurgir's reveals Nessa has been charmed into being Yurgir's lover with succubus spittle. Doing so grants the inspiration ⁠ Mating Season to party members with the Guild Artisan background. With Speak with Animals [ edit section | visual editor ] If investigating the spider carcass, the party can detect a similar spell in Nessa's breath and then attempt to convince her to turn against Yurgir by passing one of the following checks: [DECEPTION]  The orthon sold you to me. I'm your master now. (DC 16)   -1   -1   -1   +1   -1 [PERSUASION]  You only love your master because he's been dosing this meat. He's manipulating you. (DC 16)   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 Curing Nessa of the spiked spider carcass meat or using anything that removes Charmed or Poisoned conditions also works. Persuading Nessa that her spider meat has been dosed and she is being manipulated results in her cursing and threatening everything on two legs. It also unlocks two more dialogue option: [PERSUASION]  The only liar here is your 'master'. Let's end him together. (DC 30) [INTIMIDATION]  Stop your mewling before I shred you  (DC 16) The Persuasion option convinces Nessa to fight alongside the party against Yurgir; after Yurgir and his minions are defeated she remains neutral. Without Speak with Animals [ edit section | visual editor ] If interacting without using Speak with Animals, the party can only deduce there is something amiss with the displacer beast: [NATURE]  Something doesn't seem quite right - take a closer look.  (DC 16) [DRUID] [RANGER] [NATURE]  Something doesn't seem quite right - take a closer look.  (DC 16  ) [ANIMAL HANDLING]  Make eye contact with the beast.  (DC 16) The party can then make another check for more clues, or pet the beast: Give it a scratch behind the ears.   +1   +1   +1   +1   -1   +1   +1 Reach out to stroke one of its tentacles. Technical UID S_WYR_RefugeeCamp_FlamingFistManip UUID c5ed5400-53e6-4201-813c-d4b107be7a75 Stats WYR_ManipNestor Eqp. EQP_GreatAxe_C_HalfPlate Trs. BG_Guard Manip Nestor is a dwarven fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist in Rivington in Act Three . [ 1 ] “ You - turn around and toddle your way right back out of here. Everything in this barn has been donated for the refugees - not you. „ — Nestor , to the player character, if they were spotted inside the barn without permission Contents 1 Involvement 2 Companion approval and Inspiration 3 Combat 3.1 Attacks and actions 3.2 Loot 4 Related literature 5 Related quests 6 Notes and references Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nestor is the chief of the Flaming Fist squad, guarding the goods donated to the benefit of refugees, put into storage inside the Requisitioned Barn . His subordinates are Fist Broadhorn , Fist Lochan , Fist Madigan , Fist Poole , Fist Rowan , and Fist Varone . Nestor accepts donations of gold (500) or supplies (40) for refugees. Also, the party can donate any amount of various items. To this end, Nestor has a dialogue option to engage in trade, despite not carrying any inventory . Interacting with Manip Nestor plays a vital part in resolving the ⁠ Investigate the Suspicious Toys quest. To check and find dangerous donations, the party should negotiate with Nestor to gain passage into the barn, which would otherwise be considered trespassing . If they are spotted inside the barn by any Fist guard, explanations of searching for wrong-stuffed toys are not taken seriously, and the party is taken to Nestor anyway. The interacting party member can use various options to gain access into the barn: [PERSUASION]  I need to get into the barn - right now. Something dangerous might be among the donations. (DC 10) (after witnessing the basement of Arfur's mansion) [PERSUASION]  I'd like to take the donation into the barn myself. (DC 20) Party members spotted exploring the barn without due permission can state they are investigating a crime: I was investigating a crime - I think some of the donations might be dangerous. [INTIMIDATION]  So you're fine with innocent people getting hurt just because you won't own up to your guards' negligence? (DC 18) [PERSUASION]  Please, go and check. It won't take much of your time, but it could save lives. (DC 15) [DECEPTION]  I'll be honest with you: I'm hot on the trail of my client's prize pig Lulabelle. [ 2 ]  (DC 20) [FIGHTER] [DECEPTION]  Fist  reporting for duty, SIR! I was asked to check on the barn. (DC 18) If a party member tries to interact with donated dangerous toys and they explode, they might use following options to explain themselves away: [PERSUASION]  I almost died in the explosion myself! I want to find whoever's responsible. (DC 15)  (if toys exploded) [PERSUASION]  Why would I disarm my own explosives? I just want to find whoever's responsible. (DC 15)  (if toys didn't explode yet) [DECEPTION]  I was sent by the Council to check up on your operation. (DC 20) Because I've already found and dealt with the real culprit: Arfur Gregorio. You're lucky I was here.  (if Arfur already confessed) [DARK URGE]  Activate the toy and toss it to him. Companion approval and Inspiration [ edit section | visual editor ] When a party member first speaks to Nestor, he asks for donations instead of regular greeting. Some possible answers to his request grant the following approval/disapproval points from various companions: Donate some gold. [ 3 ]   -1   +1   +2   +1   -1   -1   +1   +1 I'll take a donation, please.   +1   +1 Interacting with Nestor invokes the following Inspirational Events : ⁠ Alms for the Unfortunate ( Noble background) ⁠ Food for the Soul ( Acolyte background) - if donating amount of supplies enough to take a Long Rest ⁠ Gifts of the Wilds ( Outlander background) ⁠ Never Trust an Honest Person ( Charlatan background) - lie to gain access into the barn ⁠ Sharing the Spoils ( Soldier background) ⁠ Spare What You Can ( Urchin background) Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Nestor has four superiority die to spend on abilities. Haven't had a clean catch in a tenday or more. Klorrvank You'll have to wash them all. Marric will never let you sell them like that. Nets Blandorf Wonder what's causing it? Klorrvank I've fished these waters my whole life. Never known anything like it. Klorrvank Something's going on down there. DEN_Apprentice Nettie is a dwarven druid in the Circle of the Emerald Grove in Act One . Nettie is a student under First Druid Halsin . In his absence, she is the primary healer in the Emerald Grove . “ You seem healthy enough. A bit tired 'round the eyes, maybe. „ — Nettie upon examining the player Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act One 2 Companion approval 3 Combat 3.1 Attacks and actions 3.2 Notable loot 4 Related literature 5 Related quests 6 Speak with Dead 6.1 If Halsin is alive 6.2 If Halsin is dead Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] During ⁠ Get Help from Healer Nettie Nettie is in the Druids' Chambers tending to a Wounded Bird , who became injured in her search for Halsin . If a party member heals the bird through using a spell like Healing Word , Nettie comments on this, being impressed by the party member's healing skills. If the party ask her to heal them of their tadpoles, Nettie guides them into the Enclave Library . If the interacting party member is honest with Nettie, she admits she does not know how to remove their tadpoles but that she and Halsin were investigating Illithids . She asks the party to rescue Halsin because he may be the only person who knows of a cure. She offers the party Wyvern Toxin , to be consumed if they begin to transform into mind flayers . If the interacting party member refuses to drink the poison, Nettie becomes hostile and attacks. If the interacting party member avoids Nettie's questions, she attempts to poison them using a thorn branch. They can attempt to talk her down, diverting the conversation back to the request to rescue Halsin and Nettie giving the party Wyvern Toxin. After completing ⁠ Save the First Druid and returning Halsin safely, the party can talk to her and ask for an additional reward. She gives a Pouch containing a Mugwort and Red Apple . Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] Swear to take the wyvern toxin after asking her for a cure. Clerics of Selûne have a unique dialogue option for this decision; notably, Shadowheart still approves.   -1   -1   +1   +1 Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Barkskin ( + ) Touch a willing creature to toughen its skin and increase its Armour Class up to 16. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Flaming Sphere ( + ) Damage: 2~12 2d6 ⁠ Fire Summon a Flaming Sphere that deals 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage to nearby enemies and objects. It also sheds bright light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius, and dim light for an additional 6 m (20 ft). You can move the sphere. You can remain hidden while casting this spell. If the creature is only wearing metal armour, it always receives Disadvantage. If the creature is still touching the metal, you can use a bonus action on subsequent turns to deal another 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Fire and force the creature to let go or receive Disadvantage. LOW_CountingHouse_Guard Cashguard Basher Nickelow is a human member of the Cashguard, in the Counting House in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . “ Never mind Glitterbeard. It's Meadhoney's good books you want to be in. „ — Nickelow Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nickelow guards the lower gate to the vaults next to Cashguard Artillerist Dadger . Attempting to pass Nickelow results in her asking the party for their vault pass . The party can either show it if they have one, or attempt to talk or bribe their way through: [ROGUE] [DECEPTION]  I just showed it to you, don't you remember? Are you feeling all right? (DC 15) [DECEPTION]  I'm with the group that came down just before me. (DC 18)  (if the party knows about the cultists) [INTIMIDATION]  It's just us down here. No one to judge you for choosing life over 'duty'. (DC 30) [PERSUASION]  The city depends on me getting down there. I really don't have time to explain. (DC 25) [PERSUASION]  Do you accept cash instead? (5000) (DC 15) Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Maul Damage: 6~16 2d6 + 4 ⁠ Bludgeoning Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Ranged Attack ( )   –   Hand Crossbow Damage: 2~7 1d6 + 1 ⁠ Piercing Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Lay on Hands: Greater Healing ( + 2 ) Healing 4 × (Paladin level) ⁠ Healing Imbue your hands with divine power to heal an ally. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Blinding Smite ( + + ) Damage: 3~24 Normal weapon damage + 3d8 ⁠ Radiant Evoke a heavenly flare and possibly Blind your target CON Save Range: Normal weapon range Divine Smite ( + ) Damage: 3~24 Normal weapon damage + 2d8 ⁠ Radiant + 1d8 ⁠ Radiant Your weapon deals an additional 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant DRS damage, increased by 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant damage when attacking Fiends or Undead . Range: Normal weapon range Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Hand Crossbow Helmet Maul Plate Armour Torch Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Nickelow occassionally chats with Dadger: Cashguard Artillerist Dadger Head Banker Glitterbeard almost got my name right today. Cashguard Basher Nickelow Never mind Glitterbeard. It's Meadhoney's good books you want to be in. Cashguard Basher Nickelow Glitterbeard might shake hands and smile, but it's Meadhoney who can assign you to the graveyard shift. Cashguard Artillerist Dadger You ever seen anyone actually raid this place? Cashguard Basher Nickelow Nah. None of us have. Cashguard Artillerist Dadger What, it's never been robbed? Cashguard Basher Nickelow If it has, I doubt the guards get to stick around to tell about it. Cashguard Artillerist Dadger We'll be pulling a late one tonight. Cashguard Basher Nickelow What? Why? Cashguard Artillerist Dadger Half that crowd up there aren't getting their coin. Some will go quietly out the front door... Cashguard Basher Nickelow And some will go out with a splash by the dock door. WYR_Ironhand_Worker Nickels Zeltron is a deep gnome member of Clan Ironhand in Moonrise Towers Prison in Act Two . “ Stone guide me - I'll be home soon. „ — Nickels Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Nickels is in a cell in Moonrise Towers Prison , together with Wulbren Bongle and Nimble . If he escapes, he can be directed or escorted to Last Light Inn . If not freed from Moonrise Towers before dealing with the Nightsong , his corpse in the Oubliette together with those of the other prisoners. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If he survives Act Two, Nickels moves with other members of Clan Ironhand to Angleiron's Cellar in Rivington . He has noticed the shaking in the city, and realised it is coming from inside the rock. Nickels says he has asked the stone why it is shaking, but it only screams. Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers Prisoner Log Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Avenge the Ironhands ⁠ Deal with the Gnomes ⁠ Gather Your Allies ⁠ Rescue the Tieflings ⁠ Rescue Wulbren Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] When met in Moonrise Towers Prison , Nickels has no equpiment, and can only use Throw Stone . On encountering him in Rivington he has equipment and corresponding weapon actions. Actions and abilities [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Heavy Crossbow Damage: 2~11 1d10 + 1 ⁠ Piercing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Throw Stone ( ) Damage: 4~7 1d4 + 3 ⁠ Bludgeoning Throws a sharp stone at a foe. Range: 9 m (30 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Heavy Crossbow Leather Armour Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] While in a cell in Moonrise Towers Prison , Wulbren, Nickels and Nimble discuss their predicament. Nickels The stone - I feel it. Hollow behind the back wall, and beyond... water? Wulbren Bongle I'd bet my last copper there's a pier nearby. Nimble This could be our chance, sir. Nimble We should leave - and soon. Wulbren Bongle That is the plan, Nickels. Nickels There's something evil here. Below, down, down... argh! Nimble Breathe - I've got you. Wulbren Bongle Unless this 'evil' can get us out of here, I don't want to hear about it. Wulbren Bongle It's only a matter of time 'til we're served up to the necromancer on a platter. Nimble We'll get you to Baldur's Gate , sir - I swear it. Wulbren Bongle Damn straight - without me everything will be for naught. The Ironhand Gnomes must succeed. While in a cell in Moonrise Towers Prison , Nimble and Nickels have a chat together. Nimble You need to eat before we head off, all right? Nickels Yes. Nimble Do you have anything to eat? Nickels No. Nimble Where did I leave that damn hammer? Nickels The stone says it is one floor down to the left. Nimble Hah - thanks Nickels. And the stone. Nickels You are welcome. Nimble I'll sort you out for dinner. How does the stone read? Nickels The way is clear - the light has shown the way. Nimble Good. The sooner we get out of here the better. EQP_Mace_Chainmail_Shield Trs. WYR_Ironhand_Worker Nimble Paternon is a Deep Gnome member of Clan Ironhand . “ I shouldn't say anything to you until you've spoken to Wulbren . He's very... particular. „ — Nimble Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Nimble is in a cell in Moonrise Towers Prison , together with Nickels and Wulbren Bongle . If she escapes, she can be directed or escorted to Last Light Inn . If she is not freed from Moonrise Towers before the dealing with the Nightsong , her corpse is in the Oubliette together with those of all the other prisoners. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If party members enter Wyrm's Crossing from the South Span Checkpoint , they must pay a fine and submit to a scan from the Steel Watcher there. If they attack or (after the scan) submit to imprisonment, Nimble and Laridda (if alive) run past and lob a Flashblinder grenade at the Watcher. They then flee to Angleiron's Cellar via the alternative entrance on the western side of the crossing. Nimble and Laridda later move to Angleiron's Cellar, accessible through a rock opening near South Span Checkpoint. Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers Prisoner Log Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Avenge the Ironhands ⁠ Deal with the Gnomes ⁠ Gather Your Allies ⁠ Rescue the Tieflings ⁠ Rescue Wulbren Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] When met in Moonrise Towers Prison , Nimble has no equpiment, and can only use Throw Stone . On encountering her in Rivington she has equipment and corresponding weapon actions. Actions and abilities [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Mace Damage: 4~9 1d6 + 3 ⁠ Bludgeoning Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Throw Stone ( ) Damage: 4~7 1d4 + 3 ⁠ Bludgeoning Throws a sharp stone at a foe. Range: 9 m (30 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Chain Mail Mace Shield Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] While in a cell in Moonrise Towers Prison , Wulbren, Nickels and Nimble discuss their predicament. Nickels The stone - I feel it. Hollow behind the back wall, and beyond... water? Wulbren Bongle I'd bet my last copper there's a pier nearby. Nimble This could be our chance, sir. Nimble We should leave - and soon. Wulbren Bongle That is the plan, Nickels. Nickels There's something evil here. Below, down, down... argh! Nimble Breathe - I've got you. Wulbren Bongle Unless this 'evil' can get us out of here, I don't want to hear about it. Wulbren Bongle It's only a matter of time 'til we're served up to the necromancer on a platter. Nimble We'll get you to Baldur's Gate , sir - I swear it. Wulbren Bongle Damn straight - without me everything will be for naught. The Ironhand Gnomes must succeed. While in a cell in Moonrise Towers Prison , Nimble and Nickels have a chat together. Nimble You need to eat before we head off, all right? Nickels Yes. Nimble Do you have anything to eat? Nickels No. Nimble Where did I leave that damn hammer? Nickels The stone says it is one floor down to the left. Nimble Hah - thanks Nickels. And the stone. Nickels You are welcome. Nimble I'll sort you out for dinner. How does the stone read? Nickels The way is clear - the light has shown the way. Nimble Good. The sooner we get out of here the better. Nimbus is a shadow mastiff summoned via the Shadow Magic sorcerer's Hound of Ill Omen ability. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Ominous Bite ( ) Damage: 3~18 3d6 ⁠ Piercing Bite a target and possibly place an Omen on them. CON Save Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Umbral Tangle ( ) Damage: 2~12 2d6 ⁠ Necrotic Trap your enemies in shadowy vines. On a successful save, the target still takes half damage. STR Save Range: Self Splinter Shadow ( ) When you are attacked by a melee attack that does not deal Radiant damage , splinter off a piece of yourself to spawn a new version from the shadows. Additionally, when moving adjacent to a friendly Accursed Spectre , Nimbus gains the Shadow Infusion condition which grants a special reaction from the spectre until the next long rest. The reaction is triggered when the summoner hits a target with a melee weapon attack. Right Behind You ( ) Damage: 1~12 + modifiers 1d12 + Summoner's Charisma modifier ⁠ Necrotic Materialise next to your summoner's victim. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Despite Ominous Bite being a weapon attack, Elixir of the Colossus and other weapon damage modifiers don't apply to it. Instead, some elixirs which are effective on Nimbus are the Elixir of Battlemage's Power , Elixir of Bloodlust , and Elixir of Vigilance . Although it is not specified anywhere, Nimbus can see in magical darkness. This means he does not suffer from Blindness and attacks with advantage when fighting in the caster's Darkness clouds. v t e Creatures Humanoids Aasimar Bugbear Changeling Gnoll Goblin Hobgoblin Kobold Kuo-toa Meazel Sahuagin Shadar-Kai Werewolf Aberrations Cloaker Countermeasure Intellect Devourer Mind Flayer Spectator Spectral Flumph Tentacle Beasts Alioramus Badger Bat Bear Bird Boar Cat Crab Deep Rothé Dilophosaurus Displacer Beast Dog Frog Giant Eagle Hyena Owlbear Ox Rabbit Rat Raven Dire Sheep Spider Squirrel Wolf Dire Celestials Deva Hollyphant Moonlight Sliver Constructs Adamantine Golem Animated Armour Arcane Turret Automaton Guardian of Faith Flesh Golem Manifestation of Tyranny Ptaris' Mental Image Scrying Eye Steel Watcher Dragons Red Dragon Undead Dragon Elementals Azer Djinni Elemental Air Earth Fire Grease Lava Mud Water Flaming Sphere Hell Sphere Mephit Grease Ice Magma Mud Myrmidon Air Earth Fire Water Fey Blink Dog Dryad Hag Meenlock Pixie Redcap Fiends Cambion Vengeful Hellsboar Gilded Lesser Vengeful Imp Gilded Lesser Vengeful Incubus / Succubus Merregon Vengeful Orthon Giants Ogre Monstrosities Bulette Ettercap Doppelganger Drider Gremishka Harpy Hook Horror Minotaur Gilded Mimic Phase Spider Shadow Mastiff Slayer Worg Oozes Fetid Ooze Greaseball Ochre Jelly Plants Blight Myconid Shadow Creeper Shambling Mound Wood Woad Undead Conjured Spectre Crawling Claw Dark Justiciar Death Knight Death Shepherd Flying Ghoul Ghast Ghost Ghoul Grim Visage Mummy Mummy Lord Poltergeist Shadow Skeleton Vampire Vampire spawn Wraith Zombie Greater

Nina Dortmell In-game Portrait Identity Female Voice / Actor Alex Tregear Family Garret Dortmell (brother, deceased), Unnamed Mother, Unnamed Father Hometown Baldur's Gate Stats Size Small Type Humanoid Race Human Balanced Balanced Difficulty Stats HP 5 AC 10 Initiative 0 Movement 9 m (30 ft) Weight 25 kg (50 lb) Darkvision 0 m (0 ft) XP reward 1 Ability scores STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) 10 (0) Saving throws STR DEX CON INT WIS CHA 0 0 0 0 0 0 Features Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Technical UID S_LOW_KurwinCoffin_KidNecromancer UUID 2be44da8-cada-4e84-a788-fc9813fa651e Stats Human_Child Nina Dortmell is a human child who can be found in the Graveyard of the Lower City . “ You're close, Myrkul - I can feel your shadow! Give my brother back, please. „ — Nina Dortmell Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nina stands by her brother's grave trying to resurrect him. When approached, she tells the party that her big brother Garret was murdered. [ 1 ] She attempts to cast a spell to resurrect Garret but it fizzles out. The party can then either help her or persuade her to let him rest in peace: Here - this scroll might do the trick.  (if the party member has a scroll of Animate Dead ) [ARCANA]  You need to focus your power - make it a sharpened point, like the tip of an arrow. (DC 18) [ARCANA]  The spell you're looking for is 'Raise Undead'. This is how you do it... (DC 10) [SCHOOL OF NECROMANCY] [STRENGTH]  You wish to raise the dead? Allow me to teach you, curious child... (DC 10) [WIZARD] [STRENGTH]  Raising a fallen creature? Paltry magic. Allow me to explain... [ARCHFEY] [ARCANA]  Instruct the child in faerie rites of raising the dead.  (DC 10) [GREAT OLD ONE] [ARCANA]  Teach the child deep, forbidden magic to regurgitate a soul from the void.  (DC 10) [FIEND] [ARCANA]  Tell the child all you know of how fiends snatch souls from the afterlife.  (DC 10) [THE HEXBLADE] [ARCANA]  Show the child how to carve a soul out of the afterlife.  (DC 10) [SORCERER] [ARCANA]  Magic is about instinct. Trust you gut, trust your magic and the rest will flow. (DC 10) [PERSUASION]  Your brother deserves to rest in peace - let him. (DC 15) [MONK] [PERSUASION]  Your brother's soul is at rest - it is not fair to disturb it. Make peace with your dead, child. (DC 15) Successfully helping her to raise her brother summons two Greater Zombies , three Zombies , two Skeletons and a unique Death Shepherd named Garret Dortmell . Aside from each undead providing individual XP rewards, completing the battle awards 1890 experience. Alternatively, it is also possible to persuade her to let her brother rest in peace, after which the party can tell Mortarch Gracie Scyre about the young girl's acts of necromancy. This triggers a cutscene where the Mortarch offers to help honour Nina's brother and bring her peace. Either option awards 2970 experience in tactician difficulty. [ 2 ] Both dissuading and encouraging her to raise her brother from the dead awards the following inspiration: ⁠ What Remains of the Dead ( Acolyte background) ⁠ Good Intentions ( Urchin background) Technical UID S_LOW_Guildhall_NineFingers UUID ef1b7a12-6439-470a-885c-fa47851728cd Stats LOW_Guildhall_NineFingersKeene Nine-Fingers Keene is the human Guildmaster of the Guild in the city of Baldur's Gate. [ 2 ] “ I haven't got the slightest idea what he's trying to say. „ — Nine-Fingers Keene , when Minsc tells her that he will dislodge her 'wicked rump' Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nine-Fingers Keene is in the Guildhall in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate and can provide information on finding Minsc . If Jaheira speaks with her, Keene refers to Jaheira as a hero, claims that Jaheira owes her money, and makes note of allowing a Harper to walk 'unholed' through the Guildhall. If Minsc is present when the party visits again, Nine-Fingers tells him he was a hero of hers when she was younger. Minsc and Boo can offer to join the Guild as Nine-Fingers' 'Berserker Lodge', after the Absolute is slain. Nine-Fingers Keene can help the party in the final fight if they side with the Guild instead of the Zhentarim at the end of the quest ⁠ Aid the Underduke , allowing her personal bodyguards to be summoned with Gather Your Allies . The inspiration ⁠ Woman of Her Word is granted to party members with the Charlatan background. EQP_Longsword_ScaleMail Trs. HAV_Survivor Fist Nipawa is a human Flaming Fist in Act Two . She can help the party during the ⁠ Assault on Moonrise Towers . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] If Isobel is saved at the Last Light Inn , and once the Nightsong is freed from her cage and heads for Moonrise Towers , Nipawa, along with the Flaming Fists Hadenwell , Helena , Rhed and Ulthred survives the first assault and assists the party in the remaining battle against the Absolute forces. [ 1 ] Talking to her lets her remark that they are killing cultists who believe in a false god. [ 2 ] After the battle, provided she survives, she and the remaining Flaming Fists scout the Moonrise Towers Prison and enter a second battle against the Myrkulites Duckie Verish , Sarabayle , and Willinx Jindlebee , as well as a Death Shepherd and a horde of Necromites . The party can assist the Fists in this optional battle. If the Fists survive, they guard the prison until Ketheric Thorm is defeated. Talking with Nipawa after Ketheric has retreated to the Mind Flayer Colony but before the party follows him lets her mention that she only joined the expedition hazard pay, [ 3 ] and she jokingly says to the party that they should split the bonus for saving Ulder Ravengard . [ 4 ] After Ketheric Thorm is killed and the party leave for Act Three , Nipawa disappears from the game entirely. Technical UID S_WYR_BusinessIsBusiness_Dwarf01 UUID 8e867dff-c807-4868-8568-9570d0d11d57 Stats Dwarf_Commoner Nisvan is a dwarven refugee who appears just after entering Rivington . “ You might see a bunch of refugees, but I see a ripe business opportunity - if you're lucky, I might even let you invest. „ — Nisvan Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nisvan is a refugee near the Rivington waypoint. She is discussing with Solras her idea about starting a new business and asks for a small investment. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Nisvan I'm not asking for much - just a teensy investment to get me started. Solras Uh-huh. What are you calling this new 'business'? Nisvan 'Cheap and Cheerful - Refugees for Hire!' Catchy, right? Solras Mate, there is so much wrong with that name. Nisvan Think about it - they're stuck here with no coin and nothing to do! Solras You're going to hire all the refugees? Just like that? Nisvan Of course! Cleaning, cooking, construction - the possibilities are endless! Solras What do you get out of this, hmm? Nisvan Well, it's the right thing to do, isn't it? Everyone deserves the chance to make some coin. Solras Say the refugees agree to work for you - how much are you going to pay them? Nisvan Well, considering this economy, plus the risk I'm taking, I'd say... half the going rate? Solras Hah! So you're going to pay slave wages and undercut the locals? Nisvan Slaves don't get wages. This is honest business! Solras Aye. Technical UID S_LOW_VoloFate_Thug_Ranged_02 UUID 6af2f037-5b4b-4fe3-b84e-9184d1f5cdaa Stats LOW_VolosFate_Thugs_Ranged_02 Nobster is a dwarven character in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nobster can be found near the Grey Harbour Docks , as part of Churg Elvek's mob, ready to bring Volo to "justice". When the party approach the Steel Watch Foundry , they can come across Churg Elvek and his mob, as well as Volo - who is tied up to some Smokepowder Barrels . Upon approaching, a cutscene plays out where Churg smears Volo with harmful lies and accusations of conspiracies and fear mongering. The party can opt to intervene or draw their weapons after which Churg and his mob attack. Technical UID S_LOW_ShadowheartFriend UUID 2c10ff0f-d2ff-4dcb-8f8b-c6f870044f5d Stats LOW_ShadowheartFriend Nocturne , formerly known as Rennald , [ 1 ] is a Tiefling follower of Shar and childhood friend of Shadowheart . “ You may not remember, but we shared a lot together once. Good times, hard times... I will not turn on you. Even if it angers Lady Shar. „ — Nocturne , to Shadowheart Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If Shadowheart consumed Noblestalk while in the Underdark , she remembers "a young tiefling boy" with short horns and purple hair who was named Rennald. This starts ⁠ A Familiar Face . Upon meeting Nocturne Shadowheart realises that Nocturne is this young tiefling from her recovered memories. Nocturne, a trans woman, goes on to explain how Shadowheart used to be teased about her name - attacked for who she was - which helped Nocturne understand more about herself, and that she was not happy with who she was. Shadowheart's courage to keep fighting gave Nocturne the strength to find herself and eventually change from Rennald to Nocturne. [ 2 ] Nocturne is surprised that Shadowheart made it back, as it was speculated in the cloister that the hunt for the artefact was a suicide mission, and further, that it was not Shar's plan but the Mother Superior's alone. If Shadowheart takes control of the cloister, Nocturne stays on as quartermaster, and tells Shadowheart to come see her later so that they can catch up. Otherwise, she makes plans to go to another enclave, not yet brave enough to leave Shar entirely. Nocturne acts as quartermaster in the Cloister of Sombre Embrace , and sells a small selection of items. If Shadowheart defies Shar and kills the cultists, Nocturne only remains in the cloister until the next long rest, after which she departs and is not seen again. Otherwise, she remains as quartermaster. Epilogue [ edit section | visual editor ] During the Epilogue , the player character can ask Shadowheart about Nocturne. If Shadowheart takes over the cloister, she relays that Nocturne is still the quartermaster, and is busy with the rapid growth of the enclave. Otherwise, Nocturne acts as an informant to Shadowheart on the plans of some of the Sharran chapters, still a loyal friend to Shadowheart even though her faith and allegiances remain. Shadowheart hopes that Nocturne will turn from Shar in time, ready to support her in that change, but says that it is "a decision she will have to make for herself" . [ 3 ] Store [ edit section | visual editor ] Purple Worm Toxin Scroll of Otto's Irresistible Dance Scroll of Seeming Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Letter from Nocturne Nocturne's Journal Quotes [ edit section | visual editor ] “ They were attacking who you were. I never found it funny, but wasn't quite sure why. Eventually I realised it was because I wasn't happy with who I was. I couldn't keep going like that. But seeing how you fought on, I realised that I didn't have to. From then on, I was Nocturne. It wasn't easy... but everything started to make sense. I could breathe. „ — Nocturne , to Shadowheart [ 4 ] “ I know it might be hard to believe, but you can find acceptance in the unlikeliest of places. „ — Nocturne , to Shadowheart [ 5 ] References [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Nocturne is a character in the game specifically identified as having changed their gender. ↑ Dialogue with Nocturne and Shadowheart in the cloister. ↑ Shadowheart's dialogue in the Epilogue . ↑ Quote source: LOW_SharGrotto_FamiliarFace_OM_Shadowheart_COM ↑ Quote source: LOW_SharGrotto_FamiliarFace_OM_Shadowheart_AOM_OOM v t e Cloister of Sombre Embrace Characters Arnell Hallowleaf Emmeline Hallowleaf Viconia DeVir Justiciar Crusaders Nightmist Owltalon Fidelians Gloommask Gydd Hyrald Lamona Uttermask Novices Bluenail Dohna Dollay Garrigan Greymask Humboldt Monteith Tylda Sentries Baxta Fredrichk Hendly Imwise Traders Nocturne Locations Armoury Chamber of Loss Dormitory Night Orchid Cave Quests A Familiar Face Daughter of Darkness Investigate the House of Grief Surrender Shadowheart to Viconia

Technical UID S_WYR_South_Civilian_001 UUID 4134d7c5-e8ba-4123-bd25-32094a9c3701 Stats Human_Commoner Trs. BG_Commoner_Poor Noira Crysst is a human refugee. She is attempting to enter Baldur's Gate through the South Span Checkpoint in Rivington during Act Three . “ We can't get in. I - I have family here. They said we'd be welcome. „ — Noira Crysst Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Noira is with her husband Horus Crysst , and her son Torin Crysst attempting to convince Fist Kepso and Fist Silena to let them in. Unfortunately, the Flaming Fist soldiers refuse to let refugees in, even though they have family members inside Baldur's Gate, because they are outsiders. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Fist Kepso Citizens only. I won't say it again. Horus Crysst But - but we walked clear from Amn . There's nowhere else to go. Please - Fist Silena Orders are orders. We've got ours, you've got yours. I need you to step back. Noira Crysst There must be something - Fist Silena I said step back. Horus Crysst Please. My son - he's only a boy. You must understand - Fist Silena Sir. Sir. We can't let you in. Horus Crysst I - I thought we'd be safe in the Gate. I heard the stories. Fist Kepso Wail all you want - we've got enough mouths to feed. We don't need your kind. Horus Crysst Our - our kind? Fist Kepso Refugees. Outsiders. Fist Silena Enough, Kepso. Sir, you need to stay clear. Noira Crysst The Duke - Ravengard, I think. I heard he's a good man. Horus Crysst Let us talk to him. Please. If he could just - Fist Kepso We have the Duke's full support. For the good of the people. MOO_Cultist Adept Nola is stationed on the west side of the Moonrise Towers throne room in Act Two . “ Don't try giving orders, True Soul. Everyone here answers directly to Z'rell. „ — Nola Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Nola is in the Moonrise Towers throne room, standing guard over the trial presided by Ketheric Thorm . After the trial ends, Nola moves to stand guard on the western side of the room, next to the door leading into the Moonrise Towers Prison . Interacting with Nola shows her indifference to the party, and that she does not care about their status as True Souls . Nevertheless, after Isobel is kidnapped, she confidently asserts that she will become a True Soul once they take Baldur's Gate . Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Nola is part of the remaining forces defending Moonrise Towers, and remains in the throne room. Should the party enter the throne room prematurely, or kill a few Absolutists in the hall, she joins combat. Technical UID S_LOW_BeachSahuagin_Civilian_003 UUID 7d8d9cb0-eb53-402b-a5a7-e8878da2427f Stats Halfling_Commoner Nonabune is a strongheart halfling walking by the docks east of Philgrave's Mansion in the Lower City . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nonabune is initially seen walking on the beach next to Philgrave's Mansion , his path only a few steps away from where Old Troutman sells fish. Should the Sahuagin attack the docks and Nonabune survive, he has a completely ecstatic and joyful reaction in the wake of what happened. He believes the events that unfolded will make for a great story, and improvises on the spot a name for it: "When Fish Fight Back " [ 1 ] [ 2 ] . Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Nonabune is one of only two strongheart halflings in the entirety of the game. The other strongheart halfling being Robbin Datherswick , a customer of Felogyr's Fireworks and secret Banite . Despite being a strongheart halfling, Nonabune does not have the Poison Resistance as he should. Nonabune has a rare and unusual developer comment in the code that's shared with all nearby NPCs in the docks/beach area, simply describing him as "POTENTIAL SIMPLE CHARACTER". Technical UID S_WYR_TiredWalkers_Mother UUID 51d12be7-131c-4a07-9d38-57b88a6f56bf Stats Human_Commoner Nonah Baragezian is a human refugee who appears just after entering Rivington . “ We told our son that this is a holiday to spare him the truth. We don't have homes to go back to. „ — Nonah Baragezian Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nonah Baragezian is a refugee near the Rivington waypoint. She is trying to persuade her recalcitrant son Charl Baragezian to continue their journey to Baldur's Gate by promising sweets. Her husband Fyl Baragezian is trying to convince Charl as well. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Fyl Baragezian Nearly there now. You can see the city, up on the hill. Charl Baragezian I see it, but it's up there, and we're down here! Nonah Baragezian That's why we need to walk just a little more. One foot in front of the other. Charl Baragezian You have been saying that for days. My feet hurt! Fyl Baragezian I know, little one. But you'll be in a big, cosy bed soon enough. Nonah Baragezian And you'll have anything you want for supper. All the treats your tummy can handle. Charl Baragezian I'm never allowed sweet things right before bed. Fyl Baragezian This one time we'll make an exception. Technical UID S_LOW_FireworksHouse_BaniteGuard04 UUID c6e81e27-210c-4a62-8a1b-f1f9bd075d24 Stats LOW_Human_FelogyrFireworks_AlchemichalWorker Chymist Norffe is a human who can be encountered in the Felogyr's Fireworks workshop in the Lower City of the Baldur's Gate , in Act Three of the game, while following through the quest ⁠ Investigate the Suspicious Toys . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Chymist Norffe can be found on the second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks . He is an assistant of Tomboldt the Pallid , the head of the secret explosives' production that hides behind the veneer of the pyrotechnics shop. Norffe works in the main laboratory, guarded by Fist of Bane Hyrriet and Fist of Bane Volgu Drak . As the second floor of Felogyr's Fireworks is considered a restricted area, Chymist Norffe, along with other laboratory workers and guards, becomes hostile immediately upon seeing any party member there, or if he is spoken with. Also he joins the fight as soon as he notices any commotion, siding with other followers of Bane . She can be found in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Fist Norys patrols the streets of Lower City with Fist Togarr , Fist Pagnola and a Steel Watcher . Their route runs back and forth from the Singing Lute to the Beehive General Goods (approximately from X: -124 Y: -117 to X: -75 Y: -105 ). Norys and her mates do not respond to any attempts to speak with them, regardless of whether the Steel Watch Foundry is intact or destroyed. Technical UID S_LOW_HouseOfHope_Nubaldin UUID 046f67d9-d477-42d5-8b70-fd0a7911caf4 Stats Gnome_Melee Nubaldin is a rock gnome under the employ of Raphael as the keeper of the Chamber of Egress within the House of Hope . He is self-important and easily angered, wistful about the days he was in charge of the House's prison, before he made a mistake and was reassigned. “ I used to work in the prison, ensuring no desirable people left the House of Hope. Now, I guard the portals to ensure that no undesirable people enter. „ — Nubaldin , about his former and present duties History [ edit section | visual editor ] Nubaldin was previously in charge of Raphael's prison, with one of his charges a young Enver Gortash , who was sold to Raphael by his parents to pay off a debt. Nubaldin ordered Gortash around during his time in the House, [ 1 ] disliking him greatly and beating him for his own enjoyment. Gortash eventually escaped and, as the one responsible for him, Nubaldin was punished by Raphael for this oversight. Nubaldin was moved to the Chamber of Egress, until such a time that Raphael could find someone to replace him. [ 2 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nubaldin is found in the Chamber of Egress; the eastern room in the House of Hope filled with portals to different locations. The party can ask Nubaldin for help finding Hope , and he informs them that her corporeal form is locked in unbreakable chains in Raphael's dungeon. If Gortash is alive, the party can ask to see the prison, but must pass a Persuasion or Intimidation check, or read his mind, to discover that the entrance is left of the chamber's exit, and down a hatch that leads below the House. If Gortash is killed, Nubaldin is delighted to hear of it, and tells the party a secret entrance into the boudoir: through the balcony next door. He is also more than happy to tell them the way to the prison, no checks required. Technical UID S_LOW_BaldursGate_FlamingFist_Melee_003 UUID 631b6f9d-b5bd-4ea9-99ff-c8cb2f9b6c1d Stats FlamingFist_Human_Melee_Defender Fist Nudelmann is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist . He can be found in Lower City in Act Three . “ Either get in line or get gone. „ — Nudelmann Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Nudelmann is standing watch on the bridge at the Upper City Gate Checkpoint . He watches over the queue of residents trying to make their way into the Upper City . Having received orders to not let anyone into the Upper City, Nudelmann and his fellows: Fist Grassley , Fist Wizard Hartlebury , Fist Magnolia and Fist Qirahe , accompanied by a Steel Watcher , are trying to keep the queue orderly and prevent anyone from entering. If spoken to, Nudelmann, just as most other guards in the cordon, takes the player character for a citizen who tries to make their way through the gate ahead of the queue. If the party return to the city after acquiring all Netherstones , three infected refugees near the queue transform into Mind Flayers and attack the bypassers. Nudelmann is Surprised , but fights alongside the party. Once the Mind Flayers are dead, he and all the Fists around run away to warn their superiors, before completely vanishing from the game once far enough.
