Technical UID S_LOW_Guildhall_Zhent_Mercenary_001 UUID 5ac9c7ec-d26f-404e-bd17-e9d3dad000c4 Stats LOW_Guildhall_SlickInatra Slick Inatra is a high half elven ranger and sergeant of the Zhentarim who can be found in the Guildhall , during Act Three . She is the local leader of the Zhent mercenaries, protecting the Guildhall against Stone Lord intrusions. “ We're all on the same side, friend. Nine-Fingers invited us herself. „ — Slick Inatra , to the Guild's Professor. Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Protecting the Guildhall 1.2 Battle for the Guildhall 2 Combat 2.1 Attacks and actions 3 Loot 4 Idle banter 5 Related quests 6 Notes 7 References 8 External links Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Protecting the Guildhall [ edit section | visual editor ] Inatra can be found in the Guildhall , where she can be first observed talking with The Professor , reassuring them of their loyalty in regards to their alliance with the Guild . [ 1 ] Afterward, Inatra patrols the pit, southern and southwesthern half of the Guildhall, occasionally stopping to chat with other Zhentarim members. The Caravan Strongbox can be given to her for a reward if the party decided to deliver it themselves. However, if the party gave the chest to Zarys back in Act One , it can instead be pickpocketed from her or looted from her corpse. The Iron Flask will still be inside. During her patrol, she occasionally talks to her subordinates, telling them to be careful, [ 2 ] and that they are still waiting for orders. [ 3 ] She frequently stops by to chat with and chastise Phase in particular, for his unflattering hygiene and his tendencies to play betting games. [ 4 ] Battle for the Guildhall [ edit section | visual editor ] If Roah Moonglow , Boss Friol , or Trinoda attempts to take over the Guildhall, Inatra joins the fight alongside her Zhentarim allies against the Guild. Siding against the Zhentarim ends in Inatra's demise, or in her disappearance if she is knocked out. If the party aid the Zhentarim to win the battle, and if she survives the fight in Guildhall , Inatra takes position at the door leading into the guildmaster's office. She remarks that she did truly respect Nine-Fingers Keene , but nevertheless had no qualms following orders to attack her. [ 5 ] Inatra can be summoned with Gather Your Allies variant Black Fist Enforcers , if the party completed ⁠ Aid the Underduke and sided with the Zhentarim . Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Short rest Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Caravan Strongbox - only if the Caravan Strongbox has been delivered to Zarys back in Act One Drow Poison Longbow +1 Studded Leather Armour Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Slick Inatra We're all on the same side, friend. Nine-Fingers invited us herself. The Professor The guildmaster hired you, yes - but I think it's best if your Zhentarim keep to themselves. There's not a lot of trust in the Guildhall of late. Slick Inatra You're all scared shitless of this Stone Lord, you mean. Which is exactly why your boss hired us. Slick Inatra Look, if your lot could look after themselves, we wouldn't need to be here. The Professor The Guild is a collective of specialists - not a private army. Slick Inatra 'Specialists'. Thieves, con-artists, and killers - nothing so special about that, friend. The Professor ...There are no killers here, Zhent. Assassins, those are a different matter entirely. The Professor As you'll see, there's plenty of space for your people. Slick Inatra Down there in the damp, you mean. The Professor Count yourself lucky. This place is usually so full that you wouldn't find room to sit your padded arse down. Slick Inatra Don't try to flirt with me, boss. We both know this place is like a tomb because your crews are running scared. Slick Inatra And what are we meant to do about food? The Professor Talk to Severn at the bar. Slick Inatra What - the bugbear? The Professor The guildmaster poached him from a minor peer of Parliament. He's quite the cook. Slick Inatra I told our clients we'd be on our best behaviour. Everyone playing nice here? Phase Not playing at all, boss. Slick Inatra Even better. Slick Inatra Make sure the others keep to themselves. This place is jumpy - better to give the Guildies their space. Phase 'S not like we're bloody diseased, boss. Slick Inatra Worse, Phase - we're Zhentarim . Phase What are we waiting for, Inatra? If we're meant to fight this Stone Lord, then let's bloody be about it. Slick Inatra See my uniform, Phase? It's nicer than yours, agreed? And not just because I don't sleep in it. Slick Inatra That's because I outrank you. So when I say that I haven't even been told our orders yet, I want you to believe me. Phase Yes. Sergeant. Slick Inatra I'd also like you to bathe sometime this tenday. Phase Yes, sergeant. Phase The locals going to kick us out, sergeant? Slick Inatra Just you, Phase. You rob the place of its glamour. Phase No loss. Last time I was here they had dice, blood-bouts, the works. Now it's just a lot of sulking pickpockets. Slick Inatra Those sulks are paying us, Phase. So chin up, make your coin, and you can lose it somewhere else. Aye? Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Find the Missing Shipment ⁠ Aid the Underduke ⁠ Confront the Elder Brain Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Slick Inatra acts as the leader of the group of Zhentarim in the Guildhall , until Roah or Boss Friol arrives. She appears to be the one giving orders to the rest of the Zhentarim, and Phase refers to her as a Sergeant. It is not clear if Slick Inatra was aware of the Zhents' true purpose at the Guildhall before the takeover, as she mentions to Phase she has yet to receive any further orders, yet at the same time Carlorina the Wolf and Gravedigger Karcen are seemingly meant to be on alert for an unexplained signal. BG_Commoner Sloncha Owena is a Wood Elf having a picnic with Bogdan Vortleson outside of the Windmill in Rivington . “ Please, we're not looking for a third wheel. Not today, at least. „ — Sloncha Owena Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If the newborn Mind Flayer in the Rivington windmill was told to find his own corpse in ⁠ Feed the Mind Flayer , it attacks Bogdan and Sloncha. Sloncha is killed and Bogdan kidnapped, never to be seen again. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Sloncha Owena This was a wonderful idea. Just what we needed. Bogdan Vortleson I thought you might want to get your mind off things. I know I do. Sloncha Owena True. What with all the refugees, ill rumours, the food shortages... Sloncha Owena Speaking of which, I'm surprised you managed to get such a spread. Bogdan Vortleson Ways and means, dear. Ways and means. Sloncha Owena Did you hear something earlier? Almost like a groan. Bogdan Vortleson Well, we're by a windmill, after all. Probably some cog or joint in need of a little grease. Sloncha Owena Hmm. Speaking of grease, are there any sausage rolls left? Bogdan Vortleson Freshen your drink, perhaps? Sloncha Owena I think it's been freshened enough times as it is - I can feel my face going flush. Bogdan Vortleson And here was me, thinking you were blushing with happiness to be here with me. Sloncha Owena Oh I see, compliments in return for the picnic, is it? Maybe I'll take that drink after all... Technical UID S_LOW_SteelwatchGame_Player3 UUID 0d6593c5-1739-4c35-ae0f-a975ecf702c3 Stats Human_Child Slow-Butt is a human child in the Steeps district of the Lower City in Act Three . “ Hey! You jumped the queue! I was s'posed to be next! „ — Slow-Butt Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Slow-Butt plays with his friends on a small stone-paved space at X: -166 Y: -75 . He and his two mates, Cinnamon and Punkins , are standing near Golbraith's Home . He is waiting to take his turn in a game where the kids pretend to be a Steel Watcher scanning two others as citizens to check their 'records'. However, his friends obviously toss the 'watcher' role to each other, denying Slow-Butt a chance to participate. If spoken to, Slow-Butt complains that he is bored waiting for his turn to portray the automaton. If a party member takes part in the game and asks Punkins to scan them, Slow-Butt complains that they jumped the queue. If the party tell Punkins about Cinnamon's "spy candy" (detecting it prior), Slow-Butt gloats about it, saying he calls dibs on this sweet. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Punkins Halt, citizen! Prepare to be scanned! Cinnamon I am holding very still! Go ahead and scan, Watcher ! Punkins Humm humm humm zip! Punkins Hold still, citizen. Initiating scans and stuff. Cinnamon Go ahead! I am totally not an Absolute spy! Punkins Humm zip humm humm zip! Punkins Violation! Violation! Whoop whoop! Cinnamon No way, hee hee! I know my rights and I have nothing to hide! Slow-Butt Ha ha! Fun at last! Punish her, Watcher! Slow-Butt Aw, come on! When is it my turn? Punkins Be patient, citizen. Technical UID S_WYR_SteelWatcherNerds_Human UUID ea910cbb-9a38-4066-ad09-1958f173dcdc Stats Human_Commoner Slozy Arminifer is in Wyrm's Crossing in Act Three . “ Excuse me, we're discussing Steel Watcher gyronetics - a topic beyond your understanding, I imagine. „ — Slozy Arminifer Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Slozy Arminifer together with Vinegaroon and Trinigan Gazotts is standing near Carm's Garms , discussing spiritedly the technical features of the Steel Watchers . The three of them are fascinated by this latest novelty in maintaining order, and meet every day to discuss the automatons' specialties. Slozy's friend, Vinegaroon, dreams of meeting a Gondian who invented the Steel Watch, seemingly proud of these mechanisms being a product of a gnome's mind. Slozy argues with this, calling Enver Gortash - a human - an actual inventor of the automatons. If spoken to, Slozy behaves arrogantly, deeming the party member too inexpert in mechanics to discuss the subject with them. If the Steel Watch Foundry is destroyed, idle banter of the three enthusiasts changes: they are saddened because of it, and Slozy blames the Cult of the Absolute for doing this. v t e Wyrm's Crossing Characters Cultists of Bhaal Gavv Hemm Lunn Zoll Flaming Fists Azari Edwynna Elin Falcäo Gai Meadows Mîran Shah Carm's Garms Naaber Slozy Arminifer Trinigan Gazotts Vinegaroon Danthelon's Dancing Axe Geraldus Limmy Safyre Somi Tairn Fraygo's Flophouse Bernyr Crak Dalyria Dashkent Moliver Drim Ffion Goldgrind Petras Rilia Rosanna Sharess' Caress Amira Arfur Gregorio Borgus Elamin Chapeau Chorizo Cillian Earspoon Embry Ghainemeir Hakeem Irenya Jara Kira Korrilla Laila Naoise Nallinto Nym Orlith Raphael Rhol Sorn Orlith Surixana Valeria Voss Other Kali Hammerhand Neno Quilltop Traders Carmen Pennygood Entharl Danthelon Glynda Oltower Griska Hoots Hooligan Queelia Arvis Roberon Silt Stylin' Horst Thodric Shedeveer Velson Oakes Locations Carm's Garms Danthelon's Dancing Axe Fraygo's Flophouse Sharess' Caress The Velveteen Elixir Quests Deal with the Devil Deal with the Gnomes Find a way into Wyrm's Rock fortress Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion Free Orpheus Help Kith'rak Voss Investigate Cazador's Palace Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders The Githyanki Warrior The High Harper

Technical UID S_LOW_PrisonGuard01 UUID 6dd2049c-413c-4c68-b58f-2a0cf5094053 Stats FlamingFist_Human_Melee_Defender Fist Smithwynn is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist . He can be found in Lower City in Act Three . “ I could read you the list of crimes you committed while you were stumbling and singing your way across the city, but I don't have a tenday to spare. „ — Smithwynn , greeting the player character who wakes up in cell Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Smithwynn together with Fist Arrinye , Fist Corlos and a Steel Watcher guards the Heapside Prison underneath the Basilisk Gate Barracks . He stands watch inside the prison proper, randomly wandering between several points ( X: -1262 Y: 756 , X: -1272 Y: 764 and X: -1275 Y: 755 ). If spoken to, he just suggests that the player character mind their own business. However, if the player character comes to their senses in the prison after tasting Hoots Hooligan's special hooch (while within the Lower City only), Smithwynn greets them monitively and says he has never seen anyone so drunk, even while patrolling city quarters around the Blushing Mermaid . He clearly hints at the player character having messed around heavily after blacking out. Technical UID S_GOB_SpiderNest_Adventurer UUID 692ebd77-cfe7-4cac-8022-bd835e9e5a82 Stats Human_Commoner Smythin is a human captive in the Goblin Camp during Act One . “ At least give me a sword! „ — Smythin , before being shoved to his death Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] As the party approach the area above the spider pit in the Shattered Sanctum of the Goblin Camp, they encounter goblin warriors Druk and Bez planning to push Smythin into the pit. If left alone, Smythin is shoved in and dies on impact. It is possible to save Smythin if Druk and Bez are killed or removed from the room. This can be done in a number of ways, such as pushing or throwing the goblins themselves into the pit. To prevent the entire camp from becoming hostile toward the party, it is possible to throw a Potion of Invisibility at Smythin. Alternatively, a party member can cast Minor Illusion , lure them into Dror Ragzlin's room and then close the gate. If Smythin is saved, he flees and disappears permanently; party members with the Folk Hero background gain the ⁠ Saved by a Thread inspiration. Escorting Sazza out of the grove prevents Smythin from spawning and also prevents party members from getting any inspiration involving him. However, it is possible to escort her out after rescuing Smythin at the goblin camp. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Smythin can be drawn toward the party with Command: Approach ; however, if he does not move far enough away from the goblins, Druk runs up to him and shoves him anyway. Regardless of whether Smythin falls, once he is shoved, he dies. v t e Goblin Camp Characters Bugbears Bao'ek'nuk Stimk Teghun Camp Followers Owlbear Cub Volo Companions Halsin Minthara Goblins Aggy Azak Bal Bez Birka Bolt Brakkal Breg Clack Crub Crusher Cry Culk Druk Dullwill Eef Fezk Glomp Gnat Greez Gribbo Grikka Grush Gruz Gurd Gurk Huk Kirz Klagga Krolla Mirg Mrak Muzul Nass Neem Nik-Nuk Nozk Nrog Olak Piddle Plagg Plig Puce Puli Raagg Rancer Rindle Roo Rot Rozzak Sazza Shekt Sluck Snurd Spike Skrut Sul Tak Tiny Tizg Tozad Trinzas Tud Vrak Wasp Zami Zurga Zurk Children Eight Five Four One Three Goblin Leaders Dror Ragzlin Gut Minthara Ogres Gurgon Polma Traders Grat Roah Moonglow Other Abdirak Andrick Brynna Dishevelled Chicken Erna Ferr Larger Giant Spider Kagran Klaw Liam Narvass Smaller Giant Spider Small Klaw Smythin Taeglyn Tale Yerle Locations Bloodied Shrine Defiled Temple Goblin Camp Shattered Sanctum Worg Pens Quests Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Defeat the Goblins Find a Cure Find the Nightsong Raid the Emerald Grove Rescue the Druid Halsin Rescue Volo Save the First Druid Save the Goblin Sazza Save the Refugees Travel to Moonrise Towers

If the goblins survive the raid, the four goblins can then be found enjoying a pissing contest by the shore. Technical UID S_LOW_BhaalTemple_Reaper_02 UUID ef16770b-0590-457f-8475-712f2c491be2 Stats Human_Cultist_Bhaal_Reaper Reaper of Bhaal Snirr is a member of the Cult of Bhaal , found in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate . “ Orin taught us some very specific cruelties. Betray the Chosen's trust, and I will inflict them upon you without hesitation. „ — Snirr , to the companion of the Dark Urge who embraced Bhaal Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] The party can go to the Bhaal Temple in hopes of saving their party member from Orin . There they encounter Orin, who engages the party in combat by transforming into a Slayer . Snirr, along with the rest of the reapers, begins channeling a ritual spell Bloody Favour , granting Orin a Boon of Bhaal at the start of every turn. If the player character is not the Dark Urge , and Orin is killed or disabled, Snirr ends concentration and attacks the party as normal. If the player character is the Dark Urge and defeats Orin, Snirr remains neutral to the party and moves to the foot of one of the stairs leading to the central altar ground. His one-liners depend on whether the Dark Urge embraces or rejects their Bhaalspawn legacy. Technical UID S_LOW_HeapsideGuardTower_FlamingFist2 UUID cf256b0e-c80a-4fea-94c0-2a420fdeb3f9 Stats FlamingFist_Human_Melee_Defender Gauntlet Soapstone is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist in the Lower City . “ Your sunny, smiling face convinces me that all's well and I can take a little snooze. „ — Soapstone , after positive article about the party is printed Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Soapstone is stationed at the base of the Central Watch Tower in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate , accompanied by Gonfalon . If spoken to, Soapstone expresses a wish to shift their common duties onto Gonfalon and take a nap. Her reaction to the player character might differ depending on the positive/negative article printed about them in the Baldur's Mouth Gazette (or neither printed at all), as an outcome for ⁠ Stop the Presses quest. Technical UID S_WYR_BusinessIsBusiness_Dwarf02 UUID 2f0f30de-a38c-4a8f-bfc2-ff7a3811c436 Stats Dwarf_Commoner Solras is a dwarven refugee who appears just after entering Rivington . “ If I hear one more pitch for a 'new business', I'm going to scream . „ — Solras Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Solras is a refugee near the Rivington waypoint. She is discussing a new business opportunity with Nisvan . Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Nisvan I'm not asking for much - just a teensy investment to get me started. Solras Uh-huh. What are you calling this new 'business'? Nisvan 'Cheap and Cheerful - Refugees for Hire!' Catchy, right? Solras Mate, there is so much wrong with that name. Nisvan Think about it - they're stuck here with no coin and nothing to do! Solras You're going to hire all the refugees? Just like that? Nisvan Of course! Cleaning, cooking, construction - the possibilities are endless! Solras What do you get out of this, hmm? Nisvan Well, it's the right thing to do, isn't it? Everyone deserves the chance to make some coin. Solras Say the refugees agree to work for you - how much are you going to pay them? Nisvan Well, considering this economy, plus the risk I'm taking, I'd say... half the going rate? Solras Hah! So you're going to pay slave wages and undercut the locals? Nisvan Slaves don't get wages. This is honest business! Solras Aye. MOO_Cultist Zealot Soreni is stationed in the Moonrise Towers Prison in Act Two . “ Do I know you, True Soul? Feels like we met before - maybe in a previous life. „ — Soreni Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Soreni is in the Moonrise Towers Prison , conversing with fellow drow Zealot Zira about the fates of the True Souls that have received audiences from Ketheric Thorm and the Absolute . If a party member interacts with Soreni, she informs the party that they moved all the cargo to the docks outside. Should the party attempt to ⁠ help the gnomes and ⁠ tieflings escape from the prison, Soreni can join The Warden in pursuit of the escapees should the cells be opened (either by the party, or by the Warden). Soreni can engage the prisoners in combat and kill them if the party does not intervene. Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Soreni is killed during the subsequent battle. Her corpse is next to the staircase leading into Moonrise Towers, at X: -153 Y: -114 . Gold_Pocket_Modest Variant 1 UID UNI_WYR_DapperDrow_Brother_Naked UUID e1b256c5-17ac-41ae-81ef-6977afe510e9 Stats WYR_DapperDrow_Brother Trs. Gold_Pocket_Modest Sorn Orlith [ 1 ] is a Seldarine Drow sex worker employed at Sharess' Caress , where he works alongside his twin sister, Nym Orlith . “ Remember our vow to keep one another safe? When the music stops, you and I - we will continue dancing. „ — Sorn Orlith , reassuring his sister, Nym History [ edit section | visual editor ] Hailing from the Underdark , Sorn was originally employed as a courtesan, and Nym as an artisanal masseuse. The pair fled the Underdark due to the matriarchy's mistreatment of men, ultimately coming to work in Baldur's Gate. Sorn seems to thoroughly enjoy his line of work, particularly fulfilling extreme and interesting fantasies; he remarks that Drow culture is obsessed with bondage, which became boring. Sorn also believes that snails are an aphrodisiac. A Lolth-sworn Tav or Dark Urge can question the validity of their claims about their background by pointing out that Sorn and Nym are Seldarine Drow. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Services from Sorn or Nym individually cost 500 gold, and from both together cost 1000 gold. Completing ⁠ Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion , then reporting back to Mamzell Amira and requesting a reward results in Mamzell Amira offering the party the drow's services at a discount; the player character can then hire one of the twins for free, or both for 500 Gold. Sorn and Nym Orlith can be hired by the player character individually, or as a pair together with additional companions, although - in most cases - this is only possible if said companions are romanced. [ 2 ] If the player character is in a romance with Shadowheart and her final romance scene has not been triggered yet, she rejects the invitation, wanting the first time to be just her and the player character. After that scene, she enthusiastically agrees to have sex with Sorn, Nym, and the player character. Astarion , when romanced, only agrees after ⁠ The Pale Elf is completed. However, as the night unfolds the narrator notes that while Astarion plays his part enthusiastically, he either has "a look <...> that reveals he's a million realms away" or "in his eyes there is <...> an intensity that makes you [ 3 ] shiver" (depending on the quest outcome). A romanced Gale can be convinced to participate with DC 25 Persuasion Check , but once the scene begins, he ducks out and leaves behind an Astral Projection to participate in his stead. Halsin , when romanced, also always agrees, and if romanced at the same time as Shadowheart or Astarion, can join in alongside them. If Halsin joins alongside another romanced companion and increases the number of participants to five, Sorn observes that in Qu'ellarz'orrl custom, a group of five or more is "legally" an orgy, while four or fewer is simply a gathering. Other companions reject Sorn and Nym's invitation. However, Karlach admits that while having a foursome sounds appealing in theory, the reality of doing so with the twins is not. However, if the player character backs out as well and hires only one twin, she happily encourages them to have fun and save some for her later. Sorn's one-on-one scenes are brief and generally comical in nature. When hired alone, Sorn can be asked to do the following: Pretend to be Drizzt Do'Urden , to which he remarks "not again." Provide an "unusual sensation", which results in him spilling spiders all over the bed. To simply be as he is, which results in him calling the player character a prude before providing his services. To use the Menzoberranzan Love Trick, which seems to be Sorn casting Enlarge on himself. To do missionary with the lights off. Sorn seems to particularly enjoy this, as the narrator remarks at the end: "The drow seems to have the time of his life." Sorn only offers to commence activities once all non-participating party members have left the room. If any are present, he admonishes the player character, stating, "As much as I enjoy when others watch, that wasn't included in the price." [ 4 ] [ 5 ] Once either or both of the twins are met in their room, the player character can also change their mind and decide not to go through with the act, which results in either sibling returning the fee paid. Receiving the service from either of the drow grants the following inspiration: ⁠ Alternative Vocations ( Guild Artisan background) ⁠ Carnal Rituals of Sharess ( Acolyte background) ⁠ Giving a Private Performance ( Entertainer background) Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Bone Chill ( ) Damage: 1~8 1d8 ⁠ Necrotic Prevent the target from healing until your next turn. The target cannot help Downed characters. An undead target receives Disadvantage on Attack Rolls . Range: 18 m (60 ft) Darkness ( + ) Create a cloud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscures and inflicts Blind to creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of it. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Knock ( + ) Unlock an object that is held shut by a mundane lock. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Garrotte ( ) Damage: 1~6 1d6 ⁠ Bludgeoning Wrap a rope around a creature's throat to start Garrotting it. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Recharge: Per turn Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Key Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ In Drow language, "Sorn" means "enchanted" or "spell", see Owen K.C. Stephens, "By Any Other Name: The Drow", Dragon 267 (January 2000): 28-31 ↑ Astarion is the only known exception to this rule. If the player character has never slept with Astarion, is not romancing him, and he is present when Nym or Sorn is spoken with about the prospect of sleeping with her and Sorn together, Nym declares, "In that case, we will require two of you . And indeed, I suggest it because I have never seen a creature as fair as this beau beside you." To this Astarion replies, "What a world. I never dreamed I'd be on the paying end in a brothel. But, our leader here has made the mistake of failing to sleep with me so far, and it's a mistake I've been aching to correct." Astarion gives this rejoinder even if ⁠ The Pale Elf has not been completed, and the player character may then accept Nym's invitation for them all together as a foursome. ↑ I.e., the partnering player character ↑ A glitch sometimes occurs if Scratch is summoned when the player character and Shadowheart approach Nym and Sorn in their Private Room to initiate the sex scene. If triggered, Nym and Sorn roll for initiative and combat begins. Dismissing Scratch solves this problem. A summoned Planar Ally: Djinni or Conjured Elemental also starts combat upon initiating dialogue. ↑ All of Sorn and Nym's sex scenes are largely voiceover with a black screen; the lights in the room are turned off as "part of the experience." Technical UID S_DEN_BardSquirrel UUID efc0ba71-b3fa-4bb5-8a38-10bd0dd8b923 Stats Rat Spar is a Squirrel in the Emerald Grove in Act One . He can be found next to Alfira , painfully listening to her sing alongside Corinna . “ Please, make it stop! „ — Spar Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party talk to Spar and Corinna without Speak with Animals , they both screech and run away. If the party ask the pair what is wrong, they describe how awful Alfira's singing is; the party can respond with a few options, all of which cause them to leave: It is quite a racket. You could spare your ears by leaving. Sing along with the bard - as loudly and off-key as you can. Don't mock her - she's trying her best... I assume. If the party tell the Squirrels they are ruining the song, Corinna and Spar begin a duet. The party can respond with a few options: Bravo. You could go on tour, with talent like that. [BARD] [TIEFLING]  Sing along with them, improvising lyrics: 'How can we stop this dreadful song, this half-formed verse from leaden tongue?'   +1   +1   -1 [BARD]  Sing along with them, improvising lyrics: 'How can we stop this dreadful song, half-formed verse from devil's tongue?'   +1   +1   -1 Shut up - I want to hear the bard. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Spar and Corinna's scathing critique of Alfira's performance is likely intended as meta-humor, as they are voiced by the game's performance director and voice director respectively. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Faerie Fire ( + ) All targets within the light turn visible, and Attack Rolls against them have Advantage . DEX Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Invisibility ( + ) Touch a creature to turn it Invisible . Attacks against it have Disadvantage . It attacks with Advantage . Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, interacts with an object, takes an action or bonus action, or is damaged. Technical UID S_LOW_HeapsideKitchenHelper_Civilian1 UUID fb90d37e-5fda-4660-bd27-6cf9a4aca4a4 Stats Dwarf_Commoner Spatula Farggo is a dwarven kitchen worker in the Elfsong Tavern distributing leftovers to hungry Baldur's Gate citizens during Act Three . “ I've seen hungry folk try and eat copies of the Gazette before - wouldn't recommend it. „ — Spatula Farggo Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Farggo is just outside the kitchen of the Elfsong Tavern surrounded by Harissa Chopeta , Pickles , Slumgullion , and Tooralooralayo . He is attempting to distribute discarded food without Chef Roveer knowing. Farggo's attitude towards the party changes depending on the outcome of ⁠ Stop the Presses . Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Spatula Farggo Quiet, now - we don't want Chef Roveer overhearing us. Spatula Farggo And don't push! There's enough for everyone, for Chauntea's sake. Harissa Chopeta Sorry, sir. Thank you, sir. Tooralooralayo Gods bless you for your kindness! Spatula Farggo It's the least I can do - all this would've gone to waste otherwise. Spatula Farggo I don't like giving you what other people have been picking at... Spatula Farggo But there is a whole chicken someone only took a leg off. Spatula Farggo I wouldn't give you anything I wouldn't eat myself. Harissa Chopeta Can... can I have that, please, sir? Spatula Farggo Of course, love! And please don't call me sir - I'm barely even a chef. Technical UID S_UND_MyconidSovereign UUID ea0f222f-eaad-4d83-bbcd-cbae51ccf265 Stats Myconid_Sovereign Trs. UND_Myconid_SovereignCorpse Sovereign Spaw is a myconid in Baldur's Gate 3 . It is the Sovereign of the Myconid colony in Ebonlake Grotto . “ ((*flesh-talker. I show you a memory. watch and listen*)) „ — Spaw Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Sovereign Spaw's colony was attacked by duergar slavers who were trying to recapture Thulla , a runaway deep gnome slave the Myconids were giving safe harbour to. They were able to repel the deep dwarves, but sought help to finish off the invaders. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Spaw telepathically engages the party from afar when they pass through Rapport Spores for the first time. Spaw explains using imagery that duergar invaders have been killing their young, and then threatens the party with images of strangulation. To enter the Ebonlake Grotto peacefully, the party must convince Spaw: [ 1 ] [PERSUASION]  Conjure tranquil memories in hopes of calming the sovereign.  (DC 5) [INTIMIDATION]  Do you truly wish to do battle with a great warrior? (DC 10)  (if not a Berserker) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  THREATEN ME AGAIN. I DARE YOU. (DC 10  ) [GITHYANKI] [INTIMIDATION]  Utter a githyanki war cry. Did you truly wish to risk battle with me? (DC 10) [PERSUASION]  Kneel in submission. I mean no harm to you. (DC 10) [DUERGAR] [PERSUASION]  Kneel in submission. I am not of the killers' clan. (DC 10) [PERSUASION]  I am a traveller seeking adventure. (DC 5) [INSIGHT]  Seek understanding. Focus on the sovereign's song.  (DC 5) I sense your fear. I've come to aid you. [INTIMIDATION]  My purpose is private. Let me pass, and I will leave you unharmed. (DC 5) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  ROAR.  (DC 5  ) [BARD]  Hum a peaceful tune in harmony with the sovereign.   (if not Githyanki) [BARD] [GITHYANKI]  Mumble an ancient gith axiom in rhythm with the sovereign. [DROW-ELF] [DROW HALF-ELF] [DEEP GNOME]  The Underdark is my home. I do not need your permission to be here. [OATH OF THE ANCIENTS]  I am nature's bulwark. Where good things grow, I lend my protection. [OATH OF DEVOTION]  To do what is right. To do my duty. [OATH OF VENGEANCE]  I seek retribution for those who cannot. [OATH OF THE CROWN]  I am a servant of the law in lawless places. [OATHBREAKER]  I have no 'purpose'. I simply am . That is enough. Tell the truth of the parasite. You only seek safe passage in your search for treatment. If a Duergar is in the party, conversation options change and it becomes harder to convince them of the party's non-aggressive intent: [ 1 ] [PERSUASION]  Conjure tranquil memories in hopes of calming the sovereign.  (DC 10) [DUERGAR] [PERSUASION]  Kneel in submission. I mean no harm to you.  (DC 10) [PERSUASION]  Kneel in submission. My duergar companion means you no harm.  (DC 10) [INTIMIDATION]  If I wanted you dead, you would be. Don't tempt me. (DC 10) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  ROAR.  (DC 10  ) When they come face-to-fungi in the Ebonlake Grotto, Spaw asks the party to slay the duergar who threaten its colony. If the party slay the duergar, or a bard convinces Spaw to believe they are already dead ( DC 20 Deception Check ) Spaw goes further and requests Nere's head, ending the Absolute's push through the Underdark . If the party complete this quest, Spaw transforms the dead drow's head into a Blooming Drow Head and the colony celebrates with a dance. Glut [ edit section | visual editor ] The party can turn on Spaw as part of ⁠ Avenge Glut's Circle . Attempting to coup Spaw turns the entire colony hostile against Glut and the party, but this battle can be ended prematurely by focusing on Spaw alone. Once Spaw is dead, the rest of the colony turns neutral again as they immediately accept Glut as a new sovereign. This grants the ⁠ New Management inspiration to party members with the Haunted One background. The mere fact of first supporting Glut in his plans for a coup and then picking a whichever side earns another inspirational event: ⁠ Warmonger ( Charlatan background). Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Animating Spores ( ) Release spores at a corpse to animate it as a spore servant under your command. Range: 3 m (10 ft) Recharge: Per turn Fist ( ) Damage: 6~36 3d8 ⁠ Bludgeoning + 3d4 ⁠ Poison Lash out with a fungal hand. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Multiattack ( ) Damage: 16~72 4d8 + 4 ⁠ Bludgeoning + 4d8 + 4 ⁠ Bludgeoning Aim multiple attacks at a target. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] The Sovereign's Key Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Avenge Glut's Circle ⁠ Defeat the Duergar Intruders ⁠ Deliver Nere's Head Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Render by Luna Wullaert Render by Luna Wullaert Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] The tooltip of Spaw's animating spores mentions that it can only be used on one target at a time; however, Spaw can use it each turn as long as there are valid targets. When Spaw initially greets the party telepathically, it commands them to "descend" to it, despite the party needing to climb up a large series of mushroom "steps" to get to it. Spaw does not join the combat between the party and Glut even if caught in the crossfire. Spaw cannot be stolen from. Technical UID S_GOB_Torturers_Spike UUID 3f1fa953-6a0d-4589-adfd-23c69603da2f Stats Goblin_Melee_Strong Eqp. EQP_Club Trs. GOB_Goblin_Generic Torturer Spike is a goblin and follower of the Absolute . He and Lookout Grush torture Liam next to the Bloodied Shrine within the Shattered Sanctum of the Goblin Camp . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] When approached, a cutscene plays out where Spike is torturing Liam, and he asks the interacting party member if they want to join him. They can either join in on and take over the interrogation, force Spike to leave using their Illithid tadpole, or lie to him telling him they have been relieved. If the party member tortures Liam to reveal the Emerald Grove's location, Spike then heads to Minthara and informs her, after which she prepares the assault. After informing Minthara, he moves to where Abdirak is and loiters. Torturing Liam grants the inspiration ⁠ Grabbing the Poker with Both Hands for a character with the Haunted One background. [ 1 ] Freeing Liam grants the inspiration ⁠ Fate Worse Than Death for party members with the Folk Hero background. If Spike witnesses a party member undergo the pain ritual, he claims that he needs to "see it again" and commands Grush to undergo the ritual as well. The party can watch as Grush takes hit after hit, eventually succumbing and getting Knocked Out . Don't swallow me! I taste like crap! „ — Spool Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Spool, together with his friends Stinker and Runt , can be encountered in the alley in front of Devil's Fee shop. They are egging each other to test their courage and enter the spooky house. Runt and Stinker dare one another to visit the "devil's house" but none of them wants to go first, mocking and accusing each other of cowardice. Spool, however, thinks it all boring and offers to change the game. Runt, Spool and Stinker's reactions to the party vary depending on the resolution of ⁠ Stop the Presses quest: they either look at them as heroes who will without a doubt enter the place, or deem them as devils who just emerged from the hellish house to swallow them up. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Runt You go first. It was your idea. Stinker Yeah, but I dared you first, so you have to go. Runt Nuh-uh, my fingers were crossed. I'm not going in there and getting swallowed by a devil. Stinker Oh, I get it. You're scaaaaaaared. Spool Aw, knock it off and let's go home. We can play Chase the Gelatinous Cube in the alley. Technical UID S_MOO_KethericHound UUID 9c7a8f97-bae8-4509-ad10-a67c17202a31 Stats Skeleton_Hound Squire is an undead dog in Ketheric Thorm's room on the first floor of Moonrise Towers during Act Two . Squire takes the form of a filigreed skeleton, as loyal in death as she was in life. “ Hm. Hmmm... All right, that's enough. „ — Squire , when receiving pets Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] History [ edit section | visual editor ] Prior to becoming undead, Squire was the Thorm family dog. She died the same night as Isobel while trying to protect her, an event she now only vaguely remembers. As part of Ketheric's desperate alliance with Myrkul to restore his lost family, he also revived Squire. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Squire can initially be seen standing next to Ketheric on his throne before the cutscene, and later found patrolling his bedroom in Moonrise Towers. She can be spoken to with or without Speak with Animals , and depending on the outcome, she lets the party pass or becomes hostile and attacks. If the party has the Blessing of Selûne and initiates any dialogue with Squire, with or without Speak with Animals, she disappears from Moonrise Towers once the party enters the Shadowfell and completes ⁠ Find the Nightsong , and does not join Ketheric in the battle on the rooftop. With Speak with Animals [ edit section | visual editor ] If the interacting party member received the Blessing of Selûne and can Speak with Animals , Squire recognises the scent of Selûnite magic and remarks that the party smells familiar. If they let Squire smell them, the undead hound describes the scent with nostalgia, saying that the tower's current odour is 'wrong'. The skeletal dog subsequently inquires into the party's motives. The party can report that they 'only want to stop the Absolute', to which Squire says her loyalties are strictly to Ketheric, not the Absolute, and lets the party pass peacefully. Alternatively, Squire can be pacified using an ability check: [PERFORMANCE]  Give her your best salute.  (DC 6) [PERSUASION]  I'm just exploring the tower. I mean no harm. (DC 6) [INTIMIDATION]  Down, lapdog. A True Soul walks where they please. (DC 18) If Squire is pacified, it is possible to ask to pet her. She accepts, for a few moments, noting that the interacting party member is the first soldier who is brave enough to try. If the interacting party member carries Scratch's Ball , they can let Squire sniff the ball. She verbally snaps at the party member for being patronising, but wistfully remarks that whichever dog owns the ball seems comfortable and happy. Without Speak with Animals [ edit section | visual editor ] If the interacting party member lacks Speak with Animals , Squire can still recognise the familiar smell from the Blessing of Selûne , but without the ability to converse, the interacting party member needs to pass an Animal Handling , Performance , or Intimidation check to avoid hostilities: [ANIMAL HANDLING]  Lower your eyes - you're no threat.  (DC 18) [PERFORMANCE]  Snap off your best salute.  (DC 18) [INTIMIDATION]  Give the creature a snarl of your own.  (DC 18) The party can also reduce the DC requirements from 18 to 14: Stay still and let it sniff you.   (if the party received Blessing of Selûne) Wave Scratch's ball.   (if the party didn't receive the blessing but possesses Scratch's Ball) Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Bite ( ) Damage: 5~19 2d8 + 3 ⁠ Piercing Bite with cold, lifeless fangs that   Bone Chill a target. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Calling for Help ( ) The creature calls out in alarm to alert its allies. Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Faded Drow Leather Armour Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Sszaryn can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . Who are you? Dead Drow Raider ... Sszaryn... Where are you from? Dead Drow Raider ... from... Sshamath... before... the Absolute... What was your profession? Dead Drow Raider ... male... How did you die? Dead Drow Raider ... archer... roof... should have... seen... Why were you at the inn? Dead Drow Raider ... raid... retrieval... for the Absolute... What were you trying to retrieve? Dead Drow Raider ... Grand... Duke... Absolute... demands him... Where were you trying to take the Duke? Dead Drow Raider ... take... to Moonrise ... Towers... Was the raid successful? Narrator *The corpse remains silent. It does not know.* [LOLTH CLERIC] [LOLTH DROW] [LOLTH PALADIN]  Have you forsaken Lolth ? Dead Drow Raider ... false... goddess... only... Absolute... Technical UID S_LOW_SWS_Patrols_001_FF_000 UUID 04589068-fb1d-4497-8a54-38eebe94290a Stats FlamingFist_Human_Melee_Attacker Fist Starrlet is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist . She can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Fist Starrlet patrols the streets of the Lower City with Fist Syllving , Fist Discoria and a Steel Watcher . Their route runs back and forth from the bridge and gates to the Upper City to the Society of Brilliance Lodge (approximately from X: -195 Y: -10 to X: -196 Y: -68 ). Starrlet and her mates do not respond to any attempts to speak with them, regardless of whether the Steel Watch Foundry is intact or destroyed. Technical UID S_MOO_Cat UUID 8da4c9e8-e962-4b58-a34c-da99c79a7e37 Stats Cat Steelclaw is a cat in Act Two of Baldur's Gate 3 . “ These are the stalking grounds of Steelclaw, furless one - tread lightly. „ — Steelclaw warning the party Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Steelclaw can be encountered outside the southeast wall of Moonrise Towers . If spoken with, she identifies as a dedicated predator of the Mind Flayer Tadpoles infesting Moonrise, and resents any intrusion onto her hunting grounds. If the dead tadpole she is toying with is picked up, she flees into the nearby cat hole. The party can speak with Steelclaw using Speak with Animals . Doing so grants the inspiration ⁠ Mutual Respect for party members with the Outlander background. Meeting His Majesty as well also grants the ⁠ Alley Cats inspiration to party members with the Urchin background. Steelclaw previously met the Dark Urge while they were at Moonrise Towers. If the Dark Urge tries to remember Steelclaw, they go into a daze and kill her. If they use Speak with Animals to speak to her, she reveals that the Dark Urge grew angry at and kicked Steelclaw for making noise while all others in the tower acknowledged their status with silence. Without Speak with Animals, the party can try to befriend her but she ignores the party: [ANIMAL HANDLING]  Hold out your hand, letting the cat sniff it.  (DC 14) Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Steelclaw's hunting prowess is confirmed in ambient dialogue by the nearby hungry Winged Horrors : "Caat? Take flesh from caaat ?" "NO! Not again - my flesh still stings from her claws!" "A great hunter. To be feeaared ." Technical UID S_GOB_Festivities_BugbearSleeper_00 UUID 289953c8-adef-434d-b88b-2f9262b78b1f Stats Bugbear Eqp. EQP_Bugbear_MorningStar Trs. GOB_Goblin_Generic Stimk is a sleeping bugbear in the Goblin Camp during Act One . “ Go away, True Soul. I need sleep. „ — Stimk Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Stimk is on the northern edge of the Goblin Camp with several other goblins . They have fallen into a drunk slumber. Attacking the cracked wall to gain entry into the Shattered Sanctum causes him and other nearby enemies to wake up and initiate combat. The party can also startle Stimk awake by landing nearby with a Jump ; it is then possible to avoid combat by passing a skill check. [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  SLEEP, OR DIE. YOUR CHOICE. (DC 10  ) [HALF-ORC] [INTIMIDATION]  Go back to sleep before I put you to sleep. (DC 10) [INTIMIDATION]  Sleep is for the weak. I could have killed you where you lay. (DC 15) [DECEPTION]  Huh? I was sleeping with the rest of you. No idea who made that racket. (DC 15) [ILLITHID] [WISDOM]  You dare speak to me like that? Go back to sleep. (DC 2) Offering Stimk an alcoholic beverage such as Ithbank : [PERSUASION]  Sorry - I thought you might need fresh drinks. (DC 7) Despite threatening to kill the party if woken up again, no amount of disturbance forces Stimk from another slumber. Failing any of the above checks starts combat. Technical UID S_LOW_HeapsideTestOfCourage_Child2 UUID 34c83d64-691d-4459-ab3b-31d0e323f319 Stats Human_Child Stinker is a human child in the Heapside district of the Lower City in Act Three . “ I'm not going in there - to hell! It was Runt's idea. „ — Stinker Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Stinker, together with her friends Spool and Runt , can be encountered in the alley in front of Devil's Fee shop. They are egging each other to test their courage and enter the spooky house. Runt and Stinker dare one another to visit the "devil's house", but none of them wants to go first, mocking and accusing each other of cowardice. Their third friend, Spool, thinks it all boring and offers to change the game. Runt, Spool and Stinker's reactions to the party vary depending on the resolution of ⁠ Stop the Presses quest: they either look at them as heroes who will without a doubt enter the place, or deem them as devils who just emerged from the hellish house to swallow them up. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Runt You go first. It was your idea. Stinker Yeah, but I dared you first, so you have to go. Runt Nuh-uh, my fingers were crossed. I'm not going in there and getting swallowed by a devil. Stinker Oh, I get it. You're scaaaaaaared. Spool Aw, knock it off and let's go home. We can play Chase the Gelatinous Cube in the alley. Technical UID S_WYR_Circus_SculptorAssistant UUID 08d3b7be-bc23-4a7a-a6b5-9457bae054cd Stats Elemental_Mud Stoney is a Mud Elemental at the Circus of the Last Days . She and her husband Boney run Stoney and Boney's Bespoke Creations , with Boney running sales and Stoney sculpting. Stoney speaks with the sound of earth moving and rock falling; Terran , the language of creatures from the earth elemental plane. [ 1 ] “ *Grumble.* „ — Stoney shyly regarding the player character Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Stoney's favourite requests are customs of people, and especially when they have unique facial structures. She is quite shy and easily startled, and Boney worries that she works too hard. [ 2 ] Stoney also has a strong friendship with Dribbles , the two chattering from "dawn till dusk". [ 3 ] The player character can speak to Boney to commission one of Stoney's statues , the funds of which will go towards their getaway to the Moonshae Isles . CRE_Supplies_Gith_NPC Ghustil Stornugoss is the principal healer of Crèche Y'llek during Act One . “ That's it, you're almost there. The zaith'isk never fails. „ — Stornugoss Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Find the Githyanki Crèche Stornugoss is in the Doctor's Office of the crèche at X: 1286 Y: -800 . She is initially friendly to the party, but may become hostile if provoked. If the party seek treatment via the Zaith'isk , Stornugoss oversees the 'process' of this treatment, and is the focus of another conversation which occurs after it concludes. During this conversation, the selected responses may cause Stornugoss to become hostile. Following the Zaith'isk treatment sequence, if Stornugoss leaves the Infirmary after ending the conversation, she tries to lock the door behind her. After doing this, and after a period of time has passed, a combat encounter begins with Stornugoss and several other githyanki soldiers attacking the party. If Stornugoss becomes hostile and starts a combat encounter, the entire crèche does not become hostile; only the characters inside the infirmary area will attack, though other githyanki who wander close to the combat area will join. HAV_PhasmOx The Strange Ox is a mysterious ox first encountered in the Emerald Grove in Act One . “ Move along. I mean - moo. „ — Zlorb , displaying its unparalleled ox impression Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act One 1.2 Act Two 1.3 Act Three 2 Combat 2.1 Attacks and abilities (Act 2) 2.2 Attacks and abilities (Act 3) 2.3 Loot 3 Related literature 4 Bugs 5 Notes Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Walking past the Strange Ox prompts a DC 10 Insight Check to notice its odd behavior. A character who passes the check can talk to the Strange Ox via Speak with Animals or a Potion of Animal Speaking and make a DC 10 Arcana Check to investigate further: [ARCANA]  The ox makes you uneasy. Try to discern why.  (DC 10) [ARCANA]  There's something strange about this ox. What is it?  (DC 10) (using Speak with Animals) Passing this check confirms the creature is not what it appears to be. [ 1 ] The mysterious creature presents as a rare Red-Backed River Ox. The party must successfully pass a DC 10 Persuasion Check , DC 10 Intimidation Check , or DC 10 Deception Check to pressure the Ox into revealing its secret. On success, the Ox tells the party that it is heading to Baldur's Gate but refuses to elaborate further. Attacking the Strange Ox in Act One causes its caretaker, Toron , and neighboring oxen to become hostile. The ox drops pools of Acid when damaged. On death, it drops a Glyph of Warding: Acid that immediately explodes for 8d8 ⁠ ⁠ acid damage. If the party complete ⁠ Raid the Emerald Grove and attack the refugees, the Strange Ox disappears with the other oxen when the grove prepares for the siege, and can be encountered later on. Extra Attack Can make an additional attack after an unarmed or weapon attack. Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Walking towards the Strange Ox in the stables of the Last Light Inn prompts a DC 10 Insight Check to recall whether the player character has seen it before. Passing this check is not necessary to talk to the Strange Ox. With Speak with Animals , the party can continue the conversation from the Emerald Grove . Regardless, the interacting party member must pass an ability check to continue: [PERSUASION]  Ah c'mon, now you've piqued my curiosity... (DC 14) [PERCEPTION]  You're the ox I met back in the grove. You were very hungry then; I saved you all, and now you have food. (DC 14) (if talked to previously with Speak with Animals) [NATURE]  You're a rare breed. An authentic Red-Backed River Ox. I thought you'd be more discerning... (DC 14) On success, the Ox telepathically shows images of disfigured corpses with the sound of screaming in the background. Failing the check causes the conversation to end, but it is still possible to continue speaking with the Ox, essentially skipping the check. Pressuring it to reveal its true identity results in the Ox threatening the party. The conversation can either end here or the interacting party member can continue asking questions. Questioning the Ox further causes it to revert to its native state: a cyan Phasm Ooze and enter combat with the party [ 3 ] [ 4 ] . Before doing so, it tells the player character it was seeking a simple life of hay and a clean stable to live in. Alternatively, telling the creature its secrets are safe ends the conversation peacefully (   +1   +1   +1 ). The Dark Urge may relate to the ox's revelations and can tell it about their own murderous nature, to which it remarks they may be a kindred spirit, but it only wishes to be an ox. The player character can either respect or chastise it for not giving in to its bloodlust - the latter option causes the Dark Urge to brutally attack the creature mid-dialogue, killing it without initiating combat as it struggles to retain its ox form until the very end. [ 5 ] Alternatively, The Dark Urge can, after sharing its violent visions, choose to respect its wishes by answering, "I don't care what you might be behind it all; you're an ox to me." The Strange Ox responds to the Urge's discretion by regurgitating a leveled gem as a gift. If the protection surrounding Last Light Inn crumbles and the Shadow Curse falls upon the area, the Strange Ox disappears but manages to survive and can be encountered later on. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Strange Ox survives into Act Three , it moves to Rivington at X: 36 Y: -149 on a hill west of the requisitioned barn. Approaching it triggers a DC 10 Insight Check check to confirm its likeness. This time, the Ox is glad to see the party and has worried about the player character's health since the previous encounter. As previously, the Ox can be questioned about its true nature and, as before, doing so causes it to deform into its natural shape and become hostile. Any other conversation path leads to initiating ⁠ Help the Devilish Ox . If the player character decides to help, it turns into a Strange Apple on the stable floor that can be picked up. The moment the player character enters the Lower City with it inside their inventory, the Ox declares, "Oh-ho! Thank you for the lift, my friend. Thank you very much indeed. Ta-ta!" The quest then ends and it disappears, leaving behind its Shapeshifter's Boon Ring and a Slightly Slimy Note . [ 6 ] If the party enters the Lower City before speaking to the Ox, it disappears and the quest cannot be started. If the quest was not previously started, the Ox cannot be recruited for ⁠ Gather Your Allies . [ 7 ] Completing ⁠ Help the Devilish Ox allows the party to summon it using a Gather Your Allies (class action) during ⁠ Confront the Elder Brain . It reveals its true form as Phasm , a type of Ooze with a true form similar to an Ochre Jelly which can shapeshift into different monsters with unique abilities during combat. The player character and party members will still make an intuition roll, but the Ox will physically not be there to be interacted with, therefore making its quest impossible to start. There is currently no solution to this other than to attempt to reload a previous save file or use third party programs to forcibly spawn the Ox. Technical UID S_LOW_UndercityPatrol2_Cultist_002 UUID 0e27e169-ee1e-4e56-93ba-3b86feafd252 Stats Hobgoblin_Devastator Devastator Stropes is a hobgoblin member of the Cult of Bhaal in the Undercity Ruins , underneath Baldur's Gate . He attacks the party if they attempt to cross the Manslaughter Chasm. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] As part of the 'test' to enter the Bhaal Temple , the Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev surprises the party with a combat encounter. He begins casting a ritual spell to kill the entire active party after a certain number of turns, and his minions (including Stropes) appear and attack the party as they attempt to cross the bridge to stop Ghislev. Technical UID S_LOW_Elfsong_Exterior_Patron_000 UUID c1a924a2-032a-4f21-9849-93cfa6af83f8 Stats Dwarf_Commoner Stug Minedale is a dwarven patron at the Elfsong Tavern in Act Three . “ But I already took the money for it from Uktar, so I got to follow through - it's like an oath or something. „ — Stug Minedale Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Stug is in the Elfsong Tavern in the Lower City arguing with his sister Gherva Minedale about Stug leaving the Guild to join her order of Helm called the Vigilant Knights. He is finishing a job for Uktar , pressuring the Guild’s debtors to pay what they owe, which might involve breaking their knees. The party can advise him to either finish the job or abandon it. In the latter case Stug says he will return the payment to Uktar and hopes he will only have to break one of his knees. Regardless of the choice, he decides to remain at the Elfsong Tavern with his sister, claiming he is not yet ready to face up what he must do. v t e Lower City v t e Characters in the Lower City Most of us'll be lucky to afford a basement in the Upper City. „ — Sula Ghevora Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Sula Ghevora is standing in line behind Saer Fleiner , near the entrance to the Upper City. She and her partner hope that they can afford food and shelter once inside the Upper City. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Sula Ghevora occassionally chats with Tuloria. Tuloria What are you going to miss the most? Sula Ghevora About what? Tuloria About not living in the Upper City after we get in. Sula Ghevora Being able to afford things, probably. Sula Ghevora You do realise what we're signing up for here, don't you? Tuloria I'm sure we'll be able to afford things. At least the things we need. Sula Ghevora Honey, we might not be able to afford a room, let alone anything else. Tuloria They won't exactly let us starve to death! Sula Ghevora You sure about that? Look what they're making us do now. Tuloria It'll be all right. Technical UID S_LOW_BhaalTemple_Harper_02 UUID 60a4b43e-80c4-4af6-a932-68c37aa99cb5 Stats LOW_HarperConfrontation_Druid_Gnome Harper Sulian is a rock gnome druid and a member of the Harpers in Act Three . She joins Jaheira in the battle against the Dark Urge , should the latter choose to accept and embrace their heritage. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Temple of Bhaal [ edit section | visual editor ] Should the Dark Urge defeat Orin the Red and embrace Bhaal's gift, becoming the latter's Chosen, the Harpers set up an ambush at the entrance of the Temple of Bhaal , provided Jaheira is alive. Led by Jaheira and accompanied by Minsc (if rescued), the Harpers stand guard on the bridge leading out of the temple, preventing the party from leaving. The player character then has a brief exchange with Jaheira concerning the Dark Urge's role as the Chosen of Bhaal , and should Minsc be present, has the ability to psionically control him into stabbing Jaheira in the back through his Mind Flayer Tadpole . Doing so immediately kills Jaheira, and triggers combat with Minsc, Sulian, and the rest of the Harpers. [WISDOM]  Ease his confusion. Try to control him.  (DC 25) Alternatively, if the Dark Urge withdraws from Minsc's mind, Jaheira can potentially convince Gale (if under 20 approval), Karlach (if under 40 approval), or Wyll (always) to turn their side, forcing the party to kill them in the ensuing fight with the Harpers. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Conjure Woodland Being ( + ) Conjure a dryad to fight alongside you. She can use   Nature's Step ,   Entangle enemies, and   Summon a wood woad. Range: 9 m (30 ft) Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] Jaheira Captain Leafsong Blaird Freddo Glist Minsc (if present) Wyll (if present) Gale (if turned) Karlach (if turned) Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Elixir of Barkskin Leather Armour Quarterstaff Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Unlike other Harpers , Sulian and the nearby Harpers do not conform to their organization's brown and blue colour patterns. MOO_Cultist Questioner Sumera is charged with interrogating prisoners in Moonrise Towers Prison with Jasin during Act Two . “ The prisoners will say anything to get your attention. Do not acknowledge them. „ — Sumera Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Torturing Minthara [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Decide Minthara's Fate If Minthara is present in the prison, Sumera can be found alongside her sister, Questioner Jasin , working to break Minthara's mind. Without Minthara [ edit section | visual editor ] If Minthara did not survive Act One, Sumera is still found in the prison. She talks with her sister about hoping for new "playthings," while insisting that the prisoners in the cells are for Balthazar alone. Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch the assault on Moonrise Towers, Sumera is killed and her body can be found amongst the dead bodies at the entrance. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Blindness ( + ) Limit a foe's sight range. It is easier to hit, and the creature will miss more often. Attack rolls against it have Advantage and the foe attacks with Disadvantage . CON Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Cloud of Daggers ( + ) Damage: 4~16 4d4 ⁠ Slashing Conjure a cloud of spinning daggers that attack anyone inside. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Confusion ( + ) Befuddle a group of creatures, causing them to attack at random, wander around aimlessly, and occasionally skip turns in the stupor. WIS Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Eldritch Blast ( ) Damage: 1~10 1d10 ⁠ Force Conjure a beam of crackling energy. Deals 1d10 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage to a target. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] If Minthara is present, Sumera and Jasin question Minthara: Questioner Jasin Do you yet recall your name, prisoner? Nightwarden Minthara Minthara Baenre. Questioner Sumera We will take it from you soon. Nightwarden Minthara Queen of Spiders, I beseech of you the strength to destroy my foes. Questioner Sumera Lolth cannot hear you. She has forsaken you. Questioner Jasin There are no gods left to you, Minthara. You are alone. Questioner Sumera You are despised, Minthara. Questioner Jasin A blemish in the Absolute's design. Questioner Sumera We will cleanse you. Questioner Jasin How can you hope to resist the voice of a god? Nightwarden Minthara It is no god. If your mighty mast needs... „ — Surixana Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Surixana is standing near the northern corner of the Sharess' Caress building, speaking to Cillian . She suggests that he purchase a certain remedy which might provide some " pleasurable assistance". Despite positioning herself as a vendor, Surixana cannot be traded with. If spoken to, she refuses, referring to having deals only with commended clientele. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Cillian This is safe to take - you're absolutely sure? Surixana My good man, every substance has been tried and tested by yours truly. Cillian What - what does it feel like? Surixana In a word, sir? Exquisite. Almost painfully so. My body burned like the noonday sun. Cillian And the... other person with you - they enjoyed it? Surixana Enjoyed it? Sir, I had no less than two maidens and a bachelor clawing at my door the very next morn. Cillian How long do the effects last? Surixana It depends on the person, and their virility . For you, I'd recommend two doses. Cillian Two? That seems like a lot. Surixana Do you not wish to pleasure your fine maiden? To feel her fingers grip yours in pure ecstacy? Cillian Shhh - people will hear. Surixana Good - let them see you taking charge of your pleasurable destiny. Surixana I sense some hesitation in you - speak, good sir. Cillian It's just embarassing to need something like this. Surixana Whatever for? Does the hand not assist the lips? The lips the tongue? If your mighty mast needs - Cillian I got it! I got it - and thanks. Surixana Of course. Set your worries at ease - you're in safe hands. v t e Wyrm's Crossing Characters Cultists of Bhaal Gavv Hemm Lunn Zoll Flaming Fists Azari Edwynna Elin Falcäo Gai Meadows Mîran Shah Carm's Garms Naaber Slozy Arminifer Trinigan Gazotts Vinegaroon Danthelon's Dancing Axe Geraldus Limmy Safyre Somi Tairn Fraygo's Flophouse Bernyr Crak Dalyria Dashkent Moliver Drim Ffion Goldgrind Petras Rilia Rosanna Sharess' Caress Amira Arfur Gregorio Borgus Elamin Chapeau Chorizo Cillian Earspoon Embry Ghainemeir Hakeem Irenya Jara Kira Korrilla Laila Naoise Nallinto Nym Orlith Raphael Rhol Sorn Orlith Surixana Valeria Voss Other Kali Hammerhand Neno Quilltop Traders Carmen Pennygood Entharl Danthelon Glynda Oltower Griska Hoots Hooligan Queelia Arvis Roberon Silt Stylin' Horst Thodric Shedeveer Velson Oakes Locations Carm's Garms Danthelon's Dancing Axe Fraygo's Flophouse Sharess' Caress The Velveteen Elixir Quests Deal with the Devil Deal with the Gnomes Find a way into Wyrm's Rock fortress Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion Free Orpheus Help Kith'rak Voss Investigate Cazador's Palace Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders The Githyanki Warrior The High Harper

MOO_Cultist Susdera is a necromancer [ 1 ] of the Cult of Myrkul . She is atop Moonrise Towers , and assists Ketheric Thorm in battle against the party. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party proceed to the rooftop of Moonrise Towers after completing ⁠ Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic (i.e., freeing or killing the Nightsong and thus ending Ketheric's immortality), a cutscene with him is triggered followed by fight against him and his allies. Susdera is then one of Ketheric's allies in battle against the party. If the party proceed to the rooftop of Moonrise Towers before completing ⁠ Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic , Susdera stops and admonishes them to turn back. Answering "I go where I wish" causes her and all eight Necromites to turn hostile. Ketheric Thorm does not become hostile unless a party member gets too close to him. However, he cannot be defeated this time because he is still immortal. Unlike the Zealots, Adepts, and other members of the Cult of the Absolute , it appears Susdera and other Mistresses of Souls are fully aware of what the Absolute is and the religious hoax they're perpetrating. [ 2 ] This greater understanding (and accompanying disdain) is shared by the other high-ranking Myrkulite necromancers serving General Thorm, with Kressa Bonedaughter bemoaning the weak servility of the infected she is presented with, and Balthazar using the player character's worm-infested status as an expletive. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Bone Chill ( ) Damage: 1~8 1d8 ⁠ Necrotic Prevent the target from healing until your next turn. The target cannot help Downed characters. An undead target receives Disadvantage on Attack Rolls . Range: 18 m (60 ft) Fireball ( + ) Damage: 8~48 8d6 ⁠ Fire Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity for 8d6 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage. DEX Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Incubate Death ( ) Damage: 6~27 3d8 + 3 ⁠ Necrotic Spawn a skeletal involucre. After 1 turn, the involucre explodes, dealing 3d8 Necrotic damage and birthing a necromite. DEX Save Range: 24 m (80 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Myrkulite Scourge Damage: 3~15 1d8 + 1 ⁠ Bludgeoning + 1d6 ⁠ Necrotic Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. WYR_OpenHand_Sarcophagus Suttida Attana is a corpse in the crypt underneath the Open Hand Temple in Rivington . He is raised as a Greater Zombie , if the party refuses to take the curse from the Sentient Amulet (Rare) . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Upon reaching the Open Hand Temple, it is revealed that Shirra Clarwen died the previous year, and her spirit passed on. The monk's manifestation inside the sentient amulet laments the passing of her spirit, who would have born the curse, and asks the interacting party member if they will bear it instead. If they refuse, the spirit inside the amulet (now inside the body of Shirra Clarwen ) raises three nearby corpses, including Suttida Attana, to attack the party. Technical UID S_LOW_BlushingMermaid_Patron_09 UUID da46cc19-8972-478a-b063-7f7a5f61ae93 Stats Human_Commoner Svend is a human in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ Mate, we once docked at Moonshae while a fomorian chucked rocks at us - yet here I stand, not a bother on me! „ — Svend Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Svend can be found in the Blushing Mermaid in the Lower City . Siggy is trying to convince him to skip his upcoming date because their ship is leaving port at first light. Svend insists that he will return on time, despite the recent dangers in the city. The party can interact with them to convince Svend to go on his date or stay with Siggy. Passing a DC 7 Persuasion Check convinces Svend to stay and grants the ⁠ Playing Sune inspiration to party members with the Entertainer background. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Siggy You know the captain won't wait for you, right? Svend Yes, I have sailed with him before. Many times. Siggy Just be sure you're back before dawn. Svend Yeah, yeah. Svend Stop worrying. Siggy I'm not! Svend Yes you are - that's your worried face. After Svend is convinced to cancel his date and stay inside the Mermaid, the banter between him and Siggy changes. Svend Are you sure you don't want another drink? Siggy Only if you're buying. Svend You know there might be room in the hammock tonight for two? Siggy I'm sure the cook would be happy to share with you - so long as you like the smell of ham. Svend You wound me! Siggy So do you every time you speak. Now finish your drink. Technical UID S_HealingVeteran_Healer_Vignette UUID 9e86959d-9dab-4a06-9ec1-943e52d1e528 Stats Halfling_Commoner Healer Sylbert is tending to an old veteran in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ Recovery is a hard journey, the hardest. It needs a controlled environment. I'm sure you're lovely, but you see - strangers - it's difficult. You understand. „ — Sylbert Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Sylbert and Twitch Broven are taking a walk in the garden south of Elerrathin's Home . According to dialogue files, the recent news of war is causing Broven severe anxiety and causing him to self-isolate. Sylbert accompanies him on his walks as he encourages him toward recovery. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Twitch Broven The worst is fireworks - and darkness. Turns the laughter to screams. Healer Sylbert I'm right here with you, Simon. I'm not in pain, and I'm not going anywhere without you. Twitch Broven You're too young to be wasting your life looking after an old codger like me. Healer Sylbert I'm exactly where I want to be - don't you worry. Twitch Broven All these people... they should be at home with their loved ones. Healer Sylbert Look around you - it's peaceful, isn't it? Twitch Broven Peaceful for the moment. But for how long? Healer Sylbert The only moment you're living in is this one. Worry about the next one when it comes. Healer Sylbert One step at a time, Simon. Breathe in, breathe out. Twitch Broven In... out... in - What's that? Sorry. Nothing. Healer Sylbert Do you hear that? Technical UID S_LOW_BlushingMermaid_DrunkPatron_06 UUID 2951e8fa-b900-4722-8830-badfc6645a6b Stats Human_Commoner Syllabub Fran , also known as Shimmer the Siren, is a drunk performer in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Syllabub can be found unconscious near The Blushing Mermaid in the Lower City . Despite his apparent success as a performer, his manager has been impersonating Syllabub during performances because he is too drunk to go onstage. A backpack near Syllabub contains a Sword Coast Songbook , which presumably belongs to him. She is on the streets of Lower City in Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Fist Syllving patrols the streets of the Lower City with Fist Starrlet , Fist Discoria and a Steel Watcher . Their route runs back and forth from the bridge and gates to the Upper City to the Society of Brilliance Lodge (approximately from X: -195 Y: -10 to X: -196 Y: -68 ). Syllving and her fellow Fists do not respond to any attempts to speak with them, regardless of whether the Steel Watch Foundry is intact or destroyed. Technical UID S_WYR_MissingLetters_FemaleHalfling UUID 8da69a0e-fa94-49ee-9a8c-2d8d01fabe11 Stats Halfling_Commoner Sylvie Summerworth is a halfling resident of Rivington . She is complaining about the treatment of her letters at the Sword Coast Couriers during Act Three . “ I am this close to buying and training a pigeon to send my own post! Oh, now there's an idea... „ — Sylvie Summerworth Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Sylvie is outside the Rivington General across from the Open Hand Temple complaining to Balgor and Randalf . Sylvie complains that her letters were lost, while Randalf and Balgor attempt to reassure her, hopping the problem will resolve itself. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Sylvie Summerworth 'To Send and to Serve', they say. Well I say poppycock! I cannot believe they lost my letters. Randalf I'm sure your letters will turn up - have patience. Sylvie Summerworth This is the third time in the last tenday! Balgor Maybe it has something to do with the army about to invade the city. Sylvie Summerworth Don't believe everything you read in the broadsheets. That so-called army is probably no more than a pack of goblins and bugbears. Randalf What did the postmaster say? Danzo , isn't it? Sylvie Summerworth He muttered a bunch of excuses, but I wasn't having it. He has one job - deliver my post. So do it! Balgor Actually, the pigeons do the delivering. Why don't you take your complaints to them? Sylvie Summerworth You know - that's an excellent idea! I should go straight to the source. Balgor Never thought I'd feel sorry for a flock of pigeons. Balgor Instead of complaining to me, why don't you find a different delivery service? Sylvie Summerworth I checked - it's the Sword Coast Couriers or nothing. Can you believe it? Balgor I think that's what they call a monopoly. Sylvie Summerworth It's a racket, is what it is. v t e Rivington v t e Characters in Rivington Refugees Arne Jacobson Belron Strongstep Ben Golewits Bex Billigan Indigo Billy Bobby Brekka Brilgor Technical UID S_LOW_CazadorsPalace_Servant_002 UUID 8d5fb663-c039-4330-b832-5c6e584cb11b Stats Human_Rogue Syrin is a human servant of the Szarr Palace in Baldur's Gate . “ Miss a spot and he'll see it. Master sees everything. „ — Syrin Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Syrin wanders back and forth the corridor in the lower floor of the Szarr Palace. From time to time she falls on her knees and starts to rub the floor frantically. If spoken to, she is depicted by the Narrator as "verging on manic". The player character can ask Astarion (if he is in the party) about Syrin and other human servants in the palace, particularly about their strange behaviour. Astarion describes them all as "fanatics, here of their own free will and utterly devoted to Cazador <...>, idiots who brought this on themselves" [ 1 ] . Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party enter combat with the residents of the palace, Syrin joins them against the party. Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Sneak Attack (Melee) ( ) Damage: 1~6 Normal weapon damage + 1d6 ⁠ Weapon Deal an extra 1d6 damage to a foe you have Advantage against. Also works if you have an ally within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the target and you don't have Disadvantage . Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Per turn Notable loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Everything Must Be Perfect x2 Dagger External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Syrin on the Forgotten Realms Wiki Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Despite Astarion's scornful and dismissive observations, in-game dialogue files for Syrin and other servants suggests that they too would likely have served their "new master" with the same ardour and humility. Alas, regardless of the Rite outcome, Syrin and her colleagues inevitably die by the moment the party members return to the palace proper from the dungeon. v t e Szarr Palace Characters Creatures Bat Bloodfang Fallen Gur Hunter Giant Rat Werewolf Whitemist Gur Cassivora Dophir Dominica Arsetz Gandrel Godfrey Mordels Katelyn Lerskin Oliver Quarlic Pumler Grejit Ulma Servants Greenfern Jaryd Merony Reklan Syrin Varderola Vilhelm Vampires/spawns Amanita Szarr Andrik Antwun Dufay Aurelia Cazador Szarr Chessa Dalyria Gondlemead Hapdim Kass Leon Misha Petras Sebastian Vanja Vellioth Violet Wensleydale Yousen Victims Callira Sanseverina Sterlac Victoria Werewolves Blaise Hhune Duver Rillyn Gheris Hhune Lurianna Sauvage Other Chatterteeth Godey Locations Attic Ballroom Cazador's Dungeon Subterranean puzzle area Quests Call of the Blood Gather Your Allies Investigate Cazador's Palace The Pale Elf
