Technical UID S_LOW_DjinniTrap_Antagonist UUID e84d8eb3-89ab-4b65-b6e1-05b04afc2d1c Stats LOW_DjinniTrap_Djinni Yafeu is a djinni in Baldur's Gate 3 , found trapped within a Djinni Lamp in the Sorcerous Vault . “ Seas rose and fell while I rotted in that prison - yet you mock me? Ha. Haha. Die. „ — Yafeu , thanking his rescuer Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Within a room hidden behind an illusory wall in the Sorcerous Vault at X: 374 Y: 1039 , the party can find a peculiar lamp. A party member who interacts with the lamp in any way is transported inside the lamp, where they meet Yafeu. Yafeu is ecstatic to meet his rescuer, explaining that someone must be inside the lamp at all times, and any new occupant takes the place of the previous one. There are four possible responses, including Attack. All of these options have the same result , causing Yafeu to give one response, before he ends the conversation and leaves the lamp. Wizards have an additional option: "High level magic is afoot here, but what?" , prompting a DC 10 Arcana Check that is rolled with advantage. If passed, the narrator responds with a few lines of dialogue, but this does not change the outcome of the scene. After talking with him in the lamp, Yafeu is released back into the world, while the party member remains trapped within the lamp. Back outside in the vault, Yafeu greets the party members who remain in the room, addressing them as servants. [ 1 ] There are initially four possible responses. Some choices cause approval changes, but only with party members who are standing in the same room as the conversation. Asking "Who are you?" gives the talking party member three more options afterward. Asking him to release the trapped party member results in approval changes and causes him to attack. Saying that the party did not like their "master" anyway (the party member who is now stuck in the lamp) provides the party with 1000gp and causes approval changes. Letting him leave results in Yafeu disappearing. Asking for gold provides the party with 1000gp and causes approval changes. Asking him to release the trapped party member results in approval changes, giving the talking party member three more options afterward. Wizards replace this option with "I know what magic prisons do to a person - that won't happen to my friend." Asking him to release the trapped party member results in approval changes and causes him to attack. Saying that the party do not like their companion provides the party with 1000gp and causes approval changes. Letting him leave results in Yafeu disappearing. Saying "How dare you - I have no master!" causes him to attack. If using a summon to move the lamp, it is trapped instead and Yafeu is freed. If selecting the dialogue option that the party sent a summon to the lamp purposely, the djinni is irritated but comments on their cleverness, and leaves without any conflict; he also gives the party the 1000gp. Escaping the lamp [ edit section | visual editor ] There are a few options for escaping the lamp, if a party member becomes trapped inside. Clicking, holding and dragging to move the lamp is sometimes required instead of "Use". Summoning any creature, and letting them interact with the lamp to swap places with the trapped party member. Summoning any creature from within the lamp frees the summoner, and traps the summoned creature. Within the lamp is a Scroll of Summon Quasit in one of the gilded chests at X: -1602 Y: 113 , which can be used for this purpose. A trapped party member can cast Banishment on themself to escape. A trapped party member can damage themselves until they fall unconscious; the lamp is then destroyed and the party member is sent back to the hidden room. If the lamp is left unoccupied, for example through dismissing a summon or banishing oneself, the lamp is destroyed. It is not possible to pickpocket Yafeu and nothing appears on his corpse if he is killed. WYR_OpenHand_Priest Sister Yannis , also known as Rector Yannis, is a halfling follower of Ilmater and the woman in charge of the Open Hand Temple in Rivington during Act Three . “ Shitey little elephant. „ — Yannis , on Valeria Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Yannis is arguing with Investigator Valeria in the Open Hand Temple at X: -45 Y: -6 . She believes that Brilgor , the refugee who is accused of killing Father Lorgan , is innocent. However, Valeria disagrees and leaves the temple. The party can approach Yannis to ask about the disagreement. Yannis explains the case and asks the party to investigate too. She forewarns them that it will be necessary to gather very convincing evidence to convince Valeria of Brilgor's innocence. Agreeing to investigate grants ⁠ Assistant to the Extra-Planar Agent for party members with the Sage background. The party can also ask Yannis about the location of Shirra Clarwen to complete ⁠ Help the Spirit of the Amulet . She informs them that Shirra died a year ago and directs the party to the basement crypt. ## Yenna

- **分类**: Characters

Yenna In-game Model Portrait Identity Female Voice / Actor Rebecca Hanssen Role Camp follower Family Grub (pet) Emery (mother, deceased) Hometown Rivington Stats Size Medium Type Humanoid Race Human Technical UID S_GLO_Yenna UUID d496d903-d3d6-4314-a324-18542de77b0f Stats Human_Child Trs. BG_Child Yenna is a Human and potential Camp Follower living in Rivington with her mother and her cat, Grub . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Yenna approaches the party as they enter Rivington for the first time. She explains her mother has gone missing and would like help finding her. The party can choose to give Yenna some money or food, suggest they find a guard to help her, tell her her mother is likely dead, or leave. Regardless of the option chosen, Yenna shows up at the Campsite with Grub and asks if they can stay there. There are dialogue options to accept her into the camp, or kick her out. Rescue Orin's Victim [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Rescue Orin's Victim If none of the candidate companions are alive at camp when Orin kidnaps someone, Yenna is taken instead. If kidnapped, her cat Grub is killed and cooked on a skewer by Orin. To ensure that Yenna is not kidnapped, it is necessary that least one of Lae'zel , Gale , Halsin or Minthara is at camp after finding out about a shapeshifter infiltrating the camp; one of them may then be taken instead. Otherwise Yenna can be kidnapped. If Lae'zel is kidnapped, Yenna may be murdered by Orin in Lae'zel's form if the kidnapping occurs at camp and the player character fails to pass a speech skill check to stop her. If the skill check is successful, Yenna is shaken by the events, but recovers quickly and starts to sell soup at camp. Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] When first meeting Yenna: Do not help Yenna   -1 ,   -1 ,   -1 ,   -1 and   -1   +1   +1 Help Yenna   +1 ,   +1 ; this may also trigger a conversation if he is in your party. Give Yenna coin or food   +1   +1   +1   +1 Any choice   +1 Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Yenna's corpse can be communed with using Speak with Dead . Yenna... I didn't want this to happen. Narrator The corpse doesn't speak Who can I inform of your death? Yenna Grub... and you... Where are you from? Yenna Outer... city... Baldur's Gate... What can I do to honor your memory? Yenna Eat... lots... What did you want to be when you grew up? Yenna A cook... like... mummy... Why did this happen? Narrator The corpse remains silent. It does not know. v t e Party and camp Companions Origin Astarion Gale Karlach Lae'zel Shadowheart Wyll The Dark Urge origin Non-Origin Halsin Jaheira Minsc Boo Minthara Temporary Alfira Losiir Yerle is a member of the Zhentarim who guards Roah Moonglow alongside Erna in the Shattered Sanctum and Moonrise Towers . “ Nothing for you in there, mate. „ — Yerle , guarding a door Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] In the Shattered Sanctum , Yerle and Erna guard Roah Moonglow . Yerle discourages the party from entering the room due to the high number of explosive barrels kept within. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] In Moonrise Towers , Yerle begins to express apprehension toward the Cult of the Absolute because the cult is no longer just about "goblins branding arses", but that it actually means business. PLA_Tavern_Paladin Yeva is a human fighter and a Gauntlet of the Flaming Fist . She can be encountered in Act One and Act Two of the game. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] “ Grand Duke Ravengard could be inside! Don't just stand there - push! „ — Yeva Yeva can be first encountered in Act One , on the Risen Road , struggling to get inside the burning building of the Waukeen's Rest inn together with her subordinates Fist Recruit Aelis , Fist Recruit Ito , Fist Recruit Pavel and Fist Recruit Tristan . Gauntlet Dain and Fist Recruit Ephren are also present but do not take part in the rescue activity. As the inn burns after being razed by a horde of goblins and drow , Yeva attempts to push through the blocked main door to no avail. If spoken to, she explains they are trying to save Duke Ravengard , who might still be trapped inside. If Wyll is in the party (or played as an origin), he recognizes the name at once, but Yeva does not react, dedicated to current task. A party member can step in and aid the Fists by crushing the door with a DC 10 Strength Check . If successful, Yeva and other members of the squad run to the second floor, where Florrick can be heard shouting for help. If freed, Florrick, along with Yeva and her Fists, immediately descends and goes outside. Florrick then announces to the Fists that Grand Duke Ravengard has been taken by the drow westward, and personally orders Yeva to report to the Manip (likely Shuurga or Vidor ) for reinforcements. Upon receiving their orders, Yeva, along with her subordinates and Gauntlet Dain , run to begin the task assigned, away from the inn. Yeva is the only one of them who may be encountered in the game later. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] “ This is a bleeding shitshow. Half my squad's dead, the other half's sporting tentacles. „ — Yeva , if freed from the mind flayer pod Near the end of the Act Two , Yeva can be met again in the Mind Flayer Colony , imprisoned in a pod within the Tadpoling Centre . Upon interacting with the Neural Apparatus controlling the pods, it is revealed that Yeva has been captured and consigned to future transformation and – along with Zevlor and Manip Shuurga – has been imprisoned in one of several pods around the room. Choosing to release Yeva and other pod captives immediately leads to a battle with several victims already transformed into Mind Flayers and all Intellect Devourers that spot the fight. If she survives, Yeva thanks the party and explains that she and her squad were defeated in their attempt to rescue Ulder Ravengard. She also confirms that the Duke was still human, alive and unbowed when she last saw him. Yeva then presumably escapes the colony with Zevlor and Shuurga, and is never seen again. EQP_Shortsword_Leather_Torch Harper Yonas is a Harper ranger in the Shadow-Cursed Lands during Act Two . [ 1 ] “ I can't see anything. Something's wrong. Who's there? Meg? Is that - argh! „ — Yonas Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Yonas can be encountered near the entrance to the Shadow-Cursed Lands from the Grymforge lift as part of a Harper expedition led by Lassandra which consists of himself, Karrow , and Meygan . After being ordered to move in, Yonas is struck down and snatched into the darkness by a Shadow , and he calls for help. He is quickly killed by the Shadow Curse and wanders back into line of sight as a Shadow-Cursed Undead . [ 2 ] The blighted Harper sides with the shadows against the party. Once Yonas and the shadows are dispatched, Lassandra speaks with the party and marks a safe location on their map, known as Last Light Inn . Last Light Inn [ edit section | visual editor ] Upon arrival at Last Light Inn, Karrow and Meygan move a rocky ledge south of the docks and mourn Yonas. Meygan kneels in front of a shrine, grieving Yonas, while Karrow observes her from a few paces behind. Speaking with Meygan reveals she had developed feelings for Yonas and had wanted to be with him before his untimely demise. It is unclear if Yonas knew this, but the party can tell her that Yonas probably felt the same way. If the party speak with Karrow, he remarks that Yonas was 'green' and inexperienced. A party member can offer Yonas' Harper Blade to Meygan, who then provides Gold in return for this memento. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Ranged Attack ( )   –   Heavy Crossbow Damage: 4~13 1d10 + 3 ⁠ Piercing Make a ranged attack with your equipped weapon. Range: 18 m (60 ft) [ 3 ] Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Harper Blade Heavy Crossbow Leather Armour Torch Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Yonas, Meygan, Lassandra, and Karrow, are the only level 5 Harpers in Act Two . All other Harpers in Last Light Inn are level 6, except for Jaheira , who is level 8. ↑ As of Patch 6 and after, there is an exploit which allows the party to save him. It involves the use of Polymorph on Yonas during the encounter, which removes the Shadow-Cursed Undead condition from him. After that, Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks must be used to hit the polymorphed Yonas, which may cause him to revert back to his human form and free him from the curse. There is also a chance that he may die instead from the hit. If successful, Yonas can be found at the entrance of Last Light Inn. However, as he is supposed to die, he cannot be interacted with, and has no additional scripts or dialogue. [ verify ] ↑ As of Patch 6 and after, despite having Extra Attack , Yonas is not able to attack twice during his turns. v t e Shadow-Cursed Lands Characters Companions Halsin Cultists of the Absolute Bedi Gronag Kansif Kar'niss Korliss Lora Rizzle Vez Flaming Fists Art Cullagh Aubree Cyril Florrick Gretta Helena J'ehlar Marcus Falgor Nipawa Rahir Rhed Thadwick Ulthred Vidor Harpers Antony Arthus Bor Branthos Callie Chenti Darragh Donner Elifer Elindale Essius Grenywald Hangfar Jaheira Karrow Lanni Lassandra Lightspark Lilineth Lymn Manus Meygan Mijah Naysa Olam Olys Skywin Teebs Terradissia Tumeril Yonas Shadow Creatures Crawling Claw Daddy Doggy Giant Shadow Creeper Mummy Shadow Shadow Creeper Shadow Friend Shadow Mastiff Shadow Mastiff Alpha Shadow Plush Shadow-Cursed Harper Shadow-Cursed Flaming Fist Shadow-Cursed Githyanki Warrior Shadow-Cursed Needle Blight Shadow-Cursed Pilgrim Shadow-Cursed Raven Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound Shadow-Cursed Vine Blight Shadow-Cursed Zealot Winged Horror Wraith Tiefling Refugees Alfira Bex Cal Cerys Danis Ide Lakrissa Lia Meli Mirkon Mol Rolan Umi Traders Barcus Wroot Dammon Mattis Talli Other Dolly Dolly Dolly He Who Was His Majesty Hyena Isobel Madeline Meazel Meenlock Oliver Raven Strange Ox Teth'ka Thaniel Locations Grand Mausoleum Last Light Inn Cellar Moonrise Towers Reithwin Town Ruined Battlefield Quests Capture Isobel the Selûnite Cleric Daughter of Darkness Find Arabella's Parents Find Rolan in the Shadows Follow the Convoy Infiltrate Moonrise Towers Investigate the Selûnite Resistance Find the Githyanki Creche Find the Nightsong Kill Raphael's Old Enemy Lift the Shadow Curse Punish the Wicked Rescue the Tieflings Resolve the Abduction Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse The Chosen of Shar The Hellion's Heart The Pale Elf Wake Art Cullagh

He is meeting up with his group in Rivington during Act Three . “ I wish I could have spent more time perusing the shops - but alas, it is time to move on. Such is the life of a daring adventurer! „ — Yonks Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Yonks is between the Circus of the Last Days and the Rivington General with his adventuring party of Quinara , Sarafin , and Zog about whether to stay or go. Sarafin wants to stay the night for the comfortable beds, but Zog warns that the Absolute is on its way to Baldur's Gate . Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Zog How are we fixed on supplies? Sound off. Sarafin Got camp bits and bobs from Danthelon's Dancing Axe. Yonks I have secured a most excellent supply of potions from The Velveteen Elixir! Quinara Armour. Blades. The Rivington General. Zog Good job, gang. That should last us the journey. Sarafin What's the rush, Zog? Can't we stay here for a bit? Zog With the Absolute's army on its way? Not a chance. Sarafin What's the harm in one night? Think of it - actual beds. Pillows. Yonks It would be most pleasing to sleep indoors for once... Quinara Zog said to leave, so we're leaving. End of story. Sarafin The city's rumour mill is going mad - thieves, murderers, monsters. All hells breaking loose. Yonks Goodness me, that's terrible! Sarafin Are you joking? This is great! Think of all the work we can get here! Zog Woah, hold on - there will be plenty of work in Neverwinter . He may appear at camp or Cazador's Dungeon during Act Three . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] After reaching the Lower City , Yousen, Violet , Aurelia and Leon will visit camp at night and attempt to kidnap Astarion. He and his fellow spawn can be persuaded that Astarion will help them, but regardless they will be compelled to attack. Failing to defeat them before Astarion reaches 1HP results in their abducting him back to Szarr Palace . Yousen and the other spawn will later be encountered in Cazador's Dungeon, trapped by ritual ruins as Cazador prepares for his ascension. CRE_Supplies_Crates Warrior Yr’rk is a githyanki in Crèche Y’llek in Act One . “ On second thoughts, perhaps an inquisitive istik would make a good practice dummy. „ — Yr'rk Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Yr’rk patrols the main corridor of the Crèche together with Raider Ahu’u’rag , walking from the door of the Infirmary to that of the Hatchery , and then to the entrance of the Captain’s Quarters , never entering any of these locations. If spoken with, he tells the party not to distract yanki (i.e., youths and kids) from training and also thinks aloud that too-bothersome strangers would serve as a good training dummy. If the player character is githyanki, Yr’rk cautiously mentions that Sa’varsh Kethk instructs the trainees harder than usual. He becomes hostile to the party if they choose to walk back through the Crèche after having spoken with the Inquisitor and started a fight. Technical UID S_PLA_DeadZorruFriend UUID 2e5a05d0-66ef-407c-806d-a12d4ab0c1df Stats Tiefling_Melee Trs. DEN_Refugee Yul can be found dead along the Mountain Pass in Act One . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Yul's corpse is west of Waukeen's Rest along the Mountain Pass at X: -140 Y: 559 . Using Speak with Dead can reveal that he and Zorru were scouting for a path to Baldur's Gate when they were ambushed by a githyanki patrol. Zorru fled, leaving Yul to fend for himself. If Lae'zel speaks to Zorru at the Emerald Grove in ⁠ Find the Githyanki Crèche , Zorru reveals that a githyanki jammed its blade through Yul's belly, straight to the other side. A dead tiefling is also in the Blighted Village . The ogres, who killed and ate her, claim that she came from the east, calling for Yul. Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Yul can be communed with using Speak with Dead . Who are you? Yul Yul... son of Gara... Yul? Then you are Zorru's friend? ## Yurgir
- **来源**: [Yurgir](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Yurgir)
- **分类**: Characters、Bosses

Overview Combat Yurgir Identity Male Voice / Actor Stewart Scudamore Role Attached Follower Family Nessa (partner) Hometown Avernus Stats Size Large Type Fiend Race Orthon Technical UID S_GLO_Orthon UUID 1dc8091d-2af6-4d33-9268-998ef266d19c Stats Orthon Eqp. EQP_Orthon_Crossbow_Shortsword Trs. SHA_OrthonTreasure_Legendary_Greatsword_Treasure Yurgir is an Orthon, a powerful type of Fiend from the Nine Hells. He and his band of Merregon Legionnaires are in the Gauntlet of Shar , where they have been trapped by consequence of a contract with Raphael . “ Bargaining are you? A Kara-Tur warlord once tried the same - I made him watch as I ate his concubines and young, then fashioned a codpiece from his skull. „ — Yurgir Contents 1 Overview 1.1 Background 1.2 Description 1.3 History 2 Involvement 2.1 Act Two 2.1.1 Killing Yurgir 2.1.2 Breaking Yurgir's contract 2.2 Act Three 2.2.1 Visiting camp 2.2.2 House of Hope 3 Companion approval 4 Combat 4.1 Loot 4.1.1 Carried by Yurgir 4.1.2 Nearby loot 5 Related literature 6 Related quests 7 Gallery 8 Notes and references 9 External links Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] Background [ edit section | visual editor ] Yurgir is an orthon who has been trapped in the Gauntlet of Shar for many years, unable to fulfil the requirements of his contract with Raphael. Under the devil's orders, he and his merregons devastated Ketheric Thorm's Dark Justiciars, killing all they found from the Grymforge to the Gauntlet. Description [ edit section | visual editor ] Yurgir is a towering and foreboding figure, a veteran of the Blood War who is confident in his command. He speaks in a low rumble, his skin hard and red with three large sets of horns curling from the crown of his head. Yurgir loves a good fight, and has respect for capable warriors. History [ edit section | visual editor ] A long time ago, Yurgir fought on the front-lines of the Blood War. [ 1 ] Sometime around the late 14th century DR, Ketheric Thorm began amassing an army of Dark Justiciars . Morfred , a Selûnite mason who had worked for Ketheric, including creating Moonrise Towers , [ 2 ] had tried to build a resistance against him to no avail. He eventually contacted Raphael , asking him to destroy Ketheric's army. [ 3 ] Raphael then recruited Yurgir and his band of Merregon Legionnaires for this mission; Yurgir signed a contract with Raphael: “ Spill all the blood sworn to the night. Silence all prayers; smother each rite. Wander Shar's halls; hungry to slay; Leave no Justiciar alive to obey. Leave none to hear it, then be set free; This song is your oath, swear, swear to me. [ 4 ] [ 5 ] „ His contract stated that he must fulfill its terms, die trying, or forfeit his freedom and become Raphael's slave. Yurgir carried out his attack with his legion of Merregons, breaking through the walls of the Grymforge and killing the Justiciar presence there. [ 6 ] [ 7 ] He and his legion then moved to the Gauntlet of Shar to defeat the remaining Justiciars. With no more Justiciars to be found, Yurgir and his band seemed to have succeeded. However, Yurgir remained bound to the Gauntlet. Unbeknownst to Yurgir, Raphael had given a book named One Becomes Many to the final Dark Justiciar, Lyrthindor , which helped him to escape through splitting his body into a swarm of rats. [ 8 ] Unable to fulfill and unwilling to break his contract and enter into servitude, Yurgir remained in the Gauntlet, hunting shadows for a century. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Yurgir reciting the contract. While exploring the Gauntlet of Shar , the party is lured by Nessa , a Displacer Beast , into an ambush with Yurgir and his Merregons. [ 9 ] Yurgir catches the scent of Raphael on them immediately and voices his hatred of the devil, explaining the details of their contract. As a result of the contract he intends to kill anyone that dare venture into his wing of the temple. The party can continue speaking to Yurgir to learn more about his circumstances and about the fate of the Dark Justiciars, and even agree to try and help free him. Proceeding through his encounter can go two ways: ⁠ Kill Raphael's Old Enemy or ⁠ Break Yurgir's Contract . If the party already killed Lyrthindor , Yurgir does not attack the party and instead thanks them for their help. Killing Yurgir [ edit section | visual editor ] Bards and Warlocks are given a unique opportunity to defeat Yurgir and his group through dialogue checks. It is also possible for other classes if they pass a DC 14 Insight Check check after Yurgir recites his contract. [ 10 ] It is possible to gain several inspiration points while dealing with Yurgir: ⁠ Catchy Tune ( Entertainer background) - for listening to Yurgir recite his contract in song ⁠ Killer Poetry ( Haunted One background) - for tricking Yurgir to kill himself ⁠ Return to Sender ( Soldier background) - if Yurgir is killed ⁠ Strength in Cowardice ( Urchin background) - for convincing Yurgir to spare you, for now ⁠ Tools of the Trade ( Outlander background) - for obtaining Yurgir's Hellfire Hand Crossbow ⁠ The Devil's in the Details ( Charlatan background) - for passing the Insight check to spot the issue with his contract It is also possible to sneak up on Yurgir and his group, avoiding conversation entirely. Stealing from Yurgir's chests (such as using stealth) locks the party out of all friendly negotiations with him, even if the characters doing the stealing are not detected. Additionally, if the party attack Nessa before she lures them to Yurgir, this also prevents peaceful negotiation. While in peaceful negotiations with Yurgir, the party can convince his displacer beast, Nessa to fight against him with a Persuasion check, after investigating the spider carcass. Breaking Yurgir's contract [ edit section | visual editor ] While exploring the Gauntlet of Shar, the party can discover the book One Becomes Many at the foot of the large statue of Shar . It reveals that the rats in the area are actually parts of the final Dark Justiciar, baited into splitting by Raphael. The party can defeat the rats, and then Lyrthindor , and return to Yurgir so that he and Raphael can renegotiate the terms of his employment. This can be done preemptively in which case Yurgir and all the Merregons turn friendly, even if not having talked to them yet. Immediately after finishing dialogue Yurgir returns to Raphael's House of Hope . [ 11 ] Additionally, if Astarion is present, he becomes upset that the party have not killed Yurgir and questions them. He is furious and asks why he should remain in the party at all. A DC 14 Persuasion or Deception Check is required to convince him to remain in the party. [ 12 ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] During ⁠ Deal with the Devil in Act Three , the party can find Raphael at Sharess' Caress , where he offers them a deal; the Crown of Karsus in exchange for the means to free Prince Orpheus . Visiting camp [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party freed Yurgir from his contract, the orthon appears one night during a Long Rest . He compliments the Campsite and tells the player character to seek out the diabolist Helsik at the Devil's Fee in order to access Raphael's abode, the House of Hope . When questioned on his motives, Yurgir appears genuinely thankful for helping him with his contract and considers it a favour repaid. House of Hope [ edit section | visual editor ] Yurgir is encountered again while leaving the House of Hope after stealing from Raphael. In the ensuing fight, if the party helped free him from his contract, he switches allegiances and helps the party kill Raphael. If the party killed Yurgir in Act Two, he can still be persuaded to aid the party with a DC 30 Persuasion Check . If the party performed the actions to free him of his contract, but do not go through the related dialogue, then it is still necessary to persuade Yurgir. If Yurgir aids the party, he becomes an ally for ⁠ Gather Your Allies . When summoned, he becomes an Attached Follower through the action Hellstalker Yurgir . Even succeeding on just the first roll makes the fight significantly easier. ↑ It is still possible to kill Yurgir at this point, which also results in him returning to Raphael's House of Hope. ↑ Normally, Astarion vehemently disapproves of any action where Raphael has offered to reveal the meaning behind his scars but may do so not if the deal to kill Yurgir is not fulfilled (for example, if Yurgir kills himself). If Astarion is in the party and they seek to avoid Raphael offering the deal, Astarion must be disguised when they encounter Raphael at the Last Light Inn and the entrance to the Grand Mausoleum , or far enough away to not be brought into these conversation cut-scenes with Raphael when they begin. ↑ If Yurgir is defeated in both Act Two and Act Three , the Hellfire Hand Crossbow can still only be looted once. If Yurgir is disarmed of both his melee and ranged weapons during his a fight, his weapons do not replenish during any subsequent fight where he appears, locking him out of any abilities associated with those weapons. ↑ During the fight against him in the Gauntlet of Shar , once he gets to low enough health he throws multiple Orthonic Handbombs all around him, all of which can be picked up and used as regular grenades. MOO_Executioner Trs. MOO_Cultist Disciple Z'rell is a high-ranking Absolutist and trusted advisor to Ketheric Thorm in Moonrise Towers during Act Two . “ I see you have been rejected in the past. Do not worry - the Absolute loves you, and that is all that truly matters. „ — Z'rell , if she sees that the player has been romantically rejected by a companion Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Throne room [ edit section | visual editor ] When first encountered, Z'rell is in the Moonrise audience chamber with Ketheric Thorm , where they are judging the failures of the Absolute's forces from the Goblin Camp . Ultimately, Ketheric Thorm delegates their punishment to the player character, and Z'rell orders them to report to her afterwards. Upstairs [ edit section | visual editor ] There, she orders them to assist the necromancer Balthazar in securing a relic needed by Ketheric, called the Nightsong . If the party allow Balthazar to seize the Nightsong, then Z'rell offers the follow-up quest ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , tasking the party to assist Marcus with the abduction of Isobel . Unlocking Lann Tarv's secret stash [ edit section | visual editor ] The trader Lann Tarv has a secret stash of items which can be unlocked by convincing Z'rell to give the party access to it. If the dialogue option "What exactly was this relic he was sent to retrieve?" does not appear, casting Detect Thoughts is recommended. After choosing the conversation option or casting the spell, a DC 14 Insight Check must be passed, followed by a DC 18 Persuasion Check . If the interacting party member passes both checks, the party can then speak with Lann Tarv to access his secret stash. Assault on Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If Z'rell is still alive after killing or freeing the Nightsong, she leads the Absolute forces against the party during the assault on Moonrise Towers. She starts the conflict with Mirror Image and Fire Shield: Chill . Romance Reactions [ edit section | visual editor ] If the player character succeeds a DC 14 Persuasion Check in distracting Z'rell with thoughts of their romantic partner, she has unique dialogue lines for each. If romancing Astarion : "My my, your lust for the neck-pricker is succulent. I'd like to take a bite out of him myself." If romancing Gale : "Hmm, you have used the wizard well. But the desperate one who would love such a pathetic man must hunger for greater delights deep down." If romancing Karlach : "You have quite the imagination. But that's all it can ever be with you two, Imagination. The Absolute offers the real." If romancing Lae'zel : "I've never lain with a githyanki. It looks like this one nearly broke you in half. How invigorating." If romancing Minthara : "How curious. I've only ever known Minthara to moan with pleasure when somebody's losing a limb. She must have liked you, such a shame she'll never smile again. But I'll enjoy the memory of this moment." If romancing Shadowheart : "You took pity on one of Shar's sorry little followers - or was it genuine affection? Let's take a closer look." If romancing Wyll : "Forget your love. I have seventeen husbands scattered across the Coast's shores. They were mere meat." If not romancing anyone: "You long to be touched. A shame we're preparing for war, or I might find time for you - but all you truly need is the Absolute." If the player character could have romanced someone but has not: "You are desired and yet you choose to sleep alone. Are you sure you aren't one of Balthazar's walking corpses?" If the player character's romance attempt was rejected previously (i.e., by Halsin ): " You have been rejected in the past. Do not worry - the Absolute loves you, and that is all that truly matters ." Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Black Hole ( ) Create a point of intense gravity that pulls in all nearby enemies and possibly Slows them. Five more black holes can be summoned after this spell's initial casting. [ See Notes ] Afterwards, you must Short Rest before casting it again. INT Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Short rest Cone of Cold ( + ) Damage: 8~64 8d8 ⁠ Cold Make a flurry of frost, crisp air, and condensed snow crystals erupt from your hands. CON Save Range: Self Counterspell ( + ) Try to stop a spell being cast. If it is higher level than the spell slot you used to Counterspell, you must make a check using your spellcasting ability [ See: Bugs ] to prevent it. The check's difficulty is equal to 10 plus the level of the spell you are trying to counter. This spell can be cast while you are Silenced . Eldritch Blast ( ) Damage: 1~10 1d10 ⁠ Force Conjure a beam of crackling energy. Deals 1d10 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage to a target. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Handaxe +1 Damage: 5~10 1d6 + 4 ⁠ Slashing Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Mirror Image ( + ) Create 3 illusory duplicates of yourself to distract attackers. Each duplicate increases your   Armour Class by 3. Whenever you successfully evade an attack, one of the duplicates disappears. Range: Self Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] It can be tempting to use a large Area of Effect spell to start combat like Fireball or Hunger of Hadar since Z'rell usually starts the fight in the centre of a large, open entryway surrounded by her allies, but this is a bait since she will use Counterspell on the first spell the party casts. It is recommended to cast a cantrip first instead of a stronger spell. Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Absolute's Protector Handaxe +1 Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen Scroll of Fear Scroll of Shatter Studded Leather Armour Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Z'rell will have Bennel report to her from time to time: Disciple Z'rell In Her Name. Report? Zealot Bennel There are some ghouls nesting on the upper ramparts. They seem... restless. Disciple Z'rell We had best hope they don't forget themselves - or I'll have to send you out there to calm them down. Zealot Bennel I'll put some sense in their heads, Disciple. Disciple Z'rell Or some meat in their bellies, at least. Zealot Bennel All quiet, Disciple. Disciple Z'rell All quiet? Do you suppose the Absolute's enemies are resting, soldier? Zealot Bennel I - no, Disciple. Disciple Z'rell Perhaps you cannot find them - root them out - because they are your allies? Hm? Zealot Bennel I - no, mistress! I would never - Disciple Z'rell Oh, relax and let me have my fun. This paperwork grows tedious. Zealot Bennel Nothing to report, Dis- Disciple Z'rell Then why are you reporting, soldier? Interrupt me again, and you will serve Disciple Balthazar instead. Do you want that? Zealot Bennel No, Disciple. Forgiveness, Disciple. DEN_GoblinRaider_Captain Za'krug is the goblin boss leading an attack on the Emerald Grove at the start of Act One . “ Scouts - get to the high ground. Raiders - charge the bastards! For the Absolute! „ — Za'krug Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] When the party first arrive at the Emerald Grove, Aradin , Barth , and Remira are attempting to enter the sanctuary. An arrow strikes the gatekeeper, Kanon , trapping the adventurers outside as a group of goblins attack. Za'krug is the goblin boss who advances the ambush along with other goblins, a bugbear , and worg . The group is immediately hostile to the party. Range: Self Recharge: Short rest Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Gloves of Power Goblin Scimitar Spiked Shield Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Similar to the weakened Intellect Devourers on the nearby beach , Za'krug and his cohort are different creatures from the general Goblin Tracker , Bugbear , etc. found throughout Act One. This is revealed on Tactician , where they lack the racial bonuses found on otherwise identical enemies. EQP_Longbow Zae is one of the tiefling refugees seeking shelter at the Emerald Grove in Act One . “ WOOOOO! „ — Zae Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Zae appears only at the tiefling camp celebration , which happens during a long rest after successfully finishing ⁠ Defeat the Goblins . She takes the place of Lakrissa , if she dies. All she wants to do is dance. The party member talking to her has a number of options, and simply swaying their arms and hips does not satisfy her: [PERFORMANCE]  Spin in a circle - hands drifting through the air.  (DC 10) [PERFORMANCE]  Kick out a jaunty two-step.  (DC 10) [DRAGONBORN] [PERFORMANCE]  Perform an ancient waltz of victory.  (DC 10) [BARBARIAN] [STRENGTH]  Stamp the ground and ROAR.  (DC 10) [BARD] [PERFORMANCE]  Begin a classical Baldurian courtier's dance.  (DC 10) [BARD] [PERFORMANCE]  Improvise a unique dance.  (DC 10) Dancing with her successfully grants the ⁠ Celebrant inspiration for party members with the Entertainer background. She appears as one of the dead tieflings at the Goblin Celebration if the quest ⁠ Raid the Emerald Grove is completed. Approval [ edit section | visual editor ] Dancing with Zae grants the following approval:   +1   +5   +1 Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Zae telling Chell to dance but she is not into it Chell It doesn't matter how many times you ask. Zae Just TRY. Chell No. Zae COME ON. Chell Dance somewhere else. Zae BORING. Zae Shake those hips! Let's go! Chell Not a chance. Zae UGH. Zae attempting to get Alfira to join her Zae Play something! Something fun! Alfira I told you - I quit music.  (if convinced to quit) Alfira No jig I know could keep up with you. Zae Aw, come on! Zae Get up! Let's dance. Alfira I'll need more wine for that. Zae Yes! More wine! Alfira Do you ever get tired, Zae? Zae Never! Alfira Hah! Let's see how you are in the morning. Technical UID S_LOW_EastwayFoodCrisis_Farmer2 UUID 13e47a4f-5485-4cd5-b879-c29c2e3d3137 Stats Human_Commoner Ploughman Zakk is a farmer who recently arrived in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . “ We never should've come here - we should've kept going and taken our chances with the Absolute. „ — Zakk Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Ploughman Zakk is near the main entrance of Basilisk Gate Barracks in the Lower City . Alongside Asparagus Mhallie , Drussuvissill and Turnip Bubbs . The farmers are distraught that they must turn over their livestock to Kuthbert , who is enforcing Enver Gortash's decrees. If the party speak with Zakk, he reveals that his husband is still in the Outer City with their few remaining cows, and believes that they cannot survive without their cattle. If Gortash is defeated, Zakk and Kuthbert as well as the rest of the farmers leave, not to be seen again. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Fist Kuthbert Any complaints will be handled after you turn your animals over to the care of the ducal council. Turnip Bubbs And what good is that going to do us? How are we going to support ourselves? Drussuvissill My thoughts exactly - you're sentencing us all to a slow death. Ploughman Zakk Please, sir - we have children. We need to be able to provide for them. Fist Kuthbert Not my concern. Turnip Bubbs Not like we can even turn around and leave now - Absolute's hemmed us in good and proper. Fist Kuthbert Please provide a full inventory of any and all livestock before entering Baldur's Gate proper. Smuggling or any other form of deceit will not be tolerated. Drussuvissill What are you going to do - check under my skirt for any stray chickens? Fist Kuthbert All animals must be surrendered. Failure to do so will- Drussuvissill Result in a good hiding from Lord Gortash, got it. Thank you. Turnip Bubbs This is out-and-out madness. Technical UID S_LOW_GondianWorker08_Leader UUID 3607ec31-f939-41aa-a7d2-e32f8c46979d Stats LOW_SteelWatchFoundry_ZannerToobin Zanner Toobin is a Rock Gnome , first found in the Steel Watch Foundry in Act Three . If the party help to save the kidnapped Gondians in the Iron Throne , he becomes an Attached Follower while progressing through the Foundry. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party have not first travelled to the Iron Throne , Zanner Toobin can be found in the back room of the Steel Watch Foundry . Tanner wears a Kill Collar , which, in case of fighting against the Banites, must be disabled by deactivating a Motivator held by one of the Black Gauntlets. He informs them that the Gondians dare not fight back against the Banites for fear of killing the hostages in the Iron Throne. The party can either choose to heed his pleas and free the hostages first, or ignore them and turn all the Gondians hostile. If the party return after rescuing the hostages, Zanner moves to the main floor of the Foundry and leads an uprising against Tamia Holzt and her allies. After defeating them, Zanner mentions that he knows a secret passcode to make the foundry self-destruct; the party can either agree to take him with them as a Attached Follower or tell him to flee since they have the Runepowder Bomb . If Zanner accompanies the party, he aids them in combat until they reach the doors to the control centre, where he senses the power of the Steel Watcher Titan and warns the party that he cannot hope to survive against it. He remains outside the entrance of the control centre until the titan is defeated. Dialogue [ edit section | visual editor ] Ambient: Steel Watch Foundry, Lab Level "I smell death and decay. We're near cadaver preparation, aren't we? Poor bastards are shipped in from all over the Realms. Most come from a fellow called Balthazar by way of Moonrise Towers." Conversation: Control Centre "Antechamber" The following lines from Zanner are interspersed between other character dialogue lines. "Wait, Elevated gyroscopes, triple-set quadropecs. No - it can't be." "I hear it through the floor - powerful. Indestructible. The ultimate Watcher - the Titan." "It shames me to admit this but you must face this beast of Gondian folly alone - I would be crushed in an instant." "When it raises its shields, strike it with every scrap of magic and might you posess - and pray to Gond that it does not fire upon you. Good luck, my friend." Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Destroyed Kill Collar Winkling Gloves Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] Gondian Droo Falbo Gondian Frell Olsin Gondian Lowa Speak with Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] Zanner Toobin can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . Who are you? Gondian Zanner Toobin Zanner Toobin... leader of the... Gondians... What is going on here? Gondian Zanner Toobin The Banites came... collared us... took our families... forced us to build... the Steel Watchers... Where are your families being held? Gondian Zanner Toobin Not in the Foundry... Who designed the Steel Watchers? Gondian Zanner Toobin I did... to my eternal shame... How do I destroy the Steel Watch? Gondian Zanner Toobin Go the Neurocitor... in the depths of the Foundry... Input code 'Nebelun'... then increase to maximum output... Once I input code 'Nebelun' into the Neurocitor, what do I do? Gondian Zanner Toobin Run... Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Ifran We have your designs. We have your methods. We have no more use for you. Zanner Toobin We are the greatest engineers in the realm - you need us to maintain the Steel Watch ! Ifran Beg and scream all you wish. You will die today. Zanner Toobin I have an idea - for a new Watcher. One that could flatten the city with a single swing! Ifran You are in no position to negotiate, Gondian . Zanner Toobin But look at all these unfinished Watchers. You need us! Ifran Convenient that you mention this only when you are about to die. Zanner Toobin Spare us, and I will begin prototyping the new Watcher. Immediately! Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Avenge the Ironhands ⁠ Disable the Steel Watch ⁠ Save the Gondians Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Gondian Automaton Conversion Mechanical Diagrams Property of Zanner Toobin To Bendobrus Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] While out of combat, Zanner has minor ambient dialogue for certain parts of the Steel Watch Foundry Lab Level, connecting the Steel Watch foundry's story to certain events and characters from Act Two. Zanner's blindness is distinct from Blinded and cannot be directly cured. In addition, Lesser Restoration cannot be cast on him if he is not also Diseased , Poisoned , Paralysed , or Blinded . However, if his particular form of blindness is overridden by another which shares the same StackID (e.g., from an Arrow of Darkness or Darkness ), clearing the newly acquired source of blindness removes the condition altogether - though he retains his blindfold. Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] While an attached follower, Zanner Toobin can be instructed to deactivate a Motivator . CRE_Gith_Generic Youth Zar'a'ath is a member of a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in Crèche Y'llek in Act One . “ I love fighting with daggers. It's so personal. You're close enough to see the light go out behind their eyes. „ — Zar'a'ath Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Zar'a'ath and several other githyanki youths and children are in the Crèche Classroom , watching their mentor, Sa’varsh Kethk , goad Youth Varrl to retaliate. After the situation with Varrl is resolved, Zar'a'ath resumes training together with the other students. Zar'a'ath seems to relish his classmate's suffering. He informs the party that if anyone were to beat up Varrl next, it would be him. If the interacting party member is a githyanki, he offers to help them practice and claims that he will not hurt them much. If the interacting party member is not a githyanki, Zar'a'ath dismisses their combat skills, claiming they are not even capable of joining their practice. Technical UID S_WYR_Circus_FacePainter UUID 1138b56d-1cd2-4c7b-9147-ea77709a85bd Stats Mummy Trs. WYR_Circus_FacePainter Zara the Mummy is a Mummy trader at the Circus of the Last Days . She sells dyes and disguise kits, though her intentions as a trader are hidden behind muffled grunts. “ Mmhm. Mmmhm? „ — Zara attempting to communicate with the party Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Zara is at her tent at the Circus of the Last Days in Rivington at X: -52 Y: -75 . The words that attempt to escape her desiccated, undead, presumably tongueless mouth are indecipherable. Understanding her requires passing one of the following ability checks: [WISDOM]  Try to interpret her hand movements.  (DC 10) [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM]  Read her thoughts, trying to glean her intentions. Zara Does this arsehole not understand Common?! DO. YOU. WANT. TO. BUY. FACE-PAINTS? [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  ROAAAAR!  (DC 10  ) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  Grunt back menacingly at the mummy.  (DC 10  ) Neither of these checks are actually required in order to access her trade inventory, as it is still possible to press the 'Trade' button in the lower-left corner during dialogue to access her wares at any point. Trade inventory [ edit section | visual editor ] Corresponds to WYR_Circus_FacePainter . Disguise Kit Face-Painting Kit - 4x - one for every present party member should they go directly into fighting Dribbles . Scroll of Disguise Self She also pulls additional stock from the Dye Subtable . Zara behaves exactly like Withers when it comes to stealing : whether successful or not, Zara does not react or search for the offending character, nor does she call upon authorities to do so; if a dexterity skill check is failed at any time while trying to steal from her, she does not react, and the player character can continue trying until they succeed. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Zara has abilities typical of a regular Mummy . PLA_ZhentHideout_Guard Zarys leads the group of Zhentarim occupying the Zhentarim Basement in Act One . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] When the party meet Zarys she is overseeing the destruction of the hideout to hide the Zhentarim presence from the Flaming Fist after the events at Waukeen's Rest . The party must earn Zarys' approval to purchase, pickpocket, or loot certain items from Brem . Upon first entering the hideout, Zarys threatens to kill them: [ 1 ] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  Try and I will take your skulls as trophies (DC 10) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  ROAR.  (DC 10  ) [INTIMIDATION]  Stand down. I go where I please. (DC 10)   +1   +1   +1 [PERSUASION]  I don't want trouble - I just want to trade. (DC 10)   +1   +1   +1 [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM]  Read her mind. (DC 12) I know what became of Rugan. His cargo, too. I'm here to help you find your missing cargo.   +1   +1   +1 [BARD] [DECEPTION]  I've a network of dangerous contacts who know I'm here. Kill me, they come for you. (DC 10) [GITHYANKI] [INTIMIDATION]  A child of Gith goes where they please. (DC 10  ) The party must pass one of the above checks to convince her to offer passage. They can attempt to slip into the shadows. If they fail the stealth check, they must pass a more difficult check to avoid combat: [ 1 ] [STEALTH]  Slip back into the shadows.  (DC 10) [INTIMIDATION]  I'm coming in. If you want to die over it, that's your business. (DC 15) [GITHYANKI] [INTIMIDATION]  I'm coming in. If you want to die over it, that's your business. (DC 15  ) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  LET ME IN. OR DIE. CHOOSE.  (DC 15  ) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  I want you to know the face of your killer. Or you can let me in. (DC 15) [PERSUASION]  I truly don't want to fight - just to trade. (DC 15) Otherwise, all Zhentarim in the base become hostile and all traps are activated. If the party succeed, Zarys orders her crew to disarm the traps so the party can approach. If a fight is avoided, Zarys remarks that not many people can talk their way into a Zhentarim hideout and that she has a job for them: to ⁠ Find the Missing Shipment . If the party complete this quest – or have already done so – Zarys treats them very differently depending on how it is (or was) done. Saving Rugan [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party saved Rugan and Olly but did not take the Caravan Strongbox from them, then these two return it to Zarys themselves. Zarys thanks the party for their assistance and rewards them with Harold , gold, and access to special items in Brem's shop. Returning the unopened Strongbox after Rugan's death [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party recovered the Caravan Strongbox after Rugan and Olly were killed, then the party can give it to Zarys. She is overjoyed and rewards the party with Harold, either 125 or 250 gold, and access to special items in Brem's shop. NOTE: Even if the party killed Rugan and Olly, they do not have to pass a Deception check to lie about this to Zarys. Persuading Rugan to give the party the Strongbox [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party persuaded Rugan to give them the Caravan Strongbox, then they walk into a unique scene in the hideout where the Zhentarim have killed Olly and are torturing Rugan for losing the shipment. Zarys demands that the party execute Rugan. If the party kill him, then Zarys rewards them with access to Brem's special stock but does not give them Harold. If the party do anything other than kill Rugan, then Zarys and the rest of her crew immediately turn hostile. If they ignite the Smokepowder Barrels lying around the base then they can potentially kill the entire party in a single turn. Returning the Iron Flask [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party already opened the Caravan Strongbox and instead give Zarys the Iron Flask , she exclaims that the buyer will kill them all for opening the package and then immediately attacks the party alongside the rest of the Zhentarim. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Uncommonly, Zarys is multiclassed as a ranger with Cure Wounds , 3 spell slots , and a rogue with Sneak Attack . Technical UID S_WYR_FamishedRefugees_FemaleHalfling01 UUID 9ba6f691-d53d-42f2-b4f8-39a9ea9d5499 Stats Halfling_Commoner Zeffy Softbluff is a Lightfoot halfling . He is near the broken cart east of the Abandoned Windmill in Rivington during Act Three . “ You can root through the cart when we're done . „ — Zeffy Softbluff Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Zeffy Softbluff is near the broken cart east of the Abandoned Windmill in Rivington . She is scavenging the cart together with Slarmy and Tina Two-Thumbs . They somewhat ironically condemn those who broke the cart and looted it, though they themselves are scavenging the leftovers. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Slarmy The state of this cart - what were they thinking?! Zeffy Softbluff They wasn't thinking - starving folk tend not to. Slarmy If they'd just lined up and - and taken their fair shares, we'd have plenty for everyone! Zeffy Softbluff 'If' won't get us fed and watered. Slarmy Look at that - finest pie that fruit could have made. Now it's mush. Tina Two-Thumbs You remember that spiced apple loaf we had in Waterdeep? The big one? Slarmy Gods, I can practically smell it. Zeffy Softbluff Shut it. Scavenge whatever you can from this mess - we'll make something out of it. Zeffy Softbluff Take the wood from the cart too - that'll be good for a fire, if nothing else. Tina Two-Thumbs Finders bloody keepers, I say. Slarmy Bloody savages, the lot of them! Zeffy Softbluff We're as desperate as the rest of these 'savages'. They just had the sense to move quicker than us. v t e Rivington v t e Characters in Rivington Refugees Arne Jacobson Belron Strongstep Ben Golewits Bex Billigan Indigo Billy Bobby Brekka Brilgor Technical UID S_CRE_MageHandKid01 UUID 67c5e825-c850-414f-8279-e1968a321d4f Stats Githyanki_Child Zel'i is a a member of the a new githyanki generation hatched and raised in the Crèche Y'llek during Act One . “ Ooo, the istik wants to play. What do you say, Ra'jak, shall we play with the istik? „ — Zel'i Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Zel'i and Ra'jak are playing in the Crèche Infirmary . They are honing their Mage Hand skill, shoving a locked Traveller’s Chest back and forth. When being hit, wailing sounds emerge from the chest, which can be heard far beyond the Infirmary. The player character may speak to Zel'i and choose one of three major options: Ask the kids what is inside the chest Bid them to stop shoving the chest (might require DC 10 Intimidation Check ) Express a wish to take part in their game Eventually, all dialogue lines (except those letting kids continue their game) lead to one of two outcomes: either Zel'i hits the player character with the Mage Hand, or both children run away to the right-central alcove of the Infirmary and chuckle, allowing the party to lockpick the chest ( DC 18 Sleight of Hand Check ) and face the consequences. In the latter case, the party learns the source of the wailing: there is a Gremishka locked inside. Once set loose, it becomes hostile to everyone in the room and must be killed. Also, the player might lockpick the chest without talking to the kids first, which leads immediately to combat with the Gremishka. If itneracting afterwards, Zel'i mocks them, pleased with the Gremishka 'joke'. If the player starts a fight with the characters in the Infirmary (for example, after letting Ghustil Stornugoss run for help out of Doctor’s office ), Zel'i and Ra'jak disappear from the Infirmary and cannot be found anywhere. One option is to pick the chest up and send it to camp. Zel'i berates the player for "stealing toys from children". v t e Rosymorn Monastery and Crèche Y'llek Characters Ardents G'nuril Jhe'rezath Kur'ashk Lin'a'an Qu'th Vraalsith Gish Far'aag Umr'a'ac Yy'rul Warriors Brelal'reth Ch'guth Ith'dul Qen Vu'un Xon'ar'as Yr'rk Raiders Add'ath Ahu'u'rag Chy'raagh G'r'ath Helag Jy'ir Kyrr'a'ath Ra'gur Un'n Zar'an Youth Astyl Ba'akreth Dyrr'kas Mirya'al Pyrindath Qun'irel Rheg'zel Tra'an Varrl Vis'kiir Zar'a'ath Children Gha'an Jheruth Kyr'das Ra'jak Ul'mirel Zel'i Traders Esther Jeera Other Ancient Giant Eagle Blue Jay Burrock Corliss D'hak Kethk Ko'kuu Mahrin Stornugoss Therezzyn Ur'uth Vlaakith W'wargaz Xavier Locations Crèche Y'llek Captain's Quarters Classroom Doctor's Office Hatchery Infirmary and Dormitory Inquisitor's Chamber Trade Post Rosymorn Monastery Rosymorn Monastery Trail Secret Chamber Quests Discover the Artefact's Secrets Discover the History of Prince Orpheus Find the Blood of Lathander Find the Githyanki Crèche Reclaim the Blue Jay's Nest Steal a Githyanki Egg The Githyanki Warrior

Technical UID S_WYR_MerchantsHouse_ThugLeader UUID bed33e19-1620-4845-aaa6-52de87f7e2e8 Stats WYR_MerchantsHouse_HalfElf_Figher_Rogue Eqp. EQP_Scimitar_Chainshirt_Shield Trs. WYR_Thugs_Leader Zenovia Dawg is a leader of the Rivington Rats , [ 1 ] a criminal gang affiliated to The Guild . She is in Rivington during Act Three . “ Arfur, sweetheart - you paid me and my boys to be caravan guards, not cattle wranglers. If you want us to get our hands dirty, it'd be our pleasure - but that'll be extra. „ — Zenovia Dawg , to Arfur [ 2 ] Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Zenovia is arguing with Arfur Gregorio , who hired her to bring him safely home. However, he now demands that she also eject the squatters from his mansion. Zenovia reminds him that she and her group were only paid to act as caravan guards and anything more will cost extra. Zenovia is accompanied by her fellow Guild members: Gleeful Clong , Scarpers , and Dimples Backster . The party can help Arfur remove the squatters, or insist he leave them be. If they help the squatters, Arfur offers Zenovia's crew gold to attack the party. She can be intimidated to abandon Arfur's side and leave peacefully. If a party member uses Detect Thoughts they learn Arfur is afraid of something being discovered in his basement. If they then choose the dialogue option "Mind if I take a look?" , Arfur immediately pays Zenovia and she attacks without any Intimidation check, unless Arfur was pickpocketed before the cutscene started – in which case Zenovia departs as Arfur is unable to pay for her services. Technical UID S_LOW_BhaalTemple_DeathsHead_03 UUID 1f0a7364-4893-4066-b188-907a51a75bd8 Stats Human_Cultist_Bhaal_Reaper Reaper of Bhaal Zerillis is a human member of the Cult of Bhaal , in the Bhaal Temple within the Undercity of Baldur's Gate . “ The Death's Head does not speak, only stares. Her eyes are full of awe, of reverence... of hunger . „ — Narrator on Zerillis Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Zerillis is in The Chosen's Room in the rear of the temple. If the player character is the Dark Urge , she stands near the entrance of the room. She is apparently mute, and when speaking with her, the narrator describes her emotions instead, depending on whether the Dark Urge embraces or rejects their Bhaalspawn legacy. [ 2 ] If Orin is defeated by the player character who is not the Dark Urge , Zerillis dies instantly. Her corpse lies at the same place. If the Dark Urge embraces Bhaal, and Jaheira and Minsc were recruited and did not leave the party up to the moment, they both confront the player character on their way back from the temple. In this case, Zerillis joins the fight as the party's ally. Mostly fire. „ — Zerillo Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Zerillo is among the group of observers watching the magic show performed by Astoundo the Greater , Astoundo the Lesser , and Salamander . She watches the show with her mother, Ma Festina , along with Duddy Dudderken , Ermlaut , and other citizens, refugees and bypassers. If interacting, she shares her dream of one day becoming a wizard . Zerillo's reactions to the party vary depending on the resolution of ⁠ Stop the Presses quest. WYR_Circus_LoveDryad Zethino is a dryad who works at the Circus of the Last Days . “ The city of stone and steel is an endless scream in nature's womb. I have felt no peace here. Until now. „ — Zethino on Baldur's Gate Contents 1 Involvement 1.1 Act Three 1.1.1 Zethino's test of love 2 Notes and references Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] For a fee, Zethino offers a test to determine if the love between the player character and a companion [ 1 ] can "stand the test of time" . [ 2 ] The test does not influence romance progression, only approval. The companion need not be one who is being romanced , but they must be romanceable. Jaheira and Minsc always refuse the test, although the tone of Jaheira's reply changes above an approval of 50 (see thresholds ). Zethino serves also as a vendor of alchemical ingredients, but only the first time when she is spoken to by a party member . She also is one of Orin's possible disguises. The real Zethino can only be encountered if Orin has already revealed herself twice. Zethino's test of love [ edit section | visual editor ] Picking two or more 'incorrect' answers results in a more negative comment from the companion the love test is done with, while picking two 'correct' answers results in a more positive interaction, and answering all three correctly earns their praise. [ 3 ] Completing Zethino's relationship test earns the following inspirations: ⁠ A Test of Faithfulness ( Acolyte background) ⁠ Knowledge of the Heart ( Sage background) Below are the recorded answers for each applicable companion . Some companions disapprove of certain correct answers. ★ denotes an answer that is considered correct. DEN_TieflingLeader Trs. DEN_Refugee Zevlor is the leader of a group of Tiefling refugees who are traveling to Baldur's Gate after being exiled from their home. He and his fellow tieflings are found hiding within the Emerald Grove . “ We'd need an army of our own to escort us safely to Baldur's Gate, and while I don't doubt your abilities... you're no army. „ — Zevlor in the Emerald Grove Background [ edit section | visual editor ] Zevlor was a Commander of the Hellriders of Elturel . After the Fall of Elturel, many people started viewing tieflings with distrust thinking their race was to blame for it. Due to this, Zevlor was forced to leave his position and abandon the city, taking a group of tieflings with him in the hopes for a better life at Baldur's Gate . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Zevlor is first encountered during the initial Goblin assault at the Emerald Grove . He defends the Grove against the attack together with some tieflings as well as Aradin , and Wyll . If the party speak with Zevlor after the skirmish, he requests the party's aid in dealing with Kagha and the Goblin leaders. If they agree to help him and are successful in stopping her, he rewards the party with his enchanted gloves, Hellrider's Pride . If the party side with the tieflings against Minthara and the forces of the Absolute and Zevlor survives, he is extremely grateful, and prepares a surprise celebration at the Campsite with the rest of the refugees, before leading them to the city. After this, he bids them farewell with hopes of encountering the party again. If the party side with Minthara and the rest of the goblins instead, he furiously calls the player character a traitor, and takes up arms to defend his people. If Zevlor dies while siding with the tiefling refugees, Asharak replaces him as the refugees' leader. If Asharak is also dead or otherwise unavailable, Cerys replaces Zevlor. In this scenario, Cerys only appears after the Goblin Leaders are defeated. Travelling to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before resolving Kagha's Rite of Thorns , results in the expulsion of all the tiefling refugees from the Emerald Grove; Zevlor's corpse is then among the bodies of all the other refugees near the bridge to the Blighted Village . Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Find Zevlor If Zevlor survives Act One, he and the other refugees make their way through the Shadow-Cursed Lands. By speaking with the surviving tieflings at the Last Light Inn , the party can find out that the refugees were attacked and Zevlor tried to surrender. He was then captured along with several other tieflings. This initiates the quest ⁠ Find Zevlor . Features Improved Divine Smite Melee weapon attacks deal +1d8 Radiant . Zevlor can later be found in a transformation pod within the Mind Flayer Colony . He can be released by opening all pods, which initiates combat with several Mind Flayers . If Zevlor survives, he tells the party how the Absolute infiltrated his mind, causing him to call out the surrender during the attack on the refugees. He believes that the other tieflings will not welcome him back and cannot be convinced otherwise, ultimately leaving on his own. He can otherwise be purged along with all the mind flayers, killing him. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] If Zevlor is not killed or released at the Mind Flayer Colony, Orin the Red kills him instead and leaves his corpse along with a Grand Infernal Painting at the campsite. Communing with his corpse reveals he was used as an offering and that Orin is located below the city. Otherwise, if he is saved from the pod in the Mind Flayer Colony , his Hellrider Platoon can be summoned as allies using the Call Forth Allies Class Action while ascending towards the Netherbrain at High Hall . However, he along with the Armored Owlbear , are two major characters who can permanently die during this final fight. If Zevlor dies, he is removed from the Epilogue . Epilogue [ edit section | visual editor ] If Zevlor survives the Netherbrain fight, a thank-you note from him is in the Chest of Grateful Words . In his note he reveals the Hellriders now have no oath but have nevertheless taken up residence in Baldur's Gate to protect the city from suffering as they did in Elturel. If killed during raid on grove: Who are you? Zevlor Zevlor... Hellrider... but cast out ... Where are you from? Zevlor Elturel... city on the river... terrible times... What happened in Elturel? Zevlor Dragged... to the Hells. They blamed... us. Fools. What should the tieflings do now that you're dead? Zevlor Finish... the plan. Go... where... they belong... Did you have any secrets? Zevlor Plenty... to have... none... to tell... If killed in the Tadpoling Centre : What happened to you? Zevlor Blessed... by the Chosen... Where are these Chosen now? Zevlor Down... in the dark... down... down... Who put you in that pod? Zevlor The Absolute's... Chosen... an offering... Where are these Chosen now? Zevlor Down... in the dark... down... down... Why did you surrender your people to the cult? Zevlor Her voice... Absolute... promised... What happened after you surrendered? Zevlor Moonrise... granted audience... the others... Zevlor What... happened to... others...? What did the voice of the Absolute promise you? Zevlor To be... paladin again... protect... my people... Zevlor My... people... where are... my people...? Many of your people died. Because of you. Zevlor No... we are... sainted... safe... home... Technical UID S_TUT_Helm_Devil_005 UUID ed103005-fd71-457d-ae6c-39654bbd8f2e Stats TUT_CambionCommander Eqp. TUT_Zhalk Commander Zhalk is a cambion in the service of Zariel . He is an optional boss during the Prologue . “ Take this ship or Zariel will have your head! „ — Commander Zhalk Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Prologue [ edit section | visual editor ] Zhalk is encountered at the helm of the Nautiloid , where he and his minions are fighting a Mind Flayer . When at least one party member enters the helm, combat immediately begins. Although it is not required to kill Zhalk to end the fight, he can be killed for his Everburn Blade and extra experience . His weapon can also be taken after he is disarmed, see Tactics . Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Fly ( ) Fly to a target position Range: 18 m (60 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Everburn Blade Damage: 8~21 2d6 + 5 ⁠ Slashing + 1d4 ⁠ Fire Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Everburn Blade Allies [ edit section | visual editor ] Wave 1 [ edit section | visual editor ] Lesser Hellsboar Lesser Imp – 2x Wave 2 [ edit section | visual editor ] Lesser Hellsboar Lesser Imp – 2x Wave 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Cambion – 2x [ 1 ] Encounter Details [ edit section | visual editor ] Zhalk is encountered at the helm of the Nautiloid , bellowing orders and threats in equal measure at his minions whilst they engage a mind flayer and the party. Despite his impressive stats and powerful weapon, he is not aggressive to the party so long as the mind flayer he is fighting is alive. However, considering the 15-turn time limit, along with the fact that Cambion reinforcements eventually arrive, he must either be bypassed hastily or defeated in combat. Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] It is possible to obtain Zhalk's Everburn Blade without killing him. Before starting the fight, have Shadowheart – or a cleric or Fiend Warlock player character – use Command: Drop to disarm the cambion. Zhalk does not pick up his sword, giving the party plenty of time to do so. If possible, Command should be used on the first turn to significantly decrease the speed at which Zhalk damages the mind flayer. Killing Zhalk is far more challenging, considering his large amount of Hit Points , high AC , and resistances to many damage types . Nevertheless, there are several tactics which can be used to tilt the odds in the party's favour: Prior to the fight, Shadowheart can prepare Bless , cast it on three party members, then refresh her spell slots before entering the fight. Having Lae'zel equip the Everburn Blade helps, as its magical Slashing damage bypasses his Slashing resistance . Lae'zel's Great Weapon Fighting passive also applies, boosting its average damage. Bards , druids , Light Domain Clerics , and Archfey Warlocks can cast Faerie Fire on Zhalk for Advantage on attacks against him, significantly hastening his demise. If the party is fortunate enough to have a Candle spawn as random loot before the battle, weapons can be continually Dipped into it for a flame coating, which grants an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage on each hit (halved due to resistance). There are three (or four if one was picked up by the party in the last room) Nautiloid Tanks , which are powerful explosives. While Zhalk is resistant to Fire damage, use of all the tanks can remove a significant amount of his health, especially if the damage rolls are high and Zhalk fails his saving throws . If Zhalk survives the tanks' explosions, Caustic Bulbs , Spiked Bulbs , Magic Missiles , and normal attacks can help finish him off. If the Caustic Brine left behind from a Caustic Bulb is hit with fire, it creates a Fire surface which can be used to Dip weapons for a little extra damage. As long as it lives, Zhalk only targets the mind flayer, so party members between the mind flayer and Zhalk in the initiative order can Shove the mind flayer out of Zhalk's melee range, forcing him to take Opportunity Attacks as he re-engages the mind flayer. So long as the mind flayer is friendly to the party, it can be shoved without a skill check. If the mind flayer dies, Zhalk proceeds to target the party. Conversely, if Zhalk dies, the mind flayer proceeds to target the party, unless at least one of Zhalk's infernal minions remains active in combat (excluding his two cambion lieutenants, who appear later). Lae'zel or a high-Strength player character can work to position themselves for the opportunity to Shove him or his lieutenants to their deaths down one of the several openings present. On Explorer and Balanced difficulty levels, Zhalk cannot make Opportunity Attacks. As such, party members can run in, attack him, and run back out of his reach safely. Related quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Escape the Nautiloid Achievements [ edit section | visual editor ] Devil's in the Details Defeat Commander Zhalk on the nautiloid. Notes and references [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ The Cambions appear when the countdown reaches 11 on Balanced and Tactician difficulties or 8 on Explorer. MOO_Cultist Zealot Zira is stationed in the Moonrise Towers Prison in Act Two . “ Don't get too close to the prisoners - they're desperate enough to try anything. „ — Zira Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Zira is in the Moonrise Towers Prison , conversing with fellow drow Zealot Soreni about the fates of the True Souls that have received audiences from Ketheric Thorm and the Absolute . Should the party attempt to ⁠ help the gnomes and ⁠ tieflings escape from the prison, Zira can join The Warden in pursuit of the escapees should the cells be opened (either by the party, or by the Warden). Zira can engage the prisoners in combat and kill them if the party does not intervene. Defending Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] If the Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Zira is killed during the subsequent battle. Her corpse is on the bridge leading into Moonrise Towers proper, at X: -153 Y: -114 . To the prisoners, I mean. Zealot Soreni Any one of them could be elevated to True Soul, should they accept the Absolute. Zealot Zira Ugh. Then I shall have to keep them busy praying for mercy from other gods, won't I? Zealot Zira You're mistaken, surely. Zealot Soreni I am not. Zealot Zira But we've seen, what? Five True Souls sent for an audience? Zealot Soreni And not a single one came back down from the tower-top. Must've been unworthy. Zealot Zira It is impossible to keep a garment clean down here. Zealot Soreni You'll find it all the harder once we're off on the march. Zealot Zira If you think I'm walking all the way to Baldur's Gate without a litter, you don't know me at all. Zealot Soreni Oh, of course! Perhaps our prisoners can be your bearers. He is is meeting up with his group in Rivington in Act Three . “ Thought we'd get something steady here, but no coin is worth it - not with the Absolute breathing down our necks. „ — Zog Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Zog is between the Circus of the Last Days and the Rivington General talking to the rest of his adventuring group Quinara , Sarafin , and Yonks about whether to stay or go. Sarafin wants to stay the night for the comfortable beds, however Zog reminds her that the Absolute is on its way to Baldur's Gate and admonishes the party to leave. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Zog How are we fixed on supplies? Sound off. Sarafin Got camp bits and bobs from Danthelon's Dancing Axe. Yonks I have secured a most excellent supply of potions from The Velveteen Elixir! Quinara Armour. Blades. The Rivington General. Zog Good job, gang. That should last us the journey. Sarafin What's the rush, Zog? Can't we stay here for a bit? Zog With the Absolute's army on its way? Not a chance. Sarafin What's the harm in one night? Think of it - actual beds. Pillows. Yonks It would be most pleasing to sleep indoors for once... Quinara Zog said to leave, so we're leaving. End of story. Sarafin The city's rumour mill is going mad - thieves, murderers, monsters. All hells breaking loose. Yonks Goodness me, that's terrible! Sarafin Are you joking? This is great! Think of all the work we can get here! Zog Woah, hold on - there will be plenty of work in Neverwinter . LOW_CountingHouse_Clerk Clerk Zollerix is one of the cashiers handling customers at the Counting House in the Lower City . “ JUST TAKE WHAT YOU WANT! „ — Zollerix Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Zollerix is too busy to talk to the party, as she fears being locked up by Rakath Glitterbeard for not making quota. Mevelenora and Legarioll are waiting in line for her to assist them. Idle banter [ edit section | visual editor ] Clerk Zollerix occasionally chats with Clerk Chervis , who manages the queue of customers next to her: Clerk Zollerix Are you thinking what I'm thinking? Clerk Chervis I am, if you're looking where I'm looking. Clerk Zollerix Do you have any blank vouching documents? Clerk Chervis No - but I've got a little brandy in hip flask. Want a nip? Clerk Zollerix During work hours? Are you crazy? Clerk Chervis That's what they tell me. But we'll save it for later. Clerk Zollerix So, I told him 'I'm not that kind of drow.' Clerk Chervis You didn't! And what did he say? Clerk Zollerix He said, and I'm not kidding, 'What's stopping you?' Clerk Chervis Waukeen's scales! I'd have slapped him.
