## Undead
- **来源**: [Undead](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Undead)
- **分类**: Races

An undead zombie. Undead are a type of creature that has died and been brought back through magical or spiritual means. They are frequently found throughout Baldur's Gate 3, most notably during Act Three, and may be created through various spells and actions available to players and NPCs. “ Remnants of the once-living that are trapped between life and death. „ — In-game racial description Contents 1 Characteristics 2 Types of undead 2.1 Conjured Spectres 2.1.1 Conjured Spectres in Baldur's Gate 3 2.2 Crawling Claw 2.2.1 Crawling claws in Baldur's Gate 3 2.3 Dark Justiciar 2.3.1 Dark Justiciars in Baldur's Gate 3 2.4 Death Knight 2.4.1 Death knights in Baldur's Gate 3 2.5 Flying Ghoul 2.5.1 Flying ghouls in Baldur's Gate 3 2.6 Ghast 2.6.1 Ghasts in Baldur's Gate 3 2.7 Ghost 2.7.1 Ghosts in Baldur's Gate 3 2.8 Ghoul 2.8.1 Ghouls in Baldur's Gate 3 2.9 Grim Visage 2.9.1 Grim Visages in Baldur's Gate 3 2.10 Mummy 2.10.1 Mummies in Baldur's Gate 3 2.11 Mummy Lord 2.11.1 Mummy Lords in Baldur's Gate 3 2.12 Shadow 2.12.1 Shadows in Baldur's Gate 3 2.13 Skeleton 2.13.1 Skeletons in Baldur's Gate 3 2.14 Undead Dragon 2.14.1 Undead dragons in Baldur's Gate 3 2.15 Vampire 2.16 Vampire Spawn 2.17 Wraith 2.17.1 Wraiths in Baldur's Gate 3 2.18 Zombie 2.18.1 Zombies in Baldur's Gate 3 3 Other 4 Related items 5 Related spells and abilities 6 List of abilities that do not work on undead 7 External links Characteristics [ edit section | visual editor ] Most undead are reanimated from formerly living creatures, and generally exist between the realms of the living and the dead. As such, certain damage types or status effects that would normally be effective against organic creatures are ineffective against undead creatures. ⁠ Poison and ⁠ Necrotic resistances appear quite commonly, and some are often immune to Poison or Necrotic damage, or both. Similarly, they are unaffected by many conditions such as Bleeding and Poisoned . Conversely, almost all healing effects including Healing Word , Lay on Hands , and Preserve Life have no effect on undead. However, potions can still heal them. [ verify ] Aid can heal the undead. Types of undead [ edit section | visual editor ] Conjured Spectres [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Conjured Spectre and Spectre on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Phantasms of arcane origin. „ — In-game racial description Conjured Spectres in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Mage Hand (creature) Feeble Spectre Mundane Spectre Primordial Spectre Crawling Claw [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Crawling Claw and Crawling claw on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Severed from their owners and skittering along on digits still stiff with rigor mortis, these hands can squeeze the breath from a throat in an instant. „ — In-game racial description Crawling claw and reanimated severed limbs, usually created to perform menial tasks as a servant by dark wizards. Lacking a brain, crawling claws do not possess intelligence, although they can still hear and understand basic commands. Crawling claws in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Itchy Scratchy Dark Justiciar [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Dark Justiciar and Dark Justiciars on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Remnants of the once-living that are trapped between life and death. „ — In-game racial description Dark Justiciars are elite warriors who serve Shar, some even after death. Their skeletal remains are in Grymforge during Act One, and all but one serve the Dark Lady as undead in the Gauntlet of Shar in Act Two. Dark Justiciars in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Charismatic Sentinel Intelligent Sentinel Justiciar Avenger Justiciar Crusader Justiciar Soulhunter Justiciar Nightweaver Lyrthindor Wise Sentinel Death Knight [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Death Knight and Death knight on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ When a fallen paladin dies without atonement, it can be brought back from the grave as something entirely different - entirely evil. „ — In-game racial description Death knights are reanimated warriors, often created from those who were evil in life. They appear fully clad in armour, which hides their rotting skin such that only their eyes show through as pinpoints of light. Death knights were most often created from those who were, or whose behaviors aligned with, paladins or others sufficiently of their ilk. Death knights in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Stalker Svignee That Which Guards That Which Lurks That Which Watches Flying Ghoul [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Flying Ghoul “ With their jagged wings and razor-sharp teeth, these undead gorge on humanoid flesh in the depth of night. „ — In-game racial description Flying Ghouls are flying variants of the regular Ghoul. They have large jagged wings and often swoop down to consume humanoid corpses Flying ghouls in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Winged Horror Ghast [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Ghast and Ghast on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Orcus, god of undeath, creates ghasts by infusing ghouls with a particularly baleful dosage of his abyssal energy. Whereas a ghoul is little more than a savage beast, a ghast is cunning and can inspire a pack of ghouls to obey its commands. „ — In-game racial description Ghasts are very similar to ghouls - humanoid creatures that can paralyze their foes with their claws and teeth. They are generally more cunning and deadly, but carry the stench of rotting flesh. This stench is so severe it can cause nausea , and even paralysis . Ghasts in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Fallen Gur Hunter Ulnar Ghost [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Ghost and Ghost on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ The soul of a once-living creature, bound to the material plane by its desire to resolve some unfinished task from its life. „ — In-game racial description Ghosts are spirits which are bound to someone or some place, either from being denied a proper burial or by having unfinished business when they died. Being incorporeal, they can fly and pass through solid objects as they please. Ghosts in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Echo of a Lost Love Echo of Abazigal Echo of Amelyssan Echo of Illasera Echo of Sendai Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev Gordis Houndmaster Pol Rocky Tribunal Ghost Tormented Soul Vengeful Soul Zina Ghoul [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Ghoul and Ghoul on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Driven by their insatiable hunger for humanoid flesh, ghouls usually roam the night in packs. „ — In-game racial description Ghouls are humanoid looking carnivorous creatures that devour corpses and hunger for the flesh of living beings. They have long sharp teeth, and can paralyze their prey with claw or bite wounds. Ghouls in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Benji Carpal Ghoul Medic Hamate Ligus Rectus Grim Visage [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Grim Visage and Grim Visage on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ These skulls spawned from Gerringothe Thorm's twisted psyche. Manifestations of her worst flaws, they keep the coins of her protective armour intact. „ — In-game racial description Grim visages are floating skulls created from various aspects of Gerringothe Thorm's personality to guard her coins. There are six of these reprehensible aspects; defeating any of them removes armor from Gerringothe. Grim Visages in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Visage of Cowardice Visage of Greed Visage of Guilt Visage of Heartlessness Visage of Obedience Visage of Regret Mummy [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Mummy and Mummy on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Shambling, their bodies clothed with rotted scraps of funereal wrappings, mummies bring their malice with them out of their tombs. „ — In-game racial description Mummies are undead creatures created from preserved, mummified corpses. They retain the bandages which wrapped and preserved their body, but are in various stages of extreme decay. If attacked by a mummy, a condition known as Mummy Rot may be inflicted. Mummies in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Ancient Servant Zara the Mummy Mummy Lord [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Mummy Lord and Mummy lord on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Huddled in their sarcophagi like sickly penitents, mummy lords creep out to protect their tombs, their crumbling rags host to fierce ancient fists and skin crawling with curses. „ — In-game racial description Mummy lords are more powerful, intelligent versions of Mummies which are created from powerful creatures. If defeated, they automatically reform in their lair unless their desiccated hearts are found and destroyed by fire. Mummy Lords in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Mystic Carrion Shadow [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Shadow and Shadow on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Resembling dark exaggerations of humanoid shadows, these undead feed on the vitality of the living creatures they were once part of. „ — In-game racial description Shadows are dark, incorporeal creatures. Those found in Act Two are the are twisted remnants of once living creatures who have been corrupted and consumed by the Shadow Curse . When defeated, they usually leave behind a Shadow Vestige ; interacting with these reveals fragments of their former lives. Shadows in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Shadow Friend Shadow Plush The Judge Skeleton [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Skeleton and Skeleton on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ The remains of the dead, animated by dark magic - be they summoned by spellcasters, or risen on their own. „ — In-game racial description Skeletons are a commonly encountered form of undead. They are animated from a corpse of a creature that is devoid of flesh. Consisting of mainly brittle bones, skeletons are vulnerable to ⁠ Bludgeoning damage and can be created through various magic spells. Skeletons in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Agile Guardian Apostate Destroyer Apostate Defender Apostate Librarian Apostate Sentinel Bloodmarrow Skeleton Chatterteeth Death Shepherd Entombed Scribe Entombed Warrior Fallen Champion Fallen Fighter Fallen Ranger Fallen Wizard Giant Skeleton Godey Infernal Mason Necromite Reconstituted Arcanist Reconstituted Duellist Reconstituted Marksman Robust Guardian Withers Undead Dragon [ edit section | visual editor ] Main article: Undead Dragon “ Bones studded with rotting scales and draped with dead tissue, these dragons have been animated by fell necromancy. „ — In-game racial description Undead dragons are exceedingly rare creatures reanimated by use of extraordinarily powerful magic. Their bodies are skeletal in appearance, and they retain much of their abilities and magic as they had in life. Undead dragons in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Ansur Vampire [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Vampire and Vampire on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Amiable aristocrats and cold-hearted hunters, vampires are the embodiments of evening made flesh. „ — In-game racial description Vampires are powerful undead creatures known for their pale-skin, sharp claws, blood-red eyes, and sharp teeth used to pierce and drink the blood of their victims. They can regenerate, as well as turn other humanoid creatures into vampire spawn by feeding on them. They are also known for their sensitivity to sunlight, and their skin burns in its presence. Vampires in Baldur's Gate 3 Cazador Szarr Vampire Spawn [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Vampire Spawn and Vampire spawn on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Subservient to the one who created them, vampire spawn are deadly hunters both ravenous and proud. „ — In-game racial description Vampire spawn are creatures created when a vampire bites and drinks the blood of a humanoid creature and allows it to survive. They have some of the features of a vampire such as sensitivity to light and a hunger for blood, but are bound to the one who turned them unless their master is killed, or their freedom is granted. Vampire spawn in Baldur's Gate 3 Astarion Andrik Antwun Dufay Aurelia Chessa Dalyria Gondlemead Hapdim Kass Leon Misha Petras Sebastian Vanja Wensleydale Violet Yousen Wraith [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Wraith and Wraith on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ A wraith is malice incarnate, concentrated into an incorporeal form that seeks to quench all life. Even small fires can be extinguished by the sucking oblivion of the wraith's horrifying existence. „ — In-game racial description Wraiths are similar in appearance to Shadows, and can also be found in Act Two. In combat, Wraiths frequently teleport from shadow to shadow. They also generate an Aura of Vile Oblivion which snuffs out nearby light sources and can drain the life of their enemies. Wraiths in Baldur's Gate 3 [ edit section | visual editor ] Daddy Mummy Zombie [ edit section | visual editor ] Main articles: Zombie and Zombie on the Forgotten Realms Wiki “ Mindless remains of the dead, imbued with necromantic magic, zombies do their creator's bidding without fear or hesitation. „ — In-game racial description Zombies are a common form of undead similar to Skeletons except for retaining significant amounts of flesh. Mindless and often missing body parts, zombies can be created from most living creatures and they usually form the backbone of any necromancer's army. Zombies can be resilient opponents, often recovering after receiving an otherwise fatal blow. ## Undead Dragon
- **来源**: [Undead Dragon](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Undead_Dragon)
- **分类**: Races

An Undead Dragon in Baldur's Gate 3 Undead Dragons are non-playable Dragon creatures in Baldur's Gate 3 . They are deceased dragons reanimated through powerful necromantic magic. “ Bones studded with rotting scales and draped with dead tissue, these dragons have been animated by fell necromancy. „ — In-game racial description About undead dragons [ edit section | visual editor ] Undead dragons are an extremely rare type of dragon that are reanimated from the corpse of a deceased dragon. They appear like they did when they were living except most of the flesh has rotted away, leaving behind a skeletal structure. Despite the lack of flesh, they can be just as terrifying as they were when alive. Racial features [ edit section | visual editor ] Base Racial Speed 18m / 60ft Size Huge Magic Resistance Has Advantage on Saving Throws against Spells and other magical effects. ## Vampire
- **来源**: [Vampire](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Vampire)
- **分类**: Races

See also: Vampire Spawn A full vampire in Baldur's Gate 3 Vampires are a type of non-playable Undead race in Baldur's Gate 3. “ Amiable aristocrats and cold-hearted hunters, vampires are the embodiments of evening made flesh. „ — In-game racial description About Vampires [ edit section | visual editor ] Vampires are one of the most feared and powerful undead, and can turn other humanoids into Vampire Spawn by feeding on their blood; in order to become a true Vampire, the spawn must feed on their master's blood in turn. Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] Vampires regenerate health each turn with their Vampire Regeneration ability, and can also turn into a fog cloud which is resistant to damage. However, both of these abilities can be countered by exploiting their Sunlight Hypersensitivity , for instance; casting the level three evocation spell Daylight . She also could be vampire spawn. ## Vampire spawn
- **来源**: [Vampire spawn](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Vampire_spawn)
- **分类**: Races

A vampire spawn in Baldur's Gate 3 Vampire spawn are Undead creatures in various locations in Baldur's Gate during Act Three . With the exception of Astarion as Origin , they are not playable characters. “ Subservient to the one who created them, vampire spawn are deadly hunters both ravenous and proud. „ — In-game racial description About vampire spawn [ edit section | visual editor ] Vampire spawn are created when a Vampire bites and drinks the blood of another creature. Once spawn are born, they are entirely subservient to their creator. They may only regain their free-will through the death of their creator, or reciprocally drinking their masters blood to become a true vampire. Astarion is a notable exception to this rule, having regained his free will from being infected by a Tadpole . Vampire spawn do not possess the powerful abilities of a true vampire, though they suffer from the usual afflictions. They are hypersensitive to sunlight, making spells such as Daylight useful against them. They also have resistance to ⁠ Physical and ⁠ Necrotic damage. Racial features [ edit section | visual editor ] Base Racial Speed 9m / 30ft Size Medium Sunlight Hypersensitivity This creature takes 20 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant damage if it starts its turn in sunlight. While sunlit, it has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks . Vampire Regeneration The vampire regains 10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points at the start of its turn if it isn't in sunlight, or has taken ⁠ Radiant damage or damage from Holy Water , in which case this trait doesn't function until the start of its next turn. Vampire spawn characters [ edit section | visual editor ] Astarion [ 1 ] Amanita Szarr [ 2 ] Andrik Antwun Dufay Chessa Gondlemead Hapdim Kass Misha Sebastian Vanja Wensleydale Astarion's siblings: Aurelia Dalyria Leon Petras Violet Yousen Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Bite ( ) Damage: 3~18 + modifiers 1d6 + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing + 2d6 ⁠ Necrotic Sink your fangs into a target and Sap its blood. Subsequent attacks that sap blood will further reduce the target's maximum hit points. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Claws ( ) Damage: 2~8 + modifiers 2d4 + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Slashing Lash out with deadly claws. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Multiattack ( ) Damage: 4~16 + modifiers 2d4 + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing + 2d4 + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Aim multiple attacks at a target. Each attack deals 2d4 Slashing damage. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Recharge: Per turn See also [ edit section | visual editor ] Vampire Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Astarion has a unique Bite attack and none of the vampire spawn passives or resistances. Further, while he is not visibly classed as being undead, he does enjoy some of their benefits (such as ignoring Spell Rot ). ↑ Amanita is only mentioned; it is not clear if she was a spawn or a true vampire. Water Elementals are a type of Elemental creature in Baldur's Gate . Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Water Elementals can be summoned via the spell Conjure Elemental . They are also found in the Sorcerous Sundries and The Wyrmway . Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Slam ( ) Damage: 7~17 5 ⁠ Bludgeoning + 2d6 ⁠ Cold Slam into a foe and create a puddle of water around the impact site. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Recharge: Per turn Elemental Warp ( ) Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see. Range: 18 m (60 ft) Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] If thrown into a water chasm, Water Elementals float back to safety. The Spell Save DC for this creature is Strength , which means a consistent way to increase DC for the Water Elemental variant of Conjure Elemental is to give it strength-altering potions such as the Elixir of Hill Giant Strength or the Elixir of Cloud Giant Strength . Opportunity Attack Attack an enemy moving out of reach. Werewolves are a non-playable humanoid race in Baldur's Gate 3 . “ Savage predators that spread their curse through biting other humanoids. Most werewolves succumb to their bloodlust, but some learn to control their urges, often under the guidance of Selûne, goddess of the moon. „ — In-game racial description About werewolves [ edit section | visual editor ] Werewolves possess the feature Multiattack: Wounded , and have the very rare distinction of being immune to non-magical bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage. This makes them dangerous against opponents who do not wield magical weapons or cast spells. Werewolves are in Szarr Palace and can be summoned through Retinue of the Vampire Lord as part of the ⁠ Gather Your Allies quest. [PERSUASION]  Have patience. There's a lot of flesh waiting in Baldur's Gate. (DC 18) [INTIMIDATION]  I've never eaten ghoul before. For you, I might make an exception. (DC 18) [ILLITHID] [WISDOM]  Your friends seem faithful enough. So they may start by feeding on your flesh. (DC 2) Attack. The player character can pacify them with a DC 18 Persuasion or Intimidation Check , use Illithid Persuasion to convince the ghouls to eat one another, or attack them outright. ## Wolf
- **来源**: [Wolf](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Wolf)
- **分类**: Races

Wolves are a race of beast found throughout Baldur's Gate 3 . These fearsome canines are seen in a wide variety of contexts, from enemies to allies. “ Furtive pack animals roaming the wilderness, wolves are wary of attacking creatures unless driven to ferocity by territorialism or hunger. „ — In-game racial description About wolves [ edit section | visual editor ] Wolves are canine pack hunters. They are excellent trackers by scent. Non-hostile, non-summoned wolves can be spoken with using Speak with Animals . Beast Master characters can summon an allied wolf using Ranger's Companion . Druid characters can transform into a wolf using Wild Shape: Wolf . Racial features [ edit section | visual editor ] Base Racial Speed 9 m (30 ft) Size Medium Pack Tactics When an ally is within 3 m (10 ft) of your target and is not Incapacitated , your Attack Rolls against the target have Advantage . Wolf characters [ edit section | visual editor ] Indra Isbeth Istor Lupus Lupus Major Lupus Optumus Silver Vulk Dire wolf characters [ edit section | visual editor ] Bloodfang D'hak Dire Wolf Dire Wolf (wild shape) Ur'uth Whitemist Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Shadowheart has the hidden passive ability Fear of Wolves which triggers when she stands within 9 m (30 ft) of one. As territorial plant-humanoids created through ritual sacrifice, they serve as determined guardians thanks to their regenerative abilities and magically infused clubs. Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Two Wood woads are in the Sunlit Wetlands in Act One . They guard the secluded island of the Decrepit Sanctuary with Ancient Mud Mephits . Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Concussive Smash ( )   –   Twisting Branch Damage: 5~8 1d4 + 4 ⁠ Bludgeoning Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them. CON Save Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Short rest Entangle ( ) Create a vine surface, slowing down creatures, possibly Entangling them. STR Save Range: 6 m (20 ft) Main Hand Attack ( )   –   Twisting Branch Damage: 5~8 1d4 + 4 ⁠ Bludgeoning Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Twisting Branch Weavemoss Wood Bark Wood Woad Shield Tactics [ edit section | visual editor ] Fire damage is needed to prevent wood woads from regenerating every turn. However, fire can spread to nearby party members via Entangle . It is recommended to include members who are resistant to fire damage such as Karlach or by applying Elixir of Fire Resistance . Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Early Access in-game appearance Concept art by Tan Burci Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Wood woads can be summoned by Fallen Lover , a unique ability of Conjure Woodland Being . Wood woads have two near identical versions of Entangle ( Target_Entangle_WoodWoad and Target_Entangle_WoodWoad_Hardcore ) which differ only in the radius of the area of effect. Conjured wood woads have both versions added to the hotbar. Wood woads have a darkvision range of 18 m (60 ft) instead of the normal 12 m (40 ft) shown in the Darkvision passive. Worgs are a type of Monstrosity found throughout Act One of Baldur's Gate 3 . About Worgs [ edit section | visual editor ] Vicious yet intelligent, these wolf-like creatures are often enslaved and trained by goblins to become savage warbeasts, guard dogs, trackers [ 1 ] , and hunting companions. Worgs are more sentient than the average animal and are capable of rudimentary speech without the need for Speak with Animals . They are not considered especially intelligent, however. Similarly to goblins, worgs are rude to all races but drow, who they identify as their "master's master." [ 2 ] They're from the Nordiland worgata family. [ 3 ] Goblins use the catch-all term 'worg-meat' to describe any variety of meat fed to them. This often includes those who fall in battle with goblins [ 4 ] or are taken prisoner [ 5 ] . The goblin tribe in Act One have a pack of worgs, including Klaw and her litter: Small Klaw , Ferr , and Tale . Ferr and Tale are in the Worg Pens in the cell next to Halsin and are driven mad with excitement. [ 6 ] Goblin Sharp-Eyes can summon Worgs using the Worg Companion ability. These summoned variants disappear once the summoner is defeated. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Bite ( ) Damage: 3~9 2d4 + 1 ⁠ Piercing Bite a target. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Loot [ edit section | visual editor ] Worg Fang Named Worgs [ edit section | visual editor ] Ferr Klaw Small Klaw Tale Related literature [ edit section | visual editor ] Guide to Taming Worgs Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Several apparent sayings include worgs thoughout the game, including: "tough as worg meat", "hair of the worg", "greedy old son of a worg", and "straw that breaks the worg's back". [ 7 ] [ 8 ] [ 9 ] [ 10 ] One Vicious Mockery line mentions worg-roast, an apparently greasy meal that does not exist in-game. Don't matter if yer friend or foe. ↑ Player character: Were you the only prisoner here? Dead Elf: Goblins took... my friends. Cut them up... for the worgs. For meat. ↑ Butcher Vrak: 'Ere to see the bear? Just follow the noise. Worgs 'ave been goin' crazy for it. and T ale: Fur. Can't you smell the fur? Fur and meat. Lots of MEAT! and Ferr: Want it. Fur and meat. Kill it. KILL IT! ↑ Four: Sod off or I'll fetch my mum. She was tough as worg meat before the Absolute came along. ↑ Kobold Scout: Have some more wine, that'll sort you. These creatures generate an Aura of Vile Oblivion that snuffs out nearby light sources and imposes magical darkness within melee range. Technical UID BASE_Undead_Zombie UUID a42a8493-b701-4d71-bdc8-0857e718c247 Stats Zombie Zombies are a type of Undead creature and non-playable race found in Baldur's Gate 3 . They serve as mindless foot soldiers for Necromancers after being raised from corpses. “ Mindless remains of the dead, imbued with necromantic magic, zombies do their creator's bidding without fear or hesitation. „ — In-game racial description Involvement [ edit section | visual editor ] Zombies can be found in various locations in Act Two as well as Act Three. During Act Two, they can be encountered in the House of Healing Morgue as well as the Ancient Lair . In Act Three, they can be raised from the ground in the Graveyard . Animate Dead [ edit section | visual editor ] In addition, a special Zombie can be created through the spell Animate Dead , a level three spell available to level 5 Clerics , Wizards , and Circle of the Spores Druids . The spell is also available to level 9 Oathbreaker Paladins . The spell can also be cast with a common Scroll of Animate Dead . This version of the zombie can apply Crawling Gnaw to targets it hits. When a creature dies with the Crawling Gnaw condition active, they raise as a "Newborn Zombie." A Newborn Zombie has 10 HP and takes 1 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage each turn. A Newborn Zombie otherwise has the same stats as a regular Zombie. Combat [ edit section | visual editor ] Attacks and actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Slam ( ) Damage: 4~9 1d6 + 3 ⁠ Bludgeoning Hit a target with your bare fists. Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Undead Fortitude [ edit section | visual editor ] Due to passive Undead Fortitude , zombies will come back to life at 1 HP when killed, unless the killing blow was applied with ⁠ Radiant damage or a critical hit . This often make zombies resilient to death, requiring more actions to kill. ## Acolyte
- **来源**: [Acolyte](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Acolyte)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Acolyte is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around religion. Shadowheart and the hireling Zenith Feur'sel have this background. “ You have spent your life in service to a temple, learning sacred rites and providing sacrifices to the god or gods you worship. Serving the gods and discovering their sacred works will guide you to greatness. „ Contents 1 Background features 2 Background goals 3 Cut Background Goals 4 Notes and References Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Insight Proficiency : Gain proficiency with Wisdom ( Insight ) ability checks . Religion Proficiency : Gain proficiency with Intelligence ( Religion ) ability checks. Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description General Anywhere 20 Fate Must Wait Resurrect anyone in your party. Granted for the first resurrection of a party member in a playthrough, regardless of the means (with a spell, a scroll, or with the help of Withers ). If the Acolyte character cannot witness the resurrection (they are not in the active party, or they are the one who are resurrected), and they are the only one companion with this Background, the inspiration is not granted and cannot be obtained later. Act 1 Dank Crypt 20 Divinity Undone Unlock and read the Book of Dead Gods . Shared with ⁠ Secrets of the Sundering inspiration. Emerald Grove 25 Silvanus' Solitude Witness the ritual that seals off the grove from the world. 25 Treefather's Sorrow Unleash Silvanus ' curse upon the grove. Kill the druids and steal the Idol of Silvanus . Grymforge 50 Acolytes of the Demonweb Pits Persuade the spiders in Grymforge to remain faithful to Lolth. The inspiration can only be obtained with Speak with Animals active. Despite the description, various ability checks can be used to convince the spiders. Owlbear Nest 25 Her Gift of Silver Recover Selûne's lost treasure through prayer. Read the prayer note while next to the locked chest. Shadowheart cannot open the chest, but still gains the inspiration if she is present. Shattered Sanctum 25 A Kiss Without Mercy Endure the ritual of Loviatar until Abdirak is pleased. A character must succeed three ability checks on Performance or Intimidation (can be mixed), OR fail three Constitution checks. Shedding the armour applies the Ardent Apostle condition, helping to endure or imitate pain. Eating any spoiled/rotten food before the ritual applies the Poisoned condition, which may help to fail Constitution checks. Shared with ⁠ The Art of Agony inspiration. 25 Saving the Heretic Learn about Maglubiyet and safely free his priest . A party member must first talk to Brakkal , then get him out of trapped and locked cage. If freeing him first, the inspiration is not gained. This can also be obtained by killing everyone in the temple, then freeing him, allowing him to escape unharmed; the spiders must be killed or still contained before freeing him, otherwise they will kill him. Underdark 30 Last Rites of the Dark Dancer Complete Eilistraee 's ritual of sorrow and obtain her blessed blade . A character must succeed a Religion check to take the blade, or a Strength check to bypass the ritual. 30 Shatter the Moon Destroy Selûne 's protection over the Underdark fort. Destroy the Moonstone above the statue in the Selûnite Outpost . 30 Tipping the Scales Earn the worship of the Kuo-toa . Also granted by convincing BOOOAL to let you kill in his name. Waukeen's Rest 30 A Unified Spirit Pray with the Flaming Fists at Waukeen's Rest. The option to do this is only available to Clerics of good-aligned deities and Paladins (except Oathbreakers ). Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 75 Cerimonia Alārum Release the Nightsong . Shared with ⁠ Damsel No More , ⁠ Good Deed of the Day , and ⁠ Soldier of Faith inspirations. Additionally, shared with ⁠ Fickle Allegiances and ⁠ Rebellious Phase , if the party helped Balthazar to reach Shadowfell and betrayed him there. 75 Cerimonia Compedum Execute the ritual to bring Nightsong to Ketheric . Ally with Balthazar and allow him to take Nightsong. Shared with ⁠ Soldier of Fortune inspiration. 75 In Her Footsteps Solve each of Shar's trials in the Gauntlet of Shar. Shared with ⁠ Recognised by Shadows inspiration and inspirations earned throughout the Self-Same Trial. 75 Sole Survivor Discover the truth behind the numerous rats in the Gauntlet of Shar. Shared with ⁠ Rat King inspiration. 75 Those for Whom the Bell Tolled Kill all of Balthazar 's undead. Last Light Inn 50 Moonweaver's Prayer Witness Isobel's ritual to keep up the protection of Last Light. Acquired only if the Acolyte character is present when talking to Isobel for the first time. 50 Tragic Love Witness Yonas' funeral. Talk to Meygan while she's mourning Yonas at the fane at X: -61 Y: 112 . Obtainable only before Marcus' attempt to kidnap Isobel. Shared with ⁠ Memento Mori inspiration. Mind Flayer Colony 60 A Piece of Three Piece together Ketheric's allegiances. Reithwin Town 60 Blessed's Final Rest Find the aasimar's journal . On the desk at X: 47 Y: -1010 in the House of Healing Morgue . Shared with ⁠ Snuffed Spark inspiration. 60 Did My Homework Recite Shar's dogma to the surgeon . The interacting character must choose the line with DC 14 Religion Check and pass it. It is not connected to Malus's notes in his office. This check is not available to Shadowheart , but she still can obtain the inspiration as a companion. 60 Honing the Darkness Pass all of Shar's tests in the middle of the cursed town. Pass DC  14 Saving Throw on Charisma, Intelligence and Wisdom (not necessary done by the same party member). Ruined Battlefield 50 Let Sleeping Dogs Lie Prevent He Who Was from completing his task. Either grant Madeline forgiveness or make the Shadar-Kai stab himself multiple times. Granted as well if the party defeats He Who Was after taking up quest, without giving him Madeline's ledger. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ No Rest for the Wicked inspiration. 50 No Rest for the Wicked Assist He Who Was in his task. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Let Sleeping Dogs Lie inspiration. Act 3 Lower City 170 Child Protection Agents Find and rescue Lora 's daughter, Vanra . Shared with ⁠ Finding Vanra inspiration. 170 Offerings to the Waves Make an offering for the dead waveservant . There are two options to gain this inspiration: Place anything into the Offerings Chest in the Water Queen's House . Speaking to Allandra Grey for the first time, choose the option about any offering, including Monk and Barbarian specific lines. Shared with ⁠ Sea Memorial inspiration, if obtained from Allandra Grey. 170 Ordinary Practises in Extraordinary Times Offer appropriate offerings to a deity in the Stormshore Tabernacle . The offering is the same amount as needed to get a merchant to 100 Attitude as seen here . 220 Rites of Loss Complete the Mapping of the Heart . 220 True Exorcism Burn Kerri's portrait with the Torch of Revocation and banish Kerri from the Material Plane. Obtainable only if Oskar Fevras was saved from the Zhentarim Basement in Act One . Shared with ⁠ Flames of Passion and ⁠ Using the Proper Means inspirations. 170 What Remains of the Dead Guide Nina to acceptance or prowess. She can be found in the Graveyard (Lower City) . Either helping her resurrect her brother or convincing her not to will award the inspiration. Murder Tribunal 220 Liturgy of Blood Embrace Bhaal and complete the Murder Tribunal . Despite the description, the inspiration is earned if any party member becomes an Unholy Assassin, not only the Dark Urge. Shared with ⁠ Death of Innocence and ⁠ Titles for the Collection inspirations. 220 Revulsion of Blood Free Valeria during the Murder Tribunal. Shared with ⁠ A Step Too Far and ⁠ End of the Tribunal inspirations. Rivington 135 A Scorned Closed Heart Side with the open-minded priest . In the dialogue with the priests, choose "Sounds like your god would be proud of Father Logan" . 135 A Test of Faithfulness Ask the Master of Love to test your bond. Shared with ⁠ Knowledge of the Heart , if the player character scores the best possible result with their partner. 135 A Wounded Open Heart Side with the close-minded priest . In the dialogue with the priests, choose "If Father Logan had been pickier, he might still been alive" . 135 Food for the Soul Donate a Long Rest's worth of food to the donation chest . [ 1 ] Shared with ⁠ Alms for the Unfortunate , ⁠ Gifts of the Wilds , ⁠ Sharing the Spoils , and ⁠ Spare What You Can inspirations. 135 Needs of the Many Persuade the merchant to let the refugee squatters stay in his home. Shared with ⁠ Finders Keepers and ⁠ Securing Hospitality inspirations. Also shared with ⁠ Exerting Judgement inspiration, if the party sided with Ben Golewits. 135 The Dismemberment of Dribbles Find all the pieces of Dribbles' body and return them to Lucretious . Shared with ⁠ Macabre Enigma , ⁠ Macabre Hunt , and ⁠ Trail of Blood inspirations. Undercity 220 Forgotten, Bloodied, Halls Discover the Temple of Bhaal . Granted upon opening the doors to the temple itself in the Undercity Ruins Shared with ⁠ Homecoming and ⁠ The Face of Evil inspirations. 170 Grinning with Bhaal Agree to an alliance with Orin . Granted if the party accept Orin's proposition after she kidnaps a companion. For a Dark Urge , accepting a duel challenge also grants the inspiration. Wyrm's Crossing 135 Carnal Rituals of Sharess Take part in the... erm... negotiable affection provided in Sharess' Caress . Unlike other similar inspirations, this one concerns only the deal with the drow twins . The Acolyte character must be the player character's romantic partner, which in general case narrows the variations to Shadowheart only. Shared with ⁠ Alternative Vocations and ⁠ Giving a Private Performance inspirations. Wyrm's Rock Fortress 170 Shaking Bane's Hand Agree to an alliance with Gortash . Cut Background Goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Justice Sees All: Discover why Anders betrayed Tyr. In Early Acess, Anders was a fallen paladin of Tyr. However, in the release version his backstory was changed to simply be a servant of Zariel pretending to be a paladin; therefore, the dialogue that would trigger this inspiration was removed. ## Charlatan
- **来源**: [Charlatan](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Charlatan)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Charlatan is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around trickery and deceit. Astarion and the hireling Kree Derryck have this background. “ You're an expert in manipulation, prone to exaggeration and more than happy to profit from it. Bending the truth and turning allies against each other will lead to greater success down the road. „ Contents 1 Background features 2 Background goals 3 Cut and inactive Background Goals 4 Notes and references Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Deception Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Charisma ( Deception ) Ability Checks . Sleight of Hand Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Dexterity ( Sleight of Hand ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description Act 1 Blighted Village 25 Just Passing Through Trick the goblins in Moonhaven. Using Illithid and Intimidation lines, as well as bribing the goblin guards does not work. 25 Mirror Master Trick or intimidate the magic mirror in the Thayan cellar . Goblin Camp 25 Anything for a Profit Steal the toe ring from Crusher without getting caught. Shared with ⁠ What Price Dignity? and mutually exclusive with ⁠ Give Them a Show . 25 Spiked Poison the beer in the goblin camp. Shared with ⁠ Culling the Crowd and ⁠ Now It's a Party! 25 Very Important Parasite Deceive any of the guards in the goblin camp. Using Illithid and Intimidation lines does not work. Grymforge 50 A Friend to All Gain access to Grymforge peacefully by lying to the raft patrol . Mountain Pass 30 Silver Blades, Silver Tongue Convince Kith'rak Voss to leave without violence. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Conquer the Conquerors . Overgrown Tunnel 30 One of Us Use the hag's mask to peacefully bypass her thralls. Granted when a party member with the mask equipped crosses the waterfall behind the corridor guarded by the masked thralls. To protect from the effects of the mask, Protection from Evil and Good can be used. Ravaged Beach 20 Cheese Your Way Through Talk your way past the bandits and enter the chapel . Must convince Gimblebock to flee and then trick Andorn to let the party inside. If the gang outside is fought, the inspiration is not granted. If Gimblebock's gang is chased off and then attacked, the inspiration is given as usual. 20 Flexible Diplomacy Betray the tieflings after convincing them to free Lae'zel . The party must attack the tieflings through the dialogue. If Lae'zel died while escaping the Nautiloid , this inspiration cannot be obtained. Shattered Sanctum 25 Devil's Advocate Interrogate the dead mind flayer without drawing suspicion. 25 A Better Offer Convince the pit spiders to attack the goblins. The inspiration can only be obtained with Speak with Animals active. Underdark 30 Warmonger Cause Glut to stage a coup - then pick a side. Report to Spaw on eliminating the duergar near the Ebonlake while having Glut as a party follower. Waukeen's Rest 30 The Importance of Networking Talk your way into the Zhentarim hideout . The inspiration is granted after the party convince Zarys to let them in. Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 75 The Devil's in the Details Expose a half-truth in the orthon's contract with Raphael . Requires the interacting party member to succeed a passive DC 14 Insight Check in the initial dialogue with Yurgir to detect a tricky clause in the text of the contract. Bards and Warlocks pass the check automatically. Shared with the ⁠ Killer Poetry inspiration. Last Light Inn 50 Always Trust a Dishonest Person Expose Marcus to the Harpers. Only available if Tieflings weren't saved -- if Mol is alive she will vouch for the party instead of Marcus. 50 Shuffling the Board Rig the game of lanceboard . 50 Tadpole Solidarity Go along with Marcus' plan. Granted only if Marcus vouches for the party at the entrance and is not exposed to Jaheira. Thus, only obtainable if Tieflings weren't saved. Moonrise Towers 50 Clear Conscience Successfully lie to Z'rell about the fate of the goblins. 60 Know thy Clientele Instigate Z'rell into showing off her gifts from the Absolute. 50 Pied Piper Successfully influence the gnolls , either to break free or continue being subservient. Moonrise Towers Prison 50 Not to Worry, I Have a Permit Evade repercussions when speaking to the Moonrise prisoners. This can be achieved by either convincing the guards to let the party talk to the prisoners, by talking to the prisoners unobserved, or by killing all the guards and then talking to a prisoner. Reithwin Town 60 Takes One to Know One Expose the true form of the toll collector by removing all her gold armour. This requires killing all her minions in combat. 60 Tricks of the Trade Successfully pretend to drink from the steins of ale. During dialog with Thisobald Thorm , pass all three Sleight of Hand checks to feign drinking. Shadow-Cursed Lands 75 Morally Grey Betray the trust of Moonrise or Lastlight. * The party must allow Marcus to kidnap Isobel from Last Light Inn, but then free the Nightsong. OR, prevent Marcus from kidnapping Isobel and then let Balthazar transport the Nightsong from Shadowfell to Moonrise. Act 3 Multiple locations 220 Always Trust a Dishonest Person [ 1 ] Betray a recently forged alliance. This inspiration has multiple mutually exclusive options to gain (granted once to whichever comes first): Accept Gortash's bargain . At any point after that, if Gortash becomes hostile, the inspiration is rewarded. Enter combat against Mystic Carrion after obtaining the quest Find Mystic Carrion's Servant . [ 2 ] Betray Nightsong to Lorroakan . Face Orin in the Bhaal Temple without killing Gortash after telling Orin that you would. Turn down The Emperor and release Orpheus . Choosing a side in the conflict between the Guild and the Zhentarim throughout Aid the Underduke and then betraying them does not grant this inspiration. Lower City 170 Grave Prospector Retrieve the grave's gold from Bugthimble . 170 Perks of the Trade Obtain a rebate for your room at the Elfsong Tavern . Trying to persuade Alan Alyth to give a discount by appealing to the murder does not grant this inspiration. Using any other ability checks, including class-based options, do grant it. 170 Saving a Fellow Tale-Spinner Save Volo from an untimely death. Rescue Volo from the angry mob in front of the Steel Watch Foundry . 170 Silver-Tongue's Better Than Any Key Gain access to Avery's workshop . The party can either sneak in or gain access with the password obtained during Investigate the Suspicious Toys . 170 The News of My Deeds Was Greatly Exaggerated Rig the Baldur's Mouth printing press. Complete the quest Stop the Presses . Rivington 135 Cheating the Cheater Find the source of the genie's trick and take it. Pickpocket the Djinni Ring from Akabi and then win the jackpot. The inspiration is granted after Akabi awards you the "prize". Shared with ⁠ A Grand Prize! . 135 Never Trust an Honest Person Lie to make your way into the big barn . 135 Seams of Lavender and Thyme Deceive your way into the circus . The inspiration cannot be gained if the party have already entered the circus' territory through an alternative route (e.g., from the Open Hand Temple ). In this case, the gatekeeper Klaus behaves as if they have already convinced him. 135 Stuffed Bears in the Closet Blackmail the merchant . Undercity 170 Friends in Low Places Gain access to the Undercellar through Tusgront . 220 Woman of Her Word Side with the Nine-Fingers against the Zhentarim . At the conclusion of Aid the Underduke , support Nine-Fingers. 220 Winged Serpent of Gold Side with the Zhentarim against Nine-Fingers. At the conclusion of Aid the Underduke, support the Zhentarim. Roah Moonglow or Friol must survive and escape to the Guildhall in the previous stage of the quest . Wyrm's Crossing 170 Not so Infallible After All Evade being arrested by a Steel Watcher . 170 Rock-Solid Alibi Manage to convince the Flaming Fist to let you into Wyrm's Rock. Wyrm's Rock Fortress 135 Nothing's Not for Sale Convince the Flaming Fist quartermaster to trade with you. Cut and inactive Background Goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Little White Lies : Lie to Arabella about the fate of her parents . Arabella can be lied to after the party find her parents, but the trigger for this inspiration event is a specific unreachable scene with Withers and Arabella. Not My First Time : Does not trigger as of game ver 4.1.17209685. ## Criminal
- **来源**: [Criminal](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Criminal)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Criminal is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around law-breaking and the criminal underworld. The hireling Ver'yll Wenkiir has this background. “ You have a history of breaking the law and survive by leveraging less-than-legal connections. Profiting from criminal enterprise will lead to greater opportunities in the future. „ Contents 1 Background features 2 Background goals 3 Cut Background Goals 4 Notes and references Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Deception Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Charisma ( Deception ) Ability Checks . Stealth Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Dexterity ( Stealth ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description General Anywhere 25 A Fine Fortune Steal an item worth at least 1000 gold. 20 Blood Price Murder an innocent civilian. Specifically, kill someone who isn't hostile at the time you attack them. 20 Escape Artist Escape from jail after being arrested. Act 1 Emerald Grove 20 Heretic Steal the Idol of Silvanus . Shared with ⁠ Idolatry inspiration. 20 Jailbreaker Smuggle Sazza out of the grove. The dialogue option to rob the kid is available for Rogues only. Shared with ⁠ Protector of the Small inspiration. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Slaying the Piper inspiration. Goblin Camp 25 Culling the Crowd Use poison to kill the drunk goblins in camp. Shared with ⁠ Spiked and ⁠ Now It's a Party! inspirations. 20 Slaughter's Prize Ally with Minthara to loot and slaughter the grove. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Guardian of the Forgotten and ⁠ A Headless Horde inspirations. Grymforge 50 Perfect Cut Split Nere's money with the duergar mutineers . Risen Road 30 Friend of the Family Become an ally of the Zhentarim . The party must pickup or steal the Caravan Strongbox without opening it and deliver it to Zarys . The party can pickpocket, knock out, or kill Zarys for the Caravan Strongbox even after delivering it to her. If left with Zarys, it can instead be stolen or looted from Slick Inatra in Act Three. Underdark 30 Swiftly Stolen Obtain Thulla's magical boots through underhanded means. Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 75 Fickle Allegiances Betray Balthazar after learning that Nightsong is not a simple relic. 75 What's Yours is Mine Take Shar's gem without aiding or killing the orthon . Mind Flayer Colony 95 Body Heist Open and loot the mind flayer colony's vault . Moonrise Towers 60 An Absolute Douceur Accept the Absolute's promise of gifts. Can be triggered by cooperating with Marcus to abduct Isobel from Last Light Inn . 60 Enter Nostalgia Trespass into Ketheric and Isobel's respective rooms . Unlike similar inspiration for Outlanders, this one does not require entering rooms from outside. 75 Long-Awaited Reunion Hand Isobel over to Ketheric Thorm . Can be triggered by cooperating with Marcus to abduct Isobel from Last Light Inn . 50 War Profiteer Find Roah in Moonrise and trade with her. Moonrise Towers Prison 60 Always a Way Out Help the Moonrise prisoners escape. Reithwin Town 60 A Dark Edge Take Shar's dagger from the ritual pedestal. The pedestal is in the hidden room of the Sharran Sanctuary . Taking the dagger spawns several enemies. Shared with ⁠ Ruthless Craftsmanship inspiration. 60 Notes of an Amateur Craft some Brewed-Up Bellyglummer . Brew? inspiration. 60 Personal Payroll Discover the Toll Collector's personal hoard at X: -125 Y: -90 . 60 Right Tool for the Job Obtain all 4 variants of the nurses' tools. Act 3 House of Hope 220 Interplanar Cat Burglar Burgle and escape the House of Hope . Lower City 220 A Pressing Heist Rig the Baldur's Mouth printing press. 170 Key to the Vault Obtain a way to enter the lower vaults. 170 Next Generation of Pockets Assume a contributive role in Dez's parenting. Shared with the ⁠ Weak Gifts for Weak Beings . 220 What Do We Have Here? Open one of the additional vaults in the lower levels of the Counting House . Must be opened via lockpicking. Rivington 135 Donations Means 'Free' Steal donated goods from the big barn . ## Entertainer
- **来源**: [Entertainer](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Entertainer)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Entertainer is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around bardic performances. The hireling Brinna Brightsong has this background. “ You live to sway and subvert your audience, engaging common crowds and high society alike. Preserving art and bringing joy to the hapless and downtrodden heightens your charismatic aura. „ Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Acrobatics Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Dexterity ( Acrobatics ) Ability Checks . Performance Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Charisma ( Performance ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description Act 1 Campsite 25 Celebrant Enjoy a dance in camp with the tieflings . Dance with Zae , a Tiefling who only appears if Lakrissa has been killed or knocked out. Alternatively, read the four Druid frescos in the room before confronting her. 25 A Very Tall Tale Tell Volo a dramatic story fit for a chapbook. 20 Made You Look Earn Mattis' respect by taking his ring. This inspiration is shared with ⁠ Artful Dodger . The interacting party member must pass a DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check through dialogue to get both inspirations. Rogues have Advantage and only need to pass a DC 10 Sleight of Hand Check . Goblin Camp 25 Chicken Chase Extraordinaire Win a match of chicken chase. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Anything for a Profit and ⁠ What Price Dignity? 25 Life of the Party Take part in the Goblin Camp's toast. 25 The Art of Agony Perform for Loviatar's pleasure in her ritual . ## Folk Hero
- **来源**: [Folk Hero](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Folk_Hero)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Folk Hero is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around rescuing others from peril. Wyll , Minsc , and the hireling Danton have this background. “ You're a champion of the common people, challenging tyrants and monsters to protect the helpless. Saving innocents in imminent danger will make your legend grow. „ Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Animal Handling Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Wisdom ( Animal Handling ) Ability Checks . Survival Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Wisdom ( Survival ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description Act 1 Blighted Village 25 The Most Unfortunate Gnome Rescue the gnome from his fate at the windmill. This is earned after speaking to him. Campsite 25 The Bard with Nine Lives Rescue Volo from the Goblin Camp . The inspiration is granted in the camp, if Volo was sent there after saving him. Emerald Grove 20 A Timely Rescue Save Findal from the goblins who kidnapped him. 20 Guardian of the Forgotten Save the tieflings from the goblin assault. The party must defend the grove when Minthara's forces assault the grove. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Slaughter's Prize and ⁠ A Headless Horde . 20 Protector of the Small Save Mirkon from the harpies. Shared with ⁠ The Allure of Coin and ⁠ Slaying the Piper . 20 Snake Whisperer Save Arabella from Kagha and her serpent. The party must complete the quest by speaking to Arabella and her parents to get the inspiration Grymforge 30 Breaker of Chains Save the deep gnomes from Nere and the duergar . Overgrown Tunnel 30 Unmasking the Truth Free the Mask of Regret , one of the Hag's masked thralls Shattered Sanctum 25 Fate Worse Than Death Save Liam from his goblin torturers. 25 Saved by a Thread Save Smythin from his lethal fall. There is a very tight timing as he is pushed down shortly after any party member reaches the top of stairs X: 305 Y: 0 or X: 288 Y: 0 . If Sazza is escorted out the grove before the party reaches this point, Smythin does not appear. Underdark 30 A Lethal Endeavour Escort Baelen out of the field of bibberbangs. Waukeen's Rest 30 Rescued from the Flames Save whoever you can from Waukeen's Rest . Despite the description, saving either Florrick or Benryn grants it, even if the other one is still alive and blocked inside. Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 75 Damsel No More Free Nightsong . Last Light Inn 50 A Smile Better Suits... Offer a hopeful response to Alfira's inquiry. 50 From One Hero to Another Meet Jaheira and drink the wine she offers. 50 Helping the Little Guy Help Mol win the game of lanceboard. 60 Meeting of Fates Side with either Isobel or Marcus during the confrontation in Last Light. Moonrise Towers 50 No Strings to Hold Them Back Release the gnolls from their enslavement. 50 Uncommon Recognition Relate your feats to the bugbear merchant . Moonrise Towers Prison 60 Breakout! Break out and save all of the Moonrise prisoners. Reithwin Town 60 Power Corrupts Defeat a major figure in the corrupted town. The party must defeat Gerringothe Thorm , Malus Thorm , or Thisobald Thorm . 75 Power Corrupts... Absolutely Defeat all of the major figures in the corrupted town. The party must defeat Gerringothe Thorm , Malus Thorm , and Thisobald Thorm . All three must be defeated in combat. 50 Saving the Prodigious Save Rolan from the Shadow-Cursed Lands. Shadow-Cursed Lands 60 Greatness Thrust Upon Them Find, save & bring Arabella to your camp. 50 Not Another Soul Keep all Harpers alive during the ambush with the Shadows. Act 3 House of Hope 220 Freeing the Preyed Free Hope from captivity. Iron Throne 220 Against All Odds Rescue all thirteen captured Gondians' family members before the turn limit expires. Lower City 170 A Bet Is a Bet Meet with Lakrissa in Baldur's Gate . Only obtained if the party talked with Lakrissa in the Emerald Grove and made a wager with her on reaching Baldur's Gate. 170 Empathy for the Fallen Convince the coffin-maker Ulkov Sully to make an exception. 220 In Need of a Hero Successfully rescue all of the Gondians from the Steel Watch Foundry . 170 Painted Hero Obtain your portrait from Oskar . 170 Safeguarding the Songbird Meet the unflappable Alfira in Baldur's Gate . 170 Truth Shines Through Find the true culprit behind the serial murders. Murder Tribunal 220 End of the Tribunal Save Valeria and end the Murder Tribunal. Rivington 170 Innocence Lost Expose the toy-maker's mischief. 135 Keeping Your Hands Clean Refuse to cause collateral damage with Wulbren's plan. 135 Securing Hospitality Save the squatters from being kicked out. 135 Trusting Your Instincts Take up Valeria's shoddily concluded investigation. Upper City 220 Chained, Unfortunate Souls Rescue the vampire spawn from Cazador's lair . 220 Never To Be Chained Again Defeat Lorroakan and let Nightsong execute her vengeance. Wyrm's Rock Prison 170 Diplomatic Rescue Save Counsellor Florrick from Wyrm's Rock. Wyrmway 170 Wyrmslayers Challenge and defeat Ansur , the not-so-immortal sentinel of Wyrm's Crossing. Cut Background Goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Soul Warden: Save Nadira from the bugbear assassin. While this event is still present in the game, completing it does not seem to award this inspiration. Liberator: Liberate the enthralled fishermen from the mindflaye The enthralled fishermen were a group encountered in the crashed Mindflayer ship during early access but were removed for the release version, making this goal unobtainable. v t e Character creation Classes Barbarian Bard Cleric Druid Fighter Monk Paladin Ranger Rogue Sorcerer Warlock Wizard Backgrounds Acolyte Charlatan Criminal Entertainer Folk Hero Guild Artisan Haunted One Noble Outlander Sage Soldier Urchin Races Dragonborn Drow Dwarf Elf Githyanki Gnome Half-Elf Half-Orc Halfling Human Tiefling Deities Bahamut Corellon Larethian Eilistraee Garl Glittergold Gruumsh Helm Ilmater Laduguer Lathander Lolth Kelemvor Mielikki Moradin Mystra Oghma Selûne Shar Talos Tempus Tiamat Tyr Vlaakith Yondalla
## Guild Artisan
- **来源**: [Guild Artisan](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Guild_Artisan)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Guild Artisan is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around crafting and mercantilism. The hireling Jacelyn has this background. “ Your skill in a particular craft has earned you membership in a mercantile guild, offering privileges and protection while engaging in your art. Repairing and discovering rare crafts will bring new inspiration. „ Contents 1 Background features 2 Background goals 3 Cut Background Goals 4 Footnotes and References Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Insight Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Wisdom ( Insight ) Ability Checks . Persuasion Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Charisma ( Persuasion ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description General Anywhere 25 A Golden Masterpiece Sell an item worth at least 1000 gold. 20 Valued Customer Trade with someone who has High approval of you. Act 1 Grymforge 30 Art Endures Craft something in the Adamantine Forge. 50 Expert Opinion Evaluate the ruins in Grymforge and share your findings with the duergar mason . This is granted if all three checks ( Investigation , History and Perception , all DC 10) on examining ruins are passed by a single character. Any other party member starts an independent dialogue and has to pass their own sequence of checks. The checks are not necessary passed in a single dialogue; a party member can try them separately until they use the dialogue option "I'm ready to report" . Forest 25 A New Vision Reforge the broken spear . Riverside Teahouse 30 An Acquired Taste Drink one of Ethel's unique potions. Heart of Stone or A Mother's Loathing are recommended, as the others have negative effects. If not earned here, this inspiration can also be earned in Act Three in The Blushing Mermaid Basement , if Ethel resides there. Underdark 30 Mind Over Mushrooms Gather ingredients for Omeluum's potion. 30 Regeneration Restore power to the elevator in the Arcane Tower . 30 The Finest Ingredients Create a masterwork item from Sussur Tree Bark . 30 Trash & Treasure Observe the effects of the Chest of the Mundane . Waukeen's Rest 30 The Spider's Gift Identify the drow armour near Waukeen's Rest . This requires the armour to be picked up with a Drow, Duergar, Deep Gnome, or any character with +5 to History or higher in the party. Zhentarim Basement 30 An Artist in Need Rescue Oskar the painter from the Zhentarim . 30 In Working Order Repair the elevator in the Zhentarim Hideout . Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 75 Dark Machinations Fill all sockets with Sharran gems in the Gauntlet of Shar. 75 Made of Shadows Unlock and take the Spear of Rampant Night . The relevant weapon is actually called the Spear of Night. 60 Mating Season Discover the source of the displacer beast's infatuation. The party must investigate the spider carcass near Yurgir . Last Light Inn 60 Hellish Armaments Obtain a piece of infernal equipment from Dammon . 50 In the Palm of My Hand Acquire the Brilliant Retort from Barcus . This is the reward for completing the quest Rescue Wulbren . Moonrise Towers 50 Blood, Sweat, and the Other Thing Give your blood to Araj Oblodra . Moonrise Towers Prison 50 Simple Tools, Great Works Return Wulbren's tools to him. This doesn't need to be his hammer that was confiscated; any bludgeoning weapon, including the club that Wulbren can pick up on the docks, will award this Inspiration. Reithwin Town 60 Confiscated Works Acquire a magical item from the toll collector's confiscation chest. 60 Inhumane Trials Witness a horrid operation in the cursed house of healing . 60 Ruthless Craftsmanship Take Shar's ceremonial dagger . This prompts a fight with hostile undead Dark Justiciars. 60 Safety-Averse Quaffing Drink at least 1 of the brewer's steins. 60 Special Iced Arsenic... Brew? Craft some Brewed-Up Bellyglummer . 60 Tragedy in Masonry Discover the fate of the mason. Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Trust and a Little Pixie Dust Investigate the Moonlantern and find its power source. Act 3 Lower City 135 Extravagance Required Acquire an exquisite new outfit from Figaro's. Granted only upon trading with Figaro Pennygood himself. Trading with Phlanders Hort if Figaro died does not count. 220 Flames of Passion Burn Oskar's painting with a Torch of Revocation . 170 Lantanna Marvel Take control of the Submersible . Despite the description, convincing Redhammer to operate the submersible also grants the inspiration. 170 Putting the Pen to Paper Discover the inner workings of the Baldur's Mouth printing press. 170 Sanguine Progress Find out what happened to Araj and her blood experiment. 170 Soured Taste Find a bottle of poisoned wine at the wine festival . 220 The Art of Destruction Use the Runepowder Bomb to destroy the Steel Watch Foundry . 170 These Belong in a Museum! Open any of the special vaults in The Counting House . 170 Touring the Sights Correctly identify all of the Devil's Fee's relics. Despite the description, it is enough to correctly identify any two of the highlighted items (of four total). A DC 15 Arcana Check is required to identify each one of the items. For Karlach , however, the check is DC 0 instead (a reliable way to obtain the inspiration). Rivington 135 Dream Big Describe your perfect weapon to Gyldro Angleiron . This is only possible if Orin is impersonating the smith, and granted only if the answer to her third question is "Perhaps. If there was no other option" [ 1 ] It is not necessary for the Guild Artisan character to be the one talking to Gyldro. 135 Encouraging Local Artists Commission a Statue of yourself. 135 Free Advertisement Complete the interview with Lens . 170 Following the Instructions Return the Sentient Amulet to Shirra . 135 Immoral Ingenuity Discover the booby-trapped toys. 170 Macabre Enigma Piece the corpse of Dribbles back together. Wyrm's Crossing 170 Alternative Vocations Partake in a service from Sharess' Caress : Accept a free drink from Hoots Hooligan Experience 'rapture' from Naoise Nallinto Hire either Nym Orlith or Sorn Orlith or both Cut Background Goals [ edit section | visual editor ] The Apprentice Turns Master: Craft Nettie 's antidote in the cauldron. This source of inspiration was removed by Patch 1 when the quest Get Help from Healer Nettie was changed to use regular potion crafting to make an antidote rather than using the cauldron and Flora of the Dalelands to craft an Elixir of Silvanus . ## Haunted One
- **来源**: [Haunted One](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Haunted_One)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Haunted One is a character background unique to the Dark Urge with inspirations themed around embracing (or sometimes resisting) The Urge . “ A wicked moment, person, or thing that cannot be slain by sword or spell haunts your mind and flickers in your peripheral vision. You carry it wherever your adventure takes you - or perhaps it carries you. „ Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Medicine Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Wisdom ( Medicine ) Ability Checks . Intimidation Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Charisma ( Intimidation ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration Points. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration Points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to the Dark Urge . While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points to Dark Urge characters. Location XP Reward Name Description General Anywhere 25 Indulge Thine Appetites Follow your Dark Urge. There are many opportunities to obtain this version, generally by choosing dialogue options related to giving in to the urges, but only the first time this is done actually grants an Inspiration Point. Interaction catalysts include: Killing Gale, Timber, Arabella, Wounded Bird, Okta, Remira, Pandirna, Zevlor, Lady Esther, Blood of Lathander, and the Strange Ox in Act 2, among others. 50 Killing Spree Kill 5 enemies in a single round. 50 Panoply of Agony Get at least one kill with each Damage type . There are thirteen different damage types. 25 Subdue Thine Appetites Resist your Dark Urge. There are many opportunities to obtain this version, generally by choosing dialogue options related to refusing to give in to the urges, but only the first time this is done actually grants an inspiration point. Interaction catalysts include: Saving Gale, Okta, Arabella, and Sa'varsh Kethk, among others. 95 Unfriendly Fire Defeat 5 neutral creatures in a single round. Act 1 Blighted Village 25 Creatures of Bloodlust Recruit the ogre mercenaries , using the corpses of your enemies as payment. Shared with ⁠ Bodyguards for Hire and ⁠ Pyramid Scheme . Campsite 25 Snipping the Chords Kill Alfira in cold blood. Killing Quil Grootslang instead of Alfira does not count. Dank Crypt 20 Unfamiliar Familiarity Release Withers from his tomb. Druids Grove 50 Camaraderie in Bloodthirst Spill the blood of the tieflings. 50 Morally Acceptable Massacre Spill the blood of the goblins. Forest 25 Reuniting Friends Kill Brynna and Andrick , reuniting them with their fallen companion. Goblin Camp 25 Good Ol' Long Pig Eat a chunk of the cooked dwarf . 25 Grabbing the Poker with Both Hands Torture Liam . The option to torture Liam is not available to Drow characters. To do this, they must be disguised as anyone but a drow. [ verify ] 25 Now It's a Party! Poison the stolen ale , slaughtering the goblins. Shared with ⁠ Culling the Crowd and ⁠ Spiked . Grymforge 50 Head of the Snake Take Nere's head . Ravaged Beach 20 To Sleep, Perchance To Dream Tentacled Dreams Close the pinned mind flayer's eyes forever. Underdark 50 New Management Kill the Myconid Sovereign for Glut . Waukeen's Rest 30 Fresh Kindle for the Fire Leave the pinned Benryn to burn. Freeing Benryn but letting him die from the fire before he escapes counts. Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 75 Bleeding the Corpse Dry Kill the necromancer . 75 Blood Moon Kill the Daughter of the Moon . 75 Killer Poetry Trick the orthon with a false loophole. Requires the interacting party member to succeed a passive DC 14 Insight Check in the initial dialogue with Yurgir to detect a tricky clause in the text of the contract. Bards and Warlocks pass this check automatically. Shared with the ⁠ The Devil's in the Details inspiration. 75 Self-Flagellation Kill your mirror-self in Shar's trial. Shared with the ⁠ Know Thine Enemy inspiration. Last Light Inn 75 Forced Retirement End Jaheira's career permanently. 75 Lunar Eclipse Kill the protector of Last Light . Mind Flayer Colony 95 Lesser of the Three Kill the envoy of Myrkul. Moonrise Towers 50 Too Easy Execute the useless goblins. 60 Swimming with the Shadows Force the Zhent smuggler to jump off the docks. 60 Who Let the Gnolls Out Release the gnolls from their leashes. Moonrise Towers Prison 60 Soulful Lobotomy Torture Minthara , reducing her to a husk of her former self. Obtained if the Urge personally erases Minthara's mind; letting the Inquisitors do it does not grant an inspiration point. Reithwin Town 60 Lack of Moderation is Key Kill the brewer with his own brew. 60 Under the Knife Kill the surgeon using his own servile nurses. Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Fly-Swatter Kill the trickster pixie . This can also be triggered by arriving to Moonrise Towers with Kar'niss' convoy. 50 Forcing Responsibility Demand that the goblin fetch his bone. Act 3 Bhaal Temple 275 Bhaalspawn No More Reject your legacy. 75 Forced Retirement End Jaheira's career permanently. This inspiration can be earned here, if the Dark Urge embraces their Bhaalspawn legacy and Jaheira survives to this moment. Shared with the ⁠ Putting the Past to Rest inspiration Lower City 220 A Massacre Beyond Imagining Annihilate the Steel Watch Foundry with Wulbren's secret weapon. 220 An Overdue Slaughter Pull off a long-overdue climax to the life of Mystic Carrion . 170 Culling the Imitator Kill the wannabe assassin . 220 Re-tasting the Kill Kill Ethel a second time - that stubborn, swampy scandal of a hag. ## Noble
- **来源**: [Noble](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Noble)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Noble is a character background . Minthara and the hireling Kerz have this background. “ You were raised in a family among the social elite, accustomed to power and privilege. Accumulating renown, power, and loyalty will raise your status. „ Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] History Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Intelligence ( History ) Ability Checks . Persuasion Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Charisma ( Persuasion ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description General Anywhere 25 Dragon's Hoard Have at least 2000 gold among the party. Only obtainable the first time the threshold of 2000 gold is reached. 30 Eldritch Authority Become a True Soul . Use illithid dialogue options in conversations 7 times. [ 1 ] 20 Fine By Me Use your wealth to bribe a guard. 20 Noblesse Oblige Dismiss a companion for interrupting a conversation or Ignore the pleas or requests of a companion in dialogue. This only works as a Custom party member, [ verify ] and does not work with Hirelings or Minthara. It is possible to let Lae'zel make Zorru bow or kneel once to get approval , and then step in after. 25 Penchant for Diplomacy Reach a High level of approval with a companion . Does not work with Hirelings . 20 Soul for Sale Acquire a Soul Coin for your personal collection. The earliest options to earn this are looting a coin from the chest in the Dank Crypt or convincing Nadira in the Emerald Grove . Act 1 Multiple locations 25 Entitled Earn a title from your deeds. This can be awarded by doing the following: Killing the duergar for Sovereign Spaw . Persuading Kagha to abandon the Shadow Druids , thus earning the title "Faithwarden" (available only for a Druid characters). Earning the "Mahkloompah" title from the Kuo-toa in Festering Cove does not grant this inspiration. Blighted Village 25 Bodyguards for Hire Recruit the ogres to protect you. Shared with ⁠ Pyramid Scheme and ⁠ Creatures of Bloodlust . Campsite 30 Blueblood Solidarity Learn Wyll's family history. This only works as a Custom party member, [ verify ] and does not work with Hirelings . Wyll must be spoken with after saving Counsellor Florrick at Waukeen's Rest . 20 Lest Ye Be Judged Learn Astarion's history as a magistrate. This only works as a Custom party member, [ verify ] and does not work with Hirelings . Goblin Camp 25 A Man of Many Talents Expand your retinue by bringing Volo to camp. Underdark 30 Know Your Place Leverage the player character's role in the drow matriarchy to force Dhourn to abandon his quest. The dialogue option to do this can be made available to non-Drow characters through the use of Disguise Self . Waukeen's Rest 30 Protector of the Duke Rescue Counsellor Florrick from the burning inn . This is earned after speaking to Counsellor Florrick. Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 60 Meat Shield Obtain Balthazar's bell and summon his flesh golem. The inspiration is not granted on attempt to summon Flesh in a battle against Balthazar himself. 75 Recognised by Shadows Pass all of Shar's trials . Last Light Inn 60 Favour for a Favour Wake Art for Counsellor Florrick and the Flaming Fist. 50 Noble Feline Speak with the lordly cat at Last Light. Only obtainable the first time a character speaks with His Majesty. 60 Patrician of the Grove Recruit Halsin . Moonrise Towers 50 A Velvet Glove Spare the goblins. Mutually exclusive with the ⁠ An Iron Fist inspiration. Shared with the ⁠ Newly Downtrodden inspiration. 50 An Iron Fist Execute the goblins. Mutually exclusive with the ⁠ A Velvet Glove inspiration. Shared with the ⁠ Too Easy inspiration. 50 Can't Bribe 'Em All Bribe Moonrise's warden . 75 Ketheric's Loss Learn Ketheric's past. Read the letter in the locked chest at the foot of Kethric's bed and investigate the plaque in front of Isobel's sarcophagus. 60 Nobleborn as Below, so Above Recruit Minthara . 60 Top of the Ladder Meet Ketheric at the top of Moonrise. Reithwin Town 50 Taxes? Never Heard of 'Em Don't give any gold to the toll collector . This effectively means fighting her, as any ability checks which convince her to "retire" require tossing her several coins first. Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Odd Entourage Complete the drider escort to Moonrise. Act 3 Multiple locations 170 An Apocalyptic Deal Convince someone to aid you during the endgame or by making a deal with Raphael This can be awarded by: Convincing Mol or Nine-Fingers to aid the party in the battle for Baldur's Gate. Defeating Raphael in the House of Hope, while first convincing Yurgir to join the party's side. Siding with Wulbren Bongle during Disable the Steel Watch . Recruiting Auntie Ethel as an ally. Lower City 220 Defamed No More Sabotage the printing press. 170 The Means of Coercion Find the true reason the Gondians are cooperating with Gortash . Granted only upon trading with Figaro Pennygood himself. Trading with Phlanders Hort if Figaro died does not count. 170 Wine Connoisseur Warn Mrs Highberry of the poisoned wine. Murder Tribunal 220 Titles for the Collection Become the Unholy Assassin of Bhaal . Rivington 125 Alms for the Unfortunate Donate something to the refugees.
