## Outlander
- **来源**: [Outlander](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Outlander)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Outlander is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around exploration and navigating the wilds. Karlach , Halsin , and the hirelings Eldra Luthrinn and Sina'zith have this background. “ You grew up in the wilds, learning to survive far from the comforts of civilisation. Surviving unusual hazards of the wild will enhance your prowess and understanding. „ Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Athletics Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Strength ( Athletics ) Ability Checks . Survival Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Wisdom ( Survival ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description Act 1 Multiple locations 30 Walking On Air Successfully use a fairy ring. "Fairy ring" refers to the mushroom circles found in the Sunlit Wetlands , in the Overgrown Tunnel or in the Underdark . Campsite 25 Cub Tamer Successfully tame the owlbear cub . The inspiration is given after the cub comes to the camp for the second time and if then stays as a follower. Grymforge 50 The Floor Is Lava Defeat the Lava Elemental in the lava lake. Forest 25 A Mother's Fury Triumph over the mother Owlbear . Does not require actually fighting the Owlbear. Convincing her not to attack using Speak with Animals is sufficient. Risen Road 30 Rock Steady Survive the bandit's rolling boulder trap. The trap blocks the cave mouth at X: 50 Y: 570 . The description is misleading; disarming or getting around the two tripwire traps awards the inspiration, while getting hit by the boulder and surviving does not. 30 Cursebreaker Discover the curse of Yeenoghu and destroy his hyenas. The nearby gnolls must also be killed. Sunlit Wetlands 30 Eyes of the Wild See past the illusion covering the swamp. Underdark 30 A Noble Endeavour Effectively use a noblestalk mushroom. This can be accomplished by giving the mushroom to Derryth , Shadowheart , or Baelen , or by The Dark Urge using it themselves. 30 Abyss Jumper The party must enter the Underdark through the bottomless well. Feather Fall effects, via spell or potion, can be used to survive the fall. This can be acquired even if the Underdark was previously entered via some other way. 30 Clever Cuckoo Steal from the giant bird's nest in the Underdark . The nest can be reaced by series of jumps up from X: 43 Y: -141 . The chest inside can be looted freely. 30 Mushroom Enthusiast Destroy each kind of hazardous Underdark mushroom. The party must destroy at least one stalk of Bibberbangs , Timmasks and Torchstalks , regardless of the order. Nightlights and Barrelstalks do not count. The inspiration is given regardless of whether any party member got hurt from the mushrooms' effects. 30 Nest Egg Take an item from the Carrion Crawler nest . The inspiration is awarded only after the passive DC 15 Survival Check , which, in turn, is available only to Short races, e.g. Halfling , Dwarf or Gnome . Wilderness 20 Sticky Fingers Secure the pouch from the spider crevice . Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 75 Always a Step Ahead of the Darkness Reach Nightsong without having been affected by the shadow curse. This is not granted when you reach Nightsong, but when you come back from the Shadowfell . 75 Path Least Followed Complete the Gauntlet of Shar without going to Last Light or Moonrise . 75 Tools of the Trade Obtain the orthon's crossbow. Last Light Inn 60 Grove Keeper's Keeper Protect Halsin's portal while he saves the spirit of the land . Mind Flayer Colony 95 From Head to Toe Explore all sections of the mind flayer colony. This is awarded upon following Ketheric to the lower level. Moonrise Towers 50 Delving into the Deep Enter the oubliette ... for better or for worse. 50 Mutual Respect Meet Steelclaw the tadpole-hunting cat. 60 Never Liked Stairs Enter a restricted area in Moonrise Towers from the outside. It can be one of the following rooms: Isobel's room Ketheric's chambers Balthazar's lab Reithwin Town 60 I've Had Worse Successfully drink and resist the negative effects of the brewer's concoction. It is not necessary for the Outlander to actually do this; they just need to be present when someone does. Shadow-Cursed Lands 60 Bumps in the Dark Conquer three combat encounters in the Shadow-Cursed Lands. 50 Child's Play Beat Oliver at hide and seek without alerting the shadow creatures. This requires winning both rounds of Oliver's game. 50 Embracing the Environment Survive two rounds of the shadow curse. The inspiration is given at the start of the third turn, if the character feeling the curse effect is still alive and not downed. It does not need to be the character with the Outlander background themselves. 60 I Ain't Afraid of No Shadows Traverse through the Shadow-Cursed Lands to Last Light and Moonrise without using a Moonlantern. 60 No Cursed Stone Left Unturned Explore each key area of the Shadow-Cursed Lands. The party must visit the Ruined Battlefield , Reithwin Town , the Last Light Inn , and reach the Gauntlet of Shar (through the Grand Mausoleum ). The inspiration is given upon entering the last of all four locations, regardless of the order. Thorough exploration is not needed. 50 Sleeping in the Dark Take a full Long Rest in the Shadow-Cursed Lands . This is only awarded for resting in a camp that's out in the actual dangerous area. Camping at Last Light Inn , in Moonrise Towers , or in the Gauntlet of Shar [ 1 ] does not count. Act 3 Iron Throne 220 Down to the Depths Below Enter the Iron Throne . The inspiration is given upon docking the submersible at the underwater prison. House of Hope 220 Horizon Walker Travel through the House of Hope portal. The inspiration is given upon arrival. Shared with ⁠ An Exotic Charter inspiration. Lower City 220 Catastrophic Structural Failure Blow up the Steel Watch Foundry . 170 Children of an Outlander Convince Jaheira to let her family stay in the city. Shared with ⁠ Cherishing Family inspiration. 170 For Once, a Warm Meal Obtain room and board at the Elfsong Tavern . Shared with ⁠ Proper Lodging, Finally , ⁠ Veteran's Hotspot , and ⁠ Perks of the Trade inspirations (the latter if a discount was gained). 170 Nature of the Beast Discover the fate of the Githyanki egg. 170 Urban Jungle Survive the Bhaalist ambush at the park . Rivington 135 Cat's Got Your Tongue? Find the missing letters . Shared with ⁠ Interrupted Communications inspiration. 135 Enlisted Avian Meet Commander Lightfeather . Shared with ⁠ Reporting for Duty inspiration. 135 Gifts of the Wilds Give raw goods as a donation . Shared with ⁠ Food for the Soul inspiration. 170 Macabre Hunt Find all the pieces of Dribbles ' body and return them to Lucretious . 170 Primary Needs Tame the dilophosaurus , making it non-hostile. Mutually exclusive with the ⁠ Running Wild inspiration. 135 Running Wild Release all the imprisoned circus beasts. Mutually exclusive with the ⁠ Primary Needs inspiration. If Crimson is fed before unlocking his cage, he does not run away, and the inspiration cannot be gained. 135 Solemn Farewell Witness the Gur funeral . Available only if Astarion was not betrayed to the Gur hunter in Act One . Shared with ⁠ Skald's Song inspiration. Undercity 170 Beneath the Gate Enter the Undercellar . Shared with ⁠ Friends in Low Places and ⁠ Underbelly Diplomat inspirations. 220 The Face of Evil Reach the Temple of Bhaal . Shared with ⁠ Forgotten, Bloodied, Halls and ⁠ Homecoming inspirations. Notes and References [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ The area free of the curse starts in approximately 3 m (10 ft) from the hidden door leading to the Gauntlet from the Grand Mausoleum . Moving to the campsite before this imaginary line leads to the primary Shadow-Cursed Lands' campsite layout and allows to earn the inspiration. v t e Character creation Classes Barbarian Bard Cleric Druid Fighter Monk Paladin Ranger Rogue Sorcerer Warlock Wizard Backgrounds Acolyte Charlatan Criminal Entertainer Folk Hero Guild Artisan Haunted One Noble Outlander Sage Soldier Urchin Races Dragonborn Drow Dwarf Elf Githyanki Gnome Half-Elf Half-Orc Halfling Human Tiefling Deities Bahamut Corellon Larethian Eilistraee Garl Glittergold Gruumsh Helm Ilmater Laduguer Lathander Lolth Kelemvor Mielikki Moradin Mystra Oghma Selûne Shar Talos Tempus Tiamat Tyr Vlaakith Yondalla
## Sage
- **来源**: [Sage](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Sage)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Sage is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around the pursuit of scholarly knowledge. Gale and the hireling Sir Fuzzalump have this background. “ You are curious and well-read, with an unending thirst for knowledge. Learning about rare lore of the world will inspire you to put this knowledge to greater purpose. „ Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Arcana Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Intelligence ( Arcana ) Ability Checks . History Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Intelligence ( History ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description General Anywhere 20 Reanimator [ 1 ] Correctly follow Gale's instructions to resurrect him. Only the party member interacting with Gale's flute gets the inspiration. Alternatively, the Scroll (Gale's Pouch) can be thrown into the lava at Grymforge while a Sage character is within 6 meters of that spot. You can get the Inspiration if you revive Gale with any character, but it must be Gale who opens the pouch and plays the music on the flute. 26 Whispers from the Grave [ 1 ] Glean some wisdom from speaking with the dead . Act 1 Blighted Village 30 A Natural Alliance Recognise the druid and Harper armour. A party member must interact with either of the two skeletons under the broken bridge at X: -9 Y: 498 and pass a DC 10 History Check . If the party had passed a History check on the "Union" fresco in the Inner Sactum , the inspiration is gained without another check. [ 2 ] 25 A Solitary Spider [ 1 ] Read the arachnomancer's journals at the bottom of the well . There are four journals to be read: Bloody Journal , Burnt Journal , Tattered Journal , and Web-Covered Journal . The inspiration is given after reading them all regardless of the order. The Sage character is not necessarily the one to read the journals. 25 Secrets of the Necromancer [ 1 ] Discover the strange nature of the Thayan tome . Dank Crypt 20 Secrets of the Sundering [ 1 ] Unlock and read the Book of Dead Gods . Shared with ⁠ Divinity Undone inspiration. Druids Grove 20 Roots of the Grove Learn local history from the druidic frescos. Requires passing ability checks on all four frescos (a DC 5 History Check , a DC 10 Intelligence Check , and two DC 10 Religion Checks ) in the Inner Sanctum of the Emerald Grove. This inspiration is also granted if the checks are passed by different party members. 20 Secrets of the Shadow Druids [ 1 ] Discover and read Faldorn's Canticle . This book is in the locked chest in the Inner Sanctum of the Emerald Grove Goblin Camp 25 Secrets of the High Chieftain [ 1 ] Read Volo's Guide To Goblins . This book is owned by Booyahg Piddle on the top of one of the towers in the central part of the outer camp. 25 The Phases Unfold Solve the moon puzzle sealing the door to the Underdark . The puzzle can be solved even after opening the passage to the Underdark via the hidden lever and the inspiration will still be granted. Underdark 30 If I Can't Have It... [ 1 ] Discover the secrets of the the Adamantine Forge from all three drow wizards. The party must pass the ability checks to decipher the following 3 items: Memory Shard taken from Dhourn Scribbled Notes written by Filro The Great Furnace of Grymforge found on the corpse of Xargrim 30 Secrets of the Matron [ 1 ] Read the obscure text by a drow matron. This book is in the forgotten drow stash at X: 84 Y: -207 . 30 Secrets of the Sussur Tree Disable an arcane turret using a sussur flower . 30 The Forbidden Arcane [ 1 ] Read Omeluum's notes on illithid magic. Can be purchased from Omeluum after completing ⁠ Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite or from Nansi Gretta in the Lower City . Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 60 History Never Forgets Open the way into the Gauntlet of Shar. The inspiration is granted after successfully solving the fresco puzzle in the Grand Mausoleum . 75 Emblem of the Moonmaiden Discover the truth about the Nightsong . 75 Rat King Discover the truth behind the numerous rats in the Gauntlet of Shar. Shared with ⁠ Sole Survivor inspiration. Last Light Inn 50 Theskan Tactician Help Mol win the game of lanceboard. Shared with ⁠ Helping the Little Guy , ⁠ Orphan Camaraderie , and ⁠ Shuffling the Board inspirations (the latter in case of rigging the board). 60 Waking the Sleeper Wake Art from his catatonic slumber. Mind Flayer Colony 95 Brain Blast! Successfully complete the mind puzzle in the mind flayer colony . Moonrise Towers 60 A Little Too Familiar with the Grotesque... Solve Balthazar's secret study puzzle without making a mistake. [ 3 ] 50 Secrets of the Necromancer Solve Balthazar's secret study puzzle. [ 3 ] 50 They're in the Walls! Discover what the 'meat sound' is. Interact with the Cracked Wall up over the kitchen area (accessible from the Moonrise_Towers#Rafters ) Select "Do Nothing" or fail the first ability check or interact with the wall again to activate the cutscene where the Absolute introduces itself Shared with ⁠ A Different Kind of Muse inspiration. 60 Thorm Family Secrets Discover the fate of Ketheric's family members. Requires interacting with Ketheric, Isobel , Gerringothe Thorm , Malus Thorm , and Thisobald Thorm . The order is irrelevant. 60 To Have Loved and Lost [ 1 ] Discover the source of Ketheric's shame. The letter is in the locked chest in Moonrise_Towers#Ketheric's chambers . Shared with the ⁠ Ketheric's Loss inspiration. Reithwin Town 60 Hippocratic No More [ 1 ] Find the Surgeon's Research Notes . This journal is in the laboratory of the House of Healing morgue. 60 Partaking in Local Customs Perform the ritual in the Sharran Sanctuary . Pass DC 10 Religion Check on the altar to Shar in the hidden room and sacrifice your blood. 60 Snuffed Spark [ 1 ] Find the dead aasimar's journal . Shared with ⁠ Blessed's Final Rest . 60 Tenets of Loss Open the way into the Sharran Sanctuary . Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Corrupted Beyond Recognition [ 1 ] Find and read the Dead Druid's Journal about how the shadow curse came to be. The journal is on the skeleton at X: 109 Y: 183 . Act 3 House of Hope 170 An Exotic Charter Obtain access to the House of Hope portal. Granted after actually entering the House of Hope through the portal. Shared with the ⁠ Horizon Walker inspiration. Lower City 30 All Knowledge Is Worth Having [ 1 ] Finish reading the Thayan tome of necromancy . 170 A Foul and Awesome Display Use the Runepowder Bomb given by Wulbren . Granted even if the bomb is used not in the Steel Watch Foundry . 170 Blood of the Covenant Find out how Araj's blood experiments are going. 170 Membership Admittance Ask Havkelaag to join the Society of Brilliance . 170 Rennaissant Ingenuity Uncover the machinery powering the printing press . 220 The Returned Cap'n Behold the true Captain Grisly in all her piratical glory. To obtain the inspiration, Grisly must be knocked out in the Blushing Mermaid's basement. The inspiration is granted once Ethel is permanently dead. If fighting Ethel's pawns before her, inspiration may not trigger. 220 Using the Proper Means Find and use the Torch of Revocation . Obtainable only if Oskar Fevras was saved from the Zhentarim Basement in Act One . Rivington 170 A Grand Prize! Figure out Akabi's scheme and obtain the 'grand' prize. Pickpocket the Djinni Ring from Akabi and then win the jackpot. The inspiration is granted after Akabi awards you the "prize". Bards have an option to win the game without pickpocketing the djinni. 135 Assistant to the Extra-Planar Agent Take up Valeria's serial killer investigation. The party must offer their help to Sister Yannis in the Open Hand Temple after Valeria leaves. Shared with ⁠ Drama Sleuth and ⁠ Trusting Your Instincts inspirations 135 Knowledge of the Heart Get a fresh perspective on your relationship with a companion. Get the best possible outcome from Zethino's relationship quiz. [ 4 ] The Sage character is not necessarily either the one taking the quiz or their romantic partner. Upper City 220 Stopping the Repetition of History Defeat Lorroakan . 220 The Karsus of Our Times Give Nightsong to Lorroakan. Wyrm's Crossing 135 New Normal Let yourself be scanned by a Steel Watcher . The inspiration can be obtained only at the South Span Checkpoint when first interacting with a Steel Watcher. If the party gain access to the Wyrm's Crossing by any means of bypass, it cannot be gained anymore. Wyrm's Rock Fortress 170 Coronation of the Dreadmaster Meet Gortash in Wyrm's Rock and witness his coronation. Shared with ⁠ Personal Invitation inspiration. 170 Crossing's Namesake Find the undying sentinel underneath Wyrm's Crossing. Granted after interacting with the wyrm in The Wyrmway . 170 Heavy is the Head Find the Helm of Balduran . Shared with ⁠ Great Helm of Legends inspiration. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ 1.00 1.01 1.02 1.03 1.04 1.05 1.06 1.07 1.08 1.09 1.10 1.11 1.12 1.13 1.14 This goal is linked to interacting with a specific item. The item can be stored and used strategically at any location and time for an 'on-demand' inspiration point, provided that a character with the Sage background (such as Gale) is in the party. ## Soldier
- **来源**: [Soldier](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Soldier)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Soldier is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around war and masterful combat. Lae'zel , Jaheira , and the hireling Varanna Sunblossom have this background. “ You are trained in battlefield tactics and combat, having served in a militia, mercenary company, or officer corps. Show smart tactics and bravery on the battlefield to enhance your prowess. „ Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Athletics Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Strength ( Athletics ) Ability Checks . Intimidation Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Charisma ( Intimidation ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description General Anywhere 25 One For The Ages Survive a fight in which you kill ten or more enemies. Summoned creatures that disappear when their summoner dies count toward this. 25 Pentacrush Kill 5 enemies in a single turn. 25 Strategist Defeat a powerful foe in one strike. Act 1 Emerald Grove 20 No One Left Behind Ensure all of the Grove's defenders survive the first goblin assault. Aradin , Barth , and Remira must survive the initial fight at the ramparts Kanon dying in the prior cutscene does not prevent getting this. 20 To Arms! Help Guex learn to fight. The interacting party member must succeed an Athletics or an Insight check, or use any available Class-based/Race-based options. The Soldier character is not necessary the one to pass the checks Goblin Camp 25 A Headless Horde Kill every leader in the goblin camp. Dror Ragzlin , Gut , and Minthara are the relevant leaders. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Slaughter's Prize and ⁠ Guardian of the Forgotten inspirations. Mountain Pass 30 Conquer the Conquerors Defeat the Githyanki raiding squad . Requires actually fighting them; a peaceful resolution does not grant inspiration. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Silver Blades, Silver Tongue inspiration. Risen Road 30 Chain of Command Follow Flaming Fist orders at the burning inn . This is earned after knocking down the door. 30 Warrior of the Hells Kill the cultist leader seeking Karlach . Underdark 30 Drowned in the Dark Defeat the duergar patrolling on the Ebonlake. Act 2 Gauntlet of Shar 75 Know Thine Enemy Defeat yourself in the Gauntlet of Shar 's mirror trial. Shared with ⁠ Self-Flagellation inspiration. 75 Return to Sender Kill the orthon , returning him to Raphael . 75 Soldier of Faith Save and release Nightsong. Shared with ⁠ Cerimonia Alārum , ⁠ Damsel No More , ⁠ Soldier of Fortune , and ⁠ Good Deed of the Day inspirations. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Blood Moon , ⁠ Cerimonia Compedum , and ⁠ Soldier of Fortune inspirations. 75 Soldier of Fortune Give Nightsong to Ketheric . Allow Balthazar to transport Nightsong from the Shadowfell. Shared with ⁠ Cerimonia Compedum inspiration. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Blood Moon , ⁠ Cerimonia Alārum , ⁠ Damsel No More , ⁠ Soldier of Faith , and ⁠ Good Deed of the Day inspirations. Last Light Inn 75 Absolute Devastation Destroy Last Light. The party must remove the lunar protective shield around the Last Light Inn, either killing or knocking out Isobel. 50 Shield of the Moon Obtain Selûne's blessing from Isobel. Moonrise Towers 95 A Bone To Pick Overcome the skeletons in Moonrise prison during the assault. 75 Devastation of the Absolute Complete the assault on Moonrise. 50 Notched Armour Show off your prowess to the bugbear merchant . Shared with ⁠ Uncommon Recognition inspiration. Reithwin Town 60 An Apple a Day Keeps the Scalpel Away Defeat the Surgeon without being operated upon. Shared with ⁠ Under the Knife inspiration. Also shared with ⁠ The Best Offence is Virtually Nonsense , if that one was not obtained earlier. 60 Familicide Kill all members of the Thorm family. This includes only Gerringothe , Malus , and Thisobald . Shared with ⁠ Power Corrupts... Absolutely inspiration. 60 The Best Offence is Virtually Nonsense Defeat a member of the Thorm family without drawing steel. Gerringothe , Malus , and Thisobald can each be eliminated via a series of skill checks. Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Centennial Rivalries Complete the Harper ambush . 75 Masterful Execution Kill any of the bosses in and around the Shadow-Cursed Lands in a single round of combat. 50 Realities of War Tell Arabella what happened to her parents. Act 3 Bhaal Temple 220 Putting the Past to Rest Execute Orin . Shared with ⁠ Securing Your Line inspiration. House of Hope 220 Hot Exit Escape the House of Hope . Shared with ⁠ Interplanar Cat Burglar inspiration. Lower City 220 Double-Tap Kill Auntie Ethel ... again... Shared with ⁠ Re-tasting the Kill and ⁠ Estrangement of Ethel inspirations. 170 Innovations in Volatility Give your blood to Araj a second time. 220 Kicking the Rust Bucket Destroy a Steel Watcher. Shared with ⁠ Down with the Steel Oppressors! inspiration. 220 Knives in the Dark Survive the confrontation in the Sharran Cloister . 135 Love That Smell Aid the deep gnomes and use the Runepowder Bomb to blow up the Steel Watch Foundry . Shared with ⁠ A Foul and Awesome Display and ⁠ A Massacre Beyond Imagining inspirations. 170 Urgent Communications Commune with the Netherbrain . Talk to Edenosa after the ambush in the park. If Edenosa was killed in the fight, talking to Fist Griff (a replacement NPC) instead does not give the inspiration. 170 Veteran's Hotspot Purchase a room at the Elfsong Tavern . Shared with ⁠ Proper Lodging, Finally⁠ , ⁠ For Once, a Warm Meal , and ⁠ Perks of the Trade inspirations (the latter if a discount was gained). Rivington 135 Removing Chaotic Actors Remove the head of the deep gnome insurrectionists . This requires saving Wulbren from Moonrise Towers , but then killing him as part of Deal with the Gnomes . Shared with ⁠ Buyable Loyalty inspiration. 135 Reporting for Duty Report to Commander Lightfeather . Shared with ⁠ Enlisted Avian inspiration. 135 Sharing the Spoils Donate to the refugees. Shared with ⁠ Alms for the Unfortunate , ⁠ Sharing the Spoils , ⁠ Spare What You Can , ⁠ Food for the Soul , and ⁠ Gifts of the Wilds inspirations. Upper City 220 Rudolph Van Richtover My Dead Body Defeat the Ascended Cazador . Obtaining this inspiration means losing Astarion as a companion permanently , as Cazador sacrifices him to ascend. Wyrm's Rock Fortress 170 Court Marshall Expose the Flaming Fist deserter . ## Urchin
- **来源**: [Urchin](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Urchin)
- **分类**: Backgrounds

Urchin is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around street smarts. The hireling Maddala Deadeye has this background. “ After surviving a poor and bleak childhood, you know how to make the most out of very little. Using your street smarts bolsters your spirit for the journey ahead. „ Contents 1 Background features 2 Background goals 3 Inactive Background Goals 4 Notes Background features [ edit section | visual editor ] Sleight of Hand Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Dexterity ( Sleight of Hand ) Ability Checks . Stealth Proficiency : Gain Proficiency with Dexterity ( Stealth ) Ability Checks . Background goals [ edit section | visual editor ] Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration . These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points. Location XP Reward Name Description Act 1 Multiple locations 20 Hunger Never Fades Fill your plate at Raphael's House of Hope . On the first introduction cutscene, choose the option Ignore him and fill your plate. Blighted Village 20 Pyramid Scheme Convince the ogres to work for you without giving them gold. Shared with ⁠ Creatures of Bloodlust and ⁠ Bodyguards for Hire inspirations. Emerald Grove 20 Artful Dodger Earn Mattis' respect by taking his ring. The interacting party member must pass a DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check (DC 10 with Advantage for Rogues ). Shared with ⁠ Made You Look inspiration. 20 Family Comes First Encourage Meli to tell the truth about the amulet. Mutually exclusive with ⁠ Protect Your Own . 20 Idolatry Help Mol steal the Idol of Silvanus . Shared with ⁠ Heretic . 20 Not On My Watch Save Arabella from Kagha and her serpent . This is earned as soon as Arabella safely runs away. Shared with ⁠ Snake Whisperer inspiration. 20 Paying It Forward Give Mol money to found a guild in Baldur's Gate. Saving or helping tiefling childen in the Grove eventually leads to this option. The party must find out about the kids' thievery spree (either witness Meli stealing from Barth or let themselves be robbed by Mattis and Silfy ) [ 1 ] , then find a way into the Tiefling Hideout and speak with Mol . ## Aid
- **来源**: [Aid](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Aid)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Aid is a level 2 abjuration spell . It allows spellcasters to heal and embolden their allies and themselves with resolve. Affected creatures have their maximum Hit Points increased for the duration of the spell. Description Bolster your allies with toughness and resolve to heal and increase their Hit Points maximum. Properties Cost Action + Level 2 Spell Slot Details Range: Self AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Radius At higher levels Upcasting : Casting this spell at a higher level increases the target's maximum health by an additional 5 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points for each spell slot level above 2nd. Technical details UID Shout_Aid Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Condition: Aid Aid Duration: Until Long rest Hit point maximum increased by 5 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Hit point maximum increases by a further 5 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points for every Spell Slot Level above 2 used. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Cleric and Life Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 5: Paladin Other ways to learn: Wizards cannot transcribe a Scroll of Aid to their spellbooks. Notes Downed allies return back to the fight and heal an additional 1 hit point. The Aid condition remains even if the caster is removed from the party. Given the persistence of both the Aid condition and the increased hit points it bestows (see below), it may be useful – particularly at higher levels – to have companions disguised and grouped together so an upcast version of this spell can be applied to all four intended active party members. The increase to maximum hit points from this spell is distinct from temporary hit points . Specifically, these hit points can be replenished with normal healing while temporary hit points cannot. Aid can stack with any single source of temporary hit points while sources of temporary hit points cannot stack with each other. Alternate versions granted by items: Khalid's Gift: Aid from Khalid's Gift and equivalent to Aid at 3rd level ( Recharge: Long rest ) Shield of Devotion: Aid from Shield of Devotion and equivalent to Aid at 3rd level ( Recharge: Long rest ) Absolute's Talisman: Aid from Absolute's Talisman and equivalent to Aid at 2nd level ( Recharge: Long rest ) When granted from an item, it only affects the wearer. This is the only healing spell available to player characters that affects Undead and Constructs . If cast by a Paladin or Cleric (non-Life Domain), this spell must remain Prepared ; removing Aid from the caster's Prepared Spells removes the buff from all party members whom the caster applied Aid to, reverting their Maximum HP to its normal amount. If applied by using a scroll , the caster need not keep this spell Prepared to maintain the buff. Multiple casts of Aid do not stack; the most recently cast instance takes precedence. Despite the tool tip saying the spell heals the caster and their allies, the spell does not benefit from or trigger any items or class features that boost or interact with healing, such as Disciple of Life or Ring of Salving , unless the target is at 0 HP. The incantations for Aid are Vita Excolatur ( "Life is elevated" ) and Dum Vita Est Spes Est ( "Where there is life, there is hope" ). ## Animate Dead
- **来源**: [Animate Dead](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Animate_Dead)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Animate Dead is a level 3 necromancy spell . It allows spellcasters to animate a corpse to create an undead servant. Description Animate a corpse to create an undead servant while not in combat. The target must be a Medium or Small corpse. Properties Cost Action + Level 3 Spell Slot Details Range: 3 m (10 ft) At higher levels When the spell is cast at 4th Level, raise up to 3 Skeletons or Zombies instead of 1. When the spell is cast at 5th Level, raise a Ghoul or Flying Ghoul . When the spell is cast at 6th Level, raise up to 3 Ghouls or Flying Ghouls instead of 1. Technical details UID Target_AnimateDead Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsLinkedSpellContainer , IsSpell Variants Animate Dead: Skeleton Animate Dead: Zombie Animate Dead: Skeleton Squad Animate Dead: Zombie Battalion Animate Dead: Ghoul Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul Animate Dead: Ghoul Pack Animate Dead: Flying Ghoul Flock How to learn Classes: Class level 5: Cleric , Wizard , Circle of the Spores (Circle Spell), Warlock (via Pact of the Tome once per long rest), and Death Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets ) and Necromancer (via Necromancy School ) Class level 9: Oathbreaker (Oath Spell) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Granted by items: Circle of Bones ( Recharge: Long rest ) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 3 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Animate Dead to their spellbooks. Notes Each individual caster can only have one active instance of this spell at once, no matter which version is used. Casting it again while an undead summons is already present dismisses the previous one. Wizards with the Necromancy School subclass can raise an additional undead for each level and version of the spell. None of these summoned undead have melee weapons, so they are not affected by Aura of Hate from Oathbreaker Paladin. A Sorcerer may apply Twinned Spell on a casting of Animate Dead from a Scroll, but only one creature is raised; the other is immediately destroyed as if the caster had cast two instances, wasting Sorcery Points in the process. If the caster unprepares this spell, the summoned undead will remain. As of Patch 8, corpses can be reused for animate dead. [ verify ] Bugs When selecting between variants, the controller UI incorrectly indicates that the spell targets three corpses by default. Visuals Play Video Local File https://bg3.wiki/wiki/File:Animate_Dead_Visuals.mp4 External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Animate dead on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
## Animate Dead (Balthazar)
- **来源**: [Animate Dead (Balthazar)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Animate_Dead_(Balthazar))
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

This article is about a special variant of the spell unique to Balthazar. For other uses, see Animate Dead (disambiguation) . Animate Dead is a level 6 necromancy spell . This a unique variant of Animate Dead that is cast by Balthazar when fought in Nightsong's Prison . When cast, this spell reanimates the many surrounding piles of bones into an army of skeletons. It cannot be learned by party members. Description Awaken the dead from their century-long slumber. Properties Cost Action + Level 6 Spell Slot Details Range: 22 m (73 ft) At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_SHA_Necromancer_ReclaimControl Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Creature: Zombie STR 16 (+3) DEX 6 (-2) CON 16 (+3) INT 3 (-4) WIS 6 (-2) CHA 5 (-3) Hit Points 22 Armour Class 8 Slam ( ) Hit a target with your bare fists. How to learn Used by creatures: Balthazar Notes Balthazar will always cast this spell at the first available opportunity. Each pile of bones will reanimate into one of the following: Apostate Defender , Apostate Sentinel , Apostate Destroyer , Apostate Librarian . The outcome for each pile of bones is fixed and predetermined. If a pile of bones is moved, the spawn point for the linked creature is moved to the same location. This can be abused by stacking multiple piles of bones on top of each other to make spawn points overlap, allowing multiple opponents to be damaged or killed quickly with area effect spells or pushing abilities like Thunderwave .

## Armour of Agathys
- **来源**: [Armour of Agathys](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Armour_of_Agathys)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Armour of Agathys is a level 1 abjuration spell . It allows spellcasters to create a spectral armour of frost that covers the caster and their equipment. This armour provides additional Hit Points to the caster and damages hostile targets while the added hit points are present. Description Gain 5 temporary hit points and deal 5 ⁠ ⁠ Cold damage to any creature that hits you with a melee attack. Can only have Temporary Hit Points from one source. Properties Cost Action + Level 1 Spell Slot Damage: 5 5 ⁠ Cold (When hit by a melee attack) Details Range: Self At higher levels Upcasting : Gain an additional 5 temporary hit points and deal an additional 5 ⁠ Cold damage per level. Technical details UID Shout_ArmorOfAgathys Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Condition: Armour of Agathys Armour of Agathys Duration: Until Long rest Gained 5 × spell level temporary hit points . If hit with a melee attack, the attacker takes 5 × spell level ⁠ ⁠ Cold damage. This effect ends when the temporary hit points are lost. How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Warlock and Draconic Bloodline (White/Cold Ancestry) Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets ) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Warlock Granted by items: Icebite Robe ( Recharge: Long rest ) Other ways to learn: There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Scroll of Armour of Agathys has been entirely removed from the game. Notes The temporary hit points from Symbiotic Entity can be used to increase the temporary hit points from Armour of Agathys if the former are higher than the latter. Otherwise, most sources of temporary hit points treat this spell like any other source of temporary hit points: If they are lower than the maximum hit points granted by Armor of Agathys, they do nothing. If they are higher than the maximum hit points granted by Armor of Agathys, they replace the temporary hit points and end Armor of Agathys. The incantation for Armour of Agathys is Mactē Virtutē , the Latin command "honour with virtue!" If cast via Icebite Robe , the spell ends if Icebite Robe is unequipped. Bugs When upcast to either spell slot level 3 or 4, the tooltip description incorrectly references the condition applied via the spell slot level 1 version. Barkskin is a level 2 transmutation spell . It allows spellcasters to fortify the defense of a willing creature and increase their Armour Class . While under the effect of this spell, the target's skin has a bark-like texture. Description Touch a willing creature to toughen its skin and increase its Armour Class up to 16. Properties Cost Action + Level 2 Spell Slot Details Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Concentration At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_Barkskin Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsConcentration , IsMelee , IsSpell Condition: Barkskin Barkskin Duration: Until Long rest Armour Class increased to 16. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Druid , Nature Domain (Domain Spell), and Circle of the Land (Forest) Class level 5: Ranger Other ways to learn: There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Scroll of Barkskin has been entirely removed from the game. Notes If the recipient's Armour Class is lower than 16, Barkskin changes it to 16 with no other bonuses allowed from any source. Mage Armour , Draconic Resilience , Unarmoured Defence (Barbarian) , Unarmoured Defence (Monk) and Barkskin all change base armour class; their benefits do not stack. If the recipient has multiple instances of these, they receive the benefit of that which provides the most Armour Class . Barkskin can work while in Wild Shape . This effect only works on forms with an Armour Class of less than 16. The incantation for Barkskin is Mactē Virtutē , the Latin command "Honour with virtue!" Bless is a level 1 enchantment spell . It allows spellcasters to temporarily bolster themselves and their allies’ attacks and saving throws. Description Bless up to 3 creatures. They gain a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws . Properties Cost Action + Level 1 Spell Slot Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Targets: 3 non-hostile creatures Concentration At higher levels Upcasting : Affects an additional target for each spell slot level above 1st. Technical details UID Target_Bless Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IgnorePreviouslyPickedEntities , IsConcentration , IsSpell Condition: Bless Bless Duration: 10 turns Gains a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws . How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Cleric and Life Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 2: Paladin Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets ) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Cleric Granted by items: Staff of Arcane Blessing ( Recharge: Long rest ) Other ways to learn: There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Scroll of Bless has been entirely removed from the game. Notes A similar effect (without the visuals), Sweet Stone Features can be obtained permanently by purchasing a statue of the character from Boney in the Circus of the Last Days . If a character wears The Whispering Promise ring, they will also Bless any creature(s) they heal through any Healing action (including non-Spell actions and self-healing). Although this version of Bless only lasts for 2 turns, it does not require Concentration . The incantation for Bless is Mactē Virtutē , Latin for "with great virtue" . ## Blight
- **来源**: [Blight](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Blight)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

For the race of plant-like creatures, see Blight (race) . Blight is a level 4 necromancy spell . It allows spellcasters to drain the moisture and vitality from a target creature using necromantic energy. It is especially effective versus plants. Description Deals 8d8 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage to a target. Plants take maximum damage from this spell, and have Disadvantage on the Saving Throw against it. No effect on undead and constructs. Properties Cost Action + Level 4 Spell Slot Damage: 8~64 8d8 ⁠ Necrotic ( 64 ⁠ Necrotic against plants) Details CON Save ( Spell save DC ) (On Save: Target still takes half damage.) Range: 9 m (30 ft) At higher levels Upcasting : Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage for each spell slot level above 4th. Technical details UID Target_Blight Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell How to learn Classes: Class level 7: Druid , Sorcerer , Warlock , Wizard , Circle of the Spores (Circle Spell), and Death Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Granted by items: Woe ( Recharge: Long rest ) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 4 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Blight to their spellbooks. Notes There are very few plants in the game. By the time this spell is obtained, the party is likely in Act Two , where all plants are resistant to necrotic damage, reducing the maximum possible damage. However, at level 6, a Death Domain Cleric's Inescapable Destruction allows this spell to ignore resistance. Even with the necrotic resistance of Act Two plants, Blight mathematically remains one of the most effective means of damaging these plants. The incantation for Blight is Perē , the Latin command "Vanish/be destroyed!" Delverdenn , Limeleech and Viconia DeVir have access to a unique level 5 variant of this spell which can target constructs and undead . Bugs This spell lacks an IsHarmful spell flag , and as such is able to target creatures affected by Sanctuary . When cast at spell slot level 4 against a non-plant enemy that fails the saving throw, Blight incorrectly deals non-magical damage. Visuals Play Video Local File https://bg3.wiki/wiki/File:Blight_Visuals.mp4 External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Blight (spell) on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

## Blindness
- **来源**: [Blindness](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Blindness)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Blindness is a level 2 necromancy spell . It allows spellcasters to magically Blind a targeted hostile creature. Description Limit a foe's sight range. It is easier to hit, and the creature will miss more often. Attack Rolls against it have Advantage and the foe attacks with Disadvantage . Properties Cost Action + Level 2 Spell Slot Details CON Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels Upcasting : Affects an additional target for each spell slot level above 2nd. Technical details UID Target_Blindness Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , HasVerbalComponent , IsHarmful , IsSpell Condition: Blindness Blindness Duration: 10 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls . Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft). Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have Advantage . At the end of each turn, the affected creature rolls a Constitution Saving Throw against the Spell Save DC of the caster. If successful, the condition is removed. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Bard , Cleric , Sorcerer , Wizard , The Fiend , Circle of the Spores (Circle Spell), and Death Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 8: Arcane Trickster and Eldritch Knight Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 2 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Blindness to their spellbooks. Notes See also Blind Immunity . Blindness is one of a relatively small number of spells that can apply a disabling effect without requiring Concentration be maintained. The incantation for Blindness is Caeco Te , Latin for "I blind you" . Bugs Upcast versions of this spell gain the ability to target multiple creatures, but as the spell lacks the SpellFlag IgnorePreviouslyPickedEntities the same creature can be selected multiple times, requiring a saving throw for each time they are selected. ## Blink
- **来源**: [Blink](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Blink)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Blink is a level 3 transmutation spell . It allows the spellcaster to travel to the Ethereal Plane, unassailable and unseen until they return. Description At the end of your turn, roll a  d20. On 11 or higher, you vanish into the Ethereal Plane. While there, you can't be harmed or seen in this world. When you do vanish, your presence here is a representation of the location you'll come back to. You can choose to teleport it up to 6 m (20 ft). Available only in combat. Properties Cost Action + Level 3 Spell Slot Details Range: Self At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Shout_Blink Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Condition: Blink Blink Duration: 10 turns At the end of each turn, there is a chance the affected entity gets Blinked to the Ethereal Plane , where it can't be harmed, seen or affected. While in the Ethereal Plane , the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can only choose to teleport up to 6 m (20 ft). When combat ends, so does this effect. Condition: Blinked to the Ethereal Plane Blinked to the Ethereal Plane Duration: Until end of combat Affected entity is in the Ethereal Plane , where it can't be harmed, seen, or affected. While in the Ethereal Plane, the entity can't move or interact with anything in the world. It can choose to teleport up to 6 m (20 ft). At the end of each turn, there is a chance it reappears in the Material Plane. When combat ends, so does this effect. Immune to Bleeding . How to learn Classes: Class level 5: Sorcerer , Wizard , The Archfey , and The Hexblade Granted by items: Ring of Blink ( Recharge: Long rest ) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 3 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Blink to their spellbooks. Bugs Despite purposely ignoring the functor which breaks Concentration , a StatusGroup error still breaks Concentration when vanishing. When vanishing into the Ethereal Plane, equipped items are temporarily disabled. This causes item technical statuses that include OnRemoveFunctors (such as those used by Markoheshkir ) to trigger, removing any effects provided by those items. Bolts of Doom is a level 4 evocation spell . It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of lightning and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir . Description Embrace Kereska's lightning bolts to gain resistance to ⁠ Lightning damage. Your lightning spells deal additional ⁠ Lightning damage equal to your proficiency bonus . When you deal spell damage, gain 2 [ See Notes ] Lightning Charges . While attuned to Kereska's lightning you can cast Chain Lightning and Lightning Bolt once each per short rest . Chain Lightning ( ) Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Short rest .) Lightning Bolt ( ) Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Short rest .) Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Recharge: Short rest At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Shout_MAG_TheChromatic_LightningAttunement Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Condition: Crackling with Kereska's Lightning Crackling with Kereska's Lightning Duration: Until Long rest Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Lightning damage. Its lightning spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it gains 2 Lightning Charges . While attuned to Kereska's lightning, it can cast Chain Lightning at 6th level and Lightning Bolt at 3rd level once per short rest. How to learn Granted by items: Markoheshkir This spell is a variation of: Kereska's Favour Notes The version of Chain Lightning granted by this spell can still be used with Metamagic: Twinned Spell even though the normal version no longer can. The in-game tooltip says this effect grants 1 Lightning Charge, but it actually grants 2. This is the only variant of Kereska's Favour that grants a 6th level spell. All other spells granted are cast at 5th level at most.

Bone-shaking Thunder is a level 4 evocation spell . It is a variant of Kereska's Favour that allows its caster to imbue themselves with the power of thunder and unlock resistances and spells associated with it. It is granted by Markoheshkir . Description Embrace Kereska's thunder to gain resistance to ⁠ Thunder damage. Your thunder spells deal additional ⁠ Thunder damage equal to your proficiency bonus . When you deal spell damage, inflict 2 turns [ See Notes ] of Reverberation upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's thunder you can cast Shatter and Destructive Wave once each per short rest . Shatter ( ) Cast as a level 5 spell ( Recharge: Short rest .) Destructive Wave ( ) Cast as a level 5 spell ( Recharge: Short rest .) Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Recharge: Short rest At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Shout_MAG_TheChromatic_ThunderAttunement Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Condition: Rumbling with Kereska's Thunder Rumbling with Kereska's Thunder Duration: Until Long rest Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Thunder damage. Its thunder spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of Reverberation upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's thunder, it can cast Shatter and Destructive Wave at 5th level once per short rest. How to learn Granted by items: Markoheshkir This spell is a variation of: Kereska's Favour Notes The in-game tooltip says this effect inflicts 1 turn of Reverberation, but it actually inflicts 2 turns. Applying Reverberation can only occur once per attack. A spell hitting multiple targets like Shatter will only apply the condition to a single target. Bugs The version of Destructive Wave granted by this condition still displays the individual variant spells ( Destructive Wave: Necrotic / Destructive Wave: Radiant ) as costing a Level 5 Spell Slot . Though no actual spell slot cost is incurred by the caster, these variants will still activate effects which trigger when spending spell slots.
## Booming Blade
- **来源**: [Booming Blade](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Booming_Blade)
- **分类**: Spells、Cantrips、Actions

Booming Blade is a cantrip (Evocation) . It allows the caster to strike with their melee weapon, dealing further damage if the target moves afterwards. Description Strike with your weapon, afflicting your foe with a resonance that hurts them for 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder when they move. This spell can be cast while you are Silenced . Requires proficiency with the equipped weapon Properties Cost Action Damage: 1~8 Normal weapon damage + 1d8 ⁠ Thunder (When the target moves) Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Per action At higher levels At character level 5, the damage increases to Damage: 3~24 Normal weapon damage + 1d8 ⁠ Thunder + 2d8 ⁠ Thunder (When the target moves) At character level 11, the damage increases to Damage: 5~40 Normal weapon damage + 2d8 ⁠ Thunder + 3d8 ⁠ Thunder (When the target moves) Technical details UID Target_BoomingBlade_ClassSpell Spell flags IsDefaultWeaponAction , IsHarmful , IsMelee , IsSpell Condition: Booming Blade Booming Blade Duration: 1 turn Affected entity will take 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage when it moves. How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Sorcerer , Wizard , and Warlock Class level 3: Arcane Trickster and Eldritch Knight Races: Character level 1: High Elf and High Half-Elf ( Character level is the sum of all class levels for a multi-classed character.) Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer Magic Initiate: Warlock Magic Initiate: Wizard Other ways to learn: There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Notes Since this cantrip uses a weapon attack roll, it qualifies for Extra Attack . Whenever the caster could make a normal melee attack, this cantrip can be cast instead; although it is limited to one cast per action. Receiving Extra Attack via the Sentinel: Vengeance passive on a character who has already begun their turn will allow that character to attack once with Booming Blade, and then again by using an Action, circumventing the one cast per action restriction. Unlike every other cantrip in the game, Booming Blade receives its final upgrade at level 11, not level 10. Because its damage includes weapon's damage, this spell allows to trigger effects that care about spell damage type (e.g., Poisoner's Robe , Mourning Frost ) with weapon damage. Booming Blade causes Diadem of Arcane Synergy to grant Arcane Synergy as it inflicts a condition. It also triggers the Ring of Arcane Synergy by virtue of being a damage-dealing cantrip. Bugs Though it is not displayed in its description, Booming Blade can be cast while Silenced . This cantrip is not correctly classified as a ⁠ Thunder spell so it does not work with the following effects: Bone-shaking Thunder Destructive Wrath Elemental Adept: Thunder Heart of the Storm: Thunder Necklace of Elemental Augmentation Ring of Absolute Force Prophecy: Thunderous Applause Some other elemental effects are implemented differently and work with the ⁠ Thunder damage Booming Blade receives at level 5. These effects include: Boots of Elemental Momentum Gloves of Belligerent Skies Hat of Storm Scion's Power Ring of Elemental Infusion Due to an additional bug, these items do not work in Honour mode unless the weapon itself deals elemental damage (e.g., from Elemental Weapon or any innate elemental damage bonus). ## Branding Smite
- **来源**: [Branding Smite](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Branding_Smite)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions、Bonus_actions

See also: Legacy of Avernus: Branding Smite Branding Smite is a level 2 evocation spell . It allows spellcasters to cause their weapon to gleam with astral radiance, allowing them to mark targets with light, preventing them from turning Invisible . Description Your weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike and possibly mark your targets with light, preventing it from turning Invisible . Properties Cost Action Cost on hit Bonus Action + Level 2 Spell Slot Damage: 2~12 Normal weapon damage + 2d6 ⁠ Radiant Details Attack Roll Range: Normal weapon range Concentration At higher levels Deals an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant damage per level. Technical details UID Target_Smite_Branding_Container Spell flags HasVerbalComponent , IsConcentration , IsHarmful , IsLinkedSpellContainer , IsMelee , IsSpell Variants Branding Smite (Melee) Branding Smite (Ranged) Condition: Branding Smite Branding Smite Duration: 10 turns Cannot turn Invisible . How to learn Classes: Class level 3: The Hexblade Class level 5: Paladin Notes See Smite for additional functionality information. This spell, unlike most other Smite spells, works with ranged weaponry. Zariel tieflings get a special version called Legacy of Avernus: Branding Smite that can only be cast once per Long Rest , but doesn't consume a spell slot on hit. This spell differs from Branding Smite (Melee) in that it has a small 1 m (3 ft) radius in which it can be used to target the ground and still cause damage and apply Branding Smite to a single target which may be Invisible and thus not directly targetable. Bugs Branding Smite cast with a Level 4 Spell Slot incorrectly lists tooltip damage using the Level 2 Spell Slot of the spell. The spell container for Branding Smite does not correctly display the current spell slot level for Warlocks. This spell lacks a restriction against targeting items, and due to the small radius and its target limit of 1 it is possible to target a creature but have Branding Smite applied to an item within the radius. ## Bursting Sinew
- **来源**: [Bursting Sinew](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Bursting_Sinew)
- **分类**: Spells、Cantrips、Actions

Bursting Sinew is a cantrip (Necromancy) . It allows the caster to detonate a corpse into a small AoE of damage. Description Explode a corpse, causing it to impale those around it. Properties Cost Action Damage: 1~10 1d10 ⁠ Piercing ( Dexterity Saving Throw to negate) Details DEX Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) AoE: 3 m (10 ft) Radius Targets: 1 fresh corpse At higher levels At character level 5, the damage increases to 2d10 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing . At character level 10, the damage increases to 3d10 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing . Technical details UID Target_BurstingSinew Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsHarmful , IsSpell How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Cleric , Sorcerer , Wizard , and Death Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 3: Eldritch Knight and Arcane Trickster Races: Character level 1: High Elf and High Half-Elf ( Character level is the sum of all class levels for a multi-classed character.) Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Cleric Magic Initiate: Sorcerer Magic Initiate: Wizard Other ways to learn: There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Notes The damage is considered non-magical so creatures resistant to non-magical piercing damage take only half damage. The corpse cannot be an ooze , plant , construct , or elemental . Any other creature type works. The corpse must be "fresh". This is the same criteria as for Speak with Dead . If killed where the final form of damage is by ⁠ Fire , ⁠ Radiant , or ⁠ Acid , the corpse is unusable with Speak with Dead and also this cantrip. After using this spell, the target corpse is reduced to a pile of viscera which cannot be reused for this spell nor reanimated with spells like Animate Dead . With the Death Domain Cleric feature, Reaper , this cantrip can be twin cast on two separate corpses at once. If the area of effects overlap, creatures in the overlap take damage from both explosions. It is one of the only area of effect spells that can be twin cast. This cantrip cannot be twin cast by Sorcerers using Metamagic: Twinned Spell .
## Call Lightning
- **来源**: [Call Lightning](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Call_Lightning)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Call Lightning is a level 3 conjuration spell . It allows spellcasters to call down lightning to hit all targets within the area of effect. The spellcaster can also call down lightning repeatedly on subsequent turns. Description Lightning strikes all targets within the area of effect for 3d10 ⁠ ⁠ Lightning damage. Then for 10 turns, you can call down lightning again without expending a spell slot. Properties Cost Action + Level 3 Spell Slot Damage: 3~30 3d10 ⁠ Lightning Details DEX Save (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) Range: 18 m (60 ft) AoE: 2 m (7 ft) Radius Concentration At higher levels Upcasting : When the spell is cast using a 4th-level spell slot or higher, it deals an additional 1d10 ⁠ ⁠ Lightning damage for each spell slot level above 3rd for the initial casting and all granted free casts. Technical details UID Target_CallLightning Spell flags CanAreaDamageEvade , HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsConcentration , IsSpell Grants: Activate Call Lightning Condition: Call Lightning Call Lightning Duration: 10 turns Can Call Lightning without expending a spell slot . How to learn Classes: Class level 5: Druid , Tempest Domain , Circle of the Land (Coast or Forest), and Warlock (via Pact of the Tome once per long rest) Class level 6: Storm Sorcery and College of Lore (Magical Secrets) Class level 10: Bard (Magical Secrets) Used by creatures: Halsin and Harvard Willoughby (Nature's Vengeance) Notes Call Lightning is a recastable spell , and can be used without spending another spell slot so long as Concentration is not broken. All free recasts will match the level of the initial casting. For example, if the spell is initially upcast to 6th level, dealing 6d10 damage, all subsequent recasts will also deal 6d10. Free recasts can be placed in different locations than the initial casting. Activate Call Lightning is the "granted spell" given to the caster after the initial casting and can be used to recast the spell. Granted spells such as this are not directly tied to the caster's known spells (i.e., their spellbook icon in the game). Therefore, if a granted spell (in this case, Activate Call Lightning ) is cast when multiclassed, it uses the spellcasting modifier of the most recently acquired class rather than the spellcasting modifier that was used for the initial casting of Call Lightning. In this case, it may result in an unexpectedly low spell save DC. The incantation for Call Lightning is Perurē , the Latin command "Burn/scorch!" ## Chain Lightning
- **来源**: [Chain Lightning](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Chain_Lightning)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Chain Lightning is a level 6 evocation spell . It allows casters to create a bolt of lightning which strikes a target and chains to nearby enemies. Description Strike an enemy with lightning. Three more bolts will leap from the target, electrifying as many as three other enemies within range. Properties Cost Action + Level 6 Spell Slot Damage: 10~80 10d8 ⁠ Lightning Details DEX Save (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) Range: 18 m (60 ft) Targets: 1 primary target and 3 enemies within 18 m (60 ft) of the primary target At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Projectile_ChainLightning Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell How to learn Classes: Class level 11: Sorcerer and Wizard Granted by items: Markoheshkir ( Recharge: Short rest ) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 6 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Chain Lightning to their spellbooks. Notes Since Patch 6, Chain Lightning cannot be used with Metamagic: Twinned Spell . However, this restriction does not apply to the version of Chain Lightning granted by Markoheshkir . Characters under the effects of an Elixir of Bloodlust can use this spell to gain an additional action point by targeting the spell at an object. When the object "dies" and a living creature is then hit by the same effect, the game gives the caster an additional action for killing an enemy, as per the Elixir. This also works with Arrow of Many Targets . The DC of the saving throw to reduce damage from the lightning chains uses the spellcasting modifier of the most recently acquired spellcasting class, rather than the spellcasting modifier that was used for the initial casting of Chain Lightning. Bugs This spell lacks an IsHarmful spell flag , and as such is able to target creatures affected by Sanctuary . ## Cloudkill
- **来源**: [Cloudkill](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Cloudkill)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Cloudkill is a level 5 conjuration spell . It conjures a moveable cloud which damages and obscures everything it envelops. Description Craft a large cloud that inflicts 5d8 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage per turn. You can reposition the cloud every turn. The cloud Heavily Obscures everything within it. Properties Cost Action + Level 5 Spell Slot Damage: 5~40 5d8 ⁠ Poison ( Constitution Saving Throw to halve) Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) Creates Area: Cloudkill Concentration At higher levels Upcasting : Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage for each spell slot level above 5th. Technical details UID Target_Cloudkill Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsConcentration , IsHarmful , IsSpell , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold Area: Cloudkill Cloudkill Duration: 10 turns AoE: 6 m (20 ft) Radius Creatures who remain in the cloud take heavy poison damage. The cloud also heavily obscures what's in it. Type: Cloud Condition: Cloudkill Cloudkill Duration: Whilst on surface While it remains in the cloud, affected entity takes 5d8 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage every turn. How to learn Classes: Class level 9: Sorcerer , Wizard , Circle of the Spores (Circle Spell), Circle of the Land (Swamp and Underdark), and Death Domain (Domain Spell) Granted by items: Markoheshkir ( Recharge: Short rest ) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 5 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Cloudkill to their spellbooks. Notes Characters under the effects of Heroes' Feast are immune to this spell's damage Cloudkill is considered a "granted" condition not unlike that of a "granted" spell. Granted spells are issued to the caster after using the original, and can be can be recast without spending another spell slot as long as Concentration is not broken. This (10-turn) condition is not directly tied to the casters' repertoire of known spells (i.e., their spellbook icon in the game). Therefore, if a granted spell (or in this case, a granted condition) is used when multiclassing, subsequent re-uses (in this case, Cloudkill ) use the spellcasting modifier of the most recently acquired spellcasting class rather than the spellcasting modifier that was used for the initial casting of Cloudkill. In the case of this condition, it may result in an unexpectedly low spell save DC. When recast, Cloudkill only has a range of 9 m (30 ft). Bugs If upcast to level 6, Cloudkill creates an invisible cloud due to the surface lacking an attached particle effect. NPCs will not automatically leave this cloud, as its surface ID is missing from character PathInfluence . The cloud lasts for 10 turns starting from the last time it was recast instead of starting from the initial cast. This often leads to a situation where the caster no longer has the ability to recast Cloudkill, but both the Concentration effect and the cloud persist for longer than they would otherwise be expected to. ## Command
- **来源**: [Command](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Command)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Command is a level 1 enchantment spell . It allows spellcasters to order their target to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground, or drop their weapon. Description Command a creature to flee, move closer, freeze, drop to the ground or drop its weapon. The target must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw in order to resist the effects. No effect on undead. Properties Cost Action + Level 1 Spell Slot Details WIS Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels Upcasting : Affects an additional target for each spell slot level above 1st. Technical details UID Target_Command_Container Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IgnorePreviouslyPickedEntities , IsHarmful , IsLinkedSpellContainer , IsSpell Variants Command: Approach Command: Drop Command: Flee Command: Grovel Command: Halt How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Cleric , The Fiend , and Knowledge Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 2: Paladin Class level 3: Oath of the Crown (Oath Spell) Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets ) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Cleric Granted by items: Gauntlet of the Tyrant ( Recharge: Long rest ) Netherstone-Studded Gauntlet ( Recharge: Long rest ) Salty Scimitar(rrr) ( Recharge: Long rest ) Notes A creature will not obey a command that is directly harmful, such as Command: Approach through a damaging surface. However, a creature will obey indirectly harmful commands, such as Command: Approach causing Opportunity Attacks as the creature leaves the threat range of melee creatures. This can cause a creature to take massive damage when surrounded. Arguably one of the most useful spells in the game, this spell does not require concentration and can be used immediately, while on the Nautiloid in the Prologue – and throughout all three Acts of the game – to temporarily disable (most) opponents or force them to drop their weapon, often to highly advantageous effect. A sorcerer can double the length of Command using Metamagic: Extended Spell . Notably, targets are only given the chance to roll a saving throw when the spell is initially cast; if they fail, they are effectively disabled for two turns without the opportunity to roll again. External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Command on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

Cone of Cold is a level 5 evocation spell . It allows spellcasters to blast icy air into a region in front of them, damaging affected creatures and turning existing Water surfaces into Ice Surfaces . Description Make a flurry of frost, crisp air, and condensed snow crystals erupt from your hands. Properties Cost Action + Level 5 Spell Slot Damage: 8~64 8d8 ⁠ Cold Details CON Save (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) Range: Self AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Cone Creates Area: Ice At higher levels Upcasting : The damage is increased by 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Cold for each spell slot level above 5th. Technical details UID Zone_ConeOfCold Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsHarmful , IsSpell Area: Ice Ice AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Cone Difficult terrain - movement speed is halved and creatures may fall Prone. Type: Surface Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 1 turn DEX Save ( Spell save DC ) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. Condition: Difficult Terrain Difficult Terrain Duration: Whilst on surface Movement Speed halved How to learn Classes: Class level 9: Sorcerer , Wizard , The Fiend , The Hexblade , and Circle of the Land (Arctic) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Granted by items: Markoheshkir ( Recharge: Short rest ) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 5 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Cone of Cold to their spellbooks. ## Conjure Elemental
- **来源**: [Conjure Elemental](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Conjure_Elemental)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

This article is about the level 5 conjuration spell. For other uses, see Conjure Elemental (disambiguation) . Conjure Elemental is a level 5 conjuration spell . It allows spellcasters to summon a Fire, Earth, Water, or Air Elemental. Description Bend the barrier between the Planes until they disgorge an elemental ally to follow and fight for you. Properties Cost Action + Level 5 Spell Slot Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels At level 6, the spellcaster can summon an Air Myrmidon , Earth Myrmidon , Fire Myrmidon , or Water Myrmidon . Technical details UID Target_ConjureElemental_Container Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsLinkedSpellContainer , IsSpell Variants Conjure Elemental: Air Elemental Conjure Elemental: Earth Elemental Conjure Elemental: Fire Elemental Conjure Elemental: Water Elemental Conjure Elemental: Air Myrmidon Conjure Elemental: Earth Myrmidon Conjure Elemental: Fire Myrmidon Conjure Elemental: Water Myrmidon How to learn Classes: Class level 9: Wizard , Druid , and Circle of the Land (Coast and Mountain) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Other ways to learn: Warlocks who choose the Eldritch Invocation Minions of Chaos at level 9+ learn this spell. Wizards with a Level 5 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Conjure Elemental to their spellbooks. Notes Each individual caster can have only one active summon from this spell at a time. Casting it again while an Elemental or Myrmidon is already summoned replaces the existing one. This spell is independent of Conjure Minor Elemental . The same caster can have one instance of an Elemental or Myrmidon and a Minor Elemental active simultaneously. The scroll version of the spell is cast at level 5 and as a result can only summon elementals and not myrmidons. Properties Cost Action + Level 6 Spell Slot Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. ## Conjure Minor Elemental

This article is about the level 4 conjuration spell. For other uses, see Conjure Elemental (disambiguation) . Conjure Minor Elemental is a level 4 conjuration spell . It conjures 2 Mud Mephits, 2 Ice Mephits, or an Azer to fight for you. Description Conjure a minor elemental to fight alongside you. Properties Cost Action + Level 4 Spell Slot Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_ConjureElementals_Minor_Container Spell flags CannotTargetCharacter , CannotTargetItems , HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsLinkedSpellContainer , IsSpell Variants Conjure Minor Elemental: Azer Conjure Minor Elemental: Ice Mephits Conjure Minor Elemental: Mud Mephits How to learn Classes: Class level 7: Wizard , Druid , and Circle of the Land (Arctic and Forest) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 4 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Conjure Minor Elemental to their spellbooks. Notes Each caster is only able to have one instance of this active at a time, no matter which version is chosen. Casting it a second time despawns the current elemental(s), and activates their Death Burst. This spell is considered independent of Conjure Elemental ; each caster can have one instance of Elemental and Minor Elemental active simultaneously. Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith is a level 6 necromancy spell . Summon a Shadow to fight by your side. Description Pull an undead creature from the depths of the Shadow Lantern's depraved magic to join your side in combat. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 3 m (10 ft) At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_ORI_Gale_ShadowSummon Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent Creature: Shadow STR 6 (-2) DEX 16 (+3) CON 13 (+1) INT 6 (-2) WIS 10 CHA 8 (-1) Duration Until long rest Hit Points 24 Armour Class 13 Movement Speed 10 m (33 ft) Necrotic Claws ( ) Lash out with cursed claws. ## Contagion
- **来源**: [Contagion](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Contagion)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Contagion is a level 5 necromancy spell . It allows spellcasters to infect their target with an affliction of their choosing, potentially resulting in the target contracting a disease. Description Poison a target and possibly afflict them with a disease of your choice. Once infected, the target will roll a Constitution Saving Throw each turn. If it accumulates 3 successes, it recovers. If it accumulates 3 failures, it contracts the disease chosen by the spellcaster. Properties Cost Action + Level 5 Spell Slot Details Melee Spell Attack Roll Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_Contagion Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsHarmful , IsLinkedSpellContainer , IsMelee , IsSpell Variants Contagion: Filth Fever Contagion: Flesh Rot Contagion: Slimy Doom Contagion: Seizure Contagion: Mindfire Contagion: Blinding Sickness Condition: Contagion Poisoned Contagion Poisoned CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Checks . Each turn, it must succeed on a Saving Throw , or the poison will advance in stage. On 3 successes, it recovers. On 3 failures, it contracts the disease corresponding to the variant of the spell Contagion that was cast. How to learn Classes: Class level 9: Cleric , Druid , Circle of the Spores (Circle Spell), Circle of the Land (Arctic/Forest/Underdark), and Death Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Notes After this spell hits, the target is only affected by the less potent Contagion Poisoned condition until it fails 3 saving throws. Then the selected variant of disease sets in and persists after a long rest, essentially forever. To remove this, heal the target with Lesser Restoration or a similar effect . Casting Contagion outside of battle on any NPC is not considered an aggressive action. However, missing the attack roll when casting the spell is considered aggressive and might turn NPCs hostile. After contracting Contagion: Mindfire , NPCs turn Hostile to everyone permanently which may be undesirable for key quest NPCs. The conditions inflicted by the different variants of the spell do not share stack IDs . This means a target can be affected by multiple distinct contagions at the same time.
