- **来源**: [Protection from Missiles](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Protection_from_Missiles)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Protection from Missiles is a level 2 abjuration spell . It protects the caster against ranged weapon attacks for up to 10 turns. Description Amplify your reflexes to better contend with incoming missiles. Ranged weapon attacks against you have Disadvantage , and their damage is halved. Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Recharge: Short rest Concentration At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Shout_MAG_FlamingFist_BattleWizardGauntlet_ProtectionFromMissiles Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsConcentration , IsSpell Condition: Cindersnap Reflexes Cindersnap Reflexes Duration: 10 turns Ranged weapon attacks targeting this entity have Disadvantage and their damage is halved. How to learn Granted by items: Abdel's Trusted Shield ( Recharge: Short rest ) Cindersnap Gloves ( Recharge: Short rest ) Notes The damage reduction is distinct from Resistance and stacks in a manner where multiple instances are applied sequentially (multiplicatively); each effect modifies the result of the previous one with it. For example, with Protection from Missiles and ⁠ Piercing resistance, arrows will deal one quarter damage. Usually such damage reduction is impossible since resistances cannot stack with each other. Bugs The in-game tooltip on Cindersnap Reflexes incorrectly says the target is only protected against the next ranged attack. They will be protected by all ranged attacks while the spell is active. Attacks from off-hand Hand Crossbows are not affected by Protection from Missiles. External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Protection from arrows on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

## Reduce
- **来源**: [Reduce](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Reduce)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

See also: Reduce (Duergar) Reduce is a level 2 transmutation spell . This spell allows spellcasters to decrease a creature's body size. Affected creatures deal less damage with their weapons and have Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws . Description Make a creature smaller. Its weapons deal 1d4 less damage (minimum of 1 damage). It has Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws . Properties Cost Action + Level 2 Spell Slot Details CON Save Range: 9 m (30 ft) Concentration At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_Reduce Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsConcentration , IsLinkedSpellContainer , IsSpell Condition: Reduced Reduced Duration: 10 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Size is reduced. Weapon attacks deal 1d4 less damage. Has Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws . Carrying Capacity is reduced by 25% How to learn This spell is a variation of: Enlarge/Reduce Notes The Constitution Saving Throw only applies when the spell is cast on a non-party member. Reduce decreases the target creature's size to the next smaller category. For example, a Medium creature becomes Small . This also reduces the scale of the creature's model by 33%. Reduce also decreases the weight of the target creature to original weight/2.35. If the new weight is above the maximum weight of the new size category (e.g. 40 kg if decreased to Small ), the weight is set to the maximum value for that category. See Creature Size for more information. Reduced creatures have significantly more limited Shove weight limit. Refer to max shove weight for details. On the other hand, Reduce does not affect the weight of objects that can be Thrown or wielded as a Improvised Melee Weapon by the Reduced creature. However, it does make the Reduced creature itself easier to throw or used as an improvised weapon. The change in size from the spell stacks with the change in size from Disguise Self , making it possible to become a tiny creature (small race + Reduce). As a tiny creature it is possible to go through even the smallest of passageways such as pipes or jumping through the bars of a fence, something even the small races can't do. The incantations for Reduce are Minimus ("Smaller") and Diminue ("Diminish"). Visuals Play Video Local File https://bg3.wiki/wiki/File:Enlarge_Reduce_Visuals.mp4 External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Enlarge/reduce on the Forgotten Realms Wiki
## Reduce (Duergar)
- **来源**: [Reduce (Duergar)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Reduce_(Duergar))
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

See also: Reduce Reduce is a level 2 spell . This racial spell allows Duergar to decrease their body size. Affected creature is much harder to hit, but they are easier to affect with various skill checks or saving throws and weapons do less damage. Description Shrink in size to become harder to hit but slightly weaker. Your Armour Class increases by 5, but you receive Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Saving Throws using Strength, and your weapons deal 1d4 less damage (minimum of 1 damage). Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Shout_Reduce_Duergar Spell flags IsEnemySpell Condition: Reduced (Duergar) Reduced Duration: 3 turns Size is reduced. Armour Class increased by 5 Has Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Saving Throws . Attacks deal 1d4 less damage. How to learn Used by creatures: Dunnol , Fonmara , and Kettel Notes Reduce decreases the Size category of the target creature by 1. This affects the maximum size of creature it can Throw or use as an Improvised Melee Weapon , and vice-versa. For example, a creature of Medium size can only be thrown by a Large or larger creature. When Reduced, a Medium creature becomes Small and can be thrown by a Medium creature. While not stated in the spell description, Reduce also decreases the weight of the target creature. The formula used is: Original Weight / 2.35 = New Weight (minus additional weight, if needed, to place creature in the correct size category) (See Creature Size for more information.)

The target's Strength and Dexterity scores are set to 10 while in this form. Immune to Bleeding . If the creature is only wearing metal armour, it always receives Disadvantage. If the creature is still touching the metal, you can use a bonus action on subsequent turns to deal another and force the creature to let go or receive Disadvantage. Properties Cost Action + Level 4 Spell Slot Damage: 7~42 7d6 ⁠ Fire Details DEX Save (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) Metal weapons are dropped if the creature holding it fails their initial Saving Throw . If the creature is touching the heated metal item, they receive Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks . Each subsequent turn, if the creature is still touching the metal, the spellcaster can use Reapply Heat Metal to deal another 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage, forcing the creature to pass a Saving Throw again or drop the item (if it is a metal weapon). Condition: Heat Metal: Disadvantage Heat Metal: Disadvantage Duration: 10 turns Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks until the start of the caster's next Turn. ## Sanctuary
- **来源**: [Sanctuary](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Sanctuary)
- **分类**: Spells、Bonus_actions

Sanctuary is a level 1 abjuration spell . It allows spellcasters to ward themselves or an ally against enemy attacks. Description You or an ally cannot be targeted until you attack or harm a creature. You can still take damage from area spells. Until the affected entity attacks or harms another creature, it cannot be targeted by enemy attacks. However, it can still take damage from spells that influence a larger area. Properties Cost Bonus Action + Level 1 Spell Slot Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_Sanctuary Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Condition: Sanctuary Sanctuary Duration: 10 turns Affected entity can't be targeted by enemy attacks or spells. However, it can still take damage from spells that influence a larger area. Condition ends if the affected entity attacks or harms another creature, and will receive Sanctuary Blocked for 1 turn. How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Cleric Class level 3: Oath of Devotion (Oath Spell) Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets ) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Cleric Notes There are several actions and effects that a creature under Sanctuary can use which end the spell early: Weapon attacks that hit or damage something Self-inflicted damage [ verify ] Shove Throw – this applies to any object, including healing potions [ verify ] Damage dealt by a surface created by the creature under Sanctuary or a condition inflicted by the surface – regardless of when the surface was created Damage dealt by a condition the creature under Sanctuary inflicted – regardless of when the condition was inflicted This does not include cases where the condition is not attributed to the creature under Sanctuary, such as Singing Sword: Shriek [ verify ] Reactions that target an enemy, such as: [ verify ] Counterspell Cutting Words Opportunity Attack – only if it hits There are some seemingly harmful actions and effects that a creature under Sanctuary can use which do not end the spell: Weapon attacks that miss Damage dealt by controlled summons Bend Luck: Ability Check Penalty Chromatic Orb – provided no damage is dealt [ verify ] Cloud of Daggers – provided no damage is dealt on the initial casting [ verify ] Create or Destroy Water Crown of Madness Flaming Revenge Gust of Wind – provided no damage is dealt [ verify ] Hypnotic Gaze Moonbeam or Move Moonbeam – regardless of whether or not damage is dealt Portent Die Psionic Revenge Sleet Storm The incantation for Sanctuary is Mactē Virtutē , Latin for "With great virtue". Bugs Creatures affected by Sanctuary can still be targeted with Blight , Chain Lightning , and Thorn Whip , due to these spells lacking the IsHarmful spell flag. For the same reason, a large number of NPC actions (for example, Sharp Rock ) can target creatures that are affected by Sanctuary. Neutral NPCs (yellow outlined) with Sanctuary can be targeted with attacks. [ verify ] External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Sanctuary on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

## Scorching Ray
- **来源**: [Scorching Ray](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Scorching_Ray)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

For the equivalent Way of the Four Elements Monk spell, see Embrace of the Inferno . Scorching Ray is a level 2 evocation spell . It allows spellcasters to hurl 3 rays of fire at one or more targets within range. Each ray has a separate Attack Roll and deals Fire damage. Description Hurl 3 rays of fire. Each ray deals 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage. Properties Cost Action + Level 2 Spell Slot Damage: 6~36 2d6 ⁠ Fire + 2d6 ⁠ Fire + 2d6 ⁠ Fire Details Attack Roll Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels Upcasting : Casting this spell at a higher level hurls an additional ray for each spell slot level above 2nd. Technical details UID Projectile_ScorchingRay Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsHarmful , IsSpell , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Light Domain (Domain Spell), Sorcerer , The Fiend , and Wizard Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets ) Class level 7: Eldritch Knight Class level 8: Arcane Trickster Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Granted by items: Circlet of Blasting ( Recharge: Long rest ) Gloves of Cinder and Sizzle ( Recharge: Long rest ) Hellfire Hand Crossbow ( Recharge: Short rest ) Scroll of Scorching Ray Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 2 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Scorching Ray to their spellbooks. Notes Any bonus damage provided by passives and conditions is applied to each ray. Examples include Hex , Elemental Affinity: Damage , Hexblade's Curse and the Callous Glow Ring . When interacting with effects like Death Ward and dealing multiple ray attacks to the same creature, assuming the 1st attack was sufficient to down the creature with Death Ward active, the 2nd attack appears to apply before Death Ward activates. This means that after 2 ray attacks the creature loses Death Ward but remains with 1HP: If the initial attack has 3 rays the creature is downed on the 2nd ray attack and again for an actual kill on the 3rd ray attack. In the case of party members with Death Ward applied, they need to receive 6 ray attacks to actually die: 2 to break down the ward, 1 to get downed and 3 more to fail 3 Death Saving Throws . This effect appears to apply to all multi-application attacks such as Eldritch Blast and Magic Missile (as of 4.1.1.3669438). The incantation for Scorching Ray is Ardē , the Latin command "Burn/blaze!" External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Scorching ray on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

## Shadow Blade
- **来源**: [Shadow Blade](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shadow_Blade)
- **分类**: Spells、Bonus_actions

For the weapon created by this spell, see Shadow Blade (weapon) . For the passive feature, see Shadow Blade (passive feature) . Shadow Blade is a level 2 illusion spell . It creates a Shadow Blade in the caster's main hand which deals ⁠ Psychic damage. Description Weave a shadowy shortsword in your hand that deals 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage. When you use the sword to attack a target that is in dim light or darkness , you make the Attack Roll with Advantage . The shadow blade can be unequipped and equipped again, but must remain on the spellcaster's person. [ See: Bugs ] Properties Cost Bonus Action + Level 2 Spell Slot Damage: 2~16 + modifiers 2d8 + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Psychic Details Range: Self At higher levels Upcasting : When you cast this spell using a 3rd or 4th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 3d8 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic . Upcasting : When you cast this spell using a 5th or 6th-level spell slot, the damage increases to 4d8 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic . Technical details UID Shout_ShadowBlade_Class Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Item: Shadow Blade (weapon) Shadow Blade   – Duration: Until Long rest Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Psychic Properties Shortswords Melee Simple One-handed Price: 65 gp Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Special properties Shadow Blade You have Advantage on Attack Rolls against Lightly or Heavily Obscured targets when using this blade. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Sorcerer , Warlock , and Wizard Class level 7: Arcane Trickster (via spell replacement) Class level 8: Eldritch Knight Granted by items: Shadow Blade Ring ( Recharge: Short rest ) Other ways to learn: There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Notes The caster has innate proficiency with the summoned weapon, so wizards and sorcerers who lack shortsword proficiency can still wield it properly. A Shadow Blade item produced by this spell remains in the caster's inventory until long rest or until the caster is knocked unconscious, even if unprepared. As such, it can be cast at the beginning of the day and then swapped for a more useful spell later. However, the Shadow Blade's damage reduces to 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic upon doing so, treating any upcast version as if cast at 2nd level. The spell is not properly included in Arcane Trickster's illusion and enchantment spell list , but can still be learned at level 7 via spell replacement. Bugs Having any hireling cast the spell, then adding any item to their inventory, immediately recalling their soul, and then hiring them again, creates a permanent Shadow Blade in their inventory, which anyone can use. It is then possible to do this again to have two permanent Shadow Blades and dual wield them. If obtained in this manner, the permanent Shadow Blade only uses the spell's base damage, even if it was originally created via upcasting. These permanent Shadow Blades do not properly function with various effects, such as Battlemage's Power . External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Shadow blade on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

## Shield (spell)
- **来源**: [Shield (spell)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shield_(spell))
- **分类**: Spells、Reactions

For the mundane item, see Shield . For the equipment type, see Shields (equipment) . Shield is a level 1 abjuration spell . It allows spellcasters to avoid being hit by an enemy attack at the last possible instant. It also nullifies Magic Missile damage against them. Description When you are about to be hit by an enemy, use your Reaction to increase your Armour Class by 5. You also take no damage from Magic Missile . These effects last until the start of your next turn. Properties Cost Reaction + Level 1 Spell Slot Details Range: Self At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UIDs Shout_Shield_Wizard Wizard version Shout_Shield_Sorcerer Sorcerer version Shout_Shield_Warlock Warlock version Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsLinkedSpellContainer , IsSpell Condition: Shield Shield Duration: 1 turn Immune to Magic Missile. Armour Class is increased by 5. How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Sorcerer , Wizard , and The Hexblade Class level 3: Arcane Trickster and Eldritch Knight Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Sorcerer Magic Initiate: Wizard Granted by items: Amulet of the Harpers ( Recharge: Long rest ) Shield of Shielding ( Recharge: Long rest ) Elegant Studded Leather ( Recharge: Short rest ) Other ways to learn: There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Scroll of Shield has been entirely removed from the game. Notes This spell does not trigger Spell Rot . If a character with more than one class using Charisma as its Spellcasting ability wants this spell (e.g., Sorcerer and The Hexblade ) both classes can select it. While the Wizard , Arcane Trickster and Eldritch Knight classes share the same Spellcasting ability ( Intelligence ), this spell cannot be picked multiple times via these classes on the same character, following these rules: A Wizard selection will always be replaced by the two others as it is considered less efficient. Once selected by either Arcane Trickster or Eldritch Knight , it will not be available for the other. Bugs Due to a coding error, Shield does not grant charges of Arcane Ward . Due to an incomplete list of spell checks, Shield will not reduce the damage of Magic Missiles from Illithid Arcanists for the rest of the turn after Shield is used as a reaction. When provided by an item, Shield does not provide any beneficial effects which would otherwise normally last until the start of the caster's next turn. ## Shillelagh
- **来源**: [Shillelagh](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shillelagh)
- **分类**: Spells、Cantrips、Bonus_actions

Shillelagh is a cantrip (Transmutation) . It imbues the caster's weapon with nature power. Description Quarterstaff or Club Required. Your staff or club becomes magical: it deals 1d8 + Spellcasting modifier ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage, and uses your Spellcasting modifier for Attack Rolls . Properties Cost Bonus Action Details Range: Self Technical details UID Shout_Shillelagh Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsMelee , IsSpell Condition: Shillelagh Shillelagh Duration: 10 turns Creature's weapon is magical and deals 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. Attack Rolls use the wielder's Spellcasting modifier . How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Druid and Nature Domain (Domain Spell) Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Druid Other ways to learn: There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Notes Despite misleading tooltips, a Shillelagh'ed weapon replaces Strength with the highest Spellcasting modifier for both Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls , no matter if learned as a Druid, Nature Cleric or even via Magic Initiate: Druid . As it uses the highest spellcasting ability, Shillelagh might result in unexpected collateral effects with multiclassing. For example: a Druid 11 / Wizard 1 will use the higher of Intelligence or Wisdom for attacks, not always Intelligence as previously believed. A character who obtains Shillelagh via Magic Initiate: Druid, with only levels in Fighter , will always use Intelligence as no other spellcasting ability is available to this character class. If this same character then takes a level in a class that uses another spellcasting ability (for example: Barbarian with Charisma) that new spellcasting ability will be used. It has the equivalent effect as the Infernal Rapier and Sylvan Scimitar , but into a staff or club of the player's choice. A simple Torch is one of the strongest weapons early game, as it can be enchanted with Shillelagh for 1d8 + Spellcasting modifier ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning + 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage. Martial Arts: Dextrous Attacks overrides Shillelagh, causing attacks to use the Dexterity modifier even when Wisdom is higher. The enchanted weapon can be unequipped, but not thrown or otherwise removed from the inventory. The Ironvine Shield provides a retaliatory damage effect when the wielder is hit with a melee attack while holding a weapon that has this spell active on it. An Ironwood Club deals an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage through Ironwood Harmony if Shillelagh is cast on it. Shillelagh has the same two incantations as Flame Blade : Canto Te , Latin for "I enchant you" , and Para Bellum , Latin for "prepare for war" . Description Embrace Kereska's acid to gain resistance to ⁠ Acid damage. Your acid spells deal additional ⁠ Acid damage equal to your proficiency bonus . When you deal spell damage, possibly inflict 3 [ See Notes ] turns of Noxious Fumes upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's acid you can cast Melf's Acid Arrow and Hunger of Hadar once each per short rest . Melf's Acid Arrow ( ) Cast as a level 5 spell ( Recharge: Short rest .) Hunger of Hadar ( ) Cast as a level 5 spell ( Recharge: Short rest .) Its acid spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it possibly inflict 3 turns of Noxious Fumes upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's acid it can cast Melf's Acid Arrow and Hunger of Hadar at 5th level once per short rest. How to learn Granted by items: Markoheshkir This spell is a variation of: Kereska's Favour Notes The in-game tooltip for this spell says its effect inflicts Noxious Fumes for 1 turn, but it actually inflicts it for 3 turns. It also requires a DC  13 Dexterity Saving Throw to apply the condition. Possibly applying Noxious Fumes can only occur once per attack. A spell hitting multiple targets will still only make a single saving throw for one of the targets to apply the condition. This is the only variant of Kereska's Favour that requires a saving throw to inflict its condition. The ice, thunder, and poison variants all apply their respective conditions without a saving throw. The version of Melf's Acid Arrow granted by this spell matches the damage of a level 5 upcasted version ( 7d4 ⁠ ⁠ Acid + 5d4 ⁠ ⁠ Acid delayed), but it only counts as a level 2 spell.

Ice is a surface that is considered Difficult Terrain . Creatures moving through it have their Movement Speed halved, and will fall Prone on a failed Dexterity Saving Throw . Slow is a level 3 transmutation spell . It allows spellcasters to reduce movement speed, Armour Class, and Dexterity Saving Throws, and also limit actions. Description Alter time around up to 6 enemies to Slow them. They won't get far, they can't do much, and they're easier to hit. Properties Cost Action + Level 3 Spell Slot Details WIS Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Targets: 6 creatures Concentration At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_Slow Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IgnorePreviouslyPickedEntities , IsConcentration , IsSpell Condition: Slowed Slowed Duration: 10 turns WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Affected entity's Movement Speed is halved, and its Armour Class and Dexterity Saving Throws are reduced by 2. The entity can't take Reactions or make more than 1 attack per turn, [ See: Bugs ] and can only take either an Action or a Bonus Action . Spells cast might be delayed for 1 turn. [ See: Bugs ] How to learn Classes: Class level 5: Sorcerer , Wizard , The Great Old One , and Knowledge Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets ) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Other ways to learn: Also granted to Warlocks who choose the Eldritch Invocation Mire the Mind at level 5+. Wizards with a Level 3 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Slow to their spellbooks. Notes Each affected creature repeats the Wisdom Saving Throw at the end of their turn, ending the effect if successful. Bugs Normally, the targets of Slow must be distinct, but when upcast to level 4, and only level 4 , targets can be selected multiple times. For example, two enemies can be targeted three times each forcing them to make three separate saving throws to avoid being slowed. This is due to the level 4 upcasted version lacking the IgnorePreviouslyPickedEntities flag. When cast via scroll, Slow requires 6 targets; as enemies cannot be selected twice, and allies are not targetable, this scroll might be difficult to use after the first round. ## Smite
- **来源**: [Smite](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Smite)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Smite is a category of unique weapon attacks that, unlike regular attacks , which generally only cost an Action , additionally expend spell slots (and often a Bonus Action ) to activate. Though requiring a spell slot, they do not consume the spell slot (nor bonus action, when applicable) on a miss. As they are considered weapon attacks, they can be used with Extra Attack and can be used multiple times per turn. The damage they deal is also affected by critical hits . List of smite actions [ edit section | visual editor ] Banishing Smite Branding Smite Blinding Smite Divine Smite Searing Smite Staggering Smite Thunderous Smite Wrathful Smite Lunar Smite (NPC-exclusive) Divine Smite [ edit section | visual editor ] Notably, Divine Smite functions differently from the other smites. Despite consuming spell slots, Divine Smite is not a spell and does not interact with any effect or ability that only works with spells. Examples include Counterspell , Vivacious Cloak , or Tempestuous Magic . Unlike other smite spells, Divine Smite can be configured to trigger automatically on hit inside the Reactions menu with Divine Smite (reaction) . The reaction is split into two options per spell slot level unlocked, one for normal hits called Divine Smite and one for critical hits called Divine Smite: Critical Hit. This means that with level 2 spell slots, there will be four Divine Smite reactions (two per level) that can be configured separately. By default, the Divine Smite: Critical Hit reactions are set to auto-confirm, and the normal Divine Smite reactions are disabled. Using Divine Smite as a reaction has a number of advantages. It allows Divine Smite to be combined with any melee weapon attack (that is not Divine Smite itself), such as off-hand attacks, weapon actions like Cleave , or special attacks like Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack . It can even trigger when using another smite spell. Using Divine Smite directly through the action is less flexible and is equivalent to using the reaction on a basic attack. When used as a reaction, the only additional resource consumed is the selected level of spell slot. Even though it is configured in the Reactions menu, Divine Smite never consumes a Reaction resource. Divine Smite as a reaction cannot be triggered when attacking from invisibility. Other smites [ edit section | visual editor ] Other smites cannot be used as reactions and must be used manually; however, Divine Smite can be triggered as a reaction when using other smite spells, allowing for two different smites on a single attack. Other smites also count as proper spells for the purpose of features that interact with them, like Ring of Elemental Infusion or Empowered Evocation , and can even be affected by Counterspell.

## Speak with Dead
- **来源**: [Speak with Dead](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Speak_with_Dead)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Speak with Dead is a level 3 necromancy spell . It allows spellcasters to grant a semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions. Description Grant a semblance of life to a corpse, allowing it to answer questions. Skeletons and creatures killed with ⁠ Acid , ⁠ Fire , ⁠ Lightning , ⁠ Necrotic , ⁠ Radiant damage no longer have a mouth and can't be made to talk using this spell. Doesn't work on Undead. Properties Cost Action + Level 3 Spell Slot Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Ritual At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_SpeakWithDead Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Condition: Recast Speak with Dead Recast Speak with Dead Duration: Until Long rest Can recast Speak with Dead without expending a spell slot . How to learn Classes: Class level 5: Bard and Cleric Granted by features: Ritual Caster: Free Spells Granted by items: The Amulet of Lost Voices ( Recharge: Long rest ) Necromancy of Thay ( Recharge: Long rest ) Other ways to learn: Also granted to Warlocks who choose the Eldritch Invocation Whispers of the Grave at level 9+. Wizards cannot transcribe a Scroll of Speak with Dead to their spellbooks. Notes With one notable exception, each corpse only answers five questions before the spell loses its power. Casting this spell also affords Recast Speak with Dead , as a granted spell . Granted spells allow the spellcaster to recast a like copy of the original without expending a spell slot, until the next Long Rest . Most corpses are unwilling to speak with the caster if they dealt the killing blow or they were in the active party during the combat where the victim was killed. While not always the case, this can be circumvented by applying Disguise Self spell before casting this. For the list of NPCs this spell can be used on see Category:Available to Speak with Dead . If cast by a Cleric from their spell list and not from a scroll, the spell must remain Prepared . If removed from the Cleric's Prepared Spells list, they lose the ability to use Recast Speak with Dead until preparing and casting Speak with Dead once more. Meanwhile, applicable corpses do not show a green glow to indicate they can be spoken to. If cast with a scroll or item, the caster need not keep this spell prepared, and can use Recast Speak with Dead until their next Long Rest. Keeping a collection of corpses in the Traveler's Chest at camp can be a useful way to activate "Recast Speak with Dead" after each long rest, to get the green glow on "speak-able" corpses, though this can only be done once per corpse. Using Speak with Dead grants the ⁠ Whispers from the Grave inspiration to party members with the Sage background. The incantation for Speak With Dead is Cum Mortuus in Lingua Mortua , Latin for "With the dead in a dead language" or In Nocte Consignē , Latin for "Mark/seal in night." ## Spiritual Weapon
- **来源**: [Spiritual Weapon](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Spiritual_Weapon)
- **分类**: Spells、Bonus_actions

This article is about the base spell. For other uses, see Spiritual Weapon (disambiguation) . Spiritual Weapon is a level 2 evocation spell . It summons a floating weapon that can attack enemies. The caster can choose between several different weapons, and each has a different weapon action . Description Summon a floating, spectral weapon that attacks your enemies alongside you. Properties Cost Bonus Action + Level 2 Spell Slot Damage: 2~9 + modifiers 1d8 + 1 + Spellcasting modifier ⁠ Force Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels Upcasting : For every 2 spell slot levels higher than 2nd, the weapon gains 8 hit points and deals an additional 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage. Technical details UID Target_SpiritualWeapon Spell flags CannotTargetCharacter , CannotTargetItems , HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsLinkedSpellContainer , IsSpell Variants Spiritual Weapon: Greataxe Spiritual Weapon: Greatsword Spiritual Weapon: Halberd Spiritual Weapon: Maul Spiritual Weapon: Spear Spiritual Weapon: Trident How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Cleric and War Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 5: Oath of the Crown (Oath Spell) Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets ) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Granted by items: Sethan Harper Sacredstriker Notes The summoned weapon rolls its own initiative (with a +0 bonus) and acts on its own turn rather than the summoner's turn. The weapon is Ethereal , Immune to ⁠ Psychic and ⁠ Poison damage, and Resistant to all other Damage Types. Each spiritual weapon lasts for 10 turns, and only one Spiritual Weapon may be summoned at any time. The caster's spellcasting modifier is added to both the damage and attack rolls of the summoned Spiritual Weapon. If the caster has multiclassed , the spellcasting modifier of the newest caster class is used. The caster's proficiency bonus is also added to the summoned weapon's Attack Rolls . On the other hand, the weapon action DC of the summoned weapon (used for example by Spiritual Weapon: Spear to inflict Gaping Wounds with Piercing Strike ) is fixed at 12 and does not benefit from the caster's spellcasting modifier. The greataxe, greatsword, and halberd variants of Spiritual Weapon are functionally identical and all have Lacerate . The spear and trident variants are functionally identical and both have Piercing Strike . The maul variant has Concussive Smash . Spiritual Weapons cannot make opportunity attacks. The incantation for Spiritual Weapon is Ex Textura , Latin for "From the weave" . Condition desired: Gaping Wounds → Trident, Spear Bleeding → Greataxe, Greatsword, Halberd Dazed → Maul External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Spiritual weapon on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

## Sunbeam
- **来源**: [Sunbeam](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Sunbeam)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Sunbeam is a level 6 evocation spell . It allows spellcasters to project a beam of light, Blinding and dealing Radiant damage to everything in its path. They can then use Recast Sunbeam on subsequent turns without expending a Spell Slot. Description A beam of brilliant light sears and Blinds all creatures in its path. Until the spell ends, you can recast Sunbeam without expending a spell slot . Properties Cost Action + Level 6 Spell Slot Damage: 6~48 6d8 ⁠ Radiant Details CON Save (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) AoE: 18 m (60 ft) Line Concentration At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Zone_Sunbeam Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsConcentration , IsHarmful , IsSpell Grants: Recast Sunbeam Condition: Blinded Blinded Duration: 10 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls . Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft). Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have Advantage . Condition: Sunbeam Sunbeam Duration: 10 turns Can Recast Sunbeam How to learn Classes: Class level 11: Druid , Sorcerer , and Wizard Granted by items: The Blood of Lathander ( Recharge: Long rest ) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 6 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Sunbeam to their spellbooks. Notes This spell creates a beam of light from the caster out to a distance of 18 m (60 ft). The beam is 2.5 m (8 ft) wide. A character concentrating on Sunbeam emits a 9 m (30 ft) aura of sunlight which triggers Sunlight Hypersensitivity . Hitting a creature with a Sunbeam does not trigger Sunlight Hypersensitivity; the aura (maintained by concentration) is what does this. Recast Sunbeam is a "granted" spell. Granted spells are issued to the caster after casting the original, and can be recast without spending another spell slot as long as Concentration is not broken. Granted spells such as this are not directly tied to the casters' repertoire of known spells (i.e., their spellbook icon in the game). Therefore, if a granted spell is cast when multiclassing, subsequent recasts (in this case, Recast Sunbeam ) use the spellcasting modifier of the most recently acquired spellcasting class rather than the spellcasting modifier that was used for the initial casting of Sunbeam. In this case, it may result in an unexpectedly low spell save DC. The incantation for Sunbeam is Incendē , the Latin command "Set on fire/inflame!" Tasha's Hideous Laughter is a level 1 enchantment spell . It allows spellcasters to send a targeted creature into a fit of laughter, falling Prone . Description Leave a creature Prone with laughter, without the ability to get up. The creature must have an Intelligence of 5 or more. The target can try to shake off the effect each time it takes damage. Properties Cost Action + Level 1 Spell Slot Details WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 18 m (60 ft) Concentration At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. At the end of its turn or when it takes damage, the entity can try to shake off the effect. How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Bard , Wizard , The Great Old One , and Draconic Bloodline (Copper/Acid Ancestry) Class level 3: Arcane Trickster and Eldritch Knight Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Bard Magic Initiate: Wizard Other ways to learn: Learned as a quest reward for completing ⁠ Help the Cursed Monk and choosing to bear Shar's curse. ## Telekinesis
- **来源**: [Telekinesis](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Telekinesis)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Telekinesis is a level 5 transmutation spell . It allows spellcasters to throw creatures and objects around with only their mind. Description Throw a creature or object up to 18 m (60 ft) with a thought. Once per turn, you can use Telekinesis again without expending a Spell Slot . Heavier items deal more damage. Properties Cost Action + Level 5 Spell Slot Details STR Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Concentration At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Throw_Telekinesis Spell flags AbortOnSecondarySpellRollFail , AbortOnSpellRollFail , AddFallDamageOnLand , CombatLogSetSingleLineRoll , HasHighGroundRangeExtension , HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IgnoreVisionBlock , InventorySelection , IsConcentration , IsHarmful , IsSpell , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold Condition: Telekinesis Telekinesis Duration: 10 turns STR Save ( Spell save DC ) Once per turn, the affected entity can telekinetically throw a creature or object again without expending a Spell Slot How to learn Classes: Class level 9: Sorcerer , Wizard , Knowledge Domain , and The Great Old One Granted by items: Hr'a'cknir Bracers ( Recharge: Short rest ) Tressym Collar ( Recharge: Long rest ) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 5 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Telekinesis to their spellbooks. Notes Bodies or objects that cannot be looted or picked up because they have landed in chasms can sometimes be retrieved using telekinesis. If the target is a creature who succeeds their initial save, the caster does not get the Telekinesis condition and thus, cannot recast this spell. This can be avoided by targeting an item with the initial cast, guaranteeing the Telekinesis condition and recast spell, and then targeting a creature on subsequent casts with the recast spell. Creatures succeeding a saving throw against the recast spell do not prematurely end the Telekinesis condition. Telekinesis is considered a "granted" condition not unlike that of a "granted" spell. Granted spells are issued to the caster after using the original, and can be recast without spending another spell slot as long as Concentration is not broken. This condition is not directly tied to the casters' repertoire of known spells (i.e., their spellbook icon in the game). Therefore, if a granted spell (or, in this case, a granted condition) is used when multiclassing, subsequent re-uses (in this case, Telekinesis ) use the spellcasting modifier of the most recently acquired spellcasting class rather than the spellcasting modifier that was used for the initial casting of Telekinesis. In the case of this condition, it may result in an unexpectedly low spell save DC. Bugs Using Telekinesis to throw a Burning object at a target sets the caster on fire. This does not occur if the thrown object impacts only the ground. ## True Strike
- **来源**: [True Strike](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/True_Strike)
- **分类**: Spells、Cantrips、Actions

True Strike is a cantrip (Divination) . It gives the caster Advantage on their next Attack Roll against the target. Description Gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll . This spell can be cast while you are Silenced . Properties Cost Action Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) Concentration Technical details UID Target_TrueStrike Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , HasSomaticComponent , IsConcentration , IsHarmful , IsSpell Condition: True Strike True Strike Duration: 2 turns The spellcaster has Advantage on Attack Rolls against this creature. How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Bard , Sorcerer , Warlock , and Wizard Class level 3: Arcane Archer , Arcane Trickster , and Eldritch Knight Races: Character level 1: High Elf and High Half-Elf ( Character level is the sum of all class levels for a multi-classed character.) Granted by features: Magic Initiate: Bard Magic Initiate: Sorcerer Magic Initiate: Warlock Magic Initiate: Wizard Other ways to learn: Mage Breaker (Ranger class feature) There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Notes The description of True Strike is among the more confusingly worded, and thus is prone to being misunderstood. Specifically: Only the caster of this spell gains Advantage on their next attack against the affected target, never their allies. Only the first attack roll following the application of the condition gains Advantage. The condition is removed immediately afterward, whether the attack roll is a hit or a miss. The duration is 2 turns, but this includes the turn on which the condition is applied . This is true of many spells, but is especially important for short duration spells. True Strike is rarely considered worth using due to its opportunity cost; a full Action must be spent on it to improve the chances of hitting once . Most of the time, if two actions are available - whether on the same turn or not - attacking twice is more effective than attacking once with advantage (due to damage bonuses). However , True Strike is not considered "aggressive", so the caster could cast it just before combat to gain its benefits without having to spend an action mid-fight (this eliminates the opportunity cost). The duration is only 2 turns (12 seconds while not in turn-based mode). Another niche use case exists for an Arcane Trickster making a Sneak Attack . If the caster is out of spell slots, and no allies can flank for a sneak attack, and there is no other way to gain advantage for an attack roll, spending a single action on True Strike to enable a single sneak attack can be considered efficient. In such cases, True Strike can be even more useful when using the ranged version of sneak attack, since this allows the caster to benefit from the range of the cantrip, especially with a High Ground bonus. At such distances, however, it is typically easier to just use a Bonus Action to hide first and obtain Advantage. Bugs Though not displayed in its description, True Strike can be cast while Silenced . External links [ edit section | visual editor ] True strike on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

## Vampiric Swarm
- **来源**: [Vampiric Swarm](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Vampiric_Swarm)
- **分类**: Spells、Reactions

This page is about content exclusive to Honour mode . Vampiric Swarm is a level 6 conjuration spell . It is cast as a legendary reaction available to Cazador in Honour mode. It cannot be learned by party members. Description Call forth a swarm of vampire bats. Targets are pushed backwards 7 m (23 ft) and may become Swarmed . Properties Damage: 12~144 12d12 ⁠ Piercing Details DEX Save Range: 10 m (33 ft) AoE: 5 m (17 ft) Line Pushes: 7 m (23 ft) At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UIDs Zone_LOW_Cazador_BatSwarm_Huge Version available with 6 or 7 sources Zone_LOW_Cazador_BatSwarm_Large Version available with 3, 4 or 5 sources Zone_LOW_Cazador_BatSwarm Version available with 1 or 2 sources Spell flags AddFallDamageOnLand , HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsHarmful , IsSpell Condition: Swarmed Swarmed Duration: 2 turns Affected entity is Vulnerable to Piercing damage and will take 4d8 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing every turn. While the entity is Swarmed , Cazador will heal 4d8 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points every turn. How to learn Granted by features: Legendary Action: Vampiric Swarm Used by creatures: Cazador Notes Cazador can only use this spell once he begins his ritual. The region that can trigger this spell is highlighted by a shaded red circle around Cazador. Entering this region while Hiding does not trigger the spell. Allies of Cazador hit by this spell are pushed away a distance of 3 m (10 ft) as well, but they do not take any damage. The effects of this spell change depending on the number of Ritual Sources Cazador has active: With 6 or 7 sources active, the spell deals 12d12 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing damage when an enemy steps within 10 m (33 ft) of him; enemies are pushed 7 m (23 ft), while allies are pushed 3 m (10 ft). With 3, 4 or 5 sources active, the spell deals 10d12 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing damage when an enemy steps within 8 m (27 ft) of him; enemies are pushed 5 m (17 ft), while allies are pushed 2 m (7 ft). With 1 or 2 sources active, the spell deals 8d12 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing damage when an enemy steps within 6 m (20 ft) of him; enemies are pushed 3 m (10 ft), while allies are pushed 1 m (3 ft). With no sources active, Cazador loses this spell. If Cazador loses all sources, he still has access to the weakest version of this spell until it is triggered. Similarly, if Cazador gains a source, he does not obtain this spell again until the beginning of the next round. Cazador does not require line of sight on the enemy triggering the spell. However, environmental objects such as the pillar-like objects in the arena will block the spell's path. Bugs Silence does not prevent Cazador from casting this spell despite technically requiring a verbal component. While the tooltip states that Cazador can cast this spell as a reaction when a creature steps within 10 m (33 ft) of him, it can also be triggered when an arbitrary condition is applied to Cazador. Notably, stepping onto or off of a Ritual Source circle can trigger this reaction, as doing so applies a new Ritual Sources condition corresponding to the number of currently available Ritual Source circles. [ verify ]
## Vampiric Touch
- **来源**: [Vampiric Touch](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Vampiric_Touch)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Vampiric Touch is a level 3 necromancy spell . It allows spellcasters at melee range to siphon the life force of their target. Description Touch an enemy to siphon their life force and regain half as many Hit Points . For 10 turns, you can use Vampiric Touch again without expending an additional Spell Slot . Properties Cost Action + Level 3 Spell Slot Damage: 3~18 3d6 ⁠ Necrotic Details Melee Spell Attack Roll Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Concentration At higher levels Upcasting : Casting this spell at a higher level deals an extra 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage for each spell slot level above 3rd. Technical details UID Target_VampiricTouch Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsConcentration , IsHarmful , IsMelee , IsSpell Condition: Vampiric Touch Vampiric Touch Duration: 10 turns Each turn, using an Action , can recast Vampiric Touch without expending a Spell Slot . How to learn Classes: Class level 5: Warlock , Wizard , Circle of the Land (Swamp), and Death Domain (Domain Spell) Class level 6: College of Lore (via Magical Secrets ) Class level 10: Bard (via Magical Secrets ) Other ways to learn: Wizards with a Level 3 Spell Slot can transcribe a Scroll of Vampiric Touch to their spellbooks. Notes While active, Vampiric Touch provides the caster with a Granted Vampiric Touch spell of the same level. Granted spells are issued to the caster after using the original, and can be recast without spending another spell slot as long as Concentration is not broken. Granted spells are not directly tied to the casters' repertoire of known spells (i.e., their spellbook icon in the game). Therefore, if a granted spell is used when multiclassing, subsequent re-uses use the spellcasting modifier of the most recently acquired spellcasting class rather than the spellcasting modifier that was used for the initial casting of Vampiric Touch. In this case, it may result in an unexpectedly low spell save DC. Bugs The Level 4 Spell Slot , Level 5 Spell Slot , and Level 6 Spell Slot versions of the recastable spell lack PowerLevel entries which leads to these spell versions appearing on the UI to be the Level 3 Spell Slot version, most notably when using a controller. However, these spell versions do cast at the correct level. ## Veil of the Weird
- **来源**: [Veil of the Weird](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Veil_of_the_Weird)
- **分类**: Spells、Cantrips、Actions

Veil of the Weird is a cantrip (Illusion) . It is an unique spell only available during the Confront the Elder Brain quest which allows the caster to apply Greater Invisibility on up to five creatures. Description Channel Auntie Ethel's hag magic to render 5 creatures within range Invisible. Available only in combat. The caster can only use this feature once in their adventure. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 24 m (80 ft) Targets: 5 allies Technical details UID Target_END_AllyAbility_HagInvisibility Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsSpell Condition: Greater Invisibility Greater Invisibility Duration: 2 turns Entity has Advantage on Attack Rolls . Attack Rolls against it have Disadvantage When interacting with items, casting spells, or attacking, the entity needs to succeed on a Stealth Check to maintain Invisibility. The Check becomes harder with each successful attempt. How to learn This spell is a variation of: Gather Your Allies (class action) Other ways to learn: By siding with Auntie Ethel during Gather Your Allies . There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Notes Unlike other Gather Your Allies abilities, this is actually classified as a spell. This has a number of implications: Numerous enemies in the finale have Counterspell including The Emperor and Spellplague and will counterspell this action if possible. If this happens, the action is not used and can be attempted again. Metamagic can be used with this action, most notably Metamagic: Extended Spell which doubles the duration to 4 turns. It can be cast as a bonus action with Illusion Quickening .

Description Insult a creature: it has Disadvantage on its next Attack Roll . Properties Cost Action Damage: 1~4 1d4 ⁠ Psychic Details WIS Save (On Save: Spell is negated) Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels At character level 5, the damage increases to 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic . At character level 10, the damage increases to 3d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic . These remarks are fully voice acted, including for characters who do not normally have access to the spell. (These same lines are also used for the College of Lore Bard feature Cutting Words .) ## Warding Bond
- **来源**: [Warding Bond](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Warding_Bond)
- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Warding Bond is a level 2 abjuration spell . It allows spellcasters to bolster an ally's defenses while also sharing any damage they receive. Description Ward an ally. They gain resistance to all damage, and a +1 bonus to their Armour Class and Saving Throws . Properties Cost Action + Level 2 Spell Slot Details Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_WardingBond Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsMelee , IsSpell Condition: Warding Bond (Target) Warding Bond Duration: Until Long rest Affected entity has a +1 bonus to Armour Class and Saving Throws , and Resistance to all damage. Each time it takes damage, the spellcaster takes the same amount of damage. Condition: Warding Bond (Caster) Warding Bond Duration: Until Long rest Creature is bound to an ally. Each time the ally takes damage, the creature takes the same amount of damage. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Cleric Class level 5: Oath of the Crown (Oath Spell) Granted by items: Viconia's Walking Fortress ( Recharge: Long rest ) Other ways to learn: Also granted by the ring True Love's Embrace . The spell can only be cast once per Long Rest , and the target must be wearing the matching ring, True Love's Caress . There are no scrolls available for wizards to transcribe to their spellbooks. Notes This spell can be active on multiple allies at once. In such cases, the caster redirects damage from all allies who have received Warding Bond from them. Damage redirected by Warding Bond triggers a Concentration Saving Throw if the caster is concentrating on another spell. Damage redirected by Warding Bond can be reduced by the caster's resistances (if any). Warding Bond remains active on the target party member if the caster is Downed , but is removed if the caster dies . Warding Bond has no effect on a party member who has already cast Warding Bond. If multiple party members cast Warding Bond on each other, Warding Bond will not activate for either party member (Resistances and bonuses to Armour Class and Saving Throws are removed, and damage is not redirected). If a party member casts Warding Bond on another party member, and that party member then casts Warding Bond on a third party member, Warding Bond only remains active for the third party member (who has not cast Warding Bond). Warding Bond persists if the caster is dismissed from the party back to camp. In such a case, the caster continues to receive damage redirected from their bonded target, and will be damaged (or potentially dead) while at camp. This spell must remain Prepared by the caster; removing this spell from the caster's Prepared Spells list removes the buff from themselves and the party members they cast Warding Bond on. This feature can be used to remove existing Warding Bond cast by using above mentioned items without long resting. Bugs If the target party member is in Wild Shape and has the Tavern Brawler feat, damage shared to the caster will be increased according to the Tavern Brawler bonus, resulting in high extra damage taken for the caster. Warding Bond places a passive on the caster which, among other text, states that the spell ends if "...you and the target become separated by more than ." Despite the lack of a stated distance, no such mechanic exists. External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Warding bond on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

- **分类**: Spells、Actions

Withering Theft is a level 4 necromancy spell . This spell allows spellcasters to siphon the life force of their target. It cannot be learned by party members. Description Rob a creature of its life force and gain 20 temporary hit points . Properties Cost Action Damage: 2~16 2d8 ⁠ Necrotic Details Attack Roll Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels Casting this spell at a higher level grants no additional benefit. Technical details UID Target_SHA_Skeleton_WitheringSuction Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , IsEnemySpell , IsHarmful , IsSpell Condition: Withering Life Force Withering Life Force Duration: Until Long rest Stole a creature's life force and gained 20 temporary hit points . Reconstituted Arcanists can hand their Withering Life Force to other creatures. How to learn Used by creatures: Reconstituted Arcanist Notes Cannot be used against Undead or Construct type creatures.

## A Coven of Hags
- **来源**: [A Coven of Hags](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/A_Coven_of_Hags)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This action creates illusory copies of Auntie Ethel around the arena, while shrouding the original in Invisibility , Description You'll never find your Auntie Ethel. Properties Cost Action Details Recharge: Per combat Technical details UIDs Shout_HAG_SpawnDoubles_Phase2 Version used in Act 1 Shout_LOW_Hag_SpawnDoubles_Phase4 Version used in Act 3 Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsEnemySpell How to learn Used by creatures: Auntie Ethel Notes Summons between two and five copies of Auntie Ethel . All "Ethels" obtain the condition Hag's Trickery . The original Ethel's location is randomized as well. Auntie Ethel will lose all conditions other than Hag's Trickery and gain Invisible for 2 turns. An illusory copy of Ethel disappears after a single instance of damage. The original Ethel will only lose Hag's Trickery . Any undamaged illusory copies will continue to exist after the original Ethel has been discovered.

## Absorb Intellect
- **来源**: [Absorb Intellect](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Absorb_Intellect)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the illithid power. For the upgraded full-illithid version, see Synaptic Consumption . Absorb Intellect is an illithid power which saps a target's Intelligence and heals the user over time. The healing per turn and Intelligence reduction starts at 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points and -1 respectively and increases by a stacking 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points and -1 reduction each subsequent turn for 5 turns. Description Gobble up a foe's intellect, lowering their Intelligence by 1 per turn and healing your wounds for 5 turns. Properties Cost Action Healing: 15~120 1d8 ⁠ Healing (On initial application) + 2d8 ⁠ Healing (After 1 turn) + 3d8 ⁠ Healing (After 2 turns) + 4d8 ⁠ Healing (After 3 turn) + 5d8 ⁠ Healing (After 4 turns) Details INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 9 m (30 ft) Recharge: Short rest Duration: 5 turns Technical details UID Target_TAD_AbsorbIntellect Spell flags CannotTargetItems , CannotTargetTerrain , DisableBlood , IsHarmful Condition: Absorbed Intellect (Stage 1) Absorbed Intellect Duration: 1 turn INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Intelligence is being reduced by 1. Regain 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points How to learn Other ways to learn: Unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining one of the following: Perilous Stakes Displacer Beast Shape Notes The condition Absorbed Intellect is lost and regained each round after an initial failed saving throw. Every turn of the effect, the amount of Intelligence lost increases by 1, starting as a -1 penalty on the first turn and ending as a -5 penalty on the final turn. Absorb Intellect inflicts Atrophied once the Intelligence of the affected entity reaches 2, as opposed to 0.

Acid Breath is a dragonborn racial breath weapon . This action allows them to breathe a column of damaging acid in a target direction. Description Spew forth a line of acid. Properties Cost Action Damage: 2~12 2d6 ⁠ Acid Details DEX Save ( DC  8 + Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus ) (On Save: Target still takes half damage.) Range: Self AoE: 5 m (17 ft) Line Recharge: Short rest At higher levels At character level 6, the damage increases to 3d6 ⁠ ⁠ Acid . At character level 11, the damage increases to 4d6 ⁠ ⁠ Acid . Technical details UID Zone_BreathWeapon_Acid Spell flags CanAreaDamageEvade How to learn Races: Character level 1: Black Dragonborn and Copper Dragonborn ( Character level is the sum of all class levels for a multi-classed character.) Notes Breath weapons use spell save DC calculated using Constitution . This means that, despite the unusual casting ability, breath weapons still benefit from anything that improves spell save DC . Bugs The tooltip incorrectly describes the area of effect as a cone, when it is instead a line.

## Animating Spores
- **来源**: [Animating Spores](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Animating_Spores)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the action used by Glut. For the similar action learned by Circle of the Spores druids, see Fungal Infestation . Animating Spores is a special class action available to Glut and Spaw which allows them to reanimate a corpse and have it fight by their side. The reanimated creature retains all of its actions, though it cannot use spellcasting. Description Release spores at a corpse to animate it as a spore servant under your command. Only affects one target at a time. No effect on corpses of constructs, plants, or aberrations. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 3 m (10 ft) Targets: Corpse of a monstrosity , humanoid , or beast Recharge: Per turn Technical details UID Target_AnimatingSpores Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , IsEnemySpell Condition: Spore Servant Spore Servant Duration: Until Long rest The animating spores of a myconid sovereign have taken over this dead creature's body, moving it according to the sovereign's will. Resurrected creature is classified as a plant . Immune to all Frightened conditions, Blinded conditions, Befuddled , Charmed , Crown of Madness , Friends , Hideous Laughter , Hold Person , Mind Mastery , Noxious Fumes (Bibberbang) , Paralysed , and Sleeping . Creature is resistant to ⁠ Poison damage. Creature is unable to cast spells or wild shape. How to learn Used by creatures: Glut and Spaw Notes The targeted creature is reanimated with 65% hit points. Only one creature can be animated at once with this action. Reanimating a new one kills the already existing one. A corpse can only be reanimated once with this action. While Glut is a temporary companion, this action allows player characters to take direct control of some powerful monsters by reanimating them. The most notable example is the Bulette with some other examples including Minotaurs and Hook Horrors . Additionally, corpses from outside the Underdark can be brought to Glut to reanimate. A notable example is Dror Ragzlin who even retains his legendary action in Honour mode. For this to work, corpses must be light enough to pick up, so heavier monsters like the Owlbear or Phase Spider Matriarch will not work. The description does not state it, but this cannot be used on Fiends , (excluding Flind , who is also affected by spells which only work on humanoids such as Hold Person ).

## Arcane Recovery
- **来源**: [Arcane Recovery](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Arcane_Recovery)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Arcane Recovery is a Wizard class action. This ability allows you to regain half your wizard level, rounded up, in spell slots once per day. Description Replenish Spell Slots while out of combat. You cannot restore spell slots above 5th level. Properties Cost Action + Arcane Recovery Charge Details Range: Self At higher levels At level 3, unlock the ability to spend an Action  +  2 Arcane Recovery Charges to replenish a Level 2 Spell Slot . At level 5, unlock the ability to spend an Action  +  3 Arcane Recovery Charges to replenish a Level 3 Spell Slot . At level 7, unlock the ability to spend an Action  +  4 Arcane Recovery Charges to replenish a Level 4 Spell Slot . At level 9, unlock the ability to spend an Action  +  5 Arcane Recovery Charges to replenish a Level 5 Spell Slot . Technical details UID Shout_ArcaneRecovery Spell flags IsLinkedSpellContainer How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Wizard Notes A wizard receives a number of Arcane Recovery Charges equal to class level divided by two, rounded up. For example, a level 5 wizard will have 3 Arcane Recovery Charges total. These charges replenish after a long rest. Recovering a spell slot costs a number of charges equal to the spell level. For example, recovering a Level 3 Spell Slot costs 3 Arcane Recovery Charges . The maximum spell level that can be replenished is capped at level 5 even though a level 11 or 12 wizard will have 6 total charges. Unlike Create Spell Slot and elixirs of Arcane Cultivation , this action cannot add new spell slots, only replenish expended slots and is depicted in the hotbar by a grey pip changing into blue. ## Arcane Shot: Bursting Arrow
- **来源**: [Arcane Shot: Bursting Arrow](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Arcane_Shot:_Bursting_Arrow)
- **分类**: Actions

Arcane Shot: Bursting Arrow is a special arcane arrow attack available to Arcane Archers which deals 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage in a small radius around the target in addition to normal weapon damage. Description Use Evocation magic to make your arrow explode on impact and deal an additional 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage to targets within 5 m (17 ft). Properties Cost Action + Arcane Arrow Damage: 2~12 Normal weapon damage + 2d6 ⁠ Force Details Ranged Weapon Attack Roll (On Miss: Arrow does not explode and Arcane Arrow cost is refunded) Range: Normal weapon range AoE: 5 m (17 ft) Radius Technical details UID Projectile_ArcaneShot_BurstingArrow Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , IsAttack , IsHarmful , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Arcane Archer Notes There is no saving throw to reduce or avoid the explosion damage so this Arcane Arrow option does not benefit from Intelligence . Bugs Unlike most other Arcane Shot options, this action consumes the Arcane Arrow immediately rather than on hit. Instead, this resource cost is refunded on a miss which is almost equivalent behaviour. This results in some unusual behaviour with Curving Shot . If Bursting Shot misses its initial target, the Arcane Arrow cost is refunded and then the attack is redirected to a new target. If this target is hit, the Bursting Arrow will apply for effectively free. If the redirected hit also misses, it will refund yet another Arcane Arrow netting +1 Arcane Arrow in total. v t e Fighter Subclasses Arcane Archer Battle Master Champion Eldritch Knight Fighting Styles Archery Defence Duelling Great Weapon Fighting Protection Two-Weapon Fighting Manoeuvres Commander's Strike Disarming Attack Distracting Strike Evasive Footwork Feinting Attack Goading Attack Manoeuvring Attack Menacing Attack Precision Attack Pushing Attack Rally Riposte Sweeping Attack Trip Attack Arcane Shots Banishing Arrow Beguiling Arrow Bursting Arrow Enfeebling Arrow Grasping Arrow Piercing Arrow Seeking Arrow Shadow Arrow Other class features Action Surge Curving Shot Eldritch Strike Extra Attack Improved Critical Hit Improved Extra Attack Improved Combat Superiority Indomitable Magic Arrow Remarkable Athlete: Jump Remarkable Athlete: Proficiency Second Wind War Magic Weapon Bond

This attack does not require an attack roll and always hits. Description Use Transmutation magic to attack all those within the line of your shot. Each target must succeed a Saving Throw or be dealt an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing damage. Properties Cost Action + Arcane Arrow Damage: 1~6 Normal weapon damage + 1d6 ⁠ Weapon Details DEX Save ( Spell save DC ) (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) Range: Self AoE: 10 m (33 ft) Line Technical details UID Zone_ArcaneShot_PiercingArrow Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , IsAttack , IsHarmful , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Arcane Archer Notes This attack is one of the small handful of abilities without attack rolls that work with Extra Attack . Though it does not state it on the tooltip, overall damage from this ability is reduced by half on a successful saving throw. Despite what the in-game tooltip indicates, the damage from this attack is not necessarily ⁠ Piercing . It inherits the damage type from the weapon so it deals ⁠ Force damage with the Ne'er Misser . The AoE can include targets at different height levels. Including characters at the players height and the ground below. Bugs Since this attack does not involve an attack roll, it does not benefit from certain bonus damage sources which check the attack roll type despite listing the additional damage on the tooltip. ## Augmented Shield of Thralls
- **来源**: [Augmented Shield of Thralls](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Augmented_Shield_of_Thralls)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the upgraded full-illithid power. For the base illitihid power, see Shield of Thralls . Augmented Shield of Thralls is an action and illithid power used by Full-Illithids . When used, this ability applies the Volatile Shield condition to the character or an ally, granting 25 temporary hit points . If the hit points are removed by incoming damage, all nearby enemies must make an Intelligence Saving Throw or be Stunned for 1 turn. Description Conjure a volatile shield around yourself or an ally, granting the target 25 temporary hit points . If these temporary hit points are lost due to incoming damage, the shield bursts and Stuns nearby foes. Can only have temporary hit points from one source. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Targets: 2 allies Technical details UID Target_MF_ShieldOfThralls Spell flags DisableBlood , Wildshape Condition: Volatile Shield Volatile Shield Duration: Until Long rest Affected entity has been granted temporary hit points by an illithid. If these are removed by incoming damage, the shield bursts, possibly Stunning nearby foes. The shield only bursts after all temporary hit points have been removed. This also removes the condition. When the shield bursts, enemies within 9 m (30 ft) are Stunned for 1 turn, unless they succeed a DC  15 Intelligence Saving Throw . Condition: Stunned Stunned Duration: 1 turn INT Save ( DC  15) Affected creatures cannot move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions . Affected creatures automatically fail Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Removed by Freedom of Movement , Greater Restoration , Unshackling Strike . Attack Rolls against affected creatures have Advantage . Breaks Concentration of target when applied How to learn Used by creatures: Full-Illithid Notes Compared with the base Shield of Thralls , the upgraded version can target 2 allies at once, has no cooldown, and grants 25 instead of 10 temporary hit points.

## Backbreaker
- **来源**: [Backbreaker](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Backbreaker)
- **分类**: Actions

Backbreaker is a weapon action available to characters proficient in and wielding a maul or warhammer in their main hand. Description Put extra force behind your strike to possibly knock your enemy Prone . The target can't be Huge in size. Properties Cost Action Damage: 1~4 + modifiers 1d4 + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll STR Save ( Weapon action DC ) (On Save: Targets aren't knocked prone.) Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Short rest Technical details UID Target_PostureBreaker Spell flags IsDefaultWeaponAction , IsHarmful , IsMelee Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 2 turns STR Save ( Weapon action DC ) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. How to learn Granted by wielding the following weapon types with proficiency : Mauls Warhammers Bugs This attack may only target characters that are Large size or smaller, and is missing the related tooltip warning found on similar attacks, such as Trip Attack (Melee) .

Bear Companion is a variant of Ranger's Companion which is a Subclass Feature of Rangers learned immediately upon choosing the Beast Master subclass. This ability allows the Beast Master to call upon their animal companion to fight and aid them in combat. Description Summon a black bear that can endure heavy attacks and draw the enemy's attention with its Goading Roar . Properties Cost: Action Details: Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Short rest Ursa STR 15 (+2) DEX 10 CON 14 (+2) INT 2 (-4) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 7 (-2) Hit Points 19 Armour Class 11 Size Large Summon a black Bear companion that can draw the enemy's attention and endure heavy attacks. Goading Roar ( ) Roar at nearby enemies to goad them into attacking you. Claws ( ) Lash out with deadly claws. Prey's Scent You deal an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's Hunter's Mark . Your bear companion has 19 Hit Points and 11 Armour Class . At Higher Levels Level 5 Ursa Major STR 15 (+2) DEX 10 CON 16 (+3) INT 2 (-4) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 7 (-2) Hit Points 39 Armour Class 15 Size Large New Ability: Honeyed Paws ( ) Lash out with paws sticky from honey and Disarm your target. If it isn't holding any weapons, it falls Prone instead. Companion's Bond Your Ranger's Companions receive a bonus to Armour Class and damage equal to its Proficiency Bonus . Your Bear companion now has 39 Hit Points and 15 Armour Class . Its Constitution increases by 2 and its proficiency bonus increases from +0 to +3. Level 7 Exceptional Training Your summoned companions can now Dash , Disengage , and Help as a Bonus Action . Level 8 Your Bear companion now has 69 Hit Points and 16 Armour Class . Level 11 Ursa Ingens STR 19 (+4) DEX 10 CON 16 (+3) INT 2 (-4) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 7 (-2) Hit Points 99 Armour Class 18 Size Large New Ability: Ursine Reinforcements ( ) You summon an additional bear to fight alongside you. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Bestial Fury Grants all your companions an extra attack. Your Bear companion now has 99 Hit Points and 18 Armour Class . Its Strength Increases by 4 and its proficiency bonus increases to +4. ## Benign Transposition: Teleport

- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Benign Transposition Teleport is a Conjuration School Wizard class action that you can use to teleport near or swap places with an ally. This ability can be replenished by casting a Conjuration spell or resting. Description Teleport to a nearby, unoccupied space, or swap places with an ally. Targets must be Medium or Small Properties Cost Action Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Recharge: Long rest Technical details UIDs Target_BenignTransposition_Teleport Target_LOW_BhaalCultist_BenignTransposition Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , HasVerbalComponent , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold Condition: Benign Transposition: Spent Benign Transposition: Spent Duration: Until Long rest Affected entity has used its Benign Transposition feature for the day. To replenish this feature, the entity must cast a Conjuration spell of Level 1 or higher. How to learn Classes: Class level 6: Conjuration School Notes Use of this action can be restored by casting any non-cantrip Conjuration spell. It does not need to consume a spell slot so casting Find Familiar as a ritual , using the free recasts of Cloudkill or Call Lightning , or using an item spell like Disrobing Blinkstep all replenish this feature without consuming spell slots. v t e Wizard Subclasses Abjuration School Bladesinging Conjuration School Divination School Enchantment School Evocation School Illusion School Necromancy School Transmutation School Spells Abjuration Conjuration Divination Enchantment Evocation Illusion Necromancy Transmutation Other class features Arcane Recovery Arcane Ward Benign Transposition: Teleport Bladesong Empowered Evocation Experimental Alchemy Expert Divination Extra Attack Focused Conjuration Grim Harvest Hypnotic Gaze Illusory Self Improved Abjuration Improved Minor Illusion Instinctive Charm Inured to Undeath Minor Conjuration: Create Water Portent Potent Cantrip Projected Ward Sculpt Spells See Invisibility Shapechanger Song of Defence Split Enchantment Third Eye: Darkvision Third Eye: See Invisibility Training in War and Song Transmuter's Stone Undead Thralls Animate Dead Additional Undead Better Summons
## Bhaal's Power Word Kill Ritual
- **来源**: [Bhaal's Power Word Kill Ritual](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Bhaal's_Power_Word_Kill_Ritual)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

See also: Power Word Kill Bhaal's Power Word Kill Ritual is a unique spell cast by Farslayer of Bhaal Ghislev which casts Power Word Kill on a target after completing a multi-turn ritual. Upon completion, the target of the ritual dies instantly if below 101 hit points . Description Begin a ritual that will end in you casting Power Word Kill upon the next eligible target you see. Properties Cost Action Technical details UIDs Shout_LOW_BhaalCultist_PowerWordKill_Ritual_Start Version used in Balanced with a 6 turn ritual time Shout_LOW_BhaalCultist_PowerWordKill_Ritual_Start_Hardcore Version used in Tactician and above with a 5 turn ritual time Shout_LOW_BhaalCultist_PowerWordKill_Ritual_Start_EasyMode Version used in Explorer with a 7 turn ritual time Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent Condition: Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill Duration: 5 turns As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the Farslayer has begun chanting. It can cast Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of 55 m (183 ft) makes its enemies invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict. How to learn Used by creatures: Ghislev Notes The duration of the ritual depends on the difficulty: On Explorer, it will be complete after 7 rounds. On Balanced, it will be complete after 6 rounds. On Tactician and above, it will be complete after 5 rounds. While this spell is not concentration , the ritual can be interrupted in a number of ways similar to concentration spells. For example, Silencing , Stunning , or knocking Ghislev Prone will all cancel the ritual. More generally, inflicting any condition from the following groups will also interrupt the ritual: Incapacitated (status group) Unconscious (status group) Frightened (status group) Fleeing (status group) Petrified (status group) Stunned (status group) Prone (status group) While performing the ritual, Ghislev is unable to perform any other action.
