## Bind Hexed Weapon
- **来源**: [Bind Hexed Weapon](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Bind_Hexed_Weapon)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Not to be confused with Bind Pact Weapon Bind Hexed Weapon is a class action available to The Hexblade warlocks that allows them to bind a weapon and apply Hexblade curses. Description Bind to your main hand weapon. Its damage becomes magical, you cannot drop or throw it, and you become Proficient with it if you weren't already. When you attack with this weapon, there is a chance [ See Notes ] that Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target. You can only have 1 pact weapon at any time. The weapon returns to its previous state if you are more than 1.5 m (5 ft) away from it for more than 10 rounds. Properties Cost Action Technical details UID Shout_Hexblade_Bind Condition: Hexed Weapon Hexed Weapon The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical and uses the warlock's Charisma modifier. When the warlock attacks with this weapon, there is a chance that Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target. How to learn Classes: Class level 1: The Hexblade Notes The roll to apply Hexblade's Curse is made on a d20. A roll of 17 or more is required, and no modifiers are applied. This means it has a fixed 20% chance to apply and is unaffected by anything that adjusts dice rolls such as Advantage . The duration for Hexblade's Curse cannot be refreshed by attacking with a Hexed Weapon; it can only be applied to targets that are not currently cursed. Bugs Despite the extra description of a warlock's bound weapon returning "to its previous state" , no code exists in the game which removes Hexed Weapon from a weapon that is away from the Warlock. The Hexed Weapon condition is only removed on respec if the weapon is equipped while doing do; leaving the weapon in inventory does not remove it. v t e Warlock Subclasses The Archfey The Fiend The Great Old One The Hexblade Pact Boon Pact of the Chain Pact of the Blade Pact of the Tome Eldritch Invocations Agonising Blast Armour of Shadows Beast Speech Beguiling Influence Book of Ancient Secrets Devil's Sight Dreadful Word Fiendish Vigour Lifedrinker Mask of Many Faces Minions of Chaos Mire the Mind One with Shadows Otherworldly Leap Repelling Blast Sculptor of Flesh Sign of Ill Omen Thief of Five Fates Whispers of the Grave Other class features Accursed Spectre Armour of Hexes Beguiling Defences Bind Hexed Weapon Dark One's Blessing Dark One's Own Luck Entropic Ward Fey Presence Fiendish Resilience Deepened Pact Hex Warrior Hexblade's Curse Misty Escape Mortal Reminder Mystic Arcanum Spells Thought Shield: Psychic Reflection Thought Shield: Psychic Resistance
## Bind Pact Weapon
- **来源**: [Bind Pact Weapon](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Bind_Pact_Weapon)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Not to be confused with Bind Hexed Weapon Bind Pact Weapon is a class action available to warlocks that choose Pact of the Blade at level 3. This is for binding existing weapons - to summon a new weapon, use Pact of the Blade . Description Bind to your main hand weapon. Its damage becomes magical, you cannot drop or throw it, and you become Proficient with it if you weren't already. You can only have 1 pact weapon at any time and it uses your Charisma modifier. The weapon returns to its previous state if you are more than 1.5 m (5 ft) away from it for more than 10 rounds. Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Technical details UID Shout_PactOfTheBlade_Bind Condition: Pact Weapon Pact Weapon The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical. The weapon uses the caster's Charisma modifier for Attack Rolls and damage rolls. Prevents the weapon from being dropped or otherwise disarmed. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Warlock Bugs Despite the extra description, no code exists in the game that removes Pact Weapon from a weapon that is away from the Warlock. The Pact Weapon condition only get removed on respec if the weapon was equipped. Leaving the weapon in inventory wont remove it.

How to learn Used by creatures: Vampire Spawn Other ways to learn: Agree to be bitten by Astarion after he completes Cazador's ritual (requires him to be romanced) Notes Each turn remaining of Blood-Sapped reduces the target's maximum hit points by 8. ## Black Fist Enforcers
- **来源**: [Black Fist Enforcers](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Black_Fist_Enforcers)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Black Fist Enforcers is a unique class action only available during the Confront the Elder Brain quest. It allows the party to summon Slick Inatra and Fishbait Arno to aid them in the final battle. Description Summon two elite assassin mercenaries from the Zhentarim's ranks. Available only in combat. Dismissed after combat until re-summoned. Can't be summoned again if killed in combat. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) Technical details UID Target_END_AllyAbilities_ZhentarimSummon Spell flags CannotTargetCharacter , CannotTargetItems , HasVerbalComponent , IgnoreVisionBlock , IsLinkedSpellContainer , Wildshape Creature: Slick Inatra STR 12 (+1) DEX 18 (+4) CON 12 (+1) INT 10 WIS 17 (+3) CHA 10 Duration Until combat end Hit Points 82 Armour Class 16 Slick Inatra is Ranger / Rogue multiclass with Sneak Attack and Extra Attack equipped with a Longbow +1 . Cunning Action: Dash ( ) Cover more distance this turn: double your movement speed . Ensnaring Strike (Ranged) ( + + ) Your attack summons thorny vines that possibly Ensnare your target. Sneak Attack (Ranged) ( ) Deal an extra 1d6 damage to a foe you have Advantage against. ( Recharge: Per turn.) Wolf Companion ( ) Summon a wolf that can inflict devastating wounds and knock down enemies with its Lunging Bite . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Creature: Fishbait Arno STR 11 DEX 16 (+3) CON 13 (+1) INT 12 (+1) WIS 10 CHA 10 Duration Until combat end Hit Points 76 Armour Class 14 Size Small Fishbait Arno is Rogue equipped with a Rapier +1 . Cunning Action: Dash ( ) Cover more distance this turn: double your movement speed . Flourish ( ) Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Piercing Strike ( ) Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Sneak Attack (Melee) ( ) Deal an extra 1d6 damage to a foe you have Advantage against. ( Recharge: Per turn.) Weakening Strike ( ) Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict Weak Grip . ( Recharge: Short rest .) How to learn This spell is a variation of: Gather Your Allies (class action) Other ways to learn: By completing the quest ⁠ Aid the Underduke and siding with the Zhentarim against the Guild, gaining the Zhentarim as an ally during Gather Your Allies . Notes Slick Inatra and Fishbait Arno will be replaced by Gravedigger Karcen and Phase if they are killed during the battle for the Guildhall. If they have also died, Zhent Elf , Zhent Half-Elven and Zhentmodeus will in turn be the summoned fallback characters.

## Black Hole
- **来源**: [Black Hole](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Black_Hole)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the normal illithid power. For the improved full-illithid version, see Nebulous Black Hole . Black Hole is an action and Illithid Power . This ability creates a black hole which pulls in nearby enemies and possibly Slows them. Description Create a point of intense gravity that pulls in all nearby enemies and possibly Slows them. Five more black holes can be summoned after this spell's initial casting. [ See Notes ] Afterwards, you must Short Rest before casting it again. Properties Cost Action Details INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 18 m (60 ft) AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Radius Pulls: 6 m (20 ft) (Towards AoE center, no saving throw) Targets: All enemies in AoE Recharge: Short rest Duration: 5 turns Technical details UID Target_TAD_BlackHole Spell flags DisableBlood , IsHarmful Condition: Slowed (Black Hole) Slowed Duration: 1 turn INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Affected entity's Movement Speed is halved, and its Armour Class and Dexterity Saving Throws are reduced by 2. The entity can't take Reactions or make more than 1 attack per turn, [ See: Bugs ] and can only take either an Action or a Bonus Action . Spells cast might be delayed for 1 turn. [ See: Bugs ] How to learn Used by creatures: Disciple Z'rell and Metamage Persecutor Other ways to learn: Unlock with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining one of the following illithid powers : Displace Psionic Dominance Notes The description that "five more black holes can be summoned after this spell's initial casting" is misleading. Rather, the caster is granted the ability to recast Black Hole for 5 turns. This ability will be lost after 5 turns whether or not Black Hole was used 5 more times. Conversely, with sources of additional actions, Black Hole can be recast more than 5 times during this period.
## Blade Flourish
- **来源**: [Blade Flourish](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Blade_Flourish)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Blade Flourish is an enhancement to Bardic Inspiration available to College of Swords Bards at Level 3 that provides a series of Weapon Action -like actions that all require a Bardic Inspiration Charge to use. Normal Bardic Inspiration actions are still available to College of Swords Bards. Blade Flourish Description Grants Defensive Flourish Attack defensively, increasing your Armour Class by 4 if you hit. Defensive Flourish (Melee) Defensive Flourish (Ranged) Slashing Flourish Attack up to 2 enemies at once. Slashing Flourish (Melee) Slashing Flourish (Ranged) Mobile Flourish Thrust your weapon with enough force to push your target back 6 m (20 ft). Afterwards, you can Teleport to the target. Mobile Flourish (Melee) Mobile Flourish (Ranged) Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] The Bardic Inspiration Charge is only used up if the attack hits. Slashing Flourish does 2 separate attack rolls rather than one for both targets. Slashing Flourish (Ranged) simply lets you select two targets of your choice using the targeting system of Magic Missile . Slashing Flourish (Melee) does a cleave and hits 2 targets. Both Mobile Flourish teleports use standard movement. In order to teleport you need 6 m (20 ft) movement remaining plus whatever distance you are from the target before the push. v t e Bard Subclasses College of Glamour College of Lore College of Swords College of Valour Inspiration Bardic Inspiration Combat Inspiration Font of Inspiration Improved Bardic Inspiration Mantle of Inspiration Blade Flourish Defensive Flourish Melee Ranged Slashing Flourish Melee Ranged Mobile Flourish Melee Ranged Other class features Countercharm Cutting Words Expertise Extra Attack Jack of All Trades Magical Secrets Mantle of Majesty: Command Song of Rest Spells

## Boar Charge
- **来源**: [Boar Charge](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Boar_Charge)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Boar Charge is a Boar Companion action. Boars use this ability to charge toward enemies and deal slashing damage as well as knock them Prone . Description Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and possibly knocking them Prone . Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks . Properties Cost Action Damage: 2~5 1d4 + 1 ⁠ Slashing Details Melee Unarmed Attack Roll STR Save ( Spell save DC ) AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Line Targets: All enemies in path Duration: 2 turns Technical details UID Rush_Rush_Boar_Summon Spell flags IsHarmful Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 2 turns STR Save ( Spell save DC ) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. How to learn Used by creatures: Verres , Verres Calamitosus , and Verres Major Notes At level 5 with Companion's Bond and Rage active, this attack is significantly more powerful than the tooltip suggests. It will deal Damage: 8~14 1d4 + 1 ⁠ Slashing (Base) + 1d4 + 2 ⁠ Slashing (From Rage) + 3 ⁠ Slashing (From Companion's Bond) to all enemies in the path of the charge. The spellcasting ability used by boar companions is Strength . This gives a Difficulty Class for the Prone effect of 9 at level 3, 13 at level 5, and 14 at level 11. The extremely low DC at level 3 is because the proficiency bonus of the beast companions is 0 until level 5 when it increases to 3. Both Elixir of Hill Giant Strength and Elixir of Battlemage's Power will increase this DC. Animal companions and other summons can consume these items from the party's inventory.
## Boar Companion
- **来源**: [Boar Companion](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Boar_Companion)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Boar Companion is a variant of Ranger's Companion which is a Subclass Feature of Rangers learned immediately upon choosing the Beast Master subclass. This ability allows the Beast Master to call upon their animal companion to fight and aid them in combat. Description Summon a boar that can sweep through the battlefield and knock enemies off their feet with its Charge . Properties Cost: Action Details: Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Short rest Verres STR 13 (+1) DEX 11 CON 12 (+1) INT 2 (-4) WIS 9 (-1) CHA 5 (-3) Hit Points 11 Armour Class 11 Summon a Boar companion that can sweep through the battlefield and knock enemies off their feet. Tusk Attack ( ) Gore a target. Boar Charge ( ) Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and possibly knocking them Prone . Prey's Scent You deal an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's Hunter's Mark . Your boar companion has 11 Hit Points and 11 Armour Class . At Higher Levels Level 5 Verres Major STR 15 (+2) DEX 11 CON 12 (+1) INT 2 (-4) WIS 9 (-1) CHA 5 (-3) Hit Points 27 Armour Class 14 Rage ( ) Go into a frenzy, increasing your size and becoming stronger through raw anger. ( Recharge: Per combat.) Frenzied Strike ( ) Gore an enemy as a bonus action while in a fit of rage. Companion's Bond Your Ranger's Companions receive a bonus to Armour Class and damage equal to its Proficiency Bonus . Your Boar companion now has 27 Hit Points and 14 Armour Class . Its Strength increases by 2 and its proficiency bonus increases from +0 to +3. Level 7 Exceptional Training Your summoned companions can now Dash , Disengage , and Help as a Bonus Action . Level 8 Your Boar companion now has 51 Hit Points and 15 Armour Class . Level 11 Verres Calamitosus STR 15 (+2) DEX 11 CON 16 (+3) INT 2 (-4) WIS 9 (-1) CHA 5 (-3) Hit Points 85 Armour Class 17 Kick Up Muck ( ) Slather a target in mud, Slowing them. Bestial Fury Grants all your companions an extra attack. Your Boar companion now has 85 Hit Points and 17 Armour Class . Its Constitution increases by 4 and its proficiency bonus increases to +4. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Beast Master This action is a variation of: Ranger's Companion Notes The Spell Save DC for this creature is Strength . Bolstering Magic: Level 1 Spell Slot is a Wild Magic Barbarian class action. This ability recovers a level 1 spell slot for you or an ally, once per long rest. Description You or an ally recover a Level 1 Spell Slot . Properties Cost Action Details Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Recharge: Long rest Technical details UID Target_BolsteringMagic_SpellSlot1 Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , IsMelee How to learn Classes: Class level 6: Wild Magic Barbarian Notes If the target has both level 1 Warlock spell slots and normal level 1 spell slots, this action will prioritise restoring the normal spell slot first. ## Bolt of Celestial Light
- **来源**: [Bolt of Celestial Light](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Bolt_of_Celestial_Light)
- **分类**: Actions

Bolt of Celestial Light is a weapon action granted by Gontr Mael . Description Frighten your target with intimidating arrows. After attacking, ranged weapon attacks made by Gontr Mael deal an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant damage. Properties Cost Action Damage: 1~8 + modifiers Normal weapon damage + Proficiency bonus ⁠ Piercing + 1d8 ⁠ Radiant Details Ranged Weapon Attack Roll WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Short rest Duration: 10 turns Technical details UID Projectile_MAG_Victory_Longbow_RoaringShot Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , IsDefaultWeaponAction , IsHarmful , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold Condition: Frightened Frightened Duration: 2 turns WIS Save ( Weapon action DC ) Cannot move. Frightened entities also have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls . Condition: Ever Radiant Ever Radiant Duration: 10 turns Deals an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant . How to learn Granted by items: Gontr Mael Notes The 10 round buff is triggered regardless if the weapon action hits or misses. This weapon action can still be used even if the wielder is not proficient with Longbows. Bugs This action does not use Superiority Dice at any time, contrary to the in-game tooltip stating "On Miss: Does not spend Superiority Dice." A hidden technical condition, which is responsible for applying a visual effect to struck targets, triggers the passives from Boots of Stormy Clamour , Coldbrim Hat , and Diadem of Arcane Synergy .

## Break of Dawn
- **来源**: [Break of Dawn](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Break_of_Dawn)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Break of Dawn is an action used by Dawnbreaker traps in the Rosymorn Monastery to push invaders to their deaths. Description Emit a pulse of energy and possibly push all nearby creatures and objects away and knock them Prone . Properties Cost Action Damage: 1~6 1d6 ⁠ Radiant ( Constitution Saving Throw to negate) Details CON Save ( DC  18) (On Save: Targets are not pushed back.) Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) AoE: 20 m (67 ft) Cone Pushes: 8 m (27 ft) Technical details UID Zone_CRE_PulseTrap_Blast Spell flags IsHarmful , IsTrap Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 1 turn CON Save ( DC  18) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. How to learn Other ways to learn: Triggered by traps in the Rosymorn Monastery . ## Bufotoxin
- **来源**: [Bufotoxin](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Bufotoxin)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Bufotoxin is a class action used by Conjured Frogs that deals Acid damage and potentially applies a toxin. Description Touch a creature and possibly impose Disadvantage on its Dexterity Saving Throws . Properties Cost Action Damage: 1 1 ⁠ Acid Details CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Technical details UID Target_Bufotoxin_Frog_Summon Spell flags IgnoreSilence , IsAttack , IsHarmful , IsMelee Condition: Bufotoxin Bufotoxin Duration: 10 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws . How to learn Used by creatures: Conjured Frog Notes The spellcasting ability of a conjured frog is Dexterity so this will have a DC of 11 which could theoretically be improved by feeding the familiar a Elixir of Battlemage's Power . This is one of a very small handful of attacks that do not use Attack Rolls but work with Extra Attack . This exception is made so that Pact of the Chain's Deepened Pact works with frog familiars.
## Bull Rush
- **来源**: [Bull Rush](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Bull_Rush)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Bull Rush is a special class action granted by The Mighty Cloth that lets the wearer charge forward and potentially knock over all enemies along the path. Description Charge forward and possibly knock your foes back 3 m (10 ft). Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Properties Cost Action + Movement Speed Details STR Save ( Weapon action DC ) AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Line Pushes: 3 m (10 ft) Recharge: Per turn Technical details UID Rush_MAG_Barbarian_Armor_Trample Spell flags AddFallDamageOnLand , CanAreaDamageEvade , IsHarmful How to learn Granted by items: The Mighty Cloth Notes The effect is applied in a 2 m (7 ft) radius along the charge path. Unlike Shove, this does not show the potential trajectories of the targets. Bugs The in-game tooltip is not accurate. It is duplicated from the similar Primal Stampede ability. In particular, the tooltip says Bull Rush does damage, knocks targets prone, and is only available while Raging , none of which are true.

## Burrow (Bulette)

This article is about the version of the ability available to Bulettes. For other uses, see Burrow (disambiguation) . Burrow is a Bulette class action. It will use this ability after two rounds of combat to escape. [ 1 ] Description Burrow into the ground to escape combat and recover hit points. Properties Cost Action Healing: 18~74 8d8 + 10 ⁠ Healing Details Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Technical details UID Target_Burrow_Bulette Spell flags IsHarmful , IsMelee How to learn Used by creatures: Bulette Notes The healing effect can be prevented with Bone Chill , thus preventing the bulette from healing between encounters. References [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ This behaviour is defined in Mods/Gustav/Story/RawFiles/Goals/Act1_UND_Bulette.txt . When combat with the bulette starts, a 12 second, or two round, timer starts ( UND_BULETTE_DESPAWNTIMER ). At the end of this timer, a flag is set which instructs the bulette to use this ability on its next turn.

Properties Cost Action Damage: 2~20 2d10 ⁠ Piercing Details Attack Roll Range: 9 m (30 ft) Technical details UID Projectile_BurstingBrood_Spider Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , IsHarmful Condition: Infested (Bursting Brood) Infested Duration: Until Long rest Crawling with tiny spiders that deal 1d4 Piercing damage and 1d4 Necrotic damage each turn. How to learn Classes: Class level 11: Beast Master Used by creatures: Aranea Aculeata Notes The Attack Roll uses Strength unlike all of Wolf Spider Companion 's other abilities which use Dexterity. At level 11, the spider will have 18 Dexterity, but only 12 Strength, so this attack roll will be significantly more difficult than its other attacks. Properties Cost Action + Bonus Action + Reaction Technical details UIDs Shout_MindFlayerForm Shout_END_MindFlayerFormCivilian Shout_LOW_MindFlayerFormCivilian Condition: Mind Flayer Form Mind Flayer Form Duration: Permanent Affected entity has completed ceremorphosis and become a mind flayer. ## Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
- **来源**: [Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Channel_Divinity:_Cloak_of_Shadows)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions、Channel_Divinity_actions

For the equivalent Way of Shadow Monk class action, see Cloak of Shadows . Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows is a Trickery Domain Cleric class action that allows the user to enter the shadows and disappear from sight. Description Wrap yourself in shadows to become Invisible if you are obscured . [ See: Bugs ] Invisibility ends early if you attack, cast another spell, take an action, or take damage. Properties Cost Action + Channel Divinity Charge Details Range: Self Technical details UID Shout_CloakOfShadows Spell flags Invisible , Stealth Condition: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows Duration: 2 turns Has Advantage on Attack Rolls and imposes Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage. How to learn Classes: Class level 6: Trickery Domain Bugs This ability incorrectly uses the description from Cloak of Shadows . It does not actually require the user to be obscured, and can be used in plain view of others, even in bright light. v t e Cleric Subclasses Death Domain Knowledge Domain Life Domain Light Domain Nature Domain Tempest Domain Trickery Domain War Domain Channel Divinity Charge Charm Animals and Plants Cloak of Shadows Destructive Wrath Dampen Elements Guided Strike Invoke Duplicity Knowledge of the Ages Preserve Life Radiance of the Dawn Read Thoughts Touch of Death War God's Blessing Divine Strike Radiant (Melee) Radiant (Ranged) Poison (Melee) Poison (Ranged) Cold (Melee) Cold (Ranged) Fire (Melee) Fire (Ranged) Lightning (Melee) Lightning (Ranged) Necrotic (Melee) Necrotic (Ranged) Thunder (Melee) Thunder (Ranged) Weapon (Melee) Weapon (Ranged) Other class features Acolyte of Nature Blessed Healer Blessing of the Trickster Blessings of Knowledge Destroy Undead Disciple of Life Divine Intervention Expertise Improved Warding Flare Inescapable Destruction Potent Spellcasting Reaper Spells Thunderbolt Strike Turn Undead War Priest Warding Flare Wrath of the Storm
## Charge (Deep Rothé)
- **来源**: [Charge (Deep Rothé)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Charge_(Deep_Rothé))
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the version of the ability available in wild shape form. For the version used by Deep Rothé creatures, see Frenzied Charge . For other uses, see Charge (disambiguation) . Charge is a Wild Shape: Deep Rothé action. Deep Rothé use this ability to ram into enemies in a straight line, dealing piercing damage and possibly knocking them prone. Description Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and possibly knocking them Prone . Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Properties Cost Action + Movement Speed Damage: 1~6 + modifiers 1d6 + Strength modifier ⁠ Piercing Details Melee Unarmed Attack Roll STR Save ( Spell save DC ) AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Line At higher levels At Level 4, this attack deals an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing damage. At Level 8, this additional damage becomes 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing . At Level 12, this additional damage becomes 1d10 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing . Technical details UID Rush_Rush_DeepRothe Spell flags IsHarmful Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 2 turns STR Save ( Spell save DC ) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. How to learn Used by creatures: Wild Shape: Deep Rothé Bugs This ability can target dead creatures, leading to unintended interactions with other on-hit effects such as Cull the Weak .
## Charge (Minotaur)

- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

See also: Charge (disambiguation) Charge is a class action available to Minotaurs that allows them to charge forward, push foes and leave them Prone . Description Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way, pushing them back 2 m (7 ft) and possibly knocking them Prone . Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Properties Cost Action + Movement Speed Damage: 8~36 4d8 + 4 ⁠ Piercing Details Attack Roll STR Save ( DC  14) AoE: 12 m (40 ft) Line Pushes: 2 m (7 ft) Recharge: Per turn Technical details UIDs Rush_Charge_Minotaur Rush_Charge_Minotaur_Ally Spell flags AddFallDamageOnLand , IsEnemySpell , IsHarmful Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 2 turns STR Save ( DC  14) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. How to learn Used by creatures: Minotaur Notes This charge has a minimum range of 4.5 m (15 ft) so at closer ranges, a minotaur will use its weaker Gore attack.
## Charger: Shove
- **来源**: [Charger: Shove](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Charger:_Shove)
- **分类**: Actions、Bonus_actions

Charger: Shove is a weapon action granted by the Charger feat that lets you rush forward and shove the first enemy in your path. This ability uses both your Action and your Bonus Action . Description Charge forward and Shove the first enemy in your way. Your chances depend on your Athletics , and are higher if you're hidden or invisible. The shove distance depends on your Strength and the target's weight. Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Properties Cost Action + Bonus Action Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Technical details UID Rush_Charger_Push Spell flags AddFallDamageOnLand , IsHarmful How to learn Granted by features: Charger Notes The target gets shoved depending on the result of a contest using the attacker's Athletics and the target's Acrobatics or Athletics (whichever is higher). Unlike the ordinary Shove, this does not show the potential trajectory of the target. Cannot be used while immobile. ## Charger: Weapon Attack
- **来源**: [Charger: Weapon Attack](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Charger:_Weapon_Attack)
- **分类**: Actions、Bonus_actions

Charger: Weapon Attack is a weapon action granted by the Charger feat. The attacker chargers forward in a straight line and makes a powerful weapon attack against the first creature in the path. Description Deal more damage: charge forward and slam your weapon in the first enemy in your way. Doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks. Properties Cost Action + Bonus Action Damage: 5 Normal weapon damage + 5 ⁠ Weapon Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Range: 9 m (30 ft) Targets: First creature or object in the charge path Technical details UID Rush_Charger_Attack Spell flags IsHarmful How to learn Granted by features: Charger Notes The charge does not stop after hitting its target so you can charge through your enemy by targeting the ground behind it. The charge can only deal damage to one target, though. This attack has a deceptively wide collision radius during the charge and can hit allies or breakable objects like crates. You can accidentally hit an ally or object instead of your intended target simply by charging past it. The creature or object that will be hit by the charge will be highlighted when targeting the ability. This action follows high ground rules despite being a melee attack: Charging down a slope from an elevation at least 2.5 m (8 ft) above the target provides the +2 high ground bonus to the attack roll. Charging up a slope to a target at least 2.5 m (8 ft) above the starting position imposes the -2 low ground penalty to the attack roll.
## Charm Animals and Plants
- **来源**: [Charm Animals and Plants](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Charm_Animals_and_Plants)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions、Channel_Divinity_actions

Charm Animals and Plants is a class action available to Nature Domain clerics. This ability allows these clerics to reduce the aggressiveness of nearby fauna and flora. Description Channel fey magic to Charm nearby beasts and plants. Properties Cost Action + Channel Divinity Charge Details WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: Self AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Radius Targets: All beasts and plants in range Technical details UID Shout_CharmAnimalsAndPlants Condition: Charmed (Charm Animals and Plants) Charmed Duration: 10 turns Friendly to the charmer and its allies. Taking damage ends this condition. How to learn Classes: Class level 2: Nature Domain Notes Some plants, such as the Wood Woad , are inherently immune to charms and will not be affected by this spell. Bugs This spell does not function as described, and instead acts similarly to Charm Person . As such, and despite the lack of related tooltip warnings, this action is considered hostile by creatures that make a successful saving throw against it. The condition also ends early if the caster or an ally hurts the target, and in higher difficulty modes, the target might become hostile when the spell ends. The in-game tooltip incorrectly links the default Charmed condition instead of the condition it actually applies. v t e Cleric Subclasses Death Domain Knowledge Domain Life Domain Light Domain Nature Domain Tempest Domain Trickery Domain War Domain Channel Divinity Charge Charm Animals and Plants Cloak of Shadows Destructive Wrath Dampen Elements Guided Strike Invoke Duplicity Knowledge of the Ages Preserve Life Radiance of the Dawn Read Thoughts Touch of Death War God's Blessing Divine Strike Radiant (Melee) Radiant (Ranged) Poison (Melee) Poison (Ranged) Cold (Melee) Cold (Ranged) Fire (Melee) Fire (Ranged) Lightning (Melee) Lightning (Ranged) Necrotic (Melee) Necrotic (Ranged) Thunder (Melee) Thunder (Ranged) Weapon (Melee) Weapon (Ranged) Other class features Acolyte of Nature Blessed Healer Blessing of the Trickster Blessings of Knowledge Destroy Undead Disciple of Life Divine Intervention Expertise Improved Warding Flare Inescapable Destruction Potent Spellcasting Reaper Spells Thunderbolt Strike Turn Undead War Priest Warding Flare Wrath of the Storm

## Clench of the North Wind
- **来源**: [Clench of the North Wind](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Clench_of_the_North_Wind)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Clench of the North Wind is an action that allows a Way of the Four Elements monk to cast their equivalent of Hold Person by expending Ki Points instead of spell slots. Description Hold a humanoid enemy still. They can't move, act or react. Attacks from within 3 m (10 ft) are always critical hits . Properties Cost Action + 3 Ki Points Details WIS Save Range: 18 m (60 ft) Concentration At higher levels At level 9, hold up to 2 humanoids. Technical details UID Target_HoldPerson_Monk Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension , HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsConcentration , IsHarmful Condition: Hold Person Hold Person Duration: 10 turns WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Affected entity can't Move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions . Attacks against the entity automatically succeed their Attack Roll . Attacks against the entity are always Critical Hits if the attacker is within Range: 3 m (10 ft). Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a Wisdom Saving Throw . On a successful save, the condition is removed. How to learn Classes: Class level 6: Way of the Four Elements Notes Unlike with an upcast Hold Person , the targets of a level 9 Clench of the North Wind do not need to be distinct. This means a single target can be chosen twice, forcing it to make two initial saves. However, on subsequent turns, it will only need to succeed one saving throw to remove the Hold Person effect since multiple instances of this effect do not stack. Bugs Unlike other Way of the Four Elements actions, this still retains its HasVerbalComponent SpellFlag from its parent spell Hold Person and thus cannot be used while Silenced .

## Combustible Coins
- **来源**: [Combustible Coins](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Combustible_Coins)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Combustible Coins is an action available to Gerringothe Thorm , which creates several piles of coins which will detonate at the end of the next round, dealing force damage. Description Enchant a pile of coins to explode. Properties Cost Action Damage: 3~24 3d8 ⁠ Force Details DEX Save (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) AoE: 5 m (17 ft) Radius Recharge: Per turn Technical details UID Shout_CoinBomb_TollCollector Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , IsEnemySpell Condition: Explosive Hoard Explosive Hoard Duration: 1 turn This mound of coins is primed to explode. How to learn Used by creatures: Gerringothe Thorm Notes Can be removed by simply picking up the pile of enchanted coins. The summary is a bit misleading. Gerringothe does not create piles of coins for this action but instead enchants existing piles. Gerringothe and Grim Visages are immune to this damage. Gerringothe can only make this action if at least one pile of 100 gold from a destroyed piece of coin armour is on the floor. Such a coin pile dropped by the party does not work (but any coin pile can be exploded). Exploded piles of coins are not destroyed and can be picked up afterwards.
## Commander's Strike
- **来源**: [Commander's Strike](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Commander's_Strike)
- **分类**: Actions、Bonus_actions、Class_actions

Commander's Strike is a Battle Master fighter class action. This combat manoeuvre allows the fighter to expend an action, bonus action, and Superiority Dice to have an ally make a single melee weapon attack as a reaction on one of their subsequent turns. Description Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses a reaction on their next turn to make a weapon attack . Properties Cost Action + Bonus Action + Superiority Die Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Technical details UID Target_CommandersStrike Spell flags IsHarmful , IsMelee Grants: Commander's Strike (Attack) Condition: Onus of Battle Onus of Battle Duration: 3 turns Affected entity can immediately use a Reaction to make a weapon attack. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Battle Master Granted by features: Martial Adept Granted by items: Duke Ravengard's Longsword ( Recharge: Short rest ) Ravengard's Scourger ( Recharge: Short rest ) Notes Onus of Battle ends immediately after the granted attack is made, even if it misses. The granted attack must be a melee weapon attack and cannot be ranged or an unarmed strike. Commander's Strike triggers Extra Attack for the character using this manoeuvre. The weapon attack given to an ally does not trigger extra attack, since it does not cost an Action . Best used on a character that can make strong weapon attacks, such as a Paladin or a Rogue . Note, however, that under most circumstances, Rogues only get one sneak attack (typically on their turn) per combat round. So granting a Rogue an extra attack here usually does not afford the desired extra sneak attack damage. v t e Fighter Subclasses Arcane Archer Battle Master Champion Eldritch Knight Fighting Styles Archery Defence Duelling Great Weapon Fighting Protection Two-Weapon Fighting Manoeuvres Commander's Strike Disarming Attack Distracting Strike Evasive Footwork Feinting Attack Goading Attack Manoeuvring Attack Menacing Attack Precision Attack Pushing Attack Rally Riposte Sweeping Attack Trip Attack Arcane Shots Banishing Arrow Beguiling Arrow Bursting Arrow Enfeebling Arrow Grasping Arrow Piercing Arrow Seeking Arrow Shadow Arrow Other class features Action Surge Curving Shot Eldritch Strike Extra Attack Improved Critical Hit Improved Extra Attack Improved Combat Superiority Indomitable Magic Arrow Remarkable Athlete: Jump Remarkable Athlete: Proficiency Second Wind War Magic Weapon Bond
## Concentrated Blast
- **来源**: [Concentrated Blast](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Concentrated_Blast)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the normal illithid power. For the improved full-illithid version, see Potent Concentrated Blast . Concentrated Blast is an action and Illithid Power . This ability deals 3d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage to an enemy, but can only be cast by a character who is concentrating on another spell. If the target is also concentrating on a spell, the caster is healed for an amount equal to the damage dealt. When this ability is used, whatever spell the caster was concentrating on will end. Description You must be concentrating on another spell to cast this. If the target was concentrating, you heal as much as the damage that was dealt to it. The spell you were concentrating on will end. Properties Cost Action Damage: 3~18 3d6 ⁠ Psychic Healing: 3~18 3d6 ⁠ Healing (Conditional) Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Recharge: Per turn Technical details UID Target_TAD_ConcentratedBlast Spell flags DisableBlood , IsHarmful How to learn Used by creatures: Illithid and Partial-Illithid Other ways to learn: Unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen . Unlocked automatically after becoming a Partial-Illithid Notes The caster must have an active Concentration spell Ends the caster's active Concentration spell when cast On a successful hit, if the target was concentrating on a spell itself, heals the caster for an amount equal to the damage dealt to the target. If the target wasn't concentrating on a spell, only damage is dealt but no healing received. Concentrated Blast has no Attack Roll or Saving Throw , which means that it will always hit an eligible target.

Constrict is a class action exclusive to Shadow-Cursed Vine Blights . It restrains and damages a target as long as the blight maintains concentration. It spreads shadow-cursed vines in an area leading to and around the target. The blight is considered Constricting while concentrating on this ability and cannot move or act. Description Wrap your cursed tendrils around a creature to constrict it. Properties Cost Action Damage: 7~20 2d6 + 4 ⁠ Bludgeoning + 1d4 ⁠ Necrotic Details STR Save ( DC  14) Range: 14 m (47 ft) Recharge: Per turn Concentration Technical details UID Target_Constrict_Blight_Vine Spell flags CannotTargetItems , CannotTargetTerrain , HasSomaticComponent , IgnoreSilence , IsConcentration , IsEnemySpell Condition: Constricted Constricted Duration: 4 turns STR Save ( DC  14) Affected entity can't move. Attack Rolls against it have Advantage , while its attack rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have Disadvantage . The entity takes 2d6+2 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing and 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic per turn. Can be removed by Help . Condition: Constricting Constricting Duration: 4 turns Wrapped around a target to Constrict it and can't move. How to learn Used by creatures: Shadow-Cursed Vine Blight Notes Land's Stride: Advantage gives Advantage on the saving throw of this ability. Land's Stride: Plants , Freedom of Movement , and similar features will prevent you from being restrained by this ability, but the initial damage will still be applied on a failed save. If this happens, the blight will continue to behave as if it successfully restrained its target and be stuck in place Constricting nothing for 4 turns. The Constricted condition can be removed by Help . A blight will prioritize using this ability on a target afflicted by Digestive Juices to set up the Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound 's deadly Devour attack.
## Control Undead
- **来源**: [Control Undead](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Control_Undead)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Control Undead is a Channel Oath action available to those that have chosen the path of the Oathbreaker paladin. This ability allows these paladins to gain control over the undead. Description Use the power of your Oath to gain control over an undead creature. The undead will follow you around and attack your enemies. The target's level must be lower than yours. Properties Cost Action + Channel Oath Charge Details WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 6 m (20 ft) Technical details UID Target_ControlUndead Condition: Controlled Controlled Duration: Until Long rest WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) This undead is under the control of a Paladin . It will follow the Paladin and attack their enemies. Condition: Controlling Undead Controlling Undead Duration: Until Long rest This paladin has control over an undead creature. The creature will follow them and attack their enemies. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Oathbreaker Notes Despite the name, this does not allow the player to control the targeted creature. It causes the creature to become an allied NPC that will simply attack the nearest enemy of the caster, or follow the caster around if there are no enemies nearby. Control of the target is lost if the Paladin is Downed , and does not come back if the Paladin recovers. This can be used on several undead creatures including some bosses so long as they are "alive", Undead , a lower level than the caster, and don't have the Immune to Control Undead passive. NPCs that die due to the Shadow Curse will revive a turn or two later as a Shadow-Cursed Undead , gaining the Undead type making them susceptible to this ability. This interestingly can be exploited to capture certain NPCs as a "pet" of sorts until the next Long Rest. You can Control Undead any Shadow-Cursed Undead NPC and pickpocket them without turning them hostile until you succeed. This means that you can kill and then carry or push any Act 1 or Act 2 vendor to the Shadow-Cursed Lands and then pickpocket all of their equipment for free. v t e Paladin Subclasses Oath of Devotion Oath of the Ancients Oath of the Crown Oath of Vengeance Oathbreaker Channel Oath Charge Abjure Enemy Champion Challenge Control Undead Dreadful Aspect Healing Radiance Holy Rebuke Inquisitor's Might Nature's Wrath Righteous Clarity Spiteful Suffering Sacred Weapon Turn the Faithless Turn the Tide Turn the Unholy Vow of Enmity Aura Courage Devotion Hate Protection Warding Other class features Divine Allegiance Divine Health Divine Sense Divine Smite Extra Attack Lay on Hands Improved Divine Smite Relentless Avenger Spells

## Dash
- **来源**: [Dash](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Dash)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Dash is a basic, common action available to almost every creature. It doubles the movement speed of a creature for one turn. Description Cover more distance this turn: double your Movement Speed . Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Duration: 1 turn Technical details UIDs Shout_Dash Shout_Dash_NPC Shout_Dash_HookHorror Spell flags IgnoreSilence , Invisible , NoCameraMove , Stealth Condition: Dash Dash Duration: 1 turn Movement Speed is doubled. Details [ edit section | visual editor ] Stacking dashes [ edit section | visual editor ] Dashing multiple times in a turn is possible with additional actions from features like Action Surge or Haste or by using bonus action dashes like Cunning Action: Dash . When dashing multiple times, the movement bonus from Dash stacks by addition rather than multiplication. For example, a character with 9 m (30 ft) movement speed who dashes twice gets 9 m (30 ft) bonus movement speed added twice for a total of 27 m (90 ft) (a 3x multiplier) rather than doubling the movement speed twice (which would be a 4x multiplier). Similarly, dashing three times applies a movement speed multiplier of 4x, not 8x. Dashing more than three times in a turn has no effect; subsequent dashes simply do not add any additional movement speed. [ 1 ] The special dash-like action Click Heels does stack multiplicatively with normal dashes. That is, dashing and using Click Heels doubles movement speed, and then doubles it again for a 4x multiplier. Dashing three times and using Click heels increases movement speed by 8x. The order of the dashes and Click Heels does not matter and the total movement speed increase is the same. Dash variants [ edit section | visual editor ] Aside from the base Dash action available to every creature, there are a number of special, cheaper dash actions available to certain classes or under certain conditions. Click Heels – Dash-like bonus action granted by the Boots of Speed . Cunning Action: Dash – Bonus action dash available to rogues at level 2. Dash (bonus action) – Bonus action dash from Expeditious Retreat or Rage: Eagle Heart . Note that even though the initial cast of Expeditious Retreat grants Dash , it does not count as a dash action for certain interactions. Step of the Wind: Dash – Bonus action dash available to monks at level 2. This action also requires a Ki Point . Related items [ edit section | visual editor ] The following items trigger an effect when using Dash: Boots of Arcane Bolstering – Grants two turns of Arcane Charge Fleetfingers – Grants a free, special Jump action Linebreaker Boots – Grants three stacks of Wrath Springstep Boots – Grants three stacks of Momentum The Speedy Lightfeet – Grants three Lightning Charges These items also trigger when using any of the dash variants. Other movement actions such as Charger or Primal Stampede do not count as dashes for these items. Related features [ edit section | visual editor ] Aspect of the Beast: Stallion – Receive temporary hit points with the Dash condition. Note that Aspect of the Beast (Stallion) does not work with Click Heels, which grants a distinct condition ( Click Heels ), nor does it work with stacked dashes since they are separate, but identically named, conditions. [ 1 ] Mobile Shot – Requires the Dash condition (or the Disengage condition) in order to use the attack. It also only works with a single dash and not stacked dashes. See also [ edit section | visual editor ] List of sources of movement speed References [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ 1.0 1.1 The way Dash is coded, subsequent dashes replace the normal DASH condition with DASH_STACKED after the second dash and DASH_STACKED_2 after the third dash. This does not support stacking dash beyond the third time so any additional dashes have no effect.

Devour is a class action used by Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound . This ability allows the shambling mound to devour and instantly kill a creature that is restrained and covered in digestive juices. Description Devour a creature that's Restrained and marinating in your Digestive Juices . Properties Cost Action Details Attack Roll Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Technical details UID Target_Devour_ShadowMound Spell flags IsHarmful , IsMelee How to learn Used by creatures: Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound Notes The Shadow-Cursed Shambling Mound can use the potent combination of Digestive Sap and Devour in a single turn. It will target any restrained creature with Digestive Sap (who will roll the saving throw at Disadvantage due to being restrained). If successful, it will immediately follow up with Devour and instantly kill the target. As a result, it is important to avoid being restrained in the first place. This is most easily accomplished with Freedom of Movement or Ring of Free Action . Before Patch 6, Devour dealt 10d10 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing instead of killing the target instantly.

Dire Raven Companion is a variant of Ranger's Companion which is the signature Beast Master subclass feature. This ability allows the Beast Master to summon a raven companion to fight and aid them in combat. Only one beast companion of any time can be summoned at once. Description Summon a dire raven that can fly and Blind its enemies. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Short rest Corvus STR 6 (-2) DEX 14 (+2) CON 8 (-1) INT 3 (-4) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 6 (-2) Hit Points 13 Armour Class 16 Size Small Summon a Corvus , a dire raven companion that can cover great distances and blind enemies. It has 13 Hit Points and 16 Armour Class . It is also proficient in Perception and can use the following abilities: Beak Attack ( ) Peck at a target. Rend Vision ( ) Attack a creature's eyes and Blind it. Prey's Scent You deal an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Physical damage to creatures marked by your Ranger's Hunter's Mark . Fly ( ) Fly to a target position At higher levels Level 5 Corvus Major STR 6 (-2) DEX 14 (+2) CON 10 INT 3 (-4) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 6 (-2) Hit Points 21 Armour Class 19 Size Small Your dire raven companion advances to Corvus Major . It now has 21 Hit Points and 19 Armour Class . Its Constitution increases by 2 and its proficiency bonus increases from +0 to +3. The damage of its Beak Attack and Rend Vision increases by 1d4. It also learns new abilities: Bad Omen ( ) Hurl one of your feathers at a target to mark it as cursed. ( Recharge: Per turn.) Companion's Bond Your Ranger's Companions receive a bonus to Armour Class and damage equal to its Proficiency Bonus . Level 7 Exceptional Training Your summoned companions can now Dash , Disengage , and Help as a Bonus Action . Level 8 Your dire raven companion now has 32 Hit Points and 19 Armour Class . Level 11 Corvus Celer STR 6 (-2) DEX 14 (+2) CON 10 INT 3 (-4) WIS 14 (+2) CHA 8 (-1) Hit Points 44 Armour Class 22 Size Small Your dire raven companion advances to Corvus Celer . It now has 44 Hit Points and 22 Armour Class . Its Wisdom increases by 2, its Charisma increases by 2, and its proficiency bonus increases to +4. The extra damage added at level 5 increases from 1d4 to 1d6. It also learns new abilities: On Black Wings ( ) Summons two ravens allied to you. You cannot control the ravens. Raven Sight The raven cannot be Blinded . Fly ( ) Fly to a target position and create a small cloud of   Darkness . Technical details UID Target_RangersCompanion_Raven Spell flags CannotTargetCharacter , CannotTargetItems , IgnoreSilence , IsLinkedSpellContainer How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Beast Master This spell is a variation of: Ranger's Companion Notes Children often react to the raven with written dialogue above their heads, commenting on its feathers, beak, and wondering if it would like to be pet. Properties Cost Action Details Recharge: Long rest Technical details UID Shout_TAD_DisplacerBeast Condition: Displacer Beast Form Displacer Beast Form Duration: Until Long rest Affected entity has adopted the eldritch pantherlike form of a displace beast. Illusory Copy ( ) Create an illusory displacer beast to attack nearby enemies. Tentacle Whip ( ) Lash out with a sleek, spinous tentacle. Extra Attack You can make an additional free attack after making an unarmed or weapon attack. Improved Extra Attack You can make two additional attacks after attacking with your main-hand weapon. Evasion Your agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain spells. This damage is capped to 5d8, so using a spell slot above 4th spell level adds no further damage. ## Divine Strike
- **来源**: [Divine Strike](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Divine_Strike)
- **分类**: Actions

Divine Strike is a weapon action available to level 8 Clerics of the following Domains: Death , Life , Trickery , Nature , Tempest , and War . It is usable once per turn and deals 1d8 additional damage upon a weapon strike (either melee or ranged) of a type dependent on the chosen domain. Contents 1 Variations 2 Overview 3 Notes 4 Bugs Variations [ edit section | visual editor ] Domain Damage Variation Death 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic Divine Strike: Necrotic (Melee) Divine Strike: Necrotic (Ranged) Life 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant Divine Strike: Radiant (Melee) Divine Strike: Radiant (Ranged) Nature 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Cold Divine Strike: Cold (Melee) Divine Strike: Cold (Ranged) 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Fire Divine Strike: Fire (Melee) Divine Strike: Fire (Ranged) 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Lightning Divine Strike: Lightning (Melee) Divine Strike: Lightning (Ranged) Tempest 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder Divine Strike: Thunder (Melee) Divine Strike: Thunder (Ranged) Trickery 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Poison Divine Strike: Poison (Melee) Divine Strike: Poison (Ranged) War 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon Divine Strike: Weapon (Melee) Divine Strike: Weapon (Ranged) Overview [ edit section | visual editor ] There are two ways of using Divine Strike. First is to use it directly with the corresponding attack ability (e.g. Divine Strike: Radiant (Melee) ). Second is to use any other weapon attack and let Divine Strike trigger as a post-strike reaction upon hit. Triggering it this way does not cost a Reaction , but it is configured the same way as other reactions in the reactions tab . Using Divine Strike as a reaction means it can be used in conjunction with any attack such as an offhand attack, a weapon action , with a special arrow , or an Opportunity Attack . On the other hand, using the ability directly is always equivalent to a basic main-hand attack with the bonus damage from Divine Strike. Thus, it is usually better to trigger Divine Strike as a reaction since it works in far more situations. Divine Strike only works with melee and ranged weapons; it cannot be used with unarmed attacks or thrown weapons, even as a reaction. Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] War Domain's variant of Divine Strike inherits the damage type of the weapon in the main hand, so it can deal a wide variety of damage types such as ⁠ Force with the Ne'er Misser or ⁠ Psychic with the Shadow Blade . The main hand weapon's damage type is used even if the triggering attack was made with an offhand weapon. Bugs [ edit section | visual editor ] The different methods of using Divine Strike (as a post-strike reaction or with the weapon action directly) have independent, once-per-turn cooldowns. Activating Divine Strike directly does not prevent triggering it again that turn with a post-strike reaction (and vice versa). This means that Divine Strike can actually be used twice in a turn, provided it is used once with each method. Activating Divine Strike directly does not trigger on-hit weapon functors found on many weapons, such as the Sussur Dagger . Using Divine Strike as a post-strike reaction does trigger on-hit weapon functors. When playing Honour mode , all Divine Strikes (when used as a post-strike reaction) are changed to not invoke additional DRS mechanics. However, when activated directly, only Divine Strike from the Death Domain (added in Patch 8 ) does not invoke additional DRS; all other direct-use variants of Divine Strike continue to invoke DRS. Additionally in Honour Mode, the changed variants of Divine Strike cease to function with effects/passives which trigger when certain kinds of damage are dealt, such as the thunder damage from Tempest Domain and the Hat of Storm Scion's Power . Melee variants of Divine Strike are not properly tagged with the DamageType corresponding to their damage types. Most notably, this means that Divine Strike: Thunder (Melee) cannot trigger Destructive Wrath . This issue is not present with the ranged variants. For ranged variants, when wielding two Hand Crossbows and Dual Wielding toggle enabled, Divine Strike action will consume both an Action and Bonus Action , but the offhand attack will not be performed. This wiki displays the ability icons that each Divine Strike variant is supposed to use; however, each in-game variant (except for Death/Necrotic) displays the default Divine Strike container icon. v t e Cleric Subclasses Death Domain Knowledge Domain Life Domain Light Domain Nature Domain Tempest Domain Trickery Domain War Domain Channel Divinity Charge Charm Animals and Plants Cloak of Shadows Destructive Wrath Dampen Elements Guided Strike Invoke Duplicity Knowledge of the Ages Preserve Life Radiance of the Dawn Read Thoughts Touch of Death War God's Blessing Divine Strike Radiant (Melee) Radiant (Ranged) Poison (Melee) Poison (Ranged) Cold (Melee) Cold (Ranged) Fire (Melee) Fire (Ranged) Lightning (Melee) Lightning (Ranged) Necrotic (Melee) Necrotic (Ranged) Thunder (Melee) Thunder (Ranged) Weapon (Melee) Weapon (Ranged) Other class features Acolyte of Nature Blessed Healer Blessing of the Trickster Blessings of Knowledge Destroy Undead Disciple of Life Divine Intervention Expertise Improved Warding Flare Inescapable Destruction Potent Spellcasting Reaper Spells Thunderbolt Strike Turn Undead War Priest Warding Flare Wrath of the Storm

## Diving Strike
- **来源**: [Diving Strike](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Diving_Strike)
- **分类**: Actions

Diving Strike is a Wildheart barbarian class action only available while using Rage: Eagle Heart , allowing you to leap down on a target dealing damage and knocking them prone. Description Leap down unto a foe below you, dealing normal weapon damage and knocking them Prone . You do not take falling damage . You must be at least 1.5 m (5 ft) above your target. Available only when Raging . Properties Cost Action Damage Normal weapon damage Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Range: Jump range Targets: A creature at least 1.5 m (5 ft) below Technical details UID Projectile_DivingStrike Spell flags CombatLogSetSingleLineRoll , HasHighGroundRangeExtension , IsHarmful , IsJump Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 2 turns Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Wildheart Granted by spells: Rage: Eagle Heart Used by creatures: Shiv Dahlia Notes Any effects that boost jump range like the Athlete feat or Enhance Leap apply to Diving Strike as well. Refer to this table of jump distance modifiers for an exhaustive list of such effects. This attack benefits from high ground bonus to attack rolls. Note that this ability requires a 1.5 m (5 ft) elevation over the target, but the high ground bonus requires a slightly higher 2.5 m (8 ft) elevation. A stack of two crates is sufficient to get the required 1.5 m (5 ft) height advantage against a target on level ground. It is also sufficient to unlock the +2 high ground bonus to the attack roll. Diving strike counts as a jump for the purposes of features like Shockwave . Bugs If this attack misses and Reckless Attack is triggered in response, the attack roll is not actually rerolled, so it will always still miss. However, if Reckless Attack is already active, the attack roll is made with Advantage as expected. v t e Barbarian Subclasses Berserker Giant Wild Magic Wildheart Rage Frenzy Giant's Rage Rage Bear Heart Eagle Heart Elk Heart Tiger Heart Wolf Heart Rage: Wild Magic Aspect of the Beast Bear Chimpanzee Crocodile Eagle Elk Honey Badger Stallion Tiger Wolf Wolverine Bestial Heart Bear Heart Eagle Heart Elk Heart Tiger Heart Wolf Heart Bolstering Magic Boon Level 1 Spell Slot Level 2 Spell Slot Level 3 Spell Slot Other Class Features Boot of the Giants Brutal Critical Danger Sense Diving Strike Elemental Cleaver Extra Attack Fast Movement Feral Instinct Inciting Howl Intimidating Presence Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain Magic Awareness Mighty Impel Mindless Rage Primal Stampede Reckless Attack Relentless Rage Tiger's Bloodlust Unarmoured Defence Unrelenting Ferocity Unstable Backlash Vaprak's Greed

## Fierce Perilous Stakes
- **来源**: [Fierce Perilous Stakes](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Fierce_Perilous_Stakes)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the improved full-illithid power. For the normal version, see Perilous Stakes . Fierce Perilous Stakes is an action and illithid power available to Full-Illithids . It grants a target a massive boost to critical hit chance and bonus psychic damage, but at the cost of suffering vulnerability to all damage types. Description Grant an ally an additional 15 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage, healing 2~16 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points when they attack. They become Vulnerable to all damage for the duration of this effect. Properties Cost Action Details INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 9 m (30 ft) Technical details UID Target_MF_PerilousStakes Spell flags DisableBlood , IsHarmful , Wildshape Condition: Fierce Perilous Stakes Perilous Stakes Duration: 3 turns Affected entity's attacks deal an additional 15 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage and heal 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . The entity scores a Critical Hit when rolling a 15 or higher. The entity is Vulnerable to all damage. How to learn Used by creatures: Full-Illithid Notes This action is unlocked automatically after becoming a Full-Illithid. When targeting enemies, there is an Intelligence Saving Throw to apply the effect. This saving throw automatically succeeds when targeting allies. As with Perilous Stakes , in honour mode this ability can only target allies. Bugs This can be cast multiple times on the same target to apply multiple instances of Perilous Stakes at once, and can even stack with Perilous Stakes . The critical hit threshold reduction, bonus damage, and healing effect from each application all stack with each other. The damage vulnerability does not stack.

## Gather Power
- **来源**: [Gather Power](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Gather_Power)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Gather Power is a unique class action available to Ansur that causes him to begin building up massive energy. After a 2 turn delay, he will release a devastating Stormheart Nova , damaging all creatures caught in the open. This damage can be avoided by taking cover behind Attuned Crystals . While charging up, Ansur has full damage resistances but cannot perform any other actions. In Honour mode, the delay is reduced to a single turn. Additionally, when Ansur is first dropped to 0 hit points in Honour mode, he will remain conscious, gain 100 temporary hit points , and trigger this action again. Description Take flight, land, and begin to gather power. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 30 m (100 ft) Recharge: Per turn Technical details UID Target_Fly_Dragon_Skeletal_EnterFlightState Spell flags IgnoreVisionBlock , Invisible , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold Condition: Hoarding Energy Hoarding Energy Duration: 2 turns Ansur is gathering energy while airborne and is Resistant to all damage. Condition: Ansur's Ire Ansur's Ire A storm of vicious lightning is soon to erupt - striking all standing in the open. How to learn Used by creatures: Ansur Notes The condition Ansur's Ire is used as an indicator for which creatures will take damage from the Stormheart Nova released after two turns. Creatures without this condition (whether because they are out of range or behind cover), will be safe from the explosion. Globe of Invulnerability is an easy way to protect the entire party from this action.

Properties Cost Action Damage Normal weapon damage + Proficiency bonus ⁠ Thunder Details DEX Save ( Weapon action DC  + 2) (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) AoE: 3 m (10 ft) Radius Pushes: Shove distance (from AoE centre) Recharge: Short rest Technical details UID Target_MAG_WeaponAction_GrandSlam Spell flags CanAreaDamageEvade , IsDefaultWeaponAction , IsHarmful , IsMelee How to learn Granted by items: Corpsegrinder Notes This action does not count as an attack for the purposes of Extra Attack and requires the wielder's full Action . ## Grave Shot
- **来源**: [Grave Shot](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Grave_Shot)
- **分类**: Actions

Grave Shot is a unique weapon action used by Houndmaster Pol . It fires a bolt of necrotic damage which can be significantly strengthened by consuming up to 6 Predator Essences . Description Loose a bolt of necrotic energy. You can spend Predator Essence to empower the shot. Each Predator Essence adds 4d10 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic and heals you for 4d10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Properties Cost Action Damage: 6~15 1d10 + 5 ⁠ Necrotic Details Ranged Weapon Attack Roll Range: 18 m (60 ft) At higher levels With Predator Essence: 1 , the attack deals 5d10 + 5 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic and heals 4d10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . With Predator Essence: 2 , the attack deals 9d10 + 5 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic and heals 8d10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . With Predator Essence: 3 , the attack deals 13d10 + 5 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic and heals 12d10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . With Predator Essence: 4 , the attack deals 17d10 + 5 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic and heals 16d10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . With Predator Essence: 5 , the attack deals 21d10 + 5 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic and heals 20d10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . With Predator Essence: 6 , the attack deals 25d10 + 5 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic and heals 24d10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Technical details UIDs Projectile_LOW_Houndmaster_GraveShot Base version with no Predator Essence Projectile_LOW_Houndmaster_GraveShot_1 Version unlocked with 1 essence Projectile_LOW_Houndmaster_GraveShot_2 Version unlocked with 2 essence Projectile_LOW_Houndmaster_GraveShot_3 Version unlocked with 3 essence Projectile_LOW_Houndmaster_GraveShot_4 Version unlocked with 4 essence Projectile_LOW_Houndmaster_GraveShot_5 Version unlocked with 5 essence Projectile_LOW_Houndmaster_GraveShot_6 Version unlocked with 6 essence Spell flags DisplayInItemTooltip , HasHighGroundRangeExtension , IsHarmful , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold How to learn Used by creatures: Houndmaster Pol Notes This attack consumes all collected essences on use. While this attack is capable of dealing tremendous damage, it is unlikely that Houndmaster Pol will be able to reach high amounts of Predator Essence . The sequence of events required to gain Predator Essence is: Pol casts Houndmaster's Mark on target. One of Pol's hounds ( Gordis , Rocky , or Zina ) lands an attack on the marked creature and gains a Prey Essence . The hound runs back to Pol and uses Have Nice Gift! to turn the Prey Essence into a stack of Predator Essence for Pol.

## Hide
- **来源**: [Hide](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Hide)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Hide is a common Action that allows the user to conceal their location. Description Try to conceal yourself. Hiding depends on your Stealth and whether you are Obscured . Attacking or casting spells reveals your location. Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Technical details UID Shout_Hide Spell flags AllowMoveAndCast , CombatLogSetSingleLineRoll , ImmediateCast , Invisible , Stealth , UnavailableInDialogs Condition: Hiding Hiding Affected entity is invisible to enemies until it crosses their cone of sight. The entity has Advantage on all Attack Rolls . Notes If a player character is in the line of sight of a non-allied creature, and is either in melee range or considered to be in a Clear Area (see obscurity and darkvision ), then the character is spotted immediately. If they are in the line of sight of a non-allied creature while considered Lightly Obscured (with darkvision taken into account) and not in melee range, then the player character rolls a Stealth check contesting a passive Perception check by the other creature. This is displayed as a Hiding Check in the combat log, whose Difficulty Class is determined by the passive Perception score of the other creature. It is repeated every turn (or every 6 seconds outside of turn-based mode) and for each non-allied creature that has line of sight on the hiding player character. The line of sight of creatures without darkvision does not extend into Heavily Obscured areas, so they cannot detect a character hiding in such an area. Attacking automatically ends hiding, meaning that undetected stealth attacks cannot be made from within an enemies' line of sight, even if successfully hiding in obscurity prior to the attack. However, attacking from hiding is still beneficial, because it confers Advantage on the attack roll . Lines of sight (aka 'vision cones') are shown with a red overlay when the selected player character is currently in hiding. They can be manipulated using distractions such as Minor Illusion or Meow , which compel creatures to turn towards a specific direction and / or walk to another location. This can create an opening for a pickpocketing attempt or a stealth attack. Hiding inside a Fog Cloud or Darkness is an automatic success as sight cones of enemies do not reach inside unless they have a passive that grants sight through magical darkness like Devil's Sight or Born into Darkness . This also makes up for the Blind debuff, as enemies cannot target the player character from outside the cloud if they are hiding. In Early Access patch 9, Hide was a Bonus Action, but it was changed to an Action in the full release of the game. However, the Way of Shadow Monk subclass, the Gloom Stalker Ranger subclass, and the Rogue class are still able to Hide as a Bonus Action via class features. See also [ edit section | visual editor ] Cunning Action: Hide Dread Ambusher: Hide Shadow Arts: Hide
