## Horde Breaker (Melee)
- **来源**: [Horde Breaker (Melee)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Horde_Breaker_(Melee))
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

See also: Horde Breaker (Ranged) Horde Breaker (Melee) is a Hunter Ranger class action. It allows them to deal damage to an additional nearby target. Description Target two creatures standing close to each other. Attack the first creature and get a free shot at the second. Properties Cost Action Damage Normal weapon damage Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Range: Normal weapon range AoE: 2 m (7 ft) Radius Recharge: Per turn Grants: Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Melee) Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Ranged) Condition: Horde Breaker Horde Breaker Duration: 1 turn Can attack a second creature close to its first target. Condition: Horde Breaker (Target) Horde Breaker Duration: 1 turn Creature is open to a follow-up attack. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Hunter Notes This action triggers Extra Attack and similar features. Every creature within 2 m (7 ft) of the target receives the Horde Breaker condition, even if the attack misses, marking them as eligible targets for the follow-up attack. A Hunter can then use a Horde Breaker Follow-Up to make an attack against any of these creatures as a Free Action. The follow-up attack can be either a Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Melee) or a Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Ranged) , even if the initial attack used a different weapon type. Using either of the follow-ups ends the condition on other creatures. To make use of Horde Breaker more regularly, a Ranger can use features which reposition enemies closer to each other without costing a whole Action : Shove Weapon actions and spells like Sorrowful Lash , Pushing Attack (Titanstring Bow) , and Absolute Power Class features like Pushing Attack (Melee) , Mobile Flourish (Melee) , Flurry of Blows: Push , and Boot of the Giants Bugs Some features and equipment that would normally affect the initial Horde Breaker target might instead trigger on a random creature within the Horde Breaker AoE. The game appears to use some kind of alphabetical order to arrange targets in the Horde Breaker AoE and decide who will be affected. This is known to happen with Sneak Attack , Ability Drain , Divine Strike: Weapon , and Luck of the Far Realms . As Horde Breaker adds the Horde Breaker condition to targets, equipment requiring the application of a condition will always be activated. This is the case for the Diadem of Arcane Synergy and Coldbrim Hat . The Boots of Stormy Clamour trigger twice , and can trigger even more times if the attack activates certain other features such as Mortal Reminder and Radiant Shockwave . As described above, the Boots of Stormy Clamour and Coldbrim Hat can add conditions to unexpected targets within the Horde Breaker AoE. Despite seeming like a single-target attack, Horde Breaker actually rolls "invisible attacks" (i.e. not displayed in the combat log) against all enemies in the AoE, and the game then evaluates their results (i.e. hit, miss, or critical hit). Most of the time, these attack rolls do nothing, as most game abilities require damage to trigger secondary effects. However, there are some features and equipment that do not require damage to be activated – Horde Breaker will trigger these effects on all targets within its area of effect. Weapons forcing enemies to roll saving throws to avoid receiving a condition when hit by Horde Breaker's invisible attack: – Vision of the Absolute ( Blinded ) – Bow of the Banshee ( Frightened ) – Sussur Greatsword ( Silenced ) – Staff of the Ram ( Stunned , limited to 1 enemy/turn) – Twisted Oak Crook ( Entangled ) – The Baneful ( Bane , if bound) As opposed to the above weapons, a Horde Breaker attack using The Watcher's Guide adds True Strike to all enemies which the invisible attack misses . This behaviour may be undesirable, for example, the Unseen Menace loses Invisible Weapon , thus losing advantage on attack rolls, if an invisible attack misses. Since more attack rolls are made, the chance of losing this condition is greater than when Horde Breaker is not used. Some weapons are capable of dealing actual damage to multiple characters through invisible attacks when using Horde Breaker, additionally causing any damaged character to be affected by rider effects, such as coatings : Rat Bat , Shortsword of First Blood , and weapons using the Prepare action affect all targets in the AoE (the last two do not work in Honour Mode ). Duellist's Prerogative hits up to two extra targets via the Withering Cut reaction. Weapons using the Tenacity reaction can affect one additional target on a miss. Valiant Damage can damage one additional target, and Divine Smite can damage multiple targets with the same attack (by expending multiple spell slots). These features can be used with any weapon, or they can be combined with the weapons above. There are also some non-damaging features capable of triggering once per target in the Horde Breaker AoE, depending on the result of the invisible attack roll: On any result: Bladesong Healing Charge , Aspect of the Beast: Wolverine , Mobile: Evade Opportunity Attack , and Fancy Footwork On hit: Perilous Stakes , Inquisitor's Might ( Daze only), and Hexed Weapon (as well as the effects of Hexblade's Curse ) On critical: Mortal Reminder and Great Weapon Master: Bonus Attack Due to a conditional requirement check bug, Horde Breaker may not be usable on the turn immediately following a turn in which it was used. This can be mitigated by moving the character any distance. v t e Ranger Subclasses Beast Master Gloom Stalker Hunter Swarmkeeper Favoured Enemy Bounty Hunter Keeper of the Veil Mage Breaker Ranger Knight Sanctified Stalker Natural Explorer Beast Tamer Urban Tracker Wasteland Wanderer ( Cold Fire Poison ) Other class features Bestial Fury Companion's Bond Dread Ambusher Melee Ranged Hide Escape the Horde Exceptional Training Extra Attack Gathered Swarm Cloud of Jellyfish Flurry of Moths Legion of Bees Hide in Plain Sight Hunter's Prey Colossus Slayer Giant Killer Horde Breaker Iron Mind Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain Mighty Swarm Multiattack Defence Prey's Scent Spells Ranger's Companion Stalker's Flurry Steel Will Superior Darkvision Umbral Shroud Volley Whirlwind Attack Writhing Tide
## Horde Breaker (Ranged)
- **来源**: [Horde Breaker (Ranged)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Horde_Breaker_(Ranged))
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

See also: Horde Breaker (Melee) Horde Breaker (Ranged) is a Hunter Ranger class action. This ability allows them to deal damage to an additional nearby target. Description Target two creatures standing close to each other. Shoot the first creature and get a free shot at the second. Properties Cost Action Damage Normal weapon damage Details Ranged Weapon Attack Roll Range: Normal weapon range AoE: 2 m (7 ft) Radius Recharge: Per turn Grants: Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Melee) Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Ranged) Condition: Horde Breaker Horde Breaker Duration: 1 turn Can attack a second creature close to its first target. Condition: Horde Breaker (Target) Horde Breaker Duration: 1 turn Creature is open to a follow-up attack. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Hunter Notes The additional attack can be against anyone within 2 m (7 ft) around the target of this ability. Every creature in the area receives Horde Breaker condition, even if the attack misses, marking them as eligible for the follow up attack. The Hunter can use a Horde Breaker Follow-Up to make an attack against any of these creatures as a Free Action, even if the starting attack misses. The follow-up attack can be either a Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Melee) or a Horde Breaker Follow-Up (Ranged) , no matter if starting with a different weapon type, e.g. a ranged horde breaker attack can be followed by a free melee attack against a nearby enemy. Using either of them expires the condition in other creatures. To make use of Horde Breaker more regularly, the Ranger can use abilities repositioning enemies closer to each other, without costing a whole action: Shove Weapon abilities, like Sorrowful Lash cantrip (granted by Sorrow ) and Pushing Attack (Titanstring Bow) (granted by Titanstring Bow ) Class abilities, like Enraged Throw (from Berserker ), and Pushing Attack (Melee) and Pushing Attack (Ranged) manoeuvres (from Battle Master ) Bugs Some abilities/gear expected to affect the original Horde Breaker target might instead trigger to a random enemy in the Horde Breaker zone. As these abilities are triggered after the base attack, they will always be applied to random enemies in the area if the targeted enemy is killed, which can be used on player's advantage. This is known to happen with Sneak Attack , Ability Drain and Divine Strike: Weapon , but there are particular cases: Boots of Stormy Clamour and Staff of the Ram can trigger twice, usually one time at random and one time to the original target (if attacks hits) or at random (if attack misses). The Watcher's Guide can add True Strike to a nearby enemy if the original target is hit . There are a few weapons capable to trigger their abilities to all targets (including teammates, but excluding the Horde Breaker character) in area when they receive Horde Breaker condition - likely a bug. Known weapons to interact with Horde Breaker are: Vision of the Absolute ( Blinded ), Bow of the Banshee ( Frightened ), Sussur Greatsword ( Silenced ) and The Baneful ( Bane ) are weapons forcing all enemies in Horde Breaker area to roll a saving throw to avoid receiving a condition. Shortsword of First Blood ability Break the Unbroken activates dealing 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing to targets that still have all their hit points . Rat Bat unnamed ability deals 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing DRS at all targets. Greataxes ability Prepare deals [Strength modifier] ⁠ ⁠ Physical DRS damage to all targets. Due to a conditional requirement check bug, Horde Breaker may not be usable on the next turn immediately following a turn in which it was used. v t e Ranger Subclasses Beast Master Gloom Stalker Hunter Swarmkeeper Favoured Enemy Bounty Hunter Keeper of the Veil Mage Breaker Ranger Knight Sanctified Stalker Natural Explorer Beast Tamer Urban Tracker Wasteland Wanderer ( Cold Fire Poison ) Other class features Bestial Fury Companion's Bond Dread Ambusher Melee Ranged Hide Escape the Horde Exceptional Training Extra Attack Gathered Swarm Cloud of Jellyfish Flurry of Moths Legion of Bees Hide in Plain Sight Hunter's Prey Colossus Slayer Giant Killer Horde Breaker Iron Mind Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain Mighty Swarm Multiattack Defence Prey's Scent Spells Ranger's Companion Stalker's Flurry Steel Will Superior Darkvision Umbral Shroud Volley Whirlwind Attack Writhing Tide

Hypnotic Gaze is an Enchantment School wizard class action which hypnotises a creature, rendering it entirely incapacitated for a brief period. Additional actions can be spent to maintain this effect. Description Charm and Incapacitates a creature. It cannot attack you. It cannot act. You can Maintain Hypnotic Gaze your Hypnotic Gaze each turn to extend its duration. The condition ends upon taking damage. Properties Cost Action Details WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Recharge: Long rest Technical details UID Target_HypnoticGaze Spell flags IsMelee Grants: Maintain Hypnotic Gaze Condition: Hypnotic Gaze Hypnotic Gaze Duration: 2 turns WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Can't move or take actions, bonus actions, or reactions. Spellcaster has Advantage on Ability Checks in dialogue. Removed upon taking damage. Duration can be extended with Maintain Hypnotic Gaze How to learn Classes: Class level 2: Enchantment School Notes This action does not count as a spell and cannot be used with Split Enchantment . Only the initial application of this effect has a saving throw. Maintain Hypnotic Gaze will extend the duration without requiring additional saving throws. Under certain conditions, this action does not break Sanctuary , such as being out of combat or being Invisible , though it will end invisibility. ## Improvised Melee Weapon
- **来源**: [Improvised Melee Weapon](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Improvised_Melee_Weapon)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

See also: Improvised Melee Weapon (Bonus Action) Improvised Melee Weapon is a common Action that allows the user to improvise an attack by picking up an item or creature off the ground or from their inventory. Description Pick up an item or creature and use it to make a melee attack. Your Strength affects how much weight you can lift. Heavier items deal more damage. Properties Cost Action Damage Object ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Attack Roll Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Range for picking up objects from the ground is AoE: 1 m (3 ft) Radius Damage: For weapons with the Thrown property, the damage roll and damage type is the same as the weapon's melee damage For other objects and creatures, damage is determined by the targets weight [ note 1 ] of the object being thrown: Light objects: under Weight: 10 kg (20 lb): 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. Medium objects: Weight: 10 kg (20 lb) - 50 kg / 100 lb: 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. Heavy objects: over Weight: 50 kg (100 lb): 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. If the thrown object or creature is heavier than half the target's weight the target will be knocked back 2 m (7 ft). [ note 1 ] If the thrown object or creature is heavier than the target's weight the target will become Prone (no saving throw). [ note 1 ] Throwing a creature will apply Prone to that thrown creature (no saving throw). Technical details UID Throw_ImprovisedWeapon Spell flags AbortOnSecondarySpellRollFail , AddFallDamageOnLand , CombatLogSetSingleLineRoll , IgnoreSilence , IgnoreVisionBlock , InventorySelection , IsHarmful , PickupEntityAndMove , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 1 turn Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. Notes A creature can pick up items and other creatures weighing up to 0 . 2 ⋅ Strength 2 kg [ 1 ] . For example, with a Strength score of 18, the weight limit for Improvised Weapon is Weight: 64.8 kg (129.6 lb). It requires a Strength of at least 20 to pick up a normal humanoid ( Weight: 75 kg (150 lb)). Triggers Extra Attack . Can be done as a free attack after triggering Extra Attack. Berserker can do this as a bonus action via Improvised Melee Weapon (Bonus Action) . Improvised Melee Weapon counts as a melee unarmed attack. The Tavern Brawler feat improves Improvised Melee Weapon. This ability can allow a strong character to move other creatures and objects to more desirable locations, though it usually involves smashing said creature or object into the ground. Canceling your action allows movement without making the attack, and only uses movement as a result - no actions expended (though you need an action to attempt the Improvised Melee Weapon). This feature can be further used to relocate creatures or objects by use of the fast travel system. While still moving the object/creature that is to be used as a melee weapon, quickly fast travel to your desired location. If you manage to fast travel before completing the attack, you and the held creature will be teleported together. Without a clear path back to their original location, NPCs will remain locked in their new location, allowing players to create a convenient hub of Merchants in one fast travel location. This can be used to make certain fights much easier. For example, Gortash can be brought to a tall ledge and thrown to the ground, instantly killing him. Footnotes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ 1.0 1.1 1.2 This weight is not influenced by a creatures equipped items or items inside a creatures inventory or a container. The weight is not how much it weighs to pick up or have in your inventory, but the weight of only the object/creature itself. You can see this weight by clicking "Examine -> Detailed Info" and looking under "Weight: " . References [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ From the definition of CanImprovisedWeaponWeight() in Scripts/thoth/helpers/CommonConditions.khn .

## Let the Slaughter Begin
- **来源**: [Let the Slaughter Begin](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Let_the_Slaughter_Begin)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Let the Slaughter Begin is a special class action available to the Slayer which brands nearby creatures, dazing them. Killing marked creatures grants the Slayer a stacking bonus to Armour Class . Description Brand nearby creatures with a sinister mark so that their deaths make you harder to kill. Marked targets are Dazed , and when they die, you gain +1 bonus to Armour Class . [ See: Bugs ] Properties Cost Action Details CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: Self AoE: 12 m (40 ft) Radius Targets: All enemies in range Condition: Bhaal's Murderous Mark Bhaal's Murderous Mark Duration: 4 turns Affected entity's death grants a +1 Armour Class bonus to the Slayer. Condition: Dazed Dazed Duration: 1 turn Has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws , can't take Reactions , and loses the Dexterity bonus to their Armour Class . Removed if an ally Helps this creature. Condition: Bhaal's Boon Bhaal's Boon Duration: 1 turn Bhaal revels in the affected entity's gift for murder, granting it a +1 bonus to Armour Class per marked kill. 1 point of this bonus Armour Class is lost each time the Slayer avoids an attack. [ See: Bugs ] How to learn Used by creatures: Slayer Notes Allies in range are Marked , but not Dazed . Bugs The spell save DC of the Slayer's actions uses the spellcasting ability of the last class you took a first level in, but with the Slayer's ability scores. This results in a very low DC due to the Slayer's low mental ability scores. In particular, Fighters, Rogues, Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Monks, and Rangers have a +0 spellcasting modifier from Intelligence or Wisdom in Slayer form, while Barbarians, Bards, Paladins, Sorcerers, and Warlocks have a -1 spellcasting modifier from Charisma while in Slayer form. Stacks of Bhaal's Boon granted by killing marked targets are lost in far more circumstances than they should be. This makes it essentially impossible to accumulate stacks of this condition as they are usually removed as soon as they are added. Whenever a condition of any type is removed from the Slayer, the number of stacks will decrement. Many features involve hidden technical conditions that are applied and removed frequently. In particular, every attack made with Extra Attack involves applying and removing hidden technical conditions which track the extra attacks. As a result, simply attacking causes the stacks to decrement, often immediately after acquiring the first stack.

## Mind Sanctuary
- **来源**: [Mind Sanctuary](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Mind_Sanctuary)

Mind Sanctuary is an action and illithid power . This ability creates a magical nexus that allows those within to take actions and bonus actions interchangeably. Description Sculpt a magical nexus that allows those within to take actions and bonus actions interchangeably. (Honour Mode only) Instead of allowing bonus actions and actions to be used interchangeably, Mind Sanctuary just grants Hastened . The Mind Sanctuary removes and prevents other sources of Slowed or Hastened conditions affecting creatures within it. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) AoE: 3 m (10 ft) Radius Creates Area: Mind Sanctuary Recharge: Long rest Technical details UIDs Target_TAD_MindSanctuary Partial illithid version with a once-per-rest cooldown Target_MF_MindSanctuary Full illithid version without a cooldown Spell flags DisableBlood , IsHarmful Area: Mind Sanctuary Mind Sanctuary Duration: 3 turns AoE: 3 m (10 ft) Radius Anyone within the Mind Sanctuary can take actions and bonus actions interchangeably. Type: Summoned Condition: Within the Mind Sanctuary Within the Mind Sanctuary Affected entity can take actions and bonus actions interchangeably, as long as it stays within the mind sanctuary. After using both action and bonus action, this condition ends and the affected entity gains the Mind Sanctuary: Depleted condition. How to learn Used by creatures: Full-Illithid and Partial-illithid Other ways to learn: After becoming a Partial-Illithid , unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining one of the following: Psionic Backlash Freecast Notes The Full-Illithid version does not have a cooldown and can be used at-will. If an already hastened creature enters the Honour Mode version, they immediately become Lethargic , as the mind sanctuary overrides and thereby ends their existing haste.

## Mist Stance

Mist Stance is a class action that allows the Way of the Four Elements monk to cast the equivalent of the level 3 Wizard spell Gaseous Form that can only affect the caster. Description Transform into a tiny gas cloud. It can't fall, and fits through small openings. It is very hard to damage. The cloud has Advantage on Constitution , Dexterity , and Strength Saving Throws . While transformed, the target won't be able to attack, cast spells, or talk. Properties Cost Action + 4 Ki Points Details Range: Self Concentration Technical details UID Shout_GaseousForm_Monk Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , IsConcentration Grants: Fly (class action) Martial Arts: Bonus Unarmed Strike Condition: Gaseous Form Gaseous Form Duration: Until Long rest Transformed into a cloud of mist. Resistant to all non-magical damage. Has Advantage on Constitution , Dexterity , and Strength Saving Throws . Becomes Tiny in size. Cannot attack, cast spells, or speak. The target's Strength and Dexterity scores are set to 10 while in this form. Immune to Bleeding . Creature: Gaseous Form (creature) STR 10 DEX 10 CON 10 Armour Class 10 Size Tiny Dismiss Gaseous Form Dismiss your gaseous shape and turn back into your original form. Fly ( ) Fly to a target position Ethereal Affected entity is incorporeal and can't be Shoved , Thrown , or used as an Improvised Melee Weapon How to learn Classes: Class level 11: Way of the Four Elements Notes The description "fits through small openings" includes traveling to different regions by going through small openings (pipes, animal burrows, cat holes, etc.), but also includes moving through 'walls' with openings in them like prison bars and gates. Moonlight Butterflies is a weapon action granted by Moonlight Glaive . Description Strike a foe, conjuring an illusory swarm of moon-pale butterflies and gaining Advantage on attacks against the target. Deal additional ⁠ Psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus . When the target moves away from your illusion, it takes 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage. Properties Cost Action Damage Normal weapon damage + Proficiency bonus ⁠ Weapon + Proficiency bonus ⁠ Psychic Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Range: Normal weapon range Creates Area: Moonlight Butterflies Recharge: Short rest Must be proficient with weapon Technical details UID Target_MAG_WeaponAction_MoonlightButterfly Spell flags IsDefaultWeaponAction , IsHarmful , IsMelee Area: Moonlight Butterflies Moonlight Butterflies Duration: 3 turns AoE: 2 m (7 ft) Radius An illusory swarm of moon-pale butterflies. Creatures inside the area are illuminated and all attacks against them have Advantage . Creatures fleeing the illusion suffer 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage when leaving the area. Type: Summoned Condition: Moonlight Butterflies Moonlight Butterflies Surrounded in moon-pale butterflies, creatures have Advantage on attacks against the affected entity. When the illusion is fled from or disappears, the entity takes 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic . How to learn Granted by items: Moonlight Glaive Notes The Moonlight Butterflies area affects every entity inside it, including allies and inanimate objects. The 3 m (10 ft) range of the attack is just enough such that the attacker can remain outside of the Moonlight Butterflies area when attacking at maximum range. At any shorter range, the attacker will also be enveloped in the Moonlight Butterflies and suffer the penalties. ## Myrmidon's Immolation

Myrmidon's Immolation is an action available to Fire Myrmidons , including in Wild Shape: Fire Myrmidon form. It briefly Hastens the myrmidon, granting an extra Action . Description Ignite with incandescent, primordial flames that Hasten you. Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Concentration Duration: 3 turns Technical details UID Shout_BurningRage_Myrmidon_Fire Spell flags IsConcentration , Wildshape Condition: Hastened Hastened Duration: 3 turns Creature has a +2 bonus to Armour Class , Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws , its Movement Speed increases by 9 m (30 ft), [ See: Bugs ] and it can take one additional Action per turn. When the condition ends, the creature becomes Lethargic . How to learn Used by creatures: Fire Myrmidon Notes The extra action granted by this ability works with Wild Strike and Improved Wild Strike in Honour mode . This is unique because no other source of extra actions works with any form of Extra Attack in Honour mode (other than Action Surge ). ## Natural Recovery
- **来源**: [Natural Recovery](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Natural_Recovery)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

See also: Arcane Recovery and Create Spell Slot Natural Recovery is a Circle of the Land druid class action. This ability allows these druids to replenish a number of spell slots each long rest. Description Replenish expended Spell Slots while out of combat. Available only out of combat. Properties Cost Action + Natural Recovery Charge Details Range: Self At higher levels At level 3, unlock the ability to spend an Action  +  2 Natural Recovery Charges to replenish a Level 2 Spell Slot . At level 5, unlock the ability to spend an Action  +  3 Natural Recovery Charges to replenish a Level 3 Spell Slot . At level 7, unlock the ability to spend an Action  +  4 Natural Recovery Charges to replenish a Level 4 Spell Slot . At level 9, unlock the ability to spend an Action  +  5 Natural Recovery Charges to replenish a Level 5 Spell Slot . Technical details UIDs Shout_NaturalRecovery Container ability Shout_NaturalRecovery_1 Version to restore level 1 slot Shout_NaturalRecovery_2 Version to restore level 2 slot Shout_NaturalRecovery_3 Version to restore level 3 slot Shout_NaturalRecovery_4 Version to restore level 4 slot Shout_NaturalRecovery_5 Version to restore level 5 slot Spell flags IsLinkedSpellContainer How to learn Classes: Class level 2: Circle of the Land Notes A Circle of the Land druid receives a number of Natural Recovery Charges equal to class level divided by two, rounded up. For example, a level 5 druid will have 3 Natural Recovery Charges total. These charges replenish after a long rest. Recovering a spell slot costs a number of charges equal to the spell level. For example, recovering a Level 3 Spell Slot costs 3 Natural Recovery Charges . The maximum spell level that can be replenished is capped at level 5 even though a level 11 or 12 druid will have 6 total charges. Unlike Create Spell Slot , this action cannot add new spell slots, only replenish expended slots. v t e Druid Subclasses Circle of the Land Circle of the Moon Circle of the Spores Circle of the Stars Wild Shapes Creatures Badger Bear Cat Spider Wolf Dire Raven Deep Rothé Panther Owlbear Sabre-Toothed Tiger Dilophosaurus Air Myrmidon Earth Myrmidon Fire Myrmidon Water Myrmidon Starry Forms Archer Chalice Dragon Lands Arctic Coast Desert Forest Grassland Mountain Swamp Underdark Other class features Cosmic Omen Fungal Infestation Halo of Spores Improved Wild Strike Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain Lunar Mend Natural Recovery Nature's Ward Primal Strike Spells Spreading Spores Symbiotic Entity Twinkling Constellations Wild Strike

## Nebulous Black Hole
- **来源**: [Nebulous Black Hole](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Nebulous_Black_Hole)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the improved full-illithid power. For the partial-illithid version, see Black Hole . Nebulous Black Hole is an action and Illithid Power available to Full-Illithids . This ability creates a black hole which violently pulls in nearby enemies, dealing ⁠ Force damage and possibly slowing them. Description Create a point of intense gravity that pulls in all nearby enemies and possibly Slows them. Properties Cost Action Damage: 7~34 3d10 + 4 ⁠ Force Details INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 18 m (60 ft) AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Radius Targets: All enemies in range Technical details UID Target_MF_BlackHole Spell flags DisableBlood , IsHarmful , Wildshape Condition: Black Hole Black Hole Duration: 1 turn INT Save ( Spell save DC ) The black hole pulls nearby creatures and deals 3d10+4 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage. The nearby area is Difficult Terrain and can Slow creatures within it. [ See: Bugs ] How to learn Used by creatures: Full-Illithid Notes This action is obtained automatically after becoming a Full-Illithid . This action deals damage immediately when cast and then the Black Hole condition deals damage again when applied, effectively making Nebulous Black Hole deal 6d10+8 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage to creatures that fail their saving throws. Bugs Due to a miscoded Force() function, the trajectory arcs of affected creatures can be manipulated to throw them over the black hole entity and to the other side of it. Black Hole behaves as intended.

## Ominous Bite
- **来源**: [Ominous Bite](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Ominous_Bite)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Ominous Bite is a Hound of Ill Omen class action that allows them to place an omen on enemy targets. Description Bite a target and possibly place an Omen on them. Properties Cost Action Damage: 3~18 3d6 ⁠ Piercing Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Condition: Omen of Acid Omen of Acid Duration: 3 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) If the affected entity is dealt 1 ⁠ ⁠ Acid damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1 Sorcery Point . Condition: Omen of Cold Omen of Cold Duration: 3 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) If the affected entity is dealt 1 ⁠ ⁠ Cold damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1 Sorcery Point . Condition: Omen of Fire Omen of Fire Duration: 3 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) If the affected entity is dealt 1 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1 Sorcery Point . Condition: Omen of Lightning Omen of Lightning Duration: 3 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) If the affected entity is dealt 1 ⁠ ⁠ Lightning damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1 Sorcery Point . Condition: Omen of Thunder Omen of Thunder Duration: 3 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) If the affected entity is dealt 1 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1 Sorcery Point . Condition: Omen of Poison Omen of Poison Duration: 3 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) If the affected entity is dealt 1 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage, the owner of the hound will regain 1 Sorcery Point . How to learn Classes: Class level 6: Shadow Magic Used by creatures: Hound of Ill Omen Notes The save for this attack uses the hound's spell save DC, not the sorcerer's. It is based on the hound's Wisdom, so the only way to increase the DC is to consume a Elixir of Battlemage's Power with the hound. If the target fails its save, the omen applied to it is randomly determined by a series of dice rolls. [ See: Bugs ] Omen of Acid has a 50% chance of being applied. Omen of Cold has a 25% chance of being applied. Omen of Fire has a 12.5% chance of being applied. Omen of Lightning has a 6.25% chance of being applied. Omen of Thunder has a 3.125% chance of being applied. Omen of Poison has a 3.125% chance of being applied. More than one omen can be active on the same target at once, provided that they are different elements. Omens of the same element cannot be applied as one already active; the roll for the element will be skipped and the next element will be rolled for instead. The damage to trigger the omen can come from any source. Bugs The method by which each omen condition is rolled for is bugged in comparison to Larian's intended method due to a miscoded khn function . See the Hound's Omen page for additional information. After dealing the correct damage type to an enemy afflicted with an omen, the sorcerer receives a condition named "Hound's Omen: Sorcery Point" for one turn which lacks an icon. Despite being a melee weapon attack, Ominous Bite is not affected by any damage modifiers that would normally apply to weapon attacks, such as Inquisitor's Might or Elixir of the Colossus . v t e Sorcerer Subclasses Draconic Bloodline Shadow Magic Storm Sorcery Wild Magic Metamagic Careful Spell Distant Spell Extended Spell Twinned Spell Heightened Spell Quickened Spell Subtle Spell Draconic Ancestry Red Black Blue White Green Gold Silver Bronze Copper Brass Heart of the Storm Lightning Thunder Resistance Other class features Bend Luck Controlled Chaos Create Spell Slot Create Sorcery Points Draconic Resilience Elemental Affinity: Damage Elemental Affinity: Resistance Eyes of the Dark Eyes of the Dark: Darkness Fly Hound of Ill Omen Shadow Walk Storm's Fury Strength of the Grave Tempestuous Magic Tides of Chaos Wild Magic Spells

## One with Shadows (class action)
- **来源**: [One with Shadows (class action)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/One_with_Shadows_(class_action))
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

See also: Hide in Plain Sight One with Shadows is an Eldritch Invocation from the Warlock class. It allows the warlock to vanish into darkness while standing still. Description Vanish into the darkness and become Invisible , as long as you stand still. Area must be Lightly or Heavily Obscured Invisibility ends early if you move, cast another spell, take an action, or take damage. Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Duration: Until Long rest Technical details UID Shout_OneWithShadows Spell flags Invisible , Stealth Condition: One with the Shadows One with the Shadows Duration: Until Long rest Affected entity is invisible. It has Advantage on Attack Rolls and imposes Disadvantage on enemy Attack Rolls. Invisibility ends early if the invisible entity moves, attacks, casts another spell, takes an action, or takes damage. How to learn Other ways to learn: Granted to Warlocks who choose the Eldritch Invocation One with Shadows at level 2+. Notes Some movement actions like Fly (Illithid Power) or Brutal Leap do not break the invisibility so it is possible to move around while remaining invisible indefinitely. This applies to most other actions with the Invisible spell flag as well. The two exceptions are the basic Jump and Fly (class action) actions which are specifically coded to remove One with the Shadows . v t e Warlock Subclasses The Archfey The Fiend The Great Old One The Hexblade Pact Boon Pact of the Chain Pact of the Blade Pact of the Tome Eldritch Invocations Agonising Blast Armour of Shadows Beast Speech Beguiling Influence Book of Ancient Secrets Devil's Sight Dreadful Word Fiendish Vigour Lifedrinker Mask of Many Faces Minions of Chaos Mire the Mind One with Shadows Otherworldly Leap Repelling Blast Sculptor of Flesh Sign of Ill Omen Thief of Five Fates Whispers of the Grave Other class features Accursed Spectre Armour of Hexes Beguiling Defences Bind Hexed Weapon Dark One's Blessing Dark One's Own Luck Entropic Ward Fey Presence Fiendish Resilience Deepened Pact Hex Warrior Hexblade's Curse Misty Escape Mortal Reminder Mystic Arcanum Spells Thought Shield: Psychic Reflection Thought Shield: Psychic Resistance

## Pact of the Blade
- **来源**: [Pact of the Blade](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Pact_of_the_Blade)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the action to summon a new pact weapon. For the action to bind an existing weapon, see Bind Pact Weapon . For the Pact Boon, see Pact of the Blade (passive feature) . Pact of the Blade is a class action available to Warlocks that choose Pact of the Blade at level 3. It allows the warlock to conjure a magical weapon of a chosen type. Alternative, warlocks may bind an existing weapon with Bind Pact Weapon . Description Summon a weapon to your hand. It uses the wielder's Charisma modifier , and its damage is magical. You are Proficient with the weapon. You can only have one at a time. The weapon disappears if you are more than 1.5 m (5 ft) away from it for more than 10 rounds. Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Recharge: Per combat Technical details UID Shout_PactOfTheBlade Spell flags IsLinkedSpellContainer Variants Pact of the Blade: Battleaxe Pact of the Blade: Glaive Pact of the Blade: Greatsword Pact of the Blade: Rapier Pact of the Blade: Trident Pact of the Blade: Warhammer Pact of the Blade: Flail Pact of the Blade: Maul Pact of the Blade: Sickle How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Warlock Notes The weapon action DC of the summoned Pact Weapon still uses Strength or Dexterity instead of Charisma . The last three variants, Flail , Maul , and Sickle , are exclusive to Hexblades who choose Pact of the Blade. Other warlock subclasses will not have access to them.

## Pact of the Blade: Flail
- **来源**: [Pact of the Blade: Flail](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Pact_of_the_Blade:_Flail)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Pact of the Blade: Flail is a class action available to Hexblades that selected the Pact of the Blade at level 3. It is a variation of Pact of the Blade that summons a new Pactbound Flail to your hand. Description Summon a flail. You are Proficient with the weapon. You can only have one at a time. The weapon disappears if you are more than 1.5 m (5 ft) away from it for more than 10 rounds. Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Recharge: Per combat Technical details UID Shout_PactOfTheBlade_Hexblade_Flail Item: Pactbound Flail Pactbound Flail   – Duration: Permanent Damage: 1~8 1d8 ⁠ Bludgeoning Properties Flails Melee Martial One-handed Price: 0 gp Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Condition: Hexed Weapon Hexed Weapon Duration: Permanent The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical and uses the warlock's Charisma modifier. When the warlock attacks with this weapon, there is a chance that Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Hexblade (via Pact of the Blade ) This spell is a variation of: Pact of the Blade Notes The weapon action DC of the summoned Pact Weapon still uses Strength or Dexterity instead of Charisma . Unlike some other Pact of the Blade weapon summoning actions, this one is exclusive to Hexblades . Bugs This summoned weapon includes a hidden boost which provides proficiency for its weapon type, redundant with the innate Hexed Weapon it receives. Thus, when this weapon is equipped on a character that has Dual Wielder , the character is able to wield another weapon of this type with full proficiency in both hands.

## Panache
- **来源**: [Panache](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Panache)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Panache is a class action available to Swashbuckler rogues. Description Roll a Persuasion check to beguile a humanoid, who must contest it with an Insight check. Enemies who fail gain Panache: Disadvantage ; others who fail become Charmed . Doesn't work on beasts, constructs, elementals, monstrosities, plants, or undead. In higher difficulty modes, the target might accuse the caster of enchanting them. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) Targets: Creature that is not a beast , monstrosity , plant , undead , ooze , construct , or elemental Duration: 10 turns Technical details UID Target_Panache Spell flags HasVerbalComponent Condition: Panache: Disadvantage Panache: Disadvantage Duration: 10 turns You have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against all enemies except the caster of Panache . You are also unable to make Opportunity Attacks against enemies other than the caster. Condition: Charmed Charmed Duration: 10 turns Cannot attack the spellcaster. The spellcaster has Advantage on Charisma Checks in dialogue. How to learn Classes: Class level 9: Swashbuckler Notes This action involves a contested skill check similar to Shove . See Contests for details. In particular, the character rolls a Persuasion skill check with a DC equal to the target's passive Insight score which is given by 10 + Wisdom modifier + proficiency bonus (if proficient) + other bonuses . Advantage on Insight checks (or Wisdom checks in general) gives a +5 flat bonus to this DC, while Disadvantage reduces the DC by 5. It is not stated anywhere, but the Panache: Disadvantage condition is removed when any creature other than the Swashbuckler attacks or targets the affected entity with a harmful ability. It is not stated on the action, but in higher difficulty modes, the target might accuse the caster of enchanting them. Bugs Enemies with the War Caster or Polearm Master feats still take Opportunity Attacks when otherwise affected by this feature. v t e Rogue Subclasses Arcane Trickster Assassin Swashbuckler Thief Cunning Action Dash Disengage Hide Sneak Attack Sneak Attack (Melee) Sneak Attack (Ranged) Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee) Rakish Sneak Attack (Ranged) Other class features Assassin's Alacrity Assassinate: Ambush Assassinate: Initiative Dirty Trick Flick o' the Wrist Sand Toss Vicious Mockery Expertise Evasion Fancy Footwork Fast Hands Infiltration Expertise Mage Hand Legerdemain Magical Ambush Panache Rakish Audacity Reliable Talent Second-Story Work Supreme Sneak Uncanny Dodge

## Perilous Stakes
- **来源**: [Perilous Stakes](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Perilous_Stakes)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the partial-illithid power. For the improved full-illithid version, see Fierce Perilous Stakes . Perilous Stakes is an illithid power which causes a creature to heal when it attacks at the cost of making it vulnerable to all damage. Outside of Honour mode, this can target any creature including enemies, but in Honour mode, it can only target allies. Description Invest a creature with power that heals it when it attacks, but also makes it Vulnerable to all damage. Properties Cost Action Details INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 9 m (30 ft) Recharge: Long rest Duration: 3 turns Technical details UID Target_TAD_PerilousStakes Spell flags DisableBlood , IsHarmful Condition: Perilous Stakes Perilous Stakes Duration: 3 turns INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Affected entity is Vulnerable to all damage, but when it attacks it heals 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . How to learn Other ways to learn: Unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining the following: Transfuse Health Notes When cast on allies, there is no saving throw to apply the condition. In Honour mode , this ability can only be cast on allies. To use this on an enemy in Honour Mode, it is possible to use an enchantment spell such as Dominate Person , Dominate Beast or Planar Binding to make them an ally. It then becomes possible to apply Perilous Stakes and exploit the granted vulnerability. Bugs Perilous Stakes can be stacked multiple times upon the same character, providing multiple occurrences of healing without any additional negative effect.

## Phalar Aluve: Shriek
- **来源**: [Phalar Aluve: Shriek](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Phalar_Aluve:_Shriek)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Phalar Aluve: Shriek is a class action granted by Phalar Aluve . It is a variant of Phalar Aluve: Melody . The sword penalises nearby enemies' Saving Throws and Attack Rolls and causes them to take additional ⁠ Thunder damage whenever they are damaged. Description The sword Shrieks. All enemies within ⁠6 m (20 ft) of range have a 1d4 penalty to all [ See: Bugs ] Saving Throws . Affected creatures receive an extra 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder DRS damage. The sword will stop shrieking if unequipped. Properties Cost Action Damage: 1~4 1d4 ⁠ Thunder (Per damage instance) Details Range: Self AoE: 6 m (20 ft) Radius Targets: All enemies in range Recharge: Short rest Duration: 5 turns Technical details UID Shout_MAG_Harpers_SingingSword_Shriek Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent , IsMelee Condition: Singing Sword: Shrieking Singing Sword: Shrieking Duration: 5 turns Enemies within 6 m (20 ft) of range have 1d4 penalty to all [ See: Bugs ] Saving Throws and Attack Rolls and take an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage. Condition: Singing Sword: Shriek Singing Sword: Shriek Affected entity has 1d4 penalty to all [ See: Bugs ] Saving Throws and Attack Rolls . When it is damaged, it takes an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage. How to learn Granted by items: Phalar Aluve This spell is a variation of: Phalar Aluve: Melody Notes The condition Singing Sword: Shrieking is applied to the wielder of Phalar Aluve. The condition Singing Sword: Shriek is applied to enemies within the area of effect. Despite what the in-game descriptions implies, the additional thunder damage triggers on any damage dealt to targets in aura from any source (not just from weapon attacks from Phalar Aluve, and not just damage from direct party members). Effects that hit multiple times (such as Magic Missile ) trigger the thunder damage multiple times. The 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage does not trigger items or effects which require thunder damage, such as Hat of Storm Scion's Power , Gloves of Belligerent Skies , or Prophecy: Thunderous Applause regardless of whether the character triggering the damage has the item/effect or is the character activating Phalar Aluve: Shriek . This is because the thunder damage dealt to the enemy is from a passive effect placed on the enemy, rather than originating from the attacker which is necessary to trigger any such items or effect. This effect is changed in Honour difficulty, and functions as expected. Bugs Despite its description, Shriek affects all saving throws and attack rolls made by the affected target.

Piercing Growl is a special class action available to the Slayer . The Slayer howls so fiercely that nearby foes are wounded. Description Fierce howls rise from your guts and wound nearby foes, possibly inflicting Bleeding and Fear . Properties Cost Action Damage: 7~28 3d8 + 4 ⁠ Piercing Details CON Save ( Spell save DC ) (On Save: Target still takes full damage.) AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Cone Technical details UID Zone_Slayer_DeathGrowl Spell flags IsHarmful , Wildshape Condition: Bleeding Bleeding Duration: 2 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Takes 2 ⁠ ⁠ Slashing DRS damage at the start of each turn and has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws . Removed by healing. Condition: Fearful Fearful Duration: 2 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Has Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls . It must run from the source of its fear and cannot take any additional actions. Targets can make a Saving Throw to shake off this effect if they end their turn out of sight from their source of fear. How to learn Granted by items: Regarding the Slayer Used by creatures: Slayer Bugs The spell save DC of the Slayer's actions uses the spellcasting ability of the last class you took a first level in, but with the Slayer's ability scores. This results in a very low DC due to the Slayer's low mental ability scores. In particular, Fighters, Rogues, Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Monks, and Rangers have a +0 spellcasting modifier from Intelligence or Wisdom in Slayer form, while Barbarians, Bards, Paladins, Sorcerers, and Warlocks have a -1 spellcasting modifier from Charisma while in Slayer form.

## Pounce
- **来源**: [Pounce](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Pounce)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the panther attack. For other uses, see Pounce (disambiguation) . Pounce is an action available in Wild Shape: Panther form. It can be used to knock a target Prone , making it susceptible to Jugular Strike . Description Leap at a target to bite it and potentially knock it Prone . Properties Cost Action + Movement Speed Damage: 2~16 + modifiers 2d8 + Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Details STR Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: Jump range Recharge: Per turn At higher levels At level 4, this attack deals an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. At level 8, this additional damage becomes 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning . At level 12, this additional damage becomes 1d10 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning . Technical details UID Projectile_Pounce_Panther_Summon Spell flags IgnoreVisionBlock , IsJump Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 2 turns STR Save ( Spell save DC ) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. How to learn Used by creatures: Wild Shape: Panther Notes The range is equal to the normal Jump range which with the panther's Strength of 14 is 6.5 m (22 ft). Any modifiers that affect jump range also apply to Pounce. Unlike a normal jump, the movement cost of Pounce is equal to the distance travelled. With jump range bonuses like Enhance Leap , the range of Pounce will be limited by your movement speed. Also, unlike similar wild shape pounce abilities such as Pounce (Dilophosaurus) or Crushing Flight , the panther's pounce requires a full Action . Pounce does not count as an attack for the purposes of Wild Strike and Improved Wild Strike so you cannot pounce and attack with the same Action . Bugs The in-game tooltip says the damage dealt is ⁠ Piercing , but it actually is ⁠ Bludgeoning . v t e Druid Subclasses Circle of the Land Circle of the Moon Circle of the Spores Circle of the Stars Wild Shapes Creatures Badger Bear Cat Spider Wolf Dire Raven Deep Rothé Panther Owlbear Sabre-Toothed Tiger Dilophosaurus Air Myrmidon Earth Myrmidon Fire Myrmidon Water Myrmidon Starry Forms Archer Chalice Dragon Lands Arctic Coast Desert Forest Grassland Mountain Swamp Underdark Other class features Cosmic Omen Fungal Infestation Halo of Spores Improved Wild Strike Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain Lunar Mend Natural Recovery Nature's Ward Primal Strike Spells Spreading Spores Symbiotic Entity Twinkling Constellations Wild Strike

## Primal Stampede
- **来源**: [Primal Stampede](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Primal_Stampede)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Primal Stampede is a Wildheart barbarian class action only available while using Rage: Elk Heart , allowing you charge in a line dealing damage to all enemies and knocking them prone. Description Charge forward, attacking all enemies in the way and possibly knocking them Prone . Available only when Raging . Does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. Properties Cost Action + Movement Speed Damage: 1~4 + modifiers 1d4 + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Melee Unarmed Attack Roll STR Save ( DC  10 + Strength modifier) AoE: 9 m (30 ft) Line Targets: All non-allied creatures in the path Technical details UID Rush_Primal_Stampede Spell flags AddFallDamageOnLand , CanAreaDamageEvade , IsHarmful Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 2 turns STR Save ( DC  10 + Strength modifier) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Wildheart Granted by spells: Rage: Elk Heart Notes Hits all enemies, friendly NPCs, and objects within a 2 m (7 ft) radius along the charge path. This action triggers Extra Attack and can be used with Extra Attack. Primal Stampede is coded as a melee, unarmed attack. However, rather than using the typical UnarmedDamage variable, Primal Stampede does a fixed 1d4 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage. Because of this, various other effects may not behave as expected. Items and features that add a bonus to melee unarmed attack rolls apply to Primal Stampede. Examples include the attack roll components of Tavern Brawler and the Gloves of Crushing . Items and features that add a bonus to all attack rolls also apply to Primal Stampede. Examples include the attack roll components of Legacy of the Masters and Mutilated Carapace . Items and features that add a bonus to unarmed damage do not apply to Primal Stampede. Examples include, ironically, the Rage: Elk Heart damage bonus as well as the damage components of Tavern Brawler and the Gloves of Crushing. Items and features that add a damage bonus to all (relevant) damage do apply to Primal Stampede. Examples include the Shadow-Cloaked Ring , Overloaded With Synaptic Power (from Psionic Overload ), and the damage component of Mutilated Carapace. Whether other non-attack-roll, non-damage-bonus effects apply to Primal Stampede depends upon how they are coded. To apply to Primal Stampede, the effect either needs to be so general that it would apply to any type of attack or damage, or it needs to apply to melee unarmed attacks without checking for unarmed damage. Examples include: the Bleeding effect from the Helldusk Gloves , because that effect applies whenever you deal damage; the Soul Catching effect (but not the damage bonus) from the Gloves of Soul Catching , because that effect applies whenever you deal damage with an unarmed attack; and accumulating Lightning Charges from The Sparkle Hands , because that effect applies to all unarmed attacks that hit. v t e Barbarian Subclasses Berserker Giant Wild Magic Wildheart Rage Frenzy Giant's Rage Rage Bear Heart Eagle Heart Elk Heart Tiger Heart Wolf Heart Rage: Wild Magic Aspect of the Beast Bear Chimpanzee Crocodile Eagle Elk Honey Badger Stallion Tiger Wolf Wolverine Bestial Heart Bear Heart Eagle Heart Elk Heart Tiger Heart Wolf Heart Bolstering Magic Boon Level 1 Spell Slot Level 2 Spell Slot Level 3 Spell Slot Other Class Features Boot of the Giants Brutal Critical Danger Sense Diving Strike Elemental Cleaver Extra Attack Fast Movement Feral Instinct Inciting Howl Intimidating Presence Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain Magic Awareness Mighty Impel Mindless Rage Primal Stampede Reckless Attack Relentless Rage Tiger's Bloodlust Unarmoured Defence Unrelenting Ferocity Unstable Backlash Vaprak's Greed

## Psionic Overload
- **来源**: [Psionic Overload](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Psionic_Overload)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Psionic Overload is an action and Illithid Power . It grants a 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage bonus to each of the caster's attacks at the cost of dealing 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage to the caster each turn. This lasts for 10 turns or until the end of combat. Description Your attacks deal an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage, but you take 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage every turn. Properties Cost Action Damage: 2~8 1d4 ⁠ Psychic (Per attack) + 1d4 ⁠ Psychic (Per turn to caster) Details Range: Self Recharge: Short rest Duration: 10 turns Technical details UID Shout_TAD_PsionicOverload Condition: Overloaded With Synaptic Power Overloaded With Synaptic Power Duration: 10 turns Affected entity deals an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage with its attacks, but also receives 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage per turn. How to learn Used by creatures: Illithid , Partial-Illithid , and Full-Illithid Other ways to learn: Unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen Obtained automatically after becoming a Partial-Illithid Obtained automatically after becoming a Full-Illithid Notes The extra damage inflicted is added to any action using an Attack Roll including weapon attacks, unarmed strikes, attack roll spells, and thrown attacks. Actions involving multiple attack rolls such as Eldritch Blast or Flurry of Blows gain the bonus damage for each individual hit. Spells that do not use attack rolls, such as Magic Missile , do not benefit from this ability. Self-damage received each round still induces Concentration checks if using spells which require it. If must-have spells (e.g. Haste ) are wanted alongside Psionic Overload, it may be advisable to have an ally cast them (on the character using Psionic Overload). Self-damage from this ability breaks Sanctuary on the caster, despite the spell stating it breaks from damaging "another creature". Self-damage from this ability may result in multiple damage riders on the caster: having effects such as Lightning Charges or radiant damage from the Callous Glow Ring while Psionic Overload is active will likely result in the user of this ability taking significant damage each turn.

## Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee)
- **来源**: [Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Rakish_Sneak_Attack_(Melee))
- **分类**: Actions

This article is about the melee version of the attack. For the ranged version, see Rakish Sneak Attack (Ranged) . Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee) is a Swashbuckler rogue weapon action which replaces normal Sneak Attack . This ability allows the rogue to exploit an enemy's distraction and deal extra damage to their vulnerable spots with melee weapons. The weapon must have the Finesse property, but can still utilise Strength if it is higher than Dexterity. Description Deal extra damage to a foe you have Advantage against. You can also use this attack without Advantage if there are no other combatants within 2 m (7 ft) of the target, or if you have an ally within that range. You can't use this attack if you have Disadvantage . Properties Cost Action Damage: 2~12 Normal weapon damage + 2d6 ⁠ Weapon Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Recharge: Per turn At higher levels For every 2 Swashbuckler levels above 3, Rakish Sneak Attack deals an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon damage, up to 6d6 at level 11: 3d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon at level 5 4d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon at level 7 5d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon at level 9 6d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon at level 11 Technical details UID Target_SneakAttack_Rakish Spell flags IsHarmful , IsMelee , IsSwarmAttack How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Swashbuckler Notes (see notes from the normal version of Sneak Attack (Melee) ) Bugs The tooltip states 2 m (7 ft), but the actual distance is 1.5 m (5 ft). This is usable against an enemy combatant regardless of how many additional enemies are near it as long as those additional enemies are not within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the attacker. If an ally of the attacker is within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the attacker, but is not within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the target, this attack will not be usable. Rakish Sneak Attack is able to apply twice on a single attack in real time outside of combat. This is done by directly using the Rakish action with sneak attack set to ask. v t e Rogue Subclasses Arcane Trickster Assassin Swashbuckler Thief Cunning Action Dash Disengage Hide Sneak Attack Sneak Attack (Melee) Sneak Attack (Ranged) Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee) Rakish Sneak Attack (Ranged) Other class features Assassin's Alacrity Assassinate: Ambush Assassinate: Initiative Dirty Trick Flick o' the Wrist Sand Toss Vicious Mockery Expertise Evasion Fancy Footwork Fast Hands Infiltration Expertise Mage Hand Legerdemain Magical Ambush Panache Rakish Audacity Reliable Talent Second-Story Work Supreme Sneak Uncanny Dodge

## Reckless Attack
- **来源**: [Reckless Attack](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Reckless_Attack)
- **分类**: Actions

Reckless Attack is a Barbarian weapon action that grants advantage on all attacks for 1 round, but makes all incoming attacks targetting the barbarian also have advantage for the same duration. It can alternatively be triggered as a free post-strike reaction on a miss (provided the attack was not already benefiting from advantage). Description Throw all caution in the wind to gain Advantage on your melee Attack Roll . Until your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls, but enemies also have advantage on attack rolls against you. Properties Cost Action Damage Normal weapon damage Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Range: Normal weapon range Technical details UIDs Target_RecklessAttack Direct action Interrupt_RecklessAttack Post-strike reaction Spell flags IsHarmful , IsMelee Condition: Reckless Attack Reckless Attack Duration: 1 turn You have Advantage on Attack Rolls , but enemies also have Advantage on Attack Rolls against you. How to learn Classes: Class level 2: Barbarian Used by creatures: Abby , Arthus , Baff Elkhorn , Bearclaw , Bedi , Bombasto , Bor , Dror Ragzlin , Garmor , Gleeful Clong , Haseid , Inku Neza , Lady Flux , Lobo Denysse , Lord Jannath's Bodyguard , Mask of Vengeance (The Blushing Mermaid) , Morgya , Shiv Dahlia , Skoona , Somi , Tairn , Thudd , Tusgront , Ulma , and Vol Notes While Reckless Attack (both the action and post-strike reaction) must be made with a melee weapon attack, all subsequent melee and throwing attacks for the turn gain Advantage . When toggled in the Reaction menu, Reckless Attack will trigger, or ask, on every miss . It will not trigger on hits. Creatures must succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw or lose their Invisibility. Condition: Revealed Revealed DEX Save ( Spell save DC ) Affected entity lost its Invisibility due to the effects of See Invisibility . ## Seismic Strike
- **来源**: [Seismic Strike](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Seismic_Strike)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Seismic Strike is an action unique to Earth Elementals . It lets them create a quake that damages and slows nearby creatures. Description Bring down your arms like stone slabs, smashing nearby creatures, pushing them back 3m / 10ft, and making them wobble on Trembling Legs . Properties Cost Action Damage: 4~24 4d6 ⁠ Bludgeoning Details DEX Save ( Spell save DC ) (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) Range: Self AoE: 4 m (13 ft) Radius Pushes: 3 m (10 ft) Targets: All creatures in range Duration: 3 turns Technical details UID Shout_SeismicStrike_Elemental_Earth Spell flags IsMelee Condition: Trembling Legs Trembling Legs Duration: 3 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Affected entity is still wobbling on unsteady legs. Its movement speed is reduced by 2.5m / 8.3ft, and its Dexterity is reduced by 1. How to learn Used by creatures: Earth Elemental Notes Unlike Quake , this attack affects floating creatures, such as Mud Mephits . Bugs The Force() functor used to knockback targets uses the OriginToTarget argument, which does not push targets away from the caster in a perpendicular line when used with Shout_ type spells.

## Shadowsoaked Blow
- **来源**: [Shadowsoaked Blow](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shadowsoaked_Blow)

Shadowsoaked Blow is a weapon action granted by Sword of Clutching Umbra and Justiciar's Scimitar . Description Strike an enemy, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage. Moreover, if the attack hits, it deals an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage. This attack doesn't break concealment. Properties Cost Action Damage: 1~6 + modifiers Normal weapon damage + Proficiency bonus ⁠ Piercing + 1d6 ⁠ Psychic Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Short rest Must be proficient with weapon Technical details UID Target_MAG_WeaponAction_ShadowBlade Spell flags IsDefaultWeaponAction , IsHarmful , IsMelee , Stealth How to learn Granted by items: Sword of Clutching Umbra Justiciar's Scimitar Notes "Not breaking concealment" means that the attacker can remain Hidden after performing the attack, though it still ends Invisibility . A solo character can use this attack while hidden without entering combat. This lets them get two attacks off before their opponent is aware of them, making it an excellent candidate for use in assassinating isolated NPCs. This article is about the attack used by Harpies. For for similar attacks, see Throw Stone (disambiguation) . Sharp Rock is a ranged attack used by Harpies . Description Throw a sizable, rugged stone. Properties Cost Action Damage: 2~8 + modifiers 2d4 + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Ranged Weapon Attack Roll Range: 18 m (60 ft) Targets: Creature not affected by Luring Song Technical details UID Projectile_StoneThrow_Harpy Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , IgnoreSilence , IsEnemySpell How to learn Used by creatures: Harpy Bugs This attack lacks an IsHarmful spell flag , and thus can target creatures protected by Sanctuary . Due to how Luring Song is coded, harpies cannot use this attack against any target that was in the Luring Song's radius when it was applied – regardless of whether the target saves against the effect or not – as long as the song continues. They can only use Multiattack (Harpy) against such targets.
## Shatter Psyche
- **来源**: [Shatter Psyche](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shatter_Psyche)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the normal illithid power. For the improved full-illithid version, see Shatter Psyche (Full-illithid) . Shatter Psyche is an action and Illithid Power available to Partial-Illithids . This ability is a more potent version of Fracture Psyche which is granted after a creature under the effect of Fracture Psyche dies. It reduces the Armour Class and Saving Throws of the target by two instead of one. Description Invade a target's mind and disrupt its defences. The target's Armour Class and Saving Throws are reduced by 2. Properties Cost Action Details INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 9 m (30 ft) Recharge: Short rest Technical details UID Target_TAD_Imperil_Recast Spell flags Temporary Condition: Shattered Psyche Shattered Psyche Duration: 5 turns INT Save ( Spell save DC ) Armour Class and Saving Throws are reduced by 2. How to learn Granted by spells: Fracture Psyche Notes Despite not being mentioned in the in-game tooltip, Shatter Psyche also reduces the saving throws of the target by 2. Killing a target under the effect of Shatter Psyche does not grant another use of the action. It can only be cast once per use of Fracture Psyche .

All Saving Throws are reduced by 5 and Disadvantage on Concentration Saving Throws. ## Shield of Thralls
- **来源**: [Shield of Thralls](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shield_of_Thralls)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the base illithid power. For the upgraded full-illitihid power, see Augmented Shield of Thralls . Shield of Thralls is an Action and Illithid Power . When used, this ability grants a character 10 temporary hit points . If the temporary hit points are lost, all nearby enemies may be Stunned for 1 turn. Description Conjure a volatile shield around yourself or an ally, granting the target 10 temporary hit points . If these temporary hit points are lost due to incoming damage, the shield bursts, possibly Stunning nearby foes. Can only have temporary hit points from one source. Properties Cost Action Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Recharge: Short rest Duration: Until Long rest AoE: 3 m (10 ft) (Explosion radius) Technical details UIDs Target_TAD_ShieldOfThralls Shield action Projectile_TAD_ShieldOfThralls_Explosion Explosion triggered when the shield is broken Spell flags DisableBlood Condition: Volatile Shield Volatile Shield Duration: Until Long rest Affected entity has been granted temporary hit points by an illithid. If these are removed by incoming damage, the shield bursts, possibly Stunning nearby foes. The shield only bursts after all temporary hit points have been removed. This also removes the condition. When the shield bursts, enemies within 9 m (30 ft) are Stunned for 1 turn, unless they succeed a DC  15 Intelligence Saving Throw . Condition: Stunned Stunned Duration: 1 turn INT Save ( DC  15) Affected creatures cannot move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions . Affected creatures automatically fail Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Removed by Freedom of Movement , Greater Restoration , Unshackling Strike . Attack Rolls against affected creatures have Advantage . Breaks Concentration of target when applied How to learn Other ways to learn: Unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining the following: Transfuse Health Bugs The short rest required between casts of Shield of Thralls can be circumvented by traveling in between Act One and Act Two . This can allow multiple party members to start the day with Shield of Thralls active even if only one party member has access to the ability. This can also be done in Act Three , by traveling between locations that have loading zones. For example, traveling from Rivington , to a location in the Lower City , and vice versa.

Properties Cost Action Damage: 2~12 + modifiers 2d6 + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Melee Unarmed Attack Roll Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Technical details UID Target_Slam_Zombie_AnimateDead Spell flags DisableBlood , IsAttack , IsHarmful , IsMelee Condition: Crawling Gnaw Crawling Gnaw Duration: 1 turn Target is inflicted with zombie mucus. Newborn Zombies are statistically the same as the Summoned Zombie, except that they only have 10 Hit Points , and they have the condition Newborn Zombie , causing them to take 1 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage per turn. ## Slay
- **来源**: [Slay](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Slay)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Slay is the basic attack available to the Slayer . It is a powerful unarmed slashing attack with special effects against Bleeding or Prone targets. Any Opportunity Attacks made by the Slayer are performed with this attack as well. Description Rake your malevolent claws across the body of your target. If the target is Bleeding , they are afflicted with Contagion Poisoned at Stage 1. If the target is Prone , the attack will be a Critical Hit . If the target is bleeding and prone, the attack will be a critical hit and the target will possibly become Stricken With Flesh Rot . Properties Cost Action Damage: 4~24 + modifiers 4d6 + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Melee Unarmed Attack Roll Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) At higher levels At level 10, the damage increases to 6d6 + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing . Technical details UID Target_Slam_Slayer Spell flags DisableBlood , IsAttack , IsHarmful , IsMelee Condition: Contagion Poisoned Contagion Poisoned Duration: 3 turns Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Checks . Each turn, it must succeed on a Saving Throw , or the poison will advance in stage. On 3 successes, it recovers. On 3 failures, it contracts the disease corresponding to the variant of the spell Contagion that was cast. Condition: Stricken With Flesh Rot Stricken With Flesh Rot Duration: Until Long rest STR Save ( Spell save DC ) Rotting in their own vat of stinking Skin, the affected entity has Disadvantage on Charisma Checks and Vulnerability to all damage. How to learn Used by creatures: Slayer Notes There is a saving throw against the stronger Stricken With Flesh Rot effect, but not against Contagion Poisoned . Bugs The spell save DC of the Slayer's actions uses the spellcasting ability of the last class you took a first level in, but with the Slayer's ability scores. This results in a very low DC due to the Slayer's low mental ability scores. In particular, Fighters, Rogues, Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Monks, and Rangers have a +0 spellcasting modifier from Intelligence or Wisdom in Slayer form, while Barbarians, Bards, Paladins, Sorcerers, and Warlocks have a -1 spellcasting modifier from Charisma while in Slayer form. The saving throw against Stricken With Flesh Rot always occurs, even if the target is not bleeding nor prone. This saving throw will trigger Legendary Resistance , wasting charges from the affected enemy.

Can be removed with the Help action, using a Healing Potion or gaining Wet . Immune from if Wet . Dip action can be used on Burning characters or objects. ## Sneak Attack (Melee)
- **来源**: [Sneak Attack (Melee)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Sneak_Attack_(Melee))
- **分类**: Actions

"Sneak Attack" redirects here. For the ranged version of the action, see Sneak Attack (Ranged) . Sneak Attack (Melee) is a rogue weapon action and reaction. This ability allows the rogue to exploit an enemy's distraction and deal extra damage to their vulnerable spots with melee weapons. The weapon must have the finesse property, but can still utilise Strength if it is higher than Dexterity. Description Deal an extra 1d6 damage to a foe you have Advantage against. Also works if you have an ally within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the target and you don't have Disadvantage . Properties Cost Action Damage: 1~6 Normal weapon damage + 1d6 ⁠ Weapon Details Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Per turn At higher levels For every 2 rogue levels above 1, your Sneak Attack deals an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon damage, up to 6d6 at level 11: 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon at level 3 3d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon at level 5 4d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon at level 7 5d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon at level 9 6d6 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon at level 11 Technical details UID Target_SneakAttack Spell flags IsHarmful , IsMelee How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Rogue Notes Sneak Attack can either be used directly through this action, or triggered after landing any other finesse weapon attack as a post-strike reaction. This reaction is configured through the reaction tab , but it does not cost a Reaction resource. Sneak Attack can be used once per round and refreshes after the rogue's turn ends. This means it can be used on the rogue's turn and, when so triggered, subsequently an enemy's turn on the same round (e.g. with a Opportunity Attack ). However, if triggered by an enemy on the same round it will not be available during the rogue's next turn. If Sneak Attack is applied to a triggering attack via the reaction system, it is treated as a damage rider source (Tactician and lower difficulties only). As Sneak Attack requires a finesse weapon, it may not be used with main hand unarmed attacks, but can be used when throwing a finesse weapon. The Sneak Attack reaction will trigger when using Flurry of Blows while wielding a finesse weapon in your main hand, and uses the weapon's damage type. When using a weapon attack that hits multiple foes, such as Whirlwind Attack , the Sneak Attack reaction that can trigger from the attack will normally only affect the first target hit. However, when used in real time outside of combat within certain parameters, it can apply to multiple targets in the AoE. When dual-wielding, your off hand Sneak Attack uses the damage type of your main hand weapon. For example, if your main hand is a Practice Sword , your off hand Sneak Attack will deal bludgeoning damage, even if the off hand weapon itself is a piercing weapon. This includes whether the main hand is magical or not – for example, the Practice Sword deals non-magical damage unless an appropriate coating is applied. v t e Rogue Subclasses Arcane Trickster Assassin Swashbuckler Thief Cunning Action Dash Disengage Hide Sneak Attack Sneak Attack (Melee) Sneak Attack (Ranged) Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee) Rakish Sneak Attack (Ranged) Other class features Assassin's Alacrity Assassinate: Ambush Assassinate: Initiative Dirty Trick Flick o' the Wrist Sand Toss Vicious Mockery Expertise Evasion Fancy Footwork Fast Hands Infiltration Expertise Mage Hand Legerdemain Magical Ambush Panache Rakish Audacity Reliable Talent Second-Story Work Supreme Sneak Uncanny Dodge

## Song of Rest
- **来源**: [Song of Rest](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Song_of_Rest)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

Song of Rest is an action available to bards at level 2. This ability allows the bard to rejuvenate their party as if they took a Short Rest . It is usable once per Long Rest . Description Use your craft to soothe. You and your allies are revitalised as though you had taken a Short Rest . Properties Cost Action Details Recharge: Long rest Technical details UID Shout_SongOfRest Spell flags HasVerbalComponent How to learn Classes: Class level 2: Bard Notes This action can only be used in situations when it is possible to use a normal short rest. In particular, it is not available if any party member is engaged in combat. This ability refreshes when using the Restoration Pod in the Mind Flayer Colony , unlike 'normal' short rests, which do not refresh. This ability is quite different from the tabletop version. That version instead lets bards help themselves and their allies to regain more hit points during short rests, increasing the amount by between 1d6 and 1d12, depending on the bard's level, as long as any amount of Hit Dice are spent. As of Patch 5, silenced characters cannot use this action. Bugs This action incorrectly recharges whenever the party fast travels to a different region (i.e., whenever the dialog box for confirming travel to a different region appears), allowing for unlimited short rests. v t e Bard Subclasses College of Glamour College of Lore College of Swords College of Valour Inspiration Bardic Inspiration Combat Inspiration Font of Inspiration Improved Bardic Inspiration Mantle of Inspiration Blade Flourish Defensive Flourish Melee Ranged Slashing Flourish Melee Ranged Mobile Flourish Melee Ranged Other class features Countercharm Cutting Words Expertise Extra Attack Jack of All Trades Magical Secrets Mantle of Majesty: Command Song of Rest Spells

Sphere of Elemental Balance is an action; it allows a Way of the Four Elements monk to create a sphere that channels different elements. This action is the monk's equivalent of Chromatic Orb . Description Hurl a sphere of energy. It deals 3d8 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage, or 2d8 ⁠ Acid , ⁠ Cold , ⁠ Fire , ⁠ Lightning or ⁠ Poison damage and creates a surface. Properties Cost Action Damage Normal weapon damage + Proficiency bonus ⁠ Weapon Details Range: Normal weapon range Recharge: Short rest Must be proficient with weapon Technical details UID Target_MAG_WeaponAction_SteadfastStrike Spell flags IsDefaultWeaponAction , IsHarmful , IsMelee How to learn Granted by items: Steadfast Maul
## Stillness of Mind
- **来源**: [Stillness of Mind](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Stillness_of_Mind)
- **分类**: Actions、Class_actions

This article is about the action triggered by the passive feature. For the corresponding passive, see Stillness of Mind (passive feature) . Stillness of Mind is a class action used by Monks which purges any Charmed or Frightened condition affecting the monk. It is automatically cast by the corresponding passive, Stillness of Mind . Description Remove Charmed or Frightened conditions. Properties Cost Action Details Range: Self Technical details UID Shout_StillnessOfMind How to learn Classes: Class level 7: Monk Granted by features: Stillness of Mind Notes This action is automatically cast by the Stillness of Mind passive feature at the cost of an Action . There is no way to disable this in the reactions tab or to toggle off the passive. This counter-intuitively makes some Charmed or Frightened effects more dangerous for monks. Instead of just suffering from their relatively minor effects, a monk with Stillness of Mind will lose a full Action instead.
