Elemental Cleaver is a Giant barbarian class action that allows them to add elemental damage to their weapons and gives them the Thrown property, as well as the ability to return once thrown. Description Channel primordial might into your weapon. Until the end of your Rage , your weapon will deal 1d6 additional ⁠ Acid , ⁠ Cold , ⁠ Fire , ⁠ Lightning , or ⁠ Thunder damage, and gain the Thrown property. If thrown, it will immediately reappear in your hand. Must be Enraged. Properties Details Range: Self Technical details UID Shout_ElementalCleaver Spell flags IsLinkedSpellContainer Variants Elemental Cleaver (acid) Elemental Cleaver (cold) Elemental Cleaver (fire) Elemental Cleaver (lightning) Elemental Cleaver (thunder) How to learn Classes: Class level 6: Giant (barbarian subclass) Notes Can be applied to any number of weapons Persists when weapons with this property are sent to other characters This action can even apply the Thrown property to ranged weapons. Equipped ranged weapons will not be shown in Throw's item selection menu so an enchanted ranged weapon must be unequipped before it can be thrown. The additional elemental damage dealt when throwing a weapon infused with Elemental Cleaver is non-magical. This is neither an Action nor a Bonus action, and can be used several times in a turn - for example, to apply the condition both to the melee weapon and to the ranged weapon. ## Evasive Footwork
- **来源**: [Evasive Footwork](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Evasive_Footwork)
- **分类**: Class_actions

Evasive Footwork is a Battle Master combat manoeuvre usable as a free action. All enemies targeting the Battle Master suffer Disadvantage on their melee attacks for one turn. Description Evade attacks; enemies receive Disadvantage on melee attacks against you. Properties Cost Superiority Die Details Range: Self Technical details UID Shout_EvasiveFootwork Condition: Evasive Footwork Evasive Footwork Duration: 1 turn Enemies have Disadvantage on melee attacks against the affected entity. How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Battle Master Granted by features: Martial Adept Notes The tabletop version is quite different, instead granting a bonus to AC equal to the roll of a Superiority Dice for as long as the user keeps moving. The disadvantage on melee attacks against the user is instead more similar to the Dodge action (not implemented in the game) which grants disadvantage on all attack rolls against the user and grants advantage to the user's Dexterity saving throws . Prior to patch 8, this ability only worked on melee weapon attacks, instead of all melee attacks. Bugs The 1 turn duration of Evasive Footwork is deceptively short. The duration ticks down at the end of the Battle Master's turn and upon doing so immediately ends. Thus, aside from opportunity attacks or ripostes made during the user's active turn, Evasive Footwork ends before any enemies make their attacks. This action lacks a Self() restriction, and can provide its effect to other characters – albeit at a very close range. v t e Fighter Subclasses Arcane Archer Battle Master Champion Eldritch Knight Fighting Styles Archery Defence Duelling Great Weapon Fighting Protection Two-Weapon Fighting Manoeuvres Commander's Strike Disarming Attack Distracting Strike Evasive Footwork Feinting Attack Goading Attack Manoeuvring Attack Menacing Attack Precision Attack Pushing Attack Rally Riposte Sweeping Attack Trip Attack Arcane Shots Banishing Arrow Beguiling Arrow Bursting Arrow Enfeebling Arrow Grasping Arrow Piercing Arrow Seeking Arrow Shadow Arrow Other class features Action Surge Curving Shot Eldritch Strike Extra Attack Improved Critical Hit Improved Extra Attack Improved Combat Superiority Indomitable Magic Arrow Remarkable Athlete: Jump Remarkable Athlete: Proficiency Second Wind War Magic Weapon Bond

This article is about the ability used by spectator NPCs. For the version granted by The Spectator's Eye, see Ray of Fear . Fear Ray is a class action available to Spectators , that allows them to frighten a target. Description Shoot an eye ray that Frightens its target. Properties Cost Eyestalk action Details WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Per turn Technical details UIDs Target_FearRay_Spectator Target_UND_Spectator_Ray_Fear Spell flags CannotRotate , IsEnemySpell Condition: Frightened Frightened Duration: 2 turns WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Cannot move. Frightened entities also have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls . How to learn Used by creatures: Spectator Notes Spectators have two Eyestalk actions per turn to use their ray attacks, though each individual ray can only be used once per turn. Being Slowed prevents using this action. While slowed, the only ray attack a spectator can use is Wounding Ray . Bugs The tooltip for this ability states it applies Frightened for 3 turns.
## Fiendish Ascension
- **来源**: [Fiendish Ascension](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Fiendish_Ascension)
- **分类**: Class_actions

Fiendish Ascension is a free action available to Raphael that lets him take his infernal form after a Soul Pillar has been destroyed. He can use this action once per destroy Soul Pillar. Description Harness the energy of a recently shattered Soul Pillar to take on a more powerful infernal form, and consume a new soul for every broken pillar. Each time Raphael transforms he may stay in this heightened aspect for longer. Properties Details Recharge: Four times per battle Technical details UIDs Shout_LOW_Raphael_Transform Version usable after one soul pillar is destroyed Shout_LOW_Raphael_Transform_2 Version usable after two soul pillars are destroyed Shout_LOW_Raphael_Transform_3 Version usable after three soul pillars are destroyed Shout_LOW_Raphael_Transform_4 Version usable after all soul pillars are destroyed Spell flags IgnoreSilence , IsEnemySpell Condition: Ascended Fiend Ascended Fiend Raphael has gorged on souls and enhanced his fiendish powers, granting him an even deadlier array of spells and abilities. In this form, Soul Overcharge will not prevent him from using Souls to cast spells. How to learn Used by creatures: Raphael Notes Raphael has four versions of this ability with escalating potency. After one soul pillar is destroyed, he transforms into Ascended Fiend for 1 turn. After two soul pillars are destroyed, he transforms into Ascended Fiend for 2 turns. After three soul pillar are destroyed, he transforms into Ascended Fiend for 3 turns. After all soul pillars are destroyed, he transforms into Ascended Fiend permanently. Additionally, Raphael becomes enraged, changing his AI to only use melee attacks. These versions do not need to be used in order. Raphael will skip to using the strongest one available to him. The in-game tooltip says this ability is once per battle, but this is misleading since each of the four copies can be used once per battle.

## Flurry of Moths: Attack

Flurry of Moths: Attack is a free reaction available to Swarmkeeper rangers who have chosen the Flurry of Moths . It can be triggered once per turn when hitting an enemy to deal additional damage. Description Use your swarm to attack the same target and deal 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage. Properties Damage: 1~6 1d6 ⁠ Psychic Details Recharge: Per turn At higher levels At level 11, Mighty Swarm increases the damage to 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic . How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Swarmkeeper Notes Due to Prey's Scent , this ability will deal an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic to targets marked with Hunter's Mark . This damage does not increase with Mighty Swarm . Bugs A hidden technical condition, which is responsible for applying a visual effect to struck targets, triggers the passives from Boots of Stormy Clamour , Coldbrim Hat , and Diadem of Arcane Synergy . v t e Ranger Subclasses Beast Master Gloom Stalker Hunter Swarmkeeper Favoured Enemy Bounty Hunter Keeper of the Veil Mage Breaker Ranger Knight Sanctified Stalker Natural Explorer Beast Tamer Urban Tracker Wasteland Wanderer ( Cold Fire Poison ) Other class features Bestial Fury Companion's Bond Dread Ambusher Melee Ranged Hide Escape the Horde Exceptional Training Extra Attack Gathered Swarm Cloud of Jellyfish Flurry of Moths Legion of Bees Hide in Plain Sight Hunter's Prey Colossus Slayer Giant Killer Horde Breaker Iron Mind Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain Mighty Swarm Multiattack Defence Prey's Scent Spells Ranger's Companion Stalker's Flurry Steel Will Superior Darkvision Umbral Shroud Volley Whirlwind Attack Writhing Tide

Flurry of Moths: Blinding Swarm is a free reaction available to Swarmkeeper rangers who have chosen the Flurry of Moths . It can be triggered once per turn when hitting an enemy to potentially blind it. Description Use your swarm to Blind your target. Properties Details CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Recharge: Per turn At higher levels At level 11, Mighty Swarm upgrades this ability to Flurry of Moths: Mighty Blinding Swarm with an additional Slow effect. Condition: Blinded Blinded Duration: 1 turn CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls . Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft). Flurry of Moths: Mighty Blinding Swarm is a free reaction available to Swarmkeeper rangers who have chosen the Flurry of Moths . Description Use your swarm to Blind and Slow your target. Properties Details CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Recharge: Per turn Condition: Blinded Blinded Duration: 1 turn CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls . Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft). Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have Advantage . Condition: Slowed Slowed Duration: 1 turn CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Affected entity's Movement Speed is halved, and its Armour Class and Dexterity Saving Throws are reduced by 2. The entity can't take Reactions or make more than 1 attack per turn, [ See: Bugs ] and can only take either an Action or a Bonus Action . Spells cast might be delayed for 1 turn. [ See: Bugs ] How to learn Classes: Class level 11: Swarmkeeper Notes The Blinded condition only lasts 1 turn and ends at the start of the enemy's turn. This means it will not affect the enemy for even a single turn. ## Fly (class action)
- **来源**: [Fly (class action)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Fly_(class_action))
- **分类**: Class_actions

This article is about the most common Fly action. For other uses, see Fly (disambiguation) . Fly is a movement action which allows a creature to fly from one position to another. Movement with this action costs half as much as normal movement. This action is commonly used by winged and other flying creatures. It is also accessible to players through spells such as Grant Flight and certain class features. Description Fly to a target position Properties Cost Movement Speed (Half cost) Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) Technical details UIDs Projectile_Fly Projectile_Fly_Spell Projectile_Jump_Harpy Projectile_Jump_Imp Projectile_Jump_Mephit Projectile_Jump_Spectator Projectile_Fly_Dog_Ghost Projectile_Fly_Bat Projectile_Jump_Ghoul_Flying Projectile_Jump_AnimateDead_Ghoul_Flying Projectile_Jump_Cloaker Projectile_Jump_GiantEagle Projectile_Jump_Vampire_Bats Spell flags CannotTargetCharacter , CannotTargetItems , HasHighGroundRangeExtension , IgnoreVisionBlock , Invisible , IsJump , NoAOEDamageOnLand , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold , Stealth How to learn Classes: Class level 11: Draconic Bloodline Granted by spells: Fly (bonus action) Githborn: Flying Boots Grant Flight Ride the Wind Used by creatures: Aelis Siryasius , Air Elemental , Bat , Blue Jay , Cambion , Cazador Szarr , Cloaker , Dame Aylin , Dire Raven , Flying Ghoul , Ghost , Giant Eagle , Gilded Imp , Haarlep , Harpy , Imp , Krank , Lorroakan , Mage Hand , Mephit , Mind-Claw of Tu'narath , Mizora , Moonlight Sliver , Myrmidon , Phantasm , Poltergeist , Raven , Spectator , and Winged Horror Notes This is the action granted by Flight . There are many similar Fly actions aside from this one. Refer to Fly (disambiguation) for a list.
## Fly (Dire Raven Companion)
- **来源**: [Fly (Dire Raven Companion)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Fly_(Dire_Raven_Companion))
- **分类**: Class_actions

See also: Fly (disambiguation) Fly is a unique movement action available to Dire Raven Companions . It is equivalent to the common Fly action except it creates a lingering cloud of inky darkness when landing. Description Fly to a target position and create a small cloud of Darkness . Properties Cost Movement Speed Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) AoE: 3 m (10 ft) Radius Creates Area: Darkness Technical details UID Projectile_Fly_Darkness_Raven Spell flags CannotTargetCharacter , CannotTargetItems , HasHighGroundRangeExtension , IgnoreVisionBlock , Invisible , IsJump , NoAOEDamageOnLand , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold , Stealth Area: Darkness Darkness Duration: 2 turns AoE: 3 m (10 ft) Radius A shroud of magical darkness that Heavily Obscures and Blinds creatures within. Creatures cannot make ranged attacks into or out of the darkness. Type: Cloud Condition: Blinded Blinded Duration: Whilst on surface Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls . Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft). Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have Advantage . How to learn Classes: Class level 11: Beast Master Used by creatures: Corvus Celer Notes As a free action, this can be repeatedly performed in a single turn as long as the raven still has movement left. Corvus Celer has Raven Sight which renders it immune to the blinding effects of the darkness cloud.
## Fly (Illithid Power)
- **来源**: [Fly (Illithid Power)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Fly_(Illithid_Power))
- **分类**: Class_actions

This article is about the partial-illithid power. For the upgraded full-illithid version, see Levitate . For other uses, see Fly (disambiguation) . Fly is a movement action and illithid power which allows a character to fly to a target position using movement speed at half cost. It is unlocked automatically for characters who become partial-illithids . This action is functionally equivalent to the normal Fly action and differs only visually. Description Fly to a target position. Properties Cost Movement Speed (Half cost) Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) Technical details UID Projectile_TAD_Levitate Spell flags CannotTargetCharacter , CannotTargetItems , HasHighGroundRangeExtension , IgnoreVisionBlock , Invisible , IsJump , NoAOEDamageOnLand , RangeIgnoreVerticalThreshold , Stealth How to learn Used by creatures: Partial-illithid Bugs While it is supposed to replace the Jump action's keybinding, this interaction is unreliable and seems to be bugged. It will often initially work, but then be reset to Jump when e.g. loading a saved game.

## Forced Manoeuvre
- **来源**: [Forced Manoeuvre](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Forced_Manoeuvre)
- **分类**: Class_actions

See also: Manoeuvring Attack (Melee) and Manoeuvring Attack (Ranged) Forced Manoeuvre is a Battle Master fighter situational action granted after performing a Manoeuvring Attack . This is a free action that increases the movement speed of an ally by 4.5 m (15 ft) for a turn and prevents Opportunity Attacks . Description Increase an ally's movement speed by 4.5 m (15 ft). They don't provoke Opportunity Attacks . Properties Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Targets: Allies and not self Duration: 1 turn Technical details UID Target_ForcedManeuver Spell flags Temporary Condition: Forced Manoeuvre Forced Manoeuvre Duration: 1 turn Movement speed increased by 4.5 m (15 ft) and doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks . How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Battle Master Granted by features: Martial Adept Granted by spells: Manoeuvring Attack (Melee) Manoeuvring Attack (Ranged) Notes The in-game tooltip says this action increases movement speed by 50%, but it actually increases it by a flat 4.5 m (15 ft) and is unaffected by any base movement speed modifiers.
## Forever Indebted
- **来源**: [Forever Indebted](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Forever_Indebted)
- **分类**: Class_actions

Forever Indebted is a free action available to various debtors in the House of Hope . Users use this ability to detonate themselves on an enemy, creating a fiendish creature. Description On dying, explode and reincarnate as another fiendish creature - the debt must be paid, even in death. Properties Damage: 6~48 6d8 ⁠ Fire Details DEX Save (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) Range: 3 m (10 ft) AoE: 4 m (13 ft) Radius Targets: All non-fiend creatures in the radius Technical details UID Projectile_LOW_HouseOfHope_DebtorExplode Spell flags CanAreaDamageEvade , IsHarmful Creature: Vengeful Boar STR 18 (+4) DEX 12 (+1) CON 16 (+3) INT 6 (-2) WIS 10 CHA 5 (-3) Hit Points 34 Armour Class 12 Movement Speed 12 m (40 ft) Creature: Vengeful Imp STR 6 (-2) DEX 17 (+3) CON 13 (+1) INT 11 WIS 12 (+1) CHA 18 (+4) Hit Points 26 Armour Class 13 Size Small Creature: Vengeful Merregon STR 18 (+4) DEX 14 (+2) CON 17 (+3) INT 6 (-2) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 8 (-1) Hit Points 45 Armour Class 16 How to learn Used by creatures: Eternal Debtor Notes Each debtor turns into a predefined fiend with this action: Vengeful Boar - Smouldering , Perfect , Shameful , and Loyal eternal debtors Vengeful Imp - Devoured , Voyeur , Visionary , Waltzing , and Unclean eternal debtors Vengeful Merregon - Theologist , Immortal , and Mocking eternal debtors
## Fungal Infestation
- **来源**: [Fungal Infestation](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Fungal_Infestation)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

This article is about the action learned by Circle of the Spores druids. For the similar action used by Spaw, see Animating Spores . Fungal Infestation is a action gained by Circle of the Spores druids at level 6 that allows them to raise a Fungal Zombie from a nearby corpse using a resource exclusive to this action. Description Raises a mildewed, mould-encrusted zombie from a corpse. Target must be a beast or humanoid corpse. Properties Cost Reaction + Fungal Infestation Charge Details Range: 3 m (10 ft) Technical details UID Target_FungalInfestation Spell flags HasSomaticComponent , HasVerbalComponent Creature: Fungal Zombie STR 16 (+3) DEX 6 (-2) CON 16 (+3) INT 3 (-4) WIS 6 (-2) CHA 5 (-3) Duration Until long rest Hit Points 9 Armour Class 8 Slam ( ) Hit a target with your bare fists and infect it with the   Crawling Gnaw . How to learn Classes: Class level 6: Circle of the Spores Notes Circle of the Spores druids get 4 Fungal Infestation Charges at class level 6. These recharge on a long rest. As of Patch 8, corpses can be reused for Fungal Infestation. ## Instinctive Charm
- **来源**: [Instinctive Charm](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Instinctive_Charm)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

Instinctive Charm is an Enchantment School wizard passive feature and reaction that charms an attacker, interrupting and preventing the attack. If the target succeeds the Wisdom Saving Throw , it cannot be affected again until after a Long Rest . Description Charm an enemy attacking you. They will attack a new target if possible as a reaction. [ See Notes ] Properties Cost Reaction Details WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Condition: Charmed Charmed Duration: 1 turn WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Cannot attack the spellcaster. The spellcaster has Advantage on Charisma Checks in dialogue. Condition: Instinctive Charm: Unaffected Instinctive Charm: Unaffected Duration: Until Long rest Cannot be affected by Instinctive Charm until after a Long Rest . How to learn Classes: Class level 6: Enchantment School Notes As a general rule, creatures have Advantage on saving throws versus charm effects from enemies they are in active combat with. As a result, the saving throw for this action will always be rolled at advantage. The way this reaction works is as follows: An attacker targets the Enchantment wizard with any Attack Roll . This includes weapon, spell, and unarmed attack rolls. The Enchantment wizard triggers Instinctive Charm as a reaction before the attack is performed. On a failed saving throw, an attackers action is interrupted and cancelled. Any resources spent on the attack, including spell slots in the case of attack roll spells, are also lost. The attacker becomes Charmed by the Enchantment wizard for 1 turn. The attacker is then given an Extra Attack , even if the attacker normally would not have access to that feature and even if the triggering attack was a spell. This extra attack can be spent freely, but it cannot target the wizard due to the Charmed condition. Contrary to the description, using this free attack does not require an Reaction . On a successful save, the attacker gains the Instinctive Charm: Unaffected condition which lasts indefinitely and the attack is performed as normal. Instinctive Charm can not trigger against attackers with this condition. The way Instinctive Charm interrupts enemy attacks is very similar to Counterspell except that it works against attacks targetting the Enchantment wizard. It even uses identical animations, visuals, and sound as Counterspell. v t e Wizard Subclasses Abjuration School Bladesinging Conjuration School Divination School Enchantment School Evocation School Illusion School Necromancy School Transmutation School Spells Abjuration Conjuration Divination Enchantment Evocation Illusion Necromancy Transmutation Other class features Arcane Recovery Arcane Ward Benign Transposition: Teleport Bladesong Empowered Evocation Experimental Alchemy Expert Divination Extra Attack Focused Conjuration Grim Harvest Hypnotic Gaze Illusory Self Improved Abjuration Improved Minor Illusion Instinctive Charm Inured to Undeath Minor Conjuration: Create Water Portent Potent Cantrip Projected Ward Sculpt Spells See Invisibility Shapechanger Song of Defence Split Enchantment Third Eye: Darkvision Third Eye: See Invisibility Training in War and Song Transmuter's Stone Undead Thralls Animate Dead Additional Undead Better Summons

## Missile Snaring
- **来源**: [Missile Snaring](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Missile_Snaring)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

Not to be confused with Deflect Missiles Missile Snaring is a passive feature/reaction granted by Gloves of Missile Snaring which allows the wearer to spend a Reaction to intercept a ranged attack and reduce its damage. It is very similar to the monk's Deflect Missiles feature except it does not allow throwing the missile back at the attacker. Description You can intercept missiles from ranged weapon attacks with a Reaction , reducing their damage by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier . You can only reduce damage from the attack - any additional effects can't be negated. Properties Cost Reaction Technical details UID Interrupt_MAG_MissileSnaring How to learn Granted by items: Gloves of Missile Snaring Notes You can only reduce damage from the attack - any additional effects can't be negated. However, if the attack does multiple types of damage (for example an Arrow of Fire ), the damage reduction is applied separately to each type. Cannot be used while under the effects of any condition in the Polymorph Beast Shape status group.

- **分类**: Class_actions

Nautiloid Airstrike is an artillery attack which creates a detonation in a circular area initially marked by yellow glowing circles. Description A devastating airstrike from the illithid nautiloid in a 5m radius. Properties Damage: 10~60 5d6 ⁠ Force + 5d6 ⁠ Fire Details DEX Save ( DC  16) (On Save: Damage is halved.) Targets: All creatures in the circle Technical details UID ProjectileStrike_END_HighHallInterior_NautiloidStrike Spell flags IsEnemySpell , IsHarmful How to learn Used by creatures: Nautiloid (Creature)
## Needle Burst

- **分类**: Class_actions

Needle Burst is a class action used by Shadow-Cursed Needle Blight when they die. Description Explode in a barrage of needles. Properties Damage: 7~52 6d8 ⁠ Piercing + 1d4 ⁠ Necrotic Details DEX Save ( DC  11) (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) AoE: 4 m (13 ft) Radius Technical details UID Projectile_Burst_Blight_Needle Spell flags CanAreaDamageEvade , IgnoreSilence , IsEnemySpell , IsHarmful How to learn Used by creatures: Shadow-Cursed Needle Blight
## Ocular Nightmare
- **来源**: [Ocular Nightmare](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Ocular_Nightmare)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

This page is about content exclusive to Honour mode . Ocular Nightmare is a legendary action available to the Spectator in Honour mode that lets it flail around, shooting everything with each of its rays. The spectator can use this action when attacked after accumulating 5 stacks of Paranoid Dreams . Description Possibly Wound , Confuse , Paralyse and Frighten all foes within 20 m (67 ft) with your flailing Eye Rays. Properties Damage: 7~35 4d8 + 3 ⁠ Necrotic ( Constitution Saving Throw to halve) Details CON Save ( Spell save DC ) AoE: 20 m (67 ft) Radius Technical details UIDs Shout_EyebeamNova_Spectator Action triggered by the reaction Interrupt_EyebeamNova_Spectator Reaction which triggers the action Spell flags IsHarmful How to learn Granted by features: Legendary Action: Ocular Nightmare Used by creatures: Spectator Notes Multi-hit abilities like Magic Missile will apply one stack of Paranoid Dreams per hit. Each ray involves a separate Constitution Saving Throw to apply their effects. It is not mentioned in the tooltip, but this action additionally applies the effect of Unpetrification Ray to everything in the radius as well.
## Overflowing Brew
- **来源**: [Overflowing Brew](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Overflowing_Brew)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

This page is about content exclusive to Honour mode . Overflowing Brew is a legendary reaction available to Thisobald Thorm in Honour mode. Description Thisobald's unstable brew overflows, dealing 6d6 damage of the corresponding damage type to surrounding enemies and empowering his allies. Properties Details AoE: 3 m (10 ft) Radius Recharge: Per turn Duration: 1 turn Variants Bolstering Overflow Caustic Overflow Chilling Overflow Burning Overflow Shocking Overflow Venomous Overflow Wasting Overflow How to learn Granted by features: Legendary Action: Overflowing Brew Used by creatures: Thisobald Thorm
## Paralysing Critical
- **来源**: [Paralysing Critical](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Paralysing_Critical)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Passive_features

Paralysing Critical is a passive feature/reaction granted by the Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet that allows the wearer to paralyse a humanoid after landing a critical hit. Description Once per Long Rest , when scoring a Critical Hit on a humanoid , the wearer can Paralyse the target for 2 turns. Properties Details Recharge: Long rest Duration: 2 turns Technical details UID Interrupt_MAG_ParalyzingCritical Condition: Paralysed Paralysed Duration: 2 turns Affected entity can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions . Attacks against the entity are always critical hits if the attacker is within 3 m (10 ft). Attack rolls against the entity have Advantage . Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . How to learn Granted by items: Surgeon's Subjugation Amulet
## Paralysing Ray

- **分类**: Class_actions

This article is about the version of the action used by spectator NPCs. For the version available through the Burnished Ring, see Paralyzing Ray . Paralysing Ray is a class action available to Spectators , that allows them to Paralyse a target. Description Shoot an eye ray that Paralyses its target. Properties Cost Eyestalk action Details CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 18 m (60 ft) Technical details UIDs Target_ParalyzingRay_Spectator Target_UND_Spectator_Ray_Paralyzing Spell flags CannotRotate , IsEnemySpell Condition: Paralysed Paralysed Duration: 2 turns CON Save ( Spell save DC ) Affected entity can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions . Attacks against the entity are always critical hits if the attacker is within 3 m (10 ft). Attack rolls against the entity have Advantage . Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . How to learn Used by creatures: Spectator Bugs The tooltip for this ability states it applies Paralysed for 3 turns.

## Perform 'Bard Dance'
- **来源**: [Perform 'Bard Dance'](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Perform_'Bard_Dance')
- **分类**: Class_actions

Perform '(Bard Dance)' is a free action that allows the user to play the song 'Bard Dance' using their equipped Instrument . Description Play an upbeat foot-tapper to attract and delight those around you. Properties Details Range: Self Technical details UIDs Shout_Bard_Perform_BardDance_Drum Shout_Bard_Perform_BardDance_Flute Shout_Bard_Perform_BardDance_Lute Shout_Bard_Perform_BardDance_Lyre Shout_Bard_Perform_BardDance_Violin Shout_Bard_Perform_BardDance_Whistle Spell flags DontAbortPerforming , HasVerbalComponent , ImmediateCast Condition: Performing 'Bard Dance' Performing 'Bard Dance' Playing a tune. Perform the same song nearby to join in. Condition: Poor Performance Poor Performance Maybe you'd better stop, before anyone starts throwing rocks. How to learn Other ways to learn: Having an Instrument equipped. Notes If multiple characters use the Perform action, they sync up and play together. Also nearby bards, such as in the Circus of the Last Days , can join the performance. If multiple characters perform the same song, the individual instruments can be heard together as the song is played (e.g., lute and violin ). Multiple instruments are more easily heard if ambient volume in the game's audio settings is moved to or near zero. A harmonious example of multiple instruments can occur after Ketheric Thorm's defeat, when a player character on the violin joins Alfira on her lute to perform for the tiefling children. Nearby NPCs gather to hear the performance and focus their attention on the performer(s). This can create an opportunity for pickpocketing and thievery. Many patrolling NPCs cannot be distracted this way. If the performer has musical instrument proficiency , they make a Performance check. If successful, the gathered audience tips the performer with Toss a Coin when the performance ends. However, a successful performance does not necessarily result in every attendee tipping the performer(s). The Difficulty Class of the performance check scales with the size of the audience: 1 audience member: DC 10 2-3 audience members: DC 12 4-5 audience members: DC 15 6-7 audience members: DC 18 8+ audience members: DC 20 Any character can use the Perform action with an instrument equipped. However, a character without instrument proficiency makes a Poor Performance when doing so. This provokes annoyed reactions from the audience who will leave immediately. Perform is a free action, and can be used during battle. The performance ends if the performing character is Threatened . Bard Dance plays as environmental music in taverns in the Lower City . See also: Perform (disambiguation) Perform is a free action that allows the user to play a tune using a Lyre . Description Play an enchanting crowd-pleaser to attract and delight those around you. Technical details UID Shout_Bard_Perform_Lyre Spell flags DontAbortPerforming , IsLinkedSpellContainer Variants Perform 'Bard Dance' Perform 'Of Divinity and Sin' Perform 'Old Time Battles' Perform 'The Power' Perform 'The Queen's High Seas' Perform 'Sing for Me' Play the Spider's Lyre How to learn Other ways to learn: Succeed one of two Performance checks with Alfira while she is writing a song in the Emerald Grove to gain Musical Instrument proficiency. Notes If multiple characters use the Perform action, they sync up and play together. Also nearby bards, such as in the Circus of the Last Days , can join the performance. If multiple characters perform the same song, the individual instruments can be heard together as the song is played (e.g., lute and violin ). Multiple instruments are more easily heard if ambient volume in the game's audio settings is moved to or near zero. A harmonious example of multiple instruments can occur after Ketheric Thorm's defeat, when a player character on the violin joins Alfira on her lute to perform for the tiefling children. Nearby NPCs gather to hear the performance and focus their attention on the performer(s). This can create an opportunity for pickpocketing and thievery. Many patrolling NPCs cannot be distracted this way. If the performer has musical instrument proficiency , they make a Performance check. If successful, the gathered audience tips the performer with Toss a Coin when the performance ends. However, a successful performance does not necessarily result in every attendee tipping the performer(s). The Difficulty Class of the performance check scales with the size of the audience: 1 audience member: DC 10 2-3 audience members: DC 12 4-5 audience members: DC 15 6-7 audience members: DC 18 8+ audience members: DC 20 Any character can use the Perform action with an instrument equipped. However, a character without instrument proficiency makes a Poor Performance when doing so. This provokes annoyed reactions from the audience who will leave immediately. Perform is a free action, and can be used during battle. The performance ends if the performing character is Threatened . Play the Spider's Lyre is only available from the Spider's Lyre Achievements [ edit section | visual editor ] Busker Earn a hundred gold from playing sweet, sweet music in a single playthrough.

## Psionic Backlash
- **来源**: [Psionic Backlash](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Psionic_Backlash)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

Psionic Backlash is a reaction and Illithid Power . This feature allows a character to, when a nearby enemy casts a spell, use their Reaction to deal 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage for every level of that spell. Description When a nearby enemy casts a spell, you use your reaction to deal 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage for every level of that spell. Properties Cost Reaction Damage: 1~4 1d4 ⁠ Psychic (Per spell level) Details Range: 9 m (30 ft) Technical details UID Target_TAD_PsionicBacklash How to learn Other ways to learn: Unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining the following : Concentrated Blast Notes This is particularly useful against enemies casting a concentration -type spell such as some form of buff or debuff, as it does induce a Concentration check and could potentially break the spell the instant it is cast. In the French translation the damage is said to be 1d4 + the spell level but the actual damage dealt is correct.
## Psionic Dominance
- **来源**: [Psionic Dominance](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Psionic_Dominance)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

Psionic Dominance is a reaction and Illithid Power . This feature allows a character to use a reaction to nullify a spell of lower or equal level to their Proficiency Bonus when cast by an enemy within 18 m (60 ft). Description When an enemy within 18 m (60 ft) targets you with a spell of a Level that is lower than or equal to your Proficiency Bonus , you can use your reaction to nullify the spell. Properties Cost Reaction Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) Recharge: Long rest Technical details UIDs Target_TAD_PsionicDominance Action component Interrupt_TAD_PsionicDominance Reaction component How to learn Used by creatures: Partial-Illithid Other ways to learn: After becoming a Partial-Illithid , unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining one of the following: Charm Black Hole Notes Normally, this reaction can counter a spell of up to level 4 since that is the usual maximum proficiency bonus. However, on Explorer difficulty, the proficiency bonus of all characters is increased by 2. This means Psionic Dominance can counter up to level 6 spells on Explorer difficulty, including when enemies use it against the party. Custom difficulty offers a slider to adjust the proficiency bonus which has the same effect. Bugs This reaction cannot be used while affected by Starry Form or when Disguised .
## Psionic Visage
- **来源**: [Psionic Visage](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Psionic_Visage)
- **分类**: Class_actions

This page is about content exclusive to Honour mode . Psionic Visage is a legendary reaction available to Nere in Honour mode. When attacked, Nere can cast Psionic Visage to protect himself from ⁠ Physical damage with 3 psionic copies of himself. Description Summon 3 psychic copies of yourself to protect you. As long as one of those copies remain, you are immune to ⁠ Bludgeoning , ⁠ Piercing , and ⁠ Slashing damage. When the caster is struck, a Psionic Visage will Detonate . Properties Damage: 2~12 2d6 ⁠ Psychic (Per visage detonation) Details Range: Self AoE: 6 m (20 ft) Radius Recharge: Per turn Duration: 1 turn Technical details UIDs Shout_UND_Nere_PsychicMirror Action triggered by reaction Interrupt_UND_Nere_PsychicMirror Reaction which activates the action Condition: Psionic Visages Psionic Visages Duration: 1 turn Affected entity is immune to ⁠ Bludgeoning , ⁠ Piercing , and ⁠ Slashing damage while a Psionic Visage stands. When the caster is struck, a visage will shatter, striking the attacker directly with 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage. How to learn Granted by features: Legendary Action: Psionic Visage Used by creatures: Nere Notes This legendary action will trigger from many offensive actions that do not require an attack roll. Examples include Command , Create Water , and area of effect damage from throwables (but not from Spiked Bulb ). The visages will disappear at the start of Nere's next turn if they are not destroyed.
## Radiant Shockwave
- **来源**: [Radiant Shockwave](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Radiant_Shockwave)
- **分类**: Class_actions

Radiant Shockwave is an action automatically triggered upon dealing ⁠ Radiant damage while wearing Luminous Armour . It spreads Radiating Orb to all nearby enemies, disrupting their accuracy when making attacks. Description Inflict Radiating Orb in a 3 m (10 ft) radius. Properties Details AoE: 3 m (10 ft) Radius Targets: All non-allied creatures in range Technical details UID Projectile_MAG_Radiant_RadiatingOrb_Explosion Spell flags IsTrap Condition: Radiating Orb Radiating Orb Duration: 2 turns Affected entity has -1 to Attack Rolls per remaining turn. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it. Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity makes an attack. How to learn Granted by items: Luminous Armour Notes If a spell which deals radiant damage is used, the Shockwave centre changes based on the type: for targeted spells like Sacred Flame the centre is on the target , for aimed spells like Sunbeam it is on the cursor , and for aura spells like Radiance of the Dawn it remains around the caster . Radiant Shockwave also affects neutral creatures.

## Right Behind You
- **来源**: [Right Behind You](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Right_Behind_You)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

Right Behind You is a special reaction available to the Feeble Spectre , the Mundane Spectre , and the Primordial Spectre . It can additionally be acquired by Nimbus by moving adjacent to an accursed spectre. Description Materialise next to your summoner's victim. Properties Cost Reaction Damage: 1~12 + modifiers 1d12 + Summoner's Charisma modifier ⁠ Necrotic Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Range: 18 m (60 ft) Technical details UIDs Target_RightBehindYou_Specter Actual attack ability Interrupt_RightBehindYou Reaction which triggers the attack Interrupt_RightBehindYou_Hound Version of the reaction granted to Nimbus Spell flags IsHarmful How to learn Used by creatures: Feeble Spectre , Mundane Spectre , Primordial Spectre , and Nimbus Notes This reaction is triggered when the Hexblade hits a target with a Hexed Weapon . When Nimbus moves within 3 m (10 ft) of an Accursed Spectre , he gains the Shadow Infusion condition that grants this reaction until a long rest. This version of the reaction is triggered when the sorcerer hits a target with any melee weapon attack and does not require a Hexed Weapon . Additionally, the damage is just 1d12 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic without the bonus from the summoner's Charisma modifier. Bugs This reaction triggers on a killing blow, automatically spending the Reaction point of the summoned creature without providing any effect.
## Ring of Evasion (Reaction)
- **来源**: [Ring of Evasion (Reaction)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Ring_of_Evasion_(Reaction))
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

Ring of Evasion is a reaction granted by the Ring of Evasion that can automatically succeed a failed Dexterity Saving Throw . Description When you make a Dexterity Saving Throw , you can use your reaction to succeed instead. Properties Cost Reaction Details Range: Self How to learn Granted by items: Ring of Evasion Bugs This reaction is not triggered by saving throws originating from surfaces such as Ice or areas like Wall of Fire . As this reaction simply sets the wearer's saving throw roll to 20, if the save DC is higher than 20, they will still fail the save.
## Riposte
- **来源**: [Riposte](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Riposte)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

Riposte is a Battle Master combat manoeuvre triggered as a reaction. This ability allows the Battle Master to counterattack with a melee weapon strike against an enemy who misses with a melee attack. Description Retaliate with a formidable strike when a creature misses you with a melee attack. This is a Reaction . Toggle a reaction during your turn. It will automatically execute when needed. Properties Cost Reaction + Superiority Die Damage Normal weapon damage + Superiority Die Details Melee Weapon Attack Roll Range: 2 m (7 ft) At higher levels At level 10 with Improved Combat Superiority the damage bonus increases from 1d8 to 1d10. Technical details UIDs Target_Riposte Attack triggered by the reaction Interrupt_Riposte Reaction which triggers the attack Spell flags IsHarmful , IsMelee How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Battle Master Granted by features: Martial Adept Notes Riposte only triggers from melee attacks (including melee spell attacks) made within 2 m (7 ft) away. This is slightly longer than the normal weapon range of 1.5 m (5 ft) but less than Extra Reach range of 2.5 m (8 ft). This means Riposte cannot counter attacks made at full range from pikes and similar weapons. Unlike a normal Opportunity Attack , Riposte does not require the character be actively wielding a melee weapon in order to use it. If triggered while wielding a ranged weapon, the character automatically switches to their melee weapon before performing the riposte. If a melee weapon is not equipped, the riposte is performed with an Unarmed Strike instead. v t e Fighter Subclasses Arcane Archer Battle Master Champion Eldritch Knight Fighting Styles Archery Defence Duelling Great Weapon Fighting Protection Two-Weapon Fighting Manoeuvres Commander's Strike Disarming Attack Distracting Strike Evasive Footwork Feinting Attack Goading Attack Manoeuvring Attack Menacing Attack Precision Attack Pushing Attack Rally Riposte Sweeping Attack Trip Attack Arcane Shots Banishing Arrow Beguiling Arrow Bursting Arrow Enfeebling Arrow Grasping Arrow Piercing Arrow Seeking Arrow Shadow Arrow Other class features Action Surge Curving Shot Eldritch Strike Extra Attack Improved Critical Hit Improved Extra Attack Improved Combat Superiority Indomitable Magic Arrow Remarkable Athlete: Jump Remarkable Athlete: Proficiency Second Wind War Magic Weapon Bond

This page is about content exclusive to Honour mode . Sanguine Lash is a legendary action available to Orin in Honour mode . Once per turn, she can use this reaction to retaliate against nearby attackers with a sweeping slash that hits all enemies in a 180° cone. Description Sweep a warped appendage in front of you that Bleeds targets and knock them back 6ft. Properties Damage: 8~64 8d8 ⁠ Slashing Details DEX Save ( Spell save DC ) (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) AoE: 4 m (13 ft) Cone Targets: All enemies in the cone Recharge: Per turn Technical details UIDs Zone_LOW_BloodSwipe_Orin Actual attack action Interrupt_LOW_BloodSwipe_Orin Reaction which triggers the attack Spell flags CanAreaDamageEvade , IsHarmful Condition: Bleeding Bleeding Duration: 3 turns DEX Save ( Spell save DC ) Takes 2 ⁠ ⁠ Slashing DRS damage at the start of each turn and has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws . Removed by healing. How to learn Granted by features: Legendary Action: Sanguine Lash Used by creatures: Orin Notes Orin will not use this reaction if the attacker is beyond its 4 m (13 ft) range. Any attacks inside the 4 m (13 ft) radius can trigger the reaction whether or not they are melee attacks. If Orin does not use Sanguine Lash in a round, the Boon of Bhaal will place Bhaal's Edict on a party member. The party should be wary of standing too near the edge of the abyss, as this attack can potentially send multiple party members to their deaths.

## Self-Detonate
- **来源**: [Self-Detonate](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Self-Detonate)
- **分类**: Class_actions

This article is about the explosion triggered when a normal Steel Watcher is destroyed. For the version used by the Steel Watcher Titan, see Self-Detonate (Steel Watcher Titan) . For the action that primes this explosion, see Self-Detonation Protocol . For the condition that indicates a primed explosion, see Detonation Impending! (Condition) . Self-Detonate is a free action used by Steel Watchers and Hellfire Watchers . This ability is triggered when the the Steel Watcher is destroyed, causing it to explode and deal heavy ⁠ Fire damage that ignores resistances and immunities. It can also be triggered through Self-Detonation Protocol after a one round delay. Description Explode in a burst of raging hellfire - eliminate all nearby wrongdoers. Hellfire ignores Resistance and Immunity to ⁠ Fire damage. Properties Damage: 30~74 4d12 + 26 ⁠ Fire Details DEX Save ( DC  18) (On Save: Targets still take half damage.) Range: Self AoE: 5 m (17 ft) Radius Technical details UID Projectile_SteelWatcher_Biped_SelfDestructExplosion Spell flags CanAreaDamageEvade , ImmediateCast , IsHarmful How to learn Used by creatures: Steel Watcher (creature) and Hellfire Watcher Notes Although the tooltip indicates this ability is a class action, it functions as a free action - in line with that of a Steel Watcher Titan's similar functioning Self-Detonate (Steel Watcher Titan) , due to it being triggered by a game script. Bugs Despite the tooltip stating the explosion ignores resistance to ⁠ Fire damage, only when used by Hellfire Watchers is this the case. Combat logs show no record of a DEX saving throw. Characters with Evasion appear to always take half damage; characters without a comparable passive take full damage (subject to resistance). Resistance and evasion can stack for quarter damage for normal Steel Watchers only. Reactions such as Shield Master: Block will never trigger.

Shield Blow is a reaction granted by many Shields that allows the wearer to strike back with the shield when hit by a melee attack, possibly knocking the attacker Prone . Description When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to knock it Prone , unless they succeed a Strength Saving Throw . Properties Cost Reaction Details STR Save ( Spell save DC ) Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Technical details UIDs Target_ShieldBlow_Riposte Action triggered by the reaction Interrupt_ShieldBlow Reaction which triggers the action Spell flags IsDefaultWeaponAction , IsHarmful , IsMelee Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 1 turn STR Save ( Spell save DC ) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. How to learn Granted by items: Absolute's Protector Adamantine Shield Justiciar's Greatshield Ketheric's Shield Sentinel Shield Shield of the Undevout Shield of Scorching Reprisal Shield of Shielding Abdel's Trusted Shield Shield of Devotion Swires' Sledboard Notes As the saving throw to apply Prone use the wielder's spell save DC , Shield Bash is more effective on casters than it is on martial characters. Bugs The in-game description of this ability states it requires a Dexterity saving throw, but it actually is a Strength saving throw.
## Shield Master: Block
- **来源**: [Shield Master: Block](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shield_Master:_Block)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions、Passive_features

Shield Master: Block is a reaction/passive feature obtained by selecting the Shield Master feat . It negates damage from many area of effect attacks on a successful Saving Throw . Description If a spell forces you to make a Dexterity Saving Throw [ See Notes ] , you can use your Reaction to shield yourself and diminish the effect's damage. On a failed save, you only take half damage [ See: Bugs ] . On a successful save, you don't take any damage, even if you normally would. Properties Cost Reaction Details Range: Self Technical details UIDs Interrupt_ShieldBlow Reaction ShieldMaster_Block Passive feature which grants the reaction How to learn Granted by features: Shield Master (Feat) Notes Despite the description of this feature, it does not matter whether an action has a Dexterity saving throw or whether it is a spell. As a rule of thumb, explosions which involve a Dexterity saving throw can be blocked (e.g., Fireball but not Sacred Flame which does use a Dexterity saving throw but involves a single target). However, this is not true of every such explosion and there are actions without Dexterity saving throws which can also be blocked (e.g., Frost Breath which uses a Constitution saving throw). Refer to this table for a comprehensive list of actions which can be blocked with this feature. Bugs This passive provides no effect on a failed save.

## Soul Catching Boon

Soul Catching Boon is a free reaction granted by the Gloves of Soul Catching after landing an unarmed strike. It grants the wearer a +5 bonus to a missed Attack Roll , potentially turning it into a hit. This reaction is mutually exclusive with Soul Snare: Heal and Soul Catching Prowess . Only one of these three Soul Catching features can be used in a single turn. Description Gain +5 bonus on your next Attack Roll . Properties Details Recharge: Per turn Technical details UID Interrupt_Legendary_SoulCatching_Attack How to learn Granted by items: Gloves of Soul Catching Notes When this reaction is used, the Grasp Essence condition is removed. This prevents using any of the three Soul Catching features again until the following turn when Grasp Essence can be regained. While Soul Catching itself is only triggered on unarmed and throwing attacks, this reaction can boost any type of attack roll including weapon or spell attacks. Bugs The in-game description of this feature is not accurate. It states "Gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll ." Instead, it grants a +5 bonus to a single missed attack roll, if it is sufficient to turn it into a hit.

Properties Cost Reaction Details WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Range: 9 m (30 ft) Technical details UIDs Target_TAD_Charm Action triggered by the reaction Interrupt_TAD_Charm Reaction which triggers the action TAD_Charm Passive feature which grants the reaction Spell flags DisableBlood , IsHarmful Condition: Charmed Charmed Duration: 1 turn WIS Save ( Spell save DC ) Cannot attack the spellcaster. ## Tides of Chaos
- **来源**: [Tides of Chaos](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Tides_of_Chaos)
- **分类**: Class_actions

This article is about the reaction to trigger Tides of Chaos after a roll is made. For the toggleable passive to use it before a roll, see Tides of Chaos (passive feature) . Tides of Chaos is a Wild Magic sorcerer reaction that rerolls a failed attack roll, saving throw, or skill check, provided it was not already rolled with advantage. After this feature is triggered, the next spell cast has a greatly increased chance of a creating a Wild Magic surge (50% chance instead of the normal 5%). Alternatively, this feature can be used via the corresponding toggleable passive before a roll is made. Description Gain Advantage on your next Attack Roll , Ability Check , or Saving Throw . Increased chance of Wild Magic surge afterwards. Properties Cost Tides of Chaos Charge Technical details UID Interrupt_TidesOfChaos Condition: Tides of Chaos Tides of Chaos Duration: Until Long rest Increased chance of Wild Magic surge (to 50%). Lost immediately after casting a Level 1 or higher Spell and rolling a Wild Magic Check. How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Wild Magic Sorcerer Notes Wild Magic Sorcerers receive 1 Tides of Chaos Charge which is replenished on every Short Rest or Long Rest . Normally, a D20 is rolled each time a leveled spell is cast. If the result is 20, a Surge is triggered. Tides of Chaos reduces the DC to 11 (i.e. a 50% chance). Although it is triggered as a reaction , it does not consume a Reaction resource. Ring of Feywild Sparks makes the chance for the wild magic surge 100%. Bugs Tides of Chaos grants a toggleable passive by the same name which, when toggled on, provides Advantage on the character's next Ability Check. Due to the way this passive is granted, it defaults to "off" and cannot be toggled "on" the very first time it is acquired until after the character has first made an ability check, has had a condition applied to it, has used a short rest, or has taken a long rest.

Properties Cost Channel Divinity Charge Damage: 5 + modifiers 5 + (2 × Cleric level) ⁠ Necrotic How to learn Classes: Class level 2: Death Domain Notes This can trigger from any melee attack roll, including spells which require a melee attack roll, such as Inflict Wounds and Vampiric Touch . When used with Vampiric Touch , this bonus damage does not increase the siphoned healing amount. Any spell with an attack roll can be turned into a melee attack spell with Daredevil Proximity allowing them to also trigger Touch of Death. In particular, Bone Chill also benefits from Reaper so it can make two melee attacks with a single cast while Daredevil Proximity is active. Touch of Death can be triggered against both targets, though this does require 2 Channel Divinity Charges as expected. Bugs The tooltip incorrectly displays the bonus damage as 5 + 2d12 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic at all Cleric levels. It is displayed correctly in the combat log. A hidden technical condition, which is responsible for applying a visual effect to struck targets, triggers the passives from Boots of Stormy Clamour , Coldbrim Hat , and Diadem of Arcane Synergy . v t e Cleric Subclasses Death Domain Knowledge Domain Life Domain Light Domain Nature Domain Tempest Domain Trickery Domain War Domain Channel Divinity Charge Charm Animals and Plants Cloak of Shadows Destructive Wrath Dampen Elements Guided Strike Invoke Duplicity Knowledge of the Ages Preserve Life Radiance of the Dawn Read Thoughts Touch of Death War God's Blessing Divine Strike Radiant (Melee) Radiant (Ranged) Poison (Melee) Poison (Ranged) Cold (Melee) Cold (Ranged) Fire (Melee) Fire (Ranged) Lightning (Melee) Lightning (Ranged) Necrotic (Melee) Necrotic (Ranged) Thunder (Melee) Thunder (Ranged) Weapon (Melee) Weapon (Ranged) Other class features Acolyte of Nature Blessed Healer Blessing of the Trickster Blessings of Knowledge Destroy Undead Disciple of Life Divine Intervention Expertise Improved Warding Flare Inescapable Destruction Potent Spellcasting Reaper Spells Thunderbolt Strike Turn Undead War Priest Warding Flare Wrath of the Storm
## Transmuter's Stone
- **来源**: [Transmuter's Stone](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Transmuter's_Stone)
- **分类**: Class_actions

This article is about the ability. For other uses, see Transmuter's Stone (disambiguation) . Transmuter's Stone is a Transmutation School Wizard free action that allows you to create Transmuter's Stones which allow you to give a creature various benefits by holding that stone. Description Store some of your transmutation magic in a small stone. A creature carrying the stone gains a benefit of your choice. Once you have created a stone, you need to cast a Transmutation spell of Level 1 or higher or take a Long Rest before you can create another one. Properties Details Recharge: Until Long Rest Variants Transmuter's Stone: Constitution Transmuter's Stone: Darkvision Transmuter's Stone: Speed Transmuter's Stone: Acid Resistance Transmuter's Stone: Cold Resistance Transmuter's Stone: Fire Resistance Transmuter's Stone: Lightning Resistance Transmuter's Stone: Thunder Resistance Condition: Transmuter's Stone: Depleted Magic Transmuter's Stone: Depleted Magic Duration: Until Long rest Affected entity has recently created a Transmuter's Stone. It needs to cast a Transmutation spell of Level 1 or higher or take a Long Rest before it can create another one. How to learn Classes: Class level 6: Transmutation School Notes Casting ritual spells such as Enhance Leap outside of combat refreshes Transmuter's Stone without using any spell slots. Only one stone can be active at a time per casting character, though a creature can hold multiple stones from multiple characters. When the creator of a Transmuter's Stone leaves the active party, the stone created by them is destroyed. v t e Wizard Subclasses Abjuration School Bladesinging Conjuration School Divination School Enchantment School Evocation School Illusion School Necromancy School Transmutation School Spells Abjuration Conjuration Divination Enchantment Evocation Illusion Necromancy Transmutation Other class features Arcane Recovery Arcane Ward Benign Transposition: Teleport Bladesong Empowered Evocation Experimental Alchemy Expert Divination Extra Attack Focused Conjuration Grim Harvest Hypnotic Gaze Illusory Self Improved Abjuration Improved Minor Illusion Instinctive Charm Inured to Undeath Minor Conjuration: Create Water Portent Potent Cantrip Projected Ward Sculpt Spells See Invisibility Shapechanger Song of Defence Split Enchantment Third Eye: Darkvision Third Eye: See Invisibility Training in War and Song Transmuter's Stone Undead Thralls Animate Dead Additional Undead Better Summons

## Watchful Hunt
- **来源**: [Watchful Hunt](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Watchful_Hunt)
- **分类**: Class_actions

This page is about content exclusive to Honour mode . Watchful Hunt is a class action unique to Yurgir in Honour mode . He can use it to mark a target for Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush . Description Observe your prey carefully, allowing you to interrupt their attacks and spells with a Blinding Ambush . Properties Details Range: 18 m (60 ft) Targets: 1 player not tracked in the previous round Recharge: Per turn Technical details UID Target_SHA_Orthon_Track Spell flags HasHighGroundRangeExtension Condition: Hunted Hunted Duration: 1 turn Yurgir can interrupt this creature's attacks and spells once per round with a Blinding Ambush while it is Hunted. How to learn Granted by features: Legendary Action: Blinding Ambush Used by creatures: Yurgir Notes A creature cannot be targeted in consecutive rounds. There is a one round grace period that prevents a tracked creature from being tracked again immediately. When summoned as an ally with Hellstalker Yurgir in Honour mode, Yurgir will have access to this action. However, it is restricted to targeting player characters so he will not be able to use this action or his corresponding legendary action when summoned.
## Weird Magic Surge
- **来源**: [Weird Magic Surge](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Weird_Magic_Surge)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

This page is about content exclusive to Honour mode . Weird Magic Surge is a legendary reaction available to Ethel in Honour mode, which she can use to create illusory duplicates immediately after a spell is cast. A higher level spell will produce more illusory duplicates. Description Draw on residual arcana after a spell is cast to create more illusory duplicates and shuffle yourself among them in a new position. A higher level spell will create more duplicates. Properties Details: Recharge: Per turn How to learn Used by creatures: Ethel Bugs Silence does not prevent Ethel from casting this spell despite it requiring a verbal component.

Wild Magic: Enchant Weapons is a Wild Magic Sorcerer free action which is randomly used when triggered by a Wild Magic roll; it allows them to magically empower the weapon of every nearby creature, allowing each to make a single powerful strike. Description Enchant the weapon of each creature within 6 m (20 ft). Their next attack [ See: Bugs ] is a Critical Hit and deals an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Force . Properties Details AoE: 6 m (20 ft) Radius Technical details UID Shout_WildMagic_Enchant Condition: Wild Magic: Enchant Weapons Wild Magic: Enchant Weapons Duration: Until Long rest The next attack with this weapon is a Critical Hit and deals an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Force . How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Wild Magic Sorcerer Notes If the character is dual wielding weapons, only the main hand is enchanted with additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Force . Similarly, if the character has melee weapons at hand, ranged weapons are not affected (and vice-versa). The character triggers the auto critical hit when attacking with the enchanted weapon at main hand. As the enchanted weapon attack is a guaranteed Critical Hit, the actual extra damage dealt is 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Force . Bugs As the additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Force is applied to the weapon with long rest duration, if the weapon is moved to offhand or to a character who was not enchanted, attacking with this weapon is an auto critical hit, but the extra damage effect does not expire after a hit. Wild Magic: Slow is a Wild Magic Sorcerer free action which is randomly used when triggered by a Wild Magic roll; it places the Slowed condition on the user as per the Slow spell, reducing their Armour Class , Dexterity , Saving Throws and Actions . Description You are Slowed . Technical details UID Shout_WildMagic_Slow Condition: Slowed Slowed Duration: 2 turns Affected entity's Movement Speed is halved, and its Armour Class and Dexterity Saving Throws are reduced by 2. The entity can't take Reactions or make more than 1 attack per turn, [ See: Bugs ] and can only take either an Action or a Bonus Action . Spells cast might be delayed for 1 turn. ## Wrath of the Storm: Lightning
- **来源**: [Wrath of the Storm: Lightning](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Wrath_of_the_Storm:_Lightning)
- **分类**: Class_actions、Reactions

Wrath of the Storm: Lightning is a Tempest Domain Cleric passive feature and reaction. It allows the Cleric to strike back at an attacking creature using a Reaction , doing ⁠ Lightning damage. Description If a nearby enemy attacks you, you can retaliate with a strike of lightning that deals 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Lightning damage. On Save: Target still takes half damage. Properties Cost: Reaction Damage: 2d8 (2~16) ⁠ Lightning Details: Range: 2 m (7 ft) DEX Save ( Spell save DC ) (On Save: Damage is halved) How to learn Classes: Class level 1: Tempest Domain Notes The conditions for triggering this reaction are: Attacker is within 2 m (7 ft). This means enemies with longer reach can attack you without triggering the reaction. Also, Opportunity Attacks will often land after you have left the 2 m (7 ft) range, even against enemies with normal melee range. However, opportunity attack can be triggered without leaving this reaction's range by attempting to Jump or Fly . Attack does damage. This means completely negating the attack damage with abilities like Arcane Ward will prevent the reaction from triggering. Attack hits. This means that the reaction cannot trigger on an attack that misses but still does damage such as Tenacity .

Bugs The spell that is cast via this reaction is incorrectly flagged as a ⁠ Lightning DamageType , and as such will function with features that benefit Lightning spells, such as Crackling with Kereska's Lightning .

## Githyanki Parry
- **来源**: [Githyanki Parry](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Githyanki_Parry)
- **分类**: Reactions、Passive_features

See also: Parry and Supreme Githyanki Parry Githyanki Parry is an NPC-exclusive passive feature and reaction that allows githyanki warriors to parry attacks with their greatswords, reducing incoming damage by 10. Description Parry unarmed and weapon attacks to reduce their damage by 10. You must be wielding a Greatsword and you can't be Incapacitated , Blinded [ See Notes ] , or Restrained . Details Cost: Reaction Condition: Ready To Parry Ready to Parry Duration: 1 turn The Githyanki stands ready to parry the next weapon attack, reducing its incoming damage by 10. The Githyanki can parry an attack as long as they have a Reaction , they wield a greatsword , and they aren't Blinded , Incapacitated or Restrained . How to learn Used by creatures: Baretha , Bradi'ith , Brelal'reth , Ch'guth , Dor'il , Ith'dul , Khunaruth , Ma'aryk , Ma'athal , Ni'ima , Qen , Teth'ka , Therezzyn , Vu'un , W'wargaz , Xon'ar'as , Yr'rk Notes This feature is only available to githyanki NPCs. The in-game description has the requirement that the NPC must "see the attacker" which actually means that it can't be blinded . Githyanki Parry works against characters which are hidden . At higher difficulty settings, Veteran Warriors will instead have Supreme Githyanki Parry .

Luck of the Far Realms is a passive feature/reaction and Illithid Power . It allows a character to change a successful Attack Roll into a Critical Hit once per long rest. Description Once per Long Rest , you can change a successful Attack Roll against a foe into a Critical Hit . Details Cost: Reaction Recharge: Long rest How to learn Used by creatures: Full-illithid Other ways to learn: Unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining the following: Favourable Beginnings Notes Combines well with abilities which add numerous damage die to a single hit, such as Sneak Attack or Divine Smite . Bugs Due to the way this passive's reaction is coded [ 1 ] , it triggers on attacks that are not natural 20 rolls but are already critical hits due to Critical Hit Threshold Reductions . Luck of the Far Realms is not reset when consuming a Potion of Angelic Slumber nor when affected by Divine Intervention: Opulent Revival . This reaction cannot be used while affected by Starry Form . ↑ From the definition of LuckOfTheFarRealmCheck() in Mods/Shared/Scripts/thoth/helpers/CommonConditionsDev.khn : Show code function LuckOfTheFarRealmCheck() local notCrit = context.InterruptedRoll.NaturalRoll < 20 and context.InterruptedRoll.NaturalRoll > 1 local isHit = context.InterruptedRoll.Total >= context.InterruptedRoll.Difficulty return ConditionResult(notCrit and isHit) end

This feature allows a character to, when a nearby enemy casts a spell, use their Reaction to deal 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage for every level of that spell. Description When a nearby enemy casts a spell, you use your reaction to deal 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage for every level of that spell. Details Cost: Reaction Grants: Psionic Backlash How to learn Used by creatures: Full-illithid , Pactsplitter , Z'rell Other ways to learn: Unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining the following : Concentrated Blast Brief preview When an enemy casts a spell, can use a reaction to deal 1d4 Psychic per spell level.
## Psionic Dominance (passive feature)
- **来源**: [Psionic Dominance (passive feature)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Psionic_Dominance_(passive_feature))
- **分类**: Reactions、Passive_features

Psionic Dominance is a passive feature and Illithid Power . This feature allows a character to use a reaction to nullify a spell of lower or equal level to their Proficiency Bonus when targeted by an enemy within 18m. Description When an enemy within 18 m (60 ft) targets you with a spell of a Level that is lower than or equal to your Proficiency Bonus , you can use your reaction to nullify the spell. Details Cost: Reaction Grants: Psionic Dominance How to learn Used by creatures: Full-illithid , Metamage Persecutor Other ways to learn: After becoming a Partial-Illithid , unlock from the illithid power skill tree with a Mind Flayer Parasite Specimen after obtaining one of the following: Charm Black Hole Notes Normally, this reaction can counter a spell of up to level 4 since that is the usual maximum proficiency bonus. However, on Explorer difficulty, the proficiency bonus of all characters is increased by 2. This means Psionic Dominance can counter up to level 6 spells on Explorer difficulty, including when enemies use it against the party. Custom difficulty offers a slider to adjust the proficiency bonus which has the same effect.

## Riposte (passive feature)
- **来源**: [Riposte (passive feature)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Riposte_(passive_feature))
- **分类**: Reactions、Passive_features

Riposte is a Battle Master Fighter passive feature and reaction. This ability allows the Battle Master to counterattack with their melee weapon when an enemy misses them with a melee attack. Description When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, expend a superiority die to retaliate with a powerful strike that deals an additional Superiority Die damage. Details Cost: Reaction  +  Superiority Die Grants: Riposte How to learn Classes: Class level 3: Battle Master Granted by the feats: Martial Adept Used by creatures: Beorn Wunterbrood , Caïros , Falcäo , Godey , Holli Dylford , Liara Portyr , Nestor , Stalker Svignee , That Which Guards , That Which Lurks , That Which Watches Notes Riposte can only trigger from melee attacks (including melee spell attacks) made within 2 m (7 ft) away. This is slightly longer than the normal weapon range of 1.5 m (5 ft) but less than Extra Reach range of 2.5 m (8 ft). This means that Riposte cannot counter full range attacks from pikes and similar weapons. Unlike a normal Opportunity Attack , Riposte does not require you to be actively wielding a melee weapon in order to use. If you trigger it while wielding a ranged weapon, you will automatically switch to your melee weapon before performing the riposte. If you do not have any melee weapons equipped, you will perform the riposte with an unarmed strike. Brief preview Upon being missed with a melee attack, can expend a Superiority Die to retaliate.

## Supreme Githyanki Parry
- **来源**: [Supreme Githyanki Parry](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Supreme_Githyanki_Parry)
- **分类**: Reactions、Passive_features

See also: Parry and Githyanki Parry Supreme Githyanki Parry is an NPC-exclusive passive feature and reaction that allows githyanki warriors to parry attacks with their greatswords, reducing incoming damage by 20. Description Parry unarmed and weapon attacks to reduce their damage by 20. You must be wielding a Greatsword and you can't be Incapacitated , Blinded [ See Notes ] , or Restrained . Details Cost: Reaction Condition: Ready to Parry (Supreme) Ready to Parry Duration: 1 turn The Githyanki stands ready to parry the next weapon attack, reducing its incoming damage by 20. The Githyanki can parry an attack as long as they have a Reaction , they wield a greatsword , and they aren't Blinded , Incapacitated or Restrained . How to learn Used by creatures: Bradi'ith , Har'rak , Ma'athal , Voss Notes This feature is only available to certain githyanki NPCs. The in-game description has the requirement that the NPC must "see the attacker" which actually means that it can't be blinded . Supreme Githyanki Parry works against characters which are hidden . At lower difficulty levels, Veteran Warriors will instead have the basic Githyanki Parry .
## Tenacity
- **来源**: [Tenacity](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Tenacity)
- **分类**: Reactions

For the passive feature, see Tenacity (passive feature) . Tenacity is a weapon action available to characters proficient in and wielding a flail , morningstar , greatclub , or maul in their main hand. Description When you miss an attack, deal ⁠ Bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier anyway (minimum of 1). Properties Cost Reaction Damage Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Technical details UID Interrupt_Overwhelm How to learn Granted by wielding the following weapon types with proficiency : Flails Morningstars Greatclubs Mauls Notes If a weapon action misses, using Tenacity will not trigger its effects. Despite being greatclubs, neither Rat Bat nor Punch-Drunk Bastard provide Tenacity. The Air Myrmidon's Flail of the Vortex also lacks Tenacity. As Tenacity deals weapon damage, even if an attack misses, it can trigger many on-hit effects from equipment. Effects like weapon coatings, Gloves of Power , Callous Glow Ring , and any infusion from Ring of Elemental Infusion . Doom Hammer and The Sacred Star on-hit effects will be triggered. This is particularly important when you need to apply a condition consistently, like Bone Chilled to a powerful undead or fast-healing enemy. Flail of Ages can trigger its effect via Tenacity when boosted by Acid Infusion , Cold Infusion , or Fire Infusion . Bugs When dual wielding a flail or morningstar with a non-Tenacity weapon using the Dual Wielder feat, Tenacity can be triggered by missing an attack with the non-Tenacity weapon. The damage will always be ⁠ Bludgeoning , no matter the weapon used. Some non-Tenacity weapons can trigger their on-hit effects via Tenacity as well, such as the Ritual Dagger and Loviatar's Scourge . As Horde Breaker (Melee) rolls invisible, zero-damage weapon attacks against all enemies in the Horde Breaker area of effect, Tenacity can be prompted to trigger against them even if the first attack hits. It is therefore possible to score 2 hits in one attack: the full attack against the original Horde Breaker target and a Tenacity hit against another target.
## Uncanny Dodge
- **来源**: [Uncanny Dodge](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Uncanny_Dodge)
- **分类**: Reactions、Passive_features

Uncanny Dodge is a togglable passive gained by Rogues at Level 5. Uncanny Dodge allows the Rogue to reduce incoming damage once per round. Description Use your lightning-quick reflexes to protect yourself. When an attack hits you, you only take half the usual damage. Details Cost: Reaction Toggleable How to learn Classes: Class level 5: Rogue Used by creatures: Araj Oblodra , Assassin's Folly , Dolor , Earspoon , Elliot , Farlin , Fishbait Arno , Friol , Gergerann , Huido , Ironhand Grenadier , Lady Lockjaw , Nine-Fingers Keene , Orin , Quenora Grisly , Snapbone , Terse Torvalt , Zhent Elf , Zhent Half-Elven , Zhentmodeus Notes Uncanny Dodge consumes a Reaction when it is triggered, but it is not a proper reaction whose triggering behaviour can be configured in the Reactions tab. Though the description says "When an attack hits you", Uncanny Dodge can actually trigger on any received damage. This includes damage from saving throw spells like Fireball , fall damage , or even self-damage from Transfuse Health . Uncanny Dodge is one of a very small handful of multiplicative damage reductions which stack with resistance . Most other features that reduce damage by half such as Dampen Elements , Aura of Warding , or Warding Bond do so by granting resistance. Since resistances cannot stack, the damage reductions from such effects also cannot stack with each other. However, since Uncanny Dodge is implemented differently, it can stack with these sources of resistances for a total of 75% damage reduction. Bugs As of Patch 8, Uncanny Dodge has several bugs related to reaction mechanics. [ 1 ] It requires the defender to have reaction (resource) available, but doesn't actually consume it when used. It consumes the attacker's reaction (resource) when triggered. It can trigger multiple times in the same turn if hit by different attackers. It can trigger while under conditions that should prevent reaction, such as Slowed (Condition) . Brief preview Can use a reaction to reduce the damage of an incoming hit by half. v t e Rogue Subclasses Arcane Trickster Assassin Swashbuckler Thief Cunning Action Dash Disengage Hide Sneak Attack Sneak Attack (Melee) Sneak Attack (Ranged) Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee) Rakish Sneak Attack (Ranged) Other class features Assassin's Alacrity Assassinate: Ambush Assassinate: Initiative Dirty Trick Flick o' the Wrist Sand Toss Vicious Mockery Expertise Evasion Fancy Footwork Fast Hands Infiltration Expertise Mage Hand Legerdemain Magical Ambush Panache Rakish Audacity Reliable Talent Second-Story Work Supreme Sneak Uncanny Dodge ↑ A detailed explanation of how it works in patch 8 can be found in this reddit post

War Caster Opportunity Spell is a Passive feature/Reaction obtained by selecting the War Caster Feat. Characters with this feature are adept at casting Shocking Grasp at an enemy when they leave melee range. This can be done instead of the usual Opportunity Attack . Description You can also use a Reaction to cast Shocking Grasp at a target moving out of melee range. Details Cost: Reaction How to learn Granted by the feats: War Caster Used by creatures: Far'aag , For'reth , Ghush'ins , Golbraith Stredivas , Jeera , Therezzyn , Tska'an , Umr'a'ac , Wanda Tullermoor , Yy'rul , Zhendila Notes This feat does not give the user the regular Shocking Grasp spell if they do not already have it. Unlike the regular spell, this version of Shocking Grasp can be cast even while Silenced . Unlike a regular Opportunity Attack , this feature can be used while under the protection of Sanctuary ; doing so immediately ends the effect. The Amulet of Elemental Torment is an uncommon Amulet that channels the effects of certain Surfaces into the wearer's spells. Each jewel gleams with the energy of the natural elements. Properties Amulets Rarity: Uncommon Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 65 gp UID UNI_ARM_MartyrAmulet UUID c1cb7388-bd2f-4cc7-8305-7d7a0651874f Stats UNI_MartyrAmulet Special The wearer of this item gains: Nature's Vengeance When the wearer stands on certain surfaces and casts a spell that deals damage, the target also suffers the surface's effects. Where to find House of Hope X: -6477 Y: 2884 : Carried by Hope while fighting Raphael in the Foyer Notes Previously was sold by Grat the Trader in the Goblin Camp , Brem in the Zhentarim Basement , or Roah Moonglow in Shattered Sanctum . As of Patch 3, this was moved to Hope in the House of Hope . Regarding Nature's Vengeance: The surface effects applied by Nature's Vengeance are: Fire : Apply Burning for 2 turns. Deals the first tick of 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage immediately. Caustic Brine : Apply Caustic Brine for 2 turns. Deals the first tick of 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Acid damage immediately. Simple Toxin : Apply Poisoned for 2 turns. Acid : Apply Acid for 2 turns. Nature's Vengeance does not work with any other surfaces. This includes the other basic elemental surfaces like Ice surfaces or Electrified Water surfaces. Valid poison surfaces can be created by breaking Simple Toxin vials or with Chromatic Orb . Surfaces created by breaking stronger poisons like Serpent Fang Toxin are different and do not work.
