Worn by Lumi, a cleric beholden to twilight, who sheltered her fellow adventurers as a bantam shelters her chicks. Properties Amulets Rarity: Very rare Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 210 gp UID MAG_ofGreaterHealth_Amulet UUID 5ed63342-30c9-456d-9a57-a88c8596c0c9 Stats MAG_ofGreaterHealth_Amulet Special The wearer of this item gains: Sets the wearer's Constitution score to 23. The enchantment has no effect if their Constitution score is higher without it. Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws . Where to find House of Hope X: -6548 Y: 2940 : On the left-most pedestal in the Archive Notes The in-game tooltip has a typo and reads, "Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws Checks". The amulet can be stolen without the fight if the trap is disabled first with a DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check and the Orphic Hammer , the Soul-Sworn Contract and Hope are left untouched. This item can be stolen in lieu of perception and disarm checks, by placing an item of equal weight on the pedestal, prior to picking up the amulet like in Raiders of the Lost Ark . If the wearer's Constitution is lower than 22, the amulet increases their maximum hit points in accordance with the increase in Constitution, but their current hit points will remain the same and not heal up to the new maximum.

Properties Amulets Rarity: Very rare Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 65 gp UID MAG_OfTheDevout_Amulet UUID 1acf71e6-6bca-4d9b-9d24-739823e10723 Stats MAG_OfTheDevout_Amulet Special The wearer of this item gains: High Spellcasting You gain a +2 bonus to Spell Save DC . [ See: Bugs ] Where to find Stormshore Tabernacle X: 796 Y: 1159 : In the main Offering Chest in the basement Notes Unless done by Jaheira while wearing Khalid's Gift , looting any of the items from the offering chests curses the interacting party member with Castigated By Divinity . Bugs Regarding Godswill: Contrary to the in-game description, the additional Channel Divinity Charge granted by Godswill restores on a short rest . However if the extra charge is expended and the amulet is unequipped, the extra charge does not reappear if re-equipped before a long rest ; at this point it cannot be restored with a short rest. The additional Channel Divinity Charge does not incur the amulet's once-per-rest cooldown if spent on Destructive Wrath , Guided Strike , Touch of Death , or War God's Blessing . If spent in this manner, simply unequipping and reequipping the amulet restores the Channel Divinity Charge. Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Model and render by Daniil Shashenkov "Forild"

## Broodmother's Revenge
- **来源**: [Broodmother's Revenge](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Broodmother's_Revenge)
- **分类**: Amulets

The Broodmother's Revenge is an uncommon Amulet . It coats the wearer's weapon in poison for 2 turns whenever they are healed. Each of this amulet's jewels shines like a viper's eyes. Properties Amulets Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 65 gp UID MAG_Healer_HealSelfPoisonWeapon_Amulet UUID 21abc023-343a-4693-b63f-3ba07a231864 Stats MAG_Healer_HealSelfPoisonWeapon_Amulet Special The wearer of this item gains: Venomous Revenge Whenever the wearer is healed, their weapon becomes coated in magic and deals an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage. Where to find Inner Sanctum X: -461 Y: -22 : Carried by Kagha in the Emerald Grove High Hall X: 235 Y: 44 : On a table of goods, owned by Koll Notes This item synergizes well with the Derivation Cloak and Poisoner's Gloves , especially when used by characters with high attack modifiers or multiple attacks per round. It is possible to obtain this item while keeping Kagha alive and friendly within the grove. During the confrontation with Kagha for the quest ⁠ Investigate Kagha , she must be convinced to side with the party. After celebrating with the tieflings in camp after defeating the goblin leaders , Kagha will be standing alone, along the pathway entering the grove. Attacking her and knocking her out with Toggle Non-Lethal Attacks makes her lootable yet keeps her alive. Following a long rest, Kagha will be awake again and upset, but non-hostile. Trading with her via bartering can bring her relationship with the party back into good standing. Regarding Venomous Revenge: Venomous Revenge applies to both melee and ranged weapons, but, as with all poison coatings , its effect does not work when a weapon is Thrown . The effect is triggered even with full health or when being picked up from a Downed state. The effect is triggered by: being targeted by any healing spell, like Healing Word . consuming any healing items, like a Potion of Healing , a Goodberry , or a Raspberry . all equipment with continuous regeneration effects: the Helm of Balduran and Ring of Regeneration . healing effects from the Derivation Cloak and Armour of Landfall . The effect is not triggered by: Most self-healing effects from equipment: Shattered Flail , Sword of Chaos , Woe , Robe of the Weave , Psionic Ward Armour , Vest of Soul Rejuvenation , Circlet of Mental Anguish , or Wapira's Crown . Healing from Transfuse Health . This effect interacts in the following ways with dipping and coatings: The effect overwrites Dipped in Fire and vice versa. The effect does not trigger for an already coated weapon (e.g. Drow Poison ). Coatings overwrite the effect. Related quest [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ Investigate Kagha

## Necklace of Elemental Augmentation
- **来源**: [Necklace of Elemental Augmentation](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Necklace_of_Elemental_Augmentation)
- **分类**: Amulets

Necklace of Elemental Augmentation is an uncommon Amulet . When the wearer inflicts elemental damage with a cantrip, it adds their Spellcasting Modifier to the damage. The tourmaline in this necklace is almost uncomfortably hot, warmed by a heat all its own. Properties Amulets Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 65 gp UID MAG_ElementalGish_CantripBooster_Amulet UUID a92cec2f-3a86-4aa1-a7e9-1d6dc9e12957 Stats MAG_ElementalGish_CantripBooster_Amulet Special The wearer of this item gains: Elemental Augmentation When one of your cantrips deals ⁠ Acid , ⁠ Cold , ⁠ Fire , ⁠ Lightning , or ⁠ Thunder damage, add your Spellcasting Modifier to the damage dealt. Where to find Crèche Y'llek X: 1379 Y: -662 : inside a display case in the Inquisitor's Chamber Wyrm's Crossing X: -97 Y: 107 : inside a Traveller's Chest on a shipwrecked ship Northwest of South Span Checkpoint Notes Regarding Elemental Augmentation: Elemental Augmentation functions by checking the cantrip being cast for a specific DamageType flag (such as ⁠ Fire or ⁠ Lightning ) rather than the actual damage type listed for the cantrip or the damage type done by the cantrip when hitting a target. This means that 'added' damage '"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000029B-QINU`"' such as that from Lightning Charges '"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000029B-QINU`"' does not trigger the necklace's effect, because these external bonuses lack the necessary flags. Consequently, the necklace only works with cantrips which natively deal the correct damage types, and does not work with cantrips which lack a DamageType flag, like Booming Blade . Elemental Augmentation stacks with the Elemental Affinity: Damage feature for most Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers (though not those with green dragon ancestry, which use Poison damage). In this case, the Charisma modifier will be added to the damage of the relevant cantrips twice. When multiclassing, Elemental Augmentation uses the spellcasting ability modifier of the last class added, not necessarily the spellcasting ability of the class which granted the cantrip. The minimum additional damage is 1, even if the character's spellcasting ability modifier is 0 or negative. Hellflame Cleave deals two instances of damage which both receive the bonus damage from Elemental Augmentation. The following cantrips receive bonus damage from Elemental Augmentation: Name Level Cast time Duration Range/Area Attack/Save Damage/Effect Acid Splash C - 18 m / 60ft 2m / 7ft (Radius) DEX Save 1d6 ⁠ Acid Activate Witch Bolt C - 30 m / 100ft - 1d12 ⁠ Lightning Ensnaring Shock C 4 turns 18 m / 60 ft DEX Save 1d4 ⁠ Lightning Fire Bolt C - 18 m / 60ft Attack Roll 1d10 ⁠ Fire Firebolt? C - 18 m / 60ft Attack Roll 1d10 ⁠ Fire Hellflame Cleave C 1 turn 3m / 10ft (Cone) DEX Save Normal weapon damage 2d6 ⁠ Fire Produce Flame C Long Rest Self - 1d8 ⁠ Fire Produce Flame: Hurl C - 9 m / 30ft Attack Roll 1d8 ⁠ Fire Ray of Frost C 1 turn 18 m / 60ft Attack Roll 1d8 ⁠ Cold Rays of Fire (Cantrip) C - 18 m / 60 ft Attack Roll 3d6 ⁠ Fire 3d6 ⁠ Fire 3d6 ⁠ Fire Shocking Grasp C 1 turn 1.5 m / 5 ft Attack Roll 1d8 ⁠ Lightning

## Sentient Amulet (Rare)
- **来源**: [Sentient Amulet (Rare)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Sentient_Amulet_(Rare))
- **分类**: Amulets

See also: Sentient Amulet (Very Rare) Sentient Amulet is a rare Amulet that allows the wearer to cast Shatter once per Short Rest (with a drawback) and Ki Restoration (Lesser) once per Long Rest . Sun-graced warmth radiates from both the pendant and its chain. Somehow, even a brief glance of it brings a smile to your face. Properties Amulets Rarity: Rare Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 125 gp UID UNI_UND_MonkAmulet UUID 086ae8fd-c44e-43a7-b8be-777b551a06d6 Stats UND_MonkAmulet_Amulet Special The wearer of this item gains: Shatter ( ) Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Short rest .) Talk to the Sentient Amulet Speak with the consciousness lingering inside the Sentient Amulet. Ki Restoration ( ) Using the spiritual energy in the amulet, you restore 2 Ki Points . ( Recharge: Long rest .) Wearing this amulet applies the condition: High Spirits The amulet's spirit lingers, making everything seem a little more vibrant. Must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw ( DC 10/15/20, see notes) when using the amulet's power, or become Hysterical (equivalent in effect to Tasha's Hideous Laughter with a duration of 1 turn). Where to find Abandoned Refuge X: -624 Y: 224 : In a locked Adamantine Chest on the island with the broken structure near the Lava Elemental in Grymforge Notes Picking up the amulet triggers a conversation in which the amulet tries to get party member to surrender to a fit of laughter. This is a hint at the curse the amulet bears. Once the conversation is over, the quest ⁠ Help the Cursed Monk is received. The amulet is voiced by John O'Mahony . Wisdom Saving Throws are only required when using this amulet to cast Shatter . Using the Ki Restoration (Lesser) ability does not prompt a Wisdom save. The default Wisdom Saving Throw for Hysterical is a DC 10. However, after succeeding the Saving Throw at least three times and upon either equipping the amulet or leaving camp (whichever happens first), a special cutscene plays where passing a DC 10 Wisdom Saving Throw to resist the curse is necessary. If failed, the Hysterical DC is increased to 15. If the Wisdom Saving Throw for Hysterical is succeeded a further three times (and then equipping the amulet or leaving camp again), a similar cutscene plays whereby failing a DC 15 Wisdom Saving Throw increases the Hysterical DC to 20. After this, no additional cutscenes will occur. Depending on the outcome of the ⁠ Help the Spirit of the Amulet quest in Act Three , the party may receive a version of this amulet that is visually identical but missing all of its special properties ( UID: UNI_WYR_MonkAmulet_NoGhost / UUID: 14a6da9a-6689-4c70-96a1-d03319ba3278 ). Alternatively, the player may receive the Sentient Amulet (Very Rare) . While the player character carries the Sentient Amulet, the Cursed Monk occasionally makes comments at various locations and after specific interactions.
## Sentient Amulet (Very Rare)
- **来源**: [Sentient Amulet (Very Rare)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Sentient_Amulet_(Very_Rare))
- **分类**: Amulets

See also: Sentient Amulet (Rare) Sentient Amulet is a very rare Amulet which allows the wearer to cast Shatter once per Long Rest and Ki Restoration (Greater) once per Long Rest . It is a possible reward for the quest Help the Cursed Monk . Sun-graced warmth radiates from both the pendant and its chain. Somehow, even a brief glance of it brings a smile to your face. Properties Amulets Rarity: Very rare Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 210 gp UID UNI_WYR_MonkAmulet_AfterCombat UUID 7eaa1331-877c-40d7-9811-8238aee09f68 Special The wearer of this item gains: Shatter ( ) Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest .) Ki Restoration ( ) Using the spiritual energy in the amulet, you restore a number of Ki Points equal to your martial arts die. [ See Notes ] ( Recharge: Long rest .) Where to find Open Hand Temple Cellar X: -7 Y: -1004 : Obtained upon completing the Help the Cursed Monk quest Notes To acquire this amulet, the player character must refuse to take on the monk's madness and fight him. This page describes the version of the Sentient Amulet obtained after finishing the Help the Cursed Monk quest. For the version that starts the quest, see the Sentient Amulet (Rare) page. Unlike the other (rare) version of the amulet, Shatter can be cast from this amulet without requiring a Wisdom Saving Throw . However, the recharge time of this (very rare) version is Long Rest , rather than Short Rest . The version of Ki Restoration (Greater) granted by this amulet restores a random number of Ki Points equal to the martial arts die of the wearer, rather than always restoring 2 Ki Points. For example, a level 9 Monk (martial arts die of 1d8) restores 1~8 Ki Points. While the player character carries the Sentient Amulet, the Cursed Monk occasionally makes comments at various locations and after specific interactions. Bugs Although the tooltip says the Shatter spell granted by this amulet is level 2, this upgraded version actually deals 4d8 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage, in line with the level 3 version of Shatter.

Properties Amulets Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 125 gp UID MAG_LC_TheAmplifier_Amulet UUID a3964bb7-abe5-49f3-a1b1-30ff160ecbf3 Stats MAG_LC_TheAmplifier_Amulet Special The wearer of this item gains: Spell Amplification You gain an additional Level 2 Spell Slot . ## Spellcrux Amulet
- **来源**: [Spellcrux Amulet](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Spellcrux_Amulet)
- **分类**: Amulets

Spellcrux Amulet is a very rare Amulet that allows the wearer to restore any one spell slot once per Long Rest . Some scholars have speculated that spells have a mind of their own, suggesting that the spells get bored between being cast and restored. Properties Amulets Rarity: Very rare Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 210 gp UID MAG_Restoration_SpellSlotRestoration_Amulet UUID ba147dc7-98bc-4bfb-9fbc-efa1735d0841 Special The wearer of this item gains: Spell Slot Restoration Replenish an expended spell slot of any level as a Bonus Action once per Long Rest . Where to find Moonrise Towers Prison X: 569 Y: -650 : Worn by the Warden Notes The amulet cannot create new spell slots , only restore used ones. If you do not have a used spell slot of the level you chose, the amulet has no effect. The amulet can recover spell slots that the caster does not innately have from their class, such as ones gained from Create Spell Slot , or ones from gear, such as Shield of Devotion . It is capable of recovering both Warlock spell slots and regular spell slots. If you have empty spell slots of both types for the chosen level, it restores one slot for each type. Likewise, if the amulet is equipped by Gale and he has the Consumed Shadow Weave feature, selecting third level will restore both a normal third-level spell slot and the third-level "shadow spell slot" granted by this feature. The spell slot is not lost when the amulet is removed, meaning you can put the amulet on, restore a slot, and switch back to another amulet of your choice. The recharge is still tied to the amulet, so this cannot be done with multiple characters at once.

## Boots of Aid and Comfort
- **来源**: [Boots of Aid and Comfort](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Boots_of_Aid_and_Comfort)
- **分类**: Boots

Boots of Aid and Comfort are an uncommon pair of Boots that grant additional Temporary Hit Points to creatures healed by the wearer. Sturdy and well-worn, these boots make a snug fit on any wearer. Properties Boots Rarity: Uncommon Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.55 kg (1.1 lb) Price: 70 gp UID MAG_Healer_TempHPOnHeal_Boots UUID bc090f4e-ff74-49f6-a3f2-7eb561f57436 Stats MAG_Healer_TempHPOnHeal_Boots File ARM_Footwear_Leather_A Special The wearer of this item gains: The Comeback When the wearer heals a target, it gains an additional 3 temporary hit points . Where to find Goblin Camp X: -99 Y: 424 : Sold by Grat the Trader Notes Regarding The Comeback: The target of the healing, not the healer, gets the temporary hit points from The Comeback . Healing multiple creatures at the same time (e.g. via Mass Healing Word ) will grant temporary hit points to all of them. Taking a Short Rest counts as healing oneself and grants the temporary hit points to the wearer, but not to other characters benefiting from the same short rest. The temporary hit points will still be granted if the wearer directs a healing effect at a target that's already at full hit points. However, they will not be granted if the target can't be healed for some other reason, such as being under the effect of Bone Chill . The metal of these greaves is comfortably warm against your shins, as though heated by your mere presence. Properties Boots Required Proficiency: Medium Armour Rarity: Uncommon Consumable by Gale Weight: 2 kg (4 lb) Price: 90 gp UID MAG_Paladin_MomentumOnConcentration_Boots UUID 8770f821-38bc-41cc-aae9-02988d46df02 Stats MAG_Paladin_MomentumOnConcentration_Boots File ARM_Footwear_Metal_F Special The wearer of this item gains: Athletics +1 Focused Stride When you cast a spell that requires Concentration , you gain Momentum for 1 turn. While you are concentrating, you cannot be knocked Prone or moved against your will. Condition: Momentum Momentum Duration: 1 turn Spurred on by a sense of urgency. Movement Speed increased by 1.5 m (5 ft) per remaining duration of this effect. Removed when Restrained , Incapacitated , Prone , or slowed down. Momentum has a maximum Duration: 5 turns. Where to find Shattered Sanctum X: 335 Y: 43 : Worn by Minthara Bugs The Unmovable condition can be indefinitely applied by equipping the boots, casting a concentration spell, unequipping the boots, and then breaking concentration. The check to remove Unmovable is attached to the boots, and thus if they are not equipped when concentration ends, the effect will persist. The Boots of Uninhibited Kushigo are a rare pair of Boots that add the wearer's Wisdom modifier to their Unarmed Strike damage. During a hilltop battle that soaked the slopes in gore, Kushigo's best friend Irishi was scalped before he could help her. The enemy held up the bloody wig, and Kushigo fell upon one, and then another, until he had killed so many that they hung from his antlered shoulders like skewered effigies. ## Disintegrating Night Walkers
- **来源**: [Disintegrating Night Walkers](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Disintegrating_Night_Walkers)
- **分类**: Boots

The Disintegrating Night Walkers are story-related Boots which grant their wearer immunity to various surface effects, and also allows them to cast Misty Step once per Short Rest . Darker than a starless night, Night Walkers are made for secrecy in the honour of Shar . This particular pair was found deep in the ruins of an Underdark fortress. Though the leather is old and the magic is fading, the boots were recently cleaned and oiled with care. Properties Boots Rarity: Story Item Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.55 kg (1.1 lb) Price: 360 gp UID S_UND_DuergarGaleItem UUID e7f24f6d-4d73-4f04-94ef-d8e7042ce6a2 Stats FOR_NightWalkers File ARM_DrowLeather_A_Footwear UID UNI_NightWalkers UUID ac9145d1-31d0-4aa3-8755-62cc85dad22b Special The wearer of this item gains: Misty Step ( ) Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Short rest .) Night Walker The affected creature cannot be Enwebbed , Entangled , or Ensnared and cannot slip on Grease or Ice . Where to find Grymforge X: -854 Y: 780 : Worn by Nere Notes Regarding Night Walker: Night Walker only provides immunity to Ensnared received from Ensnaring Strike cast up to level two, and not from levels three or higher. It additionally does not provide immunity to Grasping Arrow: Entangled or Black Tentacles . Bugs These boots are tagged as a Story item despite not being attached to any quests within the game. ## Helldusk Boots
- **来源**: [Helldusk Boots](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Helldusk_Boots)
- **分类**: Boots

The Helldusk Boots are a very rare pair of Boots that allows the wearer to ignore Difficult Terrain , and to use a Reaction to succeed on a Saving Throw . It also grants the Hellcrawler bonus action. No ore takes better to being forged than the infernal iron of Avernus , where the archdevil Zariel presides. Properties Boots Rarity: Very rare Weight: 2 kg (4 lb) Price: 450 gp UID MAG_Infernal_Metal_Boots UUID bc82f909-ade5-4ada-9b94-cec7ca1d4a68 Stats MAG_Infernal_Metal_Boots File ARM_Demon_A_Footwear Special The wearer of this item gains: Hellcrawler ( ) Teleport to an area and deal 2d8 Fire damage where you land. The impact blast spreads in a 3 m / 10 ft zone. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Steadfast You cannot be forcibly moved by a foe's spells or actions, and you ignore the effects of Difficult Terrain . Infernal Evasion When you fail a Saving Throw , you may use your Reaction to succeed instead. Where to find Wyrm's Rock Fortress X: -32 Y: 219 : in a locked Gilded Chest on the top floor Notes Taking this item after Gortash's coronation makes Gortash and all Steel Watchers on this floor permanently hostile. Taking this item before the coronation or before Gortash leaves the throne room does not turn them hostile. If Gortash's deal is taken and Orin is killed, taking this item does not make them hostile. Along with the rest of the Helldusk Set , these boots are said to have been made by Carixim . Regarding Steadfast: Steadfast prevents the following conditions from applying: All conditions in the Prone status group Difficult Terrain Difficult Terrain: Lava from Lava surfaces Difficult Terrain: Mud from Mud surfaces Difficult Terrain: Vines from Twisting Vines surfaces Difficult Terrain: Web from Web surfaces Plant Growth from the Plant Growth spell Regarding Infernal Evasion: The reaction provided by this passive may only be used once per long rest. Bugs Regarding Steadfast: Steadfast doesn't prevent Difficult Terrain: Deep Water from Deep Water surfaces. While the description of Steadfast specifies the wearer cannot be moved by a foe's spells or actions, this also includes allies. Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Dyed variations

## Slinging Shoes
- **来源**: [Slinging Shoes](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Slinging_Shoes)
- **分类**: Boots

Slinging Shoes is a pair of Boots that deal psychic damage and return to the wearer when thrown. These shoes were formerly enchanted to return to their owner's feet. This caused a great deal of trouble for owners, who, while wearing a slipper or a nice heeled number, kept being kicked in the ankles by jealous footwear. Properties Boots Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.55 kg (1.1 lb) Price: 35 gp UID MAG_Projectile_Shoes UUID 9b94fd74-bcee-4d30-8862-0a18ae65541b Stats MAG_Projectile_Shoes File ARM_Footwear_Cloth_F Special The wearer of this item gains: Dexterity Saving Throws +1 Shoe Slinger Returns to its owner when thrown. On a hit deal an additional 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage. Where to find Highberry's Home X: -1 Y: -39 : Sold by Tara on the roof Notes Tara only accepts fish and magical items in exchange for these shoes. This is Tara's second vendor location and second item sold. Tara only appears at this location if doing the following: Speaking to her on the roof of the Open Hand Temple with Gale in the party during the Find the Missing Letters quest Visiting her on the roof of the Devil's Fee X: -29 Y: 6 after purchasing the Hat of the Sharp Caster from her Taking a Long Rest after purchasing her first item As the Slinging Shoes weigh little, they only deal a base of 1 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage when thrown (before applying any modifiers and the 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage from Shoe Slinger). Regarding Shoe Slinger: Much like other Homing Weapons , an item with Shoe Slinger automatically equips itself onto the thrower when it returns. If the thrower has other footwear equipped when throwing the Slinging Shoes, it is unequipped in favour of them. This 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic bonus damage is dealt when thrown even on miss. Bugs Regarding Shoe Slinger: The 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage is not dealt if thrown via Enraged Throw . Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Dyed variations

It is said the Speedy Lightfeet were the first of many lightning inventions made by Yrre the Sparkstruck. The boots' old, frayed edges zap and crackle with even the slightest movement. Properties Boots Required Proficiency: Medium Armour Rarity: Rare Consumable by Gale Weight: 2 kg (4 lb) Price: 240 gp UID MAG_ChargedLightning_Dash_Boots UUID 66be4e91-933b-44e8-a73c-3b8a9c6b14a8 Stats MAG_ChargedLightning_Dash_Boots File ARM_Footwear_Metal_A_1 Special The wearer of this item gains: Athletics +1 Speedy Sparks When the wearer Dashes or takes a similar action in combat, they gain 3 Lightning Charges Where to find Blighted Village X: -711 Y: -412 : In a heavy chest in the cellar behind the windmill Notes It is not stated in-game, but Speedy Sparks activates at most once per turn, even when Dashing multiple times in a turn. While The Speedy Lightfeet appears ideal for rogues , barbarians , and monks , rogues and monks do not gain Medium Armour Proficiency from their class, and barbarians and monks lose the benefits of their respective Unarmoured Defense traits if wearing The Speedy Lightfeet. ## The Watersparkers
- **来源**: [The Watersparkers](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/The_Watersparkers)
- **分类**: Boots

The Watersparkers are a pair of rare Boots that allow the wearer to electrify water surfaces and gain Lightning Charges . An enormous storm was raging the first time Yrre the Sparkstruck left the Underdark . The deep gnome 's interest in lightning became at once an all-consuming obsession, and they would spend the rest of their years striving to recreate that storm's power themselves. Properties Boots Rarity: Rare Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.55 kg (1.1 lb) Price: 190 gp UID MAG_ChargedLightning_ElectricSurface_Boots UUID fc9104ab-b61c-4481-8402-cecb13baf30f Special The wearer of this item gains: Electrify Water When the wearer stands in Water during combat, it becomes Electrified Water . Watersparks If the wearer starts their turn on an Electrified Water surface, they gain 3 Lightning Charges . Where to find Shattered Sanctum : In a gilded chest in Minthara's area of the Shattered Sanctum X: 339 Y: 41 Notes Synergizes with The Sparkswall , which provides immunity to being electrocuted each round by the electrified water. Regarding Electrify Water: Electrify Water electrifys a surface of water immediately when entering it during combat, or when standing on one as combat starts. However, it will run out in a few turns and only reactivate by leaving and entering the area of the water again. Using this in combat where friendly but non-controllable NPCs are present may result in them turning hostile afterwards if they walk through electrified water surfaces. ## Wavemother's Boots
- **来源**: [Wavemother's Boots](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Wavemother's_Boots)
- **分类**: Boots

This article is about content that is inaccessible through normal gameplay . It can still be accessed via in-game exploits or third party tools. Wavemother's Boots is a rare pair of Boots that allow the wearer to heal while standing in water. Though vindictive and about as kindly as a tsunami, Umberlee the Sea Goddess is occasionally inclined toward restorative acts, as gentle as placid waves on a white-gold shore. Properties Boots Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.55 kg (1.1 lb) Price: 190 gp UID MAG_LC_Umberlee_Regeneration_Boots UUID a1eb910c-0090-4c50-a1cb-a35cbe8c80f2 Special The wearer of this item gains: Watery Rejuvenation If the wearer is standing in a Water surface at the start of their turn, they heal 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Notes Not accessible through normal gameplay, but can still be accessed via third party tools. Regarding Watery Rejuvenation: Watery Rejuvenation only triggers if the wearer is in combat and standing on an actual Water surface . It does not trigger when standing in a permanent body of water, such as can be found in the Lower City Sewers , nor does it trigger on standing in other types of liquid surfaces such as Blood or Alcohol . Hit points can be repeatedly regained outside of combat by entering turn-based mode while standing in a water surface and repeatedly ending the turn until it is the wearer's next turn.

Where to find Lower City Sewers X: -123 Y: 834 : Worn by Aelis Siryasius in the area filled with greasy surfaces Bugs Regarding Flaming Shroud: Despite the tooltip stating that an attacker receives Burning upon damaging the wearer, Flaming Shroud requires failing a DC  12 Dexterity Saving Throw before Burning is applied. ## Derivation Cloak
- **来源**: [Derivation Cloak](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Derivation_Cloak)
- **分类**: Cloaks

Derivation Cloak is a rare Cloak which heals the wearer for 1d4 Hit Points when they Poison a foe. Based on a mad alchemist's experiments to derive youth from his victims by poisoning them, this cloak relies on a much more reliable arcane formula. Properties Cloaks Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 190 gp UID MAG_Poison_InflictPoisonHealSelf_Cloak UUID 857d9a3c-5a40-4dfa-a634-99629095248b Stats MAG_Poison_InflictPoisonHealSelf_Cloak Special The wearer of this item gains: Deadly Derivation When you Poison a foe, heal yourself for 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Where to find Moonrise Towers X: -132 Y: -175 : In a heavy chest in Balthazar's chambers on the First Floor Notes Regarding Deadly Derivation: There are four Poisoned conditions reusing the same icon, which can be confusing. The most general one is Poisoned , and it's the only one considered by this passive. That means there will be no healing via the following similar conditions: Poisoned condition caused by a weapon coated in Basic Poison . But the same item when thrown generates a Poison Cloud , which can cause the correct Poisoned condition, triggering this passive. Poisoned condition caused by drinking or throwing Suspicious Poison . Poisoned condition caused by consuming Spider meat . This passive has great synergy when combined with Poisoner's Gloves and Broodmother's Revenge . Every attack can cause Poisoned , healing the character and refreshing the poison coating. Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Dyed variations

Acid damage from Caustic Reprisal does not activate the Ichorous Corrosion passive on the Ichorous Gloves . Nymph Cloak is a very rare Cloak that allows the wearer to cast Dominate Person once per Long Rest. The charmers, seducers, philanderers, flirts, gallants, beguilers, ravishers, rogues, tempters, and tantalisers of the Feywild all share one common trait: they make you feel as if you are the only diamond among the drift. Properties Cloaks Rarity: Very rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 360 gp UID S_LOW_CountingHouse_Vault1_Nymph_Cloak UUID a2f14c28-a3dc-49d3-90d6-ed6116ea73ef Stats MAG_LC_Nymph_Cloak UID MAG_LC_Nymph_Cloak UUID 6062db99-6719-44e2-9d01-9a99131d1ba7 Stats MAG_LC_Nymph_Cloak Special The wearer of this item gains: Dominate Person ( ) Cast as a level 5 spell ( Recharge: Long rest .) Where to find The Counting House X: -711 Y: 864 : In the High Security Vault nº1 Rivington X: 44 Y: -97 : Sold by Ferg Drogher near the Requisitioned Barn Notes The cloak is part of Ferg Drogher's special stock, which requires a Persuasion check to be accessed. He does not sell any items (including this one) if Shadowheart is nearby, unless she killed The Nightsong earlier in Act Two , in which case no persuasion check is needed. This type of cloak was also available in Baldur's Gate 1 & 2 . It did not allow for direct control of other characters, but unlike most charms would not result in hostilities after the effect wears off and could be used on many creatures that were otherwise unaffected by charms like undead. The Deathstalker Mantle is a rare Cloak that turns the wearer Invisible for 2 turns after killing an enemy. Let hill and hollow be a door To screams that last forevermore Properties Cloaks Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 190 gp UID UNI_DarkUrge_Bhaal_Cloak UUID dff731f7-d6da-403d-80cf-7f3d9cc7345b Stats UNI_DarkUrge_Bhaal_Cloak Special The wearer of this item gains: The Shadow Itself Once per turn when you kill an enemy, shroud yourself in primeval darkness to become Invisible for 2 turns. Where to find Campsite (Act One) : given to The Dark Urge Origin by Sceleritas Fel Notes Regarding The Shadow Itself: The Shadow Itself only triggers once per turn, and only does so if the character kills an enemy directly while in combat mode. Examples of kills that do not trigger this effect include, but are not limited to: Indirect kills, such as attacking an incendiary barrel that then burns a nearby enemy to death. [ verify ] Killing an opponent by sniper-shot with a bow, out of combat. A creature killed from the wearer's casting of Cloud of Daggers Sneak Attack as a reaction . [ verify ] If a 'homing' weapon such as Returning Pike deals the killing blow to an enemy, then the weapon's return animation will cause the invisibility to end early. If the Dark Urge is played as origin and either Alfira or Quil are killed in camp by another (e.g., Astarion ) before finishing the Long Rest, conversation options in camp next morning proceed as if the player character killed them, and Sceleritas still meets with them upon their next Long rest, but does not reward the cape. Bugs Regarding The Shadow Itself: There is a bug involving this item with the Illithid power Cull the Weak . If the equipping character has The Shadow Itself activated and kills a target, the effect does not activate (or immediately gets cancelled). ## Garb of the Land and Sky
- **来源**: [Garb of the Land and Sky](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Garb_of_the_Land_and_Sky)
- **分类**: Clothing

Garb of the Land and Sky is rare piece of Clothing that grants the wearer Blade Ward when using Patient Defence . When using Step of the Wind , the wearer's next Attack Roll has Advantage and deals an additional 1d8 Force damage. Long ago, Kushigo was a warrior. Bedecked in an enormous set of plate steel, its shoulder pauldrons fashioned like great antlered stags, his arrival on a battlefield spelled doom for the enemy. Yet this armour - so light and fine - speaks nothing to the legacy. Properties Clothing Rarity: Rare Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 800 gp UID MAG_Monk_Magic_Armor_1 UUID dbe75b4c-d23a-4a19-b630-34de519750c6 Stats MAG_Monk_Magic_Armor_1 File ARM_Magic_Monk_B_Body File ARM_Magic_Monk_Pants Special The wearer of this item gains: Armour Class +1 Mountainous Poise While using Patient Defence , you also benefit from the effect of Blade Ward . Breezeswift Speed While using Step of the Wind , your next Attack Roll has Advantage and deals an additional 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage. Where to find Danthelon's Dancing Axe X: -10 Y: 143 : Sold by Entharl Danthelon in Wyrm's Crossing Notes Regarding Breezeswift Speed: The effect of Breezeswift Speed is dispelled when landing a successful weapon attack, but can boost attacks other than with proper weapons. The Advantage component of the effect applies to all attack rolls including unarmed attacks, throwing items, and spells. When making one of these (non-weapon) attacks, the effect remains. The damage component applies to thrown weapons as well. Again, the effect is not lost when making a throwing attack, so Breezeswift Speed can be used buff the damage of all throwing attacks in a turn. Bugs Regarding Breezeswift Speed: Breezeswift Speed provides Swift as Wind , which is only removed when making a weapon attack, as opposed to the next attack roll. Breezeswift Speed states it affects the next "Attack Roll", while Swift As Wind states it affects the next "weapon attack". While active, Swift As Wind affects all attack rolls but only increases weapon damage. The name of the goddess Selûne came to her, and never left. Properties 10 Armour Class + Dexterity modifier Clothing Rarity: Very rare Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 1600 gp UID MAG_Selunite_Isobel_Robe UUID 3b498702-834f-4989-a9d1-c0f3b38fbcfc Stats MAG_Selunite_Isobel_Robe File ARM_Isobel_A_Robe_Body File ARM_Isobel_A_Pants File ARM_Isobel_A_Robe_Skirt_B Special The wearer of this item gains: Advantage on Constitution Saving Throws . Produce Flame ( ) A flame in your hand sheds a light in a 9 m (30 ft) radius and deals 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage when thrown. Selûne's Protection While the wearer has Mage Armour , each successful Saving Throw causes the source of the Saving Throw to take 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant damage. Where to find Last Light Inn X: -60 Y: 158 : Worn by Isobel after dealing with the Nightsong but before completing the assault on Moonrise Towers Mind Flayer Colony X: 861 Y: -23 : Worn by Isobel after being kidnapped by Marcus Ramazith's Tower : Worn by Isobel if the Nightsong is killed or imprisoned by Lorroakan Campsite (Act Two) : Worn by Isobel as Camp Follower Notes The Produce Flame cantrip granted by the robes always uses Wisdom as the casting ability, regardless of the class' casting ability. Bugs Regarding Selûne's Protection: Although Selûne's Protection should be activated by Lunar Bulwark , it is not; the wearer must instead have the regular version of Mage Armour cast on them for its radiant damage to function. Additionally, although the tooltip mentions saving throws without any additional qualifiers, this does not work for saving throws rolled against non-spell effects such as weapon actions. As mentioned in the summary on this page, only successful saves against spells trigger the radiant damage. - **来源**: [Potent Robe](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Potent_Robe)

The Potent Robe is a very rare piece of Clothing that uses the wearer's Charisma modifier to increase their cantrips' damage as well as give them temporary hit points. This robe is a difficult look to pull off unless one is blessed with an otherwordly charisma. Properties 10 Armour Class + Dexterity modifier Clothing Rarity: Very rare Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 1600 gp UID MAG_CharismaCaster_Robe UUID 1e64badf-4898-4169-9b02-3910518dc73d Stats MAG_CharismaCaster_Robe Special The wearer of this item gains: Armour Class +1 Gregarious Caster Your cantrips deal additional damage equal to your Charisma Modifier. Well-Liked and Well-Fortified At the beginning of the wearer's turn, the robe activates, granting them Temporary Hit Points equal to their Charisma Modifier. Where to find Last Light Inn X: -56 Y: 141 : Rewarded by Alfira for successfully completing ⁠ Rescue the Tieflings Notes Alfira must be alive to receive this item. Although the quest can technically be completed with her dead, there is no one else to provide this specific reward. The only way to obtain this robe as the Dark Urge is to knock Alfira out (in Act One ) by using non-lethal attacks prior to actually going to sleep on the night she appears at camp, thereby forcing a substitute, Quil , to appear and be murdered in her place as a victim of the Dark Urge. The Mellow Fruit Dye often matches the colour of Handwear to this item. Regarding Gregarious Caster: Gregarious Caster stacks with similar effects such as the Draconic Bloodline Sorcerer 's Elemental Affinity feature and the Necklace of Elemental Augmentation , leading to the ability modifier potentially being added to the damage of certain spells several times. It also stacks with Warlock's Agonising Blast . Bugs Regarding Well-Liked and Well-Fortified: The temporary hit points from Well-Liked and Well-Fortified only have a StackPriority of 1, and as such are overridden by any other source of temporary hit points that have a StackPriority of 1 or higher, even if the new source is of a lesser value. Properties 10 Armour Class + Dexterity modifier Clothing Rarity: Very rare Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 4160 gp UID MAG_BarbMonk_Cloth_A_2_Late UUID 1c69a87e-9136-4e13-90af-c0f02d0fc81f Stats MAG_Monk_SoulRejunevation_Armor Special The wearer of this item gains: Armour Class +2 Defier's Rejuvenation Whenever the wearer succeeds on a Saving Throw against a Spell , they regain 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Where to find Sold by Lorroakan's Projection in Sorcerous Sundries if Rolan is dead Sold by Rolan in Sorcerous Sundries if Rolan and Lorroakan are both alive Sold by Rolan via trade option on the bottom left during the dialogue in Ramazith's Tower if Rolan is alive but Lorroakan is dead Notes Regarding Greater Kushigo Counter: Greater Kushigo Counter triggers Extra Attack , if used during a player character's turn. If this attack is done while Extra Attack (from a normal attack) is activated, both Extra Attacks (from normal attack and Greater Kushigo Counter) are lost. Sentinel: Vengeance attack from an enemy can trigger Greater Kushigo Counter at the wrong moment and cause the loss of both Extra Attacks. On Honour mode, monks with an extra Action (at least from Haste and Elixir of Bloodlust ) can get Extra Attack only once per turn, while characters without extra actions get Extra Attack for both the normal attack and the Greater Kushigo Counter. Thus, both a hasted and a non-hasted monk can get 4 attacks per turn using Greater Kushigo Counter. Properties Gloves Required Proficiency: Medium Armour Rarity: Very rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 1600 gp / 1900 gp H Honour UID MAG_OfWarMaster_Gloves UUID 85865321-5feb-447f-92e7-5c04359fe3af Stats MAG_OfWarMaster_Gloves File ARM_Gloves_Metal_E Special The wearer of this item gains: Attack rolls +1 Heightened Manoeuvre Targets have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your Manoeuvre and Weapon Actions . This includes: Every manoeuvre Almost every weapon action Stunning Strike (both unarmed and weapon variants) Water Whip Heightened Manoeuvre does not affect weapon actions that do not involve the weapon action DC. These actions include: Every Arcane Shot Dazzling Ray Hellflame Cleave Reposition Malefactor Zephyr Break Zephyr Flash The ability to subject opponents of the wearer's manoeuvres to disadvantage is of significant utility to Battle Masters . ## Gemini Gloves
- **来源**: [Gemini Gloves](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Gemini_Gloves)

The Gemini Gloves are a very rare pair of Gloves . They grant the wearer the ability to cast Cantrips which can target foes or allies twice. Designed by an arcane smith with half-vision. He made these gloves to make sure his spells hit their target. Properties Gloves Rarity: Very rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 450 gp / 860 gp H Honour UID MAG_Warlock_Twinned_Gloves UUID fc4fd633-bc45-4ff4-90e6-2e454f7ceaa0 Stats MAG_Warlock_Twinned_Gloves File ARM_Gloves_Leather_E Special The wearer of this item gains: Adroit Caster Cantrips targeting foes and allies can target an additional creature. The same target can be chosen twice. Usable once per short rest. Where to find Devil's Fee X: -38 Y: 17 : Sold by Helsik once her special stock is unlocked Notes Regarding Adroit Caster: Adroit Caster stacks additively with Metamagic: Twinned Spell , meaning that a total of three targets can be chosen if both effects are used jointly. Eldritch Blast only receives one additional blast and not another full set, e.g. a level 10 warlock gets 4 (3+1) blasts and not 6 (3x2) Cantrips that do not use projectiles instead grant the spells an area of effect; the nearest target to the primary target within this area is chosen to take the second attack. For touch range cantrips, such as Shocking Grasp or Guidance , the radius is ⁠2 m (7 ft). For non-projectile cantrips with a range greater than touch, such as Sacred Flame or Thorn Whip , the radius is ⁠6 m (20 ft). When combined with Twinned Spell, this allows these cantrips to hit 4 creatures instead of the expected 3, as the wearer casts the spell twice with its added area of effect. ## Gloves (Equipment)
- **来源**: [Gloves (Equipment)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Gloves_(Equipment))
- **分类**: Gloves

## Gloves of Battlemage's Power
- **来源**: [Gloves of Battlemage's Power](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Gloves_of_Battlemage's_Power)
- **分类**: Gloves

Gloves of Battlemage's Power is a rare pair of Gloves . They allow the wearer to gain Arcane Acuity whenever they hit a target with a spell or cantrip that uses a weapon. Bands of blue light snap and contract when the gloved fingertips are pressed together - evidence of the arcane polarity linking them. Properties Gloves Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 290 gp UID MAG_Gish_ArcaneAcuity_Gloves UUID 15381544-e616-46e6-a881-0af793971863 Stats MAG_Gish_ArcaneAcuity_Gloves File ARM_Gloves_Metal_I Special The wearer of this item gains: Strength Saving Throws +1 Battlemage's Power When you hit a target with a spell or cantrip that uses a weapon, you gain Arcane Acuity . Condition: Arcane Acuity Arcane Acuity Affected entity has a +1 bonus to its spell Attack Rolls and spell save DC for each remaining turn. Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity takes damage. Arcane Acuity has a maximum Duration: 10 turns. Where to find Reithwin Tollhouse X: -84 Y: -88 : in a locked opulent chest on the second floor in the room with two locked doors Notes DC 10 Sleight of Hand Check can be used to unlock the chest that contains these gloves. These Gloves' functions were redesigned in Patch 8. Regarding Battlemage's Power: The spells that can trigger this effect are: Any smite spell (and also Divine Smite ). Casting a smite spell and then reacting with Divine Smite will trigger Battlemage's Power twice. Booming Blade Ensnaring Strike (Melee) and Ensnaring Strike (Ranged) Hail of Thorns Any damage dealt while wielding a normal, non-permanent Flame Blade in the main hand. The damage can be from any source such as weapon attacks, spell damage (including each dart from Magic Missile ), or even damage from status effects like Burning . Battlemage's Power does not trigger if the conjured weapon is in the off-hand, even if attacking with the conjured weapon. Weapon attacks with Shadow Blade (weapon) Bugs Regarding Battlemage's Power: The reader is advised that Battlemage's Power appears to have some of the most complex and unintuitive behaviour in the game, making it difficult to distinguish what is actually a bug. Any damage dealt while wielding a normal, non-permanent Flame Blade in the main hand triggers Battlemage's Power. The damage can be from any source such as weapon attacks, spell damage (including each dart from Magic Missile and each blast from Eldritch Blast ), or even damage from status effects like Burning . Battlemage's Power does not trigger if the conjured weapons are in the off-hand, even if attacking with the conjured weapon. This only works with a normal, temporary Flame Blade summoned by the corresponding spell and not with a permanent Flame Blade acquired through hireling exploit . This effect also used to work while wielding a Shadow Blade in the main hand, but this was removed in a hotfix after Patch 8. Battlemage's Power does not function with the Mephistopheles Tiefling version of Flame Blade, as this version has a different condition applied to it which is not listed in the ArcaneAcuityGlovesCondition() .khn script. Throwing Healing Potions and Grenades triggers Battlemage's Power, even without hitting any target. Reaction Smites provide acuity if and only if the triggering attack provided acuity. If the source attack does trigger Battlemage's Power, reaction smite triggers them a second time, for a total of +4 Acuity. All of the following provide Acuity: Persistent AoE spell effects like Cloudkill and Wall of Fire Every status in the game which deals damage attributed to the wearer triggers Battlemage's Power. For example, Burning and Electrocuted . Fall damage caused by the wearer Some miscellaneous effects like the Holy Lance Helm Retaliation effects do not trigger Battlemage's Power. This includes onHit effects such as Armour of Agathys and Fire Shield ; onDamage effects such as Fleshmelter Cloak ; and onMiss effects such as Shield of Scorching Reprisal . Battlemage's Power is meant to have a OncePerAttack restriction, meaning they should only provide Acuity once per damaging event. However, the OncePerAttack limit gets reset every time the player character performs any effect which targets any in-game entity, whether that entity is an enemy, an ally, or the wearer themself. This includes regular attacks as well as self-target abilities like Dash and Rage . This also includes effects the game considers an "attack" (due to underlying code) such as: using the Perform action (including in combat), speaking with the Sentient Amulet (including in combat), targeting someone with the ability check version of Bend Luck , and provoking an attack of opportunity (though if the wearer takes damage from it, they lose 2 Acuity). Explosions also reset the gloves' once per attack limit. This includes the AOE "explosions" from Hamarhraft and Luminous Armour as well as grenades like Alchemist's Fire and Caustic Bulb . ## Gloves of Belligerent Skies

- **分类**: Gloves

The Gloves of Belligerent Skies are an uncommon pair of Gloves that inflict Reverberation when the wearer deals ⁠ Thunder , ⁠ Lightning or ⁠ Radiant damage. Balling your fingers into fists while wearing these gloves causes a sonorous chime, like the fusion of a tempest and a church bell, to resound inside your skull. Properties Gloves Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 90 gp UID MAG_Thunder_Reverberation_Gloves UUID c987b6e4-adcb-47d6-8dfd-6d4d2f15a381 Stats MAG_Thunder_Reverberation_Gloves File ARM_Gloves_Leather_A Special The wearer of this item gains: Thunderous Conversion When the wearer deals ⁠ Thunder , ⁠ Lightning , or ⁠ Radiant damage, inflict 2 turns of Reverberation upon the target(s). Where to find Crèche Y'llek X: 1348 Y: -677 : In an elegant chest in the Inquisitor's Chamber , along the southern wall of the room, on the western side Notes Regarding Thunderous Conversion: The ⁠ Lightning damage originating from Lightning Charges does not seem to trigger the item and thus does not apply Reverberation effect to targets unless on Honour difficulty rules. The ⁠ Radiant from Morninglord's Radiance , however, does trigger Reverberation - both on weapon and spell attacks. (as of 4.1.1.3648072) The ⁠ Thunder damage from Phalar Aluve: Shriek does not activate Thunderous Conversion unless on Honour difficulty rules. If the wearer's attack adds a 5th stack of Reverberation, the resulting Thunder damage re-applies two more stacks of Reverberation. Thunderous Conversion does not work with Moonbeam . Bugs Regarding Thunderous Conversion: Though stated "upon the target(s)", Thunderous Conversion can only trigger once per attack. This means that AoE spells (e.g., Radiance of the Dawn or Flame Strike ) can only apply Reverberation to the first target in the log order, leaving the rest without the effect. This also means that dealing multiple instances of damage in a single attack (e.g., with Lightning Arrow ) will still only apply 2 turns of Reverberation . The Gloves of Soul Catching are a legendary pair of Gloves . They grant additional Force damage to unarmed attacks, +2 Constitution , and heal the wearer after an unarmed attack. Formerly worn by Autumnal Baskin, a professional meditator turned bare-knuckle champion, who gained enlightenment via two methods. The second was getting a lot of fighting acumen. Advanced cosmic harmony is a nose. Sometimes you've got to break it a few times to get the best of things. Properties Gloves Rarity: Legendary Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 960 gp UID MAG_PHB_OfSoulCatching_Gloves UUID c1342b19-c898-451c-b2e8-6eb6666fe1c2 Stats MAG_PHB_OfSoulCatching_Gloves File ARM_Cloth_Magic_A_Gloves Special The wearer of this item gains: Constitution +2, up to 20. Soul Fist Your unarmed attacks deal an additional 1d10 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage. Soul Catching Once per turn, on an unarmed hit, you regain 10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Alternatively, you may forego healing to gain a +5 bonus on an Attack Roll or Saving Throw until the end of your next turn. [ See: Bugs ] Where to find House of Hope X: -6477 Y: 2884 : Given by Hope for completing her quest ⁠ Save Hope Bugs Regarding Soul Catching: Soul Catching has numerous errors: It states it requires an 'unarmed hit' while the Grasp Essence condition states "hit a creature with an unarmed attack". Functionally, any damaging unarmed attack will trigger the effect, even against world items. It states the wielder regains 10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points , but instead it grants an a free action that, when used, provides the healing. It states the wielder may gain Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws until the end of their next turn, while the Grasp Essence condition states the wielder may gain Advantage on attack rolls or saving throws before the end of their next turn. Advantage is not actually gained, but rather a free reaction is granted that provides the wielder with a choice of either adding a +5 bonus to a single attack roll or to a single saving throw, at which time the Grasp Essence condition is removed. Due to a coding error, Grasp Essence is removed from the wielder if they take damage and do not have any temporary HP. Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Dyed variations

Gloves of the Balanced Hands are a rare pair of Gloves that add the wearer's Ability Modifier to damage when they make an attack with their off-hand weapon. Formerly worn by Doubleway Douglas Fairbanks, who was so ambidextrous his tears ran down the back of his neck. Properties Gloves Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 160 gp / 460 gp H Honour UID MAG_OfTheBalancedHands_Gloves UUID 7ffce863-d530-4492-a455-a8f11c53d6c3 Stats MAG_OfTheBalancedHands_Gloves File ARM_Gloves_Leather_H Special The wearer of this item gains: Two-Weapon Fighting When you make an offhand attack, you can add your Ability Score Modifier to the damage of the attack. Where to find Last Light Inn X: -31 Y: 130 : Sold by Quartermaster Talli near the Last Light Inn waypoint Notes The gloves work with both melee and ranged weapons. These gloves do not stack with other sources of Two-Weapon Fighting . Despite the name, these are actually bracers which cover the wearer's forearms and leave their hands bare. Regarding Two-Weapon Fighting: Multiple sources of Two-Weapon Fighting do not provide additional damage to off-hand attacks. Not to be confused with the Dual Wielder feat. During level up, the character will always have only one weapon visible at their back, even if two are equipped. Unlike tabletop 5e, the Two-Weapon Fighting Style provides no benefit to Thrown weapons in Baldur's Gate 3. While dual-wielding still allows for an off-hand throw attack via Bonus Action , BG3's game engine automatically adds the user's Ability Modifier to throw damage by default. Therefore, this Fighting Style '"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000148-QINU`"' which grants the same modifier to off-hand strikes '"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000148-QINU`"' is redundant for throwing. In tabletop D&D, this style is required to add Ability Modifier damage to an off-hand throw (PHB, p. 195). Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Dyed variations

## Gloves of the Growling Underdog
- **来源**: [Gloves of the Growling Underdog](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Gloves_of_the_Growling_Underdog)
- **分类**: Gloves

The Gloves of the Growling Underdog are an uncommon pair of Gloves which grant the wearer Advantage on their melee attack rolls while surrounded by 2 or more enemies. Crowded taprooms. Packed feast halls. Bustling market bazaars. Chances to be social? Sure. Chances to be violent? Absolutely. Properties Gloves Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 110 gp / 230 gp H Honour UID MAG_ZOC_AdvantageOnMeleeAttackWhileSurounded_Gloves UUID 1001f28b-5ea3-4257-864c-f60c812aecf0 Stats MAG_ZOC_AdvantageOnMeleeAttackWhileSurounded_Gloves File ARM_Gloves_Metal_F Special The wearer of this item gains: Strength Saving Throws +1 Underdog's Bravery The wearer gains Advantage on melee Attack Rolls while surrounded [ See: Bugs ] by 2 or more foes. Where to find Shattered Sanctum X: 298 Y: 66 : In Dror Ragzlin's treasure crates behind the locked iron gate Notes This item can sometimes instead be found inside a treasure crate after passing a Survival check on the Rosymorn Monastery Trail X: -118 Y: -134 . Despite their appearance, these gloves do not count as Armour and can be used alongside Unarmoured Defence and similar effects. Regarding Underdog's Bravery: The enemies must be within 3 m (10 ft). This passive is limited to weapon attacks and does not function with Unarmed Strikes or melee spell attacks. Bugs Regarding Underdog's Bravery: Two or more enemies must be within 3 m (10 ft) of the target , not the wearer of the gloves. This means the wearer does not need to be 'surrounded' at all; they need enemies near the target of their attack. A character using a weapon with Extra Reach can gain Advantage without even having the Threatened condition. Incapacitated enemies, which are not supposed to count towards qualifying for this passive, will do so '"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000150-QINU`"' as long as at least one enemy is not incapacitated. This feature may work against Ansur and the Dominated Red Dragon even when no other enemies are nearby, due to their hit proxies counting as separate enemies. ## Nimblefinger Gloves
- **来源**: [Nimblefinger Gloves](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Nimblefinger_Gloves)
- **分类**: Gloves

Nimblefinger Gloves are a rare pair of Gloves that grant a Dexterity bonus to Gnomes , Halflings , and Dwarves , as well as a bonus to Sleight of Hand . For the right wearer, these supple doeskin gloves offer both comfort and protection - alongside a perfectly attuned sense of where one's fingers are, and what pocket they're picking. Properties Gloves Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 160 gp / 500 gp H Honour UID MAG_BG_Nimblefinger_Gloves UUID fbc9b0ad-f31e-4cdc-a1cc-1e2204cb46c5 Stats MAG_BG_Nimblefinger_Gloves File ARM_Gloves_Leather_G Special The wearer of this item gains: Sleight of Hand +1 Nimblefinger Gnomes are granted +2 to Dexterity . Halflings and Dwarves gain +1 Dexterity. Where to find Angleiron's Cellar X: -241 Y: -1065 : Sold by Bumpnagel Notes The cellar is accessible via a cave entrance at X: 30 Y: 29 or via a trapdoor in Rivington General . Regarding Nimblefinger: Being disguised as a Dwarf, Gnome, or Halfling when equipping the item also activates the effect. This effect persists even if dispelled, but doing so does not survive a reload. The Dexterity bonus is uncapped, and can therefore increase Dexterity to 24 in combination with the Mirror of Loss . However, the gloves do not stack with other capped Dexterity bonuses when Dexterity is above any of those caps. Therefore, this does not work if combined with a feat like Resilient: Dexterity , which caps at 20. Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Dyed variations

## The Sparkle Hands
- **来源**: [The Sparkle Hands](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/The_Sparkle_Hands)
- **分类**: Gloves

The Sparkle Hands are a pair of rare Gloves that grant Lightning Charges on unarmed attacks and provide Advantage against metal constructs and armoured foes while charged. 'Sometimes I just want to feel that spark,' Yrre the Sparkstruck said. 'Feel the lightning course through me.' Properties Gloves Rarity: Rare Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 110 gp UID MAG_ChargedLightning_AbilityCheckBoost_Gloves UUID a0bbe602-ffc1-45f1-9a09-de7d11575465 Stats MAG_ChargedLightning_AbilityCheckBoost_Gloves File ARM_Gloves_Metal_A Special The wearer of this item gains: Conductive Strikes On a hit with an unarmed attack, the wearer gains 2 Lightning Charges . Effective Transmitter While imbued with Lightning Charges , attacks against metal constructs and foes wearing metal armour gain Advantage . Where to find Decrepit Sanctuary X: 95 Y: 210 : in a wooden chest at the base of the giant tree stump in the Sunlit Wetlands Notes Regarding Conductive Strikes: Conductive Strikes grants Lightning Charges on any unarmed attack, which includes Throw attacks. Unlike similar passives, Conductive Strikes lacks a OncePerAttack restriction and thus triggers on any source of damage during an attack. For example, a Giant Barbarian: Throwing Lightning Jabber deals damage from the weapon, granting 2 Lightning Charges. Deals lighting damage from Throwing: Lightning Damage , granting an additional 2 Lightning Charges. Deals damage from Elemental Cleaver , granting an additional 2 Lightning Charges. When combined altogether, a total of 6 Lightning Charges have been granted by a single attack. Regarding Effective Transmitter: Spells/cantrips that use an Attack Roll , as opposed to a Saving Throw , also count for the purposes of the Effective Transmitter effect. ## Bonespike Helmet
- **来源**: [Bonespike Helmet](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Bonespike_Helmet)
- **分类**: Helmets

Bonespike Helmet is a very rare Helmet . If the wearer rages, the helmet forces all hostile creatures within a 3m radius to roll a wisdom saving throw. If failing this roll, they take 2-8 Psychic damage; a successful roll results in half damage. The tibia of a storm giant was ground and chiselled and reworked till it became this helm. The wearer can actually smell summer tempest clouds like maroon-dark dread while wearing the helm. Properties Helmets Rarity: Very rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 450 gp UID MAG_Barbarian_BoneSpike_Helmet UUID 72152951-3670-4004-b275-6b722c498bbc Stats MAG_Barbarian_BoneSpike_Helmet Special The wearer of this item gains: Intimidation +2 Menacing Attack (Melee) ( ) Possibly Frighten your target. They'll have Disadvantage on ability checks and Attack Rolls and be unable to move. ( Recharge: Per turn.) Fury In The Marrow When you Rage , hostile creatures in a 3 m (10 ft) radius must succeed a Weapon Action DC Wisdom Saving Throw or take 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage. The targets receive half damage on a save. [ See: Bugs ] Where to find Lower City Sewers X: -157 Y: 939 : Sold by Voiceless Penitent Bareki Notes For the version of Menacing Attack (Melee) granted by this item: The DC is determined by the same method as other manoeuvres . The bonus damage is not equal to a Superiority Die , as would be the case for a regular Menacing Attack; it is instead equal to the wearer's proficiency bonus . Unlike any of the manoeuvres granted by the Battle Master subclass, the Menacing Attack granted by this helmet recharges per turn . As with other manoeuvres, it uses a weapon attack roll which qualifies for Extra Attack . This makes it an attractive option for use at the beginning of every combat round for melee combatants with Extra Attack and level 11+ fighters in particular. This weapon action is usable even if the wielder is not proficient with their equipped melee weapon. Regarding Fury In The Marrow: The 2-8 Psychic damage mentioned in the in-game tooltip of Fury in the Marrow is, specifically, 2d4 Psychic damage. Bugs Regarding Fury In The Marrow: Hostile creatures that succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against Fury In The Marrow receive no damage instead of half damage.

## Circlet of Fire
- **来源**: [Circlet of Fire](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Circlet_of_Fire)
- **分类**: Helmets

This article is about an item or other previously obtainable content that has since been removed from the game , and is no longer obtainable , but can still be accessed via third party tools. The Circlet of Fire is an uncommon Circlet that grants the wearer a bonus action whenever they deal ⁠ Fire damage with a leveled spell. Merely holding the circlet makes your skin flush, filling you with determination and righteous fury. Properties Helmets Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 220 gp Special The wearer of this item gains: Fiery Return When you deal ⁠ Fire damage with a levelled spell, you Burn yourself and gain an additional Bonus Action this round. Where to find This item is not present in the launch version of the game. Its effects have largely been replicated by the Pyroquickness Hat found in Act Three . In Early Access versions of the game the circlet could be found in a gilded chest in the final room of the Apothecary's Cellar beneath the Blighted Village X: -659 Y: -370 . The cellar can be accessed through the building directly behind the village's Ancient Rune Circle . Notes Regarding Fiery Return: The conditions for activating Fiery Return are to deal fire damage with a non-cantrip spell or a melee spell attack roll. Attacks with a Flame Blade conjured by the druid spell count as melee spell attacks, so they trigger Fiery Return. However, this is not true of a Flame Blade summoned by a mephistopheles tiefling's racial feature or a permanent Flame Blade acquired through the exploit described here . The Daredevil Gloves can turn ranged spell attacks into melee spell attacks, so cantrips like Fire Bolt can trigger Fiery Return when paired with the gloves. Bugs Regarding Fiery Return: If Fiery Return is triggered with a Bonus Action (for example, with Metamagic: Quickened Spell ), the extra bonus action granted by this passive is wasted and consumed immediately. Hellcrawler , a class action granted by the Helldusk Boots , triggers Fiery Return, essentially negating the bonus action cost. Searing Smite does not trigger Fiery Return.

## Coldbrim Hat
- **来源**: [Coldbrim Hat](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Coldbrim_Hat)
- **分类**: Helmets

Coldbrim Hat is an uncommon Hat where, once per turn, if a condition is inflicted on the target, the hat also applies 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost . Upturning the hat and gazing into it, you get this slightly vertiginous feeling, as if you were looking into a cold, abandoned well with no discernible end. Properties Helmets Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 90 gp UID MAG_Frost_GenerateFrostOnStatusApply_Hat UUID d8ef5f3c-cada-42f8-a947-c3a3f62e569d Stats MAG_Frost_GenerateFrostOnStatusApply_Hat Special The wearer of this item gains: Coldbrim Chill Once per turn, any condition inflicted on a target, also applies 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost . [ See: Bugs ] Where to find Moonrise Towers X: -155 Y: -173 : In a locked chest in a hidden room behind a bookcase in Balthazar's Chambers Sorcerous Sundries : On a table by the Lava Elemental Notes Regarding Coldbrim Chill: Coldbrim Chill only affects a single target per turn. The wording of the description may be slightly confusing. Specifically, the fact that the Coldbrim Chill effect only applies once throughout the turn, meaning that an area of effect spell like Hypnotic Pattern only applies to the first target hit and only once that turn, not to all targets. Applying Encrusted with Frost to a target is specifically excluded from conditions that trigger this passive. Bugs Regarding Coldbrim Chill: Coldbrim Chill triggers under many circumstances even though it appears it should not, due to hidden technical conditions, such as when a ranged weapon attack misses, when Sanctuary is cast near enemies, or when revealing an invisible enemy with See Invisibility . ## Devilfoil Mask
- **来源**: [Devilfoil Mask](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Devilfoil_Mask)
- **分类**: Helmets

A Devilfoil Mask is a common Helmet worn by Merregons that increases the wearer's Strength by 1 and decreases the wearer's Intelligence , Wisdom , and Charisma by 1 per nearby mask. Beneath a layer of dust, the mask still gleams. An innocent smile and wide, searching eyes - seeking its own kind. Properties Helmets Rarity: Common Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 50 gp UID S_UND_MerregonMask_001 UUID b2409a86-dc0d-4193-9985-4f11419c64be Stats ARM_MerregonMask File ARM_Headwear_Merregon_Mask Special The wearer of this item gains: Infernal Legion Grants the Infernal Legion condition while worn. Condition: Infernal Legion Infernal Legion You are one, you are legion, without personality or individuality - born only to fight. When within 20 m (67 ft) of another creature wearing a merregon's mask, Strength increases by 1 and Intelligence , Wisdom , and Charisma decrease by 1 per nearby mask. Where to find Grymforge X: -620 Y: 325 : On a table near Sergeant Thrinn , at the Dig Site Grymforge X: -666 Y: 464 : On the ground at the foot of a staircase by Skarjall , behind a wall of rubble Grymforge X: -574 Y: 380 : On an altar guarded by a Merregon Legionnaire and Hellsboars Grymforge X: -574 Y: 380 : Carried by the Merregon Legionnaire Notes When first picked up, the character doing so can pass a DC 10 Arcana Check to identify it as a mask for a Merregon . As four of these masks are available relatively early in the game, they can, if worn by all party members, be used to raise the Strength of those wearing them by 3. Devilfoil Masks can be crafted into Orthon Explosives by Dammon in Act Two while at the Last Light Inn . These masks work well in conjunction with the Tavern Brawler feat. During the Self-Same Trial , any party members wearing the Devilfoil Mask will have their clone wearing a mask as well. These masks will stack with the party's masks as well as their own, causing every party member and their copy to receive the Infernal Legion buff. In this case, the buff can increase Strength by as much as 7, and decrease Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma by the same amount. Regarding Infernal Legion: The Infernal Legion condition is only applied if the mask's wearer is within range other creatures wearing a mask. It gains one stack for each mask within range, not including the wearer themself. It is also not displayed on the mask's tooltip in-game. Infernal Legion grants an uncapped bonus to Strength, but takes effect before other items and bonuses which raise Strength to a capped amount. Sometimes, upon a character level up, the Infernal Legion buff disappears; this can be corrected by unequipping and re-equipping the mask. The Infernal Legion buff disappears if a Druid wearing the mask uses Wild Shape . Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Appearance in game

Coming upon a wise woman, Kushigo got drunk and grew maudlin, and told her about Irishi's scalping. She gave him some clothes - light and fine - and encouraged him to take his time to grieve. He did. Helldusk Helmet is a very rare Headwear . It grants the wearer the ability to see in magical darkness, and they cannot be blinded. They also gain a +2 bonus to saving throws against spells and can use Immolating Gaze to frighten enemies. It is said that Carixim , the fiending titan whose flesh squirms with twenty-thousand trapped souls, forged the pieces of this armour set. Properties Helmets Rarity: Very rare Weight: 1 kg (2 lb) Price: 570 gp UID MAG_Infernal_Metal_Helmet UUID 1c198060-6b6a-41c5-82ce-a3d3c3d76404 Stats MAG_Infernal_Metal_Helmet Special The wearer of this item gains: Attackers can't land Critical Hits on the wearer. Infernal Sight You can see in magical [ See: Bugs ] and ordinary darkness up to a range of 12 m (40 ft). You cannot be Blinded . Magical Durability The wielder has a +2 bonus to Saving Throws against spells. Where to find House of Hope X: -6482 Y: 2939 : In Raphael's Vault across from the entrance to the Boudoir Notes A party member must pass a DC 10 Wisdom Check to activate the Inert Infernal Gem and then a DC 20 Arcana Check to use the Infernal Control Gem to open the door. Each party member has only one chance at each check. The helmet is located in the treasure pile. Regarding Infernal Sight: Infernal Sight prevents all conditions in the Blinded status group, in addition to Blinded . Bugs Regarding Infernal Sight: Infernal Sight does not see through magical darkness and does not provide the cone of light that is otherwise present with the Darkvision effect from a different source, such as the Darkvision spell, an Elixir of Darkvision , or from having the Darkvision passive innately via race . ## Helm of Balduran
- **来源**: [Helm of Balduran](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Helm_of_Balduran)
- **分类**: Helmets

Helm of Balduran is a legendary Headwear once worn by the fabled founder of Baldur's Gate, Balduran , and grants hit points every turn along with stun and critical hit immunities. This helm, worn atop the pate of Balduran the Brave, still gleams as if with the untarnished splendour of his legacy. Baldur's Gate itself bears his name, and tales of his exploits have turned the heads and hearts of many. Properties Helmets Required Proficiency: Medium Armour Rarity: Legendary Weight: 2 kg (4 lb) Price: 760 gp UID MAG_WYRM_OfBalduran_Helmet UUID 0a64283a-1fc4-45cd-9e5e-f463f6b762ea Stats MAG_WYRM_OfBalduran_Helmet Special The wearer of this item gains: Attackers can't land Critical Hits on the wearer. Balduran's Vitality The helmet heals you 2 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points at the beginning of every turn. Balduran's Favour You have a +1 bonus to Armour Class and Saving Throws . Stun Immunity You can't be Stunned . Where to find The Dragon's Sanctum X: 636 Y: -964 : on top of a stone altar next to Ansur Notes When picked up, the following inspiration points are granted: ⁠ Heavy is the Head ( Sage backgrounds) ⁠ Great Helm of Legends ( Soldier backgrounds) Regarding Balduran's Vitality: The healing effect activates only while in combat. The healing effect still triggers even if the wearer has full hit points. Balduran's Vitality pairs well with items and passives that trigger on-heal effects. Particularly: Blessed Healer for an additional 3 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points Boots of Aid and Comfort for an additional 3 temporary hit points Broodmother's Revenge for an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage on weapon attacks Herbalist's Gloves to remove the Poisoned condition Slippery Chain Shirt to automatically Disengage The Reviving Hands for resistance to ⁠ Bludgeoning , ⁠ Piercing , and ⁠ Slashing damage The Whispering Promise for Bless The passive effects of the following items are not triggered by Balduran's Vitality: Cloak of Cunning Brume if the wearer Disengaged as a result of the helm activating Slippery Chain Shirt Ring of Salving Bugs Regarding Stun Immunity: Stun Immunity does not protect against Stunning Gaze (as cast by the Bhaal cultists) but does protect against Mind Blast , Stunning Strike (Melee) , and Stunning Strike (Unarmed) . ## Helmet of Grit
- **来源**: [Helmet of Grit](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Helmet_of_Grit)
- **分类**: Helmets

The Helmet of Grit is a very rare Helmet . It grants the wearer an additional Bonus Action at 50% or lower Hit Points . At the barest touch, you feel a surge of exuberance and stamina - like you could take on anyone and anything. Properties Helmets Required Proficiency: Light Armour Rarity: Very rare Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 360 gp UID MAG_LowHP_BonusAction_Helmet UUID d98595e1-0722-4200-ab73-5e88269519fa Stats MAG_LowHP_BonusAction_Helmet Special The wearer of this item gains: Dexterity Saving Throws +1 Grit When the wearer has 50% Hit Points or less, they have an additional Bonus Action . Where to find Szarr Palace X: -1298 Y: 965 : In a locked opulent chest in the room with the cursed corpse of Victoria Notes Regarding Grit: temporary hit points are included in the calculation of total hit points required to activate Grit, including with the below listed bug. For example, if the wearer has a hit point maximum of 90, Grit activates once their hit points are reduced to 45 or lower. If they are at 45 hit points and then receive 14 temporary hit points, their total hit points are now 59; Grit then deactivates and only reactivates once their total hit points fall to 45 or below once again. The additional Bonus Action granted by this helmet stacks with those from other sources . Bugs Regarding Grit: Rather than only replenishing once per turn, Grit activates each time the wearer's total hit points are reduced to 50% or lower. Thus, it is possible for the wearer to gain multiple additional bonus actions in a turn by being healed above and then reduced again to 50% or less Hit Points .

The Helmet of Smiting is an uncommon Helmet which grants the wearer Temporary Hit Points whenever they apply a Condition using a Smite spell. A set of runes have been expertly worked into the helmet's filigree. Almost imperceptibly - but powerful nonetheless. Properties Helmets Required Proficiency: Medium Armour Rarity: Uncommon Consumable by Gale Weight: 1 kg (2 lb) Price: 115 gp UID MAG_Paladin_SmiteSpellsSupport_Helmet UUID 0ae1e62c-b36a-4dbc-97fb-e0658b454974 Stats MAG_Paladin_SmiteSpellsSupport_Helmet Special The wearer of this item gains: Constitution Saving Throws +1 Bolstering Smite When you apply a condition with one of your Smite spells, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier . Where to find Selûnite Outpost X: 163 Y: -248 : Inside a locked gilded chest south-west of the waypoint Notes Regarding Bolstering Smite: The spells that currently work with Bolstering Smite are: Banishing Smite , Blinding Smite , Branding Smite , Searing Smite , and Wrathful Smite . Bugs Regarding Bolstering Smite: Bolstering Smite does not function with Thunderous Smite or Staggering Smite . Any application of Frightened by the wearer triggers Bolstering Smite. Though not stated in the description, the temporary hit points only last for two turns. The temporary hit points only have a StackPriority of 1, and as such are overridden by any other source of temporary hit points which have a StackPriority of 1 or higher, even if the new source is of a lesser value. ## Mask of the Shapeshifter
- **来源**: [Mask of the Shapeshifter](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Mask_of_the_Shapeshifter)
- **分类**: Helmets

Not to be confused with Shapeshifter Hat Mask of the Shapeshifter is a legendary Mask that allows the wearer to cast Disguise Self at will. The magic of this mask comes from its gory provenance, and makes it perfect for the discerning actor, sleuth, or person with a mirror and time to kill. Properties Helmets Rarity: Legendary Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 1 gp UID MAG_OfTheShapeshifter_Mask UUID 5d66776d-0650-4512-b300-b2ac38e2be3a Special The wearer of this item gains: Disguise Self ( ) Magically change all aspects of your appearance. Where to find In the Traveller's Chest at the Campsite Notes Mask of the Shapeshifter is a reference to the mask of the same name from Divinity: Original Sin II . This item is exclusive to the Digital Deluxe Upgrade , alongside other cosmetic items themed around Divinity: Original Sin II . The ability to cast Disguise Self is useful when engaging characters as a different race or avoiding recognition by someone you killed when using Speak with Dead . As of Patch 5, Hotfix 17, you can gain racial equipment bonuses for longer than intended by using the mask, taking it off, and long resting without removing the disguise. Upon waking up, the disguise is gone, but the racial bonuses remain on your equipment. Note that this only works for racial equipment bonuses, not racial dialogue options.
