## Pyroquickness Hat
- **来源**: [Pyroquickness Hat](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Pyroquickness_Hat)
- **分类**: Helmets

Pyroquickness Hat is a very rare Hat that burns the wearer when casting a Fire spell, but also grants them an extra Bonus Action . Merely holding the circlet makes your skin flush, filling you with determination and righteous fury. Properties Helmets Rarity: Very rare Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 160 gp UID MAG_Fire_BonusActionOnFireSpell_Circlet UUID d5e4dce0-4385-4fae-a601-22a11fe0b2af Stats MAG_Fire_BonusActionOnFireSpell_Circlet Special The wearer of this item gains: Fiery Return When you deal ⁠ Fire damage with a levelled spell, you Burn yourself and gain an additional Bonus Action this round. Where to find Sorcerous Vault X: 411 Y: 997 : In an invisible chest in the vault of Elminster Notes See Invisibility or Faerie Fire can be used to see the invisible chest. The Helldusk Armour or Wet condition can negate the self-burning effect on the wearer while still allowing them to receive the extra bonus action. Regarding Fiery Return: The conditions for activating Fiery Return are to deal fire damage with a non-cantrip spell or a melee spell attack roll. Attacks with a Flame Blade conjured by the druid spell count as melee spell attacks, so they trigger Fiery Return. However, this is not true of a Flame Blade summoned by a mephistopheles tiefling's racial feature or a permanent Flame Blade acquired through the exploit described here . The Daredevil Gloves can turn ranged spell attacks into melee spell attacks, so cantrips like Fire Bolt can trigger Fiery Return when paired with the gloves. Bugs Regarding Fiery Return: If Fiery Return is triggered with a Bonus Action (for example, with Metamagic: Quickened Spell ), the extra bonus action granted by this passive is wasted and consumed immediately. Hellcrawler , a class action granted by the Helldusk Boots , triggers Fiery Return, essentially negating the bonus action cost. Searing Smite does not trigger Fiery Return. Sarevok's Horned Helmet is a very rare Headwear that grants Darkvision to its wearer and increases critical hit chance. You also cannot be Frightened . The last sight Sarevok witnessed as a mortal was his sibling's knife. This duel, the first between Bhaalspawn, is worshipped still by the cult of Bhaal , who now believe that no act is more sacred than fratricide between spawn before the altar of their Dread Lord. Properties Helmets Required Proficiency: Medium Armour Rarity: Very rare Weight: 2 kg (4 lb) Price: 1600 gp UID UNI_ARM_Sarevok_Horned_Helmet UUID 139b28dc-7db0-40b2-a383-3a4ce4c09812 Stats UNI_ARM_Sarevok_Horned_Helmet Special The wearer of this item gains: Deathbringer's Sight You can see in the dark up to 3 m (10 ft). The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by one. This effect can stack. Dauntless You can't be Frightened or afflicted with other emotion-altering conditions. Where to find Murder Tribunal X: -1248 Y: 503 : Carried by Sarevok Anchev Notes Regarding Dauntless: Dauntless prevents any condition in the Frightened or Fleeing status groups, as well as Hideous Laughter . Bugs Regarding Deathbringer's Sight: The in-game description claims that this can boost regular Darkvision from 12 m (40 ft) to 15 m (50 ft). This is not the case. The stated Darkvision range of 3 m (10 ft) is incorrect. The DarkvisionRange(3) boost from this passive adds to the MinimumDetectionRange value of 2 found on all characters, effectively providing a Darkvision range of 5 m (17 ft). Every adventuring party has at least one 'chaotic element'. In the case of one such party, this was the infamous Scabby, a barbarous goblin who was trained by monks. Properties Helmets Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 120 gp / 500 gp H Honour UID MAG_BarbMonk_Leather_Circlet UUID 48920bf4-85b0-44a1-9f6a-0ad8b493fa47 Stats MAG_BarbMonk_Leather_Circlet Special The wearer of this item gains: Martial Bravery Your weapon and unarmed attacks deal an additional 2 damage while surrounded by 2 or more foes. Bugs Regarding Martial Bravery: Due to faulty exclusionary check within the HasEnemyWithinRange() conditional script, Martial Bravery still functions with nearby unconscious and incapacitated enemies as long as there is at least one conscious enemy nearby (alive and not incapacitated). Despite the description, two or more enemies must be within 3 m (10 ft) of the target , not the wearer of the circlet. This means the wearer does not need to be "surrounded" at all; they need enemies near the target of their attack.

The Warped Headband of Intellect is an uncommon Circlet that raises the wearer's Intelligence to 17. This particular circlet is covered in yellow slime and has pieces of half-digested mutton stuck behind the gems. Properties Helmets Rarity: Uncommon Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 250 gp UID UNI_FOR_OgresForHire_HeadbandOfIntellect UUID 8f4876f1-44d9-4bb8-802e-907c6b0a0dba Stats FOR_OgresForHire_HeadbandOfIntellect Special The wearer of this item gains: Set the wearer's Intelligence score to 17. The enchantment has no effect if their Intelligence score is higher without it. Where to find Blighted Village X: 13 Y: 366 : Carried by Lump the Enlightened Notes This item originally provided the same effect as a regular D&D Headband of Intellect , setting Intelligence to 19; it was decreased to 17 to reduce its power during Early Access . This item is not worn by Lump , he carries it in his gut, which (although not stated in game) both explains and gives better context to its in-game description. Most effective on characters who need Intelligence as a secondary ability score and also have several other needed ability scores, such as Eldritch Knight Fighters and Arcane Trickster Rogues . If Wizards use this item to to prepare more spells than they are normally able to, those spells stay prepared even after taking it off. If convinced to fight for the party, Lump can be called and looted later within Act One . External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Headband of intellect on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

## Whispering Mask
- **来源**: [Whispering Mask](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Whispering_Mask)
- **分类**: Helmets

Whispering Mask is a common Helmet with connections to Auntie Ethel . Soft, unintelligible whispers seep from the dark wood, ringing in your ears and resounding in your skull. Properties Helmets Rarity: Common Weight: 0.5 kg (1 lb) Price: 1 gp UID DEC_HAG_Mask_A UUID 73690248-deea-4713-84d6-c1c8fb045869 Stats ACT1_HAG_HagMask File ARM_Headwear_Hag_Mask Special The wearer of this item gains: If Ethel is dead: Uncanny Sight Part of the Flock Auntie Ethel welcomes you, dearie. Condition: Uncanny Sight Uncanny Sight Can see objects hidden to the unaided eye. Where to find Riverside Teahouse : 4x – on a table in the Overgrown Tunnel Entrance Gallery , just before the Gnarled Door Riverside Teahouse : Worn by Mask of Vengeance , Mask of Servitude , Mask of Regret , and Mask of Terror , the thralls located in the Overgrown Tunnel Lower City : Worn by Mask of Vengeance , Mask of Servitude , Mask of Terror , and Captain Grisly , the thralls located in the Blushing Mermaid Notes Removing a Whispering Mask from an unconscious hag victim kills them if the hag is still alive. While Auntie Ethel is alive, the wearer of this mask must make a Wisdom Saving Throw every turn. If failed, they become a Hag's Pawn (controlled by Auntie Ethel) and attack the party; if all party members equip the masks and become Hag's Pawns, a Game Over screen appears. If all unaffected party members run away from combat (e.g., back to the Tea House), leaving no one to attack, the remaining mask-affected party member can unequip the mask after making a Wisdom saving throw. The negative effects of this mask can be prevented by casting Protection from Evil and Good before equipping it. In this case, the poison gas clouds in Ethel's lair temporarily dissipate for the wearer, and the thralls wearing these masks (e.g. Mask of Vengeance) will not attack the wearer. While in this protected state, the wearer still rolls saving throws against Ephemeral Whispers , but failing them has no effect. If Auntie Ethel is dead, the mask can be worn with no ill effects. If equipped by a Paladin when inside the tunnel, a dialogue with Ethel starts where a DC 15 Charisma Check is needed to prevent succumbing to the mask. Succeeding grants the Voice of Reason condition. Succumbing to Auntie Ethel's will due to wearing a Whispering Mask is an oathbreaking action for Paladins of Devotion , Paladins of the Ancients and Paladins of Vengeance .

## Band of the Mystic Scoundrel
- **来源**: [Band of the Mystic Scoundrel](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Band_of_the_Mystic_Scoundrel)
- **分类**: Rings

Band of the Mystic Scoundrel is a rare Ring that grants the wearer the ability to cast illusion or enchantment spells as a bonus action after hitting a creature with a weapon attack. What better way to disguise one's transgressions than a quickly positioned phantasm after the deed is done? Properties Rings Rarity: Rare Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 190 gp UID MAG_ArcaneTrickster_Ring UUID 5b74c9d8-cb88-4a29-99c4-25d98c7d88f7 Stats MAG_ArcaneTrickster_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Illusion Quickening After hitting a creature with a weapon attack, you can cast illusion or enchantment spells as a Bonus Action . Where to find Jungle X: -1566 Y: -1522 : In a backpack Notes Regarding Illusion Quickening: A character with Quickening Incantation condition cannot cast illusion or enchantment spells that turn as an action anymore, only as a bonus action. Spells from other schools of magic may still be cast using their regular costs. The Quickening Incantation loses duration at the start of the turn, so an Opportunity Attack does not give a character this condition for their next turn. Illusion Quickening also works for illusion or enchantment spell scrolls, including Disguise Kit which effectively counts as a Disguise Self scroll. Bugs Regarding Illusion Quickening: Any weapon attack triggers Illusion Quickening, even against world items.

The Bracing Band is an uncommon Ring which makes the wearer more difficult to hit after they shove an enemy. A common ring, simple and unadorned. Though there is a certain heft to it... Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp UID MAG_Shove_ACboost_Ring UUID c714fc94-eeaf-4622-9375-545261867514 Stats MAG_Shove_ACboost_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Personal Space After shoving an enemy [ See Notes ] , the wearer gains a +1 to their Armour Class until their next turn. Where to find Grymforge X: -628 Y: 320 : Rewarded by Sergeant Thrinn after returning her boots in the quest Find the Missing Boots Notes This is one of two possible rewards for Find the Missing Boots , the other being Armour of Uninhibited Kushigo . Regarding Personal Space: The effect is capped at 1 stack; pushing more than one enemy during the same turn does not grant additional benefits. The effect triggers when pushing an enemy in any manner, not just with Shove . For example, hitting an enemy with Repelling Blast also provides the +1 AC. This effect is also triggered by: Thorn Whip (and the Sorrowful Lash variety) Mobile Flourish (Ranged) and Mobile Flourish (Melee) Flurry of Blows: Push Bull Rush Arrow of Roaring Thunder And any other action that pushes or pulls

## Callous Glow Ring
- **来源**: [Callous Glow Ring](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Callous_Glow_Ring)
- **分类**: Rings

Callous Glow Ring is an uncommon Ring that causes the wearer to deal an additional 2 Radiant damage to illuminated creatures every time they deal damage. A grudging gleam emits from this ring - more an indictment of light than an endorsement. Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp UID MAG_Radiant_DamageBonusOnIlluminatedTarget_Ring UUID afdcde80-f976-4781-86be-75a5fb0ae05e Stats MAG_Radiant_DamageBonusOnIlluminatedTarget_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Callous Glow The wearer deals an additional 2 points of ⁠ Radiant [ See: Bugs ] damage against creatures that are illuminated. Where to find Gauntlet of Shar X: -821 Y: -752 : In an opulent chest in the vault room near Balthazar Notes This ring has synergy in conjunction with the Coruscation Ring , which applies Radiating Orb on targets hit by a wearer whom is illuminated. This means a caster standing in light will apply Radiating Orb to their target(s), which in turn will be illuminated - and thus receive 2 points of Radiant damage. Regarding Callous Glow: The effect requires the target to be standing in a light level of Clear Area . Actions and spells that deals multiple instances of damage, like Flurry of Blows , Magic Missile , or Scorching Ray will apply the additional damage for every instance. The 2 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant damage is added to almost all damage sources originating from the wearer. Examples include Phalar Aluve: Shriek , Void Bulb , Electrified Water , self-damage from Psionic Overload . Bugs Regarding Callous Glow: The ingame tooltip does not specify the damage type, but it is ⁠ Radiant .

## Coruscation Ring

Coruscation Ring is an uncommon ring that inflicts Radiating Orb on creatures that the wearer deals spell damage to. The wearer must be illuminated for this effect to occur. Provocative light blooms from the engraved contours of this ring. Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp UID MAG_Radiant_RadiatingOrb_Ring UUID 3bd041cf-bff5-4464-9002-5c17b957b3c7 Stats MAG_Radiant_RadiatingOrb_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Arcane Radiance When the wearer deals spell damage while illuminated by a light source, they also inflict Radiating Orb upon the target for 2 turns. Where to find Last Light Inn - Cellar X: 44 Y: -734 : In a trapped heavy chest in the cellar of the Last Light Inn Notes The chest is in a secret area, which is reached by going through a set of Double Oak Doors that are blocked by a destructible spiderweb and a pile of crates. The room beyond has a Cracked Wall, which, if broken, grants access to the cavernous area guarded by a pack of Meenlocks . In its far corner behind another door stands the chest. Alternatively, the chest can also be reached by going through the cell next to the Evidence Chest. Its left wall can be broken to gain entry into another room with a door that opens to the area with the chest. The chest can be disarmed with a DC 10 Sleight of Hand Check and unlocked with a DC 14 Sleight of Hand Check . This item pairs well with the Callous Glow Ring . Regarding Arcane Radiance: Multi-target spells like Eldritch Blast , Magic Missile , and Scorching Ray apply the effect numerous times. Booming Blade is treated as spell damage and thus inflicts Radiating Orb . Bugs Regarding Arcane Radiance: Arcane Radiance inflicts Radiating Orb regardless of the wearer's light level.

Eversight Ring is an uncommon Ring that imparts immunity to Blindness upon the wearer. One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Paranoid by nature, Duerra had erected a vast array of biting, blasting, blinding traps and safeguards to keep her enemies from gaining her sanctum. Of course, this also meant her children were sealed in with her by those same deadly measures. Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp UID MAG_Shadow_BlindImmunity_Ring UUID 0661eb9b-0924-450d-923b-1e371de444ae Stats MAG_Shadow_BlindImmunity_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Blind Immunity The wearer cannot be Blinded . Bugs If a hireling is dismissed with the Eversight Ring equipped, then they are later resummoned, the ring will have turned into a nonmagical version of itself. This is due to the item template not including the ring's Stats entry. Regarding Blind Immunity: Despite not stating such in the description, Blind Immunity also allows the wearer to see through magical darkness.

## Killer's Sweetheart
- **来源**: [Killer's Sweetheart](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Killer's_Sweetheart)
- **分类**: Rings

Killer's Sweetheart is a very rare Ring that makes the wearer's next Attack Roll a critical hit after killing a creature, once per Long Rest. Though the ring is highly polished, darkened slivers of blood still cling to small scrapes and corners. Properties Rings Rarity: Very rare Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 140 gp UID MAG_Critical_CriticalExecution_Ring UUID 2f2d4bf3-6a14-43f5-81fe-e14aa9871215 Stats MAG_Critical_CriticalExecution_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Executioner When you kill a creature, your next Attack Roll will be a Critical Hit . Once spent, this effect refreshes after a Long Rest . Where to find Gauntlet of Shar X: -833 Y: -729 : On the ground where the shadow copy appearing next to the Brazier is defeated in the Self-Same Trial Notes Regarding Executioner: After a creature is killed, the Executioner critical hit can be set to 'Ask' or disabled entirely in the Reactions tab , allowing it to be saved for later. Using it does not consume a Reaction resource . The automatic critical hit from Executioner can be applied to every target hit by a single AOE attack, such as Whirlwind Attack or Razor Gale . Bugs Regarding Executioner: Despite the tooltip suggesting otherwise, Executioner only applies to weapon attack rolls. When using weapon specific abilities that impose a saving throw such as Pushing Attack (Melee) and Lacerate , Executioner attempts to apply its 'Natural 20' effect to the enemy's saving throw as well as the character's attack. This creates a risk of wasting the Executioner condition to help the enemy. If the Executioner reaction is set to 'Automatic': the game forces the character's attack roll to a 20 (a Critical Hit) but also forces the target’s Saving Throw to a 20. This grants the enemy a high probability of resisting the secondary effect (e.g., they take the damage but are not pushed). If the Executioner reaction is set to 'Ask': The game triggers two separate prompts: First Prompt : asks to turn the character's attack roll into a 20. (Recommend: Yes ) Second Prompt: asks to turn the enemy's Saving Throw into a 20. (Recommend: No ) If the character accepts the second prompt, the Executioner condition is consumed, and the enemy receives a large bonus to their save. Note: While Saving Throws do not technically 'critically succeed' on a 20, the high roll often results in the enemy resisting the effect. Wasted Charges : due to a scripting error, Executioner fails to check if the attacking character has already rolled a Natural 20 normally. If the character lands a critical hit on their own, the reaction can still trigger (and be consumed) if they either accept the reaction prompt or have it set to 'Automatic'.

## Ring of Elemental Infusion
- **来源**: [Ring of Elemental Infusion](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Ring_of_Elemental_Infusion)
- **分类**: Rings

The Ring of Elemental Infusion is an uncommon Ring that infuses your weapon with the element of your spells or cantrips, dealing additional damage. The mysterious gem set in this ring seems to change hues whenever you aren't looking. Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp UID MAG_ElementalGish_ElementalInfusion_Ring UUID 9ce563ca-82b0-4c28-bd82-8640fd0a5be3 Stats MAG_ElementalGish_ElementalInfusion_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Elemental Infusion When you deal ⁠ Acid , ⁠ Cold , ⁠ Fire , ⁠ Lightning , or ⁠ Thunder damage using a Spell or a Cantrip , that element infuses your weapon. Until the end of your next turn, you deal an additional 1d4 damage of that element on your first successful weapon attack. Where to find Crèche Y'llek X: 1303 Y: -798 : Worn by Gish Umr'a'ac in the southern section of the Infirmary Notes Regarding Elemental Infusion: Elemental Infusion can apply its damage bonus multiple times to a single weapon attack. The individual elemental damage boost conditions all share the same StackID with each other, meaning only one may be active on a character at a time. However, the conditions also use a StackType of Overwrite , meaning the last condition applied from the passive is the condition that will actually affect the wearer's next weapon attack. Due to the way the passive is written, this causes a priority effect where the conditions follow this order of priority (with the later conditions overwriting the earlier conditions): Acid Infusion < Cold Infusion < Fire Infusion < Lightning Infusion < Thunder Infusion This means that if a character attacks an enemy with a spell that deals primarily Fire damage, but is also dealing bonus Thunder damage, the character will be left with Thunder Infusion.

Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp UID MAG_Psychic_MentalOverload_Ring UUID 70893b6f-b0de-4f4e-af9f-f10e2c09bd1e Stats MAG_Psychic_MentalOverload_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Mental Inhibition When a foe fails a Saving Throw against one of your spells or actions, they gain Mental Fatigue for 2 turns. A hymn to Eilistraee is inscribed along the inside of this ring, which is surprisingly heavy when worn. Notes This ring was only available in Early Access. It was sold by Omeluum in the Myconid Colony after completing his quest Help Omeluum investigate the parasite . In the Release Version, it was replaced by the Ring of Salving , though its 'gravity-themed' flavour text was retained.

## Ring of Spiteful Thunder
- **来源**: [Ring of Spiteful Thunder](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Ring_of_Spiteful_Thunder)
- **分类**: Rings

The Ring of Spiteful Thunder is a uncommon Ring that may Daze Reverberating creatures upon which the wearer deals ⁠ Thunder damage. When you slip this ring on your hand and flex your fingers, a boom of discontented thunder grumbles in the air around you. Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp / 210 gp H Honour UID MAG_Thunder_InflictDazeOnThunderDamage_Ring UUID 5c05ff73-9d0d-4d58-b93a-e4b448a1e388 Stats MAG_Thunder_InflictDazeOnThunderDamage_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Spiteful Thunder When the wearer deals damage [ See: Bugs ] to a Reverberating creature, it becomes Dazed unless it succeeds a Constitution Saving Throw . Condition: Dazed Dazed Duration: 2 turns CON Save ( DC  13) Has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws , can't take Reactions , and loses the Dexterity bonus to their Armour Class . Removed if an ally Helps this creature. Where to find Moonrise Towers X: -174 Y: -179 : Sold by Roah Moonglow on the main floor Notes This ring pairs well with conditions which inflict disadvantage on constitution saving throws (e.g., Bleeding ), and items which inflict reverberation (e.g., Boots of Stormy Clamour ). Regarding Spiteful Thunder: Spiteful Thunder can be used to inflict Dazed every turn with minimal effort. Dazed makes it more difficult for enemies to save against certain spells like Tasha's Hideous Laughter . This can be very helpful against boss enemies with Legendary Resistance and Magic Resistance . The saving throw is hidden and not shown in the combat log. Bugs If a hireling is dismissed with the Ring of Spiteful Thunder equipped, then they are later resummoned, the ring will have turned into a nonmagical version of itself. This is due to the item template not including the ring's Stats entry. Regarding Spiteful Thunder: Spiteful Thunder requires targets affected by Reverberation to make a save upon receiving any type of damage from the wearer, not just ⁠ Thunder .

## Shadow Blade Ring
- **来源**: [Shadow Blade Ring](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shadow_Blade_Ring)
- **分类**: Rings

Shadow Blade Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants its wearer the ability to cast Shadow Blade . It is a reward for completing the quest Find Arabella's Parents . One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. Long ago in a foreboding realm called Hammergrim, Deep Duerra, daughter of the dour god Laduguer, sired a great many heirs to her twisted corundum throne. Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 105 gp UID MAG_Shadow_ShadowBlade_Ring UUID 8cc165d7-0372-4f4b-b4ac-f424f4069af1 Stats MAG_Shadow_ShadowBlade_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Shadow Blade ( ) Cast as a level 2 spell ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Campsite (Act Two) : Rewarded by Arabella for completing the quest Find Arabella's Parents Notes As of Patch 8: The spell does not require concentration anymore and the conjured blade lasts until long rest. As a result, the ring can produce multiple shadow blades - one per each short rest. The ring can be unequipped after summoning the shadow blade. The ring's shadow blade can be summoned and equipped in addition to one summoned using spell slots. Bugs Unequipping this ring will break the character's current Concentration spell so long as the shadow blade is currently summoned. Due to a miscoded SummonInInventory functor, the ring's shadow blade can be transferred between characters and equipped by anyone in the party, and previously conjured blades do not disappear from the caster's inventory upon a new spell casting.

## Shapeshifter's Boon Ring
- **来源**: [Shapeshifter's Boon Ring](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shapeshifter's_Boon_Ring)
- **分类**: Rings

Shapeshifter's Boon Ring is an uncommon Ring that grants the wearer +1d4 on all checks made while shapeshifted or disguised . 'I'm a talented shapeshifter too. I can shapeshift a thin body into a fat body. All I need is a steady supply of mince pies and mulled wine.' - Overheard in a tavern in Daggerford Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 70 gp UID MAG_ShapeshiftersBurgeon_Ring UUID 6853e585-e9c7-4f26-918e-995342b19d1a Stats MAG_ShapeshiftersBurgeon_Ring Special The wearer of this item gains: Shapeshifter's Boon While shapeshifting or disguising yourself, gain a +1d4 bonus to all Ability Checks . Where to find Emerald Grove X: 217 Y: 540 : Carried by the Strange Ox in the Druid Grove Last Light Inn X: -28 Y: 170 : Carried by the Strange Ox at Dammon's blacksmith Rivington X: 39 Y: -149 : Reward for completing Help the Devilish Ox or looted from Strange Ox Notes This ring is one of few pieces of equipment that works while under the effect of wild shape . Note that it works with a Circle of Stars Druid's Starry Form , but not with a Circle of Spores Druid's Symbiotic Entity . Two ways among many to trade for this item are: Have the player character stand next to the entrance to the Tiefling Hideout and use a ranged attack, then immediately enter the hideout; upon climbing back up the ladder, the attacker will be able to speak with the Ox and trade to "...smooth things over". Have the attacking character flee via stealth and / or invisibility . The Mark of the Shifter condition is only applied during transformation and lasts until Long Rest ; it will not be applied if this ring is put on after the wearer has already shapeshifted. Shapeshifter's Boon does not take effect if the party member is shape changed via a Seeming spell cast by a different party member. However, the targeted party member can then gain this effect by casting Adjust Seeming themselves and picking a different appearance. Bugs After application of Mark of the Shifter , the wearer can unequip this ring for others to use without losing the condition.

- **来源**: [Tarnished Ring](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Tarnished_Ring)
- **分类**: Rings

The Tarnished Ring is a common Ring belonging to Derryth Bonecloak . A cheap ring marred by rust and a thin patina of neglect. Properties Rings Rarity: Common Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp UID S_UND_MushroomHunter_WeddingRing UUID 5e309a15-0f33-4343-b0f5-e98ff71219fc Where to find Carried by Derryth Bonecloak Notes If the party offer Noblestalk to Derryth Bonecloak , she initially claims to have no reward to offer. She can be given it regardless. A DC 10 Intimidation check results in her handing over her wedding ring which is the Tarnished Ring. Variant The Tarnished Ring is a common Ring belonging to Doozy the Dunce . A cheap ring marred by rust and a thin patina of neglect. Properties Rings Rarity: Common Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp UID S_LOW_Giuldhall_Member_005_Ring UUID 75a0d606-00de-4324-9bed-091310d643ed Where to find In the pit in the Guildhall at X: -23 Y: 741 Notes This ring can also be looted from Dairow Vin . Variant The Tarnished Ring is an uncommon Ring created by combining the Gemless Ring with the Ringless Gem . It can be sold to Traders for a bit of gold. A cheap ring marred by rust and a thin patina of neglect. Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp UID QUEST_WYR_RestoredMagicRing UUID 9030e638-b086-4e0d-aeb9-365b03470679 Stats QUEST_WYR_RestoredMagicRing Where to find Rivington : Created by combining (a right click option to 'combine' appears once both are collected and in the same party member's inventory): Gemless Ring - looted from the Refugee Corpse on the cliffs of northeastern Rivington at X: 46 Y: 66 Ringless Gem - sold by Ferg Drogher in the Rivington refugee camp at X: 45 Y: -98 Notes This item currently serves no purpose other than to be sold to Traders for a bit of extra gold. Lae'zel may comment on the potential of the ring when both pieces are found: "Hm - the other part of that ring. Once repaired, it could be useful." Karlach will comment: "Hey, I recognise this. Fits with the other part of that shattered ring. Progress!" Astarion will mention: "This looks familiar - the missing part from that ring. You will look lovely once you're fixed." Bugs The game code shows that this ring should be named "Magic Ring" with the description "Considered sacred by some gnomes and halflings, the gem set in this ring sparkles brilliantly." due to its Item Template . However, when the game spawns items created via Item Combination it uses the Stats of the item, which pulls data from the Parent Template field instead of the Item Template , which in this case is LOOT_GEN_Ring_A_Simple_Gold and thus why this ring appears with the name and description that it has.

## The Whispering Promise
- **来源**: [The Whispering Promise](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/The_Whispering_Promise)
- **分类**: Rings

The Whispering Promise is an uncommon Ring that grants a bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws to creatures healed by the wearer. A soft, soothing voice floats from this ring, reciting a prayer over and over. Properties Rings Rarity: Uncommon Consumable by Gale Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb) Price: 40 gp / 85 gp H Honour UID UNI_MassHealRing UUID 4aef9bb0-38a8-428e-8b87-6e462d612dd6 Stats UNI_MassHealRing Special The wearer of this item gains: Blessed Mercy When you heal a creature, it gains a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws for 2 turns. Where to find Goblin Camp X: -99 Y: 424 : Sold by Grat the Trader Sacred Pool X: 260 Y: 510 : Sold by Volo Camp : Sold by Volo Notes Volo does not trade via dialogue at the Sacred Pool. One must click the trade button in the lower left while speaking with him to do so. The ring can also be stolen. This ring can only be bought or stolen from Grat if it was not previously acquired from Volo. It is the same ring, confiscated from Volo when he is captured. If Volo is rescued and joins the party's camp, he sells the ring there if it was not previously acquired from him or Grat. Additionally, Grat no longer sells the ring after Volo leaves the Goblin Camp, even if Volo later dies or leaves the party's camp. Regarding Blessed Mercy: Applies the same condition as the standard Bless spell, and therefore cannot stack with it. Despite also being called Bless , this buff is not enhanced by the Staff of Arcane Blessing . Multi-target healing abilities, such as Mass Healing Word or a thrown Potion of Healing , bless all affected creatures (potentially including the caster). Drinking a Potion of Healing counts as healing oneself and triggers the effect of the ring as well. The Bless effect is applied even if the target being healed is already at full health. Healing effects from the Ring of Regeneration , Helm of Balduran , or taking a Short Rest all count as healing oneself and trigger the effect of the ring as well. The self-healing from Life Domain Cleric's Blessed Healer does not trigger the effect. Gaining temporary hit points does not count as healing and therefore does not trigger the effect. External Links [ edit section | visual editor ] Whispering Promise on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

Abdel's Trusted Shield is a very rare Shield that allows the wearer to cast Protection from Missiles once per Short Rest , as well as use Shield Bash . Attached to this shield is a faded note. 'G, I've found the best defence against an arrow is to be the one behind the bow - but this shield also does the trick in a pinch. Yours, AA' Properties +2 Armour Class Shields Required Proficiency: Shields Rarity: Very rare Weight: 2.7 kg (5.4 lb) Price: 570 gp UID MAG_MissileProtection_Shield UUID e308d17c-7278-44c1-b1fc-853ea3cf5c29 Stats MAG_MissileProtection_Shield Special The wearer of this item gains: Shield Blow ( ) When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to knock it   Prone , unless they succeed a Strength saving throw . Protection from Missiles ( ) Amplify your reflexes to better contend with incoming missiles. Ranged weapon attacks against you have Disadvantage , and their damage is halved. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Golbraith's Cellar X: -148 Y: -60 : Given by Golbraith on the first floor of his home Notes Golbraith must be convinced of the party's courage against Mind Flayers . Apparently, Golbraith was a friend of Abdel Adrian , the canonical identity of Gorion's Ward, the main character of the previous installments of the Baldur's Gate series. Some details about this can be read about in the book Confidant of a Duke found on a bookshelf beside Golbraith. However, neither Golbraith nor this shield appear in any previous games. Golbraith is loosely based on a fan of Baldur's Gate 3 , who had been diagnosed with Alzheimer's.

Properties +2 Armour Class Shields Required Proficiency: Shields Rarity: Very rare Weight: 2.7 kg (5.4 lb) Price: 570 gp UID MAG_OB_Paladin_DeathKnight_Shield UUID b3571443-403b-431b-b4ba-3d943a500f4b Stats MAG_OB_Paladin_DeathKnight_Shield Special The wearer of this item gains: Shield Blow ( ) When a foe hits you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to knock it   Prone , unless they succeed a Strength saving throw . Where to find Murder Tribunal X: -1293 Y: 503 : Carried by the death knight That Which Guards Bugs Regarding Dreadful Hewer: Despite misleading tooltips, Dreadful Hewer provides Disadvantage on target's Saving Throws for many effects applying Fearful or Frightened conditions. The passive affects Wrathful Smite , Fear , Menacing Attack (Melee) (and its variants), Dissonant Whispers , Dreadful Aspect , Fey Presence: Disturbing , and Ray of Fear . The passive does not affect Mortal Reminder , Intimidating Presence , Eyebite: Panicked , Blood-Curdling Emission , Command: Flee , Bolt of Celestial Light , and Immolating Gaze . The passive also provides Disadvantage against some non-expected abilities, namely Fey Presence: Beguiling . Regarding Additional Spell Slot: Additional Spell Slot can grant an extra spell slot once per character per long rest, despite the Spell Slot Depleted condition on the item. Additional Spell Slot can grant an extra spell slot multiple times to the same character if that spell slot is used to create a Sorcery Point . ## Arcane Absorption Dagger
- **来源**: [Arcane Absorption Dagger](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Arcane_Absorption_Dagger)

This article is about content that is inaccessible through normal gameplay . It can still be accessed via in-game exploits or third party tools. Arcane Absorption Dagger is a very rare, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Daggers family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile. The leather grip of this knife is decorated with jugs. As you turn it, you can see that the jug begins empty and fills. It's only when you reach the final image that you can see a man's severed head over the jug, filling it with beads of blood. ## Belm
- **来源**: [Belm](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Belm)
- **分类**: Weapons、Scimitars

Belm is a very rare +2 Scimitar . It grants the Whirlwind Attack and Perfectly Balanced Strike weapon actions. Faded but still legible, the mark of a Kara-Turan forgemaster adorns the pommel of this exquisite sword. Light as a robin's wing, quick as a gnomish wit, this weapon has unseamed many foes - and will continue to, in the correct hands. Properties Damage 1d6 + 2 (3~8) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Scimitars Rarity: Very rare Enchantment: + 2 One-Handed Finesse Light Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.35 kg (2.7 lb) Price: 480 gp UID MAG_PHB_OfSpeed_Scimitar UUID d60524f4-583e-4b16-91b2-871221d441cf Stats MAG_PHB_OfSpeed_Scimitar Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Flourish ( ) Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Perfectly Balanced Strike ( ) Send Belm snaking out with an adder's speed, the very exemplar of swiftness embodied in steel. ( Recharge: Per turn.) Whirlwind Attack ( ) Strike out at all nearby foes, making separate Attack Rolls against each target. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Elerrathin's Home X: -210 Y: -50 : in an opulent chest in the basement Notes The chest containing this weapon is in a room behind a locked ( DC 18 Sleight of Hand Check ) bookcase. This weapon was originally found in Baldur's Gate 2 , and is considered one of the best weapons in that game, as it allows the wielder to make one more attack with the weapon held in the main-hand per round. Regarding Perfectly Balanced Strike: Perfectly Balanced Strike is a variation of Dueller's Enthusiasm , allowing the wielder to make an "offhand-like" attack with Belm while it is in their main hand. The difference is that there are no restrictions on Belm's variation – shields and offhand weapons do not disable the weapon action. When Belm is equipped in the offhand , Perfectly Balanced Strike functions as an additional main-hand weapon attack. This attack uses all the stats and on-hit effects of the equipped main-hand weapon, including adding the wielder's ability modifier to the damage without the need of Two-Weapon Fighting . This effect mimics how additional attacks worked in Baldur's Gate 1 and 2 which used AD&D (i.e., 2e) rules. Regarding Whirlwind Attack (Weapon Action): Other than the once-per-Short Rest recharge time, this action is equivalent to the Hunter version . Refer there for more detailed notes. Where to find Carried by Corsair Greymon while the party first travel on Gekh's raft across the lake to Grymforge Sold by Corsair Greymon at Grymforge at X: -120 Y: -95 after the party sail there for the first time Notes If he is not shoved off the party's raft, Greymon sells this item at his trader spot in the Duergar encampment. If he drowns after turning hostile on the raft, his body washes up on the beach near the southern pier at the Decrepit Village , from which this weapon can be looted. The Bow of the Banshee is also found in Baldur's Gate: Siege of Dragonspear . The description of the items are similar; they can both inflict a fear effect and deal extra damage to targets under that effect. Regarding Blood-Curdling Emission: Blood-Curdling Emission grants different effects depending on how the wielder attacks: Attacks made with the shortbow have a chance to inflict Frightened . All weapon attacks (not just from the shortbow itself) against Frightened creatures gain +1d4 to damage rolls. All attacks (including unarmed and spell attacks) against Frightened creatures gain +1d4 to attack rolls. The Frightened condition is not actually applied by the passive feature, but by the Bow of the Banshee itself. Bugs Pushing Greymon off the party's raft via the Athletics dialogue option during the initial cutscene results in his loot being permanently lost, as his body does not wash ashore. To guarantee this item and the rest of his gear is recoverable, it is recommended to initiate combat and shove him into the water manually during the ship-to-ship battle. Regarding Blood-Curdling Emission: The combat log erroneously references the spell save DC of the wielder; it still uses the fixed DC of 12. This ability is not affected by effects providing advantage or disadvantage on saving throws against being Frightened , such as Countercharm or Shield of the Undevout .

This article is about content that is inaccessible through normal gameplay . It can still be accessed via in-game exploits or third party tools. Combination Axe is a rare, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Battleaxes family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage. The intricate engravings on this axe's blade and handle make plain the skill of its smith. Properties One-handed damage 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Two-handed damage 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Battleaxes Rarity: Rare Enchantment: + 1 Versatile Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 310 gp UID MAG_Critical_CriticalCombo_BattleAxe UUID 35465a58-d21d-46b4-a429-64d187b0781f Special The holder of this item gains: Critical Virtuoso When you score a Critical Hit you can spend a Bonus Action to make an additional attack. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Cleave ( ) Swing your weapon in a large arc to attack up to 3 enemies at once. They each take half the damage your weapon usually deals. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Maiming Strike ( ) Possibly Maims your target. They can't move. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Press the Advantage ( ) After scoring a critical hit , use your Bonus Action to make an additional attack. Notes Regarding Press the Advantage: This weapon action requires and consumes the Critical Hit! condition which is applied for 1 turn by landing a critical hit with the Combination Axe.
## Comeback Handaxe
- **来源**: [Comeback Handaxe](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Comeback_Handaxe)
- **分类**: Weapons

Comeback Handaxe is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Handaxes family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile. This loyal axe always returns to its owner after being thrown. However, it has no eyes and therefore dreadful aim, inevitably returning to its thrower blade-end-first. Properties Damage 1d6 + 1 (2~7) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Handaxes Rarity: Uncommon Enchantment: + 1 One-Handed Light Thrown Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Price: 1 gp UID UNI_WYR_Circus_HandaxeReturning UUID 82999790-f80d-47f7-9383-9bb6cf57a10b Stats WYR_Circus_HandaxeReturning Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Circus of the Last Days X: -68 Y: -73 : Given as a consolation prize by Akabi after failing to win the jackpot at the Wheel of Fortune Notes True to its name, the axe has a hidden Homing Weapon feature but also hits the thrower on its way back, dealing only the base 1d6 + 1 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. The return damage can be avoided if the return trajectory is blocked by the environment, such as trees or pillars. The handaxe still returns to the thrower. Arguably more useful than it appears at first glance, unlike other homing weapons, this axe does not equip itself after being Thrown , instead returning to inventory. It also does not suffer from the combat initiation bug , making it a solid candidate for Tavern Brawlers to start fights with if not already in turn-based combat mode.
## Corellon's Grace
- **来源**: [Corellon's Grace](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Corellon's_Grace)
- **分类**: Weapons、Quarterstaves

Corellon's Grace is an uncommon Quarterstaff that increases the wielder's Saving Throws if the wielder is not wearing any armour. They also gain a bonus to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls if attacking while unarmed. This light, flexible staff is of elven make, marked with mithral sigils that channel magic in the blink of an eye. Properties One-handed damage 1d6 (1~6) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d8 (1~8) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Quarterstaves Rarity: Uncommon Enchantment: None Versatile Dippable Consumable by Gale Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 100 gp UID UNI_RepeatStaff UUID 48b4f49b-2937-4664-ac87-7db2c64d09c9 Stats UNI_RepeatStaff Special The holder of this item gains: Natural Pugilist You gain a +1 bonus to Melee Unarmed Attack Rolls and damage. Unhampered Resistance While the wielder is not wearing armour, they receive a +2 bonus to Saving Throws . Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Topple ( ) Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find The Hollow X: 192 Y: 546 : Sold by Auntie Ethel in the Hollow in the Emerald Grove Notes Regarding Natural Pugilist: Unarmed attack bonuses granted by Natural Pugilist are still useful if a monk is equipped with Corellon's Grace , since monks can perform various unarmed attack actions (e.g., Unarmed Strike (Monk) , Flurry of Blows , and Ki Resonation: Punch ) even when equipped with a melee weapon, as long as it is a monk weapon . When using an Improvised Melee Weapon , which is considered an unarmed melee attack, Natural Pugilist grants the bonus to the attack roll but not to the damage roll. Regarding Unhampered Resistance: Unhampered Resistance works even if the wielder is holding a shield . Bugs Regarding Unhampered Resistance: Helldusk Armour and Elven Chain lack an armour proficiency group, and so can be worn by any character without incurring the normal penalties for lacking proficiency. Because they lack a proficiency group, both armours are not seen as armour proper by Unhampered Resistance and can therefore be used in combination with it. ## Corpsegrinder
- **来源**: [Corpsegrinder](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Corpsegrinder)
- **分类**: Weapons

Corpsegrinder is a rare +2 Maul that deals additional Thunder damage and grants its wielder the Grand Slam weapon action. Reliable and trustworthy, you could not hope for more respectable company than this maul whilst traversing the forlorn places of the world. Properties Damage 2d6 + 2 (4~14) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Extra damage 1d4 (1~4) ⁠ Thunder Details Mauls Rarity: Rare Enchantment: + 2 Two-Handed Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 4.5 kg (9 lb) Price: 190 gp UID MAG_SWA_Roaring_Maul UUID c1aa1bf6-2bb8-4472-9e18-b5285101c4b3 Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Backbreaker ( ) Put extra force behind your strike to possibly knock your enemy Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Concussive Smash ( ) Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Tenacity ( ) When you miss an attack, deal ⁠ Bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier anyway (minimum of 1). Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Grand Slam ( ) Slam your weapon into the ground, dealing additional ⁠ Thunder damage equal to your proficiency bonus , thunderously impacting nearby foes and possibly pushing them away. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Western Beach X: -222 Y: 93 : Carried by Cairos at the beaches west of Rivington Notes This weapon is an homage to the song "Hammer Smashed Face" by Cannibal Corpse, whose vocalist goes by the stage name "Corpsegrinder". Regarding Grand Slam: This action does not count as an attack for the purposes of Extra Attack and requires the wielder's full Action . Bugs Regarding Grand Slam: Since this attack does not involve an attack roll, it does not benefit from certain bonus damage sources which check the attack roll type despite listing the additional damage on the tooltip. These include: Arcane Synergy Great Weapon Master: All In Hunter's Mark Wrath Despite the tooltip warning, Large and bigger sized targets are pushed back.

## Crimson Mischief
- **来源**: [Crimson Mischief](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Crimson_Mischief)
- **分类**: Weapons、Shortswords

Crimson Mischief is a legendary +2 Shortsword that, when wielded in the main hand, grants additional damage when attacking with Advantage and against targets with 50% or less of their hit points . When wielded in the off-hand, it instead allows the wielder to add their Ability Modifier to their damage. When she was a girl, she toyed with nastiness and sadism. Children often grow out of this; they get hobbies. For Orin, that taste for cruelty fermented, and in a way she did find hobbies. Ones that screamed. Properties Damage 1d6 + 2 (3~8) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Extra damage 1d4 (1~4) ⁠ Necrotic Details Shortswords Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 2 One-Handed Finesse Light Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Price: 640 gp UID MAG_TheCrimson_Shortsword UUID 5961d027-75fd-4ad7-964c-8b786b5839fb Stats MAG_TheCrimson_Shortsword Special The holder of this item gains: Prey Upon the Weak This weapon deals an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing damage against targets with 50% of their hit points or fewer. Main Hand Only Redvein Savagery When you make an attack with Advantage , the target takes an additional 7 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing DRS damage. Off-Hand Only Crimson Weapon When you make an attack with your off-hand weapon, you can add your Ability Modifier to the damage of the attack. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Flourish ( ) Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Piercing Strike ( ) Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Bhaal Temple X: 61 Y: 1004 : Carried by Orin during the quest ⁠ Get Orin's Netherstone Notes Regarding Redvein Savagery: Redvein Savagery does not give +7 damage to offhand or ranged attacks made with Advantage. However, it does give +7 damage to any Sneak Attack bonuses that trigger from main hand melee attacks, for a total of +14 damage to such attacks. Although the tooltip does not specify, Redvein Savagery only applies to attacks which involve this weapon. Regarding Crimson Weapon: Crimson Weapon also applies to attacks made with an off-hand hand crossbow . Crimson Weapon does not stack with other sources of Two-Weapon Fighting . Bugs Despite being classed solely as a Shortsword, Scimitar proficiency also allows one to wield this weapon proficiently. Regarding Prey Upon the Weak: The weapon tooltip incorrectly lists two entries of + 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing , with one also stating (Conditional) . This is merely a UI bug, and the weapon will correctly deal 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing additional damage. Notes Regarding Edge of Darkness: This action is actually an AoE attack. After striking the main target, an additional attack is made against every creature and object within the 3 m (10 ft) cloud radius around that target, including allies. On-hit reactions such as Divine Smite can be applied to each creature hit by this action (at the cost of multiple spell slots, in the case of Divine Smite). Bugs Regarding Edge of Darkness: The in-game tooltip for this action is inaccurate and missing key information about it being an AoE attack. The tooltip claims there is an associated Constitution Saving Throw , but this is not true.

Open its inventory. Click the preview icon, located below the character. Click and hold the weapon. (Caution: The weapon slot only appears for a few frames.) The following also works as of Patch 8/Hotfix 31, and is possible on all platforms: [ verify ] Summon a Planar Ally: Deva . Place a weapon with the " Can be consumed by Gale " tag on the ground. As of Patch 7/Hotfix 29, this weapon was obtainable using a controller on PC or console with the following steps: Kill a Deva summoned by Castigated by Divinity and Pick Up its body. Open any character's inventory, press A/X on their melee main-hand equipment slot, and unequip their current weapon in the weapon list that appears. Still in the weapon list, press A/X on the Deva Mace to equip it to the currently selected character.

The player character can only purchase Dolor Amarus from the Echo of Abazigal if they accept becoming an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal . However, it can also be acquired through an exploit – see notes on the Echo of Abazigal page for details. Regarding Dolor Amarus (passive feature): Dolor Amarus applies to all weapon attacks while a weapon with the feature is equipped, and it can be activated multiple times if multiple weapons with the passive are equipped. For example, if both Dolor Amarus daggers are equipped '"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001E-QINU`"' or one dagger and the Vicious Battleaxe on a character with Dual Wielder '"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001E-QINU`"' together with the Vicious Shortbow , when the wielder lands a critical hit, then +21 damage will be added, instead of +7. Dolor Amarus also stacks on multiple damage riders, which could potentially lead to massive bonuses from different damage sources. The name dolor amarus is Latin for "harsh suffering" or "bitter sorrow". Bugs Dolor Amarus is missing a WPN_DAGGER tag in its root template, and as such does not function with Bladesong . Regarding Dolor Amarus (passive feature): Despite the description, Dolor Amarus does not deal an additional 7 damage on unarmed attack critical hits (including Throw attacks).

## Duellist's Prerogative
- **来源**: [Duellist's Prerogative](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Duellist's_Prerogative)
- **分类**: Weapons、Rapiers

Duellist's Prerogative is a legendary +3 Rapier that grants the wielder a greater chance of critical hits, and an extra reaction provided their off-hand is empty. The wielder can also use a reaction to grant additional Necrotic damage on a hit. A blade gifted to Lora by her own mother, Lenore the Fleet. When challenged to duels, Lenore's opponents assumed she had received this nickname from some naval exploit. They found out how wrong they were when her blade blurred faster than the eye could follow. Properties Damage 1d8 + 3 (4~11) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Extra damage 1d4 (1~4) ⁠ Necrotic Details Rapiers Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 3 One-Handed Finesse Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Price: 1300 gp UID MAG_TheDueller_Rapier UUID d49bf05e-4f94-4860-bd8c-ae63dae811be Stats MAG_TheDueller_Rapier Special The holder of this item gains: Challenge to Duel ( ) Challenge an enemy to attack only you, inflicting Bleeding on the target. Elegant Duellist While your off-hand is empty, you score a Critical Hit when rolling a 19. Moreover, you gain an additional Reaction per turn. Withering Cut On a hit with a melee weapon, use a Reaction to deal additional ⁠ Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus . Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Flourish ( ) Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Piercing Strike ( ) Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Weakening Strike ( ) Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict Weak Grip . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Dueller's Enthusiasm ( ) While you are not dual-wielding and your off hand is empty, you can make an additional melee attack with The Dueller. ( Recharge: Per turn.) Where to find Lora's House X: -65 Y: -89 : Reward from Lora Bergauz for completing the quest ⁠ Save Vanra Notes Wielding an off-hand weapon or a shield disables Elegant Duellist and Dueller's Enthusiasm. Lora does not reward the party with the Duelist's Prerogative if the quest ⁠ Save Vanra is not picked up prior to freeing Vanra from the Hag's Lair ; she must first be spoken with at the Basilisk Gate Barracks to receive this item. Although Challenge to Duel is described as a spell and not as a weapon action, it still receives a bonus from the Heightened Manoeuvre passive feature. Regarding Elegant Duellist: Although not explicitly stated as with most other critical threshold reducing items, the critical hit reduction provided here stacks with all other sources (of increased critical hit range). This passive only applies Bleeding to targets with the Compelled to Duel condition, applied by Challenge to Duel from Duellist's Prerogative . Bugs Regarding Withering Cut: The reaction triggers on attacks that are already killing blows, wasting a reaction point for no additional damage benefit. A hidden technical condition, which is responsible for applying a visual effect to struck targets, triggers the passives from Boots of Stormy Clamour , Coldbrim Hat , and Diadem of Arcane Synergy . ## Duke Ravengard's Longsword
- **来源**: [Duke Ravengard's Longsword](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Duke_Ravengard's_Longsword)
- **分类**: Weapons、Longswords

Duke Ravengard's Longsword is a rare +1 Longsword which increases the wielder's Charisma by +2 and can also grant allies temporary hit points based on their respective Charisma modifiers. Cradling his newborn son awkwardly, the Duke's face pulled into a rictus of misery. His love Francesca smiled at him, briefly, and died. He stared at her until the boy cried, and he told the boy it would be all right, though he himself did not believe it. Properties One-handed damage 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Two-handed damage 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Longswords Rarity: Rare Enchantment: + 1 Versatile Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.35 kg (2.7 lb) Price: 250 gp UID MAG_WYRM_Commander_Longsword UUID 06fbf04c-41be-4709-91df-76b4cbc9ccf5 Stats MAG_WYRM_Commander_Longsword Special The holder of this item gains: Charisma +2 Commander's Strike ( + ) Direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses a reaction on their next turn to make a   weapon attack . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Stirring Execution When you kill an enemy, allies within 9 m (30 ft) gain temporary hit points equal to your [ See: Bugs ] Charisma Modifier (minimum 1). Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Pommel Strike ( ) Make a non-lethal attack against an enemy and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Rush Attack ( ) Charge forward and attack the first enemy in your way, possibly pushing them Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Wyrm's Rock Fortress : Carried by Duke Ulder Ravengard at the audience hall Campsite (Act Three) : Carried by Duke Ulder Ravengard if he is present Notes The sword can be acquired by casting Command: Drop on Duke Ravengurad. The spell must be cast by a character who is not considered an ally: Either by a companion that was not part of the original rescue party , or by using a Disguise Self . Wyll permanently leaves the party and turns hostile if the Duke notices his sword being stolen. This can be prevented by immediately leaving the camp after picking up the sword. The Charisma bonus from the sword is uncapped, meaning that the bonus does not stack with other capped Charisma bonuses when Charisma is above any of those caps. Bugs Regarding Stirring Execution: The temporary hit points are actually based on the Charisma modifiers of the characters receiving them, not the character delivering the killing blow with this sword. The minimum of 1 still applies. The temporary hit points only have a StackPriority of 1, and as such are overridden by any other source of temporary hit points which have a StackPriority of 1 or higher, even if the new source is of a lesser value. ## Dwarven Thrower
- **来源**: [Dwarven Thrower](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Dwarven_Thrower)
- **分类**: Weapons、Warhammers

Dwarven Thrower is a very rare +2 Warhammer that returns to the wielder when thrown, and deals extra damage if the wielder is a Dwarf or the target is Large or greater. The first Dwarven Thrower was created unintentionally. The moment was transcribed in the annals of dwarfdom thusly: 'Ach, it doesn't work. Another design down the bloody drain. Now to... Does er... Does anyone else hear a sort of humming whistle? Growing louder?' Properties One-handed damage 1d8 + 2 (3~10) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d10 + 2 (3~12) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Warhammers Rarity: Very rare Enchantment: + 2 Versatile Thrown Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 2.7 kg (5.4 lb) Price: 770 gp UID MAG_PHB_DwarvenThrower_Warhammer UUID 596202a9-7d6b-4bcf-8748-dbf6aa55b002 Stats MAG_PHB_DwarvenThrower_Warhammer Special The holder of this item gains: Homing Weapon This weapon will return to its owner when thrown. Dwarven Thrower A dwarf throwing this warhammer deals an extra 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large, Huge or Gargantuan creature, the strike deals an additional 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. Weakening Strike ( ) Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict Weak Grip . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Rivington X: 43 Y: -101 : Sold by Ferg Drogher near the Requisitioned Barn Notes Ferg Drogher does not sell any items (including this one) if Shadowheart is nearby, unless she killed The Nightsong earlier in Act Two . Otherwise Ferg Drogher disappears from the game after the first interaction with him and there is no other opportunity to get the Dwarven Thrower. As this weapon returns when thrown, it works well with Tavern Brawler and Enraged Throw . Regarding Dwarven Thrower (passive feature): Being disguised as a Dwarf when equipping the weapon also activates Dwarven Thrower. Bugs Regarding Homing Weapon: Once a weapon with the Homing Weapon passive is dropped, this passive will not show if the weapon is examined while it is on the ground. Additionally, when a dropped weapon with this passive is subsequently picked up and thrown (regardless of which character throws it), it will return to the Main Hand (melee) of the character who initially dropped the item. Fabricated Arbalest is a very rare +2 Heavy Crossbow that grants the wielder the Dazzling Ray and Illuminating Shot weapon actions. A perfect system must be ruled by a keen eye - and any error foolish enough to rear its head afore the eye must be quickly, precisely, and totally eliminated. This crossbow can help with that. Properties Damage 1d10 + 2 (3~12) + Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Details Heavy Crossbows Rarity: Very rare Enchantment: + 2 Two-Handed Range: 18 m (60 ft) Weight: 8.1 kg (16.2 lb) Price: 960 gp UID MAG_Gortash_HeavyCrossbow UUID 45d888b5-e002-4bb8-85d7-6df569aceaa4 Stats MAG_Gortash_HeavyCrossbow Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Piercing Shot ( ) Deal regular damage and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds which cause extra damage on attacks. Where to find Wyrm's Rock Fortress X: -26 Y: 211 : Carried by Enver Gortash Notes Enver Gortash can be found in the audience hall during the coronation or in his personal quarters on top of the fortress. Regarding Dazzling Ray: Dazzling Ray uses the wielder's spell save DC rather than their weapon action DC and does not involve an attack roll. Consequently, it does not count as an attack for Extra Attack . Dazzling Ray uses concentration similar to other spells that can be recast like Sunbeam . While concentrating, the wielder gains a separate weapon action called Recast Dazzling Ray . Recast Dazzling Ray only becomes available when the initial cast of Dazzling Ray strikes a target. When casting Recast Dazzling Ray, the wielder makes a hidden DC 14  Constitution Saving Throw to avoid being Burned for 2 turns. When the wielder is burned, they immediately take 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Fire which may break their concentration on Dazzling Ray. Bugs Regarding Illuminating Shot: The damage dealt is fixed to 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing and does not benefit from most damage bonuses that would otherwise affect normal attacks. This includes Sharpshooter: All In , which applies the accuracy penalty without adding the damage bonus.

## Flail of Ages
- **来源**: [Flail of Ages](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Flail_of_Ages)
- **分类**: Weapons

Flail of Ages is a rare +1 Flail that applies variable conditions depending on what type of damage the flail does. Created by a warmongering rakshasa and kept for a time under the careful watch of an astute noble name Lord de'Arnise , this flail is a tool of absolute destruction, and a versatile one at that. Properties Damage 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Flails Rarity: Rare Enchantment: + 1 One-Handed Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Price: 320 gp / 480 gp H Honour UID MAG_BG_OfAges_Flail UUID 01338cbe-9ff6-485e-9052-838c82a2a753 Stats MAG_BG_OfAges_Flail Special The holder of this item gains: Elemental Age ( ) Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest .) Elements of an Epoch Depending on what kind of damage this weapon does, it also inflicts: Acid condition, Chilled condition, or Burning condition. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Concussive Smash ( ) Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Tenacity ( ) When you miss an attack, deal ⁠ Bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier anyway (minimum of 1). Weakening Strike ( ) Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict Weak Grip . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Stormshore Armoury X: -36 Y: -83 : Sold by Fytz the Firecracker , near the Lower City Central Wall waypoint Notes Elemental Age's damage bonus can be applied to other weapons if Flail of Ages is equipped in the offhand slot when cast. The condition stays on the other weapon even when Flail of Ages is unequipped. This only resets after a long rest. The Flail of Ages is also found in Baldur's Gate 2 . The description of the item in Baldur's Gate 3 refers to the events of the previous storyline. Regarding Elements of an Epoch: Multiple conditions from Elements of an Epoch can be applied each hit if the weapon does multiple types of elemental damage. For example, ⁠ Acid damage can be added with the Caustic Band or ⁠ Fire damage can be added by Dipping the weapon in fire. However, the Burning and Chilled conditions are mutually exclusive. Applying one removes the other so combining ⁠ Fire and ⁠ Cold damage on the flail is counterproductive. Each condition has its own DC  13 Constitution Saving Throw . Not to be confused with Faithbreaker Foebreaker is a very rare +2 Maul that ignores ⁠ Bludgeoning resistance of targets. As heavy and opposed to nonsense as the kitchen cook in most stories about some young adventurous girl going to become a knight or a hedge witch or something. Properties Damage 2d6 + 2 (4~14) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Mauls Rarity: Very rare Enchantment: + 2 Two-Handed Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 4.5 kg (9 lb) Price: 480 gp UID MAG_TheDestroyer_Maul UUID 89eacf71-5bf6-4e7f-ac9d-e2d7d1d6bcb0 Stats MAG_TheDestroyer_Maul Special The holder of this item gains: Lethal Weapon This weapon ignores resistance to ⁠ Bludgeoning damage. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Backbreaker ( ) Put extra force behind your strike to possibly knock your enemy Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Concussive Smash ( ) Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Tenacity ( ) When you miss an attack, deal ⁠ Bludgeoning damage equal to your Strength modifier anyway (minimum of 1). Where to find Sorcerous Vault X: 326 Y: 998 : in a hidden chest in the Karsus section Notes Once in the vault, upon finding the named doors, the party must go through the doors in the following order Silverhand -> Abjuration -> Silver to find a lever to unlock the Karsus vault door. Then the party must go through Demon to return to the starting room and proceed through the opened Karsus door. The chest is invisible and requires See Invisibility or Faerie Fire to reveal it. Regarding Lethal Weapon (Bludgeoning): Lethal Weapon does not bypass immunity to bludgeoning, only resistance . Lethal Weapon applies to unarmed strikes made while it is equipped. The game does not allow most characters to make unarmed strikes while a melee weapon is equipped in their main hand, but Monks who are level 5 and higher can use Stunning Strike to do this; they can also use Unarmed Strike to apply this effect with their off-hand as a Bonus Action . All sources of ⁠ Bludgeoning damage from a character with Lethal Weapon ignore resistance. For example, another dual-wielded bludgeoning damage weapon striking in melee, Dwarven Thrower being thrown , or the spell Ice Storm .
## Gandrel's Aspiration

Gandrel's Aspiration is an uncommon +1 Heavy Crossbow that grants Advantage against Monstrosity targets and grants the Sacred Munitions class action that Turns Undead . When Gandrel was seven, he was frightened badly by a vampire spawn during a public burning. Seized by the flames, the creature didn't shrivel up. It swelled and burst like a squeezed leech. Brains splattered the boy's shoes, grey-pink and pulpy. He would never forget it. Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Sacred Munitions ( ) Infuse your crossbow bolts with holy energy. For the rest of your turn, your ranged weapon attacks inflict Turned against undead . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Sunlit Wetlands X: -26 Y: 238 : Carried by Gandrel in Act One Notes Regarding Feller of Monsters: The Advantage granted by Feller of Monsters applies to all forms of attacks against Monstrosities, so long as the weapon with this passive feature is equipped. Regarding Sacred Munitions: The in-game description says "Your ranged weapon attacks possibly inflict Turn Undead," but there is actually no saving throw to resist it. A level 5 cleric using this feature will also have the Destroy Undead feature applied to their ranged attacks, dealing 4d6 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant bonus damage to undead targets. Githyanki Longsword (Psionic) is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Longswords family of weapons. Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Rush Attack ( ) Charge forward and attack the first enemy in your way, possibly pushing them Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) ## Gontr Mael
- **来源**: [Gontr Mael](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Gontr_Mael)
- **分类**: Weapons

Gontr Mael is a legendary +3 Longbow that can possibly inflict Guiding Bolt on its target and grants the wielder the Celestial Haste spell and Bolt of Celestial Light actions. Gontr Mael blasted from the corpse of the Steelwatcher Titan: a bow formed from the boiling slag and weird whispering gyros inherent to the mechanical giant. It must have acted as the Titan's abdomen, exchanging muscle for immaculate steel. Properties Damage 1d8 + 3 (4~11) + Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Details Longbows Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 3 Two-Handed Range: 18 m (60 ft) Weight: 1.1 kg (2.2 lb) Price: 1000 gp UID MAG_TheVictory_Longbow UUID 7e81bb6a-f465-4fe9-b1db-7ce6198246ba Stats MAG_TheVictory_Longbow Special The holder of this item gains: Celestial Haste ( ) Gain   Hastened . ( Recharge: Long rest .) Gontr Mael: Glowing This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of 6 m (20 ft). Toggle this to douse and rekindle the light. Promised Victory On a hit, possibly inflict Guiding Bolt upon the target. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Brace (Ranged) ( ) Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement . For the rest of your turn, roll ranged damage twice and use the highest result. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Hamstring Shot ( ) Shoot an enemy in the thigh and possibly reduce their movement speed by 50%. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Bolt of Celestial Light ( ) Frighten your target with intimidating arrows. After attacking, ranged weapon attacks made by Gontr Mael deal an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Radiant damage. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Steel Watch Foundry X: -1952 Y: 206 : Carried by the Steel Watcher Titan in the Control Centre Notes Does not drop if the Steel Watcher Titan is killed by the Atrophied condition. Regarding Promised Victory: Promised Victory only applies 1 turn of Guiding Bolt, differing from the spell which applies 2 turns, and as such the condition is lost immediately at the start of the target's next turn. Arrows that have an area of effect can trigger Promised Victory on all creatures and objects within the area, spreading Guiding Bolt over multiple targets. Regarding Bolt of Celestial Light: The 10 round buff is triggered regardless if the weapon action hits or misses. This weapon action can still be used even if the wielder is not proficient with Longbows. Bugs Regarding Bolt of Celestial Light: This action does not use Superiority Dice at any time, contrary to the in-game tooltip stating "On Miss: Does not spend Superiority Dice." A hidden technical condition, which is responsible for applying a visual effect to struck targets, triggers the passives from Boots of Stormy Clamour , Coldbrim Hat , and Diadem of Arcane Synergy . Because Shockwave triggers on every Jump taken during a turn, wielding this weapon while using Step of the Wind allows for many triggers of Shockwave in one turn. ## Hellfire Greataxe
- **来源**: [Hellfire Greataxe](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Hellfire_Greataxe)
- **分类**: Weapons

Hellfire Greataxe is a very rare +2 Greataxe that deals additional Fire damage, afflicts its wielder with Heat on each successful hit, and grants the Hellflame Cleave weapon action. Anything hit by this has the life expectancy of a glass hammer. Properties Damage 1d12 + 2 (3~14) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Extra damage 1d6 (1~6) ⁠ Fire Details Greataxes Rarity: Very rare Enchantment: + 2 Two-Handed Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 3.15 kg (6.3 lb) Price: 960 gp UID MAG_WATCHER_Human_Greataxe UUID dd0e9fa2-e012-454d-9f2d-53c0a0776015 Stats MAG_WATCHER_Human_Greataxe Special The holder of this item gains: Thermodynamo Whenever you deal damage with this weapon, you gain 2 turns of Heat . Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Cleave ( ) Swing your weapon in a large arc to attack up to 3 enemies at once. They each take half the damage your weapon usually deals. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Prepare ( ) Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement to deal an additional Strength modifier ⁠ ⁠ Physical DRS damage (minimum 1) on each successful melee weapon attack for the rest of the turn. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Hellflame Cleave ( ) Spew hellish flames and strike your foes. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Sorcerous Vault X: 366 Y: 941 : In a gilded chest in the "Illusion" section Notes Once in the vault, upon finding the named doors, the party must go through the "Silverhand" door and in the next area destroy the door labeled "Illusion" (trying to enter the door normally will not work). Through the door is the room with the chest. This is one of very few non- Dippable weapons in the game, as its special property functions largely the same as being dipped in Fire . Regarding Thermodynamo: It is not listed in-game, but Thermodynamo can only activate once per attack, even when hitting multiple targets with Cleave or similar abilities. Regarding Hellflame Cleave: This weapon action does not count as an attack for the purposes of Extra Attack and requires a full Action to use. Instead, this is actually classified as a cantrip which results in some unexpected interactions. It can be Counterspelled . A sorcerer can apply Metamagic to it. The applicable options are Careful Spell , Extended Spell , Heightened Spell , Subtle Spell , and perhaps most importantly, Quickened Spell . It benefits from spell and cantrip specific damage bonuses like Elemental Affinity: Damage and Necklace of Elemental Augmentation . It activates Eldritch Knight's War Magic . It can still be cast while Silenced . It cannot be cast while Raging . The Roiling Hellfire condition is applied by both the weapon action itself and the Hellfire surface it creates. Even if a target saves against the attack, it will still be inflicted with Roiling Hellfire cause by the surface. Bugs This weapon has a hidden condition MAG_FIRE_DIPPED_HELLFIRE which is supposed to make its 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage ignore fire resistance. Additionally, Hellflame Cleave and the Hellfire surface it creates are also both supposed to ignore fire resistance. Neither of these effects are currently ignoring fire resistance. Regarding Hellflame Cleave: Despite the tooltip saying that Hellfire ignores resistances and immunities, it does not. Since this attack does not involve an attack roll, it does not benefit from certain bonus damage sources which check the attack roll type despite listing the additional damage on the tooltip. These include: Arcane Synergy Great Weapon Master: All In Hunter's Mark Prepare Wrath

This light, curved blade is as unusual and unforgiving as the Darkness it strikes from. Properties Damage 1d6 + 2 (3~8) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Scimitars Rarity: Very rare Enchantment: + 2 One-Handed Finesse Light Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.35 kg (2.7 lb) Price: 480 gp UID MAG_Justiciar_Scimitar UUID 74ecc6e4-ee5d-4cd8-96cb-dd677a4acc82 Stats MAG_Justiciar_Scimitar Special The holder of this item gains: Shadow-Blinding If you attack with Advantage , you have a chance to Blind your target.
