Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Backbreaker ( ) Put extra force behind your strike to possibly knock your enemy Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Flourish ( ) Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Shadowsoaked Blow ( ) Strike an enemy, adding your proficiency bonus to the damage. Moreover, if the attack hits, it deals an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage. This attack doesn't break concealment. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Gauntlet of Shar X: -713 Y: -732 : Carried by Lyrthindor Notes This weapon does not have a proficiency classification, and does not require proficiency in Scimitars to use. Regarding Shadow-Blinding: Despite the tooltip not stating so, Shadow-Blinding applies only to attacks made with the weapon that has this feature. Regarding Shadow Blade (passive feature): While active, Shadow Blade provides Advantage to both mainhand and off-hand equipped melee weapons. Prior to Patch 8 Hotfix 1, Shadow Blade granted advantage to all attack rolls when active. This was changed to only melee weapon attacks. Regarding Shadowsoaked Blow: "Not breaking concealment" means that the attacker can remain Hidden after performing the attack, though it still ends Invisibility . A solo character can use this attack while hidden without entering combat. This lets them get two attacks off before their opponent is aware of them, making it an excellent candidate for use in assassinating isolated NPCs. Bugs Due to the missing proficiency classification, this weapon cannot be used to activate Bladesong when equipped in the mainhand weapon slot, although equipping it does not apply Bladesong Impeded (Condition) . This issue does not occur when equipped in the offhand weapon slot. This weapon has a hidden version of the Shadow Blade applied to it, which grants advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls while active, including weapon attack rolls for another equipped melee weapon while dual-wielding. Regarding Shadow-Blinding: In Honour mode , this feature is non-functional.

Where to find Grymforge X: -643 Y: 411 : Carried by Stone Guard Orgarth Bugs In the game files, the root template of this sword (UUID 5908898d-5d9e-40de-ab07-3f8fb5f0174c ) actually describes a shortsword, which is also used as the basis for the Knife of the Undermountain King . In fact, the magical properties of that sword are also added to this root template (via the  tag), meaning that this item should have those properties as well, and will do so if spawned via the console. However, the weapon that's spawned in-game is not directly based on the root template but rather on a stat entry called WPN_KingsKnife which inherits properties from WPN_Longsword . This ends up making this item functionally identical to a common longsword. Equipping a hireling with this weapon, then dismissing and re-hiring them, changes this weapon's stats and weapon actions to those of Knife of the Undermountain King , as its root template has the same stats. Piercing Strike ( ) Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Crèche Y'llek X: 1380 Y: -798 : Sold by A'jak'nir Jeera Notes Regarding Organ Rearranger: Organ Rearranger stacks with other passive effects that improve critical chance, including ranged attacks and spell attack rolls [3] [4] . Organ Rearranger's damage reroll is only applied to melee weapon attacks. When dual-wielding melee weapons, both weapons will benefit. All damage dice attached to an attack can be rerolled, not just the weapon's base damage die. The damage reroll is not normally applied to any other attack type, including throw attacks using the Knife of the Undermountain King itself. However, Organ Rearranger's damage reroll does stack with itself (via a second Knife of the Undermountain King due to the King's Knife or Invoke Duplicity bugs) or dual wielding with Twist of Fortune . The improvement of the second reroll is smaller than the first one. Regarding Shadow Blade (passive feature): While active, Shadow Blade provides Advantage to both mainhand and off-hand equipped melee weapons. Prior to Patch 8 Hotfix 1, Shadow Blade granted advantage to all attack rolls when active. This was changed to only melee weapon attacks. ## Least Expected
- **来源**: [Least Expected](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Least_Expected)
- **分类**: Weapons

Least Expected is a rare + 2 Shortbow which grants the Blinding Shot weapon action, and increases Attack Rolls while Obscured . One of the relics of Deep Duerra's rebellious children. It was to the tremendous surprise of all that Ludmilla, the quiet, the weepy, the daughter most under her mother's thumb, took up this bow and fired. The arrow flashed, and while Duerra and her blinded court wailed importantly, the children escaped into an uncertain, yet sweetly free, future. This may be confusing as it does not specify "ranged weapons" as the passive does, but the 1d4 bonus is indeed limited to ranged weapon attack rolls. Bugs Regarding Darkveil Precision: Darkveil Precision is not automatically applied to the wielder when first equipped while already Lightly Obscured or Heavily Obscured . The wielder must first either move to Clear Area and back, or Hide .

Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Concussive Smash ( ) Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Shattered Sanctum X: 338 Y: -21 : Carried by Abdirak Notes If this mace is purchased from Abdirak through his barter screen, it transfers back to him automatically when he needs to use it. Regarding Willing Whip: Due to the resistance granted by this passive, fractional damage received by the wielder is rounded down, and they take only 0~3 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage. However, nearby allies take full damage. Helldusk Armour , if used in conjunction with the above resistance, effectively negates all Necrotic damage otherwise inflicted upon the wielder by this passive. The area of effect is centred on the creature that is hit, and the radius is 2 m (7 ft). This feature is particularly useful against groupings of low-hit-point enemies that may otherwise have many opportunities to score critical hits against the party. If Lae'zel is in the party while fighting the murder of Shadow-Cursed Ravens on the Ruined Battlefield in Act Two at X: 30 Y: 114 , the area of effect damage from this passive may easily earn the Soldier 's ⁠ Pentacrush Inspiration , while taking little to no damage in the process. Attacks which deal multiple instances of damage, such as the various smite spells or Booming Blade , trigger multiple instances of Willing Whip. Similarly, weapon attacks that target multiple creatures, such as Tiger's Bloodlust , cause this passive to activate separately on each successful attack, potentially causing the wielder and all nearby creatures to take significant damage. Bugs Regarding Willing Whip: Some damage riders like Lightning Charges and Callous Glow Ring are added both to regular attacks and to the Willing Whip area effect, so they also hurt the mace wielder. Creatures close to the one struck by this weapon take damage every time, but those on the border of its AoE radius sometimes do not. This is especially noticeable with wide area attacks, such as Slashing Flourish (Melee) . External links [ edit section | visual editor ] Loviatar's Scourge on the Forgotten Realms Wiki

Markoheshkir is a legendary +2 Quarterstaff which empowers the wielder's spells and can be tuned towards a certain element, granting extra spells and effects. It can also cast a spell for free, once per long rest . Kereska , draconic goddess of arcane knowledge, imbues many chromatic dragons with their magic. This includes their exquisite and terrible breath, which has wrenched giants from their tall thrones, and destroyed civilisations of smallfolk. Properties One-handed damage 1d6 + 2 (3~8) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d8 + 2 (3~10) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Quarterstaves Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 2 Versatile Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 640 gp UID MAG_TheChromatic_Staff UUID 7e39ad11-f8c3-421a-940c-05348c420c7d Stats MAG_TheChromatic_Staff Special The holder of this item gains: Kereska's Favour ( ) Imbue yourself with elemental energy sourced from the draconic goddess, Kereska. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Arcane Enchantment You gain a +1 bonus to Spell Save DC and Spell Attack rolls. Arcane Battery Alleviate the arcane burden of spellcasting with the power of this staff. The next spell you cast doesn't cost a spell slot . Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Topple ( ) Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Ramazith's Tower X: 4970 Y: 705 : in a Globe of Invulnerability Notes A party member must use See Invisibility to see the lever and then pass a DC 20 Arcana Check , which disables the globe. Unequipping the staff after casting Kereska's Favour removes the spell. Re-equipping the staff does not restore the buff while Kereska's Favour is still on cooldown. Bugs Regarding Arcane Battery: The long rest cooldown restriction on Arcane Battery is per character , rather than per item . As such, Arcane Battery can be used repeatedly by passing the weapon possessing this feature to different characters, activating it once on each. Arcane Battery is still consumed if active when the character casts a cantrip, despite cantrips not being highlighted in the character's cast bar. Toggling Arcane Battery highlights some abilities and items that do not consume spell slots, such as Danse Macabre and spell scrolls ; these abilities and items activate properly, but are still consumed (along with Arcane Battery) in the process. The Moonlantern is a special utility item that sheds a magical Light in a large radius while equipped. Each framed facet of the lantern glass is pierced by lances and long tendrils of eerily beautiful moonlight. Properties One-handed damage 1d4 (1~4) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d6 (1~6) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Clubs Rarity: Story Item Enchantment: None Versatile Light Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Price: 30 gp UID UNI_GLO_Moonlantern UUID 9aca1109-a59d-47d3-8f35-f248b70518f9 Condition: Moonshield Moonshield ⁠Radius: 13 m (43 ft) Protected by the light of a Moonlantern or Shadow Lantern . The Shadow Curse does not affect this entity. Where to find Ruined Battlefield X: 0 Y: -15 : Carried by Kar'niss , either after the Harper ambush or at the top of Moonrise Towers Last Light Inn X: -63 Y: 172 : Given by Isobel if letting the Harpers take the Moonlantern Moonrise Towers : In Balthazar's room in Moonrise Towers Notes The Moonlantern carried by Kar'niss contains a foul-mouthed pixie Dolly Dolly Dolly who wants out. If freed using Inspect Moonlantern , she grants the party a Pixie Blessing . If Dolly is freed, her Moonlantern remains in the inventory of the character who freed her, but its inventory icon changes to a broken version and the lantern cannot be equipped anymore. If Kar'niss arrives at Moonrise Towers with the lantern (whether he escorted the party or not), Dolly dies inside it. If Kar'niss is killed at the ambush and the lantern is taken by the Harpers, the party can follow them back to Last Light Inn . There Isobel gives the party the same Moonlantern with Dolly Dolly Dolly alive inside; she can be freed and the Pixie Blessing may then still be obtained. Switching to ranged weapons while having a Moonlantern equipped retains the Moonshield effect but removes the illumination, allowing darkness-requiring effects such as Covert Critical and Shadow Step to be safely used within the Shadow-Cursed Lands . See also: Broken Moonlantern Dead Pixie Filigreed Feywild Bell Shadow Lantern Bugs The Moonlantern containing Dolly Dolly Dolly still produces a stationary Moonshield Aura when dropped on the ground even after she has been freed from it. Mourning Frost is a very rare +1 Quarterstaff that enhances the wielder's ⁠ Cold damaging spells with extra damage and the Chilled condition. The air around this staff crackles with a cold, frosty wind - a power that has been divided for too long, and is waiting to be released. Properties One-handed damage 1d6 + 1 (2~7) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Extra damage 1d4 (1~4) ⁠ Cold Details Quarterstaves Rarity: Very rare Enchantment: + 1 Versatile Dippable Consumable by Gale Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 770 gp UID MAG_Cold_IncreaseColdDamageOnCast_Staff UUID cab10a42-8c85-459a-9d68-b4836388c022 Stats MAG_Cold_IncreaseColdDamageOnCast_Staff Special The holder of this item gains: Ray of Frost ( ) Cast as a cantrip at will. Heart of Ice When dealing ⁠ Cold damage, the wielder deals an additional 1 ⁠ ⁠ Cold . Insidious Cold Dealing Cold damage with a spell possibly inflicts Chilled upon the target. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Topple ( ) Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Underdark : Created by combining the components carried by the three Drow mages competing to discover the Adamantine Forge: Icy Crystal - carried by Filro the Forgotten near the Sussur Tree Icy Helve - carried by Dhourn , west of the Selûnite Outpost Icy Metal - looted from Xargrim the Pale Corpse within the Myconid Colony , in the secret area unlocked by completing the quest Defeat the Duergar Intruders at X: 49 Y: -72 , by casting Knock , or by using a skill like Misty Step from the right angle Notes The right click option to 'combine' appears once all three are collected and in the same character's inventory. Regarding Insidious Cold: A maximum of one target per attack can be Chilled by Insidious Cold. Any attack which is both a melee weapon attack and a spell (such a Booming Blade ) will trigger this passive. Bugs Regarding Heart of Ice: The in-game description also says "A Frostbitten creature that takes Cold damage will take an additional 1 Cold damage per turn of Frostbite remaining." However, it has no interaction or relation with the inaccessible Frostbite condition.

## Nature's Snare
- **来源**: [Nature's Snare](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Nature's_Snare)
- **分类**: Weapons、Quarterstaves

Nature's Snare is a variant of the Quarterstaves family of weapons that gives its wielder a chance to Ensnare non-plants and non-beasts on hit. Thread-like vines wriggle along this wooden staff. Properties One-handed damage 1d6 (1~6) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d8 (1~8) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Quarterstaves Rarity: Uncommon Enchantment: None Versatile Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 400 gp UID DEN_TunnelStaff UUID 4893bf4e-97e1-48e0-ada8-6bbf115ad68b Stats DEN_TunnelStaff Special The holder of this item gains: Fly Trap Chance to Ensnare target if it is not a plant or a beast. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Topple ( ) Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Underground Passage X: -425 Y: -200 : In a trapped Heavy Chest Notes Regarding Fly Trap: In addition to the combat round, Ensnare also loses a turn of duration at the beginning of the target's turn. Therefore, Fly Trap can prevent an opponent from moving for one turn at most. Piercing damage from Ensnare is applied each turn regardless of whether the save fails or succeeds. There are three different kinds saves: The first is when the condition is applied. The DC for this is 12. The second is at the beginning of the victim's first turn after receiving the condition. The DC for this is Spell save DC. The condition ends if save succeeds. The third is at the beginning of the possible second turn, but this one is redundant, because the condition always ends at the start of the second round (see bugs below) regardless of whether the save fails or succeeds. The DC for this is Spell save DC. The Sharpened Snare passive feature from Sharpened Snare Cuirass affects the second and third save but not the first one. ## Needle of the Outlaw Rogue

## Netherstone-Pommelled Bloodthirst
- **来源**: [Netherstone-Pommelled Bloodthirst](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Netherstone-Pommelled_Bloodthirst)
- **分类**: Weapons、Daggers

This article is about content that is inaccessible through normal gameplay . It can still be accessed via in-game exploits or third party tools. For the condition used by Gnolls, see Bloodthirst (Condition) . Netherstone-Pommelled Bloodthirst is a legendary +2 Dagger wielded by Orin which makes critical hits more likely and can make targets vulnerable to Piercing or more likely to be hit, depending on which hand the weapon is equipped on. The Lord of Murder wasn't always a lord. He was once just a petty killer. When Bhaal first drew blood in a Baldurian back-alley, it dropped to the ground and lingered. When he ascended, this dried blood-drop grew, warped - and became sharp. Properties Damage 1d4 + 2 (3~6) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Details Daggers Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 2 One-Handed Finesse Light Thrown Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.45 kg (0.9 lb) Price: 640 gp UID S_GLO_Orin_Bhaalist_Dagger_Netherstone UUID 7051fd5c-d777-457e-9aaf-e007b4cbbb55 Stats MAG_WYR_Orin_Bhaalist_Dagger Special The holder of this item gains: True Strike ( ) Cast as a cantrip ( Recharge: Short rest .) Bound Weapon Armour Class +1 (Off-Hand Only) Improved Critical The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack. Main Hand Only Exploit Weakness Creatures hit with this weapon receive Vulnerability to ⁠ Piercing damage. Off-Hand Only True Strike Riposte When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may retaliate and gain True Strike . Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Piercing Strike ( ) Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Condition: Bound Weapon Bound Weapon Ritually bound to its wielder. The weapon cannot be knocked out of the wielder's hand, and automatically returns to its wielder when thrown . Where to find Bhaal Temple X: 61 Y: 1004 : Carried by Orin during the quest ⁠ Get Orin's Netherstone Notes When this item is looted it breaks into Bloodthirst and Orin's Netherstone . In-game this is, in terms of grammar, incorrectly labelled as "Netherstone-Pomelled Bloodthirst" . Regarding Improved Critical: Improved Critical also applies to all attacks, not just those made with the corresponding weapon. Improved Critical stacks with features that increase critical hit range. This includes multiple copies of Improved Critical itself (with both Bloodthirst and The Dead Shot equipped) or similar features like Organ Rearranger (from Knife of the Undermountain King ). For a full list, see Reducing critical threshold . Regarding Exploit Weakness: Exploit Weakness is only applied by Bloodthirst and only when used in melee combat; throwing this weapon does not apply the passive. Regarding True Strike Riposte: The retalitory attack granted by True Strike Riposte expends a Reaction resource. Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Concept art by Jane Katsubo
## Nyrulna
- **来源**: [Nyrulna](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Nyrulna)
- **分类**: Weapons

Nyrulna is a legendary +3 Trident which can be thrown to create an explosion that deals Thunder damage in an area. It grants additional movement speed and jump distance and returns to the wielder after being thrown. The forgemaster Lirrico designed this weapon for the champion of the wind goddess Akadi . A key component in the forging was his home city's wind, and for a year after the weapon was made, no wind blew there at all. Properties One-handed damage 1d6 + 3 (4~9) + Strength modifier ⁠ Piercing Two-handed damage 1d8 + 3 (4~11) + Strength modifier ⁠ Piercing Extra damage 1d6 (1~6) ⁠ Thunder Details Tridents Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 3 Versatile Thrown Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 840 gp UID MAG_TheThorns_Trident UUID daf0be7f-87d9-448a-b94e-471ffec40ac5 Stats MAG_TheThorns_Trident Special The holder of this item gains: Zephyr Connection This weapon will return to your hand when thrown. You cannot be forced to drop the trident. When thrown, the weapon creates an explosion that deals 3d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder DRS damage in a ⁠6 m (20 ft) blast centered on the target. Veil of the Wind You gain a +3 m (10 ft) bonus to movement speed and jump distance. Equipping this weapon gives you Immunity to falling damage. Nyrulna: Glowing This object shines with a glowing light in a radius of ⁠6 m (20 ft). Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Piercing Strike ( ) Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Maiming Strike ( ) Possibly Maims your target. They can't move. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Zephyr Flash ( ) Rush forward, creating an air vortex that blasts foes and possibly inflicts Bleeding . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Zephyr Break ( ) Zephyr Break imitates the effects of the spell   Gust of Wind while dealing thunder damage. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Jungle X: -1511 Y: -1522 : In a locked painted chest, near the portal to exit the area Notes Akabi , in the Circus of the Last Days , teleports the character who is talking with him to the Jungle - after they win the jackpot. While in the jungle, just prior to the exit, the chest can be found. A DC 20 Sleight of Hand Check is necessary to unlock the chest. This is arguably one of the most powerful thrown weapons in the game, especially when used in conjunction with Tavern Brawler and Enraged Throw . In addition to its returning quality as a thrown weapon and its +3 enchantment bonus, Zephyr Connection is quite potent: The explosion caused by it happens whenever a thrown attack roll is made, even if the attack misses; it does not happen if the weapon is thrown to a location on the ground without targeting something (no attack roll). The 3d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage from throwing this weapon applies to all creatures and destructible objects within its 6m area of effect. Dealing damage to non-hostile targets in populated areas (such as the Lower City) counts as a hostile action and causes nearby civilians or guards to attack the party. Dyes cannot be applied to this weapon. Regarding Zephyr Flash: The attack also pushes targets back by 2 m (7 ft) if it hits. Regarding Zephyr Break: Despite Zephyr Break being listed as a "Level 2 Evocation Spell", this ability can be used while Raging . Bugs Regarding Zephyr Connection: The hidden technical conditions which apply the thunder damage trigger Arcane Echomalefaction and Coldbrim Chill against the primary target if it is an enemy. ## Orphic Hammer
- **来源**: [Orphic Hammer](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Orphic_Hammer)
- **分类**: Weapons、Warhammers

The Orphic Hammer is a legendary, plot-critical +3 Warhammer with the power to shatter infernal bonds. It also grants the wielder Advantage on saving throws vs spells. Every contract a devil makes has some form of insurance - this one is cast in infernal iron and was forged in deep, ruinous hellfire. Properties One-handed damage 1d8 + 3 (4~11) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d10 + 3 (4~13) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Warhammers Rarity: Story Item Enchantment: + 3 Versatile Thrown Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 2.7 kg (5.4 lb) Price: 770 gp UID LOW_MephistosVault_OrphicHammer UUID 9ff968d4-08ff-4da1-a288-959ac8d7abe1 Stats LOW_OrphicHammer UID WPN_GTY_Orphic_Hammer_A UUID 776324ed-a368-4994-b5f6-fd9112a10c9b Stats WPN_Warhammer Special The holder of this item gains: Spell Resistance You have Advantage on Saving Throws against spells. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Backbreaker ( ) Put extra force behind your strike to possibly knock your enemy Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Concussive Smash ( ) Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Weakening Strike ( ) Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict Weak Grip . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Unshackling Strike ( ) Smite the magical bonds keeping a creature Restrained , Paralyzed , and Stunned , freeing it. Where to find House of Hope X: -6543 Y: 2921 : On the central pedestal in the Archive Notes This hammer is the only way to shatter the infernal crystals that shackle: Orpheus within the ⁠ Astral Plane Hope within the House of Hope While listed here as a story item, it is also a legendary item. See: the Rarity data field for LOW_OrphicHammer If the player does not have the Orphic Hammer on hand and they choose side with Orpheus , Raphael , if still alive, comes to the ⁠ Astral Plane to either hand it over to the party after signing a deal or return it to the party if the deal was signed. Refusing the deal, attacking him or not having the Orphic Hammer if Raphael is dead causes an instant Game Over. Attempting to throw the Orphic Hammer into a chasm immediately teleports it back to the nearest safe spot. Regarding Unshackling Strike: This is the only action in the game able to destroy the Infernal Crystals keeping Hope imprisoned. Unshackling Strike does not free Orpheus , instead, the Infernal Crystals ( not the Minor Orb of Domination) need to be struck with a regular attack while wielding the Orphic Hammer . Unshackling Strike uses a melee weapon attack roll, meaning that using it against a friendly character with high Armor Class is likely to result in a miss. The icon for this action is reminiscent of the Dispel Magic icons in Baldur's Gate 1 and 2, and it is in fact labelled Spell_Abjuration_DispelMagic within the game files. However, according to Swen Vincke, Dispel Magic was cut content for Baldur's Gate 3. He relates how Baldur's Gate 3 devs tried to make D&D's Dispel Magic work for a long time, but ultimately abandoned it: "it would've doubled the size of the game." Pale Oak is a rare Quarterstaff that grants the Faithwarden's Vines spell and prevents the wielder from being Ensnared by vines. Infused with Silvanus' strength, these staves are gifted to Faithwardens who act in defence of nature. Properties One-handed damage 1d6 (1~6) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d8 (1~8) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Quarterstaves Rarity: Rare Enchantment: None Versatile Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 600 gp UID DEN_FaithwardenStaff UUID 13f6ff0c-08c4-4e9f-a624-511389b68dc2 Stats DEN_FaithwardenStaff Special The holder of this item gains: Faithwarden's Vines ( ) Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest .) Faithwarden's Stride Druidic vines cannot Entangled you and do not count as difficult terrain. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Topple ( ) Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Inner Sanctum X: -461 Y: -22 : Obtained from Rath or Kagha Notes This weapon can only be obtained by druid player characters. At the conclusion of ⁠ Investigate Kagha , if Kagha is swayed to the party's side, she gives the player character the staff. If she is killed, Rath gives the player character the staff instead. This must be done before completing ⁠ Rescue the Druid Halsin . Nothing (including having this item equipped) prevents Jaheira's vines from ensnaring the player character during a cutscene at the entrance to the Last Light Inn . [ 1 ] However, having received the staff and been named Faithwarden does provide a unique dialogue option with her. Regarding Faithwarden's Stride: Faithwarden's Stride only blocks the Difficult Terrain: Vines condition instead of the usual Difficult Terrain condition. Faithwarden's Stride's in-game tooltip states vines cannot "ensnare" you, however it actually blocks Entangled rather than Ensnared Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Appearance in game Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ If the party speaks with Jaheira at the Last Light Inn , an introductory cut-scene takes place with her there, during which the lead player character is ensnared in her vines as she interrogates them. This entanglement is plot-coded and unavoidable, regardless of any spell used or item equipped – including this one. While the player character (and the entire party) may avoid the cut-scene by, for example, sneaking into the area, its occupants will become hostile if they are discovered and Jaheira was not spoken with first at the Inn's entrance.

## Phalar Aluve
- **来源**: [Phalar Aluve](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Phalar_Aluve)
- **分类**: Weapons、Longswords

Phalar Aluve is a rare +1 Longsword that can be made to Sing or Shriek , granting nearby allies or enemies a bonus to Attack Rolls or damage rolls, depending on the choice. The Drow inscription on this blade appears to have been recently carved. It translates to; “ 'Though I have to leave you, I will dance forever in Eilistraee's Light.' „ Properties One-handed damage 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Slashing Two-handed damage 1d10 + 1 (2~11) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Longswords Rarity: Rare Enchantment: + 1 Versatile Finesse Dippable Consumable by Gale Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.35 kg (2.7 lb) Price: 250 gp UID S_UND_SwordInStone_SwordReward UUID cc16c1cb-d355-47df-820a-33a83c42234b UID UNI_UND_SwordInStone_SwordReward UUID 6d0d3206-50b5-48ed-af92-a146ed6b98f2 Stats UND_SwordInStone Special The holder of this item gains: Performance +1 Phalar Aluve: Melody ( ) The sword hums in anticipation, ready to Sing or Shriek (see bugs on their respective pages). ( Recharge: Short rest .) Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Pommel Strike ( ) Make a non-lethal attack against an enemy and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Rush Attack ( ) Charge forward and attack the first enemy in your way, possibly pushing them Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Underdark X: 116 Y: -192 : Embedded inside a rock Notes The sword can be freed in these ways: Passing a DC 15 Strength Check to yank it from the stone. Passing a DC 15 Religion Check to learn how to release the magic holding it in place. Clerics of Lolth have advantage on this check. Paladins can pass a DC 10 Religion Check (with Advantage ) to consider what the appropriate ritual for releasing the sword is. If successful, they can perform the ritual or use their oath to prove their worth ( DC 10 Charisma Check ). Clerics of Eilistraee can release the sword without needing an ability check. Spilling blood on the sword outside dialogue also releases it. It is possible to make one party member hit another, or perform a Blood Sacrifice if a party member has the Ritual Dagger , to cover the sword in a Blood surface. It is also possible throw a dead body on the sword. This will make it light up, so it can be pulled out without any ability check. Longswords do not normally have the Finesse property; Phalar Aluve is special in this regard. The only other example is Larethian's Wrath . Phalar Aluve is Drow language. Phalar means 'battle-marker' or 'grave', and Aluve means 'I/we leave you'. Obtaining the sword grants the inspiration ⁠ Last Rites of the Dark Dancer for party members with the Acolyte background, unless the sword was obtained through the dialogue option of a paladin using the strength of their oath. Although it has a distinctive appearance during the cutscene for its retrieval, when equipped this sword has an appearance similar to that of a Longsword +1 , save for its blade, hilt and pommel, which are gold instead of polished steel. Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Phalar Aluve lodged in its stone

## Promise
- **来源**: [Promise](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Promise)
- **分类**: Weapons、Daggers

This article is about an item or other previously obtainable content that has since been removed from the game , and is no longer obtainable , but can still be accessed via third party tools. Promise is an uncommon, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Daggers family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. Its design lends itself well to be thrown at enemies as a projectile. A leafy pattern is carved into the dagger's blade. It glows faintly in the dark. Bugs Regarding Homing Weapon: Once a weapon with the Homing Weapon passive is dropped, this passive will not show if the weapon is examined while it is on the ground. Additionally, when a dropped weapon with this passive is subsequently picked up and thrown (regardless of which character throws it), it will return to the Main Hand (melee) of the character who initially dropped the item.

Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Shattered Sanctum X: 338 Y: -26 : on the table next to Abdirak Notes Regarding The Scourge Mistress' Bane: The Bane condition applied by this weapon is the same as the Bane spell and does not stack. Because of the bug listed below, the Battle Master Fighter's Sweeping Attack applies this debuff to every target within the cone's area of effect, hit or miss. Many situations increase the self-damage dealt by this passive feature: The Savage Attacker feat results in secondary damage being re-rolled higher. A critical hit with this axe doubles the self-damage. Some damage riders such as Lightning Charges , radiant damage from the Callous Glow Ring and Psionic Overload increase the self-damage. Effects which reduce incoming piercing damage reduce the self-inflicted damage. However, as the self-damage is classified as magical, Heavy Armour Master damage reduction does not apply. If at 50% health or higher, the wielder suffers self-damage even if the target dies from the axe blow. Bugs Regarding The Scourge Mistress' Bane: While the item description says 'chance,' Bane is always inflicted on a hit. If the wielder of this axe is at 50% health or higher and they use Non-Lethal Damage to knock out an enemy with it, they will also be knocked out, even if at full HP.
## Ritual Dagger
- **来源**: [Ritual Dagger](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Ritual_Dagger)
- **分类**: Weapons、Daggers

Not to be confused with Ritual Dagger of Shar Ritual Dagger is an uncommon dagger that temporarily Blesses the wielder when dealing damage to an enemy - or to themselves. The leader handle is smooth with use, and slick with fresh blood. Properties Damage 1d4 (1~4) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Details Daggers Rarity: Uncommon Enchantment: None One-Handed Finesse Light Thrown Dippable Consumable by Gale Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.45 kg (0.9 lb) Price: 320 gp UID WPN_GOB_PainPriest_Dagger UUID 11aa209f-6e42-40bd-a12c-aa33445c21ea Stats GOB_PainPriest_Dagger Special The holder of this item gains: Blood Sacrifice ( ) Pain is a path to power. Take 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Slashing damage to receive +1d4 bonus to Attack rolls and Saving throws . The Pain Maiden's Blessing After a successful attack with this dagger, the wielder receives a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws until the end of their next turn. [ See: Bugs ] Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Piercing Strike ( ) Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Shattered Sanctum X: 338 Y: -26 : Near Abdirak or carried by him Notes Depending on when the party members arrive, Abdirak may be carrying it, or it may be on the table or the floor near him. Both effects of this weapon grant the equivalent of a 1-turn duration Bless to the wielder. These do not stack with other Bless effects, or with each other. In comparison to Ritual Axe , the self-damage caused by the dagger is not magical so it can be reduced even by non-magical damage reduction effects like Heavy Armour Master . Bugs Blood Sacrifice generates a Blood surface under the user even if they have Unstable Blood . An Unstable Blood surface would be expected. Regarding The Pain Maiden's Blessing: The description of The Pain Maiden's Blessing erroneously claims that the effect lasts until the end of the next turn, but it is instead removed at the start of it.
## Ritual Dagger of Shar

Not to be confused with Ritual Dagger Ritual Dagger of Shar is an uncommon +1 Dagger that deals an additional 1d4 Necrotic damage. The blade is sharp, and the handle firm. Yet death exudes from this dagger as it might from a fresh corpse. Properties Damage 1d4 + 1 (2~5) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Extra damage 1d4 (1~4) ⁠ Necrotic Details Daggers Rarity: Uncommon Enchantment: + 1 One-Handed Finesse Light Thrown Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.45 kg (0.9 lb) Price: 65 gp UID S_TWN_CentralSquare_RitualDagger UUID 2b07d6f1-d698-47e2-9531-500cbffd9853 Stats TWN_SharDagger Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Piercing Strike ( ) Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Sharran Sanctuary X: 249 Y: -847 : on an altar in a hidden room at the bottom of the sanctuary Notes Picking up this dagger: Is disapproved of by Shadowheart (-1), unless she does this herself. Grants the inspiration ⁠ A Dark Edge for party members with the Criminal background and ⁠ Ruthless Craftsmanship for party members with the Guild Artisan background. Spawns three powerful sentinels that attack the party. The fight with sentinels is still triggered if the dagger is moved from the altar, which also prevents the party from picking up the dagger at all, even after defeating the sentinels – unless it is thrown so Scratch can fetch it. [ verify ] As with most weapons, the extra elemental damage (in this case, 1d4 Necrotic ) is not applied if Thrown .

## Rupturing Blade
- **来源**: [Rupturing Blade](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Rupturing_Blade)
- **分类**: Weapons、Rapiers

Rupturing Blade is an uncommon +1 Rapier that grants the Searing Blood weapon action that deals extra Fire damage on hit, but deals Slashing damage to the wielder. In addition, it also may cause Bleeding and Burning . The point of the rapier is capable of splitting into heated barbs should the wielder device to prick themselves to activate them - sacrifice for reward. Properties Damage 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Details Rapiers Rarity: Uncommon Enchantment: + 1 One-Handed Finesse Dippable Consumable by Gale Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Price: 130 gp UID MAG_OfRupture_Rapier UUID 2d55309e-52ab-4270-9211-e432e4d8fc59 Stats MAG_OfRupture_Rapier Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Piercing Strike ( ) Stab an enemy and possibly inflict Gaping Wounds . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Weakening Strike ( ) Target an enemy's hands with a non-lethal attack and possibly inflict Weak Grip . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Flourish ( ) Feint an attack to possibly throw your opponent Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Searing Blood ( ) Cut into an enemy, dealing an extra Proficiency bonus ⁠ ⁠ Fire and 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage to them, while you yourself take 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Slashing damage. Additionally, the attack might cause the target to Bleed and Burn . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Zhentarim Basement X: 295 Y: -250 : Sold by Brem after completing the quest ⁠ Find the Missing Shipment Notes Regarding Searing Blood: The target makes separate saving throws to avoid Bleeding and Burning . This attack's damage modifiers function as damage rider sources , even in Honour mode . Consequently, riders such as Phalar Aluve: Shriek and Hex trigger separately for the weapon's base damage, the 1d6 fire damage, and the proficiency bonus fire damage. Notably, these bonuses also apply to the 1d6 slashing damage reflected back onto the attacker. Bugs Regarding Searing Blood: The tooltip makes no mention of applying Bleeding and Burning.

## Scythe of Myrkul
- **来源**: [Scythe of Myrkul](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Scythe_of_Myrkul)
- **分类**: Weapons

This article is about content – such as items, spells or equipment – that cannot be used , but can still be accessed or acquired, either in-game or via third party tools. Scythe of Myrkul is a legendary unique variant of the Glaives family of weapons. It is wielded by the Apostle of Myrkul and cannot be wielded others. Simple but sharp. The shaft of this glaive is worn smooth with use. Properties Damage 2d12 (2~24) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Glaives Rarity: Common Enchantment: None Two-Handed Extra Reach Dippable Range: 2.5 m (8 ft) Weight: 2.7 kg (5.4 lb) Price: 65 gp UID WPN_MYRKUL_Apostle_Scythe_A UUID 3112f0f5-4073-45d2-8e37-eeafa1558896 Stats WPN_Apostle_Scythe Special The holder of this item gains: Only useable by the Apostle of Myrkul Reaper's Scythe : Swing your weapon in a large arc that knocks targets back 3 m / 10 ft and deals an additional 3d6 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic . Notes This item is used by the the Apostle of Myrkul and under normal gameplay conditions cannot be acquired. An Oathbreaker Paladin levelled up to level 12 (e.g., by using mods, cheats, or – possibly – meticulous XP management [ verify ] ) before facing the apostle, can use Control Undead on Ketheric Thorm . Level 12 is salient here because Control Undead requires the target's level be under the user's level, and Ketheric is level 11. [ verify ] Killing him while under this condition causes him to drop the scythe. However doing this severely hampers the party and also softlocks the game under most circumstances, as Ketheric's body does not appear, and his Netherstone cannot be obtained. This also likely results in the party being unable to leave the Mind Flayer Colony . However, if Ketheric is killed using the method listed above, a party member can ring the Filigreed Feywild Bell and insult Dolly Dolly Dolly , prompting her to polymorph them; in turn circumventing the restriction on fast traveling out of the colony. ## Selûne's Spear of Night
- **来源**: [Selûne's Spear of Night](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Selûne's_Spear_of_Night)
- **分类**: Weapons、Spears

Not to be confused with Spear of Night and Shar's Spear of Evening Selûne's Spear of Night is a legendary +3 Spear which allows the wielder to cast Moonbeam and grants Darkvision as well as Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and Perception Checks. 'One of the goddess Selûne's titles, Moonmaiden, has often been debated among the ecclesiastical. Common symbology certainly rejects the assumption of virginity. More to the point, 'maiden' itself carries some dusty connotations. How about Lunar Lady? Keeps the alliteration, too' - Margaery Henderplum Properties One-handed damage 1d6 + 3 (4~9) + Strength modifier ⁠ Piercing Two-handed damage 1d8 + 3 (4~11) + Strength modifier ⁠ Piercing Details Spears Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 3 Versatile Thrown Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.35 kg (2.7 lb) Price: 640 gp UID MAG_SHA_SeluneBlessing_Spear UUID 2eeabe97-8f29-4f4f-827e-6cfcd8fd1779 Stats MAG_SHA_SeluneBlessing_Spear Special The holder of this item gains: Moonbeam ( ) Cast as a level 3 spell ( Recharge: Long rest .) Moonmote ( ) Illuminate the area around you with wisps of moonish light that make movement difficult for enemies and bolster your allies' damage. ( Recharge: Long rest .) Selûne's Blessing You gain Advantage on Wisdom Saving Throws and Perception Checks. Darkvision Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft). Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Rush Attack ( ) Charge forward and attack the first enemy in your way, possibly pushing them Off Balance . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Maiming Strike ( ) Possibly Maims your target. They can't move. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Given to Shadowheart by Aylin at the campsite Notes Steps for acquisition: Shadowheart must be present in the ⁠ Shadowfell ; she leaves the party upon returning from the Shadowfell if they enter without her and becomes hostile if the party insist on entering the Shadowfell without the Spear of Night in the inventory of the active party. Aylin must survive ⁠ The Chosen of Shar . The player character must speak with Aylin in camp after Ketheric is defeated. Regarding Darkvision: The actual distance of Darkvision often depends on the creature that has this feature. The values above are the default for playable races. When a hiding creature enters the line of sight of a creature with darkvision, and is within the range of darkvision: Being Lightly Obscured counts as being under Clear Area instead. Being Heavily Obscured counts as being Lightly Obscured instead. The same applies to Superior Darkvision , just with a longer range. Also granted by Sarevok's Horned Helmet and Sunwalker's Gift . More information on Darkvision mechanics and its potential combat implications can be found here . Bugs Regarding Darkvision: Normally, a creature gains Advantage when making a ranged attack from within magical Darkness , assuming it can do so via a feature such as Devil's Sight that grants vision in magical darkness. However, if the target of the attack has Darkvision, and the attacker is within the target's Darkvision range, then the attacker gains no advantage. This is despite the fact that Darkvision does not grant vision in magical darkness.

## Shadow Lantern
- **来源**: [Shadow Lantern](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shadow_Lantern)
- **分类**: Weapons、Clubs

The Shadow Lantern is a unique type of Moonlantern which provides a Moonshield and grants the unique Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith spell. Encased in a cocoon of shadow within the lantern, the mangled pixie lies like some deformed pupa, its mouth slack, and those same shadows crawling over its graying tongue. Properties One-handed damage 1d4 (1~4) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d6 (1~6) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Clubs Rarity: Rare Enchantment: None Versatile Light Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Price: 190 gp UID UNI_GLO_Moonlantern_Gale UUID c9ebcfae-8c9a-4acc-8a30-da7830b32121 Stats Quest_GLO_Moonlantern_Gale Special The holder of this item gains: Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith ( ) Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Long rest .) Condition: Moonshield Moonshield Protected by the light of a Moonlantern or Shadow Lantern . The Shadow Curse does not affect this entity. Where to find Moonrise Towers X: -150 Y: -165 : Gale can craft one from a Broken Moonlantern and Dead Pixie at the table within Balthazar's hidden room. Notes Both ingredients can be found in Baltazar's hidden room. See ⁠ Balthazar's Experiment for more information. While in-game dialogue also allows the slim possibility for the player character to craft this item, the option is only available if Gale is present. Merely equipping the lantern in the light source slot is not sufficient to gain the Conjure Shadow Lantern Wraith ability and the Moonshield condition; it must be actively wielded, such as by switching to it via the light source toggle button or equipping it directly in the weapon slot. Although not clear from the flavour text's description, the lantern emits a bright sphere of light when used in a weapon slot, providing full protection from the Shadow Curse . Unequipping the lantern or switching back to active weapons via the light source toggle button automatically dismisses the conjured Shadow . Bugs Despite being tagged as a Rare item, the in-game tooltip for the lantern is coloured as a Story Item , like any other Moonlantern . Despite this spell's name, the creature summoned is a Shadow , not the more powerful Wraith . It is is unable to climb surfaces such as ladders and knotted roots, and is unable to Jump , Fly , or Warp , meaning it may be unable to follow the party to certain areas. Regrouping is possible by entering a new area or using Waypoints . See also [ edit section | visual editor ] Broken Moonlantern Dead Pixie Filigreed Feywild Bell Moonlantern

On-hit reactions such as Divine Smite can be applied to each creature hit by this action (at the cost of multiple spell slots, in the case of Divine Smite). Bugs Regarding Shar's Blessing: Shar's Blessing adds its bonus damage to any weapon attacks against obscured creatures, not just attacks with this spear. The advantage on saving throws only applies to Dexterity saving throws. Regarding Blind Immunity: Despite not stating such in the description, Blind Immunity also allows the wearer to see through magical darkness. Regarding Edge of Darkness: The in-game tooltip for this action is inaccurate and missing key information about it being an AoE attack. The tooltip claims there is an associated Constitution Saving Throw , but this is not true.

## Shattered Flail

- **分类**: Weapons、Maces

Shattered Flail is a rare +2 Mace that heals the wielder when they hit an enemy - at the cost of potentially going mad when they stop attacking. A bundle of bones and blood - and a soul-piercing demonic presence - is all that remains of the Flind's flail. It would make a decent mace with a particularly nasty bite. Properties Damage 1d6 + 2 (3~8) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Maces Rarity: Rare Enchantment: + 2 One-Handed Dippable Consumable by Gale Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 190 gp UID UNI_PLA_ConflictedFlind_Flail_Broken UUID 8a527abd-a2ff-4267-a067-d26bdf6742ee Stats PLA_ConflictedFlind_Flail_Broken Special The holder of this item gains: Yeenoghu's Gift Hitting an enemy with this weapon heals the wielder for 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points - but they can go Mad if they don't continue hitting an enemy each turn. Healing through this item doesn't trigger other passives that react to healing. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Concussive Smash ( ) Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find The Risen Road X: 33 Y: 597 : Carried by Flind , who leads a group of Gnolls in attacking the remaining occupants of the Zhentarim caravan Notes Regarding Yeenoghu's Gift: After hitting a creature with the Shattered Flail , the wielder gains Yeenoghu's Gift for 6 turns. For the duration, they must succeed a DC  10 Wisdom Saving Throw at the end of any turn on which they do not hit an enemy, or go Mad for 1 turn. The Saving Throw rolls made by the wielder of this weapon do not appear in the combat log, but they are in fact being rolled at the end of each turn where the wielder does not damage an enemy . The duration of Yeenoghu's Gift is not refreshed by hitting enemies again; it only lasts the base 6 turns, after which it can be re-applied. While Mad , the wielder is uncontrollably hostile to all nearby creatures, including allies, and uses any and all tools at their disposal to inflict harm. This could include using powerful Ammunition or Consumables from their inventory, casting high level Spells , or shoving allies to their deaths. Although the combat log states "Tav healed self...", this healing does not trigger other items which activate on the character's healing such as Boots of Aid and Comfort , The Whispering Promise or Broodmother's Revenge . The wielder is healed upon each instance of damage . This means that in the case of attacks which deal multiple damage types, such as Booming Blade and Divine Smite (as well as other Smite spells), or in the case of attacks which damage multiple targets, such as Slashing Flourish (Melee) , the wielder is healed multiple times. ## Sickle of BOOOAL
- **来源**: [Sickle of BOOOAL](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Sickle_of_BOOOAL)
- **分类**: Weapons

Sickle of BOOOAL is a rare variant of the Sickles family of weapons. It is a Simple melee weapon wielded in one hand. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. Infused with the inconceivable might of the formidable BOOOAL! Properties Damage 2d4 (2~8) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Sickles Rarity: Rare Enchantment: None One-Handed Light Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Price: 190 gp UID UNI_SickleOfBOOOAL UUID a07f2e91-e084-4fe5-9dbb-ef7de76a3c0a Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Condition: BOOOAL's Blessing BOOOAL's Blessing The wielder has Advantage on Attack Rolls against Bleeding creatures, as long as there are Kuo-toa to worship BOOOAL . Where to find The Festering Cove X: -417 Y: 284 : Carried by Pooldripp the Zealous or given to the player character by BOOOAL Notes To get the Sickle from Boooal, the correct dialog options must be chosen to cause his power to falter, and then the player character must agree to be his Chosen. When first acquired, the weapon has the BOOOAL's Blessing condition attached, but it disappears after long resting with the weapon in the inventory. This can be avoided by dropping or stashing it in a container prior to each long rest. This condition is equivalent to BOOOAL's Benediction that can be acquired permanently from BOOOAL. Choosing other dialog options during the cutscene allows you to kill BOOOAL without the Kuo-toa attacking. Once accomplished, you can purchase the weapon from Pooldripp the Zealous . This can only be done during the initial conversation with Pooldripp after killing BOOOAL, after this you will not be able to barter with him again. The Sickle of BOOOAL deals 2d4 damage, compared to the 1d4 of a normal Sickle . Using the Sickle of BOOOAL as a Monk Weapon will not increase the damage die. It will remain 2d4. ## Silver Sword of the Astral Plane
- **来源**: [Silver Sword of the Astral Plane](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Silver_Sword_of_the_Astral_Plane)
- **分类**: Weapons、Greatswords

Not to be confused with Voss' Silver Sword The Silver Sword of the Astral Plane is a legendary +3 Greatsword which grants its wielder the Soulbreaker weapon action and provides special bonuses when wielded by a githyanki . The fervour with which the githyanki express devotion to their queen is admirable to some, disquieting to others. When confronted with the fallibility of the divine (since no one is wholly perfect), who knows what reactions such folk might evince. Properties Damage 2d6 + 3 (5~15) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Greatswords Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 3 Two-Handed Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 2.7 kg (5.4 lb) Price: 1300 gp UID MAG_GreaterSilver_Greatsword UUID f01c3f5d-c542-420f-86c5-bdddf7819e29 Stats MAG_GreaterSilver_Greatsword Special The holder of this item gains: Githborn Psionic Resistance A githyanki holding this weapon has Advantage on Intelligence , Wisdom , and Charisma Saving Throws , resistance to Psychic damage, and cannot be Charmed . Githborn Psionic Weapon When wielded by a githyanki this weapon deals an additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic damage. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Cleave ( ) Swing your weapon in a large arc to attack up to 3 enemies at once. They each take half the damage your weapon usually deals. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Lacerate ( ) Slash at your target's vital points to make it Bleed . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Pommel Strike ( ) Make a non-lethal attack against an enemy and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Soulbreaker ( ) Rend the enemy's body and soul, dealing additional ⁠ Psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus , and possibly Stun them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Lower City Sewers X: -70 Y: 828 : Rewarded for showing the Orphic Hammer to (or killing) Kith'rak Voss after agreeing to meet him in the sewers within the Undercity in Act Three Notes This sword may also be obtained in Act One , by disarming Voss via Command (Drop) , Heat Metal , Fear , Disarming Attack (Ranged) , Honeyed Paws , or Dirty Trick: Flick o' the Wrist before entering the Mountain Pass X: -139 Y: 561 . Voss must be disarmed before beginning the encounter, as he immediately flies away when any hostile action is taken by the party or its allies, and he locks party members into dialogue when they approach close enough. Due to his high stats, the chance of failing the disarm attempt against him is very high, so this method may require multiple reloads or extensive preparation. See: Guide: Early Silver Sword . Using Honeyed Paws while having a divination wizard with a 15 or higher portent die nearby guarantees that he drops his weapon. It is possible to long rest until getting 15 or higher and then make the bear invisible. After placing a Potion of Invisibility on the ground, the bear companion can drink it and then approach Voss. Sometimes, Voss appears with a Githyanki Crossbow instead of the sword or, when dropped, it simply phases out of existence. The triggers for these anomalies are not known. If Voss appears with a crossbow instead of the sword, this Guide explains how to obtain it. If this sword is obtained in Act One , a second one of this will not be given as a quest reward. Otherwise, this sword can be acquired in Act Three before entering the Lower City during Deal with the Devil . If the party declines or skips signing the contract with Raphael but successfully lies to Voss, he gives the party the sword ( DC 30 Deception Check ). Regarding Githborn Psionic Resistance: In addition to Charmed, Githborn Psionic Resistance blocks all (eighteen) conditions in the Charmed status group. Bugs Regarding Soulbreaker: The additional ⁠ Psychic damage is treated as a separate damage rider source even in Honour Mode . ## Staff of Arcane Blessing
- **来源**: [Staff of Arcane Blessing](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Staff_of_Arcane_Blessing)
- **分类**: Weapons、Quarterstaves

Staff of Arcane Blessing is an uncommon Quarterstaff which grants the wielder the ability to cast Bless . In addition, all Bless spells cast by the wielder grant an additional +1d4 to spell attack rolls. Though dust has settled into every nook and cranny of this staff, it still emanates a soothing aura. Its previous owner cast it aside - forgotten because there was nobody to bless. Properties One-handed damage 1d6 (1~6) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d8 (1~8) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Quarterstaves Rarity: Uncommon Enchantment: None Versatile Dippable Consumable by Gale Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 100 gp UID UNI_UND_Tower_StaffBlessMystra UUID da0ba39a-366d-456b-8dbd-1c5790ca40bf Stats UND_Tower_StaffBlessMystra Special The holder of this item gains: Bless ( ) Cast as a level 1 spell ( Recharge: Long rest .) Mystra's Blessing Creatures you Bless also gain Mystra's Blessing for an additional 1d4 bonus to spell attack rolls. [ See: Bugs ] Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Topple ( ) Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Arcane Tower X: 164 Y: 432 : Leaning against a table in the basement Notes To reach the basement, the player must either convince Bernard on the top floor to leave Guiding Light on a table, or defeat Bernard and take it. The ring can be used to activate a secret button on the tower's teleporter pad to reach the basement. Another way to reach the basement of the Arcane Tower is to go up the stairs behind the generator, use Feather Fall , and jump down to the gap between the wall and the wooden staircase. If the party has a character capable of casting Mage Hand , they can also cast it under the stairs through the same gap, and direct it to operate the switch which will open a hidden door in the wall. Bugs Regarding Mystra's Blessing: The in-game description of this passive feature is not entirely correct, and reads as follows: Bless grants an additional 1d4 to Saving Throws and Weapon Attack Rolls, and an additional 2d4 to Spell Attack Rolls. Instead, creatures Blessed with the Staff of Arcane Blessing gain two separate conditions: The regular Bless condition , which grants a 1d4 bonus to all saving throws and attack rolls. The special Mystra's Blessing condition , which grants another 1d4 bonus, but only to spell attack rolls. Specifically, it is possible to lose the regular Bless condition (due to the caster losing concentration ) while retaining the Mystra's Blessing condition. In this case, the creature is left with a 1d4 bonus to spell attack rolls, but loses the other 1d4 bonuses, despite the tooltip of the condition claiming otherwise. Mystra's Blessing is only applied when Bless is cast using a level 1 or level 2 spell slot, in addition to the once-per-day version granted by the staff itself. ## Staff of Cherished Necromancy

Staff of Cherished Necromancy is a very rare +2 Quarterstaff which greatly enhances Necromancy spells and can use a dead creature's essence to cast a Necromancy spell without costing a spell slot . Unlike their father, Thibault, Cherish Hollow was not afraid of zombies. Cherish was afraid of sharks, liquorice, wallpaper, Netherese artifacts, hats (large), the outdoors, the indoors, hats (small), and milk pails. Zombies were a bloody picnic. Properties One-handed damage 1d6 + 2 (3~8) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Two-handed damage 1d8 + 2 (3~10) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Extra damage 1d4 (1~4) ⁠ Necrotic Details Quarterstaves Rarity: Very rare Enchantment: + 2 Versatile Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 480 gp UID MAG_GreaterNecromancy_Staff UUID ecb02247-a407-445e-8046-856133d198bf Stats MAG_GreaterNecromancy_Staff Special The holder of this item gains: Heightened Necromancy Creatures have Disadvantage on Saving Throws against your necromancy spells . Life Essence Harvest When the wielder kills a hostile creature with a spell, they greedily absorb its energy and gain Life Essence until their next Long Rest. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Topple ( ) Swipe at a creature to knock it Prone . ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Philgrave's Mansion X: 14 Y: -160 : Carried by Mystic Carrion Notes Regarding Heightened Necromancy: Any Necromancy spell that has a saving throw benefits from Heightened Necromancy. These are: Bursting Sinew Toll the Dead Ray of Sickness Blindness Ethel's Ray of Sickness Bestow Curse Paralyzing Ray Ray of Fear Wounding Ray Beckoning Darkness Blight Dethrone Circle of Death Eyebite Harm Regarding Life Essence Harvest: Life Essence Harvest has no cooldown and can be triggered without limit. Killing a creature with a spell granted from Life Essence does not provide a new charge of Life Essence . Indirect spell damage from sources like Spirit Guardians does not provide a charge of Life Essence when killing a hostile creature. Per the GreaterNecromancySpellFilter() .khn script, this effect is intended to allow the casting of an extra Necromancy spell only if the spell level is equal to or lower than the number of Life Essence turns the wielder has. However, this restriction is currently non-functional, and any level of Necromancy spell can be cast using the effect. Though none of the tooltips explicitly mention this functionality, Life Essence displays the number of turns the wielder has on its tooltip. Bugs Regarding Life Essence Harvest: Casting a Necromancy cantrip consumes the Life Essence Harvest charge, even though the character's cast bar does not highlight the cantrip to indicate it will use the effect.

Another method to force the game to spawn the staff with the additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage is to duplicate it using the Invoke Duplicity exploit.

The description of the item in Baldur's Gate 3 refers to the events of the storyline of the previous game. Regarding Chaos: Chaos does not trigger when damaging items. On-heal effects such as Blessed Mercy do not trigger through Chaos either. The wielder is healed upon each instance of damage. This means that in the case of attacks which deal multiple damage types, such as Booming Blade and Divine Smite (as well as other Smite spells), or in the case of attacks which damage multiple targets, such as Slashing Flourish (Melee) , the wielder is healed multiple times. The in-game description says "On a hit, regain 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points .". ## The Baneful
- **来源**: [The Baneful](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/The_Baneful)
- **分类**: Weapons、Shortswords

The Baneful is a rare +1 shortsword that applies the Bane condition on hit. This blade's magical powers only function if it's Bound to an Eldritch Knight or is a Warlock's Pact Weapon . The wizard Otiluke wrote about bound weapons and their propensity to coalesce with their wielder as the pair come together. He also wrote about their dangers, which are manifold, and their benefits, which make the danger worth it. ## The Blood of Lathander
- **来源**: [The Blood of Lathander](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/The_Blood_of_Lathander)
- **分类**: Weapons、Maces

The Blood of Lathander is a legendary + 3 Mace found through the ⁠ Find the Blood of Lathander quest. It continuously sheds light, blinds nearby Fiends and Undead with its light, can prevent death as well as heal its wielder, and allows the wielder to cast Sunbeam . Properties Damage 1d6 + 3 (4~9) + Strength modifier ⁠ Bludgeoning Details Maces Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 3 One-Handed Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 640 gp UID S_CRE_BloodOfLathander UUID e26f0c19-6185-43a7-b7f7-7155b936c59c Stats CRE_BloodOfLathander UID UNI_CRE_HUM_Sun_Mace_BloodOfLathander UUID 96a35552-0c05-4df0-9974-2a8f142e4be6 Stats CRE_BloodOfLathander UID WPN_HUM_Sun_Mace_Lathander_Blood_A_Glow UUID 7b961f08-46c1-46b1-99bc-c59283831a0b Stats CRE_BloodOfLathander Special The holder of this item gains: Sunbeam ( ) Cast as a level 6 spell ( Recharge: Long rest .) Lathander's Blessing Once per Long Rest , when your hit points are reduced to 0, you regain 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Allies within 9 m (30 ft) also regain 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Lathander's Light Sheds holy light in a 6 m (20 ft) radius. In combat, fiends and undead standing in the light are Blinded if they fail a DC 14 Constitution throw. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Concussive Smash ( ) Hit an enemy with all your might to deal damage and possibly Daze them. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Crèche Y'llek X: 1068 Y: -779 : On a locked altar in the Secret Chamber Notes The version of Sunbeam granted by this item does not allow recasting on subsequent turns. Despite being considered a mace, its appearance is more akin to a morningstar . Within the game files, this item has multiple variations with different names, but same functionality: UUID: 96a35552-0c05-4df0-9974-2a8f142e4be6 (Blood of Lathander). This version of the item has a quote unlike the ingame version, which may have been intended for the usable version: The large chunk of amber set into the handle of this luminous mace supposedly holds four drops of godly blood, fallen to the earth in a battle between an avatar of Lathander and a maddened Chosen of Mystra. UUID: 7b961f08-46c1-46b1-99bc-c59283831a0b (Dawngrip Mace). This is the current usable variant. Regarding Lathander's Blessing: Lathander's Blessing does not activate if the wielder is not in the active party. For example, a companion who is left at camp and receives damage via Warding Bond which reduces their hit points to zero does not cause this effect to trigger. Lathander's Blessing does not protect against being shoved, thrown, or otherwise forcibly displaced into chasms. Regarding Lathander's Light: Unlike Light , the Lathander's Light condition works even when wielding a ranged weapon. The light emitted by Lathander's Light has the following properties: It does not apply to allies, meaning you won't blind your own summoned undead. It dispels the Shadow Curse , removing the need to equip a Torch . It enables effects that require the target be illuminated, such as applying the damage from the Callous Glow Ring . It is considered sunlight for the purpose of triggering Sunlight Hypersensitivity but is not for Sunlight Sensitivity . It applies to neutral creatures (including neutral Undead ), potentially making them hostile. Bugs Regarding Lathander's Blessing: Lathander's Blessing does not heal allies of the wielder, but rather only active party members nearby. Due to the way the heal is coded, the attacker who triggered Lathander's Blessing is considered to be the source of the healing. As a result, the healing will not trigger on-heal effects such as Blessed Mercy from The Whispering Promise when equipped by the wielder. Due to an incorrectly set TargetConditions field, the additional 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points affects the wielder in addition to the 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . Due to a timing limitation caused by the method in which healing is applied, the wielder may not always receive all of the healing they are stated to have received in the combat log; they often receive only 1 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points (from being stabilized) or 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points , rather than the stated 1d6+2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points . It is also possible for the wielder to receive healing, yet still remain dead, showing their lootable corpse with remaining hitpoints. Due to a missing technical condition ( MAG_LATHANDERS_TRACKER ) resulting from The Blood of Lathander being spawned in-game via a "Local Item", this passive's "Once per Long Rest" cooldown only refreshes for the wielder during a Long Rest. Equipping the weapon on another character that did not wield the weapon during a Long Rest does not allow this passive to trigger. Additionally, Lathander's Blessing is not reset when consuming a Potion of Angelic Slumber or when affected by Divine Intervention: Opulent Revival . ## The Clover

This article is about content that is inaccessible through normal gameplay . It can still be accessed via in-game exploits or third party tools. The Clover is a legendary, moderately enchanted (+2) special variant of the Scimitars family of weapons. It is a martial melee weapon wielded in one hand. As a finesse weapon, it can benefit from the wielder's Dexterity and not just their Strength. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. Properties Damage 1d6 (1~6) + Strength or Dexterity modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Scimitars Rarity: Legendary Enchantment: + 2 One-Handed Finesse Light Dippable Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 0.9 kg (1.8 lb) Price: gp UID MAG_TheClover_Scimitar UUID 517231eb-e812-43ed-9ce3-482ba7ed31e6 Special The holder of this item gains: Armour Class +1 (Off-Hand Only) True Strike ( ) Cast as a cantrip ( Recharge: Short rest .) Organ Rearranger Reduce the number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking by 1. This effect can stack. When you roll 2 damage or less, reroll the dice, taking the highest result. Main Hand Only Exploit Weakness Creatures hit with this weapon receive Vulnerability to ⁠ Piercing damage. Off-Hand Only True Strike Riposte When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may retaliate and gain True Strike . Regarding Organ Rearranger: Organ Rearranger stacks with other passive effects that improve critical chance, including ranged attacks and spell attack rolls [3] [4] . Organ Rearranger's damage reroll is only applied to melee weapon attacks. When dual-wielding melee weapons, both weapons will benefit. All damage dice attached to an attack can be rerolled, not just the weapon's base damage die. The damage reroll is not normally applied to any other attack type, including throw attacks using the Knife of the Undermountain King itself. However, Organ Rearranger's damage reroll does stack with itself (via a second Knife of the Undermountain King due to the King's Knife or Invoke Duplicity bugs) or dual wielding with Twist of Fortune . The improvement of the second reroll is smaller than the first one. Regarding Exploit Weakness: Exploit Weakness is only applied by Bloodthirst and only when used in melee combat; throwing this weapon does not apply the passive. Regarding True Strike Riposte: The retalitory attack granted by True Strike Riposte expends a Reaction resource. Gallery [ edit section | visual editor ] Concept art by Châu Nguyễn Thị Hoài

## Titanstring Bow
- **来源**: [Titanstring Bow](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Titanstring_Bow)
- **分类**: Weapons

Titanstring Bow is a rare +1 Longbow that allows its wielder to add their Strength Modifier to damage dealt with this weapon. The commonly held belief that archers are rangey, thin-wristed people is completely false. It takes years of training to pull a bowstring all the way back to your cheekbone, and wrists like iron. Properties Damage 1d8 + 1 (2~9) + Dexterity modifier ⁠ Piercing Details Longbows Rarity: Rare Enchantment: + 1 Two-Handed Dippable Range: 18 m (60 ft) Weight: 1.1 kg (2.2 lb) Price: 310 gp / 400 gp H Honour UID MAG_StrongString_Longbow UUID 13236988-83df-4bf2-8005-b4ac31f21ff4 Stats MAG_StrongString_Longbow Special The holder of this item gains: Titan Weapon This weapon deals additional damage equal to your Strength Modifier . Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Brace (Ranged) ( ) Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement . For the rest of your turn, roll ranged damage twice and use the highest result. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Hamstring Shot ( ) Shoot an enemy in the thigh and possibly reduce their movement speed by 50%. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Special weapon actions This weapon also grants the following: Pushing Attack (Ranged) ( ) Pushes your target back 4.5 m (15 ft). ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Zhentarim Basement X: 295 Y: -250 : Sold by Brem after completing the quest ⁠ Find the Missing Shipment Moonrise Towers X: -164 Y: -167 : Sold by Lann Tarv on the main floor, only if Brem's special stock was not unlocked before by completing ⁠ Find the Missing Shipment Notes Regarding Titan Weapon: Titan Weapon adds a minimum of +1 to the damage roll, even if the attacker has a Strength of 11 or lower. The bonus damage is in addition to the normal Dexterity bonus for ranged weapons. The bonus damage can be applied multiple times to a single ranged weapon attack. For example, special arrows with additional damage will receive the bonus to its additional damage, e.g. the additional Necrotic damage from Arrow of Ilmater will also receive bonus Necrotic damage equal to your Strength modifier. Another example is a rogue's Sneak Attack when used as a reaction. This is mostly changed in Honour mode , but the bonus damage can still apply to special arrows. The bonus damage applies to most Arcane Shots . Notably, Arcane Shot: Seeking Arrow and Arcane Shot: Piercing Arrow do not apply the bonus damage due to the lack of attack rolls for these actions. Regarding Pushing Attack (Titanstring Bow): The knockback is a separate Weapon Action DC Strength Saving Throw which can fail even if the attack roll succeeds. This weapon action can still be used even if the wielder is not proficient with Longbows. Bugs Regarding Titan Weapon: Titan Weapon has an extra description that states "The weapon only adds the modifier if it improves your chance to hit." but this has no actual function/relevance. The bonus damage from Strength is not reflected on the character sheet or Ranged Attack tooltip. Regarding Pushing Attack (Titanstring Bow): Despite the game's tooltip mentioning Superiority Dice, this ability neither requires nor consumes them. ## Twisted Oak Crook
- **来源**: [Twisted Oak Crook](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Twisted_Oak_Crook)
- **分类**: Weapons、Quarterstaves

Twisted Oak Crook is a common, lightly enchanted (+1) variant of the Quarterstaves family of weapons. It is a simple melee weapon that can be wielded in one hand, or with both hands for extra damage. It's a light weapon that anyone can dual-wield without special training. ## Undead Slayer Crossbow
- **来源**: [Undead Slayer Crossbow](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Undead_Slayer_Crossbow)

This article is about content that is inaccessible through normal gameplay . It can still be accessed via in-game exploits or third party tools. See also: The Long Arm of the Gur The Undead Slayer Crossbow is a rare +2 Heavy Crossbow that grants a bonus to Attack Rolls and Damage Rolls against Undead targets. When the boy was seven, he was frightened badly by a vampire spawn during a public burning. Seized by the flames, the creature didn't shrivel up. It swelled and burst like a squeezed leech. Brains splattered the boy's shoes, grey-pink and pulpy. He would never forget it. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Brace (Ranged) ( ) Spend 6 m (20 ft) of your movement . For the rest of your turn, roll ranged damage twice and use the highest result. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Notes Can be obtained by recruiting a hireling, having them equip The Long Arm of the Gur , dismissing them to the Fugue Plane, then recruiting them again. Properties One-handed damage 1d8 + 2 (3~10) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Two-handed damage 1d10 + 2 (3~12) + Strength modifier ⁠ Slashing Details Battleaxes Rarity: Rare Enchantment: + 2 Versatile Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft) Weight: 1.8 kg (3.6 lb) Price: 310 gp UID MAG_Vicious_Battleaxe UUID 3ff89075-1ef3-487e-b456-a1b536fd681a Stats MAG_Vicious_Battleaxe Special The holder of this item gains: Dolor Amarus When you land a Critical Hit with a weapon or unarmed attack, [ See: Bugs ] it deals an additional 7 damage. Weapon actions If you have proficiency , equip in main hand to gain: Cleave ( ) Swing your weapon in a large arc to attack up to 3 enemies at once. Maiming Strike ( ) Possibly Maims your target. They can't move. ( Recharge: Short rest .) Where to find Murder Tribunal X: -1263 Y: 511 : Sold by Echo of Abazigal Notes The player character can only purchase the Vicious Battleaxe from the Echo of Abazigal if they accept becoming an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal . However, it can also be acquired through an exploit – see notes on the Echo of Abazigal page for details. Regarding Dolor Amarus (passive feature): Dolor Amarus applies to all weapon attacks while a weapon with the feature is equipped, and it can be activated multiple times if multiple weapons with the passive are equipped. For example, if both Dolor Amarus daggers are equipped '"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001E-QINU`"' or one dagger and the Vicious Battleaxe on a character with Dual Wielder '"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001E-QINU`"' together with the Vicious Shortbow , when the wielder lands a critical hit, then +21 damage will be added, instead of +7. Dolor Amarus also stacks on multiple damage riders, which could potentially lead to massive bonuses from different damage sources. The name dolor amarus is Latin for "harsh suffering" or "bitter sorrow". Bugs Regarding Dolor Amarus (passive feature): Despite the description, Dolor Amarus does not deal an additional 7 damage on unarmed attack critical hits (including Throw attacks).
