## Feed the Mind Flayer
- **来源**: [Feed the Mind Flayer](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Feed_the_Mind_Flayer)
- **分类**: Quests

A newly born Mind Flayer. Feed the Mind Flayer is a Quest in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with the starving mind flayer in Rivington . Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 2.1 Suitable corpses 3 Companion approval 4 Quest rewards Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Kill a humanoid and pick up the body. A ravenous mind flayer asked us to bring it a humanoid to feast on. Bring the body to the mind flayer. We killed a humanoid for the mind flayer - hopefully this will sate its hunger. Quest Complete We defeated the mind flayer. We convinced the starving mind flayer to hunt for its food. We left without helping the mind flayer. The now-sated mind flayer granted us a boon of psionic power. Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] Abandoned Windmill Screaming can be heard from the Abandoned Windmill in Rivington at X: 44 Y: -32 . Lockpicking the old rusty door allows the party to investigate. A hatch leads to the windmill basement, with an unconscious Mind Flayer within. Interacting with the Mind Flayer provides the following options: It doesn't feel very fortunate. Wake the newborn mind flayer. [BARBARIAN]  WAKE UP, SQUIDFACE [GREAT OLD ONE]  Connect your mind to this fledging aberration - wake it up. [PALADIN]  This abomination's existence pollutes the very thin air - try to end it. Attack the creature before it wakes up. [STEALTH]  Sneak away.  (DC 10) Choosing to attack the creature immediately starts combat with a level 8 mind flayer. Killing it provides a Mind Flayer Brain , which can be consumed, as well as a Windmill Key, Ring of Truthfulness , a random gemstone, and Absolute Orders: Newborn . Consuming the brain grants one illithid potential. Killing the mind flayer also earns the inspiration ⁠ Kill 'Em While They're Young for party members with the Haunted One background. If choosing to wake the newborn, the party can hear its demands. It explains it needs a fresh brain to feed on, and can be answered in several ways: I'll see what I can do. I can fetch you a corpse, freshly killed. Brain intact. I never work for free. Offer the mind flayer the body you're carrying.   (if carrying a corpse) [PERSUASION]  Go find your own meal! Even weakened you're more powerful than anything out there. (DC 15) [PALADIN] [DRUID]  I will not let you feed on anything in this city, aberration. I'm not going to bring you food. Attack! Suitable corpses [ edit section | visual editor ] Dead Refugee which can be fed to the Mind Flayer. If agreeing to help, a corpse must be found; any will suffice, including from killing random characters. Existing corpse options include: A dead refugee near the Ironforge Gnome hideout at X: 45 Y: 66 A murdered refugee in the Well in front of Sword Coast Couriers Brilgor buried behind the Open Hand Temple at X: -106 Y: -19 Father Lorgan in the Open Hand Temple at X: -57 Y: -22 Ffion Goldgrind on the upper levels of Fraygo's Flophouse at X: -13 Y: 76 The party must pick up the corpse and bring it back to the Mind Flayer, to be rewarded with one skill point for the Illithid Powers tree and the following inspiration: ⁠ Newfound Subject ( Noble backgrounds) ⁠ Unexpected Parenting ( Haunted One backgrounds) If fed, it leaves the windmill after a long rest. It later re-appears in Armbrust's Home in the Lower City , killing Tym Armbrust and his family. The Mind Flayer can still be killed for its brain after giving it a corpse, but consuming it at this point does not grant an additional illithid skill point. If persuaded to get its own meal, the mind flayer leaves to hunt with no further reward. This results in the death of nearby picnicker Sloncha Owena and the disappearance of her beau Bogdan Vortleson . ## Find a Cure
- **来源**: [Find a Cure](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Find_a_Cure)
- **分类**: Quests

The crashsite of Nautiloid in Act One Find a Cure is the main Quest in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3, and contains multiple related sub-quest within it. It is automatically added to the journal after completing the Prologue . Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 2.1 Get Help from Healer Nettie 2.2 Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help 2.3 Get Help from Auntie Ethel 2.4 Rescue the Druid Halsin 2.5 Help Omeluum investigate the parasite 2.6 Find the Githyanki Crèche 2.7 Moonrise Towers and Beyond 3 Related quests Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Objectives and journal entries may vary pending story decisions and outcomes. Find a way to remove the mind flayer parasite. "We've escaped the Hells on the nautiloid and crashed somewhere back in the Material Plane. We need to explore the area and find a healer." "There could be several ways to get rid of the parasite. Lae'zel, the githyanki who helped us escape the nautiloid, thinks finding a Githyanki Crèche is our best solution." "Lae'zel is now gone and she couldn't lead us to the githyanki cure." "We used the purifier Lae'zel told us about, but it didn't work - the parasite is still in our heads." "We found people taking refuge in a grove. We should explore it - there might be a healer inside." "We learned that there is a healer named Nettie in the grove. Maybe she can help us." "Nettie died before she could cure us of our parasites." "We learned that the leader of the druids is a powerful healer named Halsin. He might be able to help us remove the parasite." "Nettie couldn't help us. Instead, she poisoned us with deadly venom - hoping to kill us before we turned into mind flayers." "The druid Halsin believed that the parasites originated from a place called Moonrise Towers. We should investigate." "Halsin's magic is powerless against the parasite, but the druid said we might have a chance at a dark place called Moonrise Towers." "Halsin was defeated before he could help us find a cure for the parasite." "An old woman told us she could help us with our tadpole problem. We should follow up on this." "Auntie Ethel tried to cure us but failed. She told us the parasite had been empowered with Netherese magic." "Auntie Ethel died before she could help us with the parasite." "We met some cultists who worship a deity called the Absolute. One of them could telepathically communicate with us - which means they were infected too." "A goblin priestess apparently possesses some powerful healing spells. She might be able to help." "Instead of healing us, Priestess Gut imprisoned us - to watch us while we transform." "Priestess Gut died before she had a chance to help us." "A friendly mind flayer might know a way to remove the parasite." "Omeluum died before it could examine the parasite." "The mind flayer's potion didn't help us - it strengthened our parasite instead." Find the source of the parasite. "Our chance of finding a cure seems to be diminishing as we continue our journey - but we must press on." "It is clear that the parasites are coming from Moonrise Towers. Infiltrating the Towers and finding the source of this evil may be our only chance of finding a cure." Quest Complete "This is a far greater plot than we had imagined - one spearheaded by the Chosen of the Dead Three and involving an elder brain. We must overcome this greater evil if we wish to heal ourselves once and for all." Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] As the overarching main-quest, this questline is progressed by completing the various sub quests associated with it. Several of these sub-quests can be progressed in any order, except for Find the Githyanki Creche. Get Help from Healer Nettie [ edit section | visual editor ] The party can learn about Nettie by speaking with Nymessa and Damays as part of ⁠ Free Lae'zel , or by speaking to Zevlor after entering the Druid Grove for the first time. This starts ⁠ Get Help from Healer Nettie . As one of the earliest healers the party can encounter, they can seek her out. Nettie is within the Inner Sanctum of the Druid Grove, where she is healing an injured bird. After telling Nettie that the party members are infected, she asks them to move to a more private room where a Dissected Drow with a tadpole can be found. She explains that she has seen victims with tadpoles and that she and Master Halsin were researching them. Unfortunately, she does not have the ability to cure the party of their tadpoles, but believes Halsin would be the best possible option. Depending on how the party treat Nettie, she may attempt to poison them and may have to be killed to exit the room. If being honest with her, she gives the party a Wyvern Poison and asks that they promise to drink it if they begin to transform. The party can only leave peacefully if they agree. Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help [ edit section | visual editor ] Priestess Gut can be learned of by speaking to Sazza in the Makeshift Prison of the Druid Grove or by speaking with the guards at the entrance to the Shattered Sanctum in the Goblin Camp . This starts ⁠ Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help . The goblins all emphasize the power of Gut and how she can heal anything. As another option, the party can seek out her skills. Speaking to Gut, the player character can allow her to commune with their tadpole, using her own. By searching through their memories, Gut then realizes the player character was kidnapped aboard a mind flayer ship and infected. Surprised by this information, she asks they follow her to her private room. She claims that she can cure them, but actually offers a sleeping potion. If the player character is not resistant to sleeping potions (e.g. elves, drow, etc.) and drinks it, they wake up chained up in the Defiled Temple's prison cell. Gut arrives and annouces that she plans to make them her "squiddy pet." If the player character fails to break free or does nothing, they are rescued by Korrilla , who kills Gut and her ogre servant, Polma . Get Help from Auntie Ethel [ edit section | visual editor ] Auntie Ethel can first be found in The Hollow where she sells lotions and potions . If spoken with, she says they do not look well and asks what is the matter. The party can be honest about their tadpole infection, to which she says she can help, but she does not have the tools in the Grove. She tells the party to meet her at her teahouse in the Sunlit Wetlands and that she will help them out. This starts ⁠ Get Help from Auntie Ethel . Ethel can also be met on the path to the Sunlit Wetlands, south of the Blighted Village , where she is arguing with two men. Once at Ethel's Riverside Teahouse , she reveals herself to be a hag . She says she has removed tadpoles before and can do it again for one of their "pretty little peepers." If the player character takes the bargain, the permanent condition Paid the Price is acquired. However, Ethel is not able to remove the tadpole because they are enchanted by Netherese magic. If argued with over this, she rebuffs that they never told her about the magic and held up her part of the bargain. Rescue the Druid Halsin [ edit section | visual editor ] Talking to one of the main characters in the Emerald Grove (e.g. Rath or Zevlor ) reveals that Halsin, the First Druid of the grove, may heal the party but has gone missing. This starts ⁠ Rescue the Druid Halsin and also ⁠ Save the First Druid . Halsin was was kidnapped by goblins after a failed expedition, led by Aradin , and can be found in the Worg Pens of the Goblin Camp, where he is wild-shaped as a Cave Bear . A group of goblin children are throwing rocks at him. The party can intervene, which results in a fight. After this, Halsin can be spoken to and explains what he knows about the tadpoles: he does not have the power to cure them, but he has been extensively researching them and knows they are tied to the cult of The Absolute . He has been tracking the cult's movements and knows they are headed towards Moonrise Towers , which he advises as the party's next destination. If the party complete ⁠ Defeat the Goblins and side with the druids and tieflings against the goblins, Halsin offers to join the party on their journey to Moonrise Towers. Help Omeluum investigate the parasite [ edit section | visual editor ] In the myconid settlement in the Underdark the party can come across a friendly hobgoblin trader named Blurg at Ebonlake Grotto . If the party tell him that they are infected with tadpoles, he calls for his partner, a mind flayer named Omeluum as someone with expertise on the subject. Omeluum is surprised the party members have not transformed yet and suggests that he might commune with their tadpoles. It tells the party it can make a concoction of Tongues of Madness and Timmask Spores to connect to the tadpoles. These rare ingredients can be found in the Arcane Tower to the south. This starts ⁠ Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite . If the party bring back the ingredients, it performs the procedure, but the tadpole only gets stronger. Still seeking to aid the party, Omeluum offers to trade them for a rare Ring of Mind-Shielding , which it and others of his kind had been using to evade the Elder Brain . Find the Githyanki Crèche [ edit section | visual editor ] If Lae'zel is recruited, she insists that a githyanki crèche will have a cure. She refers to the process as "purification" and states the Zaith'isk is a sacred device which can cure the infected of their tadpoles. This starts ⁠ Find the Githyanki Crèche . The party can find a crèche at the Rosymorn Monastery Trail , inside Rosymorn Monastery . Within the infirmary of Crèche Y'llek is Ghustil Stornugoss , who claims she can purify the party - if they tell her they are infected. Unfortunately, through the process of "purification", it is revealed that the Zaith'isk is not a device of healing: it simply extracts the memories of the infected and then kills them. Whoever steps in the Zaith'isk must pass three Saving Throws to prevent persistent debuffs: -2 to Wisdom, Intellect, and Constitution, respectively. Passing all three saves awards the permanent Awakened buff. Any debuffs acquired can be cured by consuming a Mind Flayer Parasite . Moonrise Towers and Beyond [ edit section | visual editor ] The party ultimately must travel to Moonrise Towers - either through the ⁠ Underdark or through the ⁠ Rosymorn Monastery Trail , to learn more about the Cult of the Absolute in hopes of curing the tadpoles. This leads to the conclusion that the cult must be defeated in order to have any hope of destroying the tadpoles - not just for the party, but for all of the infected. ## Find a Way into Wyrm's Rock Fortress
- **来源**: [Find a Way into Wyrm's Rock Fortress](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Find_a_Way_into_Wyrm's_Rock_Fortress)
- **分类**: Quests

The Flaming Fists block the way to Wyrm's Rock Find a Way into Wyrm's Rock fortress is a quest in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by approaching the Wyrm's Rock Fortress gate from Wyrm's Crossing . Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 2.1 Getting in the Front Door 2.1.1 Valeria's Pass 2.1.2 Stealing an Admission Pass from Arfur Gregorio 2.1.3 Taking an Admission Pass from the Nymph's Grotto 2.1.4 Duke Ravengard's Report 2.1.5 Convincing the Guards 2.2 Breaking into Wyrm's Rock 3 Quest rewards Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Find a way to get into Wyrm's Rock Fortress. Wyrm's Rock is closed due to the ordination of Gortash - who is about to become Archduke of Baldur's Gate . There must be someone, or something, in Wyrm's Crossing that could help us gain entry. Enter Wyrm's Rock Fortress through the secret entrance. We found a map that details a secret entrance into Wyrm's Rock. That could be our way in. Enter Wyrm's Rock Fortress. We found a report for Duke Ravengard at the Posthouse. This should let us enter Wyrm's Rock. We have an admission pass to the ordination. This should let us enter Wyrm's Rock. Valeria gave us an admission pass to the ordination. This should let us enter Wyrm's Rock. We convinced the guards to let us into Wyrm's Rock for Gortash's coronation. Quest Complete We made our way into Wyrm's Rock, where Gortash is about to become Archduke. Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] There are a variety of ways to enter Wyrm's Rock Fortress. Only one of them needs to be pursued to gain entry to the fortress. Getting in the Front Door [ edit section | visual editor ] Blaze Elin guarding the entrance to Wyrm's Rock. The party can walk in through the gate by speaking to Blaze Elin at the gate at X: 6 Y: 155 . Based on the party's actions before approaching the guards, they have the following dialogue options: The following dialogue options offer a possibility to pass Elin's cordon without any obstacles: See this? I've been invited to the ordination.  (if the Admission Pass was obtained) As you can see, I have an urgent dispatch for Duke Ravengard.  (if the Urgent Report for Duke Ravengard was taken from the Sword Coast Couriers ) Investigator Valeria needs me in the Lower City - a serial killer's on the loose.  (if the Lower City Pass was given by Valeria) Provide the pass you took from Valeria.   (if the Lower City Pass was pick pocketed from Valeria) Valeria's Pass [ edit section | visual editor ] Valeria directs the party to Elfsong Tavern Valeria is an inspector involved in the ⁠ Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders quest. She is initially encountered in the Open Hand Temple X: -44 Y: -6 . After this, Valeria can be found drinking upstairs in Sharess' Caress at X: 24 Y: 92 . If finding enough information to exonerate Brilgor of Father Lorgan's murder, and finding the murder list in Fraygo's Flophouse , then Valeria refers the party to speak to Devella Fountainhead at the Elfsong Tavern and provides a pass to the Lower City to allow them entrance. Stealing an Admission Pass from Arfur Gregorio [ edit section | visual editor ] Arfur Gregorio , the Toymaker, carries an admission pass. He can first be encountered in front of Arfur's Mansion X: 11 Y: -95 . If Arfur is allowed back in his mansion, then he is inside. If the refugees remain in the mansion, then he is on the first floor of Sharess' Caress at X: 21 Y: 75 . Arfur at Sharess' Caress. During ⁠ Investigate the Suspicious Toys , Arfur can be confronted with the blackmail letter found in his mansion's basement . After entering the basement through the hatch X: 40 Y: -72 , the blackmail letter can be found in a heavy chest at the southeastern corner of the room at X: 361 Y: -990 . If Arfur is told I found some rather sinister things in your basement, followed up by I'll get to the bottom of this one way or another, Arfur becomes hostile and attacks the party. In this case, the pass can be looted off his body. The explosives in the Requisitioned Barn. After finding the blackmail letter, the party can speak to Manip Nestor at the Requisitioned Barn at X: 66 Y: -112 and persuade him to look into the barn for dangerous items. Arfur's explosive teddy bears can be found at the back of the barn X: 83 Y: -108 . If speaking with Arfur after this, and telling him about his teddy bears, he can be intimidated into giving more information on his bosses. If he is spared after this, he gives the party his coronation pass, or the pass can be pickpocketed off Arfur. Taking an Admission Pass from the Nymph's Grotto [ edit section | visual editor ] An admission pass can be found inside Nymph's Grotto on the Upper Floor of Sharess' Caress. The pass is in front of the bath at X: 28 Y: 94 . This pass presumably belonged to Fist Jara before she turned into a Mind Flayer . Taking this pass does not count as stealing. Duke Ravengard's Report [ edit section | visual editor ] Report for Duke Ravengard at Sword Coast Couriers. A report on Duke Ravengard can be found at Sword Coast Couriers X: 15 Y: 12 - on a cupboard behind Danzo Arkwright . If this letter is stolen, it can be shown to the guards to get by. Convincing the Guards [ edit section | visual editor ] The party can attempt to convince the guards to let them pass by passing extraordinarily high Persuasion or Deception checks: [PERSUASION]  I'm here to protect Archduke-Elect Gortash. (DC 30) [OATH OF THE CROWN] [PERSUASION]  It is my sworn duty to protect the Archduke-Elect. (DC 30  ) [DECEPTION]  An assassin is in pursuit of Duke Ravengard! I need to warn him! (DC 30) [WARLOCK] [DECEPTION]  I am Lord Gortash's new occultist - let me pass or your name goes in the Book of Vile Darkness. (DC 30) [BARD] [DECEPTION]  Please let me in - I'm meant to be in the coronation orchestra, it's my big break! (DC 30) [PERSUASION]  Such a bother. What if I were to contribute to the 'Flaming Fist's Orphans' Fund'? (DC 25)  (Requires 20,000 Gold ) Not closed to Duke Ulder Ravengard's own son, surely?  (if interacting as Wyll ) Breaking into Wyrm's Rock [ edit section | visual editor ] The party can forego the guards entirely by breaking into Wyrm's Rock. They can do this by jumping off the bridge using Fly or Feather Fall at the eastern side of the gate at X: 27 Y: 158 . After this, walking eastward reveals a crack in the wall to the prison at X: 42 Y: 190 with a successful Perception check. Crack in the Wall to Wyrm's Rock Prison. After entering into Wyrm's Rock Prison , there is a wall that can be blasted open at X: 91 Y: -720 with blunt attacks or spells (e.g. Eldritch Blast ). This leads to a storage room. The door must be lockpicked open, as well as the door to the entrance at X: 52 Y: -740 . There are multiple guards, that confront the party if they are spotted - requiring either successful sneaking or passing a deception check of 15. Alternatively, it is possible to fly from Blaze Elin's side of the bridge to the other side, leading straight to the main corridor of the fortress. Quest rewards [ edit section | visual editor ] Entering Wyrm's Rock Fortress earns the following inspiration. Using a pass: ⁠ Multipass ( Noble backgrounds) - only if using Urgent Report for Duke Ravengard ⁠ Rock-Solid Alibi ( Charlatan backgrounds) - for using any paper Without a pass: ⁠ Through Nooks and Crannies ( Urchin backgrounds) ⁠ Procedures be Damned ( Noble backgrounds) - this one includes an option to be arrested and come out into the fortress after escaping v t e Quests v t e Main quests Multi-act quests Find a Cure Get Help from Healer Nettie Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Get Help from Auntie Ethel Rescue the Druid Halsin Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite Find the Githyanki Crèche Travel to Moonrise Towers Gather Your Allies Find the Nightsong Personal quests Help Your Protector Deal with the Devil Fulfill the Deal Escape the Deal Discover the History of Prince Orpheus Discover the Artefact's Secrets Free Orpheus Embrace Your Potential Help Kith'rak Voss The Urge Open Your Scars Servant of None Forging a Heart Companion quests The Blade of Frontiers The Grand Duke Wyrmway Daughter of Darkness The Chosen of Shar A Familiar Face The Githyanki Warrior Vlaakith's Will The Prince of the Comet Our Fiery Friend The Hellion's Heart The Pale Elf The Wizard of Waterdeep In Case of Death... ## Find Arabella's Parents
- **来源**: [Find Arabella's Parents](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Find_Arabella's_Parents)
- **分类**: Quests

Arabella searches for her parents in the Shadow-Cursed Lands. Find Arabella's Parents is a Quest in Act Two of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with Arabella in Reithwin Town . Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 2.1 Meeting Arabella 2.2 Finding Arabella's parents 2.3 Breaking the news 3 Quest rewards 4 Consequences 5 Companion approval Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Objectives and journal entries may vary pending player decisions and outcomes. Search for Arabella's parents. "We met Arabella, a tiefling child from the grove, in the shadow-cursed lands. She was looking for her parents. We offered to search for them, and invited her to our camp." Search for Arabella's parents. "We met Arabella, a tiefling child from the grove, in the shadow-cursed lands. She was looking for her parents." Speak to Arabella. "We met Arabella, a tiefling child from the grove, in the shadow-cursed lands. We told her that her parents were dead, but invited her to join our camp." Tell Arabella about her parents. "We found Arabella's parents - dead. We should break the news to her at camp." Check up on Arabella. "Arabella was very upset when we broke the news to her about her parents. We should check up on her once she's had some time to process the news." Quest Complete "If Arabella is immediately told about her parents' deaths before reaching camp: Arabella fled into the shadow curse upon hearing what happened to her parents. It is unlikely that she will survive." "Withers encouraged Arabella to learn the ways of the Weave. She left to find her own way in the world." "We never did tell Arabella that her parents died." "We never did find Arabella's parents. They must have succumbed to the shadow curse." "We moved on from the shadow-cursed lands without helping Arabella. She left us a note, saying she would make her own way - letting the Weave guide her." Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] Meeting Arabella [ edit section | visual editor ] If the party saved Arabella during Save Arabella and protected the Druid Grove as part of Save the Refugees , Arabella will travel to the Shadow-Cursed Lands along with the other tiefling refugees. Arabella can be found at the gates of the Reithwin Town Graveyard at X: -153 Y: 15 , north of the Sharran monument and west of the Mason's Guild . When the party approaches, she calls out to them. A pair of Shadows attack, and Arabella restrains them with magical vines. If asked how she got these powers, she explains she was changed after touching the Idol of Silvanus and now has strange magical abilities. Bards , Druids , and Wizards have some unique conversation options about her new powers. The party can ask Arabella if she can teach them how to use her magic, or simply worry about her well-being. She says she was separated from her parents after the refugees were ambushed by Absolute cultists, and Zevlor failed to protect them. She managed to run away but lost sight of her parents, and is now looking for them. Arabella asks if the party would be willing to find them, to which they can either agree or say they will do it if she teaches them her nature magic. Arabella then asks if she can stay at their camp until her parents are found, as the vines will not hold the Shadows forever. If the party agrees, she stays in camp next to Withers . If the party refuse either to find her parents or to let her stay at camp, she runs off into the shadow curse. After a long rest, her corpse can be found and spoken to next to an entangled shadow at X: -176 Y: -67 . Finding Arabella's parents [ edit section | visual editor ] Arabella's parents, Locke and Komira , can be found in the children's ward of the House of Healing X: -185 Y: 12 , in the eastern wing. There, their bodies are tended to by Anna Lidwin . If the party talks to Sister Lidwin, she does not understand they are dead. She thinks she can still save them and "attends" to Locke's body. With a Deception or Sleight of Hand Check , she can be convinced that her "patients" are cured. Locke's corpse can be spoken to with Speak with Dead . He confirms Komira is his wife and Arabella is his daughter. If asked how he died, he explains that he and his wife ran to the House of Healing after the ambush on the refugees, believing it to be abandoned. They were attacked by the surgeon sisters. He does not know where Zevlor is. Komira's corpse refuses to speak. Breaking the news [ edit section | visual editor ] How Arabella takes the news depends on when she is told. If the party find her parents' corpses before finding Arabella, there is an option to tell her immediately. Doing so prompts either a DC 14 Persuasion or Intimidation Check or the use of Detect Thoughts with a DC 10. Upon success, Arabella goes to camp and acts the same as if she was told of the news there. However, if the check is failed, Arabella becomes shocked and upset and runs off into the shadows, just as if the player character had refused to help her initially. If Arabella goes to camp, she grows a bond with Withers, and is able to take the news much better. Unique dialogue options are available here for Bards , Clerics , or Monks . If the player character is an Oath of Devotion Paladin and has already found Arabella's parents, then their oath breaks upon telling her, "I haven't found your parents just yet." In the end, Withers encourages her to go her own way and follow the Weave, stating that she has her own destiny to follow. Arabella remains in camp until the end of Act Two, at which point she ventures off alone. As long as the news of her parents' deaths is broken to her and she survives, she can be found in Act Three. If she is never told what happened to her parents, she will instead leave a note and depart the game for good. Quest rewards [ edit section | visual editor ] Arabella's Shadow Entangle Shadow Blade Ring Consequences [ edit section | visual editor ] If Arabella is sent to camp and eventually told of her parents' deaths, she will return in Act Three . She can be found in the Lower City Sewers , west of the City Sewers Waypoint. If spoken to, she says she will help the party with the final battle, becoming an ally for the quest ⁠ Gather Your Allies . If she is never told of her parents' deaths, she instead departs the game. ## Find Doni
- **来源**: [Find Doni](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Find_Doni)
- **分类**: Quests

Doni has wandered off. Find Doni is a quest in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3 . It can be initiated by speaking with Rikka at the Emerald Grove . Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 3 Quest rewards 4 Notes Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Find Doni As the tieflings prepare for the siege, Rikka asked us to find Doni and bring him to safety. Return to Rikka We found Doni staring at the door to the druids' lair. He left for the children's hideout. Quest Complete If Doni is found: Rikka was grateful and thanked us for finding Doni. If Rikka dies during the goblin raid: Rikka died. If the party helps the druids cast out the tieflings: We betrayed the tieflings' trust - Rikka won't want to deal with us anymore. If the party leaves for the Mountain Pass or Grym's Forge without finding Doni: We left the region without helping Rikka. If the party does not speak to Rikka before the goblin raid: The siege began before we could bring any news to Rikka. Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] Rikka searches for Doni. The quest to find Doni only occurs if the Goblin Camp leaders are alive and learn the location of the Emerald Grove. In this instance, the goblins come to raid the Grove while the tieflings and druids prepare for the assault. Rikka instructed all the tiefling children to remain in their hideout so that she can lock the hatch to keep them safe. However, Doni has gone missing and Rikka is unable to lock the hatch until he is found. Rikka wanders the nearby oxen area in search of Doni at X: 215 Y: 555 . Doni can be found by the Sacred Pool in front of the door to the Inner Sanctum at X: 225 Y: 526 . The druids have locked themselves inside while Doni is outside grunting. The party can encourage Doni to return to the hatch by telling him, Go rejoin the others, kid. Doni will run toward the hatch, where Rikka soon finds him. After Doni is found, the party must hurry back to Rikka to resolve the quest, who is grateful that Doni is safe. Quest rewards [ edit section | visual editor ] 35 XP Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] Sometimes [ verify ] the option to move Doni along will not appear. In this instance, using Minor Illusion can send Doni bit by bit towards Rikka until he is close enough to be seen by her, or vice versa with Rikka moving towards Doni. Afterwards, Rikka will go to the refugees camp in The Hollow , at the site that Bex and Danis were staying previously. Once there, the party can speak with Rikka to complete the quest. v t e Quests v t e Main quests Multi-act quests Find a Cure Get Help from Healer Nettie Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Get Help from Auntie Ethel Rescue the Druid Halsin Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite Find the Githyanki Crèche Travel to Moonrise Towers Gather Your Allies Find the Nightsong Personal quests Help Your Protector Deal with the Devil Fulfill the Deal Escape the Deal Discover the History of Prince Orpheus Discover the Artefact's Secrets Free Orpheus Embrace Your Potential Help Kith'rak Voss The Urge Open Your Scars Servant of None Forging a Heart Companion quests The Blade of Frontiers The Grand Duke Wyrmway Daughter of Darkness The Chosen of Shar A Familiar Face The Githyanki Warrior Vlaakith's Will The Prince of the Comet Our Fiery Friend The Hellion's Heart The Pale Elf The Wizard of Waterdeep In Case of Death... ## Find Dribbles the Clown
- **来源**: [Find Dribbles the Clown](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Find_Dribbles_the_Clown)
- **分类**: Quests

Lucretious wants her star back - dead or alive. Find Dribbles the Clown is a quest in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with Lucretious [ 1 ] in the Circus of the Last Days . Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 2.1 Entering the Circus 2.1.1 Front Gate 2.1.2 Gap in the lattice fence 2.1.3 From the Open Hand Temple 2.2 Dribbles' Show 2.3 Collecting Dribbles' remains 2.3.1 Clown's Severed Hand 2.3.2 Clown's Severed Torso 2.3.3 Clown's Severed Arm 2.3.4 Clown's Severed Leg 2.3.5 Clown's Severed Foot 2.3.6 Clown's Severed Pelvis 2.3.7 Clown's Severed Head 2.4 Returning the Body Parts 3 Quest Rewards 4 Notes Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Investigate the Circus. "Dribbles the Clown, star of the circus, is missing. Ringmaster Lucretious asked us to find him. He's likely dead, but that doesn't seem to bother her." Find Dribbles. "We spoke to the doppelganger who impersonated the clown. He admitted he killed the real Dribbles the Clown." "Ringmaster Lucretious asked us to find the corpse of her star - Dribbles the Clown. Or what's left of him, at least." Collect Dribbles' body parts. "A part of Dribbles has been used to create a gruesome art piece. We should continue searching for his body parts." "The dead doppelganger revealed that their mistress wanted the clown's body parts for her 'art'." "We found a severed hand in the circus shop run by Popper the kobold. It looks like it belonged to Dribbles the Clown." "We found Dribbles' torso." "We found Dribbles' pelvis." "Based on how Dribbles has been cut up, it looks like we've found about half of his corpse." "We found Dribbles' arm." "We found Dribbles' leg." "We found Dribbles' foot." "We need just one final piece to complete Dribbles." "We found Dribbles' head." Return to Ringmaster Lucretious. "We have all of Dribbles' body parts. We should bring them to Ringmaster Lucretious." Quest Complete "Lucretious thanked us for our help. She intends to raise Dribbles from the dead - with some improvements. The circus will soon leave Wyrm's Crossing." "We left without helping Ringmaster Lucretious and Dribbles the Clown." "Lucretious has been defeated." "The circus vanished. Dribbles the Clown will never perform again." Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] Entering the Circus [ edit section | visual editor ] Front Gate [ edit section | visual editor ] Klaus and Benji the ghoul guard the gate. The Front gate is guarded by circus performer Klaus and his tamed ghoul, Benji . The party can attempt to enter the Circus by speaking with them, but Klaus stops them, and states he is checking every visitor to see if they are a vicious murderer. He has Benji sniff the active party member, and the ghoul reacts accordingly. Brain juice smells like PISS and IRON. NO. LIKE.  (if Illithid) BLOOD. TASTY BLOOD. SO DELICIOUS. AHAHAHA.  (if visually bloodied or Dark Urge) Urgh. Smells like a MUD FART.  (if visually dirty) Whatever the result, Klaus denies the party entry, surprised with Benji's reaction, but intent on sticking to the rules. However, he can be bribed or reasoned with: Surely we can come to an agreement? (200) [PERSUASION]  I'm not a threat to you or anyone else in the circus - I swear it. (DC 15) [DARK URGE] [PERSUASION]  I used to be a killer, but I've reformed my ways. (DC 10  ) [DARK URGE] [DECEPTION]  I used to be a killer, but I've reformed my ways. (DC 10  )  (if the character became the Slayer ) [INTIMIDATION]  Let me in, or I snap you in two. (DC 18) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  You can smell the blood of my enemies, that's all. Want to join my smell ? (DC 18  ) [BERSERKER] [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  I'LL MAKE YOU SMELL OF DEAD MEAT. MOVE.  (DC 18  ) [WIZARD] [SORCERER] [ROGUE] [MONK] [BARD] [DECEPTION]  I'm a friend of Lord Gortash. I wonder what he'll say if I tell him about this... (DC 18) [ARCHFEY] [INTIMIDATION]  Unless you seek the wrath of the Seelie Court, you will let me pass.  (DC 18  ) [WARLOCK] [WIZARD] [DECEPTION]  I've actually just been hired. I do a magic show. (DC 10) [MONK] [DECEPTION]  I've actually just been hired. I do martial arts. (DC 10) [BARD] [DECEPTION]  I've actually just been hired. Meet your new bard! (DC 10) [ROGUE] [DECEPTION]  I've actually just been hired. I juggle knives. (DC 10) [WILD MAGIC] [SORCERER] [DECEPTION]  I've actually just been hired to do a magic show. Fingers crossed no one blows up this time! (DC 10) [DRACONIC BLOODLINE] [SORCERER] [DECEPTION]  I've just been hired as a firebreather. Let's hope nothing catches light. (DC 10) [SORCERER] [PERSUASION]  It can probably smell the Weave within me. Just magical potential, that's all. (DC 10) Successfully passing a check allows the party entry to the circus grounds. Gap in the lattice fence [ edit section | visual editor ] The gatekeeping duo can easily be bypassed by walking further down the fence towards a group of children at X: -22 Y: -34 , where a gap in the fence can be jumped over. From the Open Hand Temple [ edit section | visual editor ] There are also two other points of entry: an iron fence door leading from a courtyard in the Open Hand Temple at X: -74 Y: -13 ( DC 15 Sleight of Hand Check to lockpick); and an iron gate leading from the Temple's graveyard at X: -101 Y: -41 ( DC 10 Sleight of Hand Check to lockpick). Dribbles' Show [ edit section | visual editor ] Dribbles needs a volunteer for his last act Approaching the stage at X: -41 Y: -36 where Dribbles is performing (or at X: -33 Y: -39 if the party enter through the fence breach) automatically starts a cutscene where Dribbles, accompanied by a dog called Bitey Buddy , begins performing a comedy show full of terrible puns. Towards the end of the show, he states he plans to perform a magic trick, but needs a volunteer with "nerves of steel and the heart of a lion". In doing this, he singles out the player character, who can agree to go up, or can encourage any other party member to do it. The cutscene plays out for any party member present, though none but the player character have an option to volunteer their mates. What are you going to do? Approach the stage. I think my friend Shadowheart will make a far better assistant. This is your time to shine, Lae'zel - up you go. Go on, Karlach, up you go. Minsc would be honoured. You love the spotlight, don't you Astarion? Here's your big change. I think this is a job for the Blade of Frontiers, don't you, Wyll? Gale, you're good at tricks, right? Up you go. Lend him a hand, Halsin. Well, Jaheira? Care to make your debut? My good friend Minthara is the funniest person I know. I'm good. Denying the offer results in a random crowd member volunteering. Warlocks and Rogues can attempt to see through the clown's disguise: [THE HEXBLADE] [INSIGHT]  Turn your patron's gaze on the clown - cut through to its intentions.  (DC 25  ) [FIEND] [INSIGHT]  Fix the clown with your patron's fiendish gaze.  (DC 25  ) [GREAT OLD ONE] [INSIGHT]  Gaze through the clown with your patron's eldritch sight.  (DC 25  ) [ARCHFEY] [INSIGHT]  Look at the clown through your patron's faerie eyes.  (DC 25  ) [ROGUE] [INSIGHT]  This clown's looking at you funny. What's his deal? (DC 25  ) Passing the check allows the character to cautiously go on stage, allowing the party to preemptively strike the evil clown. Doing so also grants the ⁠ Taking the Spotlight inspiration to party members with the Entertainer background. Either way, Dribbles and his dog suddenly attack, along with two other doppelgangers who disguised themselves as circus beast keepers. There are two beasts in cages at X: -61 Y: -36 near the stage where Dribbles performs: a displacer beast named Shadow-Whiskers and a dinosaur called Crimson . When the battle starts, the false beast keepers set both animals loose, and they join the fight, siding with doppelgangers. However, both beasts can be dealt with before the cutscene starts via Speak with Animals , each in its way. In which case both remain neutral. If a random crowd member comes on stage, they are instantly murdered by the dog. After defeating Dribbles, it turns out that he, too, was a doppelganger. His corpse can also be communed with using Speak with Dead , which grants some additional information on the attack. After the battle concludes, Lucretious moves from her tent closer to the stage area. Speaking with her can start the quest, as she asks the party to find what is left of Dribbles in exchange for a fabulous reward. As a necromancer, Lucretious even prefers the dead-and-raised clown to a living employee. Collecting Dribbles' remains [ edit section | visual editor ] Clown's Severed Hand [ edit section | visual editor ] The hand in Popper's tent. Dribbles' hand can be found on a plate in Popper's store inside the Circus of the Last Days at X: -89 Y: -52 . It can either be stolen like any other object, or the party can attempt to go up and grab it. If the party attempts the latter, they are stopped by Popper, who says it is his "special hand." If Popper is asked why the hand is so special, he explains the hand has artisanal rat bite marks, and therefore it costs 10,000 gold. To counter the kobold, the talking party member must pass an Intimidation or Persuasion check to get the severed hand from him for free, or a Deception check to get the hand for 100 gold: [PERSUASION]  I think that belongs to Dribbles. I need it - your ringmaster needs it. (DC 15) [DECEPTION]  You know, I can get a hand for much cheaper elsewhere. (DC 15) [WIZARD] [WARLOCK] [SORCERER] [DECEPTION]  I'm actually a sorcerer working for Lucretious. I need that hand for a magic spell. (DC 15  ) [INTIMIDATION]  Give it to me now, or I'll cut off your hands. (DC 15) [DROW] [INTIMIDATION]  You will give me that hand or I will grind you beneath my heel, you insufferable gnat. (DC 10  ) [HALF-ORC] [INTIMIDATION]  I could crush you with one finger. Give me the hand - now. (DC 15  ) [DRAGONBORN] [INTIMIDATION]  I will rip out your claws and peel the scales from your flesh. Give it to me - now.  (DC 10  ) Alternatively, if the party have found the Note from BUSINESSLORD POPPER in a wooden chest buried behind the stage of Dribbles at X: -27 Y: -30 , they can confront Popper about the hand through dialogue. Clown's Severed Torso [ edit section | visual editor ] The torso's location Dribbles' torso can be found on the corpse of Penela Lumpensicks at X: 63 Y: -1028 in the cave underneath the Open Hand Temple , alongside with Illasera, the First . The doppelgangers Muzz , Rudd , and Zomm have to be defeated first. To get to the torso's location, the party should use a hatch in the kitchen at X: -62 Y: 3 . There are pools of blood which can be followed to the actual murder site. However, bloody puddles abruptly stop in front of what appears to be a solid stone wall. There are two ways to get past the wall and into the secret tunnels beyond. The first is to go into the adjoining room to the south and jump over the breach in the wall at X: 16 Y: -1026 . The second is to enter the tunnels is by locating the secret buttons in the crypt. These buttons are obscured by heraldry on the walls to the left and right of the stone wall at X: 17 Y: -1000 and X: 18 Y: -1015 . Clown's Severed Arm [ edit section | visual editor ] The arm's location Dribbles' arm can be found on the corpse of Courageous Little Kimmabeth in the basement of Peartree House at X: 32 Y: -96 , alongside with Yaga-Shura, the Second . Peartree House is southeast of Sorcerous Sundries , and its entrance is boarded-up, so the barricade needs to be destroyed before entering. It is declared a restricted area, so breaking into it makes the nearest Flaming Fist patrol hostile. After the boards have been destroyed, the party can find a hatch hidden under a Traveller's Chest. After moving the chest aside the party can descend the hatch to find another murder scene. Clown's Severed Leg [ edit section | visual editor ] The leg's location Dribbles' leg can be found on the corpse of Incontinentia Figgin at X: 793 Y: 980 in the basement of Lavernica's Home at X: -76 Y: -70 . alongside Sendai, the Third . A copy of this letter can be found on the corpse of a drow named Danfora of the Kingfish . Lavernica's Home overlooks Araj Oblodra's Crimson Draughts , southwest of the Lower City Central Wall waypoint in the Lower City. After lockpicking the front door, the party must use the hatch to get inside the house basement. There are many dead spiders in the upper room and dead drow and duergar in the basement. Clown's Severed Foot [ edit section | visual editor ] The foot's location Dribbles' foot can be found on the corpse of a blue dragonborn Winslow Reginol , alongside with Abazigal, the Fourth , in the basement of Rainforest's Home at X: -93 Y: -109 . Rainforest's Home is located between Beehive General Goods and The Bibliophile shops, southeast of the Blushing Mermaid tavern. It can be entered by either lockpicking the front door, or taking the rear side: from the balcony or through the door under it, by using spells like Grant Flight or Misty Step , shooting an Arrow of Transposition or jumping high enough. The front door is red-outlined, and the street is patrolled by a group of Flaming Fist. The hatch to the basement is under the stairs on the ground floor. In the basement, the foot is straight ahead Clown's Severed Pelvis [ edit section | visual editor ] The pelvis' location Dribbles' pelvis can be found on the corpse of Gohumberry Tresp in an empty building in the Lower City at X: 123 Y: 4 , alongside Balthazar, the Fifth . The empty lodging is northwest of Basilisk Gate Barracks , behind Stormshore Tabernacle . Clown's Severed Head [ edit section | visual editor ] The head's location Dribbles' head can be found on the corpse of Wilting Alex in the Undercity Ruins at X: -65 Y: 1041 , alongside Amelyssan, the Sixth . To get to the corpse the party must open the unpickable door at X: -135 Y: 934 , by attacking one of the two hanging corpses near the Undercity Ruins waypoint. Slighty north of the Temple of Bhaal waypoint six corpses are chained together, with each corpse stacking atop a Blast Mine . One of the corpses is that of Wilting Alex. Returning the Body Parts [ edit section | visual editor ] When the party return to the Circus of Last Days, Lucretious is delighted to have all the parts of Dribbles back, even if they have been bitten by rats a little bit. She thanks the party and informs them that she is going to raise the corpse as one of her star performers. Upon completing the quest all circus personnel leave the premises after the next Long Rest , so the party should be sure to visit any traders or characters they would like to beforehand. Quest Rewards [ edit section | visual editor ] Spellmight Gloves - if they were already pickpocketed, a small stipend of gold will be rewarded instead. Turning in all the pieces to Lucretious grants the following Inspirations to party members: ⁠ Macabre Enigma ( Guild Artisan background) ⁠ Macabre Hunt ( Outlander background) ⁠ The Dismemberment of Dribbles ( Acolyte background) ⁠ Trail of Blood ( Haunted One background) Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Having all of Dribbles body parts when interacting with Fumm or Lucretious for the first time does not yield any unique options or dialogues. v t e Quests v t e Main quests Multi-act quests Find a Cure Get Help from Healer Nettie Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Get Help from Auntie Ethel Rescue the Druid Halsin Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite Find the Githyanki Crèche Travel to Moonrise Towers Gather Your Allies Find the Nightsong Personal quests Help Your Protector Deal with the Devil Fulfill the Deal Escape the Deal Discover the History of Prince Orpheus Discover the Artefact's Secrets Free Orpheus Embrace Your Potential Help Kith'rak Voss The Urge Open Your Scars Servant of None Forging a Heart Companion quests The Blade of Frontiers The Grand Duke Wyrmway Daughter of Darkness The Chosen of Shar A Familiar Face The Githyanki Warrior Vlaakith's Will The Prince of the Comet Our Fiery Friend The Hellion's Heart The Pale Elf The Wizard of Waterdeep In Case of Death... ## Find Explosives
- **来源**: [Find Explosives](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Find_Explosives)
- **分类**: Quests

Philomeen gives the party a vial of runepowder. Find Explosives is a quest in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by talking to Brithvar in Grymforge or by speaking to Lunkbug near the cave-in. Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 2.1 Brithvar 2.2 Lunkbug and Laridda 2.3 Philomeen 2.4 Alternative sources of explosives 3 Consequences 4 Quest rewards 5 Companion reactions 6 Notes and references Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Objectives and journal entries may vary pending story decisions and outcomes. Find smokepowder. Brithvar mentioned that a deep gnome fled with some smokepowder. Her crew should know more. Go to the deep gnome's hiding spot. We learned that the deep gnomes have a hiding spot in Grymforge. Philomeen might be there - with explosives. We have some smokepowder. If it's not enough to blow the cave-in, Philomeen might have more. She fled to a hiding spot deep within Grymforge. Find the smokepowder reserve. Philomeen left behind a reserve of smokepowder. It should clear the cave-in. Try to clear the cave-in. We met Philomeen and managed to talk her down. She gave us a small vial of runepowder - a gnomish explosive of legend. Quest Complete The cave-in was cleared. We used all the explosives we found - but we didn't clear the cave-in. We dealt with other matters instead. Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] Brithvar [ edit section | visual editor ] Brithvar can be found near the room with the cave-in at X: -626 Y: 354 , having a conversation with Kur . They are discussing the fact that the gnomes are not able to clear out the cave-in without explosives. One of the gnomes had recently run away with a barrel of explosives, which someone needs to track down to get Nere out. Upon speaking to Brithvar, he is instantly suspicious of the party. He can smell the True Soul 'stink' on them. If the party admit to being a True Souls, the pair become hostile. Otherwise, if the party deny being True Souls, there is a chance to make a deal with the duergar of Clan Flameshade : [ 1 ] [DECEPTION]  You're imagining things. I would never bow to the Absolute (DC 10) [DECEPTION]  I was a True Soul. That cult lied to me - now I want revenge. (DC 10) [DEEP GNOME] [DECEPTION]  Use your head - can you imagine a deep gnome being picked as a True Soul? (DC 10  ) [GITHYANKI] [DUERGAR]  That 'stench' is just psionic resonance - a remnant of our ancestors' enslavement by illithids. [OATH OF VENGEANCE] [PERSUASION]  What I am matters not. You seek retribution - I want to help. (DC 10) [WISDOM]  Cast Detect Thoughts.  (DC 11) That's not me you smell. You must still be catching Nere's scent. (if mind read) Convincing Brithvar that the party members are not True Souls results in him offering an opportunity for gold: Freeing Nere , then taking him down and stealing his gold. The party would get a cut of the spoils. Passing a DC 10 Intimidation Check with "Sounds good. I expect half the spoils." gains an extra payout. The party can ask him for leads on getting Nere out, to which he refers them to the gnomes at the cave-in. He believes they have an idea of where the runaway gnome with the explosives went. Lunkbug and Laridda [ edit section | visual editor ] The party can speak to Lunkbug , who is arguing with Laridda . Passing a DC 10 Perception Check reveals that Philomeen has run off with some smokepowder. [ 2 ] [INTIMIDATION]  You mentioned smokepowder. Details - now. (DC 5)  (non-Barbarian only) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  Smokepowder. Information. NOW. (DC 5  ) [PERSUASION]  Listen - I can help you. Act frightened, or you'll draw suspicion. (DC 5) [GNOME] [HISTORY]  Recite a gnomish call to action. 'Carpa bal' - 'Together, mighty.'  (DC 5  ) [GNOME] [PERSUASION]  You can trust me - I'm friendly. (DC 5) If the gnomes are successfully persuaded that the party can help them, Lunkbug explains that a gnome named Philomeen took off with explosive powder. He begs the party to find her and marks her most likely hiding spot on the map. Philomeen [ edit section | visual editor ] The hidden button needed to proceed to Philomeen's hiding spot. To get to Philomeen's hiding spot, the party must venture to the Underdark - Grymforge. From there, the party must move east across the bridge and then move north until a pair of duergar throwing dead gnomes into the water are encountered at X: -608 Y: 407 . In this area, behind a locked door, remains of a Nightfall feast can be found. Moving close to the northern wall triggers a Perception check - which reveals a button at X: -584 Y: 416 , which opens up a hidden passage. The party must continue along the passage and defeat the three Ochre Jellies which ambush the party. After climbing to the top of the stairs and continuing to move east, there are some rocks that can be jumped across to move forward at X: -562 Y: 427 . The door to Philomeen's hiding spot can be lockpicked ( DC 10 Sleight of Hand Check ), or the party can move along the western wall to find a large gap in the structure. When Philomeen spots the party, she accuses them of working with Nere as servants of The Absolute : [ 3 ] [PERSUASION]  Laridda sent me. The gnomes need your help. (DC 10) [INTIMIDATION]  If I was a True Soul, you'd be dead. Stand down before you hurt yourself. (DC 15)  (if non-Berserker) [BERSERKER] [INTIMIDATION]  KILL THE FIRE. OR DIE. PAINFULLY.  (DC 15  ) [PERSUASION]  Smile sincerely and hold out your hand.  (DC 15) [PERSUASION]  Are you sure about this? Once you're dead, that's it. It's over. (DC 15) [DETECT THOUGHTS] [WISDOM]  Cast Detect Thoughts. You will not serve Ironhand in death. But you might still serve him in life. If baiting Philomeen by saying "You wouldn't dare - you don't have the courage" and "I don't care. Go on, blow us up" then Philomeen actually ignites the barrel. The explosion kills Philomeen and does significant damage to the party. Similarly, if the party fail to persuade Philomeen in the initial dialogue, she blows up the barrel. It is possible to bypass the checks by sneaking and stealing the barrel before Philomeen can ignite it. Talking down Philomeen results in her saying she will make the cult suffer at Moonrise. The party can tell her that they just want to help with the cave-in that has trapped some gnomes, in which case she explains that the whole barrel is not necessary. It is not a Smokepowder Barrel, but a legendary explosive Runepowder Barrel . She needs to take the barrel back to Baldur's Gate to help her clan, but she is willing to give the party a Runepowder Vial that is plenty powerful enough to destroy the cave-in. If the party accept the deal, she provides the vial and runs off. Otherwise, she turns hostile. In addition to the Runepowder Vial the party can find a hidden reserve of Smokepowder. In the room where Philomeen was found, near the campfire, is a backpack with a hand-drawn map at X: -539 Y: 464 . Reading it automatically adds a marker to the map at the place of the reserve. To find it, the party must return to the docks where the gnome corpses lie. Near this place are some stairways leading up to two duergar bothering a gnome slave. The entrance to the smokepowder reserve is in a room just below and to the left of the stairways. The party must pass a Perception check to locate a button on the wall at the dead end which opens a wall, revealing a hidden room. Within this room are two Smokepowder Satchels and a heavy chest. Alternative sources of explosives [ edit section | visual editor ] Securing the runepowder is not the only way to clear the cave-in. It takes roughly two smokepowder satchels to clear the rubble. One can be found from ⁠ Rescue the Gnome in Barcus' backpack. Two can be obtained in Philomeen's reserve. Placing a Smokepowder Barrel on the cave-in to destroy it. Foregoing explosives entirely and using spells that cause force damage, as mentioned in ⁠ Free True Soul Nere . If clearing the rubble before speaking to Philomeen, then she is longer be present in Grymforge, and it is not possible anymore to obtain the Runepowder from her. Consequences [ edit section | visual editor ] If Philomeen is not killed during this quest, she appears again in Act Three in the Ironhand Gnomes hideout during ⁠ Avenge the Ironhands . ## Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic
- **来源**: [Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Find_Ketheric_Thorm's_Relic)
- **分类**: Quests

Balthazar seeks to retrieve a relic for Ketheric Thorm. Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic is a sub- quest of ⁠ Infiltrate Moonrise Towers in Act Two of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with Thisobald Thorm in The Waning Moon , by speaking to Disciple Z'rell in Moonrise Towers , or by reading Balthazar's diary in his chambers in Moonrise Towers. Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 2.1 Moonrise Towers 2.1.1 Alternative Ways to Acquire the Quest 2.2 The Relic 2.3 Gauntlet of Shar 2.3.1 Meeting Balthazar 2.3.2 Shar's trials 2.4 Shadowfell 2.4.1 Sparing Aylin 2.4.2 Killing Aylin 2.5 Confronting Ketheric Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Objectives and journal entries may vary pending story decisions and outcomes. Search Balthazar's chambers. Minthara told us that the necromancer Balthazar might know more about Ketheric's invulnerability. She suspects the answers we seek lie in Balthazar's chambers on the upper floor. Investigate the Thorm Mausoleum. Disciple Z'rell instructed us to assist General Thorm's advisor, Balthazar, in recovering a powerful relic from the Thorm's family mausoleum. The Brewer revealed that 'her cage' is located in the Thorm Mausoleum. It's unclear who this woman is, but Ketheric must have caged her for a reason. We found Balthazar's diary and learned that he went to the Thorm Mausoleum to find a relic called the 'Nightsong'. It seems to be the key to Ketheric's invulnerability. A mysterious voice in the Mausoleum warned us to leave. If we wish to find Balthazar, we should press on. Follow the secret passage. We uncovered a secret passage in the Thorm Mausoleum. The relic must be further inside. Find Balthazar. We uncovered a secret passage in the Thorm Mausoleum. Balthazar must be inside. We encountered a group of patrolling skeletons who likely serve Balthazar. They mentioned the temple's shadowy defenders. We encountered Balthazar's undead servants. They have barricaded themselves in a room as they prepare to defend their master. Talk to Balthazar. We defeated the temple's shadowy defenders and found the missing Balthazar. Find a path to the relic. We found Balthazar. He's asked us to clear the path to the relic - by any means necessary. We encountered Balthazar - General Ketheric Thorm's advisor. He's been tasked with finding a powerful relic. He asked us to clear the path - by any means necessary. We defeated Balthazar, but the relic is still at large. We should search for it. Complete the Gauntlet of Shar. To enter the temple's Inner Sanctum, we must complete the Gauntlet of Shar - trials made for her elite soldiers, the Dark Justiciars. We found an Umbral Gem. More are needed to unlock the temple's Inner Sanctum. We acquired another Umbral Gem from one of Shar's trials. We acquired a new Umbral Gem from Shar's trials. We acquired an Umbral gem from the lair of the orthon. We inserted an Umbral Gem into the altar. This activated a platform that will allow us to travel deeper into the temple. We found an altar in front of a locked door. There are three slots for Umbral Gems. We'll need to find more if we want to enter the temple's Inner Sanctum. Place Umbral Gemstone in Altar We have enough Umbral Gems. We should insert them into the altar. Open the door to the Inner Sanctum. We've collected enough Umbral Gems. Now to gain access to the Inner Sanctum. We inserted an Umbral Gem into the altar. This activated a platform that will allow us to travel deeper into the temple. Find the relic. The path to the Inner Sanctum is open. The relic lies just ahead. Reach the relic. Balthazar followed us into the Shadowfell. He intends to claim the relic. We should hurry after him. We entered the Shadowfell, the heart of the relic. Defeat Balthazar. We found the 'relic' - a woman named Nightsong. Balthazar wanted to bring her to Ketheric. We turned on the necromancer instead. Decide Nightsong's fate. The relic is a woman called Nightsong who was trapped in the Shadowfell by Ketheric and Balthazar. Her fate is in our hands. Report to Moonrise. We helped Balthazar capture the Nightsong. He was pleased. We should return to Moonrise. Report to Disciple Z'rell. We helped Balthazar return Nightsong to Moonrise Towers. Disciple Z'rell would be happy to hear this. Disciple Z'rell was pleased we assisted Balthazar and brought Nightsong to Moonrise. Report to Ketheric Thorm. We helped Balthazar return Nightsong to Moonrise Towers. Ketheric Thorm would be happy to hear this. After capturing the Nightsong alongside Balthazar, we reported our success to Ketheric Thorm. Quest Complete We killed Nightsong, making Ketheric Thorm vulnerable. We freed Nightsong and she flew across the shadow-cursed lands to Moonrise Towers, where she intends to face Ketheric Thorm. Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Upon entering the Throne Room in Moonrise Towers , Ketheric can be seen on a throne while Z'rell is interrogating some goblins. Fezzerk is one of the goblins from the Blighted Village and he pleads for his life. The party can attempt to plead their case with Ketheric, but he refuses to believe they have any worth and orders the party to handle it. He leaves for his quarters and Z'rell tells the party to do whatever they want with the goblins. The goblins can be killed, or set free. There is also the option to attack Thorm, but he walks away and tells Z'rell to deal with it, and the whole area becomes hostile. After dealing with the goblins, Z'rell must be reported to. She is up the stairs behind the throne in the audience chamber. If speaking to her, she telepathically connects with the party to see how the goblins died. Next, she tries to figure out if the party is loyal to the Absolute. The party can attempt to distract her with romantic thoughts of their love interest ( DC 14 Persuasion Check ), fill their mind with fake love for the Absolute ( DC 14 Deception Check ) or distract her with their hunger for power. Monks , Rogues , or Fighters can use special dialogue options. If successful, Z'rell gives the party a new task - tracking down Balthazar , a servant of Ketheric, who the cult has lost contact with. He was last seen at the Grand Mausoleum . Z'rell gives the party a key to his room and instructs them to take a Moonlantern and touch nothing else. However, the party can access a secret area in his room in order to start ⁠ Balthazar's Experiment . Alternative Ways to Acquire the Quest [ edit section | visual editor ] There are two other ways to start the quest beyond speaking to Z'rell. The party can either pickpocket the key to Balthazar's room or loot it from Z'rell's corpse. Entering his room, where Balthazar's Research Notes reveals his activities. If Minthara is a member of the party, she also encourages the party to search Balthazar's room to find answers on the relic. If the party drink with Thisobald Thorm in the Waning Moon, they can learn a little bit more about Ketheric's secrets. After drinking three times with him, Thisobald starts ranting. "I - I know you. I knew, I know, I am knowing. You want father's personal mysterious - (secret) - secret. No, not, never! Father said, ordered, commanded. Don't say it, don't say it! The cage. Her cage. Talk and... perish, die, buried. Buried in Thorm tomb. Father told me." This grants a hint as to Ketheric's relic. The Relic [ edit section | visual editor ] Pursuing Balthazar leads the party to Grand Mausoleum; it is north of the House of Healing . The party must enter the Mausoleum after being accosted by Raphael and there is a small puzzle to proceed forward. There are three paintings with buttons underneath them, press them in the following order to open the way: Moonrise Towers, Grief, General. Using the traversal gem, allows the party to enter the Gauntlet of Shar . Gauntlet of Shar [ edit section | visual editor ] Meeting Balthazar [ edit section | visual editor ] Once inside the Gauntlet of Shar, Balthazar's minions can be encountered, which triggers a combat with some Dark Justiciars of Shar . After the fight, Balthazar can be found in a room behind a big circular door. He introduces himself as a servant of Ketheric Thorm and that he is here to retrieve the Nightsong . He presses the party into helping him. If the party read Research Notes (Balthazar) and knows the secret of the Nightsong, the party can reveal that they know and Balthazar asks why he should not just kill them right away: I had Z'rell's permission - that good enough for you? (if sent there by Z'rell ) [DECEPTION]  I received permission. Take it up with your peers at Moonrise, if you have an issue. (DC 14) [INTIMIDATION]  You're hiding from shadows - literally. Don't make threats you can't back up. (DC 14) [BARBARIAN] [INTIMIDATION]  Because I'll rip your tongue out, shove it down your throat, then stomp on your 'creations' until they are dirt beneath my feet. (DC 14  ) [DRUID] [INTIMIDATION]  Touch me, and I'll strike you down with all of nature's fang and fury. Go ahead - try me. (DC 14  ) [PERSUASION]  It's simple - you need me. Don't pretend otherwise. (DC 14) [CLERIC] [PERSUASION]  I wield the divine. I can use it to assist you, or send you screaming to the Fugue Plane. Your choice. (DC 14  ) [PALADIN] [PERSUASION]  Do it - unleash your creations. But they will not protect you from me - or my righteous fury. (DC 14  ) [BARD] [PERSUASION]  Sir, I am a jack-of-all-trades and a master of many. Our meeting was not by chance - you need me. (DC 14  ) [MONK] [PERSUASION]  You are a ship without a sail, necromancer. You need allies - you need me . (DC 14  ) [SORCERER] [PERSUASION]  Because I am magical powerhouse . You need me, and you know it. (DC 14  ) [WIZARD] [PERSUASION]  I outmatch you in both brains and magic - you need me. (DC 14  ) Otherwise, the party can then ask why the Nightsong is so important: [PERSUASION]  I need more to go on. Why is this relic so important? What does it do? (DC 14) [ROGUE] [PERSUASION]  Jobs like this always go smoother when I know exactly what I'm looking for. (DC 14  ) [FIGHTER] [PERSUASION]  A scout is little good if they don't know what to look for. What does this relic do? (DC 14  ) [WIZARD] [PERSUASION]  What are the properties of this relic, magical or otherwise? So I can be of better assistance, of course. (DC 14  ) [WARLOCK] [PERSUASION]  I'm not the type to make a deal without the details. What exactly am I looking for? (DC 14  ) If passed, Balthazar reveals that Ketheric Thorm's relic is the Nightsong, and the source of his invulnerability and that Balthazar must protect it to protect Ketheric. The party can then opt to ask for help: [PERSUASION]  You have resources to spare - give me something to aid my search. (DC 14) [PERSUASION]  For jobs like this it's good form to provide your operatives some extra resources. (DC 14) Passing this check rewards the party with the Summon Golem Bell to summon Flesh . On the conclusion of this conversation a combat triggers, where Dark Justiciar Avengers attack both Balthazar's undead servants and the party. Once this combat is resolved, the party can speak with Balthazar further and learn more about the relic he is searching for. There is also the option to attack and kill Balthazar at any time after this encounter. It is also possible to fully avoid contact with Balthazar and his servants until entering the Shadowfell . Shar's trials [ edit section | visual editor ] The party must then overcome each of Shar's trials and collect the Umbral Gems to gain access to the Shadowfell. Shadowfell [ edit section | visual editor ] Entering Shadowfell locks the party out of many side quests, and pushes the party to the end of Act Two! If Balthazar is not killed, he arrives in the Shadowfell immediately after the party, thanking them for their service in completing the trials. He floats ahead and tells the party to come with him to witness greatness. Once the party leap to the heart of the Shadowfell, they learn the Nightsong is not an object, but an aasimar woman named Dame Aylin , who has been held captive by Balthazar to share her immortal life with Ketheric: Wait - the Nightsong is a person? What are you going to do to her? I can't let you take her My companion has her own plans for this one. Stand down. (if Shadowheart is present)   +5 [OATHBREAKER]  You cannot bind a person to the needs of another. Free her. Now. [PALADIN]  She is a person - not a thing to be used. On my oath, she will be freed. [MINTHARA]  Impressive work, Balthazar, but you are not needed anymore. The Nightsong is our sacrifice. [WIZARD]  The Nightsong's a person ? Balthazar, this is an affront to the Weave itself. [ROGUE]  If I'd known you were hunting a person, I'd have charged for my services. After this, the party can deal with Balthazar: If she's the reason Ketheric Thorm is invulnerable, you're not taking her. Leave, or you're a dead man.   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 Go on, then. Take the Nightsong to Ketheric. Get it over with.   -1   -1   -5   -1 [BERSERKER]  ROAR AT THE NECROMANCER. [BARBARIAN]  I agree - no more questions. More blood. YOURS. [SHADOWHEART] [EVIL CLERIC]  You are the one who interferes - in Lady Shar's bidding. For that, you must die. [EVIL CLERIC]  I care not for the holy creature - but you tricked me, necromancer. For that: you die. The Nightsong is angel-born. It deserves freedom.   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 [CLERIC OF SELÛNE] [GOOD CLERIC]  The Moonmaiden's light dances around this one... You will harm her no more, necromancer.   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 [GOOD CLERIC]  You will torture this angel-born no longer, necromancer.   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 Attack him.   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 Betraying Balthazar begins combat and triggers the ⁠ Rebellious Phase inspiration for party members with the Urchin background. Once Balthazar is dealt with, the party can then decide Aylin's fate. Sparing Aylin [ edit section | visual editor ] If Shadowheart is in the party, she can kill the Nightsong and become the Dark Justiciar she always dreamed she would be, or she can be convinced to spare her. If Shadowheart is not brought along, then she immediately confronts the party after returning from the Shadowfell. After cursing the party for denying her the destiny she would always dreamed of, Shadowheart then leaves the party permanently. Additionally, Aylin can only be killed by Shadowheart - otherwise, attempting to do so does nothing but annoy Aylin. If Aylin is freed, she thanks the party, and if it was Shadowheart who spared her, then she throws the Spear of Night into the abyss of the Shadowfell. However, Aylin grants her a new weapon as thanks - the Moonlight Glaive . Then, Aylin flies off to face Ketheric. After leaving the Shadowfell, Shar subjects Shadowheart to unimaginable torment before sending her back to the mortal realm, and Shadowheart loses her favour. After completing ⁠ Defeat Ketheric Thorm , upon speaking to Aylin in camp, Shadowheart is rewarded with Selûne's Spear of Night . Killing Aylin [ edit section | visual editor ] If Shadowheart kills the Nightsong, she becomes the Dark Justiciar and gains Shar's Spear of Evening . However, the party lose a valuable ally in the Nightsong. There is a major consequence for Last Light Inn due to Shadowheart's actions. Isobel is overwhelmed and unable to sustain her protection magic over the Last Light Inn, causing all within to fall to the shadow curse. Shadowheart refers to this as cleansing the resistance to Lady Shar's will. Additionally, unlike instances where Isobel is kidnapped in ⁠ Resolve the Abduction , Jaheira is nowhere to be found and does not aid the party in the Last Light Inn fight. Shadowheart has a secondary approval system, influencing the choices in ⁠ Find the Nightsong and Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic. For more information, see Nightsong Points . Confronting Ketheric [ edit section | visual editor ] The final meeting with Ketheric can go very differently depending on if the party aided him or sabotaged him. However, it always results in fighting against Ketheric. If the party spared Aylin, they are prompted to go to Moonrise Towers and assault it, resulting in a showdown with Ketheric at the top of the tower. If the party allowed Balthazar to kidnap the Nightsong, they report back to Z'rell and are either charged with a new mission, ⁠ Capture Isobel the Selûnite Cleric , or sent to the top of the tower to receive judgment from the Absolute. v t e Quests v t e Main quests Multi-act quests Find a Cure Get Help from Healer Nettie Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Get Help from Auntie Ethel Rescue the Druid Halsin Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite Find the Githyanki Crèche Travel to Moonrise Towers Gather Your Allies Find the Nightsong Personal quests Help Your Protector Deal with the Devil Fulfill the Deal Escape the Deal Discover the History of Prince Orpheus Discover the Artefact's Secrets Free Orpheus Embrace Your Potential Help Kith'rak Voss The Urge Open Your Scars Servant of None Forging a Heart Companion quests The Blade of Frontiers The Grand Duke Wyrmway Daughter of Darkness The Chosen of Shar A Familiar Face The Githyanki Warrior Vlaakith's Will The Prince of the Comet Our Fiery Friend The Hellion's Heart The Pale Elf The Wizard of Waterdeep In Case of Death...
