## Our Fiery Friend
- **来源**: [Our Fiery Friend](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Our_Fiery_Friend)
- **分类**: Quests

Our Fiery Friend is the Companion Quest for Karlach . It is automatically added to the journal when she joins the party in Act One . Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 2.1 Act One 2.2 Meeting Karlach 2.3 Finding an Infernal Mechanic 2.4 Infernal Iron Locations 2.5 Upgrading Karlach's Heart 2.6 Act Two 2.7 Moonrise Towers 2.8 Act Three 2.9 Confronting Gortash 2.10 Karlach's Fate 2.11 Leaving the Party 2.12 Conflict with Wyll 3 Sub-Quests 4 Notes Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Objectives and journal entries may vary pending player decisions. Deal with the Paladins of Tyr. "We met a fiery tiefling called Karlach. She said servants of the archdevil Zariel were nearby, disguised as paladins of Tyr." "We recruited Karlach and said we'd help defeat the paladins hunting her." "Karlach reminded us to deal with the paladins hunting her. If we want her to travel with us, we should handle this first." Travel with Karlach. "We confronted the paladins chasing Karlach. She's joined our search for a cure for the parasite." "We defeated the paladins hunting Karlach; she joined our search for a cure for the parasite." Find safe harbour and speak to Karlach. "Ketheric Thorm is dead, but Gortash escaped to the city. Karlach will have strong feelings about this." "We saw Gortash - 'The Edict of Bane' - consorting with Ketheric Thorm. Karlach was shocked to see him here." Find Lord Gortash. "Gortash was Karlach's former boss - someone she trusted. He betrayed her, consigning her to a life in the Hells. She wants her revenge, but first we have to find him." Confront Lord Gortash. "We learned Gortash is currently being ordained as Archduke of Baldur's Gate. This could be Karlach's chance to confront him." Rescue Karlach. "Karlach tried confronting Gortash during his ordination in Wyrm's Rock, but she was stopped by a Steel Watcher and sent to jail. We should break her out." Face Lord Gortash. "We broke Karlach out of jail. She's still waiting for her revenge against Gortash." Kill Lord Gortash. "We've confronted Gortash; his time as Archduke is over." Take Karlach to Gortash's corpse. "Gortash is dead. Karlach will want to see him up close." Continue travelling with Karlach. "There's still time to fix Karlach's heart, if we can find Dammon somewhere in the city." "There's still time to fix Karlach's heart, if we can find an infernal mechanic." "Gortash is dead, but Karlach's vengeance won't undo the damage he caused. At least Baldur's Gate has one less enemy." Quest Complete "We did as much as we could for Karlach's heart and helped her get revenge on Gortash. All she wants now is to see the city saved." "We helped Karlach get revenge on Gortash but didn't manage to repair her infernal heart." "We didn't get Karlach's vengeance on Gortash. We didn't repair her heart, either." "Karlach is gone forever." "Karlach left us - she won't be coming back." "Karlach went after Gortash alone; she won't be rejoining us." "We left Karlach at Wyrm's Rock Prison." "We did as much as we could for Karlach's heart but didn't help get her revenge on Gortash." "Karlach was killed." "Karlach turned against us - we had to put her down." Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] Karlach’s story spans the entire game, and has spoilers for all three Acts. “ You've quite the knack for seeing the bright side of things, haven't you? „ — Gale , responding to Karlch's comments on the potential of restoring the splendor of Grymforge “ Hope keeps you going. „ — Karlach , answering Gale Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Meeting Karlach [ edit section | visual editor ] Karlach struggles to control her infernal engine. Karlach can be encountered as part of Wyll's story or by speaking to Anders in the Toll House in the quest ⁠ Hunt the Devil . She can also be encountered on The Risen Road at X: 111 Y: 506 . Karlach is below the bridge of the Toll Road, near the stream. Here, she appears to be struggling to control herself, her body engulfed in flames. Appoaching Karlach nearby her spot triggers a cinematic which can play out in a few different variations. If the party raided the Grove or caused the conflict between Druids and Tieflings to erupt with Dammon being one of the casualties, Karlach becomes hostile upon the meeting and unavailable to recuit. The player character can try to persuade her to stand down or attack. If the Grove's occupants remain unharmed, Karlach will be available for recruitment. Upon approaching her she mentions seeing the player character on the Mindflayers ship. If Wyll is in the party he starts the confrontation stating she is the "The stink of Avernus. Advocatus diaboli ". In both scenarios after short exchange of words, the party and Karlach enter mind-meld tadpole connection showing first the vision of her experiences in Blood War in Avernus, then second vision of her slicing through Zariel's servants while desperately seeking escape. Choosing to believe Karlach results in her joining the party. She asks for help - her former master, the archdevil Zariel , sent a group of demons after her who are masquerading as Paladins of Tyr . They are holed up in the Toll House , recovering from wounds from their first confrontation with Karlach. Karlach asks that she be brought along to confront them. If Karlach is brought, Anders is shocked and afraid. He says the paladins will not survive another assault and begs the party not to let her hurt them. A DC 10 Insight Check reveals that there is a squint in his eyes which indicates he is lying. Using Detect Thoughts also reveals that Anders serves Zariel. If Anders is called out on his lie, he quickly drops the act and reveals his true allegiance with Zariel, attacking the party. Once the battle is over, Karlach goes into a frenzy, destroying anything near and setting fire to the Toll House. Karlach explains that she has an Infernal Engine for a heart which lets her burn as hot as the Hells. Unfortunately, it has been running in overdrive ever since she left Avernus . She says she needs to find a mechanic that can tune up her engine and that the paladins let slip that a tiefling infernal mechanic is in the area. Finding an Infernal Mechanic [ edit section | visual editor ] Dammon inspects Karlach's engine. The mechanic in question is a tiefling named Dammon . When the city of Elturel fell to Avernus, Dammon was there and was put to work as a mechanic. Upon meeting Karlach, he instantly recognizes her heart is from the Hells. He believes he can help her, but he needs materials to do so. He has spotted several pieces of Infernal Iron on his travels and believes this is what he needs to aid Karlach. It is possible to catch up with Dammon in three places: At the Druid Grove , in The Hollow At the Last Light Inn , in the barn In the Lower City, at the Forge of the Nine There are many occasions where Dammon can die. During the raid on the Grove in ⁠ Raid the Grove , Dammon can become a casualty. He also can die during an attack on the Last Light Inn by Fist Marcus and his minions. If Dammon makes it to Baldur's Gate, he is safe, so long as the party do not randomly kill him. Additionally, Dammon can die if the Strange Ox is killed in Act One, as it is later implied to have saved him on the road. Infernal Iron Locations [ edit section | visual editor ] There are several places to find Infernal Iron. Karlach's heart only needs two in total to get the full set of upgrades from Dammon. Possible locations include: In the basement of the Blacksmith's House in the Blighted Village - inside the same chest as the Blacksmith's Note In the locked room above Dror Ragzlin's throne in the Shattered Sanctum Inside a chest located in a locked cell in the Zhentarim Basement As a gift from Kith in Grymforge if all three checks are passed about the Ruins In the Mason's Guild in Reithwin Town in the Shadow-Cursed Lands Upgrading Karlach's Heart [ edit section | visual editor ] In order to repair Karlach's heart, the party must return to Dammon with Karlach, as she must install the upgrades herself. After the first upgrade, Karlach still feels hot, but not as badly as before. She feels more powerful than ever, but this upgrade is not a long term solution. Dammon commits to keep working and says that he considers the possibility of enchanted coolant. He advises the party to keep an eye out for more Infernal Iron on the road for when they meet again. Once the second upgrade is complete, Karlach is able to touch other people again without burning them up. She is immensely excited with this and can then be hugged. The moment is highly significant for Karlach, who has not touched another person in ten years. If the first upgrade is done in The Grove, Dammon says that he needs to think further on how he can help Karlach. He does not have a clear idea until after the party meets up with him again in the Last Light Inn in Act Two . If the party initially encounter Dammon at the Last Light Inn, both upgrades can be received after a Long Rest. If Dammon is met in Baldur's Gate, then both upgrades can be received at the Forge of the Nine after a Long Rest. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] At the end of Act Two , Karlach finds a new enemy if she is brought to the Mind Flayer Colony . The party realizes the Chosen Three are controlling an Elder Brain using three Netherstones and a Netherse crown. These individuals are Ketheric Thorm , Orin the Red , and Enver Gortash . Karlach is shocked to see Gortash there, and even more so that he is calling himself the "Edict of Bane." Later, Karlach explains Gortash was the reason she was sent to the Hells. Karlach grew up in Baldur's Gate, struggling to survive as a child. She had a rough childhood, brawling her way through the city. Gortash set his sights on her at a young age, and hired her on as a bodyguard. She initially trusted him deeply and was willing to put her life on the line to protect his. However, he betrayed her and sold her into the service of Zariel. Zariel had wanted to test her new Infernal Engine and Gortash said Karlach could handle it. Now that she is aware he is at the heart of the Absolutist plot, she vows to put an end to his misdeeds. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Confronting Gortash [ edit section | visual editor ] After entering Wyrm's Rock Fortress , Karlach finally has a chance to see Gortash in the flesh. Gortash takes control of a Steel Watcher and invites the party to his coronation. If Karlach is in the party, she prepares to confront him then and there. The party can react to this: [PERSUASION]  Careful, Karlach - the Steel Watch will destroy us in one swipe if we attack here. (DC 18) [PERSUASION]  We might need Gortash alive to save the city. Let's wait to strike until we've had the chance to question him. (DC 18) [WYLL]  Keep calm. If we do battle, my father will perish at our own hands. Wyll is right. We attack Gortash, Ravengard falls too.  (if Wyll is present) I couldn't stand to see the Steel Watch get their hands on you. Let's wait for a more opportune moment.  (if the player romanced Karlach) Lead the charge, Karlach - Gortash dies today . If the last option is chosen, Karlach attempts to run up to Gortash, but is stopped by a Steel Watcher. She is taken to Wyrm's Rock Prison, where the party can later release her. “ Is that it, then? I've killed the bastard that ruined my life, and now I crawl into a corner and die? Am I fucking missing something? „ — Karlach , after killing Gortash After defeating Gortash, Karlach angrily confronts her uncertain and tenuous future. As part of ⁠ Get Gortash's Netherstone , the party must eventually confront Gortash. If the party kill him for his Netherstone, Karlach wishes to see his dead body. Upon seeing the death of the man who sold her into servitude, she angrily laments his betrayal of her and the imminent loss of her own life and freedom. Karlach's Fate [ edit section | visual editor ] During the confrontation of ⁠ Confront the Elder Brain , the party fail to control the Elder Brain, as it has become a Netherbrain . The Emperor arrives and whisks the party to the safety of the Astral Plane and explains that only an Illithid can hope the defeat the Brain at this point. If the party do not trust the Emperor or side with Orpheus , then Karlach can volunteer to become a mind flayer. If this happens, Karlach remarks that her engine feels quiet and she is able to stay in the mortal plane. If Karlach does not transform into a mind flayer, her engine finally overheats after the battle is over. If Wyll becomes the Blade of Avernus as part of his story quest, ⁠ The Blade of Frontiers , then he offers to go with Karlach to Avernus to try and find a solution to her engine problem. A character with a suitably high approval can offer to go with her, either alone or as a trio with Wyll. Otherwise, Karlach's desire not to go back to the Hells can be honored, in which case her engine fully overheats and she explodes into flames. Leaving the Party [ edit section | visual editor ] There are some instances in which Karlach permanently leaves the party. During Act One, if the party side with the goblins as part of ⁠ Raid the Grove , Karlach immediately leaves the party. If the party raids the Grove without recruiting Karlach, then Karlach says she knows what they did. Enraged, she asks the player character if it made them feel big to abuse the refugees. She then becomes hostile and attacks the party. If the party travel to the Rosymorn Monastery Trail or the Shadow-Cursed Lands before dealing with Anders , Karlach announces she knows a bad situation when she sees one and permanently leaves. Conflict with Wyll [ edit section | visual editor ] As part of his mission as a devil hunter, Wyll is pact-bound to kill Karlach. With the aid of the tadpole's telepathic powers, however, Wyll can be shown that Karlach was a victim of the Blood War, rather than a perpetrator. As Wyll is further convinced, he realizes he has made a grave error and stands down. In the conflict, rather than attempting to broker peace, the party can also pick a side with either Karlach or Wyll, causing the other side to become hostile. In this case, the hostile party member is lost, as they could not make amends. If peace is brokered between Wyll and Karlach, the two become close. Several long rests after their fight, Mizora , Wyll's patron, comes to punish him for failing to abide by their pact. As punishment, Mizora transforms Wyll's appearance, giving him horns and a more devilish appearance. After this, Karlach feels an immense guilt towards Wyll for having him sacrifice so much to keep her alive. Through this, they gain a strong bond of friendship. Sub-Quests [ edit section | visual editor ] ⁠ The Hellion's Heart Notes [ edit section | visual editor ] If Karlach is not recruited before moving on to the Shadow-Cursed Lands of Act Two, she dies and her body can be found. ## User:Pandora/Test
- **来源**: [User:Pandora/Test](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/User:Pandora/Test)
- **分类**: Quests

The party's allies have gathered to fight the Absolute. Gather Your Allies is a main Quest spanning all three Acts of Baldur's Gate 3. It is obtained in Act One and completed in Act Three . Its objectives are completed as various quests are completed during the campaign. Contents 1 Objectives 2 Factors 3 Results 4 Trivia Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Objectives and journal entries may vary pending player decisions and outcomes. Recruit allies in the fight against the cult Freeing ourselves of the parasite is proving more difficult than we imagined. We should be on the lookout for powerful allies - we'll likely need them in the fight to come. Volo has become a most loyal ally. His powerful words of encouragement are sure to be at our backs in the trials to come. Auntie Ethel is grateful for us letting her keep the child. We can rely on her help in the trials ahead. Halsin is grateful for our help protecting the sanctity of life. We can count on his formidable druidic powers, should the need arise. Yurgir, pleased to be free of his contract, will lend us the hellish might of an orthon in the trials to come. Mizora is sure to seek revenge for her abduction to Moonrise Towers. When the time comes to face the Absolute, we'll find her on our side. Isobel is grateful that, thanks to us, her beloved is safe. We are sure to have the light of Selûne guiding us in the darkness to come. Dame Aylin, the fearsome aasimar, is now our sworn ally. She'll have our backs in any fight - no matter the enemy. Lorroakan is more powerful than ever with the Nightsong in his possession, thanks to us. The might of Ramazith's Tower will be at our backs, should we ever need it. Rolan is grateful for our help securing his position in Ramazith's Tower. We can rely on the tower's full power, should we ever need it. Arabella is back from learning how to control her powers. We can trust that her magic will be there to help us when we need it most. The strange creature is thankful that we helped it enter the city. No doubt we'll have a powerful ally when we need it most. Valeria feels indebted to us for having saved her from an untimely death. She and her City Watch are prepared to support us in the final battle. Dammon the weaponsmith has become a staunch ally. We can rely on his ingenuity and the owlbear cub's might in our final battle. Wulbren and the Ironhand Gnomes no longer have to contend with the Gondians. We can rely on their aid, should we ever need it. The Gondians' lives were saved with our help. We've made loyal allies in them, should we ever need their aid. Barcus won't forget that we helped him become the new leader of the Ironhand Gnomes. We can count on his support should we ever need it. Grand Duke Ravengard is grateful for us saving him from the Absolute's clutches. He will stand by our side in the final battle. Florrick is immensely grateful that we freed her and helped with the threat at Moonrise. We are sure to have her and the Flaming Fist by our side when we need it most. The Zhentarim don't like to be in anyone's debt - it's bad for business. For helping them, we are sure to have their blades on our side, should it come to protecting the city. It's their new home, after all. Nine-Fingers is grateful that we helped her retain control of the Guild - she's not one to give away what's hers. We can count on her and her Lady's Court in the final battle. Mol isn't one to forget those who have helped her along the way. She'll have our back in the fight to come. We've made an ally of Kith'rak Voss. He and his mighty steed will aid us when the time comes. Astarion is grateful for us helping him become Vampire Ascendant. We can count on his dark magic in the final battle. The Gur people are grateful for our role in taking down Cazador Szarr. We are sure to have them by our side, come what may. Shadowheart is thankful that we helped her gain her rightful position in the Sharran Cloister. We can count on the dark power of the Sharrans in the battle to come. Viconia is grateful that we helped her establish her rightful position. We can count on Viconia and Lady Shar's faithful in the fight to come. Jaheira has joined our party. We'll have whatever aid the High Harper can muster in the fight to come. Bhaal is most pleased we have embraced him. The Lord's slayer will make for a powerful ally in the battle ahead. Updates for Deceased/Abandoned Characters The following objectives are added for characters who leave or are killed: Halsin has left, forging his own path. He won't help us in the fight to come. We killed Dammon, so he and the owlbear cub can no longer aid us in the battle to come. Shadowheart has left, so we will be without her aid in the battle to come. We killed Viconia, so have lost the aid of her and Lady Shar's faithful. Auntie Ethel would have lent us her aid, but we killed her before she could. We killed Ulma, so we will no longer have the help of the Gur people in the final battle. Astarion is gone, so we will be without his aid in the fight to come. Counsellor Florrick was ready to support us in battle, but we killed her before she could. The Guild are leaderless. They're in no condition to help us in our fight. The Zhentarim are newly victorious, but leaderless. They will be busy with matters of their own, so will not be able to aid us. Jaheira has left us - and with her, any chance of aid from the Harpers in the fight to come. With Wyll dead, Mizora has little interest in helping us. We sent Yurgir, who could have been a powerful ally in our final battle, back to the Hells. We killed the owlbear cub, despite how far it had come. We will no longer have its support in the battle to come. The phasm would have aided us in battle, no matter how formidable our foe, but we killed it. We killed Grand Duke Ravengard, who can no longer help us in the fight to come. We killed Isobel despite all we did for her and Dame Aylin. She can no longer help us in the final battle. We killed Dame Aylin despite all we did for her and Isobel. She can no longer help us in the final battle. We killed Lorroakan, so no longer have his support from the heights of Ramazith's Tower. We killed Rolan, despite having helped him accomplish his goals. He can no longer aid us when the time comes. We killed Wulbren. He can no longer aid us in our final battle. We killed Barcus, an unfortunate gnome until the end. He can no longer aid us in our final battle. We killed Valeria, despite having saved her so recently. She can no longer aid us in our final battle. We killed Volo, just a humble bard and documentarian at the core. He can no longer help us in the fight to come. Quest Compete The allies we've made on our journey have all gathered together - ready to lend us their power in the battle ahead. It is time to finish this - once and for all. Factors [ edit section | visual editor ] Objectives for this quest are often mutually exclusive (i.e. those who choose to side with Minthara over Halsin would not receive these objectives in their quest log.) For all companions, they must be recruited in Act One and their personal story quests must be resolved for their objectives to be completed in Gather Your Allies. Ally Recruitment Boon Volo During Act One, complete Rescue Volo to free him from the goblins at the Goblin Camp . During Act Three, Volo is encountered again near the Steel Watch Foundry in the Lower City , tied to a chair in front of several Smokepowder barrels. After battling Volo's captors and saving him before the barrels explode, he will join your camp. Volo's Guide to Monsters : +2 to Attack Rolls , Saving Throws and Ability Checks . Auntie Ethel Complete Get Help from Auntie Ethel and following part of the Save Mayrina questline. After fighting Auntie Ethel and reducing her health a sufficient amount, Ethel tries to make a deal for a permanent stat boost in exchange for keeping Mayrina, leaving their deal intact. If the party killed Ethel, they can still work with her by finding her disguised as Captain Grisly during Save Vanra . If the party kills Lora , then Ethel is willing to strike a deal with them, even if they killed her previously, as she is so amused by the turn of events. Veil of the Weird: Channel Auntie Ethel's magic to render 5 creatures withing range Invisible. Rolan In Act One, complete Save the Refugees by siding with the Tieflings. In Act Two, don't let Isobel be killed or kidnapped during Resolve the Abduction , then complete Find Rolan in the Shadows by saving Rolan. In Act Three, Rolan is found in Sorcerous Sundries . Complete Find the Nightsong by siding with Dame Aylin against Lorroakan to have Rolan take over Ramazith's Tower . Rolan's Firestorm : Call upon Rolan, to unleash a fiery barrage from the Ramazith's Tower, 10d6 ⁠ Fire + 10d6 ⁠ Force dmg. Halsin In Act One, complete Rescue the Druid Halsin with Halsin alive. In Act One, Save the Refugees must be completed by rescuing the Tieflings and stopping the ritual in the Grove. After this Halsin comes with the party to the Shadow-Cursed Lands . In Act Two, don't let Isobel be killed or kidnapped during Resolve the Abduction . In Act Two, speak with Art Cullagh at Last Light Inn then visit Halsin in camp and tell him that Art mentioned Thaniel. From this point, Wake up Art Cullagh and Lift the Shadow Curse must be completed. Halsin will then join your party as a permanent companion. Spirit of the Land : Affected entities gain +1 to all Ability Scores , +2m Movement Speed . Arabella In Act One, complete Save the Refugees by siding with the Tieflings. In Act Two, complete Find Arabella's Parents . In Act Three, find Arabella in the Lower City Sewers , where she agrees to help the party. Weavewalker : One must remove all obstacles to follow one's destiny. Arabella's favour grants affected entities Freedom of Movement . Dammon In Act One, complete Save the Refugees by siding with the Tieflings. In Act One, the Owlbear Cub from the Owlbear Nest must join your camp. In Act Two, don't let Isobel be killed or kidnapped during Resolve the Abduction . Battle-Ready Owlbear : Summon your owlbear cub, all grown up and ready to rage; in full armour. Mol In Act One, complete Save the Refugees by siding with the Tieflings. In Act Three, find Mol in the Guildhall and learn about her contract with Raphael . If her contract is stolen from the House of Hope , she agrees to help in the final fight. If Raphael is killed, the contract can be still given to Mol, but Raphael's death can not be mentioned, and a successfull Persuasion Check must be passed. Fetcher's Favour : Affected entities can cast Rays of Fire , reduce all ⁠ Fire damage by 5 and gain additional 1d4 to Charisma checks and Saving Throws . Yurgir In Act Three, complete Deal with the Devil by breaking into the House of Hope . Yurgir's willingness to help the party depends on whether Break Yurgir's Contract was completed by in Act Two by defeating the Dark Justiciar Lyrthindor . He can be convinced to fight against Raphael with a persuasion check of 30, if the party killed him during Kill Raphael's Old Enemy . If he is persuaded and Raphael is defeated, then he will agree to help in the final fight. Hellstalker Yurgir : Summon Yurgir to join your side in battle. Mizora In Act Two, complete The Blade of Frontiers by saving Mizora in the Mind Flayer Colony . In Act Three, speak with Mizora at Wyrm's Rock as part of The Grand Duke . She will then appear at your camp during the next long rest, and will remain there for the rest of the game. Speak to her and choose "If you're going to be staying, I need something in return." Mizora states that she wishes to take revenge on the Absolute after being kidnapped and agrees to help in the final fight. Mizora, Agent of Avernus : Summon Mizora to join your side in battle. Isobel In Act Two, complete Resolve the Abduction without Isobel's death. In Act Two, during Find the Nightsong , Dame Aylin must be spared by Shadowheart . Isobel and Aylin will join your camp after Ketheric Thorm has been defeated. In Act Three, complete Find the Nightsong with Dame Aylin free. Balm of the Moonmaiden : Heal 14d6 up to 6 nearby allies. Dame Aylin In Act Two, during Find the Nightsong , Dame Aylin must be spared by Shadowheart . Isobel and Aylin will join your camp after Ketheric Thorm has been defeated. Aylin will join your camp after Ketheric Thorm has been defeated. In Act Three, complete Find the Nightsong with Dame Aylin free. Sword of the Silverlight : Summon Dame Aylin, to join your side in battle. Jaheira In Act Three, complete The High Harper with Minsc left alive. After Minsc is tracked down, he must be defeated with a non-lethal strike, given protection by the Astral Prism, and shown that the real Jaheira is alive. After this, Minsc joins the party as a companion and Jaheira counts herself as a loyal ally to the party. Silver Harp Squadron : Summon 3 elite Harper archers, to join your side in battle. Valeria In Act Three complete Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders and Investigate the Murders , and reject the Murder Tribunal during Impress the Murder Tribunal . Valeria is chained up in an alcove off to the side of the Tribunal, where she can be rescued. The Watch : Summon two City Watch great weapon fighters. Lorroakan In Act Two, Dame Aylin must be spared by Shadowheart during Find the Nightsong . In Act Three, complete Find the Nightsong by helping Lorroakan capture Dame Aylin . Lorroakan's Firestorm : Lorroakan uses all the arcane might Ramazith's Tower, 10d6 ⁠ Fire + 10d6 ⁠ Force damage. Ulder Ravengard In Act Three, find the Duke alive at the end of Rescue the Grand Duke . This can be achieved by Wyll remaining in a pact with Mizora in exchange for the Duke's location, or simply by rescuing the Duke in the Iron Throne prison during the Save the Gondians quest. If Wyll broke his pact with Mizora, he needs to be protected from explosive spiders in addition to the sahuagin on the exploding prison. Rallied : Galvanising word and will of Duke Ravengard runs hot through your veins - gain 30 temporary hit points. Counsellor Florrick In Act One, rescued her from a burning building in the initial stages of Rescue the Grand Duke at Waukeen's Rest . In Act Three, free her from Wrym's Rock Prison to complete Free Counsellor Florrick . Florrick's Cohort : Summon 3 highly defensive melee fighters that utilize reach. Nine-Fingers Keene In Act Three, during Aid the Underduke , the Guild is invaded by the Zhentarim , who seek to overthrow them and take control over Baldur's Gate's criminal underbelly. Side with the the Guild and keep Nine-Fingers Keene. Guildmaster Keene's Fixers : Summon two elite assassin mercenaries. (rogues) Zhentarim In Act Three, overthrow the Guild during Aid the Underduke . Did not get Zhentarim summons, while sided with; despite getting a journal entry. Zhent : Summon Zhent , presumably similar to Keene's. Wulbren In Act Two, complete Rescue Wulbren with Wulbren saved. In Act Three, complete Deal with the Gnomes and Avenge the Ironhands with the Steel Watch disabled. If Save the Gondians was also completed, Wulbren must be sided with and the Gondians defeated. ' Ironhand Grenadier : Summon 2 Ironhand Gnomes, who can throw blinding bombs and shoot Smokepowder Arrows . Barcus In Act One, complete Rescue the Gnome with Barcus left alive. In Act Two, complete Save the Grymforge Gnomes and Rescue Wulbren with Wulbren saved. In Act Three, complete Deal with the Gnomes , Avenge the Ironhands , and Save the Gondians with the Gondian's families saved. After Wulbren confronts the Gondians, the party must advocate for the Gondians and Ironhand Gnomes to work together, with Barcus as their leader. Ironhand Grenadier : Summon 2 Ironhand Gnomes, who can throw blinding bombs and shoot Smokepowder Arrows . Ulma In Act Three, complete Investigate Cazador's Palace by defeating Cazador and stopping the Black Mass ritual stopped. The Gur are grateful and agree to help during the final fight. Gur Huntwardens : Summon two Gur warriors and a Sharpshooter. Astarion In Act Three , defeat Cazador and complete the Black Mass ritual to help Astarion become an ascended vampire. Retinue of the Vampire Lord : Summon 2 Shadows , 2 Giant Skeletons , a Ghast , a Shadow Mastiff and a Werewolf . Kith'rak Voss In Act Three, complete Help Kith'rak Voss and retrieve the Orphic Hammer from the House of Hope , then choose to free Orpheus during Free Orpheus . Kirh'raki Inferno : Command the red dragon of Supreme Kith'rak Voss to breathe a wall of fire onto the battlefield. 12d6 ⁠ Fire dmg. Viconia In Act Two, Dame Aylin must be spared by Shadowheart during Find the Nightsong . Test this. In Act Three, complete Investigate the House of Grief and Surrender Shadowheart to Viconia by betraying Shadowheart and turning her over to Viconia. Nightbringer's Shadow Adepts : Summon two Sharran Novices and two Sharran Fidelian's. Shadowheart In Act Two, don't let Shadowheart spare Dame Aylin during Find the Nightsong . In Act Three, complete Investigate the House of Grief by helping Shadowheart overthrow Viconia DeVir to become the leader of the Sharran cloister. Nightbringer's Shadow Adepts : Summon two Sharran Novices and two Sharran Fidelian's. Bhaal In Act Three, complete Impress the Murder Tribunal by impressing the Murder Tribunal to become a Bhaalist worshipper. A Most Bloody Inheritance The Dread Lord Bhaal looks favourably on his chosen. You can cast Stunning Gaze and your Critical Hit Attack Roll requirement is reduced by 2. This effect can stack. Zevlor In Act One, complete Save the Refugees by siding with the Tieflings. In Act Two, complete Find Zevlor by freeing him from the pod in the Mind Flayer Colony . The Hellrider Platoon : Summon Zevlor and a Paladin and a Cleric. This currently has no journal entry. Strange Ox Don't attack it during Act One or Two. In Act Three, complete Help the Devilish Ox by smuggling the ox into the Lower City . An Apple a Day : Summon Zlorb the shapeshifting monstrosity that can change into different types of monsters. Results [ edit section | visual editor ] Gale can also blow himself up After completing Free Orpheus , the final battle begins to Confront the Elder Brain . The player receives the special skill Call Forth Allies which summons friendly units in combat based on the characters who have been recruited. The recruited characters also appear in a room in the High Hall , where they give a short dialogue line of support. If Orpheus was recruited, player will also have Orphic Favour : While withing 18m of Orpheus, affected entity has Resistance to Psychic damage and +3 bonus to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma Saving Throws. ## Punish the Wicked
- **来源**: [Punish the Wicked](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Punish_the_Wicked)
- **分类**: Quests

He Who Was and his Raven Punish the Wicked is a quest in Act Two of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with He Who Was in the Ruined Battlefield . Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 2.1 Dealing with Madeline 3 Companion approval 4 Quest rewards Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Objectives and journal entries may vary pending player decisions and outcomes. Find the ledger. He Who Was wants to bring justice to the victims of a murderer - to do so, he needs a ledger belonging to the killer. It is hidden in The Waning Moon. Give the ledger to He Who Was. We found the ledger. We should give it to He Who Was. Quest Complete We gave the ledger to He Who Was and punished the killer for her crimes. He was pleased. We refused to give the ledger to He Who Was, and do not know what became of him. He Who Was is no more. He Who Was wanted Madeline punished - we forgave her instead. He was furious. We forced He Who Was to stab himself over and over again during the ritual. He was furious. We left the shadowlands and may never know what became of He Who Was. Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] A loose plank holds the ledger. A Shadar-Kai called He Who Was can be found at the Ruined Battlefield east of the Last Light Inn at X: 126 Y: 105 . He has a ritual circle set up and is using Speak with Dead on a corpse. He Who Was initially tells the party to clear off, but his white raven suggests they might be able to help. He explains that the woman is Madeline , and that she was a murderer. She worked at The Waning Moon and kept logs on all her patrons, betraying their secrets to the Dark Justiciars . He asks the party to find Madeline's Ledger at the tavern and bring it back. He Who Was The Waning Moon is in Reithwin Town , east of the Tollhouse and west of the road to the Baldur's Gate Waypoint. The ledger is behind the bar, under a loose plank at X: -223 Y: -78 which is detected with a Perception check. If handing the ledger to He Who Was, he performs a ritual to channel Madeline's spirit through his own body, allowing the party to speak to her. Madeline claims she had been instructed by Dark Justiciar Netasha to report everything, big or small; she was too scared to say no, which is why she reported her friends complaining about Ketheric while drunk. The Dark Justiciar promised she would only chat with the two men. Instead, she gave them knives, and told them to stab themselves until she said stop - but she never said to stop. Madeline regrets it and is horrified that her actions led to the deaths of her friends. Dealing with Madeline [ edit section | visual editor ] There are several ways to deal with Madeline after learning of her story: [DARK URGE]  I once ended one dear to me. There is no punishment which could atone for it. [PERSUASION]  Anything? Then hurt yourself as Ben and Marc did - stab yourself. (DC 14) [BARBARIAN] [PERSUASION]  You could have fought back. You deserve no forgiveness, COWARD! (DC 10  ) [BARD] [PERSUASION]  Yours is a classic tale of cowardice. Were you a character in a tale of mine, I would kill you off - immediately. (DC 10  ) [BARD] [PERSUASION]  When I tell this tale, you won't be the villain - I promise. The Dark Justiciar is to blame. (DC 10  ) [MONK] [PERSUASION]  You had the means to stop it - you chose not to. You let fear and cowardice ruin you. (DC 10  ) [MONK] [PERSUASION]  Forgiveness comes from within - I cannot gift it to you. But know that I would, if I could. (DC 10  ) [PERSUASION]  Pathetic - you murdered your friends. You're a coward. (DC 10) [PERSUASION]  There's nothing you need do. This wasn't your fault - I promise. (DC 10) [GOOD CLERIC] [PERSUASION]  By the light of the one I serve, I forgive you. This wasn't your doing. (DC 10) [EVIL CLERIC] [PERSUASION]  Stab yourself. Rip your stomach open. Feel the pain of your friends - only then will you be free. (DC 6) If Madeline is made to stab herself once, or is shamed as a coward, then He Who Was is satisfied with the results and gives the party the Raven Gloves as a reward. This grants the ⁠ No Rest for the Wicked inspiration to party members with the Acolyte background. If forgiving her, or making her stab herself a second time, he becomes enraged and attack the party. Each stab inflicts 5 damage, which carry over into combat. The inspiration ⁠ Let Sleeping Dogs Lie is granted instead for party members with the Acolyte background. Failing any of the rolls has the connection fade, and while He Who Was is slightly disappointed, he still rewards the party's efforts. The Dark Urge has a special interaction with Madeline if they previously killed their dearest companion. They share this with her and say there can be no atonement for such a deed, at which point Madeline becomes overwhelmed with guilt and fades away, with the same results as shaming her for her cowardice but requiring no Persuasion checks. He Who Was also comments on the Dark Urge's guilt, but does not attack. Paladins will break their Oaths during this quest if certain actions are taken: Oath of Vengeance : Forgive Madeline, prevent her from going through with stabbing herself, or attack He Who Was before the ritual starts Oath of Devotion / Oath of the Ancients / Oath of the Crown : Make Madeline stab herself, or call her a coward Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] When first speaking to He Who Was: Tell him "I doubt you're here out of the goodness of your heart."   +1   +1 Agree to help him, without specifying that you want to be paid   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1   +1 When judging Madeline: Tell her to stab herself   -1   +1   +1   -1   -1   +1   -1   +1 Tell her to " Start stabbing, and don't stop until I say so. " or to " Prove you're sorry. Do it for Ben and Marc. "   -1   +2   +1   -1   -1   +1   -1   +1 Tell her to stop   +1   -2   -1   +1   +1   -1   +1   -1 Call her a coward   +1   -1   -1   +1   +1   -1   +1   -1 Forgive her   +1   -1   -1   +1   +1   -1   +1   -1 Quest rewards [ edit section | visual editor ] Raven Gloves , if Madeline is stabbed only once or called a coward Loot from He Who Was' body, if Madeline is stabbed multiple times v t e Quests v t e Main quests Multi-act quests Find a Cure Get Help from Healer Nettie Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Get Help from Auntie Ethel Rescue the Druid Halsin Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite Find the Githyanki Crèche Travel to Moonrise Towers Gather Your Allies Find the Nightsong Personal quests Help Your Protector Deal with the Devil Fulfill the Deal Escape the Deal Discover the History of Prince Orpheus Discover the Artefact's Secrets Free Orpheus Embrace Your Potential Help Kith'rak Voss The Urge Open Your Scars Servant of None Forging a Heart Companion quests The Blade of Frontiers The Grand Duke Wyrmway Daughter of Darkness The Chosen of Shar A Familiar Face The Githyanki Warrior Vlaakith's Will The Prince of the Comet Our Fiery Friend The Hellion's Heart The Pale Elf The Wizard of Waterdeep In Case of Death... ## Quests
- **来源**: [Quests](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Quests)
- **分类**: Quests

Quests are tasks that can be undertaken by the player and their adventuring party in Baldur's Gate 3 , some of which provide a reward or a choice between multiple rewards. Quests are recorded in the Journal. Contents 1 Prologue 2 Multi-act main quests 3 Companions 3.1 Main Quests 3.2 Sub Quests 4 Personal quests 5 Origin personal quests 6 Act One 6.1 Ravaged Beach 6.2 Emerald Grove 6.3 Blighted Village 6.4 Sunlit Wetlands 6.5 Risen Road 6.6 Goblin Camp and Shattered Sanctum 6.7 Underdark 6.8 Grymforge 6.9 Rosymorn Monastery Trail 7 Act Two 7.1 Shadow-Cursed Lands 7.2 Moonrise Towers 8 Act Three 8.1 Rivington 8.2 Baldur's Gate 8.3 House of Hope 8.4 Finale Prologue [ edit section | visual editor ] Escape the Nautiloid We've been abducted by mind flayers and infected with some kind of parasite. We need to find a way off this ship. Rescue the Illithids' Captive We encountered a survivor, trapped inside one of the pods aboard the nautiloid. Perhaps we can find a way to free her. Multi-act main quests [ edit section | visual editor ] Find a Cure   , Main quest. Subquests: Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Find the Githyanki Crèche Get Help from Auntie Ethel Get Help from Healer Nettie Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite Rescue the Druid Halsin Find the Nightsong   , , A wizard will pay anyone to track down an ancient relic, the Nightsong and bring it to him. The Nightsong is in some kind of temple. Gather Your Allies   , , Recruit allies in the fight against the cult. Travel to Moonrise Towers   , Main quest. It is divided into two subquests, reflective of the two paths to the Shadow-Cursed Lands: Travel through the Mountain Pass Travel through the Underdark Companions [ edit section | visual editor ] Main Quests [ edit section | visual editor ] Daughter of Darkness   , , We recruited a half-elf named Shadowheart. She was also infected aboard the nautiloid and was playing with a strange object when we met her. Subquests: A Familiar Face The Chosen of Shar Our Fiery Friend   , , We met a fiery tiefling called Karlach. She said servants of the archdevil Zariel were nearby, disguised as paladins of Tyr. Subquest: The Hellion's Heart The Blade of Frontiers   , , We recruited Wyll, a monster hunter known as the Blade of Frontiers. He is on a mission to kill Karlach, a powerful devil who is a danger to the entire Sword Coast. Subquests: The Grand Duke Wyrmway The Githyanki Warrior   , , Lae'zel promised we could be cleansed of our parasites at a Githyanki Crèche. We should be on the lookout for signs of githyanki presence during our travels. The High Harper   Jaheira asked us to go to Danthelon's Dancing Axe in Wyrm's Crossing, where her Harper contacts are waiting to report. The Pale Elf   , , We met a strange elf who had also been infected with a parasite. He was hostile at first, but agreed to join us when he learned we were infected too. The Wizard of Waterdeep   , , A wizard named Gale joined the party. He claims to have been on the nautiloid - which means he's infected too. Subquests: Balthazar's Experiment In Case of Death... Sub Quests [ edit section | visual editor ] A Familiar Face   , We have entered the Lower City - Shadowheart's old stomping grounds. Perhaps the friend she remembered due to the Noblestalk can still be found with the rest of the Sharrans. Balthazar's Experiment   We found a strange ritual circle hidden in a secret workshop within Balthazar's chambers. Gale was able to understand the strange sigils used to cast it, and says it was used to create the Moonlanterns that protect their wielders from the shadow curse. In Case of Death... Gale died, activating a magical projection of himself which insisted that he be resurrected with the utmost urgency. The Chosen of Shar   Shadowheart has shown interest in finding the lair of the Dark Justiciar - an elite force dedicated to the goddess Shar. The Grand Duke   , , A group of Flaming Fist mercenaries believe Grand Duke Ravengard of Baldur's Gate is trapped inside, and are trying to break inside. The Hellion's Heart   , , Karlach needs an infernal mechanic to tune up the engine she has for a heart. There might be one nearby. Wyrmway   After reading 'The Legend of Ansur', We discovered the great wyrm Ansur resides in a secret lair called the Wyrmway. The entrance is apparently located somewhere within Wyrm's Rock Prison, and the notes inside it hint that opening the way involves lightning sparks and torches. Personal quests [ edit section | visual editor ] Deal with the Devil   We spoke with Mamzell Amira on the ground floor of Sharess' Caress, and she mentioned that the devil Raphael has taken a room on the top floor. What's he doing here? We should pay Raphael a visit and find out. Subquests: Escape the Deal Fulfill the Deal Discover the Artefact's Secrets   , Shadowheart carries a strange artefact. It seemed to protect us from a horrible voice. She stubbornly avoids the subject. We should find out more about it. Discover the History of Prince Orpheus   , There may be a way to decipher these books. We should keep an eye out for something that might aid us. Embrace Your Potential   , , We were visited in our dreams by a mysterious figure, who told us that our illithid parasites are special and the source of great potential. Escape the Deal   We signed Raphael's deal but are having second thoughts about giving the ultra-powerful Crown of Karsus to a devil. Raphael is smart, but perhaps he can be outsmarted. Free Orpheus   We found out that the Astral Prism is a prison for the githyanki prince Orpheus. The mind flayer has been using Orpheus' powers to suppress the influence of the Absolute. We should find out if there's a way to free Orpheus from his chains. Fulfill the Deal   According to the terms of our deal with Raphael, we must give him the Crown of Karsus after we've defeated the Absolute threat. But first we must get hold of the relic. Help Kith'rak Voss   , , Kith'rak Voss visited our camp and asked us to help him free someone held prisoner within the Astral Prism. We agreed to bring the Prism to Baldur's Gate and meet him there. Help Your Protector   During the night, we were awoken by the voice of the Absolute. A githyanki contingent ambushed us. We heard the voice of the Dream Visitor, desperately seeking our help. Origin personal quests [ edit section | visual editor ] Call of the Blood   , , Astarion Origin Quest. I'm... alive? But it won't be long before my old master realises I'm missing, so I had better find out what in the hells is going on and quickly. Forging a Heart   , , Dammon, an infernal mechanic, told me to find some infernal iron. He might be able to repair my heart. Open Your Scars   , The Dark Urge finally learns the truth about themselves. Servant of None   , , Karlach Origin Quest. This is it. I've been trapped in the Hells for a decade - and this nautiloid is my ticket out. Subquest: Forging a Heart The Prince of the Comet   , Lae'zel Origin Subquest. Gith's son, the Prince of the Comet, is the rightful heir to the Githyanki Empire. The Urge   , , The Dark Urge Origin Quest. These vile things you do... Don't you wonder why you're doing them? You want to know, don't you? Subquest: Open Your Scars The Wizard of Waterdeep   , , Gale Origin Quest. I was an archmage - powerful, proud, full of potential - until my failed attempt to impress my lover, the goddess Mystra... Vlaakith's Will   , Lae'zel Origin Subquest. Orpheus will die by my hand, and I will be named Baht t'Vlaakith. Act One [ edit section | visual editor ] Quests that occur during Act One , taking place in the Wilderness and the Underdark . Ravaged Beach [ edit section | visual editor ] Explore the Ruins We met some bandits near some ruins. They've been trying to break into a crypt - with no success. Whatever they're after is probably still inside. Free Lae'zel We found Lae'zel, the githyanki from the nautiloid, trapped in a hanging cage. Two tieflings are deciding what to do with her. Emerald Grove [ edit section | visual editor ] Find Doni As the tieflings prepare for the siege, Rikka asked us to find Doni and bring him to safety. Find Your Belongings We've been robbed - by children no less. They distracted us by posing as merchants. We should have a word with them. Get Help from Healer Nettie Aradin told us that the druid Halsin has an apprentice. If we can find her, she might be able to help us with the parasite. Investigate Kagha The Rite of Thorns is dangerous magic. Why is Kagha so determined to do this? We should investigate. Investigate the Beach We heard strange music on the beach. Where is it coming from? Kill Kagha The tieflings and druids are at an impasse. Killing Kagha might tip the balance. Raid the Emerald Grove Minthara is preparing to attack the grove and told us to wait for next light. We should get some rest. Return the Locket We met an adventurer called Barth who accused a tiefling child of stealing his locket. We suspected the child but couldn't get the locket back. Save Arabella We learned that a child named Arabella is being held by the druids on charges of theft. We should check on her. Save the First Druid First Druid Halsin might be the only one capable of stopping Kagha from finishing the ritual. He was last seen on an expedition into goblin territory. Save the Goblin Sazza The goblin Sazza is a prisoner in the grove. She's promise us an introduction to her tribe and their powerful healer - if we break her out. Save the Refugees Kagha, the leader of the druids, ordered the tiefling to leave the grove. Zevlor fears they won't survive on the road and asked us to intervene. Steal the Sacred Idol Mol asked us to steal some kind of idol from the druids. Blighted Village [ edit section | visual editor ] Destroy the Ancient Tome   , , Evil is inscribed on every page of this book. But all evil has a weakness - there must be a way to destroy it. Finish the Masterwork Weapon We found blueprints for masterwork weapons. All we need to forge one is some bark from a Sussur Tree. Rescue the Gnome We spotted a deep gnome tied to the blades of a windmill. He's being tormented by a group of goblins. Search the Cellar   , , We found a journal that mentioned a cellar - along with some powerful items. This sounds promising and, more importantly, valuable. Subquests: Unlock the Ancient Tome Destroy the Ancient Tome Unlock the Ancient Tome   , , This book is locked tight, and the mechanism isn't shaped for a key. Maybe some kind of stone would work? Sunlit Wetlands [ edit section | visual editor ] Get Help from Auntie Ethel We met an eccentric old lady in the Emerald Grove. She's confident she can remove our parasites and invited us to her teahouse. Save Mayrina Two brothers said that their sister Mayrina is being held against her will at Ethel's house - something the old woman denied. Risen Road [ edit section | visual editor ] Find the Missing Shipment Zarys, leader of the local Zhentarim, said her agents went missing while transporting a shipment. She'll pay a hefty sum if we return it unopened. Free the Artist   , We met Oskar, an artist captured by the Zhentarim. He begged us to help him escape, promising that his patron will reward us handsomely. Hunt the Devil We met a group of paladins of Tyr who are hunting a devil. Anders asked for our help - we agreed to search for the devil. Rescue the Grand Duke   , , We approached a burning inn called Waukeen's Rest. Flaming Fists are trying to break down the door - a Grand Duke of Baldur's Gate is trapped inside. Rescue the Trapped Man We found a man trapped under a beam in Waukeen's Rest. Goblin Camp and Shattered Sanctum [ edit section | visual editor ] Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help We learned that a goblin tribe is led by a priestess with powerful magic. Dealing with goblins is risky, but this might be one way to cure ourselves. Defeat the Goblins If the tieflings are to make their way to Baldur's Gate, we will need to deal with the goblins. Zevlor thinks someone must be organising them. We should investigate their camp. Rescue the Druid Halsin Halsin was actively researching the parasite - he might be one of the few people who understand our condition. Rescue Volo We found Volo performing for the goblins under significant duress. He was led into the camp's interior by a guard - he clearly needs help. Underdark [ edit section | visual editor ] Avenge Glut's Circle A myconid named Glut heard the Sovereign ask us to kill the duergar. It wants to join us. Defeat the Duergar Intruders We agreed to help the Sovereign remove the duergar who threatened the myconid colony. Deliver Nere's Head Sovereign Spaw wants the head of the drow Nere. Cure the Poisoned Gnome We met Thulla, a deep gnome who was poisoned. The Underdark might hold a cure, but we have to be quick, she won't survive for long. Find the Missing Boots We offered to help a duergar to track down a runaway slave. The slave escaped with a pair of boots belonging to the duergar's sergeant. Find the Mushroom Picker Derryth told us about her husband Baelen. He's lost somewhere in the Underdark. Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite We mentioned the parasite to Blurg, a hobgoblin. His colleague, a mind flayer named Omeluum, offered to examine it. Perhaps it can cure us? Travel through the Underdark We learned that the best way to get to Moonrise Towers is through the Underdark. Tunnels beneath the temple of Selûne will lead us there. Grymforge [ edit section | visual editor ] Blind the Absolute We agreed to help Brithvar and his group double-cross Nere. First, we need to take out the scrying eye - discreetly. Find Explosives Brithvar mentioned that a deep gnome fled with some smokepowder. Her crew should know more. Free True Soul Nere Sergeant Thrinn said the True-Soul leading them is trapped behind the cave-in. She wants us to clear it. Get Past the Rubble We found a passage buried in rubble that leads to the Adamantine Forge. We should clear it. Help the Spirit of the Amulet   , We read the journal of a Dark Justiciar. He mentioned an amulet of great power that also made the wearer laugh. It was cast into the lava. Save the Grymforge Gnomes Thulla, a gnome of the Ironhand clan, asked us to help her kin. Duergar are holding them captive. The Adamantine Forge We learned than an adamantine forge is hidden deep within the Underdark. Rosymorn Monastery Trail [ edit section | visual editor ] Find the Blood of Lathander We learned that a powerful holy relic, the Blood of Lathander, could be somewhere nearby. We should keep an eye out for it as we explore the monastery. Find the Githyanki Crèche Lae'zel told us that the githyanki should be able to cure us, if we can find one of their crèches. Reclaim the Blue Jay's Nest We met a blue jay who asked us to kill the eagles on the monastery roof. He claimed they stole his nest. Steal a Githyanki Egg Lady Esther has asked that we steal an egg from the githyanki. The Society of Brilliance want to incubate it, raise it, and soothe its so-called violent nature. Travel through the Mountain Pass We decided to take the mountain pass. This road should lead us to Moonrise Towers. Act Two [ edit section | visual editor ] Quests that occur during Act Two , taking place in the Shadow-Cursed Lands and Moonrise Towers . Shadow-Cursed Lands [ edit section | visual editor ] Break Yurgir's Contract The orthon is bound by Raphael's contract and seeks a way to free himself from it. Find Arabella's Parents We met Arabella, a tiefling child from the grove, in the shadow-cursed lands. She was looking for her parents. We offered to search for them, and invited her to our camp. Find Rolan in the Shadows Rolan has disappeared into the darkness. He left a message for his siblings to wait for him at Last Light. He's out in the shadow curse alone. We should look for him. Investigate the Selûnite Resistance We found the old notes of a Sharran inquisitor. She had been investigating rumours of clandestine Selûne-worship in the region, and had been following a lead to an abandoned potter's workshop. Perhaps we should look for it. Kill Raphael's Old Enemy Raphael told us of a nemesis of his who lurks in the depths beneath the mausoleum. Evidently we should try to deal with this old enemy. Lift the Shadow Curse According to Halsin, if we want to lift the shadow curse, we must find Thaniel - the spirit of the land. Punish the Wicked He Who Was wants to bring justice to the victims of a murderer - to do so, he needs a ledger belonging to the killer. It is hidden in The Waning Moon. Wake Art Cullagh We met Art Cullagh, a mysterious man lying unconscious in Last Light Inn. He's being cared for by a Flaming Fist. He may have knowledge about the shadow curse. We should see if we can wake him somehow. Moonrise Towers [ edit section | visual editor ] Capture Isobel the Selûnite Cleric Z'rell, Ketheric's enforcer, told us to kidnap Isobel from Last Light and bring her to Moonrise Towers. If we do this, Last Light will no longer be protected from the shadow curse. Decide Minthara's Fate Nightwarden Minthara has been condemned to death. We ought to visit her while we can. Defeat Ketheric Thorm We battled Ketheric Thorm. Before we could finish him, he fled somewhere below the tower. We need to follow him. Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic Minthara told us that the necromancer Balthazar might know more about Ketheric's invulnerability. She suspects the answers we seek lie in Balthazar's chambers on the upper floor. Find Mol We found out that Mol, the leader of the young tiefling pickpockets, has vanished. We should help them find her. Find Zevlor Zevlor was captured by the cult of the Absolute. His fellow tieflings claim he froze and tried to surrender. We should look for him. Follow the Convoy We met a group of cultists preparing to travel to Moonrise Towers. They are waiting for a guide who must be summoned using an instrument the drow Minthara possessed. Infiltrate Moonrise Towers The dream visitor told us to go to Moonrise Towers and infiltrate the cult of the Absolute. The cult's secrets may teach us how to free ourselves of these parasites. Rescue the Tieflings We learned from Alfira that some of the tieflings were taken to Moonrise Towers. She's asked us to save them. Rescue Wulbren We freed the deep gnomes in Grymforge, but more of their kin were taken to Moonrise Towers - including their leader Wulbren. We need to find and rescue them. Resolve the Abduction Marcus, a True Soul who has infiltrated Last Light, told us that his powerful master demands that the cleric Isobel be taken to Moonrise Towers alive. If we do this, Last Light will no longer be protected from the shadow curse. Seek Protection from the Shadow Curse A deadly curse plagues this land. One wrong step could kill us. The shadow curse is even stronger in certain areas. We need to find a way to fend it off. Act Three [ edit section | visual editor ] Quests that occur during Act Three , taking place in Rivington and Baldur's Gate . Rivington [ edit section | visual editor ] Deal with the Gnomes We agreed to help Manip Falcäo track down and kill the gnomes attacking their checkpoint. He promised to reward us if we bring him the head of their leader. We should find the gnomes' hideout. Feed the Mind Flayer A ravenous mind flayer asked us to bring it a humanoid to feast on. Find a Way into Wyrm's Rock Fortress Wyrm's Rock is closed due to the ordination of Gortash - who is about to become Archduke of Baldur's Gate. There must be someone, or something, in Wyrm's Crossing that could help us gain entry. Find Dribbles the Clown Dribbles the Clown, star of the circus, is missing. Ringmaster Lucretious asked us to find him. He's likely dead, but that doesn't seem to bother her. Find the Missing Letters Carrier pigeons have gone missing. Postmaster Danzo asked us to retrieve the letters they carried. He said that if we find the letters, we shouldn't read them. Find the 'Stern Librarian' Ffion We spoke to Mamzell Amira, the proprietor of Sharess' Caress. She asked us to find Ffion, a worker of hers who has gone missing. She told us to start in Ffion's pleasure room called 'Elminster's Library', two flights up. Free Counsellor Florrick We learned of Counsellor Florrick's impending execution, but not her exact location. If we want her help, we should find where she's being kept. Help the Devilish Ox We met an odd creature. It has the shape of an ox, but is clearly something else. We agreed to help it reach the city. It transformed into an apple so we could carry it. Investigate the Suspicious Toys We found a blackmail letter in a toymaker's cellar - something dangerous has been placed inside toys donated to the refugees. We should find them, and quickly. Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders We've been asked to look into the deaths of Father Lorgan and Brilgor at the Open Hand Temple. Sister Yannis, the temple's rector, believes Brilgor's been blamed for the crime too hastily by Investigator Valeria. Baldur's Gate [ edit section | visual editor ] Aid the Underduke Nine-Fingers, leader of the city's criminal Guild, is having her territory threatened by a new player on the scene: the Stone Lord. We should head to the Guildhall to find out more. Avenge the Drowned Flood Tide Allandra Grey bid us avenge Holli, a fallen Waveservant of Umberlee. She was killed by a noxious, polluting beast around Grey Harbour - we must find it and slay its master. Avenge the Hag Survivors We disposed of a hag spy named Jatlo. Cold comfort for the hag's victims, who believe her to be in the city, and who want her gone. Avenge the Ironhands The Ironhand Gnomes are planning something big in Baldur's Gate. We should look for them once we arrive in the city. End Mystic Carrion's Immortality We agreed to help Thrumbo permanently defeat Mystic Carrion. He told us to look for a chamber beneath Carrion's mansion. Find Mystic Carrion's Servant We met Mystic Carrion, who promised to reward us if we bring back the body of one of his zombie servants, Thrumbo. Subquest: End Mystic Carrion's Immortality Help the Hag Survivors We found a poster that mentions a meeting for people who have survived hags. It's being held at Barren's Coop. Investigate Cazador's Palace Ulma told us that a vampire called Cazador has been killing their people and kidnapping their children. She asked us to save the children and slay the vampire. Investigate the House of Grief We found a very disoriented merchant called Arves loitering outside a building. We should find out what happened to him. Subquest: Surrender Shadowheart to Viconia Rescue the Grand Duke   , , We finally found Grand Duke Ravengard - standing by Gortash's side as he crowned Gortash the new Archduke. He disappeared after the ceremony. Retrieve Omeluum We spoke to a hobgoblin called Blurg in the Society of Brilliance Lodge. His illithid companion Omeluum is missing - we agreed to look for it. Return Rakath's Gold We witnessed a heist in the Counting House. Head Banker Rakath asked us to recover the stolen gold - we need to look for clues. Roveer's Storehouse Chef Roveer wants us to kill the rats in his cellar. It's not clear why he can't just do this himself... Save the Gondians We agreed to free the gondians' families, kept hostage by Gortash, in exchange for the Steel Watch's destruction. The hostages' location is kept secret, but Zanner thinks there may be clues in the Foundry's lower levels. Save Vanra Mayrina told us that a hag has kidnapped a child. The mother, Lora, can be found at Basilisk Gate. We should speak to her. Stop the Presses We met a journalist, Estra Stir, who told us we're set to star in the next edition of the Baldur's Mouth Gazette. We should find out why. Surrender Shadowheart to Viconia Viconia asked that we surrender Shadowheart to her in exchange for her help defeating the Absolute. Visit the Emperor's Old Hideout The Emperor asked us to check its old hideout in the Elfsong Tavern - some of its old items may be of use to us. House of Hope [ edit section | visual editor ] Acquire the Gauntlets for Helsik Helsik the diabolist said she will help us reach the House of Hope if we steal a powerful artefact for her while we're there: Gauntlets of Hill Giant Strength. Save Hope We met a strange spirit imprisoned in Raphael's home - named Hope, oddly enough. She mentioned an important hammer before disappearing abruptly. Finale [ edit section | visual editor ] Confront the Elder Brain We can thwart the Chosen of the Dead Three by taking control of the elder brain - but will we use that control to liberate or to conquer? Whatever the answer, it lies in Baldur's Gate. Consider Gortash's Bargain Gortash proposed a pact of allegiance with us. If we kill Orin and take her Netherstone, he will let us rule the city alongside him with the elder brain at our command. Control the Elder Brain Whoever has control over the Netherbrain will hold unspeakable power. We could dominate it and have a thousand kingdoms at our command. Destroy the Elder Brain The Netherbrain is too powerful to let live. Destroying it may be the smartest thing to do. Disable the Steel Watch Gortash is protected by the Steel Watchers. We need to figure out how to disable the Steel Watch. Get Gortash's Netherstone We discovered that Gortash is in Wyrm's Rock Fortress, where he will be sworn in as Archduke of Baldur's Gate. We need to make our way there. Subquests: Consider Gortash's Bargain Disable the Steel Watch Get Orin's Netherstone Orin, the Lash of Bhaal, is hiding somewhere in Baldur's Gate with a Netherstone. We must find her and take it. Subquests: Rescue Orin's Victim Investigate the Murders Impress the Murder Tribunal Impress the Murder Tribunal An unnerving stranger gave us a list of people and asked us to kill from it. If we do so, and bring a severed hand as proof, we can stand before the Murder Tribunal and enter the Temple of Bhaal. Investigate the Murders Duke Stelmane was ritualistically killed at the Elfsong Tavern shortly before our arrival into the city. We should investigate - it may help us find the Lord of Murder's Chosen. Rescue Orin's Victim Orin abducted one of our friends. She told us that she'll release them if we kill Gortash. v t e Quests v t e Main quests Multi-act quests Find a Cure Get Help from Healer Nettie Ask the Goblin Priestess for Help Get Help from Auntie Ethel Rescue the Druid Halsin Help Omeluum Investigate the Parasite Find the Githyanki Crèche Travel to Moonrise Towers Gather Your Allies Find the Nightsong Personal quests Help Your Protector Deal with the Devil Fulfill the Deal Escape the Deal Discover the History of Prince Orpheus Discover the Artefact's Secrets Free Orpheus Embrace Your Potential Help Kith'rak Voss The Urge Open Your Scars Servant of None Forging a Heart Companion quests The Blade of Frontiers The Grand Duke Wyrmway Daughter of Darkness The Chosen of Shar A Familiar Face The Githyanki Warrior Vlaakith's Will The Prince of the Comet Our Fiery Friend The Hellion's Heart The Pale Elf The Wizard of Waterdeep In Case of Death... ## Raid the Emerald Grove
- **来源**: [Raid the Emerald Grove](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Raid_the_Emerald_Grove)
- **分类**: Quests

Minthara commands to attack the grove Raid the Grove is a sub- quest of the Druid Grove's main quest ⁠ Save the Refugees . It can be initiated by talking to Minthara in the Shattered Sanctum within the Goblin Camp and telling her the location of the grove. Contents 1 Objectives 2 Walkthrough 3 Combatants 3.1 Cult of the Absolute 3.2 Emerald Grove 4 Quest rewards 5 Companion approval 6 Consequences 6.1 Raiding the grove 6.2 Siding with the tieflings and druids and defending the grove 6.3 Not participating in the fight at the grove 7 Notes and references Objectives [ edit section | visual editor ] Objectives and journal entries may vary pending story decisions and outcomes. Speak with Minthara. "Dror Ragzlin told us to speak to the drow Minthara. She plans to raid the adventurers' refuge - the grove." Interrogate the prisoner. "Minthara asked us to interrogate the prisoner. She wants to know where the adventurers were hiding out." Speak with Minthara. "The adventurer gave in and revealed the location of the grove. We have what the drow Minthara needs to order the raid." Prepare to raid the Grove. "Minthara is preparing to attack the grove and told us to wait for next light. We should get some rest." "Sazza told the drow Minthara where the grove is. Minthara plans to raid it - and wants our help." Secure the Emerald Grove. "Minthara and her warband have set out for the Grove. They are waiting for us to infiltrate it." Report to the tiefling leader. "We arrived at the grove just in time. Minthara's raiders will be here soon." Blow the horn. "The tieflings are as ready as they can be. All that's left is to sound the horn." Defeat the raiders. "Minthara arrived with raiders by her side. Defeating them means safety at last for the tieflings." Return to Zevlor/Asharak/Cerys. "The goblins were beaten back, and the tieflings lived to tell the tale. Zevlor/Asharak/Cerys wants to talk." Slaughter the Emerald Grove. "We chose Minthara and the Absolute over the tieflings. Now to take the grove." "The tieflings are dead, but the druids are making a last stand at their sacred pool." Return to Minthara. "Tieflings and druids alike lie dead. The grove belongs to the Absolute. Minthara will be pleased." "The grove was overrun before we could get involved. We should speak to Minthara." "Faced with a barricade of vines, the goblins couldn't raid the grove. Minthara isn't happy." Quest Complete "The goblin threat has ended, and the tieflings are ready to leave. Tonight, we celebrate our victory at camp." "With the tieflings dead, the grove is ours. Pleased, the Absolute granted us new powers. Tonight we celebrate at camp." "Minthara was furious that the grove was sealed and attacked us." "Minthara died before she could lead an attack on the grove." "Minthara died before she could reward us for our part in the attack on the grove." Walkthrough [ edit section | visual editor ] This topic has a community guide . Raiding the Emerald Grove can be started either by talking to Minthara in the Shattered Sanctum alone, or by completing ⁠ Save the Goblin Sazza and accompanying Sazza to inform Minthara about the Grove. Once the goblin forces are aware of the Grove's location, they mobilize to raid it. Minthara bids the party go back to the Grove and infiltrate it from within. The raid occurs after the next Long Rest. Once back at the Grove, the druids and tieflings have moved in response to the goblin's movements. The druids lock themselves into the Inner Sanctum and refuse to shelter any outlanders. [ 1 ] Rikka gathers the tiefling children, starting ⁠ Find Doni if the party agrees to help her. To start the raid, a party member must speak to Zevlor on the ramparts at X: 192 Y: 446 It is possible to tell him the party betrayed the tieflings, starting the battle early, or speak with him further for more information on his strategy. If Zevlor believes the party members are on his side, he instructs them to sound the war horn once they are ready to start the raid. Immediately after sounding the horn the goblins appear, as well as Minthara, who orders the player character to open the gate. The player characted can obey: [ 2 ] Obey and open the gate. [EVIL CLERIC] [EVIL PALADIN]  Of course - as does my god. [OATHBREAKER]  They still think I'm on their side. Poor fools. The player character can also refuse instead: [ 2 ] No. This grove is under my protection. I serve Shar, not the Absolute. The gate stays closed.  (Shadowheart only) [CLERIC]  Your god has no power here. New plan - I tear out your throat.  (Astarion only) There's been a change of plan.  (Lae'zel only) I will not. Boo will not. And if you think to triumph here today, drow - you will not.   (Minsc only) (impossible without mods) Not so fast. You've just walked into my trap.  (Wyll only) These people are under my protection - but I'll see you in the Hells.  (Karlach only) [GOOD CLERIC] [NEUTRAL CLERIC] [GOOD PALADIN] [NEUTRAL PALADIN]  No. I'll show the Absolute the power of a true god. [DRUID]  This place is sacred to Silvanus - the Absolute has no power here. [PALADIN]  I will not bring death to this sacred place, Minthara.   (Non-Oathbreaker only) If the party opens the gate, Minthara and the Goblin raiders become allies while the tieflings and Wyll (if present) become enemies. The party must, together with Minthara and the goblins, move through the grove in sections clearing out all that remain. On returning to Minthara after the battle she tells the player character she will meet them at camp for the victory celebration with the goblins. There Minthara congratulates the player character and rewards them with a gift from the Absolute - a True Soul tadpole. After the night ends, Minthara tells the player character that they must go to Moonrise Towers to find their place in the Absolute's Grand Design. She provides a Spider's Lyre and explains that a servant of hers can lead the party through the Shadow-Cursed Lands where Moonrise Towers is located. This instrument can also be pickpocketed from her, which results in a second instrument being generated should she later be recruited as a companion. Then, she leaves, stating that she is gathering the troops to meet the party at Moonrise Towers. This starts ⁠ Travel to Moonrise Towers . Refusing her instructions and protecting the grove results in the tieflings acting as allies. After the battle the surviving tieflings speak to the player character and thank them for their help, then celebrate at camp. If Halsin is alive, he appears to congratulate the player character and explains the strange movements occurring at Moonrise Towers. He tells them that the best shot at curing their tadpoles is going there, and offers to go with them. Combatants [ edit section | visual editor ] Cult of the Absolute [ edit section | visual editor ] Booyahg Benta Brawler Gurd Bugbear Goblin Booyahg Goblin Warlock Goblin Warrior x2 Minthara Rozzak Sapper Dextor Sharp-Eye Eef Sapper Gald Sapper Moke Sharp-Eye Nass Sharp-Eye Neem Sharp-Eye Zami Skrut Sword Spider x2 Warrior Clack Warrior Jawn Zurga Emerald Grove [ edit section | visual editor ] Asharak Arka Elegis Zevlor Quest rewards [ edit section | visual editor ] Gift from the Absolute - if the party sides with the goblins Minthara can become a Companion in Act Two, if the party sides with the goblins, bypasses her completely, resolves her conversation triggering neither the raid nor combat at any point, or knocks her unconscious [ 3 ] with a Non-Lethal Attack . Companion approval [ edit section | visual editor ] Agreeing to help raid the Emerald Grove   +1   -5   -1   -1 Consequences [ edit section | visual editor ] Raiding the grove [ edit section | visual editor ] Choosing to raid the grove with the goblin forces has immense, far-reaching consequences for the game, some of which can only be felt in later Acts. These consequences include: Karlach and Wyll leave the party (or cannot be recruited if they have not already been). Halsin is not available as a companion. Gale leaves the party unless an Insight or Deception check is passed. ⁠ Lift the Shadow Curse cannot be undertaken in Act Two. Loss of many rare equipment items, as the traders Dammon and Mattis cannot be traded with in Acts Two and Three. Halsin, Arabella , Dammon, and Zevlor cannot be recruited for ⁠ Gather Your Allies . Rolan cannot be recruited for ⁠ Gather Your Allies if he was convinced to stay and defend the Grove earlier. All unfinished quests involving the Grove cannot be successfully completed. The inspiration ⁠ Slaughter's Prize is granted to party members with the Criminal background. The inspiration ⁠ Camaraderie in Bloodthirst is granted to the Dark Urge . Siding with the tieflings and druids and defending the grove [ edit section | visual editor ] Choosing to bring the goblins to the Emerald Grove, but then siding with the tieflings and druids lets the story play out similarly to as if the party had defeated the goblin camp leaders, but without the need to defeat the other two leaders Gut and Dror Ragzlin . However, some of the tieflings might die in the fight. Siding with the Emerald Grove also results in Minthara being available as a companion in Act Two, if she is not killed but Knocked Out instead. Many but not all goblins who accompany Minthara on the raid can be encountered only during the raid. If the party returns, the entire Goblin Camp is hostile to them. Not participating in the fight at the grove [ edit section | visual editor ] A somewhat different set of consequences is incurred if the party chooses to leave the region without participating in the fight at the grove, including: All tieflings of the Emerald Grove die. Karlach and Wyll stay in the party (or can still be recruited if Act Two has not been started yet by travelling to the Shadow-Cursed Lands ). Karlach's Infernal Engine cannot be repaired because Dammon dies. Halsin cannot be recruited as companion, and spontaneously dies in his last known location, even if previously saved from the Goblins. Gale permanently leaves the party. The quest ⁠ Lift the Shadow Curse , if started, cannot be successfully completed. Loss of many rare equipment items, as the then dead traders Dammon and Mattis will not be present in Acts Two or Three. Halsin, Arabella, Dammon, and Zevlor cannot be recruited for ⁠ Gather Your Allies . Rolan cannot be recruited for ⁠ Gather Your Allies if he was convinced to stay and defend the Grove earlier. All unfinished quests involving the Emerald Grove cannot be successfully completed. Despite refusing Minthara's orders, she is still available as a potential companion in Act Two. A specific bit of dialogue happens with the being in the Astral Prism , but all other characters appear to ignore the decision.
