Not to be confused with Infernal Burning (Condition) and Burning (Orthonic) (Condition) Burning Takes 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage per turn. Can be removed with the Help action, using a Healing Potion or gaining Wet . Immune from if Wet . Dip action can be used on Burning characters or objects. Properties UID: BURNING Stack ID : BURNING Status groups : SG_Surface , SG_Light Loses duration : start of turn More properties : InitiateCombat Burning DisableOverhead IgnoreResting Notes Conditions that share the same StackID prevent the additional application of these conditions until the original condition has timed out. As a result, a character that is affected by Burning will not also be affected by Melting , meaning this character may walk around freely in lava while only receiving 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage instead of 10d6 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage. Burning creatures take double damage from the Fire Elemental's Multiattack , and are made Brittle by the Water Elemental's Winter's Breath . Burning creatures take an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Weapon damage when attacked by Dragon's Grasp or Firestoker . ## Castigated By Divinity (Condition)
- **来源**: [Castigated By Divinity (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Castigated_By_Divinity_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Castigated By Divinity Affected entity is cursed by transgressed and irritable gods. When it falls unconscious, it immediately dies. Moreover, when it dies, a terrible envoy of the offended deity is conjured from the entity's corpse. Cursed Properties UID: LOW_STORMSHORETABERNACLE_GODCURSED Stack ID : LOW_STORMSHORETABERNACLE_GODCURSED Status groups : SG_Cursed Loses duration : N/A More properties : ApplyToDead IgnoreResting Sources of Castigated By Divinity Looting any item from the offering chests [ 1 ] in the Stormshore Tabernacle basement Killing Vicar Humbletoes Notes This condition replaces Anointed in Splendour if the character has received it, though it can always be reapplied later. Only transferring an item directly from a chest to the inventory of an active party member inflicts this condition. [ 2 ] The "terrible envoy of the offended deity" is a Deva , Djinni , or Cambion depending on the afflicted character: For non- Clerics , the enemy is a Deva. [ 3 ] For clerics, the type of enemy is dependent on the deity they worship: Good Deities [ 4 ] – Devas Neutral Deities [ 5 ] – Djinn Evil Deities [ 6 ] – Cambions If the afflicted character dies or is cured via Remove Curse or Greater Restoration , one enemy is spawned; if they are healed, short rest , long rest , or die, two enemies are spawned. [ verify ] Nearby characters may become hostile to the summoned enemies, making them temporary allies of the party. [ 7 ] XP is still gained for any of the summons killed, and the party receives no penalty for NPC allies killed in this manner. Footnotes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ The curse is tied to the chest, not the items. Any item can be moved from the party's inventory to a chest and back to trigger it. ↑ Items can safely be sent to the inventory of a companion not in the active party or picked up off the ground after dragging them there or destroying the chest. ↑ Prior to patching, spawning a Deva with this curse used to be a common way to acquire the powerful Deva Mace they carry. ↑ Bahamut, Corellon Larethian, Eilistraee, Garl Glittergold, Ilmater, Lathander, Mielikki, Moradin, Mystra, Selûne, Shar (if Nightsong is freed, and the only non-good deity in this list), Tymora, Tyr, and Yondalla ↑ Tempus, Helm, Kelemvor, and Oghma ↑ Gruumsh, Laduguer, Lolth, Shar (if Nightsong is killed), Tiamat, Talos, and Vlaakith ↑ This includes members of the Flaming Fist and their Steel Watchers.

## Chilled (Condition)
- **来源**: [Chilled (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Chilled_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Chilled Affected entity is vulnerable to ⁠ Cold damage and resistant to ⁠ Fire damage. Applying Wet to a chilled entity will make it Frozen for Duration: 1 turn. Properties Stack ID : CHILLED Status groups : SG_Surface More properties : InitiateCombat DisableCombatlog DisableOverhead Condition: Frozen Frozen Duration: 1 turn Affected entity is utterly enamelled in ice and is Incapacitated . If it is dealt Bludgeoning, Thunder, or Force damage, the ice shatters, ending the condition. Gains Vulnerability to ⁠ Bludgeoning , ⁠ Thunder , and ⁠ Force damage. Gains Resistance to ⁠ Fire damage. Gains immunity to Burning and Encrusted with Frost . Notes The order of application of conditions matters. Chilling an already wet target will not freeze it. It must be chilled and then wet. However, applying wet to an already wet and chilled target will freeze it. The duration of the Frozen condition ticks down at the start of the affected creature's turn. With a duration of just 1 turn, this means the effect will immediately end at the start of the frozen creature's turn without disabling it for even a single turn. When applied with Encrusted with Frost , Frozen will instead last 2 turns (so effectively 1 full round), so it does not have this issue. Sources of Chilled Chilling Counter Elements of an Epoch Insidious Cold Cold Embrace Icy Regurgitation Slam (Water Elemental) Hiemal Strike

Targets that are Immune to Fire damage are unaffected. Coated in Basic Poison Targets must succeed a DC  11 Constitution Saving Throw or become Poisoned . On a successful save, target receives Inoculated: Basic Poison for 2 turns. Coated in Brewed-up Bellyglummer Weapon is coated in Brewed-Up Bellyglummer. Coated in Toxin Targets take 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC  11 Constitution Saving Throw . Targets receive a -3 penalty to spell Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC , and Disadvantage on Saving Throws for maintaining Concentration for 2 turns. Coated in Wyvern Toxin Targets take 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC  15 Constitution Saving Throw . Coerced Forced to fight for Nere and takes 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic each turn. Ends upon taking any non-Psychic damage. Charmed Properties Stack ID : DOWNED Status groups : SG_Charmed Loses duration : start of turn Stack priority : 0 More properties : LoseControl ForceOverhead OverheadOnTurn Notes An affected party member is fully controlled by the game's AI, which may behave in unexpected ways. Sources of Coerced Wicked Coercion Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID DOWNED , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Coerced Forced to fight for Nere and takes 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic each turn. Ends upon taking any non-Psychic damage. Downed If you reach 0 hit points, you fall Unconscious and must make Death Saving Throws . On 3 successes, you stop bleeding out and become Stable. On 3 failures, you die . Any damage you receive while unconscious counts as one failure. If you regain any Hit Points , the condition is removed. If an ally helps you, you regain 1 hit point.

Compelled to Duel Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against anyone but the caster. Might start Bleeding if struck by the Dueller. Properties Stack ID : COMPELLED_DUEL Status groups : SG_Taunted More properties : LoseControl OverheadOnTurn LoseControlFriendly Notes An affected party member is fully controlled by the game's AI, which may behave in unexpected ways. "The Dueller" was the original name for Duellist's Prerogative . As such, this condition requires attacks from the Duellist's Prerogative in order to apply Bleeding. Bugs This condition uses Compelled Duel as a parent but does not change the check which imposes Disadvantage on the attacker against anyone but the caster. As a result, the attacker will have Disadvantage against every target, even the caster of this effect. Conduit of Kereska's Ice Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Cold damage. Its cold spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's ice, it can cast Cone of Cold at 5th level and Ice Storm at 4th level once per short rest. Properties Stack ID : MAG_LEGENDARY_CHROMATIC_ATTUNEMENT_FIRE Loses duration : start of turn If already applied : replace current Grants: Cone of Cold ( + ) Make a flurry of frost, crisp air, and condensed snow crystals erupt from your hands. Ice Storm ( + ) Impel a storm of hail and ice to crash from the sky, covering the ground and striking all objects and creatures within range, dealing ⁠ Bludgeoning and ⁠ Cold damage. It also creates an   Ice surface that lasts 2 turns. Condition: Encrusted with Frost Encrusted with Frost Duration: 2 turns Affected entity has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws . When there are 7 or more turns remaining, the entity must succeed a DC  12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Cold DRS and become Frozen . On a successful save, it only takes half damage. Afterward, the frost sloughs away. Removed by Burning . Notes The in-game tooltip says this effect inflicts 1 turn of Encrusted with Frost, but it actually inflicts 2 turns. Applying Encrusted with Frost can only occur once per attack. A spell hitting multiple targets like Cone of Cold will only apply the condition to a single target. Bugs Additional damage is added solely based on the DamageType flag of the action used. It does not actually check that the action was a spell. ## Contagion Poisoned (Condition)
- **来源**: [Contagion Poisoned (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Contagion_Poisoned_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Contagion Poisoned Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Checks . Each turn, it must succeed on a Saving Throw , or the poison will advance in stage. On 3 successes, it recovers. On 3 failures, it contracts the disease corresponding to the variant of the spell Contagion that was cast. Poisoned ,  Diseased Properties Status groups : SG_Poisoned , SG_Disease Loses duration : end of turn Notes There are 3 stages to this effect. On initial application, it starts at Stage 1 and each failed saving throw advances it to the next stage. Failing a saving throw at Stage 3 removes this effect and applies the Contagion disease to the target. The duration of this effect indicates the number of successful saving throws required to recover. It starts at 3 rounds and each successful save will reduce the duration by 1 round. Failing a saving throw and advancing to the next stage does not reset this duration so the successful saves do not need to be consecutive. Each variant of Contagion has its own version of this condition with distinct stack IDs . This means a target can be affected by multiple distinct Contagion Poisoned conditions at the same time. Sources of Contagion Poisoned Contagion Contagion: Blinding Sickness Contagion: Filth Fever Contagion: Flesh Rot Contagion: Mindfire Contagion: Seizure Contagion: Slimy Doom Mapped Terror: Darkness Mapped Terror: Disease Slay

Violent Heart Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws . To end this effect, the creature must deny its Violent Heart by healing an enemy. Wayward Heart Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws . To end this effect, the creature must deny its Wayward Heart by acquiescing to Shar and aiding Viconia in combat.

Dead This creature is dead. Sources of Dead If a playable character or companion fails three Death Saving Throws after being Downed they become dead. If a non-playable creature reaches zero hit points from damage that is not non-lethal they become dead. Notes This condition can be removed from hirelings , the player character, and their companions with Revivify , a Scroll of Revivify , the Scroll of True Resurrection or through Withers' services. Non-playable characters cannot be revived after dying. In most cases, companions who die before recruitment – or during certain plot events – cannot be revived. (Refer to the talk page for examples.) Temporary companions with scripted deaths, namely Alfira and Losiir , cannot be revived. Brief preview This creature is dead.

## Detonation Impending! (Condition)
- **来源**: [Detonation Impending! (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Detonation_Impending!_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Detonation Impending! This Steel Watcher is preparing to Self-Detonate . Properties Stack ID : BULWARK_MODE Loses duration : start of turn Stack priority : 0 More properties : UnavailableInActiveRoll Notes For Steel Watcher Titans , Self-Detonate (Steel Watcher Titan) is similar to the Steel Watcher's free action Self-Detonate . Multiple stacks of Detonation Impending! are possible under certain circumstances, notably: By reducing a Steel Watcher to 0 HP while it is Malfunctioning or Stunned if it does not have the Detonation Impending! condition - after which it regains 1 HP and gains two instances of Detonation Impending! immediately. Casting Hold Monster on a Steel Watcher that has at least one stack of Detonation Impending! - which adds one additional stack each time the spell is successfully cast. The second method seems to allow for unlimited stacks of the condition. If a Steel Watcher with multiple stacks of Detonation Impending! is allowed to Self-Detonate on its turn, it detonates once. If killed before its turn, it detonates as often as it had Detonation Impending! stacks. (Verified only for normal Steel Watchers) Sources of Detonation Impending! Self-Detonation Protocol Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID BULWARK_MODE , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Defensive Protocol: Bulwark While in this defensive state, the Steel Watcher becomes Unyielding and can use its Repair Matrix , Hellfire Missiles and Repelling Protocol . Also grants 75 temporary hit points . If the Steel Watcher loses these temporary hit points, he automatically uses Terminate Bulwark Protocol and loses this condition. If hit by a Flashblinder , the Steel Watcher loses this condition. Detonation Impending! This Steel Watcher is preparing to Self-Detonate .

## Difficult Terrain (Condition)
- **来源**: [Difficult Terrain (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Difficult_Terrain_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Difficult Terrain Movement Speed halved Properties Stack ID : DIFFICULT_TERRAIN Status groups : SG_Surface , SG_DifficultTerrain More properties : DisableCombatlog DisableOverhead Notes Movement speed isn't actually halved, instead the movement speed cost is doubled when in difficult terrain. A creature must spend 2 m (7 ft) of movement to move 1 m (3 ft) through an area of difficult terrain . Movement speed cost is doubled both for moving, and for actions like Brace (Melee) , Brace (Ranged) and Prepare . The movement speed cost will go back to normal as soon as you leave the surface. You can fly over Difficult Terrain. You can gain immunity to the effects of Difficult Terrain with the following: Boots of Genial Striding , Helldusk Boots , Ring of Free Action , Freedom of Movement , Land's Stride: Difficult Terrain , Advanced Unarmoured Movement , Mobile: Evade Difficult Terrain . Note that a lot of surfaces also have other effects like proning , and you will not be immune to these Sources of Difficult Terrain Black Tentacles Grease Ice Sewage Spikes Void Wall of Thorns Hunger of Hadar Insect Plague Rampart Aura Wild Magic: Vine Growth Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID DIFFICULT_TERRAIN , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Difficult Terrain Movement Speed halved Difficult Terrain: Deep Water Movement speed halved. ## Dipped in Fire (Condition)
- **来源**: [Dipped in Fire (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Dipped_in_Fire_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Dipped in Fire Weapon deals additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage. Properties UID: DIPPED_FIRE Stack ID : DIPPED Sources of Dipped in Fire Infernal Weapon Dip Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID DIPPED , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Coated in Arsonist's Oil Coated in an oil that strips targets that are Resistant to ⁠ Fire damage of their Resistance. Targets that are Immune to Fire damage are unaffected. Coated in Basic Poison Targets must succeed a DC  11 Constitution Saving Throw or become Poisoned . On a successful save, target receives Inoculated: Basic Poison for 2 turns. Coated in Brewed-up Bellyglummer Weapon is coated in Brewed-Up Bellyglummer. Targets must succeed a DC  17 Constitution Saving Throw or become Poisoned . Coated in Crawler Mucus Targets must succeed a DC  13 Constitution Saving Throw or become Stricken with Crawler Mucus . On a successful save, targets receive Inoculated: Crawler Mucus for 2 turns Coated in Diluted Oil of Sharpness The arcane oil coating this weapon grants it a +1 bonus to Damage and Attack Rolls . The weapon has become magical, so it can damage creatures that are immune to non-magical attacks. Coated in Drow Poison Targets must succeed a DC  13 Constitution Saving Throw or become Poisoned and fall Asleep . On a successful save, targets receive Inoculated: Drow Poison for 2 turns. Coated in Malice Targets must succeed a DC  15 Constitution Saving Throw or become Blinded and Poisoned . Targets that succeed the saving throw are granted the Inoculated: Malice condition for 2 turns. Coated in Oil of Bane Targets become Baned for 2 turns unless they succeed a DC  11 Charisma Saving Throw . Coated in Oil of Combustion Coated in flammable oil. On a hit, the target is doused in oil for 2 turns. If it takes ⁠ Fire damage, the oil immolates, dealing 3d6 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage in an area around it. Coated in Oil of Diminution Targets must succeed a DC  11 Constitution Saving Throw or receive Disadvantage on Strength Checks and Strength Saving Throws , as well as a -1d4 penalty to damage on melee attacks for 2 turns. Coated in Oil of Freezing Targets receive Encrusted with Frost for 2 turns. Coated in Purple Worm Toxin Targets take 1d10 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC  19 Constitution Saving Throw . Coated in Serpent Venom Toxin Targets take 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC  13 Constitution Saving Throw . Coated in Toxin Targets take 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC  11 Constitution Saving Throw . Coated in Wizardsbane Oil Severely dampens the power of any spellcaster struck with this weapon. Targets receive a -3 penalty to spell Attack Rolls and Spell Save DC , and Disadvantage on Saving Throws for maintaining Concentration for 2 turns. Coated in Wyvern Toxin Targets take 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage at the end of their next turn, unless they succeed a DC  15 Constitution Saving Throw . Dipped in Fire Weapon deals additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage. Dipped in Poison Weapon deals additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Poison damage.

## Disguise Self (Condition)
- **来源**: [Disguise Self (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Disguise_Self_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Disguise Self Appearance is entirely changed. Polymorphed Properties Stack ID : DISGUISE_SELF Status groups : SG_Polymorph , SG_Disguise , SG_RemoveOnRespec Grants: Dispel Disguise ( ) Dispel your disguise and revert to your original form. Notes Disguised companions and hirelings revert to their normal form upon leaving the active party. Bugs Disguise Self disables effects which require the Brand of the Absolute to trigger, such as Gloves of Power . As of Patch 5, Hotfix 17, it is possible to give the caster racial equipment bonuses for longer than intended by using the Mask of the Shapeshifter , taking the mask off, and long resting without removing the disguise. On waking up, the disguise is gone, but the racial bonuses on the equipment still affect the character. This only works for racial equipment bonuses, not racial dialogue options. If the player character is disguised as a githyanki when talking to Shadowheart for the first time on the beach at the start of Act One they are awarded an extra 30 xp. If a companion is disguised while at camp , they will remain where they were last placed when another companion or player character is selected, rather than automatically moving back to their tent, until they are moved again or a long rest is taken. This can be useful when seeking to apply conditions or spells with a limited radius, such as Aid . While disguised, hirelings cannot be spoken with. ## Displaced (Condition)
- **来源**: [Displaced (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Displaced_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Displaced Until you take damage, foes have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against you. Properties Stack ID : MAG_PHB_CLOAK_OF_DISPLACEMENT More properties : DisableOverhead Notes Displaced is removed by anything the game considers to be a hit that deals damage greater than zero. This includes the following: A failed save against a damage-dealing spell (for example, Burning Hands or Thunderwave ). Damage from a spell such as Magic Missile that always deals damage. Displaced is not removed by anything the game does not consider to be a hit, even if it deals damage. This includes the following: A successful save against a damage dealing spell, even when the spell still deals half damage on a save. Tenacity damage. Displaced is not removed when damage is reduced to zero by any means, including Magical Plate , Arcane Ward , and similar. Sources of Displaced Displacement

Polymorphed Properties Status groups : SG_Polymorph , SG_DropForNonMutingDialog Creature: Displacer beast STR 18 (+4) DEX 15 (+2) CON 16 (+3) Hit Points 85 Armour Class 16 Movement Speed 12 m (40 ft) Dismiss Displacer Beast Shape Dismiss your displacer beast shape and change back to your original form. Evasion Your agility lets you dodge out of the way of certain spells. ## Downed (Condition)
- **来源**: [Downed (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Downed_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Downed If you reach 0 hit points, you fall Unconscious and must make Death Saving Throws . On 3 successes, you stop bleeding out and become Stable. On 3 failures, you die . Any damage you receive while unconscious counts as one failure. If you regain any Hit Points , the condition is removed. If an ally helps you, you regain 1 hit point. Unconscious ,  Incapacitated Properties Stack ID : DOWNED Status groups : SG_Unconscious , SG_Incapacitated More properties : DisableOverhead Sources of Downed If a companion or playable character reaches zero hit points they will be Downed. Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID DOWNED , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Coerced Forced to fight for Nere and takes 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Psychic each turn. Ends upon taking any non-Psychic damage. Downed If you reach 0 hit points, you fall Unconscious and must make Death Saving Throws . On 3 successes, you stop bleeding out and become Stable. On 3 failures, you die . Any damage you receive while unconscious counts as one failure. If you regain any Hit Points , the condition is removed. If an ally helps you, you regain 1 hit point. Removal [ edit section | visual editor ] Removing Downed via one of the following methods will cause the character to stand back up, and be able to act during their regular turn in the initiative order, though they may not have access to their full range of Resources for the remainder of the round. [ verify ] Being Helped by an ally. Any form of Healing . Prevention [ edit section | visual editor ] Instead of being Downed, one can "cheat death" via the effects in the chart below. When the character would normally hit 0 hit points, the "prevention" effect will end, and grant the character healing instead. While multiple effects can be active at once, the order of priority and stacking (or lack thereof) is not fully understood. When a character is "revived" this way, they fully restore their Resources ( Action (s), Bonus Action (s), Reaction (s), and Movement Speed ). This even applies if the character would be downed during their turn (such as from being in range of an explosion that they caused). Condition Source Replacement Effect Condition Duration Limitation After Death Do Us Part After Death Do Us Part Passive 1 2 max ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points Duration: Permanent Applies Shadow Possession Recharge: Long rest Death Ward Death Ward Spell 1 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points Duration: Until Long rest Death Ward Aegis Palms Passive 1 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points Duration: 2 turns Applies to targets Healed Lathander's Blessing The Blood of Lathander Passive 2d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points + 1d6 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points to allies within 9 m (30 ft) Duration: Permanent Recharge: Long rest Relentless Endurance Level 1 Half-Orc Passive 1 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points Duration: Permanent Recharge: Long rest Relentless Rage Level 11 Barbarian Passive 1 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points Duration: Permanent If Enraged Recharge: Short rest Strength of the Grave Level 1 Shadow Magic Sorcerer Passive 1 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points Duration: Permanent Recharge: Long rest Survival Instinct Survival Instinct Action 3d4 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points Duration: 3 turns Recharge: Short rest

## Elixir of Arcane Cultivation (Condition)
- **来源**: [Elixir of Arcane Cultivation (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Elixir_of_Arcane_Cultivation_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Elixir of Arcane Cultivation Has an additional Level 1 Spell Slot . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Properties UID: ALCH_ELIXIR_MEDITATION Stack ID : ALCH_ELIXIR If already applied : replace current Sources of Elixir of Arcane Cultivation Elixir of Arcane Cultivation Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID ALCH_ELIXIR , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Acid Resistance Resistant to ⁠ Acid damage. Cold Resistance Resistant to ⁠ Cold damage. Elixir of Arcane Cultivation Has an additional Level 1 Spell Slot . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Elixir of Barkskin Armour Class increased to 16. Elixir of Battlemage's Power Affected entity has Arcane Acuity until its next Long Rest . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Gain Arcane Acuity for 3 turns. Arcane Acuity cannot go below 3 turns. Elixir of Bloodlust Affected entity has entered a murderous state of bloodlust. Once per turn, when it kills an enemy, it gains 5 temporary hit points and an Action . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Elixir of Cloud Giant Strength Strength increased to 27. Elixir of Darkvision Can see in the dark up to 12 m (40 ft). Elixir of Guileful Movement Movement Speed cannot be reduced by Difficult Terrain , spells, or magical effects. Can't be Paralysed or Restrained . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Elixir of Heroism Affected entity is granted a 1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws until the next long rest. Elixir of Hill Giant Strength Strength increased to 21. Elixir of Peerless Focus Affected entity's ability to maintain its spells has increased. It has Advantage to Saving Throws against being Charmed and for maintaining Concentration . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Can't be put to Sleep . Elixir of The Colossus Size is increased Weapons deal an additional 1d4 damage, and the affected entity has Advantage on Strength checks and Saving Throws . Carrying capacity is also increased by 25%. Elixir of Viciousness The number you need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking is reduced by 1. This effect can stack. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Elixir of Vigilance Affected entity has a +5 bonus to initiative and can't be Surprised . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Fire Resistance You gain Resistance to ⁠ Fire damage, and can no longer Burn . Force Resistance Resistant to ⁠ Force damage. Greater Elixir of Arcane Cultivation Has an additional Level 2 Spell Slot . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Lightning Resistance Resistant to ⁠ Lightning damage. Can no longer be Shocked , Electrocuted , Jolted , or otherwise affected by lightning. Necrotic Resistance Resistant to ⁠ Necrotic damage. Poison Resistance Resistant to ⁠ Poison damage. Can no longer be Poisoned . Psionic Weakening Affected entity has Disadvantage on Constitution, Wisdom and Intelligence Saving Throws . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Psychic Resistance Resistant to ⁠ Psychic damage. Radiant Resistance Resistant to ⁠ Radiant damage. Resistant to Acid Damage Acid damage against this entity is halved. Resistant to Fire Damage Fire damage against this entity is halved. Resistant to Lightning Damage Lightning damage against this entity is halved. Resistant to Necrotic Damage Necrotic damage against this entity is halved. Resistant to Radiant Damage Radiant damage against this entity is halved. Superior Elixir of Arcane Cultivation Has an additional Level 3 Spell Slot . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Supreme Elixir of Arcane Cultivation Has an additional Level 4 Spell Slot . Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk. Thunder Resistance Resistant to ⁠ Thunder damage.

## Encrusted with Frost (Condition)
- **来源**: [Encrusted with Frost (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Encrusted_with_Frost_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Encrusted with Frost Affected entity has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws . When there are 7 or more turns remaining, the entity must succeed a DC  12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Cold DRS and become Frozen . On a successful save, it only takes half damage. Afterward, the frost sloughs away. Removed by Burning . Properties Stack ID : MAG_FROST Loses duration : start of turn If already applied : add to duration Condition: Frozen Frozen Duration: 2 turns CON Save ( DC  12) Affected entity is utterly enamelled in ice and is Incapacitated . If it is dealt Bludgeoning, Thunder, or Force damage, the ice shatters, ending the condition. Gains Vulnerability to ⁠ Bludgeoning , ⁠ Thunder , and ⁠ Force damage. Gains Resistance to ⁠ Fire damage. Gains immunity to Burning and Encrusted with Frost . Notes Markoheshkir's Encrusted with Frost condition comes from the Frost of Dark Winter variant of Kereska's Favour . Testing as of Patch 7 confirms that the save is fixed DC 12, despite the combat log showing a variable DC calculation involving Proficiency and Spellcasting Ability Modifier bonuses. Bugs The in-game description is not entirely correct: failing the DC  12 Constitution Saving Throw results in the entity becoming Frozen , whereas succeeding it causes it to take 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Cold damage. Contrary to what the description states, this damage is not halved. Sources of Encrusted with Frost Coated in Oil of Freezing Conduit of Kereska's Ice Oil of Freezing Coldbrim Chill Winter's Clutches

## Eyes of the Dark (Condition)
- **来源**: [Eyes of the Dark (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Eyes_of_the_Dark_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

This article is about the condition. For the passive feature, see Eyes of the Dark . For the spell, see Eyes of the Dark: Darkness . Eyes of the Dark You can see normally in darkness, both magical and non-magical, to a distance of 25 m (83 ft). Properties Stack ID : EYESOFTHEDARK_DARKNESS Notes This condition works similar to the Devil's Sight Eldritch Invocation, and thus the affected party member can see in magical darkness as well as regular darkness. This unique condition can be gained only when casting Eyes of the Dark: Darkness using 2 Sorcery Points. Darkness cast by other party members, or by the Sorcerer using a 2nd Level spell slot still causes the affected party member to be Blinded . Sources of Eyes of the Dark Eyes of the Dark: Darkness

## Force Conduit (Condition)
- **来源**: [Force Conduit (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Force_Conduit_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Force Conduit ⁠ Bludgeoning , ⁠ Piercing , and ⁠ Slashing damage against the affected entity is reduced by 1 per turn remaining. If the entity takes damage while it has 5 or more turns remaining, it deals 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Force DRS damage in a 6 m (20 ft) radius. Maximum Duration: 7 turns. Properties Stack ID : MAG_ZOC_FORCE_CONDUIT Loses duration : start of turn If already applied : add to duration More properties : MultiplyEffectsByDuration Notes The 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Force damage is only triggered after a melee attack deals damage high enough to surpass damage reductions and resistances. Force Conduit reduces physical damage received even via Warding Bond , but it will not trigger the Force damage as it requires a melee attack. Like Lightning Charges , all the charges are consumed when the Force damage is triggered. Bugs The hidden technical condition which applies the force damage also triggers Arcane Echomalefaction and Coldbrim Chill against enemy targets. Sources of Force Conduit Force Absorption Shield Conduit Skinburster Force

## Gaping Wounds (Condition)
- **来源**: [Gaping Wounds (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Gaping_Wounds_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Gaping Wounds Successful attacks against the creature deal an additional 2 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing damage. Removed by healing. Properties UID: GAPING_WOUND Stack ID : GAPING_WOUND Status groups : SG_Condition Loses duration : start of turn More properties : InitiateCombat Honour mode The +2 bonus damage is instead added to the original attack's damage roll, adopting its damage type. Bugs The 2 ⁠ ⁠ Piercing damage does not trigger effects requiring piercing damage, such as Prophecy: A Little Prick , because the piercing damage dealt to the enemy is from a passive effect placed on the enemy, rather than originating from the attacker which is necessary to trigger such effects. Honour Mode changes the effect of this condition to a simple +2 to damage rolls, to ensure that it doesn't trigger damage riders . This causes it to adopt the original damage type of the attack, instead of always inflicting +2 piercing damage. This additional damage also lacks a check for attack rolls, and thus adds damage to any source of damage. Sources of Gaping Wounds Bite (Alioramus) Bite (Cloaker) Multiattack (Cloaker) Spiritual Weapon: Spear Spiritual Weapon: Trident Piercing Shot Piercing Strike Piercing Strike (Spiritual Weapon)

## Grasp Essence (Condition)
- **来源**: [Grasp Essence (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Grasp_Essence_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Grasp Essence When you hit a creature with an unarmed attack, you can regain 10 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points or choose to gain Advantage on Attack Rolls or Saving Throws before the end of your next turn. Properties Stack ID : MAG_SOUL_CATCHING Stack priority : 1 Grants: Soul Catching Boon Gain +5 bonus on your next Attack roll . ( Recharge: Per turn.) Soul Catching Prowess Gain a +5 bonus on your next Saving throw . ( Recharge: Per turn.) Soul Snare: Heal Heal 10 hit points from catching a soul. ( Recharge: Per turn.) Notes As soon as you either use the 10 HP heal or either of the two reactions granted by this condition, Grasp Essence is lost. Grasp Essence cannot be gained more than once per turn. Bugs Due to a coding error, Grasp Essence will be removed from the wielder if it takes damage and does not have any temporary HP. Sources of Grasp Essence Soul Catching

## Greater Toughness (Condition)

- **分类**: Conditions

See also: Sturdy (Condition) and Medium Toughness (Condition) Greater Toughness This material is extremely strong. Only a hit that deals at least 50 damage can damage it. Properties More properties : IgnoreResting DisableOverhead Sources of Greater Toughness Possessed by some containers , doors, and other environmental objects. Notes The damage threshold is evaluated for each individual hit. An attack with Magic Missile where each missile deals its maximum of 5 ⁠ ⁠ force will never deal any damage to an object or creature with this condition, even if the sum total exceeds the threshold.

## Gripped by Kereska's Flame (Condition)
- **来源**: [Gripped by Kereska's Flame (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Gripped_by_Kereska's_Flame_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Gripped by Kereska's Flame Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Fire damage. Its fire spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it gains 2 turns of Heat . While attuned to Kereska's flame, it can cast Fireball at 3rd level and Wall of Fire at 5th level once per short rest. Properties Stack ID : MAG_LEGENDARY_CHROMATIC_ATTUNEMENT_FIRE Loses duration : start of turn If already applied : replace current Grants: Fireball ( + ) Shoot a bright flame from your fingers that explodes upon contact, torching everything in the vicinity for 8d6 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage. Wall of Fire ( + ) Create a blazing wall of fire, Burning anyone who dares stand too close. Deals ⁠ Fire to anything that moves into or ends its turn in the area. Condition: Heat Heat Duration: 2 turns Engulfed by a vengeful fire. Takes 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage each turn, but can use Heat Convergence . Heat Convergence consumes all remaining turns of Heat to deal extra ⁠ Fire damage on their next fire spell or attack. Heat has a maximum Duration: 7 turns. Notes The in-game tooltip says this effect grants 1 turn of Heat, but it actually grants 2 turns. Bugs Additional damage is added solely based on the DamageType flag of the action used. It does not actually check that the action was a spell. Sources of Gripped by Kereska's Flame Flame of Wrath Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID MAG_LEGENDARY_CHROMATIC_ATTUNEMENT_FIRE , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Adrip with Kereska's Acid Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Acid damage. Its acid spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it possibly inflict 3 turns of Noxious Fumes upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's acid it can cast Melf's Acid Arrow and Hunger of Hadar at 5th level once per short rest. Conduit of Kereska's Ice Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Cold damage. Its cold spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of Encrusted with Frost upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's ice, it can cast Cone of Cold at 5th level and Ice Storm at 4th level once per short rest. Crackling with Kereska's Lightning Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Lightning damage. Its lightning spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it gains 2 Lightning Charges . While attuned to Kereska's lightning, it can cast Chain Lightning at 6th level and Lightning Bolt at 3rd level once per short rest. Gripped by Kereska's Flame Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Fire damage. Its fire spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it gains 2 turns of Heat . While attuned to Kereska's flame, it can cast Fireball at 3rd level and Wall of Fire at 5th level once per short rest. Rumbling with Kereska's Thunder Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Thunder damage. Its thunder spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of Reverberation upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's thunder, it can cast Shatter and Destructive Wave at 5th level once per short rest. Vessel for Kereska's Poison Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Poison damage. Its poison spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of Poisoned upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's poison, it can cast Cloudkill and Ray of Sickness at 5th level once per short rest.

## Haste Spores (Condition)
- **来源**: [Haste Spores (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Haste_Spores_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Haste Spores Affected entity has a +2 bonus to Armour Class , Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws , its Movement Speed increases by 9 m (30 ft), [ See: Bugs ] and it can take one additional Action per turn. Properties UID: HASTE_SURFACE Stack ID : HASTE Status groups : SG_Surface , SG_Condition Loses duration : start of turn Stack priority : 10 Honour mode A Hastened creature can not use Extra Attack with its additional action. Applying Slowed to a Hastened creature ends this condition, and prevents it from being reapplied as long as the creature is Slowed. [ See Notes ] Notes Unlike the regular Hastened condition, this condition does not inflict the Lethargic debuff when it ends. Terazul grants a similar condition, The Terazul Jitters , which stacks with this condition. In honour mode only, Slowed and similar conditions end Haste Spores. This is because for honour mode specifically, these conditions are assigned the HASTE stack ID and a higher stack priority than Haste Spores. Bugs The in-game description says it doubles movement speed, but it actually increases it by 9 m (30 ft). ## Heat Metal (Condition)
- **来源**: [Heat Metal (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Heat_Metal_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Heat Metal Heats up a metal weapon or armour on a creature with no save (weapon is automatically prioritized). Metal weapons are dropped if the creature holding it fails their initial Saving Throw . If the creature is touching the heated metal item, they receive Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks . Each subsequent turn, if the creature is still touching the metal, the spellcaster can use Reapply Heat Metal to deal another 2d8 ⁠ ⁠ Fire damage, forcing the creature to pass a Saving Throw again or drop the item (if it is a metal weapon). Properties Loses duration : start of turn More properties : TickingWithSource RemoveOnLongRest Sources of Heat Metal Heat Metal Rolan's Fireball

You also have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls , as well as Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Saving Throws . Properties UID: ENCUMBERED_HEAVY Stack ID : ENCUMBERED Loses duration : N/A Stack priority : 1 More properties : IgnoreResting Sources of Heavily Encumbered A party member exceeding 93.33% of their carrying capacity receives this condition. This condition does not actually reduce movement speed; it instead multiplies the cost of movement by 3 (equivalent to losing 6 m (20 ft) of movement for a character with a Movement Speed of 9 m (30 ft)). ## Hexblade's Curse (Condition)
- **来源**: [Hexblade's Curse (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Hexblade's_Curse_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Hexblade's Curse Cursed by a Hexblade warlock. The warlock who cursed this entity adds their proficiency bonus to damage rolls against them. The number they need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking this entity is also reduced by 1. Properties Status groups : SG_RemoveOnRespec More properties : InitiateCombat BringIntoCombat ApplyToDead Bugs Hexblade's Curse includes a BoostContext check of OnAttack . Though this lacks an associated BoostConditions check, it causes a situation where the effect of this condition is inactive until the Warlock makes an initial attack. This is most noticeable after reloading a save file in which the Warlock already has Hexblade's Curse applied to an enemy. Sources of Hexblade's Curse Hexed Weapon Hexblade's Curse
## Hexed Weapon (Condition)
- **来源**: [Hexed Weapon (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Hexed_Weapon_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Hexed Weapon The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical and uses the warlock's Charisma modifier. When the warlock attacks with this weapon, there is a chance that Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target. Properties UID: HEXBLADE_BIND Stack ID : PACT_BLADE Status groups : SG_RemoveOnRespec More properties : IgnoreResting Condition: Hexblade's Curse Hexblade's Curse Cursed by a Hexblade warlock. The warlock who cursed this entity adds their proficiency bonus to damage rolls against them. The number they need to roll a Critical Hit while attacking this entity is also reduced by 1. Notes The roll to apply Hexblade's Curse is a d20 with no modifiers which must roll at least 17. This means it has a fixed 20% chance to apply and is unaffected by anything that adjusts dice rolls such as Advantage . The duration for Hexblade's Curse cannot be refreshed by attacking with a Hexed Weapon. It can only be applied to targets that are not currently cursed. Sources of Hexed Weapon Pactbound Flail Pactbound Maul Pactbound Sickle Bind Hexed Weapon Pact of the Blade: Flail Pact of the Blade: Maul Pact of the Blade: Sickle Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID PACT_BLADE , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Hexed Weapon The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical and uses the warlock's Charisma modifier. When the warlock attacks with this weapon, there is a chance that Hexblade's Curse will be applied to the target. Pact Weapon The warlock bound to this weapon is always Proficient with it. The weapon's damage is magical. The weapon uses the caster's Charisma modifier for Attack Rolls and damage rolls. Prevents the weapon from being dropped or otherwise disarmed.

## Hideous Laughter (Condition)
- **来源**: [Hideous Laughter (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Hideous_Laughter_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Hideous Laughter Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. At the end of its turn or when it takes damage, the entity can try to shake off the effect. Prone ,  Unconscious Properties Status groups : SG_Prone , SG_Condition , SG_Unconscious Loses duration : end of turn More properties : InitiateCombat Notes Hideous Laughter uses Prone as a parent status, and as such inherits the following status groups: SG_Prone, SG_Condition, SG_Unconscious . Legendary Resistance: Incapacitation , via the script AppliesCrowdControlStatus() , checks for SG_Prone and SG_Unconscious and as such correctly triggers on cast attempts for Hideous Laughter. Unlike ordinary prone, this condition cannot be cleared with the Help action. Sources of Hideous Laughter Scroll of Tasha's Hideous Laughter Grim Irony Tasha's Hideous Laughter

## Hound's Omen (Condition)
- **来源**: [Hound's Omen (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Hound's_Omen_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Hound's Omen A dark omen that can be of ⁠ Acid , ⁠ Cold , ⁠ Fire , ⁠ Lightning , ⁠ Poison , or ⁠ Thunder . When damage of that type is dealt to the affected entity, the owner of the hound regains 1 Sorcery Point . Properties UID: OMEN_TECHNICAL Omen Rolling and how it functions [ edit section | visual editor ] Condition OMEN_ROLL uses a new-for-patch-8 khn function called OmenRolling() which first checks if the target already has an Omen condition applied to it of the type it is trying to apply (such as OMEN_ACID ). If the target does not, then the function calls another new-for-patch-8 khn function called RollDieAgainstPercent() , which appears to be half-implemented by Larian using the older RollDieAgainstDC() code. RollDieAgainstPercent() still has an entry for a DC value, but does not actually use it during its execution. The function then makes a dice roll of the chosen type, divides the number by 2, and checks to see if that quotient has a remainder or not. If it does not then the function returns "true", and if it does then the function returns "false". This effectively makes the RollDieAgainstPercent() function only ever return a 50/50 roll, which in the case of OMEN_ROLL ignores all the individual dice roll and DC checks and gives each Omen condition a 50/50 chance of being applied when they are rolled for. However, as Acid is the first condition rolled for, it will have a vastly higher chance (50%) of being applied than say Thunder or Poison (3.125%), which are the last conditions rolled for, due to compounding dependent probabilities. Bugged Ominous Bite [ edit section | visual editor ] Condition Percentage of Application Compounded Probability Omen of Acid 50% 50% Omen of Cold 50% 25% Omen of Fire 50% 12.5% Omen of Lightning 50% 6.25% Omen of Thunder 50% 3.125% Omen of Poison 100% 3.125% Intended Ominous Bite [ edit section | visual editor ] Condition Percentage of Application Compounded Probability Omen of Acid 16.7% 16.7% Omen of Cold 20% 16.7% Omen of Fire 25% 16.7% Omen of Lightning 33% 16.7% Omen of Thunder 50% 16.7% Omen of Poison 100% 16.7%

## Legendary Resistance (Condition)
- **来源**: [Legendary Resistance (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Legendary_Resistance_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Legendary Resistance Affected entity has a +10 bonus to its next Saving Throw . This can be used 3 times. Properties UID: LEGENDARY_RESISTANCE Notes Legendary Resistance will only trigger on saving throw rolls made directly via a SavingThrow() function, and not on rolls that are made as part of a ApplyStatus() function, nor when made within a ConditionResult() function. Additionally, since Legendary Resistance uses the IsFlatValueInterruptInteresting() function as a condition, it will not trigger when a saving throw is rolled as a 1 or a 20 due to a flaw in that function's code. If Cazador enters Sinister Lord form, he receives 99 uses of Legendary Resistance. Creatures with Legendary Resistance Balthazar Cazador Szarr Enver Gortash Har'rak Lyrthindor Manifestation of Tyranny Mystic Carrion Ptaris Sarevok Anchev Tska'an W'wargaz Brief preview +10 to next 3 saving throws

## Lightning Charges (Condition)
- **来源**: [Lightning Charges (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Lightning_Charges_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

This article is about the condition. For items that grant or interact with it, see Sparkstruck set . Lightning Charges Lightning courses through you. You have +1 to Attack Rolls and deal an additional 1 ⁠ ⁠ Lightning damage. If you gain 5 charges, they are consumed the next time you deal damage, and you deal an additional 1d8 ⁠ ⁠ Lightning DRS damage. You lose 1 charge per turn. Properties Stack ID : MAG_CHARGED_LIGHTNING Loses duration : start of turn If already applied : add to duration Notes The extra damage is added to Falling damage if the falling creature was shoved or pushed by someone with Lightning Charges. Enemies with lightning resistance do not receive the additional 1 ⁠ Lightning damage. Patch #3 changed how Lightning Charge damages enemies: For Area of Effect spells such as Shatter , the Lightning Charge damage is now dealt to every target hit. For spells with two damage components such as Ice Knife or Ice Storm , Lightning Charge damage is added to every component that damages a target. Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers with a Lightning Ancestor can no longer increase the Lightning charge damage through Elemental Affinity . Bugs The hidden technical condition which applies the lightning damage also triggers Arcane Echomalefaction and Coldbrim Chill against enemy targets. Sources of Lightning Charges Crackling with Kereska's Lightning Conductive Strikes Electric Blood Electric Veins Speedy Sparks Watersparks

## Loviatar's Love (Condition)
- **来源**: [Loviatar's Love (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Loviatar's_Love_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Loviatar's Love Pain is the path to clarity. When you have 30% Hit Points or less, you gain a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls and Wisdom Saving Throws . Properties UID: GOB_CALMNESS_IN_PAIN Stack ID : GOB_CALMNESS_IN_PAIN More properties : IgnoreResting Condition: Basking in Loviatar's Love Basking in Loviatar's Love You revel in the clarity granted by your pain. You have a +2 bonus to Attack Rolls and Wisdom Saving Throws for 3 turns. Sources of Loviatar's Love Completing Abdirak's dialogue by being hit 3 times, without succeeding the Constitution or the monk class dialogue options. Notes The condition is lost upon character death, even after being Revived. Removing the party member's armour before letting Abdirak hit them grants Ardent Apostle . It is possible read On Receiving Her Grace on the nearby table to unlock a dialogue option "I saw your book. Let me try some of those techniques" . This allows a party member to choose the Ritual Dagger or Ritual Axe instead of the mace, which changes the damage type inflicted from ⁠ Bludgeoning to ⁠ Piercing or ⁠ Slashing respectively. His original weapon, Loviatar's Scourge , becomes temporarily available for purchase when he equips any of the ritual weapons. Abdirak puts the ritual weapons back on the table afterwards.

## Mage Armour (Condition)
- **来源**: [Mage Armour (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Mage_Armour_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Mage Armour Base Armour Class is 13. Properties Stack ID : MAGE_ARMOR Status groups : SG_RemoveOnRespec Notes The normal base Armour Class is 10 + Dexterity modifier , while this changes it to 13 + Dexterity modifier . You will still get bonuses from other sources that don't change your base armour class like +1 AC robes , Bracers of Defence , Shield of Faith , etc. Gloves and Helmets marked as Light , Medium or Heavy Armour count as armour, and will prevent Mage Armour from working. Mage Armour works while wearing a Shield . Mage Armour , Draconic Resilience , Unarmoured Defence (Barbarian) , Unarmoured Defence (Monk) and Barkskin all change your base armour class and therefore does not stack. If you have multiple of these you will only get the benefit of the one that gives the most Armour Class . Mage Armour can work while in Wild Shape as long as you have no armour equipped in any slot before transforming. This effect only works on forms with a base Armour Class of less than 13. Mage Armour does not count as wearing armour for things like Unarmoured Movement , Become the Bulwark and Defence . Mind Sanctuary: Haste Affected entity has a +2 bonus to Armour Class , Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws , its Movement Speed increases by 9 m (30 ft), [ See: Bugs ] and it can take one additional Action per turn. When the condition ends, the creature becomes Lethargic . [ See: Bugs ] A Hastened creature can not use Extra Attack with its additional action. Properties UID: TAD_MIND_SANCTUARY_HASTE Status groups : SG_RemoveOnRespec Loses duration : start of turn Stack priority : 15 Honour mode Stack ID : HASTE Notes In honour mode, this is the only form of Hastened that is not ended by Slowed or similar conditions, due to having a higher stack priority. This also means receiving this condition ends all variants of Slowed or Hastened (conditions with stack ID HASTE in honour mode) and may potentially cause an already Hastened creature to become Lethargic . Bugs The in-game description says it doubles movement speed, but it actually increases it by 9 m (30 ft). The in-game description says that Lethargic is applied when the conditiion ends, however this is not the case. Properties UID: END_NETHERBRAIN_SLOW Stack ID : SLOW Loses duration : end of turn Honour mode Mindbroken creatures cannot be Hastened , and Mindbreaking a creature will end Haste. Stack ID : HASTE Stack priority : 12 Grants: Slow: Actions You can't take both an action and a bonus action. If you take an action, you lose a bonus action, and vice versa. You also can't make more than 1 attack per turn. Slow: Casting If you cast a spell that costs 1 Action , roll a d20. On 11 or higher, you hang in prepare phase and skip turn. On your next turn you must spend an action point and finish casting. If you don't have an action point, the spell is cancelled. Bugs Slow: Casting is non-functional and spells cast by slowed creatures will never be delayed. Slow: Actions does not prevent a creature from making multiple attacks unless they somehow become Slowed between attacks on their own turn. Entering ⁠ Candulhallow's Tombstones . Allowing a party member other than Shadowheart to complete the Soft-Step Trial in the ⁠ Gauntlet of Shar . Freeing Yurgir from his contract. Visiting the ⁠ Philgrave's Mansion room filled with corpses. Notes Shadowheart may automatically unequip whatever Handwear she's wearing whenever her wound triggers.

## Mystra's Blessing (Staff of Arcane Blessing) (Condition)
- **来源**: [Mystra's Blessing (Staff of Arcane Blessing) (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Mystra's_Blessing_(Staff_of_Arcane_Blessing)_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Mystra's Blessing +1d4 to Attack Rolls made with spells Properties Stack ID : UND_BLESS_STAFF_MYSTRA Status groups : SG_RemoveOnRespec Notes The in-game description of this condition is incorrect, and reads as follows: Additional 1d4 to Saving Throws and weapon attack rolls, and an additional 2d4 to spell attack rolls. In truth, the only effect is a 1d4 bonus to spell attack rolls. The full effects listed in the description correspond to the cumulative effects of the regular Bless condition coupled with this additional effect. It's possible to lose the regular Bless condition (due to the caster losing concentration ) while retaining Mystra's Blessing. In this case, the creature will be left with a 1d4 bonus to spell attack rolls and no other bonus. See also the notes for the Mystra's Blessing passive effect , which is the source of this condition. Sources of Mystra's Blessing Mystra's Blessing

## Prone (Condition)
- **来源**: [Prone (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Prone_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

This article is about the condition. For the status group, see Prone (status group) . Prone Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. Prone ,  Unconscious Properties UID: PRONE Status groups : SG_Prone , SG_Condition , SG_Unconscious Loses duration : start of turn More properties : IgnoredByImmobilized InitiateCombat DisableOverhead Sources of Prone Indefinite duration The following sources of Prone inflict the condition indefinitely. It can still be removed if the affected creature spends movement speed to get up. However, if the creature is unable to move (for example, due to Ensnared , Enwebbed , Frightened , Heavily Encumbered , Maimed , or Restrained ), it remains Prone indefinitely. Water Whip: Knock Prone Trip Attack (Ranged) Two turn duration Two turns is the typical duration for a Prone effect. Since the duration of Prone ticks down at the start of the affected creature's turn, a 2-turn duration is effectively 1 round. The exact behaviour is as follows: At the start of the affected creature's turn, the remaining duration ticks down to 1 turn. If the affected creature can spend movement speed, it does so and stands up, and the remaining turn of Prone is removed. If it cannot, it remains Prone and skips its turn. In this case, at the start of the following turn, the creature expends half of its movement speed (if able) and stands up, and Prone is removed. If Prone is caused by certain sources, such as Brutal Leap , Primal Stampede , Reverberation , or Throw , duration 1 cannot be increased to 2 before the condition ends, which usually means not until the next turn. For some other sources, such as Ice , a separate Prone condition with duration 2 can be applied. The following sources have a duration of 2 turns: Adhesive Whip Backbreaker Bite (Sabre-Toothed Tiger) Boar Charge Brutal Leap Charge (Deep Rothé) Charge (Minotaur) Crushing Flight Deadly Leap Diving Strike Grounded Thunder Strike Impulse Blast Ironbound Pursuit Lunging Bite Multiattack (Owlbear) Pounce Pounce (Alioramus) Pounce (Dilophosaurus) Pounce (Hook Horror) Primal Stampede Quake Relentless Lunge Reverberation Rolan's Thunderwave Rush (Boar) Scar of the Sirocco Slam (Ansur) Slam (Grym) Slam (Ogre) Soil-Clogged Slam Stormheart Nova Strengthened Force Tunnel Topple the Big Folk Trephination Trumpet of Blasting Volatile Cluster One turn duration The following sources inflict Prone only for 1 turn. Since the duration of Prone ticks down at the start of an affected creature's turn, the condition ends even if the creature somehow lacks the movement speed required to stand up. Since creatures typically regain their movement speed at the start of their turn, this is only relevant if the creature is also afflicted with a movement-restricting condition. Absolute Consumption Break of Dawn Bulwark Rebuke Burrow (Badger) Crushing Flight (Owlbear Wild Shape) Destructive Wave Destructive Wave: Necrotic Destructive Wave: Radiant Enraged Throw Fist of Unbroken Air Flurry of Blows: Topple Forceful Throw Gale (class action) Grease Greasy Discharge Honeyed Paws Ice Improvised Melee Weapon Improvised Melee Weapon (Bonus Action) Legion of Bees: Mighty Knockback Main Hand Attack (Steel Watcher) Merciless Crush Multiattack (Flesh) Multiattack (Steel Watcher Titan) Off Balance Repelling Protocol Reprimand Sewage Shadowjaw Bite Shield Blow Slam (Brewer Zombie, tactician) Telekinetic Thrust Throat Punch Throw Thunderous Smite Topple Trip Attack (Melee) Notes A character with the Athlete feat spends only 1.5 m (5 ft) of Movement Speed to stand up. If a character falls Prone, ending their turn, another character acting on the same turn in initiative can use the Help action to remove the Prone condition, effectively "un-skipping" that character's turn and allowing them to act normally. Concentration is still broken, however. Creatures use 50% of their available movement speed to stand up. So, knocking a creature Prone and reducing its movement speed below 50% does not prevent it from standing up and automatically skip its next turn.

To end this effect, the creature must deny its Craven Heart by bravely ending its turn within 3 m (10 ft) of Viconia without using any actions or bonus actions. False Heart Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws . To end this effect, the creature must deny its False Heart by Silencing itself. Jealous Heart Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws . To end this effect, the creature must deny its Jealous Heart by Helping an ally. Melancholy Heart Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws . To end this effect, the creature must deny its Melancholy Heart by Performing , hearing a performance, or witnessing another act that brings them joy. Prying Heart Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws . To end this effect, the creature must deny its Prying Heart by Poisoning itself. Violent Heart Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws . To end this effect, the creature must deny its Violent Heart by healing an enemy. Wayward Heart Affected entity will be automatically Critically Hit by Viconia's attacks, and it has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws . To end this effect, the creature must deny its Wayward Heart by acquiescing to Shar and aiding Viconia in combat.

## Radiating Orb (Condition)
- **来源**: [Radiating Orb (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Radiating_Orb_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

This article is about the condition. For items that grant or interact with it, see Luminous set . Radiating Orb Affected entity has -1 to Attack Rolls per remaining turn. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it. Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity makes an attack. Properties Stack ID : MAG_RADIANT_RADIATING_ORB If already applied : add to duration More properties : MultiplyEffectsByDuration Notes The bright light from this condition does not count as Daylight . Duration of the condition is limited to a maximum of Duration: 10 turns; a maximum effect of -10 to Attack Rolls from this condition. Sources of Radiating Orb Coruscation Ring Fabricated Arbalest Luminous Armour Luminous Gloves The Sacred Star Arcane Radiance Radiant Strike Radiating Orb Gloves Radiant Shockwave Illuminating Shot Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID MAG_RADIANT_RADIATING_ORB , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Lunar Radiance Affected entity has -2 to Attack Rolls . It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it. Radiating Orb Affected entity has -1 to Attack Rolls per remaining turn. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it. Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity makes an attack.

## Reeling (Condition)
- **来源**: [Reeling (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Reeling_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Reeling Recovering from receiving a terrible blow or hitting a strong metal. Has a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining. Reeling has a maximum Duration: 10 turns. Properties Stack ID : MAG_ATTACK_DEBUFF Loses duration : end of turn If already applied : add to duration Stack priority : 1 More properties : MultiplyEffectsByDuration Notes All remaining stacks of Reeling are removed on the next attack made by the Reeling creature, whether or not it hits. [ 1 ] The target of the attack makes no difference. If a creature has a Multiattack action, the attack penalty applies to all attacks in the Multiattack before the duration changes. Sources of Reeling Adamantine Backlash Adamantine Shield Heavy Hitter Intense Adamantine Backlash Footnotes [ edit section | visual editor ] ↑ Consequently, Giantbreaker is the only item capable of adding additional stacks; to receive Reeling from any of the adamantine items, a creature has to attack, clearing any previous stacks before gaining new ones. MAG_ATTACK_DEBUFF contains "RemoveConditions" "IsAttack()" and "RemoveEvents" "OnAttack" .

Properties UID: ANIMATEDEAD_ZONE Stack ID : ANIMATEDEAD_ZONE Loses duration : N/A Sources of Rejuvenating Miasma Passively affects creatures in the Mind Flayer Colony [ verify ] Notes This condition is similar to but not the same as the Glutted Catacombs condition in the Grand Mausoleum . This also applies to the Fungal Infestation ability from the Circle of Spores Druid subclass, allowing the creation of Fungal Zombies without a corpse. Due to the presence of a Restoration device in this area, which will fully recharge the resources needed to use either Animate Dead or Fungal Infestation, a theoretically unbounded number of undead followers can be created (except on Honour mode , where each Restoration device can only be used once).

The affected entity must pass a DC  13 Wisdom Saving Throw at the start of their turn or remain lured. Taking damage or being Shoved removes the condition. Luring Song The affected entity must succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw every turn or is Lured by the Harpy's song. Success grants the Resisted the Song condition for 2 turns. Resisted the Song The affected entity succeeded a Saving Throw against the harpy's Luring Song and is immune to the effects for 2 turns.

## Reverberation (Condition)
- **来源**: [Reverberation (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Reverberation_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

This topic has a community guide . This article is about the condition. For items that grant or interact with it, see Reverberation set . Reverberation Affected entity has a -1 penalty to Strength , Dexterity , and Constitution Saving Throws per remaining turn. When the entity has 5 or more turns of Reverberation, it takes 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder DRS damage and must succeed a DC  10 Constitution Saving Throw or fall Prone . The condition is removed afterward. Creatures Immune to ⁠ Thunder damage can't receive Reverberation. Properties UID: MAG_THUNDER_REVERBERATION Stack ID : MAG_THUNDER_REVERBERATION Loses duration : start of turn If already applied : add to duration More properties : MultiplyEffectsByDuration Condition: Prone Prone Duration: 2 turns CON Save ( DC  10) Can't move or take Actions , Bonus Actions , or Reactions , and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws . Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature. A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up. Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration . If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends. Notes Since the penalty to Constitution saving throws is also applied to the saving throw against being knocked Prone after stacking 5 turns of Reverberation, the DC for this saving throw is effectively 15. Bugs Despite the description, no such mechanics exist to prevent Thunder-immune creatures from receiving Reverberation. In real-time mode, none of the effects described for applying 5 or more turns occur but the duration is still capped at 5 turns. If the saving throw for Prone triggers any reaction which prompts for confirmation, Prone will not be not applied and the saving throw will not be recorded in the Combat Log regardless of the result or whether any reactions are selected. If the saving throw is caused by multiple sources of Reverberation, multiple consecutive confirmation prompts might appear instead of one, and the text line(s) which would otherwise name the involved entities will not be displayed. Sources of Reverberation Rumbling with Kereska's Thunder Arcane Echomalefaction Crackling Resonance Thunderous Conversion

## Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill (Condition)
- **来源**: [Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Ritual_Chant:_Bhaal's_Power_Word_Kill_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the Farslayer has begun chanting. It can cast Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of 55 m (183 ft) makes its enemies invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict. Properties Stack ID : LOW_BHAALTEMPLE_RITUALCHANNEL More properties : OverheadOnTurn Notes Aside from killing the Farslayer, the ritual can also be interrupted by Silencing , Stunning , or knocking him Prone . More generally, inflicting any condition from the following groups will also interrupt the ritual: Incapacitated (status group) Unconscious (status group) Frightened (status group) Fleeing (status group) Petrified (status group) Stunned (status group) Prone (status group) Sources of Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill Bhaal's Power Word Kill Ritual Creatures with Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill Ghislev Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID LOW_BHAALTEMPLE_RITUALCHANNEL , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Bloody Favour Bhaal's Chosen will be granted a profane boon at the start of every turn. Ritual Chant: Bhaal's Power Word Kill As part of the challenge to enter the temple, the Farslayer has begun chanting. It can cast Bhaal's Power Word Kill once its profane ritual ends. Exiting the Farslayer's chanting range of 55 m (183 ft) makes its enemies invulnerable to the effect. Slaying the Farslayer stops the ritual and wins the conflict. - **来源**: [Ritual Sources (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Ritual_Sources_(Condition))

Ritual Sources For each ritual source, your movement increases by 1 m (3 ft), you receive 10 temporary hit points and your attacks and spells deal an additional 1d10 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage, after draining a vampire spawn's life force. Properties UID: LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFF_001 Stack ID : LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFFS Loses duration : start of turn If already applied : replace current Stack priority : 1 Sources of Ritual Sources Each party member or allied summon [ verify ] can occupy a ritual circle to gain one stack of this condition. Cazador gains the effect of all active ritual circles not blocked by the party, up to a buff of 7 m (23 ft) to Movement Speed , 70 temporary hit points , and 7d10 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage. Notes Killing a spawn permanently disables their ritual circle. Freeing Astarion with the Help action disables his ritual circle unless recaptured by Cazador. The temporary hit points can be refreshed by stepping off a circle and back onto it. The ritual circles in front of three of the spawn provide additional buffs: Astarion – Ritual Drain: Astarion Violet – Ritual Drain: Violet Yousen – Ritual Drain: Yousen As noted in the status properties, this condition does not stack. Instead there is a unique condition associated with each possible number of sources: LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFF_001   LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFF_002   LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFF_003   LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFF_004   LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFF_005   LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFF_006   LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFF_007   Creatures with Ritual Sources Cazador Szarr Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID LOW_CAZADORSPALACE_SPAWNBUFFS , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Ritual Sources For each ritual source, your movement increases by 1 m (3 ft), you receive 10 temporary hit points and your attacks and spells deal an additional 1d10 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage, after draining a vampire spawn's life force. Sinister Lord With the ritual complete Cazador has ascended. His movement speed is permanently increased by 7 m (23 ft), his Armour Class by 5, the damage of his attacks and spells increases by 7d10 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic , and he regains 100 ⁠ ⁠ Hit Points per turn. Brief preview For each ritual source, gains +1 m (3 ft) movement , +10 temporary HP , and +1d10 necrotic damage on attacks and spells.

Rumbling with Kereska's Thunder Affected entity has resistance to ⁠ Thunder damage. Its thunder spells deal additional damage equal to its proficiency bonus . When it deals spell damage, it inflicts 2 turns of Reverberation upon the target. While attuned to Kereska's thunder, it can cast Shatter and Destructive Wave at 5th level once per short rest. Properties Stack ID : MAG_LEGENDARY_CHROMATIC_ATTUNEMENT_FIRE Loses duration : start of turn If already applied : replace current Condition: Reverberation Reverberation Duration: 2 turns Affected entity has a -1 penalty to Strength , Dexterity , and Constitution Saving Throws per remaining turn. When the entity has 5 or more turns of Reverberation, it takes 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder DRS damage and must succeed a DC  10 Constitution Saving Throw or fall Prone . The condition is removed afterward. Creatures Immune to ⁠ Thunder damage can't receive Reverberation. Notes The in-game tooltip says this effect inflicts 1 turn of Reverberation, but it actually inflicts 2 turns. Applying Reverberation can only occur once per attack. A spell hitting multiple targets like Shatter will only apply the condition to a single target. Bugs Additional damage is added solely based on the DamageType flag of the action used. It does not actually check that the action was a spell. ## Shadow Curse (Condition)
- **来源**: [Shadow Curse (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Shadow_Curse_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

See also: Shadow Curse Shadow Curse Without a light source, you will take 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage every turn. This damage doubles each turn the party members are affected by the Shadow Curse. Properties Stack ID : SCL_SAFE Loses duration : end of turn Stack priority : 1 More properties : DisableCombatlog IgnoreResting Condition: Umbral Influx Umbral Influx Duration: 1 turn Tendrils of shadow engulf the corpse, until it becomes unclear where the body ends and the shadows begin. Notes When a member of the party is affected by the Shadow Curse, the game automatically enters Turn-Based Mode. Damage from the Shadow Curse caps out at 16d4 (16~64) ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic per turn. NPCs and enemies that are not already undead receive the condition Umbral Influx when killed, then revive with half their HP and the Shadow-Cursed Undead condition if killed without protection from it. Effective means of avoiding the Shadow Curse include: Lit Torches , nearby braziers, and other environmental light sources Spells that emit light, such as Light , Dancing Lights , Produce Flame , or Daylight Pieces of magical equipment that naturally emit light, such as The Blood of Lathander Blessing of Selûne Pixie Blessing A Moonlantern or Shadow Lantern carried in the active weapon set or placed on the ground nearby. Using Remove Curse to remove the condition. However, leaving and re-entering an affected area re-applies the condition. [ 1 ] Within deeper pockets of the Shadow Curse, such as the area surrounding the Reithwin Town waypoint, weaker light sources may be immediately snuffed out. In these areas, only a Pixie Blessing , Moonlantern or Shadow Lantern prevents the Shadow Curse from affecting the party. Enduring the Shadow Curse for two consecutive rounds without dying awards Inspiration to a character with the Outlander background. Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID SCL_SAFE , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Moonshield Protected by the light of a Moonlantern or Shadow Lantern . The Shadow Curse does not affect this entity. Pixie Blessing The Shadow Curse cannot affect this creature thanks to a pixie's protective magic. Shadow Curse Without a light source, you will take 2d4 ⁠ ⁠ Necrotic damage every turn. This damage doubles each turn the party members are affected by the Shadow Curse. ## Singing Sword: Shrieking (Condition)
- **来源**: [Singing Sword: Shrieking (Condition)](https://bg3.wiki/wiki/Singing_Sword:_Shrieking_(Condition))
- **分类**: Conditions

Singing Sword: Shrieking Enemies within 6 m (20 ft) of range have 1d4 penalty to all [ See: Bugs ] Saving Throws and Attack Rolls and take an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage. Properties Stack ID : MAG_HARPERS_SINGING_SWORD_SINGING_AURA If already applied : replace current Stack priority : 1 More properties : InitiateCombat BringIntoCombat Bugs The in-game tooltip specifies that Shriek applies the penalty to mental Saving Throws but it actually applies to all saving throws and attack rolls. The 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage does not trigger items or effects which require thunder damage, such as Hat of Storm Scion's Power , Gloves of Belligerent Skies , or Prophecy: Thunderous Applause regardless of whether the character triggering the damage has the item/effect or is the character activating Phalar Aluve: Shriek . This is because the thunder damage dealt to the enemy is from a passive effect placed on the enemy, rather than originating from the attacker which is necessary to trigger any such items or effect. This effect is changed in Honour difficulty, and functions as expected. Sources of Singing Sword: Shrieking Phalar Aluve: Shriek Conditions with the same stack ID Conditions with the stack ID MAG_HARPERS_SINGING_SWORD_SINGING_AURA , only one of these can be applied at the same time: Condition Effects Singing Sword: Shrieking Enemies within 6 m (20 ft) of range have 1d4 penalty to all [ See: Bugs ] Saving Throws and Attack Rolls and take an additional 1d4 ⁠ ⁠ Thunder damage. Singing Sword: Singing All allies within 6 m (20 ft) of range have 1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws .
